Further Insights

The train connects Howrah and Kamakhya, improving overnight rail travel.

It is fully air-conditioned and designed for long-distance comfort.

The service was launched on 17 January 2026.

It features 16 modern sleeper coaches.

The inauguration was part of a larger rail and infrastructure event in Malda.

questions.question: What is the main objective of "Project PARI" (Public Art of India), launched by the Ministry of Culture?
questions.question_hi: "प्रोजेक्ट PARI" (भारत की सार्वजनिक कला), जिसे संस्कृति मंत्रालय द्वारा शुरू किया गया है, का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?

options.label: A
options.text: To teach digital skills to traditional artists.
options.text_hi: पारंपरिक कलाकारों को डिजिटल कौशल सिखाने के लिए।

options.label: B
options.text: To improve the look of cities by promoting Indian art in public spaces.
options.text_hi: सार्वजनिक स्थानों में भारतीय कला को बढ़ावा देकर शहरों की सुंदरता में सुधार करने के लिए।

options.label: C
options.text: To create a national database for GI-tagged handicrafts.
options.text_hi: जीआई-टैग्ड हस्तशिल्प के लिए एक राष्ट्रीय डेटाबेस बनाने के लिए।

options.label: D
options.text: To sell historical artifacts through public auctions.
options.text_hi: सार्वजनिक नीलामी के माध्यम से ऐतिहासिक कलाकृतियों को बेचने के लिए।

questions.correct_text: To improve the look of cities by promoting Indian art in public spaces.
questions.solution:
Project PARI (Public Art of India) was launched by the Ministry of Culture to beautify urban areas by showcasing traditional Indian art forms in public spaces.

It aims to:

Promote Indian folk and tribal art

Integrate traditional art into modern city landscapes

Provide visibility and recognition to artists

GI tagging is handled under the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), not Project PARI.

Further Insights

Public art improves cultural awareness in urban areas.

Folk and tribal artists gain national exposure through such initiatives.

Cultural branding enhances tourism appeal.

Urban art projects strengthen local identity.

questions.question:
With reference to the mural paintings of Ajanta and Ellora, consider the following statements:

i) The Ajanta murals were made using the fresco-secco technique and mainly depict the life of Buddha and Jataka stories.

ii) While Ajanta paintings are mainly Buddhist in theme, Ellora reflects a multi-religious character including Hindu and Jain influences.
questions.question_hi:
अजंता और एलोरा की भित्ति चित्रों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) अजंता की भित्ति चित्र फ्रेस्को-सेक्को तकनीक का उपयोग करके बनाई गई थीं और मुख्य रूप से बुद्ध के जीवन और जातक कथाओं को दर्शाती हैं।

ii) जबकि अजंता की चित्रकारी मुख्य रूप से बौद्ध थीम की है, एलोरा एक बहुधार्मिक चरित्र को दर्शाता है जिसमें हिंदू और जैन प्रभाव शामिल हैं।

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

Statement (i) is Correct:

The murals of Ajanta Caves were executed mainly using the fresco-secco technique (painting on dry plaster).

They primarily depict:

The life of Gautama Buddha

Jataka tales (stories of Buddha's previous births)

Statement (ii) is Correct:

Ajanta caves are exclusively Buddhist.

However, the Ellora Caves are unique because they include:

Buddhist caves

Hindu caves (like the Kailasa temple)

Jain caves

Further Insights

Ajanta caves date from 2nd century BCE to 6th century CE.

Ellora caves were built between 6th and 10th centuries CE.

The Kailasa temple at Ellora is carved from a single rock.

Both sites are UNESCO World Heritage Sites.

Ajanta paintings are known for expressive eyes and natural colors.

questions.question: Which of the following is considered the most significant military achievement of the Lodi Sultanate under Bahlul Lodi?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा बहलुल लोदी के अधीन लोदी सुल्तानate की सबसे महत्वपूर्ण सैन्य उपलब्धि मानी जाती है?

options.label: A
options.text: The successful defense against the final Mongol invasions from the Northwest.
options.text_hi: उत्तर-पश्चिम से अंतिम मंगोल आक्रमणों के खिलाफ सफल रक्षा।

options.label: B
options.text: The annexation of the Sharqi Dynasty of Jaunpur in 1479.
options.text_hi: 1479 में जौनपुर की शार्की वंश की अधिग्रहण।

options.label: C
options.text: The conquest of the Deccan and the subjugation of the Vijayanagara Empire.
options.text_hi: दक्कन की विजय और विजयनगर साम्राज्य का अधीनता।

options.label: D
options.text: The final destruction of the Rajput Confederacy at the Battle of Khanwa.
options.text_hi: खानवा के युद्ध में राजपूत संघ की अंतिम विनाश।

questions.correct_text: The annexation of the Sharqi Dynasty of Jaunpur in 1479.
questions.solution:
The most important military success of Bahlul Lodi was the annexation of the Sharqi Dynasty of Jaunpur in 1479.

This victory ended a powerful and long-standing rival kingdom in North India and strengthened the political authority of the Lodi Sultanate.

The Sharqi rulers had often challenged Delhi's authority. By defeating them, Bahlul Lodi:

Reunified large parts of North India

Eliminated a strong regional rival

Consolidated Afghan power in the Indo-Gangetic plain

Further Insights

The Lodi dynasty was the last ruling family of the Delhi Sultanate before the Mughals.

Bahlul Lodi was the first Afghan ruler of Delhi.

The fall of the Lodi dynasty occurred after the First Battle of Panipat (1526).

Jaunpur was known as the "Shiraz of India" due to its cultural development.

questions.question:
With reference to how a fluorescent lamp works, consider the following statements:

i) The lamp creates ultraviolet (UV) light by exciting mercury vapor with an electric current.

ii) The white light we see is produced when phosphor powder on the glass tube absorbs UV light and glows.
questions.question_hi:
फ्लोरोसेंट लैंप कैसे काम करता है, इसके संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) लैंप विद्युत धारा के साथ पारा वाष्प को उत्तेजित करके पराबैंगनी (UV) प्रकाश उत्पन्न करता है।

ii) जो सफेद प्रकाश हम देखते हैं वह तब उत्पन्न होता है जब कांच की ट्यूब पर फॉस्फर पाउडर UV प्रकाश को अवशोषित करता है और चमकता है।

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is Correct:

Inside a fluorescent lamp, there is low-pressure mercury vapor. When electric current passes through it, the mercury atoms get excited and emit ultraviolet (UV) radiation.

Statement (ii) is Correct:

The inside of the tube is coated with phosphor powder. This phosphor absorbs the invisible UV light and converts it into visible white light.

Further Insights

Fluorescent lamps are more energy-efficient than incandescent bulbs.

The ballast in the lamp controls current flow.

UV radiation inside the tube is invisible to human eyes.

Phosphor composition determines the shade of white light.

Compact Fluorescent Lamps (CFLs) work on the same principle.

questions.question: Which of the following Pulitzer Prize-winning books by Dr. Siddhartha Mukherjee is known as a "Biography of Cancer"?
questions.question_hi: डॉ. सिद्धार्थ मुखर्जी द्वारा लिखित निम्नलिखित पुलित्जर पुरस्कार विजेता पुस्तकों में से कौन सी "कैंसर का जीवनी" के रूप में जानी जाती है?

options.label: D
options.text: Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance
options.text_hi: बेहतर: एक सर्जन के प्रदर्शन पर नोट्स

questions.solution:
The correct answer is The Emperor of All Maladies, written by Siddhartha Mukherjee.

This book is famously described as a "biography of cancer" because it traces:

The historical understanding of cancer

The evolution of cancer treatment

Scientific breakthroughs in oncology

It won the Pulitzer Prize for General Nonfiction in 2011.

Further Insights

The book was adapted into a PBS documentary.

Siddhartha Mukherjee is an oncologist and researcher.

The Pulitzer Prize is a prestigious American literary award.

Cancer research evolved significantly in the 20th century.

questions.question: Which of the following bodies is responsible for determining and maintaining the "Laws of the Game" in association football?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा निकाय एसोसिएशन फुटबॉल में "खेल के नियमों" को निर्धारित करने और बनाए रखने के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is International Football Association Board (IFAB).

IFAB is the official body responsible for creating and amending the "Laws of the Game" in association football.

It works in collaboration with FIFA, but the authority to change the rules lies with IFAB.

Further Insights

IFAB was established in 1886, before FIFA was formed.

FIFA has 4 votes in IFAB; the UK associations share 4 votes.

A 3/4 majority is required to change a rule.

VAR was introduced into the Laws of the Game through IFAB approval.

questions.question:
With reference to the role of mountain passes in trade and commerce, consider the following statements:

i) Mountain passes like the Khyber Pass were historically important trade routes connecting Central Asia and the Indian subcontinent.

ii) In the modern era, passes such as Nathu La are completely closed for trade and function only as military posts.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
व्यापार और वाणिज्य में पर्वतीय दर्रों की भूमिका के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) खैबर दर्रा जैसे पर्वतीय दर्रे ऐतिहासिक रूप से मध्य एशिया और भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप को जोड़ने वाले महत्वपूर्ण व्यापार मार्ग थे।

ii) आधुनिक युग में, नाथू ला जैसे दर्रे पूरी तरह से व्यापार के लिए बंद हैं और केवल सैन्य पोस्ट के रूप में कार्य करते हैं।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: A
options.text: Both i and ii are correct
options.text_hi: दोनों i और ii सही हैं

options.label: B
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is correct.

The Khyber Pass has historically served as a key trade and invasion route between Central Asia and the Indian subcontinent. It connected traders, armies, and cultures for centuries.

It formed part of broader trans-Asian trade networks, including routes associated with the Silk Road system.

Why Statement (ii) is Incorrect:

The Nathu La is not completely closed for trade.

It was reopened in 2006 for border trade between India and China. While it has military importance, it also allows limited commercial exchange.

Further Insights

Mountain passes reduce travel distance across high ranges.

Many historical invasions into India occurred through the northwest passes.

Nathu La lies in Sikkim and connects to Tibet.

Trade through high-altitude passes is seasonal due to weather.

Strategic passes influence both economic and defense policies.

questions.question:
Regarding the structural and philosophical transition from the Planning Commission to NITI Aayog, consider the following statements:

i) The Planning Commission primarily followed a centralized "Top-Down" planning model.

ii) NITI Aayog emphasizes a "Bottom-Up" approach by incorporating inputs from states into national policy formulation.

iii) NITI Aayog has statutory status similar to that of the Planning Commission.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
योजना आयोग से नीति आयोग तक संरचनात्मक और दार्शनिक संक्रमण के संबंध में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) योजना आयोग मुख्य रूप से एक केंद्रीकृत "टॉप-डाउन" योजना मॉडल का पालन करता था।

ii) नीति आयोग "बॉटम-अप" दृष्टिकोण पर जोर देता है जो राज्यों से राष्ट्रीय नीति निर्माण में इनपुट शामिल करता है।

iii) नीति आयोग की वैधानिक स्थिति योजना आयोग के समान है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements i and ii are correct, while iii is incorrect.

The Planning Commission operated under a centralized framework where the Union government determined national priorities and allocated funds to states - a classic Top-Down model.

NITI Aayog, on the other hand, was established in 2015 to promote cooperative federalism and Bottom-Up planning. It seeks state participation in policy design rather than imposing centrally crafted Five-Year Plans.

Statement iii is incorrect because neither the Planning Commission nor NITI Aayog had/have constitutional or statutory status - both were created by executive resolution.

Further Insights

The Planning Commission was established in 1950 by executive resolution.

NITI Aayog was formed in 2015 to replace Five-Year Plans with flexible strategy frameworks.

NITI Aayog promotes Competitive Federalism alongside Cooperative Federalism.

Unlike the Planning Commission, NITI Aayog does not allocate funds to states.

The Governing Council of NITI Aayog includes all Chief Ministers and Lt. Governors.

questions.question: The Human Development Index (HDI) measures a country's development based on certain factors. Which of the following is NOT included in the standard HDI calculation?
questions.question_hi: मानव विकास सूचकांक (HDI) कुछ कारकों के आधार पर एक देश के विकास को मापता है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा मानक HDI गणना में शामिल नहीं है?
questions.solution:
The Human Development Index (HDI) is published by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).

HDI is based on three dimensions:

Life expectancy at birth (health)

Access to knowledge (education indicators)

GNI per capita (standard of living)

Environmental sustainability and human rights are not directly included in the standard HDI formula.

Further Insights

HDI was introduced in 1990 by UNDP.

It was developed by economist Mahbub ul Haq.

Amartya Sen contributed to the capability approach behind HDI.

There is also an Inequality-adjusted HDI (IHDI).

questions.question: By which Act was the title "Governor-General of Bengal" changed to "Governor-General of India"?
questions.question_hi: किस अधिनियम द्वारा "बंगाल के गवर्नर-जनरल" का शीर्षक "भारत के गवर्नर-जनरल" में बदल दिया गया?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the Charter Act of 1833.

This Act made a major constitutional change. It:

Changed the title from Governor-General of Bengal to Governor-General of India.

Centralized legislative powers in India.

Made the Governor-General the head of the entire British Indian administration.

After this Act, Lord William Bentinck became the first Governor-General of India.

Regulating Act of 1773

This Act created the post of Governor-General of Bengal (first held by Warren Hastings),

Charter Act of 1813

This Act ended the East India Company's trade monopoly (except tea and China trade)

Government of India Act of 1858

This Act transferred power from the East India Company to the British Crown after the Revolt of 1857. It introduced the post of Viceroy, not Governor-General of India.

Further Insights

The Regulating Act of 1773 was the first step toward parliamentary control over the East India Company.

The Charter Act of 1833 ended the Company's commercial activities completely.

The Government of India Act of 1858 marked the beginning of Crown Rule.

Centralization increased significantly after 1833.

The Viceroy represented the British Crown after 1858.

questions.question:
With reference to Manu Bhaker's performance at the Paris 2024 Olympic Games, consider the following statements:

i) She became the first athlete of independent India to win two medals in a single edition of the Summer Olympics.

ii) Both of her medals were won in individual events, specifically the women's 10m air pistol and the women's 25m pistol categories.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
पेरिस 2024 ओलंपिक खेलों में मनु भाकर के प्रदर्शन के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) वह स्वतंत्र भारत की पहली खिलाड़ी बनीं जिन्होंने एक ही संस्करण के ग्रीष्मकालीन ओलंपिक्स में दो पदक जीते।

ii) उनके दोनों पदक व्यक्तिगत प्रतियोगिताओं में जीते गए थे, विशेष रूप से महिला 10 मीटर एयर पिस्टल और महिला 25 मीटर पिस्टल श्रेणियों में।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is correct.

At the Paris 2024 Summer Olympics, Manu Bhaker became the first athlete of independent India to win two medals in a single edition of the Summer Olympics.

Statement (ii) is wrong.

Manu Bhaker won:

One medal in the women's 10m air pistol (individual event)

One medal in the 10m air pistol mixed team event

She did not win both medals in individual categories, and she did not win a medal in the women's 25m pistol at Paris 2024.

Further Insights

Shooting has been one of India's strongest Olympic sports in recent decades.

Mixed team shooting events were introduced to promote gender balance.

Olympic shooting events are governed globally by the ISSF.

Independent India began Olympic participation in 1948.

questions.question:
In the following question, a statement of Assertion (A) is followed by a statement of Reason (R). Choose the correct option:

Assertion (A): A State law is not automatically invalid merely because it incidentally touches a subject mentioned in the Union List.

Reason (R): Under the Doctrine of Pith and Substance, the validity of a law depends on its real nature and main objective, not on its incidental overlap with another list.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में, एक कथन 'दावा (A)' के बाद एक कथन 'कारण (R)' दिया गया है। सही विकल्प चुनें:

दावा (A): एक राज्य कानून अपने आप अवैध नहीं होता केवल इसलिए कि वह संयोगवश संघ सूची में उल्लिखित विषय को छूता है।

कारण (R): पिथ और सब्सटेंस के सिद्धांत के तहत, किसी कानून की वैधता उसके वास्तविक स्वरूप और मुख्य उद्देश्य पर निर्भर करती है, न कि उसके संयोगवश किसी अन्य सूची के साथ ओवरलैप पर।

options.label: A
options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R सही हैं, और R, A की सही व्याख्या है।

options.label: B
options.text: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R सही हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options.label: C
options.text: A is true, but R is false.
options.text_hi: A सही है, लेकिन R गलत है।

options.label: D
options.text: A is false, but R is true.
options.text_hi: A गलत है, लेकिन R सही है।

questions.correct_text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
questions.solution:
Both the Assertion and the Reason are true.

And the Reason correctly explains the Assertion.

The Doctrine of Pith and Substance is used to determine whether a law falls within the legislative competence of a legislature. If the main subject of the law is within the State List, then the law is valid - even if it incidentally affects a Union List subject.

So, the State law will not become invalid just because of minor or incidental encroachment.

Further Insights

The Doctrine of Pith and Substance evolved from Canadian constitutional law.

It is applied when there is an apparent conflict between legislative lists.

Article 246 of the Indian Constitution distributes legislative powers.

questions.question:
Match the following Soil Types (List I) with their Characteristics (List II):

List I (Soil Type)List II(Characteristic)
i) Alluvial Soil1. High salt content and lack of humus
ii) Black Soil2. Red colour due to iron in crystalline rocks
iii) Red and Yellow Soil3. High water-retaining capacity and self-ploughing nature 4.
iv) Arid Soil5. High fertility; rich in potash but poor in phosphorus

Choose the correct code:
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित मिट्टी के प्रकार (सूची I) को उनके गुणों (सूची II) के साथ मिलाएं:

सूची I (मिट्टी का प्रकार)सूची II (गुण)
i) अलुवियल मिट्टी1. उच्च लवण सामग्री और ह्यूमस की कमी
ii) काली मिट्टी2. क्रिस्टलीय चट्टानों में लोहा होने के कारण लाल रंग
iii) लाल और पीली मिट्टी3. उच्च जल धारण क्षमता और स्व-हल चलाने वाली प्रकृति 4.
iv) शुष्क मिट्टी5. उच्च उर्वरता; पोटाश में समृद्ध लेकिन फॉस्फोरस में गरीब

सही कोड चुनें:
questions.solution:
i) Alluvial Soil → 4

Alluvial soil is very fertile. It is rich in potash and lime but generally deficient in phosphorus.

ii) Black Soil → 3

Black soil (also called Regur soil) has high clay content.

Retains moisture for long periods

Develops cracks in summer (self-ploughing nature)

iii) Red & Yellow Soil → 2

Its red colour comes from iron oxide in crystalline rocks.

iv) Arid Soil → 1

Arid soil is found in desert regions.

High salt content

Low humus

Poor fertility

Further Insights

Alluvial soil covers the Indo-Gangetic plains.

Black soil is common in the Deccan Plateau.

Red soil develops in areas of low rainfall.

Arid soil is mainly found in Rajasthan.

Soil colour often indicates mineral composition.

questions.question:
With reference to Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India, consider the following statements:

i) The main objective of GST is to remove the "cascading effect," which means charging tax on top of another tax.

ii) GST removes tax-on-tax by allowing businesses to claim Input Tax Credit (ITC) on taxes paid on inputs.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में वस्तु और सेवा कर (GST) के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) GST का मुख्य उद्देश्य "कास्केडिंग प्रभाव" को हटाना है, जिसका अर्थ है एक कर पर दूसरे कर का आरोपित होना।

ii) GST कर-पर-कर को हटाता है जिससे व्यवसायों को इनपुट पर भुगतान किए गए करों पर इनपुट टैक्स क्रेडिट (ITC) का दावा करने की अनुमति मिलती है।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Both statements are correct.

The Goods and Services Tax (GST) was introduced to create a unified indirect tax system and remove the cascading effect of taxes.

Earlier, multiple indirect taxes (like VAT, excise, service tax) were charged separately, often leading to tax on tax.

GST solves this through Input Tax Credit (ITC).

ITC allows businesses to deduct the tax they already paid on raw materials or services from the tax they owe on final products.

Further Insights

GST was implemented in India on 1 July 2017.

It is governed under Article 246A of the Constitution.

GST Council decides tax rates and rules.

GST includes CGST, SGST, and IGST components.

GST aims to create "One Nation, One Tax" structure.

questions.question: A hydroponic system uses a thin, continuous flow of nutrient-rich water through slightly sloped channels so that plant roots get both nutrients and oxygen. Which system is being described?
questions.question_hi: एक हाइड्रोपोनिक सिस्टम पौधों की जड़ों को पोषक तत्व और ऑक्सीजन दोनों प्रदान करने के लिए हल्के ढलान वाली नालियों के माध्यम से पोषक तत्वों से भरपूर पानी के पतले, निरंतर प्रवाह का उपयोग करता है। किस सिस्टम का वर्णन किया जा रहा है?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Nutrient Film Technique (NFT).

In NFT, a thin layer (film) of nutrient solution continuously flows through narrow channels. The roots are partially submerged in the flowing solution and partially exposed to air.

This ensures:

Constant nutrient supply

Proper oxygen availability

Efficient water use

Deep Water Culture (DWC)

In DWC, plant roots are fully submerged in a nutrient solution, usually with air pumped in through an air stone.

Aeroponics

In aeroponics, roots hang in air and are sprayed with nutrient mist.

Ebb and Flow (Flood and Drain)

This system floods the growing tray with nutrient solution and then drains it at intervals.

Further Insights

NFT is widely used for growing leafy vegetables like lettuce.

Hydroponics uses up to 90% less water than traditional farming.

Aeroponics allows faster growth due to higher oxygen exposure.

DWC systems are simple and suitable for beginners.

questions.question:
With reference to the monetary policy framework of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), consider the following statements:

i) Since 2014, the RBI has shifted its primary nominal anchor for inflation targeting from the Consumer Price Index (CPI-Combined) to the Wholesale Price Index (WPI).

ii) The switch to WPI was motivated by the fact that it more accurately reflects the cost of living and the inflationary pressures experienced by the end consumer compared to CPI.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (RBI) की मौद्रिक नीति ढांचे के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) 2014 से, RBI ने मुद्रास्फीति लक्ष्य निर्धारण के लिए अपना प्राथमिक नाममात्र लंगर उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक (CPI-समेकित) से थोक मूल्य सूचकांक (WPI) में स्थानांतरित कर दिया है।

ii) WPI में स्विच करने का कारण यह था कि यह CPI की तुलना में अंतिम उपभोक्ता द्वारा अनुभव किए जाने वाले जीवन यापन की लागत और मुद्रास्फीति दबावों को अधिक सटीक रूप से दर्शाता है।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: A
options.text: Both i and ii are correct
options.text_hi: दोनों i और ii सही हैं

options.label: B
options.text: Both i and ii are incorrect
options.text_hi: दोनों i और ii गलत हैं

questions.correct_text: Both i and ii are incorrect
questions.solution:
Both statements are incorrect.

India formally adopted a flexible inflation targeting framework in 2016 after the amendment to the RBI Act, and the Reserve Bank of India uses CPI (Combined) as the primary nominal anchor - not WPI.

The RBI did not shift from CPI to WPI.

In fact, it shifted emphasis from WPI to CPI.

Since 2016, the RBI has adopted CPI (Combined) as the primary nominal anchor under the Flexible Inflation Targeting (FIT) framework.

CPI reflects the actual consumption basket of households and includes services, making it a better measure of inflation faced by citizens.

Further Insights

The inflation target (4% ± 2%) is set by the Central Government in consultation with RBI.

The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) decides policy rates.

CPI includes food, fuel, housing, and services; WPI excludes services.

WPI is more sensitive to global commodity price shocks.

India formally adopted inflation targeting following the Urjit Patel Committee recommendations.

questions.question: For which specific group of people was the "Paripoorna Mediclaim Ayush Bima Yojana" launched in January 2026?
questions.question_hi: जनवरी 2026 में "परिपूर्ण मेडिक्लेम आयुष बीमा योजना" किस विशिष्ट समूह के लोगों के लिए शुरू की गई थी?

options.label: A
options.text: All citizens living below the poverty line (BPL)
options.text_hi: गरीबी रेखा के नीचे रहने वाले सभी नागरिक (बीपीएल)

options.label: B
options.text: Beneficiaries of the Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS)
options.text_hi: केंद्रीय सरकार स्वास्थ्य योजना (सीजीएचएस) के लाभार्थी

options.label: C
options.text_hi: केवल सेवानिवृत्त भारतीय सेना के कर्मी

questions.correct_text: Beneficiaries of the Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS)
questions.solution:
The Paripoorna Mediclaim Ayush Bima is a health insurance scheme launched for beneficiaries of the Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) - mainly central government employees, pensioners, and their dependents enrolled under CGHS.

Further Insights

The policy offers up to ₹20 lakh coverage and includes AYUSH treatments.

It provides a cashless facility at network hospitals nationwide.

The scheme is designed to complement, not replace, existing CGHS benefits.

It can cover up to six family members under one policy.

questions.question: Which of the following is/are a secondary storage device?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा/से सेकेंडरी स्टोरेज डिवाइस है/हैं?
questions.solution: Secondary Storage Devices: Secondary storage is a memory that is stored external to the computer. It is mainly used for the permanent and long-term storage of programs and data. Hard Disk, CD, DVD, Pen/Flash drive, SSD, etc, are examples of secondary storage.

questions.question: Which port is associated with audio input and output and is often used for connecting microphones and headphones?
questions.question_hi: कौन-सा पोर्ट ऑडियो इनपुट और आउटपुट से जुड़ा होता है और अक्सर माइक्रोफोन और हेडफ़ोन को जोड़ने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution: The 3.5mm audio jack is commonly used for audio input and output, making it suitable for connecting microphones and headphones.

questions.question:
With reference to network access layers, consider the following statements:

i) An intranet acts as a controlled bridge allowing authorized external users (like vendors or partners) to access specific parts of an organization's internal network.

ii) The Internet is the most public layer, while the intranet is the most secure and inner layer, accessible only to internal members.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
नेटवर्क एक्सेस लेयर्स के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) एक इंट्रानेट एक नियंत्रित ब्रिज के रूप में कार्य करता है जो अधिकृत बाहरी उपयोगकर्ताओं (जैसे विक्रेता या साझेदार) को संगठन के आंतरिक नेटवर्क के विशिष्ट हिस्सों तक पहुंचने की अनुमति देता है।

ii) इंटरनेट सबसे सार्वजनिक परत है, जबकि इंट्रानेट सबसे सुरक्षित और आंतरिक परत है, जो केवल आंतरिक सदस्यों के लिए सुलभ है।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कौन से कथन सही हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is Incorrect:

Statement (i) is wrong because the network that allows authorized external users (like vendors or partners) to access limited internal resources is called an Extranet, not an Intranet.

An intranet is meant strictly for internal organizational use.

Statement (ii) is Correct:

The Internet is the largest and most public network - accessible globally.

The Intranet is a private internal network used within an organization and is considered the most secure and inner layer.

Further Insights

Intranets often use firewalls for protection.

Extranets improve business collaboration with partners.

The Internet uses public IP addresses.

VPNs can allow secure remote access to intranets.

Cybersecurity measures differ across Internet, intranet, and extranet layers.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of modifier keys?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प मॉडिफाइर की (key) का एक उदाहरण है?
questions.solution:
· Modifier Keys - It is a special key (key combination) that temporarily modifies the normal action of another key when pressed together. Shift, Alt, Ctrl, Fn are modifier keys.

· Shift: used for capitalizing letters and entering different types of symbols.

· Function (Fn): Other functions such as brightness and volume control.

· Control (Ctrl): used for entering keyboard shortcuts, such as Ctrl+S, Ctrl+P etc.

· Alt: used in combination with the numeric keys and the Control key for entering keyboard shortcuts.

questions.question: Which component of the computer stores data and instructions in current use that the CPU can directly access?
questions.question_hi: कंप्यूटर का कौन-सा घटक वर्तमान उपयोग वाले डेटा और निर्देशों को संग्रहीत करता है जिसे CPU प्रत्यक्ष रूप से एक्सेस कर सकता है?
questions.solution: RAM is a primary memory that stores data and instructions in current use that the CPU can directly and quickly access. It provides temporary storage for the data and instructions needed during the execution of programs.

questions.question: Which of the given devices is not an Input Device?
questions.question_hi: दिए गए डिवाइसों में से कौन-सा एक इनपुट डिवाइस नहीं है?
questions.solution:
Microphone is an input device to input sound that is then stored in a digital form

Keyboard and Mouse are input devices.

Monitor, Speakers and Printer are output devices. Any device has to be connected to the CPU to receive or send information.

questions.question: Which of the following units saves the data And instructions for further uses?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी यूनिट आगे के उपयोग के लिए डेटा और निर्देश को सेव करती है?
questions.solution: A storage unit is a part of the computer system which is employed to store the information and instructions to be processed. A storage device is an integral part of the computer hardware which stores information/data to process the result of any computational work. Without a storage device, a computer would not be able to run or even boot up. Or in other words, we can say that a storage device is hardware that is used for storing, porting, or extracting data files. It can also store information/data both temporarily and permanently.

questions.question: Which of the following type of computer has all the features of a large sized computer but is smaller in physical size?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस प्रकार के कंप्यूटर में बड़े आकार के कंप्यूटर की सभी विशेषताएँ होती हैं, लेकिन भौतिक आकार में छोटा होता है?
questions.solution:
A minicomputer is a type of computer that possesses most of the features and capabilities of a large computer but is smaller in physical size.

A minicomputer fills the space between the mainframe and microcomputer and is smaller than the former but larger than the latter. Minicomputers are mainly used as small or mid-range servers operating business and scientific applications.

A minicomputer may also be called a mid-range computer.

questions.question:
With reference to Cryptographic and Encryption Utilities (e.g., BitLocker), consider the following statements:

i) These utilities use mathematical ciphers to scramble data, making it unreadable without the correct decryption key or password.

ii) Encryption utilities are available only as third-party software because modern operating systems do not have built-in disk encryption features.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
क्रिप्टोग्राफिक और एन्क्रिप्शन यूटिलिटीज़ (जैसे, बिटलॉकर) के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) ये यूटिलिटीज़ डेटा को स्क्रैम्बल करने के लिए गणितीय सिफर का उपयोग करती हैं, जिससे सही डिक्रिप्शन कुंजी या पासवर्ड के बिना इसे पढ़ना असंभव हो जाता है।

ii) एन्क्रिप्शन यूटिलिटीज़ केवल थर्ड-पार्टी सॉफ़्टवेयर के रूप में उपलब्ध हैं क्योंकि आधुनिक ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम में बिल्ट-इन डिस्क एन्क्रिप्शन फीचर्स नहीं होते।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is Correct:

Encryption tools like BitLocker use advanced mathematical algorithms (such as AES - Advanced Encryption Standard) to convert readable data into unreadable encrypted form.

Only someone with the correct password or decryption key can access the original data.

Statement (ii) is Incorrect:

Modern operating systems already have built-in encryption tools.

For example:

Windows includes BitLocker.

macOS includes FileVault.

So encryption is not limited to third-party software.

Further Insights

AES-256 is commonly used for strong encryption.

Full-disk encryption protects data even if the device is stolen.

Encryption does not prevent malware - it protects stored data.

TPM (Trusted Platform Module) enhances hardware-level security.

questions.question: Which of the following programming languages mainly follows the Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concept, where almost everything is treated as an object?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी प्रोग्रामिंग भाषा मुख्य रूप से ऑब्जेक्ट-ओरिएंटेड प्रोग्रामिंग (OOP) अवधारणा का पालन करती है, जहाँ लगभग हर चीज़ को एक ऑब्जेक्ट के रूप में माना जाता है?
questions.solution:
Python is strongly based on the Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) paradigm.

In Python:

Numbers are objects

Strings are objects

Lists are objects

Functions are also objects

Almost everything is treated as an object.

C

C is mainly a procedural programming language, not object-oriented.

COBOL

COBOL is mainly used for business applications and is procedural in nature.

Fortran

Traditional Fortran is procedural. Though modern versions support OOP features, it is not fundamentally object-based like Python.

Further Insights

OOP is based on concepts like classes and objects.

Key OOP principles include encapsulation and inheritance.

Java is also a strongly object-oriented language.

C++ supports both procedural and object-oriented programming.

OOP improves code reusability and modularity.

questions.question: The OSI model used in computer networking is divided into how many layers?
questions.question_hi: कंप्यूटर नेटवर्किंग में उपयोग किया जाने वाला OSI मॉडल कितनी परतों में विभाजित है?
questions.solution:
The OSI (Open Systems Interconnection) Model has 7 layers.

These layers are:

Physical

Data Link

Network

Transport

Session

Presentation

Application

Further Insights (One-Liners):

The OSI model was developed by ISO.

The TCP/IP model has fewer layers than OSI.

The Transport layer ensures reliable data delivery.

The Network layer handles IP addressing.

The Physical layer deals with cables and signals.

questions.question: Which of the following is a web browser?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक वेब ब्राउज़र है?
questions.solution: Safari is a web browser developed by Apple based on the WebKit engine. First released in 2003 with Mac OS X Panther, a mobile version has been included in iOS devices since the introduction of the iPhone in 2007. It is the default browser on Apple devices. A Windows version, now discontinued, was available from 2007 to 2012.

questions.question: Which of the following Menu is also called as a 'Drop-down Menu'?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस मेनू को 'ड्रॉप-डाउन मेनू' भी कहा जाता है?
questions.solution: Pull-Down Menu is also called as 'Drop-Down Menu'. A drop-down menu is a menu that offers a list of options. The title of the menu, or the currently-selected item in the list, is always displayed. When the visible item is clicked, other items from the list "drop down" into view, and the user can choose from those options.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of an impact printer?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प इम्पैक्ट प्रिंटर का उदाहरण है?
questions.solution: Impact printers generally utilize hammers, pins, or wheels to hit against an inked ribbon to print on paper. Non-impact printers use a spray of ink, laser, or heat and pressure to execute their printing operation. Examples of impact printers are Dot-matrix printers, Daisy-wheel printers, and Line printers. Examples of Non-Impact Printers are Inkjet printers, Thermal printers, and Laser printers.

questions.question: Which of the following function keys is a Universal Help key in almost every Windows program?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी फ़ंक्शन की लगभग प्रत्येक विंडोज़ प्रोग्राम में यूनिवर्सल हेल्प की है?
questions.solution:
F1: Universal Help in almost every Windows program.

F1 is considered the universal shortcut for help. Almost all programs instantly bring up the help or support menu if you press F1. In Windows, pressing Windows key with F1 will bring you the Microsoft's universal Windows Help and Support.

questions.question: What is the shortcut key to select an entire row in MS Excel?
questions.question_hi: एमएस एक्सेल में एक संपूर्ण रो (row) को सिलेक्ट करने के लिए शॉर्टकट की (key) क्या है?
questions.solution: The shortcut key to select an entire row in Microsoft Excel is Shift + Spacebar. When we press Shift + Spacebar, it highlights the entire row where the active cell is located. This selection makes it easy to perform actions on the entire row, such as copying, formatting, or deleting it. It is a useful shortcut when working with large datasets in Excel.

questions.question: Which of the following is/are can be signs that a computer is infected with virus?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा/से एक कंप्यूटर के वायरस से संक्रमित होने का/के संकेत हो सकता/सकते है/हैं?

options.label: B
options.text: Mass emails being sent from one's email account
options.text_hi: किसी के ईमेल अकाउंट से बड़े स्तर पर ईमेल का भेजा जाना

options.label: C
options.text_hi: असामान्य रूप से धीमा कंप्यूटर प्रदर्शन

questions.solution:
A computer virus attack can produce a variety of symptoms like:

· Frequent pop-up windows

· Changes to your homepage

· Mass emails being sent from one's email account

· Frequent crashes

· Unusually slow computer performance

· Unknown programs that start up when computer is turned on

· Unusual activities like password changes

questions.question: The speed of the modern CPUs are indicated in:
questions.question_hi: आधुनिक सीपीयू की चाल ____ में दर्शाई जाती है।
questions.solution: The clock rate typically refers to the frequency at which a chip like a central processing unit (CPU), one core of a multi-core processor, is running and is used as an indicator of the processor's speed. It is measured in clock cycles per second or its equivalent, the SI unit hertz (Hz), the clock rate of the first generation of computers was measured in hertz or kilohertz (kHz), but in the 21st century the speed of modern CPUs is commonly advertised in gigahertz (GHz). This metric is most useful when comparing processors within the same family, holding constant other features that may affect performance. Video card and CPU manufacturers commonly select their highest performing units from a manufacturing batch and set their maximum clock rate higher, fetching a higher price.

questions.question: What does "D" represent in DoF Mouse?
questions.question_hi: DoF माउस में "D" का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
questions.solution:
Six Degrees of Freedom (6DOF) refers to the specific number of axes that a rigid body is able to freely move in three-dimensional space. It defines the number of independent parameters that define the configuration of a mechanical system. 6 DoF Mouse is being used in Virtual Reality (VR) technology.

Another example of an object that has 6DOF is an airplane. It can move freely in three-dimensional space, with the two horizontal axes as X and Z while the vertical axis is Y.

questions.question:
Match the Excel Function (List I) with its correct Use (List II):

List I (Excel Function)List II (Use/Condition)
i) VLOOKUP1. Changes cell appearance based on rules
ii) IF Function2. Finds a value in a column and returns data from the same row
iii) COUNTIF3. Performs a logical test and returns one value for TRUE and another for FALSE
iv) Conditional Formatting4. . Counts cells that meet a specific condition

Choose the correct code:
questions.question_hi:
Excel फ़ंक्शन (सूची I) को उसके सही उपयोग (सूची II) के साथ मिलाएं:

सूची I (Excel फ़ंक्शन)सूची II (उपयोग/शर्त)
i) VLOOKUP1. नियमों के आधार पर सेल की उपस्थिति बदलता है
ii) IF Function2. एक कॉलम में मान खोजता है और उसी पंक्ति से डेटा लौटाता है
iii) COUNTIF3. एक तार्किक परीक्षण करता है और TRUE के लिए एक मान और FALSE के लिए दूसरा मान लौटाता है
iv) Conditional Formatting4. किसी विशिष्ट शर्त को पूरा करने वाले सेल की गिनती करता है

सही कोड चुनें:
questions.solution:
i) VLOOKUP → 2

VLOOKUP searches for a value in the first column of a table and returns related data from the same row.

ii) IF Function → 3

The IF function checks a condition and gives one result if TRUE and another if FALSE.

iii) COUNTIF → 4

COUNTIF counts how many cells satisfy one specific condition.

iv) Conditional Formatting → 1

Conditional Formatting automatically changes cell colors or styles based on conditions.

Further Insights

VLOOKUP works vertically; HLOOKUP works horizontally.

COUNTIFS applies multiple conditions.

IF can be nested for complex logical tests.

Conditional Formatting updates automatically when data changes.

XLOOKUP is a modern replacement for VLOOKUP in newer Excel versions.

questions.question: The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 78 years. Seven years ago, the ratio of their ages was 3 : 1. What is the son's present age?
questions.question_hi: पिता और उसके पुत्र की वर्तमान आयु का योग 78 वर्ष है। सात वर्ष पहले, उनकी आयु का अनुपात 3 : 1 था। पुत्र की वर्तमान आयु क्या है?
questions.solution:
Let F and S be their present ages (in years).

Formula:

F + S = 78

(F - 7) / (S - 7) = 3 / 1

From the ratio:

F - 7 = 3(S - 7)

F - 7 = 3S - 21

F = 3S - 14

Substitute into F + S = 78:

(3S - 14) + S = 78

4S - 14 = 78

4S = 92

S = 23

Thus the son's present age is 23 years.

questions.solution:
Area of remaining circular sheet = 64π cm2

Radius of remaining circular sheet = √(64π/π) = 8 cm

For rings -

a = 1 cm, d = 1.5 cm, n = 5

Sum of widths = 5/2 * [2*1 + (5 - 1)*1.5]

= 5/2 * 8

= 20

Radius of the original circular sheet = 8 + 20 = 28 cm

questions.question: A shopkeeper borrows Rs. 40000 at simple interest and lends the same amount at a rate 50% higher than his borrowing rate. If he earns a net profit of Rs. 1000 from interest transactions over 2 years, what was his borrowing rate per annum?

questions.solution:
Formula: SI = (P X R X T) / 100

Let borrowing rate = r%; lending rate = 1.5r%

Borrowers' interest cost = 40000 X r X 2/100 = 800r

Lenders' interest gain = 40000 X 1.5r X 2/100 = 1200r

Profit = 1200r − 800r = 400r = 1000 ⟹ r = 1000/400 = 2.5%

questions.question: The height of a right circular cone is 200% more than its base radius. If the volume of the cone is 3375π cm3, what is the difference between the height and the radius?

Let the radius of the cone be r cm

Height of cone, h = r * 300/100 = 3r cm

Volume of cone = 1/3 π r2 h

3375π = 1/3 π r2 X 3r

r3 = 3375

r = 15 cm

h = 45 cm

Hence, the required difference = 45 − 15 = 30 cm

questions.question: A vessel contains water and milk in the ratio of 23:17. Find the part of the mixture that must be drawn off and replaced with milk so that the quantity of water and milk in the mixture is equal.
questions.question_hi: एक पात्र में पानी और दूध का अनुपात 23:17 है। मिश्रण का वह भाग ज्ञात करें जिसे निकालकर दूध से प्रतिस्थापित किया जाए ताकि मिश्रण में पानी और दूध की मात्रा समान हो जाए।
questions.solution:
Let the quantity of mixture replaced with milk be X litres

Quantity of water in new mixture = 23 - 23X/40

Quantity of milk in new mixture = 17 - 17X/40 + X

23 - 23X/40 = 17 - 17X/40 + X

X + 6X/40 = 6

23X = 120

X = 120/23

So, replaced part of the mixture = (120/23) * (1/40) = 3/23

questions.question: 12 men and 6 women can complete a job in 4 days, while 8 men and 12 women can do the same job in 3 days. How many days will a woman alone require to finish the job?
questions.question_hi: 12 पुरुष और 6 महिलाएं एक काम को 4 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं, जबकि 8 पुरुष और 12 महिलाएं वही काम 3 दिनों में कर सकती हैं। एक महिला को अकेले काम पूरा करने में कितने दिन लगेंगे?
questions.solution:
Let m, w = daily rates of a man, woman.

12m + 6w = 1/4 => 48m + 24w = 1.

8m + 12w = 1/3 => 24m + 36w = 1.

Subtract second from first: (48m - 24m) + (24w - 36w) = 0 => 24m - 12w = 0 => m = w/2.

Substitute m into 48m + 24w = 1:

48(w/2) + 24w = 24w + 24w = 48w = 1 => w = 1/48.

Woman alone = 48 days.

questions.question: In ΔABC, D and E are the points on sides AB and AC, respectively and DE || BC. BC = 24 cm and DE = 20 cm. If the area of ΔABC = 324 cm2, then what is the area of ΔADE?

324/Area ∆ADE = (24/20)2

324/Area of ∆ADE = (6/5)2

Area of ∆ADE = 324 * 25/36 = 225 cm2

questions.question: A sector of a circle has a central angle of 45° and another sector of the same circle has a central angle of 60°. If the difference between the area of first sector and the area of the second sector is 57.75 cm2, then find the radius of the circle.

questions.question: A regular pyramid that has a square base of side 14 cm, has a height of 176cm. The Volume of a pyramid is equal to the volume of a sphere. What is the total surface area (in cm2) of the sphere?

questions.solution:
Side of the square base = 14 cm, height of the pyramid = 176cm.

A.T.Q

Volume of pyramid = volume of sphere

(1/3) * height * Area of base = (4/3) * 22/7 * r3

(14 X 14 X 176)/3 = (22/7) (4/3) r3

r3 = 2744

Or, r = 14

Total surface area of the sphere = 4* (22/7) * r2 = 4(22/7) X 14 X 14 = 2464cm2

questions.question:
Which of the following can be the variance and standard deviation of a given data respectively?

(A) 0.09, 0.81

(B) 0.64, 0.8

(C) 121, 11
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा क्रमशः दिए गए डेटा का विचरण और मानक विचलन हो सकता है?

(A) 0.09, 0.81

(B) 0.64, 0.8

(C) 121, 11
questions.solution:
We know that standard deviation of observations is equal to square root of variance of those observations.

From (A),

Variance = 0.09

Standard deviation = √0.09 = 0.3

Hence, (A) is not correct.

From (B),

Variance = 0.64

Standard deviation = √0.64 = 0.8

Hence, (B) is correct.

From (C),

Variance = 121

Standard deviation = √121 = 11

Hence, (C) is correct.

questions.question: A rectangular foam block of dimensions 24 cm X 18 cm X 12 cm is cut completely into smaller cubes, each of side 6 cm. How many small cubes are obtained?

questions.solution:
Formula: Number of small cubes = (L/a) X (B/a) X (H/a)

Let L = 24 cm, B = 18 cm, H = 12 cm, and a = 6 cm.

Number of cubes along length = L/a = 24/6 = 4

Number of cubes along breadth = B/a = 18/6 = 3

Number of cubes along height = H/a = 12/6 = 2

Total small cubes = 4 X 3 X 2 = 24

b2 = 4a2p2

From equation (2)-

b2 = 4a2 * (c/a)

b2 = 4a2p2

questions.question:
A committee of 6 members is to be formed from 7 boys and 8 girls.

What is the probability that the committee consists of exactly 3 boys and 3 girls?
questions.question_hi:
7 लड़कों और 8 लड़कियों में से 6 सदस्यों की एक समिति बनाई जानी है।

समिति में ठीक 3 लड़के और 3 लड़कियां होने की संभावना क्या है?
questions.solution:
Total people = 15

The number of ways to select boys = 7C3 = (7 * 6 * 5 * 4!)/(3 * 2 * 4!)

= 35

The number of ways to select girls = 8C3 = (8 * 7 * 6 * 5!)/(3 * 2 * 5!)

= 56

Hence, the required probability = (35 * 56)/15C6

= (35 * 56)/[(15 * 14 * 13 * 12 * 11 * 10)/(6 * 5 * 4 * 3 * 2)]

= (35 * 56)/5005

questions.question: Three dice are thrown, the probability of getting an even number on the first dice, a prime number on the second dice, and a composite number on the third dice.
questions.question_hi: तीन पासे फेंके जाते हैं, पहले पासे पर सम संख्या, दूसरे पासे पर अभाज्य संख्या, और तीसरे पासे पर संयुक्त संख्या आने की संभावना।
questions.solution:
Outcome of 1st dice = 2, 4, 6 = 3

Probability of 1st dice = 3/6 = 1/2

Outcome of 2nd dice = 2, 3, 5 = 3

Probability of 2nd dice = 3/6 = 1/2

Outcome of 3rd dice = 4, 6 = 2

Probability of 3rd dice = 2/6 = 1/3

Hence, the required probability = ½ * ½ * 1/3 = 1/12

questions.question:
If the signs ÷, - , x, + sequentially replace the * signs in the given three equations, then which of the following options is correct?

Equation I: 143 * 11 * 3 * 5 * 6 = P

Equation II: 42 * 3 * 9 * 7 * 50 = Q

Equation III: 34 * 2 * 8 * 3 * 10 = R
questions.question_hi:
यदि संकेत ÷, - , x, + क्रमशः दिए गए तीन समीकरणों में * संकेतों की जगह लेते हैं, तो निम्नलिखित विकल्पों में से कौन सा सही है?

समीकरण I: 143 * 11 * 3 * 5 * 6 = P

समीकरण II: 42 * 3 * 9 * 7 * 50 = Q

समीकरण III: 34 * 2 * 8 * 3 * 10 = R
questions.solution:
If the signs ÷, - , x, + are sequentially replace the * signs in the given three equations, then the equations will be:

Equation I: 143 ÷ 11 - 3 x 5 + 6 = P

So, 13 - 3 x 5 + 6 = P

13 - 15 + 6 = P

19 - 15 = P

So, P = 4.

Equation II: 42 ÷ 3 - 9 x 7 + 50 = Q

14 - 9 x 7 + 50 = Q

14 - 63 + 50 = Q

64 - 63 = Q

So, Q = 1.

Equation III: 34 ÷ 2 - 8 x 3 + 10 = R

17 - 8 x 3 + 10 = R

17 - 24 + 10 = R

27 - 24 = R

So, R = 3.

Thus, P > R > Q. So, option (a) is correct.

'D 22 E' का अर्थ है D, E की बेटी है।

'D 33 E' का अर्थ है D, E की बहू है।

'D 44 E' का अर्थ है D, E की माँ है।

यदि एक परिवार में छह सदस्य हैं, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा/से कथन 'S 33 Z 44 O 22 P 11 X 22 V' अभिव्यक्ति के संदर्भ में सही है/हैं?

options.label: B
options.text: P is the father of V.

options.label: C
options.text: S is the wife of V.

questions.solution:
It is given that,

'D 11 E' means D is the grandfather of E.

'D 22 E' means D is the daughter of E.

'D 33 E' means D is the daughter-in-law of E.

'D 44 E' means D is the mother of E.

After decoding the given expression, we get:

S 33 Z 44 O 22 P 11 X 22 V

S is the daughter-in-law of Z. Z is the mother of O. O is the daughter of P. P is the grandfather of X. X is the daughter of V.

There are six members in a family.

So, both options (b) and (c) are true.

तर्क I: हाँ, इससे कूड़ा कम होगा और जानवरों को होने वाले नुकसान में कमी आएगी, और यह उपभोक्ताओं को पुन: उपयोग योग्य विकल्पों की ओर प्रेरित करता है।

तर्क II: नहीं, कपड़े या जूट के बैग ले जाना कई खरीदारों के लिए स्टाइलिश नहीं लगता।

options.label: D
options.text: Both arguments I and II are strong

questions.solution:
Argument I is directly connected to the reason bans are considered (pollution and harm) and gives a sensible effect (shift to reusables).

Argument II is based on personal taste and fashion, which is not a strong policy reason against an environmental ban.

So, only Argument I is strong.

questions.question:
Which of the following is correct?

Statement I: The sum of two mixed fractions can always be expressed as a mixed fraction.

Statement II: The product of any non-zero mixed fraction and its reciprocal is always 1.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही है?

वक्तव्य I: दो मिश्रित भिन्नों का योग हमेशा एक मिश्रित भिन्न के रूप में व्यक्त किया जा सकता है।

वक्तव्य II: किसी भी गैर-शून्य मिश्रित भिन्न और उसके व्युत्क्रम का गुणनफल हमेशा 1 होता है।

options.label: A
options.text: Statement I is true, Statement II is true
options.text_hi: वक्तव्य I सत्य है, वक्तव्य II सत्य है

options.label: B
options.text: Statement I is true, Statement II is false
options.text_hi: वक्तव्य I सत्य है, वक्तव्य II असत्य है

options.label: C
options.text: Statement I is false, Statement II is true
options.text_hi: वक्तव्य I असत्य है, वक्तव्य II सत्य है

options.label: D
options.text: Statement I is false, Statement II is false
options.text_hi: वक्तव्य I असत्य है, वक्तव्य II असत्य है

questions.correct_text: Statement I is false, Statement II is true
questions.solution:
A mixed fraction is of the form m + a/b, where m is a whole number and 0 < a/b < 1.

Statement I:

Take; 1(1/2) and 2(1/2)

1(1/2) + 2(1/2) = 3 + 0 = 3, which is a whole number, not a mixed fraction.

So, Statement I is false.

Statement II:

Let 'a' be any non-zero mixed fraction.

The reciprocal of a is 1/a.

a X (1/a) = 1

So, Statement II is true.

questions.question:
A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.

The chief of police said, "Our social media monitoring team swung into action within seconds."

options.label: A
options.text: The chief of police said that their social media monitoring team had swing into action within seconds.

options.label: B
options.text: The chief of police said that ours social media monitoring team had swung into action within seconds.

options.label: C
options.text: The chief of police said that their social media monitoring team had swung into action within seconds.

options.label: D
options.text: The chief of police said that their social media monitoring team had been swung into action within seconds.

questions.correct_text: The chief of police said that their social media monitoring team had swung into action within seconds.
questions.solution:
The sentence in the Direct Speech is in Past Simple. Therefore, the sentence in the Indirect Speech should be in Past Perfect Tense.

Past Simple (Subject + V2 + Object) should be converted into Past Perfect (Subject + had + V3 + Object).

For example:

He said, "Arya sent me a book." (Direct Speech)

He said that Arya had sent him a book. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

· The inverted commas are replaced with 'that'.

· The possessive determiner 'our' is changed into 'their'.

· The verb 'swung' (past simple) is changed into 'had swung' (past perfect).

Therefore, the correct answer is: c) The chief of police said that their social media monitoring team had swung into action within seconds.

questions.question: The speaker's tone was condescending, which offended many members of the audience. What is the ANTONYM of 'condescending'?
questions.solution:
"Condescending" means having or showing a superior attitude toward others.

The opposite is "humble", which means modest and respectful.

Option (a) Patronizing means treating someone with apparent kindness but displaying superiority; same as condescending.

Option (c) Boastful means bragging or showing excessive pride; not the opposite, but still negative.

Option (d) Dismissive means showing disregard or lack of interest; unrelated to attitude of superiority.

Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

P. Exercise has to be coupled with a healthy diet for better results.

Q. This gives rise to a pressing concern - what to eat, as in a country like India where the fitness industry is fairly new, people are not as well versed in the art of dieting practises.

R. Exercising comes in many forms: weightlifting, running, Zumba, body weight training, and Pilates are some popular exercise routines.

S. To solve this concern is a pre-workout snack or meal, which is a popular term in the field of exercising and is considered crucial for better results, but the average Indian does not consume such foods.
questions.solution:
The correct order is RPQS.

Statements R & S are the only independent sentences out of the given statements.

However, statement S cannot be the first sentence of the paragraph because it forms a mandatory pair (QS) with Q; hence, statement R is the first sentence of the paragraph.

Statement R is followed by P because it gives further details on exercising to get better results.

Statement P is then followed by Q which asks the question of what to eat for better results and mentions the fact that Indians lack art of dieting.

Statement S follows Q as it states the solution to solve the concern mentioned in statement Q.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. From protest songs and murals to performance art and digital media, artists highlight injustices and inspire collective action.

B. Iconic works like Picasso's "Guernica" and the street art of Banksy capture the zeitgeist of their times, influencing public opinion and rallying support for causes.

C. It transcends language barriers, evoking emotions and spreading messages of resistance, hope, and solidarity.

D. Art has played a crucial role in social movements by acting as a powerful tool for expression and communication.
questions.solution: After reading all the sentences thoroughly, we can determine that sentence D should be placed first as it introduces the role of art in social movements. Sentence C should come next as it elaborates on the impact of art. So, 'D' and 'C' form a pair. Sentence A follows, providing examples of how different forms of art are used to highlight injustices and inspire action. Sentence B should be placed last as it references iconic works that capture the spirit of their times and influence public opinion. Therefore, the correct order is option (a) DCAB.

questions.question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts - P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

1. At about half-past ten the cracked bell of the small church began to ring. P: The Sunday-school children distributed themselves about the house and occupied pews with their parents. Q: Presently the people began to gather for the morning sermon. R: Aunt Polly came, and Jim and Sid and Mary sat with her. S: Jim sat next to the aisle, in order that he might be as far away from the open window. 6. The outside summer scenes would distract him.
questions.solution: The passage begins with 1 telling us about the ringing of the church bell. Q follows by telling us what this bell rang for, and what happened next. P follows, establishing continuity with Q, as Q talks about people, while P refers to children. R and S are a pair: R talks about specific characters, Aunt Polly, Jim, Sid and Mary, and S continues by building more on one of those characters. 6 ends the passage, and also establishes continuity with the S, as it tells us why Jim sat away from the window. So, the final order is QPRS.

questions.question:
Arrange the sentence parts:

(A)achieving such a feat/ (B) an elite club of nations/ (C)would see India enter/ (D) a successful mission
questions.solution:
The correct order is DCBA.

Part D introduces the condition or outcome of a successful mission, highlighting the importance of achieving success.

Part C describes the consequence or effect of a successful mission, stating that it would lead to India entering or joining something.

Part B specifies the group or category that India would become a part of, emphasizing it as an elite club of nations.

Part A provides additional information about the accomplishment or achievement, highlighting that the nations in the elite club have achieved a similar feat.

By arranging these parts in the given order, the sentence forms a coherent and meaningful statement.

Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.

The rearranged sentence is: A successful mission would see India enter an elite club of nations achieving such a feat.

questions.question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate tense:

By the time the inspection begins, the team ____ on the same case for seventy-two hours.
questions.solution:
"By the time .. begins" sets a clear future point.

The action (working) continues up to that future point for a duration (seventy-two hours).

So we need future perfect continuous: Option C: will have been working.

Grammar rule: By the time + Present Simple → Future Perfect

Use future perfect continuous for an action continuing up to a future time with a duration.

Example: "By 6 PM, I will have been studying for three hours."

· Option A is wrong because simple present doesn't show "duration up to a future point" here.

· Option B is wrong because "will work" does not clearly show continuous duration until that point.

· Option D is wrong because "had been working" is used for past reference, not future.

Final sentence: By the time the inspection begins, the team will have been working on the same case for seventy-two hours.

questions.question:
Fill in the blank with appropriate prepositions:

The emergency switch is hidden ____ the control panel for safety.
questions.solution:
The sentence describes location relative to a single object ("the control panel").

Option a: behind correctly shows "at the back of" the panel.

Grammar rule: Use "behind" to show something is at the back of another object.

Example: "The file is behind the monitor."

· Option b is wrong because "between" needs two items (between X and Y).

· Option c is wrong because "across" suggests movement or position from one side to another.

· Option d is wrong because "among" is used for more than two items in a group, not a single panel.

Final sentence: The emergency switch is hidden behind the control panel for safety.

Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate phrasal verb:

The editor asked the writer to ____ the opening paragraph because it sounded repetitive.
questions.solution:
The sentence needs a phrasal verb meaning "make it less strong/less intense."

Option (b): tone down means reduce strength, harshness, or intensity.

Grammar rule: Many phrasal verbs have fixed meanings that cannot be guessed word-by-word.

Example: "Please tone down your voice in the library."

· Option a is wrong because "put off" means postpone.

· Option c is wrong because "pull through" means recover from illness/difficulty.

· Option d is wrong because "set up" means arrange or establish, not reduce repetition.

Final sentence: The editor asked the writer to tone down the opening paragraph because it sounded repetitive.

Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which spelling is correct for a collection of various different items?
questions.solution:
The correct spelling is b) Miscellaneous.

Miscellaneous is an adjective that means consisting of a variety of things; a mixture of different items or types. It is often used to describe a group of objects that are not easily categorized together.

questions.question:
Choose the correct indirect speech of the following sentence:

My sister said to me, "Don't watch that movie."

options.label: A
options.text: My sister forbade me to watch this movie.

options.label: B
options.text: My sister forbade to me to watch that movie.

options.label: C
options.text: My sister forbade me to watch that movie.

options.label: D
options.text: My sister forbid me to watch that movie.

questions.correct_text: My sister forbade me to watch that movie.
questions.solution:
Imperative Sentences sometimes begin with Negative Commands like "Don't"

"Forbade" is sometimes used while transforming Direct Speech into Indirect Speech.

The construction (Forbid/Forbade + Object + to + Verb) is used.

For example:

My friend said to me, "Don't read this novel." (Direct Speech)

My friend forbade me to read that novel. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

"Said to me" should be changed to "forbade me".

"Don't" will be removed and "to" will be added before the principal verb ("watch").

Therefore, the correct answer is option c): My sister forbade me to watch that movie.

questions.question:

She seemed to reminisce about the keenest of her memories, for her face was alive with old hurts and pleasures.

options.label: B

Reminisce: to recall past experiences, events, etc. with pleasure

Among the given options, 'to fondly recollect memories of the past' is the correct option that matches the meaning of the underlined word.

Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

Option (d) is the correct answer. The correct spelling is 'supplementary'.

Obsolete: no longer produced or used; out of date.

questions.question:
Convert the sentence into passive voice.

Burn all the negative thoughts and the materialistic desires that cost us our mental health.

options.label: A
options.text: The negative thoughts and the materialistic desires that cost us our mental health will have to be burned.

options.label: B
options.text: The negative thoughts and the materialistic desires that cost us our mental health should have been burned.

options.label: C
options.text: You are requested to burn all the negative thoughts and the materialistic desires that cost us our mental health.

options.label: D
options.text: All the negative thoughts and the materialistic desires that cost us our mental health should be burned.

questions.correct_text: All the negative thoughts and the materialistic desires that cost us our mental health should be burned.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive Voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

The usage of a helping verb is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

The question in Active voice is in the imperative form.

An imperative sentence is used to express order, request, suggestion, etc.

They begin with a principal verb.

Here, the imperative sentence in Active voice is a suggestion.

The format in Active voice is: V1 + Object.

Thus, the format in Passive voice will be: Subject (Objective case) + should + be + V3.

For example:

Help the survivors of the war. (Active)

The survivors of the war should be helped. (Passive)

Option (c) is incorrect because the sentence in the Active voice is not a request.

The options except (d) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: (d) All the negative thoughts and the materialistic desires that cost us our mental health should be burned.

questions.question:
Choose the correct active voice form of the sentence:

"The critical evidence needed for the high-profile case had been carefully hidden by the clever witness before the trial began."

options.label: A
options.text: The clever witness was carefully hiding the critical evidence needed for the high-profile case before the trial began.

options.label: B
options.text: The clever witness has carefully hidden the critical evidence needed for the high-profile case before the trial began.

options.label: C
options.text: The clever witness had carefully hidden the critical evidence needed for the high-profile case before the trial began.

options.label: D
options.text: The clever witness hid the critical evidence needed for the high-profile case before the trial began.

questions.correct_text: The clever witness had carefully hidden the critical evidence needed for the high-profile case before the trial began.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" verb ['been' in the given sentence] and the preposition "by" is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

The Passive voice in this question is in Past Perfect. Thus, the Active voice will also be in Past Perfect.

In Passive voice, the format is: Object of the Active voice (Subjective case) + had + been + V3 + by + Subject of the Active voice (Objective case).

Thus, the format of Active voice is: Subject + had + V3 + Object.

For example:

She had been called by me. (Passive Voice)

I had called her. (Active Voice)

The options except (c) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (c): The clever witness had carefully hidden the critical evidence needed for the high-profile case before the trial began.

Note: V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).

questions.question:
Identify the correct type of sentence used in the line:

"When individuals possess this knowledge, they are better equipped to evaluate financial products, avoid unsustainable debt, and plan for future needs such as education, home ownership, or retirement."
questions.solution:
The clause "When individuals possess this knowledge" contains a subject "individuals" and a verb "possess," but it begins with "When," making it a dependent clause.

The clause "they are better equipped to evaluate financial products, avoid unsustainable debt, and plan for future needs" is an independent clause with subject "they" and verb phrase "are better equipped."

Since the sentence contains one dependent clause and one independent clause, it is a complex sentence.

Hence, option (b) is correct.
questions.passage:
Directions : Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

Financial literacy is increasingly regarded as an essential life skill in modern societies, particularly as individuals are required to make complex decisions about saving, spending, borrowing, and investing. Unlike basic awareness of money, which often involves knowing prices or earning income, financial literacy emphasizes understanding how financial systems operate and how personal choices influence long-term stability. This includes familiarity with concepts such as budgeting, interest rates, inflation, credit scores, insurance, and risk management. When individuals possess this knowledge, they are better equipped to evaluate financial products, avoid unsustainable debt, and plan for future needs such as education, home ownership, or retirement. In the absence of financial literacy, people may rely on misinformation, impulsive decisions, or short-term solutions that undermine long-term security. Educational institutions, workplaces, and community organizations have therefore begun to recognize the importance of structured financial education. School-based programs can introduce students to responsible money management at an early age, while adult-focused initiatives often address practical issues like loan repayment, investment planning, and fraud awareness. However, implementing effective financial literacy programs is not without challenges. Socio-economic disparities, varying levels of access to banking services, and deeply ingrained spending habits can limit the impact of instruction. Moreover, financial markets and products evolve rapidly, requiring continuous learning rather than one-time exposure. Consequently, financial literacy should be viewed not as a standalone solution to economic inequality, but as a foundational tool that, when combined with supportive policies and accessible resources, enables individuals to make informed decisions and navigate financial complexity with greater confidence.

questions.question:
What is the grammatical classification of the word "This" in the sentence,

"This includes familiarity with concepts such as budgeting, interest rates, inflation, credit scores, insurance, and risk management"?
questions.solution:
In the given sentence, "This" stands independently and refers back to the entire preceding idea about "financial literacy" and what it encompasses.

It does not modify or determine any noun directly. Instead, it replaces a previously mentioned idea and functions as the subject of the verb "includes."

Words that point to and replace a noun or idea already mentioned are classified as demonstrative pronouns.

Option (a): Incorrect - a demonstrative determiner must directly precede and modify a noun, which does not occur here.

Option (b): Correct - "This" replaces a previously stated idea and functions independently.

Option (c): Incorrect - relative pronouns introduce relative clauses and refer to a noun.

Option (d): Incorrect - indefinite pronouns refer to non-specific entities, which is not the case here.

Hence, option (b) is correct.

questions.question:
Choose the sentence that uses a homonym of the underlined word:

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is grammatically correct?

options.label: A
options.text: Running through the rain, I got my shoes wet.

options.label: B
options.text: Running through the rain, my shoes got wet.

options.label: C
options.text: My shoes got wet, running through the rain.

options.label: D
options.text: I got my shoes wet, running through the rain.

questions.correct_text: Running through the rain, I got my shoes wet.
questions.solution:
The correct sentence is (a). The participial phrase "Running through the rain" correctly modifies the subject "I," who is performing both actions.

Option (b) is incorrect due to dangling modifier: "Running" seems to modify "shoes," implying shoes are running, which is illogical.

Option (c) is incorrect for the same dangling issue; the phrase doesn't clearly connect to "shoes."

Option (d) is incorrect because "I got my shoes wet" implies intentional action, but context suggests accidental wetting from rain.

Hence, the correct answer is option (a).

questions.question:

Post Office rules forbid to employees from accepting tips.
questions.solution:
'To' should not be used with the following verbs when followed by an object. Such verbs are- advise, welcome, ask, warm, forbid, order, remind, compliment, etc. So, drop 'to' from the phrase 'forbid to employees'.

The correct sentence is - "Post Office rules forbid employees from accepting tips."

Hence, option (d) is correct.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The manager in his objections said that the employee is not following the code of conduct since two months.

options.label: C
options.text: not following the code of conduct

questions.solution:
The word 'since' is used to refer to a time that has begun in the past and is still continuing. We cannot use 'since' with 'two months' as it is a period of time. The word 'for' is used to show a period of time, be it in the past, present or future. So, 'since' should be replaced with 'for' to rectify the given sentence.

The correct sentence is: The manager in his objections said that the employee is not following the code of conduct for two months.

Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.
