questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech to direct speech.

The architect said that by next year, he would have completed the design for the entire skyscraper complex, including the interiors.

options.label: A
options.text: The architect said, "By next year, I would have completed the design for the entire skyscraper complex, including the interiors."

options.label: B
options.text: The architect said, "By next year, I will have completed the design for the entire skyscraper complex, including the interiors."

options.label: C
options.text: The architect said, "By next year, he will have completed the design for the entire skyscraper complex, including the interiors."

options.label: D
options.text: The architect said, "By next year, I will complete the design for the entire skyscraper complex, including the interiors."

questions.correct_text: The architect said, "By next year, I will have completed the design for the entire skyscraper complex, including the interiors."
questions.solution:
The sentence in the Indirect Speech is in Perfect Conditional Tense. Therefore, the sentence in the Direct Speech should be in Future Perfect Tense.

Perfect Conditional (Subject + would/should + have + V3 + Object) should be converted into Future Perfect (Subject + will/shall + have + V3 + Object).

For example:

He said that he would have worked in that company. (Indirect Speech)

He said, "I will have worked in this company". (Direct Speech)

The following things in the sentence will change when changed from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:

· The conjunction 'that' is removed.

· 'He' is changed into 'I'.

· 'Would have completed' (Perfect Conditional) is changed into 'will have completed' (Future Perfect).

· Inverted commas ("..") are placed around the direct statement.

Therefore, the correct answer is: The architect said, "By next year, I will have completed the design for the entire skyscraper complex, including the interiors."

Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

Note: V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).

questions.question: Which type of adverb is the word "meticulously" in the sentence, "Expeditions were meticulously chronicled in detailed journals and illustrated accounts, fostering a growing corpus of mountaineering literature"?
questions.solution:
The word "meticulously" is an adverb of manner because it describes how the expeditions were chronicled. Adverbs of manner explain the way in which an action is performed. Here, "meticulously" conveys that the chronicling of expeditions was done with great care and precision.

(a) Adverb of frequency: indicates how often an action occurs, e.g., "frequently."

(b) Adverb of place: indicates location, e.g., "here," "there."

(d) Adverb of degree: indicates the intensity or extent of an action, e.g., "very," "extremely."

Hence, option (c) is correct.
questions.passage:
Directions : Read the following passage and answer the questions based on the passage:

Mountaineering, as a structured pursuit, traces its origins to the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries, when burgeoning interest in natural landscapes coincided with the Enlightenment's emphasis on exploration and empirical observation. Initially regarded as a perilous undertaking confined to the physically audacious, mountaineering gradually evolved into a discipline blending scientific inquiry, athletic endeavor, and aesthetic appreciation. The Alps, with their imposing peaks and glacial vistas, became the crucible in which early mountaineering techniques were forged, attracting scholars, adventurers, and aristocrats alike. Notably, the ascent of Mont Blanc in 1786 by Jacques Balmat and Michel Paccard is frequently cited as the inaugural achievement of modern alpinism, establishing a paradigm for subsequent expeditions and inspiring generations of climbers to pursue similar feats.

The nineteenth century witnessed the proliferation of mountaineering clubs and societies, such as the Alpine Club in London, which codified practices, disseminated knowledge, and facilitated international collaboration. During this period, climbers confronted not only the formidable challenges of vertical ascents and inclement weather but also the nascent understanding of physiological and technical limitations, prompting innovations in rope techniques, ice axes, and protective clothing. Expeditions were meticulously chronicled in detailed journals and illustrated accounts, fostering a growing corpus of mountaineering literature that combined narrative flair with empirical observation, thereby elevating climbing from mere adventure to a subject of scholarly interest.

By the twentieth century, mountaineering had expanded beyond the European Alps to encompass the Himalayas, Andes, and other remote ranges, precipitating feats of remarkable endurance, strategy, and ingenuity. Ascents of peaks such as Mount Everest and K2 symbolized the zenith of human aspiration, demanding meticulous planning, acclimatization, and logistical coordination. Throughout its history, mountaineering has oscillated between conquest and communion with nature, producing a rich tapestry of cultural, scientific, and philosophical insights. The discipline's evolution reflects humanity's persistent desire to interrogate the limits of physical capacity while negotiating the profound sublimity and inherent risks of the world's highest landscapes.

questions.question: Which of the following is the correct tense used in the sentence: "Mountaineering gradually evolved into a discipline blending scientific inquiry, athletic endeavor, and aesthetic appreciation"?
questions.solution:
The verb "evolved" is in the past simple tense because it describes an action that occurred and was completed in the past. The sentence narrates a historical development, referring to how mountaineering changed over time.

(a) Present simple: used for habitual actions or general truths, e.g., "Mountaineering attracts adventurers."

(b) Present continuous: used for actions happening at the moment of speaking, e.g., "Mountaineering is gaining popularity."

(c) Past continuous: used for actions that were ongoing in the past, e.g., "Mountaineers were exploring the Alps in 1786."

Hence, option (d) is correct.

questions.question: Which term in the passage is derived from Latin to mean "the process of thoroughly recording or documenting"?
questions.solution:

This conveys not only the act of recording but also the systematic and thorough nature of the documentation, which is essential for preserving knowledge, sharing techniques, and contributing to mountaineering literature.

(b) "Observation" refers to noticing or watching phenomena, often for analysis, but does not inherently imply detailed documentation.

(c) "Coordination" refers to organizing or managing activities, not recording events.

(d) "Endeavor" denotes an effort or attempt, not documentation.

Hence, option (a) is correct, as it specifically refers to the thorough recording process implied in the historical context of mountaineering.

questions.correct_text: The historical evolution and cultural significance of mountaineering
questions.solution:
The passage traces mountaineering from its origins in the eighteenth century to its global expansion in the twentieth century, highlighting not only physical and technical aspects but also scientific, cultural, and philosophical dimensions. It emphasizes how mountaineering evolved into a structured discipline, shaped by historical developments, exploration, literature, and human aspiration.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the following passage and answer the questions based on the passage:

Mountaineering, as a structured pursuit, traces its origins to the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries, when burgeoning interest in natural landscapes coincided with the Enlightenment's emphasis on exploration and empirical observation. Initially regarded as a perilous undertaking confined to the physically audacious, mountaineering gradually evolved into a discipline blending scientific inquiry, athletic endeavor, and aesthetic appreciation. The Alps, with their imposing peaks and glacial vistas, became the crucible in which early mountaineering techniques were forged, attracting scholars, adventurers, and aristocrats alike. Notably, the ascent of Mont Blanc in 1786 by Jacques Balmat and Michel Paccard is frequently cited as the inaugural achievement of modern alpinism, establishing a paradigm for subsequent expeditions and inspiring generations of climbers to pursue similar feats.

The nineteenth century witnessed the proliferation of mountaineering clubs and societies, such as the Alpine Club in London, which codified practices, disseminated knowledge, and facilitated international collaboration. During this period, climbers confronted not only the formidable challenges of vertical ascents and inclement weather but also the nascent understanding of physiological and technical limitations, prompting innovations in rope techniques, ice axes, and protective clothing. Expeditions were meticulously chronicled in detailed journals and illustrated accounts, fostering a growing corpus of mountaineering literature that combined narrative flair with empirical observation, thereby elevating climbing from mere adventure to a subject of scholarly interest.

By the twentieth century, mountaineering had expanded beyond the European Alps to encompass the Himalayas, Andes, and other remote ranges, precipitating feats of remarkable endurance, strategy, and ingenuity. Ascents of peaks such as Mount Everest and K2 symbolized the zenith of human aspiration, demanding meticulous planning, acclimatization, and logistical coordination. Throughout its history, mountaineering has oscillated between conquest and communion with nature, producing a rich tapestry of cultural, scientific, and philosophical insights. The discipline's evolution reflects humanity's persistent desire to interrogate the limits of physical capacity while negotiating the profound sublimity and inherent risks of the world's highest landscapes.

questions.question: Which of the following best explains why mountaineering evolved into a structured discipline, according to the passage?

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.text: Because cultural interest, scientific inquiry, and systematic documentation shaped its practice

options.label: D
options.text: Because technological innovations and protective gear made climbing safer and easier

questions.correct_text: Because cultural interest, scientific inquiry, and systematic documentation shaped its practice
questions.solution:
The passage highlights that mountaineering initially was a perilous pursuit but gradually evolved into a structured discipline. This change was influenced by historical and cultural interest, the growth of scientific inquiry, and careful documentation by mountaineering clubs. [first paragraph]

(a) Reaching peaks for personal fame is mentioned indirectly, but does not explain the structured development.

(b) Leisure among the elite describes participation, not the evolution into a discipline.

(d) Technological innovations helped safety, but were not the main driver of the structured system.

Hence, option (c) is correct, as it captures the combination of cultural, scientific, and systematic factors emphasized in the passage.

questions.question: The festival of Cheti Chand is celebrated by the Sindhi community to commemorate the birth anniversary of which patron saint?

questions.solution:
Cheti Chand marks the birth anniversary of Jhulelal, who is regarded as the patron saint and protector deity of the Sindhi community. The festival usually falls in the month of Chaitra (March - April).

Further Insights

· Jhulelal is also known as Varun Dev, the deity of water.

· Cheti Chand usually coincides with the Sindhi New Year.

· The festival symbolizes religious harmony and protection of faith.

questions.question: How do vaccines utilize microorganisms to protect the human body against future infections?
questions.question_hi: टीके मानव शरीर को भविष्य के संक्रमणों से बचाने के लिए सूक्ष्मजीवों का उपयोग कैसे करते हैं?

options.label: A
options.text: By introducing weakened or dead forms of a microbe to "train" the immune system to recognize the disease.
options.text_hi: रोग को पहचानने के लिए प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली को "प्रशिक्षित" करने के लिए किसी सूक्ष्मजीव के कमजोर या मृत रूपों को पेश करके।

options.label: B
options.text: By providing a high dose of active, healthy bacteria to replace the body's natural immune cells.
options.text_hi: शरीर की प्राकृतिक प्रतिरक्षा कोशिकाओं को बदलने के लिए सक्रिय, स्वस्थ बैक्टीरिया की उच्च मात्रा प्रदान करके।

options.label: C
options.text: By acting as a chemical shield that physically blocks all germs from entering the bloodstream.
options.text_hi: एक रासायनिक ढाल के रूप में कार्य करके जो शारीरिक रूप से सभी कीटाणुओं को रक्तप्रवाह में प्रवेश करने से रोकता है।

options.label: D
options.text: By permanently changing the human DNA to make the body naturally toxic to all types of fungi.
options.text_hi: मानव डीएनए को स्थायी रूप से बदलकर शरीर को सभी प्रकार के कवकों के लिए स्वाभाविक रूप से विषैला बनाने के लिए।

questions.correct_text: By introducing weakened or dead forms of a microbe to "train" the immune system to recognize the disease.
questions.solution:
Vaccines work by introducing weakened (attenuated), killed, or inactivated parts of a pathogen into the body. This exposure stimulates the immune system to produce antibodies and memory cells, enabling it to recognize and fight the actual infection in the future without causing the disease.

Further insights

· Vaccines help develop active immunity, not passive immunity.

· Memory cells formed after vaccination can last for years or even a lifetime.

· Vaccination reduces disease spread through herd immunity.

· Not all vaccines use live microbes; some use toxins or protein subunits.

· Vaccines are among the most cost-effective public health interventions.

questions.question: Under the standard tie-break game procedure in tennis, what is the minimum requirement for a player to win the tie-break and the set?
questions.question_hi: टेनिस में मानक टाई-ब्रेक खेल प्रक्रिया के तहत, टाई-ब्रेक और सेट जीतने के लिए खिलाड़ी की न्यूनतम आवश्यकता क्या है?

options.label: A
options.text: The first player to reach 6 points with a lead of at least 1 point.
options.text_hi: पहला खिलाड़ी जो कम से कम 1 अंक की बढ़त के साथ 6 अंक तक पहुंचता है।

options.label: B
options.text: The first player to reach 7 points with a lead of at least 1 point.
options.text_hi: पहला खिलाड़ी जो कम से कम 1 अंक की बढ़त के साथ 7 अंक तक पहुंचता है।

options.label: C
options.text: The first player to reach 10 points regardless of the lead.
options.text_hi: पहला खिलाड़ी जो बढ़त की परवाह किए बिना 10 अंक तक पहुंचता है।

options.label: D
options.text: The first player to reach 7 points with a lead of at least 2 points.
options.text_hi: पहला खिलाड़ी जो कम से कम 2 अंकों की बढ़त के साथ 7 अंक तक पहुंचता है।

questions.correct_text: The first player to reach 7 points with a lead of at least 2 points.
questions.solution:
In a standard tennis tie-break, a player must score at least 7 points and also have a minimum lead of 2 points over the opponent. If the score reaches 6 - 6, the tie-break continues until one player achieves a two-point advantage.

Further insights

· Tie-breaks are usually played when the set score reaches 6 - 6.

· Players change ends every 6 points during a tie-break.

· The first server serves one point, after which service alternates every two points.

· There is no upper limit to tie-break points if the 2-point lead is not achieved.

· Some Grand Slams use final-set super tie-breaks, which follow different rules.

questions.question: According to Engel's Law, as a household's income increases, what happens to the proportion (percentage) of income spent on food?
questions.question_hi: एंगेल के नियम के अनुसार, जैसे-जैसे एक परिवार की आय बढ़ती है, भोजन पर खर्च की गई आय का अनुपात (प्रतिशत) क्या होता है?
questions.solution:
Engel's Law states that as income rises, the percentage of income spent on food falls, even though the absolute amount spent on food may increase. Food is a basic necessity, so once basic needs are met, additional income is spent on non-food items like housing, education, healthcare, and recreation.

Further insights

· Engel's Law is used to assess living standards and poverty levels.

· Food expenditure has income elasticity less than one.

· As income rises, spending shifts toward luxury and service goods.

· Engel curves show the relationship between income and consumption.

questions.question:
Match List-I (Constitutional Amendment) with List-II (Major Change/Provisions) and select the correct answer using the codes given below:

List-I (Amendment) List-II (Major Change)

i) 42nd Amendment (1976) 1. Right to Property removed from

Fundamental Rights

ii) 44th Amendment (1978) 2. Added "Socialist, Secular, Integrity" to the

Preamble

iii) 52nd Amendment (1985) 3. Lowered Voting Age from 21 to 18 years

iv) 61st Amendment (1988) 4. Anti-Defection Law (10th Schedule) added

Codes:
questions.question_hi:
सूची-I (संविधान संशोधन) को सूची-II (प्रमुख परिवर्तन/प्रावधान) के साथ मिलाएं और नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनें:

सूची-I (संशोधन) सूची-II (प्रमुख परिवर्तन)

i) 42वां संशोधन (1976) 1. मौलिक अधिकारों से संपत्ति का अधिकार हटाया गया

ii) 44वां संशोधन (1978) 2. प्रस्तावना में "समाजवादी, धर्मनिरपेक्ष, अखंडता" जोड़ा गया

iii) 52वां संशोधन (1985) 3. मतदान की आयु 21 से घटाकर 18 वर्ष की गई

iv) 61वां संशोधन (1988) 4. विरोधी-दलबदल कानून (10वां अनुसूची) जोड़ा गया

कोड:
questions.solution:
42nd Amendment (1976) → Added "Socialist, Secular, Integrity" (2)

This amendment modified the Preamble, earning the name Mini Constitution.

44th Amendment (1978) → Right to Property removed from FRs (1)

Right to Property was shifted from Fundamental Rights to Article 300A (legal right).

52nd Amendment (1985) → Anti-Defection Law added (4)

Inserted the 10th Schedule to curb political defections.

61st Amendment (1988) → Voting age lowered to 18 (3)

Expanded democratic participation among youth.

Further Insights

· The 42nd Amendment was enacted during the Emergency (1975 - 77).

· The 44th Amendment restored democratic safeguards after the Emergency.

· The Anti-Defection Law aims to ensure political stability.

· Lowering voting age increased youth political participation.

questions.question: Under the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA), which change best explains how "Primary Evidence" now covers digital and electronic records?
questions.question_hi: भारतीय साक्ष्य अधिनियम (BSA) के तहत, कौन सा परिवर्तन सबसे अच्छी तरह से समझाता है कि "प्राथमिक साक्ष्य" अब डिजिटल और इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रिकॉर्ड को कैसे कवर करता है?

options.label: A
options.text: All electronic records are treated as hearsay and can be used only after oral confirmation in court.
options.text_hi: सभी इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रिकॉर्ड को hearsay माना जाता है और केवल अदालत में मौखिक पुष्टि के बाद ही उपयोग किया जा सकता है।

options.label: B
options.text: Video recordings and stored digital data are directly treated as primary evidence.
options.text_hi: वीडियो रिकॉर्डिंग और संग्रहीत डिजिटल डेटा को सीधे प्राथमिक साक्ष्य के रूप में माना जाता है।

options.label: C
options.text: Digital records are considered secondary evidence unless the original device is produced before the court.
options.text_hi: डिजिटल रिकॉर्ड को द्वितीयक साक्ष्य माना जाता है जब तक कि मूल उपकरण अदालत के सामने प्रस्तुत न किया जाए।

options.label: D
options.text: Only printed copies of digital data, certified by a gazetted officer, are treated as primary evidence.
options.text_hi: केवल गजटेड अधिकारी द्वारा प्रमाणित डिजिटल डेटा की मुद्रित प्रतियां प्राथमिक साक्ष्य के रूप में मानी जाती हैं।

questions.correct_text: Video recordings and stored digital data are directly treated as primary evidence.
questions.solution:
Under the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, electronic records such as videos, audio files, and stored digital data are explicitly recognized as primary evidence, provided their authenticity is established. This modernizes the law to reflect current digital realities.

Further Insights

· The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam replaces the Indian Evidence Act, 1872.

· It gives legal clarity to digital evidence in criminal and civil trials.

· Authenticity and integrity of electronic records remain crucial conditions.

questions.question:
With reference to Linthoi Chanambam's performance at the Judo Junior World Championships, consider the following statements:

i) She became the first Indian judoka to win a medal at the Judo Junior World Championships by securing a bronze in the 63 kg category.

ii) Under the competition's "repechage" format, she was granted a second chance to compete for the medal despite an earlier loss in the Group stage.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
जूडो जूनियर विश्व चैंपियनशिप में लिंथोई चानम्बम के प्रदर्शन के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) उन्होंने 63 किग्रा श्रेणी में कांस्य पदक जीतकर जूडो जूनियर विश्व चैंपियनशिप में पदक जीतने वाली पहली भारतीय जूडोका बनीं।

ii) प्रतियोगिता के "रिपेचाज" प्रारूप के तहत, उन्हें समूह चरण में पहले हार के बावजूद पदक के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा करने का दूसरा मौका दिया गया।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कौन से कथन सही हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Linthoi Chanambam won a bronze medal in the women's 63 kg category at the Judo Junior World Championships, marking the first time an Indian judoka stood on the podium at the event.

In judo tournaments, athletes who lose to finalists can enter the repechage bracket - giving them a second chance to fight for bronze. Linthoi advanced to the medal bout through this repechage route after losing earlier to a finalist.

Further Insights

· Repechage in judo lets competitors who lose to finalists still compete for bronze enhancing fairness in knockout formats.

· Linthoi's achievement puts India on the medal map at the Junior World Judo Championships for the first time.

questions.question: Which of the following best explains the License Raj system that existed in India before the 1991 economic reforms?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा भारत में 1991 के आर्थिक सुधारों से पहले मौजूद लाइसेंस राज प्रणाली को सबसे अच्छी तरह से समझाता है?

options.label: A
options.text: A system where the government owned all industries and private business was not allowed.
options.text_hi: एक प्रणाली जहाँ सरकार सभी उद्योगों की मालिक थी और निजी व्यवसाय की अनुमति नहीं थी।

options.label: B
options.text: A system in which private businesses needed multiple government permissions to start, expand, or decide how much to produce.
options.text_hi: एक प्रणाली जिसमें निजी व्यवसायों को शुरू करने, विस्तार करने या उत्पादन की मात्रा तय करने के लिए कई सरकारी अनुमतियों की आवश्यकता होती थी।

options.label: C
options.text: A policy that removed import duties and freely allowed foreign companies to operate in India.
options.text_hi: एक नीति जिसने आयात शुल्क हटा दिए और विदेशी कंपनियों को भारत में स्वतंत्र रूप से संचालन की अनुमति दी।

options.label: D
options.text: A system where village panchayats controlled industrial licensing and foreign trade.
options.text_hi: एक प्रणाली जहाँ ग्राम पंचायतें औद्योगिक लाइसेंसिंग और विदेशी व्यापार को नियंत्रित करती थीं।

questions.correct_text: A system in which private businesses needed multiple government permissions to start, expand, or decide how much to produce.
questions.solution:
Under the License Raj, industries had to obtain government licenses for:

· Starting a business

· Expanding production

· Setting production capacity

This led to heavy government control, delays, and reduced competition.

Further Insights

· The License Raj existed mainly from 1950 to 1991.

· It aimed to promote planned economic development.

· Excessive regulation led to inefficiency and corruption.

· The system ended with the 1991 LPG reforms.

· Dismantling the License Raj boosted competition and investment.

questions.question: Which of the following personalities holds the distinction of being the first woman from the Indian film industry to be nominated as a member of the Rajya Sabha?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित व्यक्तित्वों में से कौन भारतीय फिल्म उद्योग की पहली महिला हैं जिन्हें राज्यसभा सदस्य के रूप में नामांकित किया गया?
questions.solution:
Nargis Dutt was the first woman from the Indian film industry to be nominated to the Rajya Sabha, in 1980. Her nomination recognized not only her cinematic contribution but also her social work and public service, especially in areas like child welfare and health.

Further Insights

· Rajya Sabha nominations are made under Article 80 for contributions to art, literature, science, and social service.

questions.question: What is the common chemical name for "Quicklime," the compound used to produce Calcium Hydroxide?
questions.question_hi: "क्विकलाइनम" के लिए सामान्य रासायनिक नाम क्या है, जो कैल्शियम हाइड्रॉक्साइड बनाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution:
Quicklime is the common name for Calcium Oxide (CaO). When quicklime reacts with water, it forms Calcium Hydroxide (Ca(OH)₂) in an exothermic reaction known as slaking of lime.

Reaction:

CaO + H₂O → Ca(OH)₂

Further insights

· Quicklime (CaO) is obtained by heating limestone in a kiln.

· Slaked lime (Ca(OH)₂) is used in whitewashing and water treatment.

· The slaking of lime is a highly exothermic reaction.

· Lime products are widely used in cement and construction industries.

· Calcium Carbonate decomposes at high temperature to form quicklime and CO₂.

questions.question: What is the primary difference between a Pressure Group and a Political Party in a democratic system?
questions.question_hi: लोकतांत्रिक प्रणाली में एक दबाव समूह और एक राजनीतिक पार्टी के बीच मुख्य अंतर क्या है?

options.label: A
options.text: Pressure groups seek to directly control and share political power by contesting elections.
options.text_hi: प्रेशर समूह सीधे राजनीतिक शक्ति को नियंत्रित करने और साझा करने के लिए चुनावों में भाग लेते हैं।

options.label: B
options.text: Pressure groups attempt to influence government policies without seeking to directly control or share political power.
options.text_hi: प्रेशर समूह सीधे राजनीतिक शक्ति को नियंत्रित या साझा किए बिना सरकार की नीतियों को प्रभावित करने का प्रयास करते हैं।

options.label: C
options.text: Pressure groups are illegal organizations that are not allowed to use media campaigns or rallies.
options.text_hi: प्रेशर समूह अवैध संगठन हैं जिन्हें मीडिया अभियानों या रैलियों का उपयोग करने की अनुमति नहीं है।

options.label: D
options.text: Pressure groups only represent the interests of the government and do not represent any section of society.
options.text_hi: प्रेशर समूह केवल सरकार के हितों का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं और समाज के किसी भी वर्ग का प्रतिनिधित्व नहीं करते।

questions.correct_text: Pressure groups attempt to influence government policies without seeking to directly control or share political power.
questions.solution:
Pressure groups aim to influence government decisions and policies, but they do not contest elections or try to form a government. In contrast, political parties contest elections to gain political power.

Further insights

· Pressure groups act as a link between society and government.

· Examples include trade unions, farmer groups, and business associations.

· Political parties aim to form or oppose governments.

· Pressure groups strengthen democratic participation.

· They highlight public issues and demands.

questions.question:
Match List-I (Saptanga Element) with List-II (Functional Meaning) and select the correct answer using the codes given below:

List-I (Element) List-II (Meaning)

i) Swami 1. The Treasury / Finance

ii) Amatya 2. The King / Ruler

iii) Kosha 3. The Fort / Fortified Capital

iv) Durga 4. The Ministers / Administration

Codes:
questions.question_hi:
सूची-I (सप्तांग तत्व) को सूची-II (कार्यात्मक अर्थ) के साथ मिलाएं और नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनें:

सूची-I (तत्व) सूची-II (अर्थ)

i) स्वामी 1. कोषागार / वित्त

ii) अमात्य 2. राजा / शासक

iii) कोष 3. किला / किलेबंद राजधानी

iv) दुर्ग 4. मंत्री / प्रशासन

कोड:
questions.solution:
The Saptanga theory of the state (mentioned in ancient Indian political thought) describes seven essential elements of a kingdom.

Swami → King / Ruler (2)

Swami refers to the sovereign authority who governs the state.

Amatya → Ministers / Administration (4)

Amatyas are officials and ministers responsible for governance and administration.

Kosha → Treasury / Finance (1)

Kosha represents the financial resources of the state, essential for administration and defense.

Durga → Fort / Fortified Capital (3)

Durga signifies fortified places that provide military security.

Further Insights

· The Saptanga theory is associated with ancient Indian political thought.

· It emphasizes that a state functions as an interconnected system, not isolated parts.

· A weak Kosha (treasury) can cripple even a strong military.

· Durga was crucial in ancient warfare for defense and control.

· Amatyas acted as the administrative backbone of the kingdom.

questions.question: Regarding the Gandhian Era of the Indian National Movement, which of the following statements is INCORRECT?
questions.question_hi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन के गांधीवादी युग के संबंध में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन गलत है?

options.label: A
options.text: Mahatma Gandhi's first major successful Satyagraha in India was the Champaran movement in 1917 against the indigo plantation system.
options.text_hi: महात्मा गांधी का भारत में पहला प्रमुख सफल सत्याग्रह 1917 में चंपारण आंदोलन था जो नील की खेती प्रणाली के खिलाफ था।

options.label: B
options.text: Mahatma Gandhi launched the Non-Cooperation Movement in 1920 to support the Khilafat cause and demand Swaraj.
options.text_hi: महात्मा गांधी ने 1920 में खिलाफत आंदोलन का समर्थन करने और स्वराज की मांग करने के लिए असहयोग आंदोलन शुरू किया।

options.label: C
options.text: During the Dandi March in 1930, Mahatma Gandhi formally broke the salt law to start the Civil Disobedience Movement.
options.text_hi: 1930 में दांडी मार्च के दौरान, महात्मा गांधी ने औपचारिक रूप से नमक कानून तोड़ा और सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन शुरू किया।

options.label: D
options.text: Mahatma Gandhi supported the British "war efforts" during World War II by launching the Quit India Movement in 1942.
options.text_hi: महात्मा गांधी ने द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध के दौरान ब्रिटिश "युद्ध प्रयासों" का समर्थन करते हुए 1942 में भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन शुरू किया।

questions.correct_text: Mahatma Gandhi supported the British "war efforts" during World War II by launching the Quit India Movement in 1942.
questions.solution:
The statement claims that Mahatma Gandhi supported British war efforts during World War II by launching the Quit India Movement, which is factually wrong. The Quit India Movement (1942) was launched to oppose British rule and demand immediate independence, not to support Britain's war efforts.

Further insights

· Gandhian movements were based on non-violence (Ahimsa) and truth (Satyagraha).

· The Champaran Movement highlighted the role of peasants in the freedom struggle.

· The Non-Cooperation Movement marked the first nationwide mass participation under Congress.

· The Salt Law was chosen deliberately as it affected every Indian, especially the poor.

· The Quit India Movement led to the rise of parallel governments in places like Ballia and Satara.

questions.question: Which of the following pairs of crops and their highest producing states in India is correctly matched?
questions.question_hi: भारत में निम्नलिखित फसलों और उनके उच्चतम उत्पादन करने वाले राज्यों के जोड़े में से कौन सा सही मेल खाता है?
questions.solution:
Sugarcane - Uttar Pradesh

Uttar Pradesh has consistently been the largest producer of sugarcane in India, owing to fertile alluvial soils, ample water supply, and a favourable subtropical climate.

Wheat - Punjab

Punjab is a major wheat producer, but Uttar Pradesh, not Punjab, is the highest producer of wheat.

Cotton - Maharashtra

Maharashtra is a leading cotton-producing state, but Gujarat ranks first in cotton production.

Rubber - Karnataka

Rubber cultivation is mainly concentrated in Kerala, which is the largest producer - not Karnataka.

Further Insights

· Uttar Pradesh leads India in sugarcane and wheat production.

· Gujarat is the top producer of cotton in India.

· Kerala dominates natural rubber production.

questions.question:
With reference to the Doppler Effect, consider the following statements:

i) The Doppler Effect refers to the change in the actual frequency of a wave produced by a source, regardless of the observer's movement.

ii) When a sound source moves toward an observer, the observer perceives a higher pitch because the sound waves are compressed together.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
डॉपलर प्रभाव के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) डॉपलर प्रभाव उस तरंग की वास्तविक आवृत्ति में परिवर्तन को संदर्भित करता है जो स्रोत द्वारा उत्पन्न होती है, चाहे पर्यवेक्षक की गति कुछ भी हो।

ii) जब एक ध्वनि स्रोत पर्यवेक्षक की ओर बढ़ता है, तो पर्यवेक्षक उच्च पिच महसूस करता है क्योंकि ध्वनि तरंगें एक साथ संकुचित हो जाती हैं।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो कथन (i) और न ही (ii)

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is incorrect because the Doppler Effect does not involve a change in the actual frequency produced by the source. It refers to the change in perceived frequency due to relative motion between the source and the observer.

Statement (ii) is correct because when the sound source moves toward the observer, the wavefronts get compressed, leading to a higher observed frequency (higher pitch).

Further insights

· The Doppler Effect applies to sound, light, and electromagnetic waves.

· For sound waves, a medium (like air) is required; for light waves, no medium is needed.

· It explains the siren effect heard from moving ambulances or trains.

· In astronomy, Doppler shift helps determine whether stars are moving toward or away from Earth.

· Redshift and blueshift are Doppler Effects observed in light waves.

questions.question: Who has been reappointed as the Attorney General for India for a new two-year term starting from October 1, 2025?
questions.question_hi: भारत के लिए नए दो वर्षीय कार्यकाल के लिए 1 अक्टूबर, 2025 से किसे पुनर्नियुक्त किया गया है?
questions.solution:
Senior Advocate R. Venkataramani has been re-appointed as the Attorney General for India for a fresh two-year term effective October 1, 2025, by a notification issued by the Ministry of Law and Justice and approved by the President of India

Further insights

· The Attorney General for India is a constitutional post created under Article 76 of the Constitution.

· The AG is appointed by the President on the recommendation of the Union Cabinet.

· The AG advises the Government of India on legal matters and represents it in the Supreme Court.

· The tenure of the AG is not fixed and can be extended, shortened, or terminated at the President's pleasure.

questions.question:
Regarding the themes of Sangam literature, consider the following statements:

i) Akam poetry focuses on the "inner world" of human emotions and romantic love, where characters remain anonymous to keep the feelings universal.

ii) Puram poetry deals with the "outer world," specifically celebrating the bravery of kings, war ethics, and historical events.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
संगम साहित्य के विषयों के संबंध में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) अकाम कविता मानव भावनाओं और रोमांटिक प्रेम की "आंतरिक दुनिया" पर केंद्रित होती है, जहाँ पात्रों को सार्वभौमिक भावनाओं को बनाए रखने के लिए गुमनाम रखा जाता है।

ii) पुरम कविता "बाहरी दुनिया" से संबंधित होती है, विशेष रूप से राजाओं की बहादुरी, युद्ध नैतिकता, और ऐतिहासिक घटनाओं का उत्सव मनाती है।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो कथन (i) और न ही (ii)

questions.solution:
Both statements accurately describe the core thematic division of Sangam literature.

Akam poems deal with personal emotions, especially love and relationships, and deliberately avoid naming individuals to maintain universality.

Puram poems focus on public life, such as war, heroism, generosity of kings, and social values.

Further insights

· Akam poetry is closely linked to the five landscapes (Tinai) like Kurinji and Mullai.

· Puram poems often praise valor, charity, and just rule of Tamil kings.

· Sangam literature dates roughly from 300 BCE to 300 CE.

· Nature is used symbolically to reflect human emotions in Akam poems.

questions.question: Which Indian Navy stealth frigate recently arrived at Busan, South Korea, to participate in the first-ever bilateral naval exercise between the two nations?
questions.question_hi: हाल ही में कौन सी भारतीय नौसेना की स्टेल्थ फ्रिगेट बुसान, दक्षिण कोरिया पहुंची, ताकि दोनों देशों के बीच पहली द्विपक्षीय नौसैनिक अभ्यास में भाग ले सके?
questions.solution:
The Indian Naval Ship INS Sahyadri, a Shivalik-class guided-missile stealth frigate, arrived at Busan Naval Harbour, South Korea, on 13 October 2025 to participate in the first-ever bilateral naval exercise between the Indian Navy and the Republic of Korea Navy.

Further insights

· The exercise is named IN-RoKN, marking the first bilateral naval drill between India and South Korea.

· The purpose of the exercise is to enhance interoperability, tactical coordination, and mutual trust between the two navies.

· It includes both harbour and sea phases, involving professional exchanges and joint operations.

· INS Sahyadri is part of the Eastern Fleet based at Visakhapatnam under the Eastern Naval Command.

questions.question:
With reference to the Central Highlands of India, consider the following statements:

i) The Aravali Range forms the southern boundary of the highlands and acts as the primary watershed between north and south Indian rivers.

ii) The Vindhya Range is situated on the northwest, consisting of highly eroded "relict" hills that stretch from Gujarat to Delhi.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत के सेंट्रल हाइलैंड्स के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) अरावली रेंज हाइलैंड्स की दक्षिणी सीमा बनाती है और उत्तर और दक्षिण भारतीय नदियों के बीच प्राथमिक जलविभाजक के रूप में कार्य करती है।

ii) विंध्य रेंज उत्तर-पश्चिम में स्थित है, जिसमें अत्यधिक क्षतिग्रस्त "रिलिक्ट" पहाड़ियाँ शामिल हैं जो गुजरात से दिल्ली तक फैली हैं।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो कथन (i) और न ही (ii)

questions.solution:
Both statements contain geographical inaccuracies.

Statement (i) is incorrect because the Aravali Range forms the north-western boundary of the Central Highlands, not the southern boundary, and it is not the primary watershed between north and south Indian rivers.

Statement (ii) is incorrect because the description of highly eroded relict hills stretching from Gujarat to Delhi actually applies to the Aravali Range, not the Vindhya Range.

Aravali = old, worn-down hills in the northwest

Vindhya = southern edge of the Central Highlands and river divider

Further insights

· The Central Highlands lie north of the Narmada River and form part of the Peninsular Plateau.

· The Vindhya Range separates the Ganga basin from peninsular rivers.

· The Aravali Range is one of the oldest fold mountains in the world.

· Rivers like Chambal, Betwa, and Ken originate in the Central Highlands.

· The region is rich in minerals and forest resources.

questions.question: Under the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) in the Constitution of India, which Article asks the State to separate the judiciary from the executive?
questions.question_hi: भारत के संविधान में राज्य नीति के निर्देशात्मक सिद्धांतों (DPSP) के तहत, कौन सा अनुच्छेद राज्य से न्यायपालिका को कार्यपालिका से अलग करने के लिए कहता है?
questions.solution:
Article 50 of the Constitution directs the State to separate the judiciary from the executive in public services. This is meant to ensure judicial independence so that judges can function without pressure from the executive branch.

Article 44 -

Deals with the Uniform Civil Code, not the judiciary.

Article 48 -

Relates to agriculture and animal husbandry, including cow protection.

Article 51 -

Talks about international peace and friendly relations between nations.

Further insights

· DPSPs are non-justiciable, but they guide government policy.

· Article 50 helps protect the rule of law.

· Judicial independence strengthens democracy.

· Separation of powers prevents misuse of authority.

questions.question:
Direction: The following question consists of two statements - one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R). Select the correct answer using the codes given below.

Assertion (A):

A high Fiscal Deficit is not always considered harmful to an economy, whereas a high Revenue Deficit is generally seen as a sign of poor financial health.

Reason (R):

Fiscal Deficit can include spending on Capital Expenditure that creates productive assets, while Revenue Deficit is limited to Consumption Expenditure which provides no future financial returns.

Select the correct option:
questions.question_hi:
निर्देश: निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में दो कथन हैं - एक को Assertion (A) और दूसरे को Reason (R) के रूप में चिह्नित किया गया है। नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनें।

Assertion (A):

एक उच्च वित्तीय घाटा हमेशा अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए हानिकारक नहीं माना जाता है, जबकि एक उच्च राजस्व घाटा आमतौर पर खराब वित्तीय स्वास्थ्य का संकेत माना जाता है।

Reason (R):

वित्तीय घाटा पूंजीगत व्यय पर खर्च को शामिल कर सकता है जो उत्पादक संपत्तियां बनाता है, जबकि राजस्व घाटा केवल उपभोग व्यय तक सीमित होता है जो भविष्य में कोई वित्तीय लाभ प्रदान नहीं करता।

सही विकल्प चुनें:

options.label: A
options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options.text_hi: दोनों (A) और (R) सही हैं, और (R) (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण है।

options.label: B
options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A).
options.text_hi: दोनों (A) और (R) सही हैं, लेकिन (R) (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है।

questions.correct_text: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
questions.solution:
Both the Assertion and the Reason are factually correct, and the Reason directly explains the Assertion.

A Fiscal Deficit includes total government borrowing and can be used for capital expenditure such as infrastructure, which boosts future economic growth.

A Revenue Deficit occurs when the government's revenue expenditure exceeds revenue receipts, indicating borrowing for consumption, not asset creation.

Thus, a high fiscal deficit may be justified if it funds productive investment, whereas a high revenue deficit usually reflects structural fiscal weakness.

Further insights

· Revenue Deficit is a subset of Fiscal Deficit.

· Capital expenditure has a multiplier effect on economic growth.

· Persistent revenue deficit reduces government savings.

· Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) aims to control deficits.

questions.question:
With reference to the Indian Financial System, consider the following statements:

i) The Money Market is the segment of the financial market where long-term debt and equity-backed securities are traded to build wealth and fund infrastructure.

ii) The Capital Market is primarily used by banks and the government to maintain liquidity through short-term instruments like Treasury Bills (T-Bills).

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारतीय वित्तीय प्रणाली के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) मनी मार्केट वित्तीय बाजार का वह खंड है जहाँ दीर्घकालिक ऋण और इक्विटी-समर्थित प्रतिभूतियों का व्यापार संपत्ति बनाने और अवसंरचना को वित्तपोषित करने के लिए किया जाता है।

ii) पूंजी बाजार का मुख्य रूप से बैंक और सरकार द्वारा ट्रेजरी बिल (टी-बिल) जैसे अल्पकालिक उपकरणों के माध्यम से तरलता बनाए रखने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो कथन (i) और न ही (ii)

questions.solution:
Both statements misclassify the functions of the Money Market and the Capital Market.

Money Market deals with short-term funds and liquidity management, not long-term wealth creation.

Capital Market deals with long-term capital formation, not short-term liquidity instruments like T-Bills.

Hence, neither statement is correct.

Money Market = short-term money needs

Capital Market = long-term investment and growth

Further insights

· Treasury Bills (T-Bills) are zero-coupon instruments issued by the Government of India.

· The Money Market helps the RBI conduct monetary policy operations.

· Capital Markets play a key role in infrastructure financing and industrial growth.

· Equity instruments provide ownership, while debt instruments provide fixed returns.

questions.question: The Battle of Chausa, fought in 1539, was a significant military engagement between which two historical figures?
questions.question_hi: चौसा की लड़ाई, जो 1539 में लड़ी गई थी, दो ऐतिहासिक व्यक्तियों के बीच एक महत्वपूर्ण सैन्य संघर्ष थी?
questions.solution:
The Battle of Chausa (1539) was fought between Humayun, the Mughal emperor, and Sher Shah Suri, the Afghan leader. In this battle, Sher Shah Suri defeated Humayun, marking a major setback for Mughal rule in India and paving the way for the establishment of the Sur Empire.

Further insights

· The Battle of Chausa was followed by the Battle of Kannauj (1540), where Humayun was again defeated.

· Sher Shah Suri introduced major administrative and revenue reforms.

· The Sur Empire laid the groundwork for later Mughal governance.

· Humayun regained the throne only in 1555 with Persian support.

questions.question: India recently offered to supply its indigenously developed 'Akash' surface-to-air missile system to which of the following South American nations?
questions.question_hi: भारत ने हाल ही में अपने स्वदेशी रूप से विकसित 'आकाश' सतह से हवा में मार करने वाली मिसाइल प्रणाली निम्नलिखित दक्षिण अमेरिकी देशों में से किसे आपूर्ति करने की पेशकश की है?
questions.solution:
India has proposed supplying its indigenous Akash air-defence missile system to Brazil as part of efforts to boost defence cooperation and strategic ties. The discussions included joint work on defence equipment and collaboration between the two nations.

Further Insights

· Akash is a medium-range surface-to-air missile developed by India's DRDO.

· Brazil's interest reflects India's growing role in global defence exports.

· Akash is designed to intercept aircraft, helicopters, and drones up to 25 - 30 km.

questions.question: What does the function VLOOKUP() do in Excel?
questions.question_hi: Excel में VLOOKUP() फ़ंक्शन क्या करता है?

options.label: A
options.text: Searches for a value in a range and returns a corresponding value
options.text_hi: किसी सीमा में एक मान खोजता है और संबंधित मान लौटाता है

options.label: B
options.text: Adds up all the values in a range
options.text_hi: सीमा में सभी मानों को जोड़ता है

options.label: C
options.text: Calculates the average of a range

options.label: D
options.text_hi: सीमा में मानों को गुणा करता है

questions.correct_text: Searches for a value in a range and returns a corresponding value
questions.solution:
The VLOOKUP() function in Excel is used to search for a specific value in the first column of a table or range, and then return a value in the same row from another column. It stands for "Vertical Lookup."

o The first argument is the lookup value, which is the value you want to find in the first column of your table.

o The second argument is the table array, which is the range of cells that contains the data. The first column of this range is where the lookup value will be searched.

o The third argument is the column index number, which specifies from which column in the table array to retrieve the value. For example, if you want to get a value from the third column, the column index number would be 3.

o The fourth argument is an optional parameter that specifies whether you want an exact match (FALSE) or an approximate match (TRUE).

questions.question: In the field of cybersecurity and networking, what is the primary role of the tool known as Wireshark?
questions.question_hi: साइबर सुरक्षा और नेटवर्किंग के क्षेत्र में, Wireshark नामक उपकरण की मुख्य भूमिका क्या है?
questions.solution:
Wireshark is a network protocol analyzer used to capture and examine data packets travelling across a network. This process is commonly known as packet sniffing.

Further insights

· Wireshark is a free and open-source tool.

· It supports hundreds of network protocols.

· Used widely in network troubleshooting and security analysis.

· Can help detect suspicious or malicious traffic.

· Often used by network administrators and cybersecurity professionals.

questions.question:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct in context of Web Browser?

a. A web browser is a free software application that is used to view web pages

b. It doesn't convert XML and HTML into readable document.

c. A web browser helps us to navigate through the World Wide Web.

d. Some of the common web browsers are Internet Explorer, Firefox, Google Chrome
questions.question_hi:
वेब ब्राउज़र के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथन सही हैं?

a. एक वेब ब्राउज़र एक मुफ्त सॉफ़्टवेयर एप्लिकेशन है जिसका उपयोग वेब पेज देखने के लिए किया जाता है

b. यह XML और HTML को पठनीय दस्तावेज़ में परिवर्तित नहीं करता है।

c. एक वेब ब्राउज़र हमें वर्ल्ड वाइड वेब के माध्यम से नेविगेट करने में मदद करता है।

d. कुछ सामान्य वेब ब्राउज़र हैं इंटरनेट एक्सप्लोरर, फ़ायरफ़ॉक्स, गूगल क्रोम
questions.solution:
Web Browser: -

A web browser is a free software application that is used to view web pages, graphics and almost any other online content. It is specifically designed to convert HTML and XML into readable document. A web browser helps us to navigate through the World Wide Web. Some of the common web browsers are Internet Explorer, Firefox, Google Chrome, Netscape Navigator and Safari.

questions.question: Where are the instructions for booting process of a computer housed in?
questions.question_hi: कंप्यूटर के बूटिंग प्रक्रिया के निर्देश कहाँ रखे जाते हैं?
questions.solution: When the power button is pressed to turn the computer on, the power supply unit gives power to the motherboard and its components so that they can play their part in the whole system. The first part of the next step of the boot process is controlled by BIOS and it is stored in the non-volatile memory- ROM. Data stored in ROM cannot be electronically modified after the manufacture of the memory device.

questions.question: In which among the following fields will you add the address of a recipient, to whom you want to send the mail without the knowledge of other recipients?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस क्षेत्र में आप उस प्राप्तकर्ता का पता जोड़ेंगे, जिसे आप अन्य प्राप्तकर्ताओं के ज्ञान के बिना मेल भेजना चाहते हैं?
questions.solution: In BCC ("blind carbon copy") each BCC recipient will receive the e-mail, but will not see who else received a copy.

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT have the capability to replicate itself?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किसके पास स्वयं को पुनरुत्पादित करने की क्षमता नहीं है?
questions.solution: A Trojan horse is simply a computer program. The program claims to do one thing (it may claim to be a game) but instead does damage when you run it (it may erase your hard disk). Trojan horses have no way to replicate automatically.

questions.question: Which Excel feature is primarily used to restrict the type of data or the values that users can enter into a cell?
questions.question_hi: कौन सा Excel फीचर मुख्य रूप से उपयोगकर्ताओं द्वारा किसी सेल में दर्ज किए जाने वाले डेटा या मानों के प्रकार को प्रतिबंधित करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution:
Data Validation in Excel allows users to control what kind of data can be entered into a cell. For example, it can restrict entries to numbers only, dates within a range, or values from a drop-down list.

Further insights

· Data Validation can create drop-down lists.

· It helps ensure data consistency in spreadsheets.

· Conditional Formatting is for visual alerts, not restrictions.

· Freeze Panes improves worksheet navigation.

· Goal Seek is part of What-If Analysis tools.

questions.question: With respect to the internet, which among the following correctly defines bandwidth?
questions.question_hi: इंटरनेट के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सही ढंग से बैंडविड्थ को परिभाषित करता है?

options.label: A
options.text: The number of bytes transferred by a channel per unit time
options.text_hi: एक चैनल द्वारा प्रति इकाई समय में स्थानांतरित बाइट्स की संख्या

options.label: B
options.text: The number of bits transferred by a channel in a minute
options.text_hi: एक चैनल द्वारा एक मिनट में स्थानांतरित बिट्स की संख्या

options.label: C
options.text: The number of bits transferred by a channel per unit time
options.text_hi: एक चैनल द्वारा प्रति इकाई समय में स्थानांतरित बिट्स की संख्या

questions.correct_text: The number of bits transferred by a channel per unit time
questions.solution: With respect to the Internet, the number of bits transferred by a channel per unit time is the bandwidth.

questions.question: By default, the title slide offers ______ text box/es in Microsoft PowerPoint.
questions.question_hi: डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से, शीर्षक स्लाइड Microsoft PowerPoint में ______ टेक्स्ट बॉक्स प्रदान करता है।
questions.solution: A title slide in PowerPoint is the first slide in the slide deck and appears in the PowerPoint workspace when that presentation is opened. By default, in PowerPoint, the title slide offers two text boxes for a title and subtitle. The title slide sets the pace for the ensuing presentation.

questions.question: Which of the following is considered a peripheral device?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक परिधीय उपकरण माना जाता है?
questions.solution: A peripheral device is an external device connected to a computer that provides additional functionality. Among the options given, a printer is considered a peripheral device. Peripheral devices are not the core components of a computer system (like the CPU or RAM), but they extend the computer's capabilities. A printer is an external device used for producing hard copies of documents, and it is connected to the computer to enhance its functionality.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the "Flash Memory" and choose the incorrect statement(s).

(i) Flash memory is a memory chip that is used for storage and for transferring of data between a computer and digital device.

(ii) Flash memory is a volatile memory.

(iii) The data in flash memory can be erased, modified and rewritten many times.
questions.question_hi:
"फ्लैश मेमोरी" के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें और गलत कथन चुनें।

(i) फ्लैश मेमोरी एक मेमोरी चिप है जिसका उपयोग कंप्यूटर और डिजिटल डिवाइस के बीच डेटा संग्रहण और स्थानांतरण के लिए किया जाता है।

(ii) फ्लैश मेमोरी एक अस्थायी मेमोरी है।

(iii) फ्लैश मेमोरी में डेटा को कई बार मिटाया, संशोधित और पुनः लिखा जा सकता है।
questions.solution:
Flash memory is a memory chip that is used for storage and also for transferring of data between a computer and digital device. A flash memory is one that retains data in spite of the electricity supply being switched off. Hence it is a non- volatile memory.

• It evolved from EPROM and EEPROM but more often it is said to be a distinct type of EEPROM which is programmed and erased in blocks.

• Flash memory is widely used for storage in consumer devices like mobile phones, USB flash drives, tablet computers, digital cameras and other solid state drives.

• The data in flash memory can be erased, modified and rewritten many times. It does not require batteries for solid state storage.

• It has very fast access time and also has higher resistance to kinetic shock as compared to hard disk drive.

• It is extremely durable and can withstand extreme pressure and temperature.

questions.question: In the context of computer applications, which of the following best describes the primary function of Microsoft Outlook?
questions.question_hi: कंप्यूटर अनुप्रयोगों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा Microsoft Outlook के प्राथमिक कार्य का सबसे अच्छा वर्णन करता है?

options.label: C
options.text_hi: उच्च स्तरीय वीडियो गेम डिजाइन करना।

questions.solution:
Microsoft Outlook is mainly used as a personal information manager. It helps users manage emails, calendars, contacts, tasks, and reminders in one place.

Further insights

· Outlook is part of the Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365 suite.

· It supports email protocols like POP3, IMAP, and Exchange.

· Outlook can be used for meeting scheduling and reminders.

· It allows contact and task management.

questions.question: What role does the BIOS (Basic Input/Output System) play in a computer?
questions.question_hi: कंप्यूटर में BIOS (बेसिक इनपुट/आउटपुट सिस्टम) क्या भूमिका निभाता है?

options.label: B
options.text: Control input devices like the keyboard and mouse
options.text_hi: कीबोर्ड और माउस जैसे इनपुट डिवाइस को नियंत्रित करें

options.label: C
options.text: Initialize hardware components during the startup process
options.text_hi: स्टार्टअप प्रक्रिया के दौरान हार्डवेयर घटकों को प्रारंभ करें

questions.correct_text: Initialize hardware components during the startup process
questions.solution: The BIOS (Basic Input/Output System) in a computer is a firmware that is stored on a motherboard's ROM (Read-Only Memory). Its primary role is to initialize and perform a self-check of the computer's hardware components during the startup process. When you turn on your computer, the BIOS kicks in first. It conducts a Power-On Self-Test (POST) to ensure that essential hardware components like the CPU, RAM, storage devices, and other peripherals are functioning properly.

questions.question: What is the file extension of the Microsoft Excel?
questions.question_hi: Microsoft Excel की फ़ाइल एक्सटेंशन क्या है?
questions.solution:
Microsoft Excel is a spreadsheet program which is used to present and organise copious amounts of data in a systematic manner.'.xls' is the file extension of the MS Excel.

'.doc and .docx' are the file extension of MS word.

'.ppt' is the file extension of MS PowerPoint.

questions.question: What is the primary function of hardware in a computer system?
questions.question_hi: कंप्यूटर सिस्टम में हार्डवेयर का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
questions.solution: Hardware in a computer system primarily functions to process information. This includes tasks such as performing calculations, executing instructions, and managing data flow within the system. Providing a user interface is a role often associated with software rather than hardware. Therefore, the primary function of hardware is to process information.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a type of CPU Register?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा CPU रजिस्टर का प्रकार नहीं है?
questions.solution:
Cache Memory is not a CPU register. It is a small, high-speed memory used to store frequently accessed data and instructions, but it is separate from CPU registers.

Further insights

· Registers are the fastest memory in a computer system.

· Cache memory is faster than RAM but slower than registers.

· The Program Counter controls the sequence of execution.

· The Accumulator stores temporary calculation results.

· Modern CPUs use multiple cache levels (L1, L2, L3).

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding CPU Control Units:

i) Hardwired Control is typically used in CISC architectures because it uses a "micro-program" to handle complex, multi-step instructions.

ii) Microprogrammed Control is highly flexible and is the foundation for architectures where complex instructions are broken down into simpler micro-operations.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
CPU नियंत्रण इकाइयों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) हार्डवायर्ड नियंत्रण आमतौर पर CISC आर्किटेक्चर में उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि यह जटिल, बहु-चरण निर्देशों को संभालने के लिए "माइक्रो-प्रोग्राम" का उपयोग करता है।

ii) माइक्रोप्रोग्राम्ड नियंत्रण अत्यंत लचीला होता है और यह उन आर्किटेक्चरों के लिए आधार है जहाँ जटिल निर्देशों को सरल माइक्रो-ऑपरेशनों में विभाजित किया जाता है।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो कथन (i) और न ही (ii)

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is incorrect because Hardwired Control does not use micro-programs. It is based on fixed logic circuits and is commonly associated with RISC architectures, not CISC.

Statement (ii) is correct because Microprogrammed Control uses micro-instructions stored in control memory, making it flexible and well-suited for handling complex instructions, as seen in CISC architectures.

Further insights

· Hardwired control offers faster execution but poor flexibility.

· Microprogrammed control allows easier updates and modification.

· RISC systems favor hardwired control for speed.

· CISC systems favor microprogrammed control for instruction complexity.

questions.question: It was observed that for the completion of a project, multiple users were utilising the same Central Processing Unit. Which among the following is the type of operating system we are referring to?

questions.solution: Time-Sharing Operating Systems (Multitasking Systems) - Each task(/user) is given some time to execute, so that all the tasks work smoothly. Hence the operating system in which multiple users utilise the same CPU is Time-Sharing Operating System.

questions.question: A frustum of a right square pyramid has the lower base side 14 cm, the upper base side 10 cm, and the slant height along the lateral face 13 cm. Find the total surface area (in cm2).
questions.question_hi: एक समकोणीय वर्ग पिरामिड का एक फ्रस्टम है जिसका निचला आधार पक्ष 14 सेमी, ऊपरी आधार पक्ष 10 सेमी, और पार्श्व चेहरे के साथ तिरछी ऊंचाई 13 सेमी है। कुल सतह क्षेत्रफल (सेमी2 में) ज्ञात करें।
questions.solution:
For a frustum of a right square pyramid,

Total Surface Area = area of lower base + area of upper base + 1/2 X sum of perimeters of bases X slant height

Given, A = 14 cm (lower side), a = 10 cm (upper side), l = 13 cm.

Area of lower base = A2

=> 142 = 196.

Area of upper base = a2

=> 102 = 100.

Perimeter sum = 4A + 4a

=> 4(14 + 10) = 4 X 24 = 96.

Lateral area = (1/2) X 96 X 13

=> 48 X 13 = 624.

TSA = 196 + 100 + 624 = 920.

questions.question: If u2 + 7u - 2 = 0, then what is the value of (u2 + 14/u)?
questions.question_hi: यदि u2 + 7u - 2 = 0 है, तो (u2 + 14/u) का मान कितना होगा?
questions.solution:
Given, u2 + 7u - 2 = 0 ---(1)

Multiplying above equation by (7/u), we get

=> 7u + 49 - 14/u = 0 ---(2)

Equating equation (1), and (2), we get

u2 + 7u - 2 = 7u + 49 - 14/u

=> u2 + 14/u = 51

questions.question: If the digits of the number 4512 are randomly arranged, what is the probability that the obtained number is divisible by 4?
questions.question_hi: यदि संख्या 4512 के अंकों को यादृच्छिक रूप से व्यवस्थित किया जाए, तो प्राप्त संख्या 4 से विभाज्य होने की संभावना क्या है?
questions.solution:
We have 4 digits and there are 4 * 3 = 12 possibilities for the last two digits

Possibilities for the last two digits are 12, 14, 15, 21, 24, 25, 41, 42, 45, 51, 52, 54

From these only 12, 24 and 52 are divisible by 4

Required probability = 3/12 = 1/4

questions.question: If the sides of a triangle are 9, 13, and X, and X is an integer, then find the number of possible values of X.
questions.question_hi: यदि किसी त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ 9, 13 और X हैं, जहाँ X एक पूर्णांक है, तो X के संभावित मानों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिये।
questions.solution:
Sum of 9 and 13 = 22

Difference of 9 and 13 = 4

So, the value of X lies between 4 and 22.

Number of possible values of X = 22 - 4 - 1 = 17

questions.question: Two craftsmen A and B can complete a statue in 20 days together, and A alone takes 30 days. They work together for 8 days; then B leaves. How many more days will A take to finish the statue?
questions.question_hi: दो कारीगर A और B मिलकर एक मूर्ति को 20 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं, और A अकेले 30 दिन लेता है। वे साथ में 8 दिन काम करते हैं; फिर B चला जाता है। A को मूर्ति पूरा करने में और कितने दिन लगेंगे?
questions.solution:
One day's work of (A + B) = 1/20;

One day's work of A = 1/30

Work done by A and B in 8 days = 8 x 1/20 = 2/5; remain = 3/5.

A's rate = 1/30;

Time taken by A = (3/5) ÷ (1/30) = 18 days.

questions.question: The radius of both a sphere and the base radius of a cone is equal to 35 cm. If the total surface area of the sphere is 7480 cm2 more than the total surface area of the right circular cone, then what is the height of the cone?
questions.question_hi: एक गोले और एक शंकु के आधार त्रिज्या दोनों की त्रिज्या 35 सेमी है। यदि गोले का कुल सतह क्षेत्रफल शंकु के कुल सतह क्षेत्रफल से 7480 सेमी2 अधिक है, तो शंकु की ऊंचाई क्या है?
questions.solution:
The total surface area of a sphere = 4πr2

= 4 * 22/7 * 35 * 35

= 15400 cm2

The total surface area of the cone = πr(r + l)

15400 - 7480 = 22/7 * 35 (35 + l)

7920 = 22 * 5 (35 + l)

72 = 35 + l

l = 37 cm

Hence, h = √(372 - 352) = 12 cm

= √(100-25)

= √75 cm

=5√3 cm

questions.question: A line is the perpendicular bisector of the line segment connecting points X(8, 11) and Y(14, 9). What is the x-intercept of the line?
questions.question_hi: एक रेखा बिंदु X(8, 11) और Y(14, 9) को जोड़ने वाले रेखा खंड की लंबवत मध्यरेखा है। उस रेखा का x-अवरोध क्या है?
questions.solution:
X(8, 11) and Y(14, 9)

Mid-point of XY:

M = (x1 + x2)/2, (y1 + y2)/2

= (8 + 14)/2, (11 + 9)/2

= (11, 10)

Slope of XY = m = (y2 - y1)/(x2 - x1)

= (9 - 11)/(14 - 8)

= -2/6

= -1/3

Slope of perpendicular bisector = -1/m = -1/(-1/3) = 3

Equation of line through M(11, 10) =>

y - 10 = 3(x - 11)

y - 10 = 3x - 33

y = 3x - 23

For x-intercept => y = 0

0 = 3x - 23

3x = 23

x = 23/3

questions.question: Raman invests Rs. 'a' in a simple interest at 20% rate of interest. The interest received after 3 years is Rs. 'a - 2400'. Find the value of 'a'.
questions.question_hi: रमन ने सरल ब्याज पर 20% ब्याज दर पर Rs. 'a' निवेश किया। 3 वर्षों के बाद प्राप्त ब्याज Rs. 'a - 2400' है। 'a' का मान ज्ञात करें।
questions.solution:
Simple interest = Principal X Rate of interest X Time / 100

a-2400 = a X 20 X 3 / 100

5a - 12000 = 3a

5a - 3a = 12000

2a = 12000

a = 6000

Hence, the value of a = 6000

questions.question: The number of male students in a college is 540 and the ratio of the number of male to female students is 3:4 respectively. 100 females leave the college. What is the percentage of female students in the college now (upto one decimal point)?

questions.solution:
No. of males = 540

So, no. of females = 540 * (4/3) = 720

After 100 females left, no. of females = 620 and total number of students = 540 + 620 = 1160

So, percentage of females now = (620/1160) * 100% = 53.4%

questions.question: A wooden box measures 50 cm X 40 cm X 30 cm externally. The thickness of the wood is 2 cm. If the density of the wood is 8 g/cm3, find the weight of the box in kilograms.

questions.solution:
Internal dimensions = (50 - 2 X 2) cm X (40 - 2 X 2) cm X (30 - 2 X 2) cm

= 46 cm X 36 cm X 26 cm

Volume of wood = Volume of outer box - Volume of inner box

= (50 X 40 X 30) - (46 X 36 X 26)

= 60000 - 43056

= 16944 cm3

Mass = Density X Volume = 8 X 16944 = 135552 g = 135.552 kg

questions.question: A, B, and C started a business by investing Rs. 50000, Rs. 75000, and Rs. 25000, respectively. After 4 months, A invests an additional Rs. 10000 and B withdraws Rs. 15000. If C's investment remains the same, then find the profit share of B out of the total profit share of Rs. 440000, after a year.
questions.question_hi: A, B, और C ने क्रमशः Rs. 50000, Rs. 75000, और Rs. 25000 का निवेश करके एक व्यवसाय शुरू किया। 4 महीने बाद, A ने अतिरिक्त Rs. 10000 का निवेश किया और B ने Rs. 15000 निकाल लिए। यदि C का निवेश समान रहता है, तो एक वर्ष के बाद कुल लाभ Rs. 440000 में से B का लाभांश कितना होगा, ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
A's investment * Time = 50000 * 4 + 60000 * 8 = Rs. 680000

B's investment * Time = 75000 * 4 + 60000 * 8 = Rs. 780000

C's investment * Time = 25000 * 12 = Rs. 300000

The ratio of the profit share of A: B: C = 680000: 780000: 300000 = 34: 39: 15

Hence, B's profit share = 440000 * 39/88 = Rs. 195000

questions.question: The variance of 9 values is X. If each value doubles, then the standard deviation of new values is 24. What is the value of X?

New standard deviation = 24

Original Standard deviation = 24/2 = 12

Variance = 122 = 144

X = 144

C.I at 9% = P X [{1 + R/100}T - 1] = 30000 * [1 + 9/100 - 1] = Rs. 2,700

Original interest = Rs. 2,600

Hence, the required difference = 2700 - 2600 = Rs. 100

questions.question_hi: A और B साथ मिलकर 6 दिनों में काम का 25% पूरा कर सकते हैं और C अकेले वही काम 40 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। A, B और C साथ मिलकर पूरा काम पूरा करने में कितना समय लेंगे, यह ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Time taken by A and B = 6*100/25 = 24 days

Time taken by C = 40 days

Total work = 120 units

Efficiency of A and B = 120/24 = 5 units/day

Efficiency of C = 120/40 = 3 units/day

Time taken by A, B and C together = 120/(5 + 3) = 15 days

questions.question:
Study the following information and answer the given question:

'J ≠ K' means J and K are brothers.

'J / K' means J is the mother of K.

'J || K' means J is the spouse of K.

'J : K' means J is the son of K.

How is N related to A in the given expression 'A / B ≠ Y : X ≠ U || N'?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित जानकारी का अध्ययन करें और दिए गए प्रश्न का उत्तर दें:

'J ≠ K' का अर्थ है J और K भाई हैं।

'J / K' का अर्थ है J, K की माँ है।

'J || K' का अर्थ है J, K का पति/पत्नी है।

'J : K' का अर्थ है J, K का पुत्र है।

दिए गए अभिव्यक्ति 'A / B ≠ Y : X ≠ U || N' में N, A से कैसे संबंधित है?

options.label: A
options.text: N is the sister of A's mother.
options.text_hi: N, A की माँ की बहन है।

options.label: B
options.text: N is the brother of A's daughter-in-law.
options.text_hi: N, A की बहू की बहन है।

options.label: C
options.text: N is the wife of A's brother-in-law.
options.text_hi: N, A के साले की पत्नी है।

options.label: D
options.text: N is the aunt of A.

questions.correct_text: N is the wife of A's brother-in-law.
questions.solution:
It is given that,

'J ≠ K' means J and K are brothers.

'J / K' means J is the mother of K.

'J || K' means J is the spouse of K.

'J : K' means J is the son of K.

After decoding the given expression, we get:

A / B ≠ Y : X ≠ U || N

A is the mother of B. B and Y are brothers. Y is the son of X. X and U are brothers. U is the spouse of N.

So, N is the wife of A's brother-in-law.

questions.question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the assumption(s) that is/are implicit.

Statement: A hospital will introduce QR-coded medicine labels to reduce dispensing errors in the pharmacy.

Assumptions:

I. A meaningful portion of dispensing errors happens due to confusion or misreading of labels.

II. Pharmacy staff can use the QR code system quickly during routine work to verify medicines.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथन को ध्यान से पढ़ें और उस/उन अनुमान(ओं) की पहचान करें जो निहित हैं।

कथन: एक अस्पताल फार्मेसी में दवा वितरण त्रुटियों को कम करने के लिए क्यूआर-कोडेड दवा लेबल पेश करेगा।

अनुमान:

I. दवा वितरण त्रुटियों का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा लेबल की भ्रम या गलत पढ़ाई के कारण होता है।

II. फार्मेसी कर्मचारी दवाओं की पुष्टि के लिए नियमित कार्य के दौरान क्यूआर कोड प्रणाली का तेजी से उपयोग कर सकते हैं।

options.label: A
options.text: Both Assumption I and Assumption II are implicit
options.text_hi: धारा I और धारा II दोनों निहित हैं

options.label: C
options.text: Neither Assumption I nor Assumption II is implicit
options.text_hi: ना तो धारा I और ना ही धारा II निहित है

questions.correct_text: Both Assumption I and Assumption II are implicit
questions.solution:
Statement: The hospital plans to introduce QR-coded medicine labels with the purpose of reducing dispensing errors. This means the hospital believes that this specific measure is relevant to the cause of errors and that it can be practically used in the pharmacy.

Assumption I: If dispensing errors were not at least partly due to label confusion or misreading, introducing QR-coded labels would not help in reducing errors. Therefore, this belief is necessary for the decision and is clearly taken for granted.

Assumption II: For QR-coded labels to reduce errors in real pharmacy operations, staff must be able to use the system efficiently without disrupting workflow. If the system were too slow or impractical, it would not serve the stated purpose. Hence, this assumption is also implicit.

So, both Assumption I and Assumption II are implicit.

questions.question: A school canteen keeps a jar with equal numbers of ₹2 coins, ₹5 coins and ₹10 coins, and the total value of all coins together is ₹255, what is the total number of coins in the jar?
questions.question_hi: एक स्कूल कैंटीन में बराबर संख्या में ₹2 के सिक्के, ₹5 के सिक्के और ₹10 के सिक्के एक जार में रखे गए हैं, और सभी सिक्कों का कुल मूल्य ₹255 है, तो जार में कुल सिक्कों की संख्या क्या है?
questions.solution:
Let x = number of ₹2 coins = number of ₹5 coins = number of ₹10 coins.

Total value = 2x + 5x + 10x = 255

17x = 255

x = 15

Total number of coins = x + x + x = 3x = 45

Which of the following does not belong to the following series?

(Left) 627 941 358 784 569 (Right)

(Example: 697 - First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the first digit of the second highest number is added to the second digit of the second lowest number and then the third digit of the highest number is added to the result?
questions.question_hi:
यह प्रश्न नीचे दिए गए पांच, तीन-अंकों की संख्याओं पर आधारित है।

(बाएं) 627 941 358 784 569 (दाएं)

(उदाहरण: 697 - पहला अंक = 6, दूसरा अंक = 9 और तीसरा अंक = 7)

(ध्यान दें: सभी क्रियाएं बाएं से दाएं की ओर की जानी हैं।)

यदि दूसरे सबसे बड़े नंबर के पहले अंक को दूसरे सबसे छोटे नंबर के दूसरे अंक में जोड़ा जाए और फिर सबसे बड़े नंबर के तीसरे अंक को परिणाम में जोड़ा जाए तो परिणाम क्या होगा?
questions.solution:
Highest number = 941

Second highest number = 784

Second lowest number = 569

First digit of 784 = 7

Second digit of 569 = 6

Third digit of 941 = 1

Resultant = 7 + 6 + 1 = 13 + 1 = 14

आठ लोग दो समानांतर पंक्तियों में बैठे हैं। पंक्ति-1 में - K, L, M और N उत्तर की ओर बैठे हैं, और पंक्ति-2 में - O, P, Q और R दक्षिण की ओर बैठे हैं। एक पंक्ति में प्रत्येक व्यक्ति ठीक एक व्यक्ति का सामना करता है जो दूसरी पंक्ति में होता है। जो व्यक्ति O का सामना करता है, उसके तुरंत दाईं ओर कौन बैठा है?

कथन I: Q, L का सामना करता है और L पंक्ति-1 के सबसे बाएं छोर पर बैठा है। K और L के बीच दो व्यक्ति हैं।

कथन II: P पंक्ति-2 के किसी एक छोर पर बैठा है। R, Q के तुरंत बाईं ओर बैठा है।

options.label: A
options.text: Data in statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
options.text_hi: वक्तव्यों I और II में दी गई जानकारी मिलकर प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।

options.label: B
options.text: Data in statements I and II together are sufficient to answer the question.
options.text_hi: वक्तव्यों I और II में दी गई जानकारी मिलकर प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है।

options.label: C
options.text: Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not.
options.text_hi: केवल वक्तव्य I में दी गई जानकारी प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि वक्तव्य II में नहीं है।

options.label: D
options.text: Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not.
options.text_hi: केवल वक्तव्य II में दी गई जानकारी प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि वक्तव्य I में नहीं है।

questions.solution:

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'SAND' is coded as 'UDLA' and 'CAVE' is coded as 'EDTB'. How will 'FOLD' be coded in the same language?
questions.question_hi: एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में, 'SAND' को 'UDLA' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है और 'CAVE' को 'EDTB' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है। उसी भाषा में 'FOLD' को कैसे कोडित किया जाएगा?
questions.solution:
Use letter positions: A=1, B=2, C=3, D=4.., Z=26

SAND → UDLA

S→U (+2), A→D (+3), N→L (-2), D→A (-3)

CAVE → EDTB

C→E (+2), A→D (+3), V→T (-2), E→B (-3)

FOLD

F→H (+2)

O→R (+3)

L→J (-2)

D→A (-3)

So, code = HRJA

questions.solution:
From 'river cuts valley' = da mo ki

From 'river brings fog' = da re po

Common word is "river", common code is "da"

So, river = da

questions.question: What was the day of the week on 3rd March 2005?
questions.question_hi: 3 मार्च 2005 को सप्ताह का कौन-सा दिन था?
questions.solution:
3rd March, 2005 = (2004 years + Period from 1.1.2005 to 3.3. 2005)

Till 2000, we have 0 odd days.

From 2001-2004 ( 1 leap year (2004) + 3 ordinary years) = ( 1x2 + 3x 1) = 5 odd days

From 1.1.2005 to 3.3. 2005 = 31 + 28 + 3= 62 days

8 weeks + 6 days = 6 odd days

Total number of odd days = 0 + 5 + 6 = 11

11/7 , so the day is Thursday.

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

Some stones are cubes.

No cube is a glass.

All bats are cubes.

Conclusions:

I. Some stones being bats is a possibility

II. No bat is a glass

III. All cubes are bats.

IV. No stone is a glass.
questions.question_hi:
दिए गए कथनों और निष्कर्षों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें। यह मानते हुए कि कथनों में दी गई सूचना सत्य है, भले ही यह सामान्य रूप से ज्ञात तथ्यों से भिन्न प्रतीत होती हो, यह निर्धारित करें कि दिए गए निष्कर्षों में से कौन-सा/से निष्कर्ष कथन(कथनों) का तार्किक रूप से अनुसरण करता/करते है/हैं।

कथन :

कोई cube, glass नहीं है।

निष्कर्ष :

II. कोई bat, glass नहीं है।

III. सभी cubes, bats हैं।

options.label: D

questions.correct_text: Only Conclusions I and II follow
questions.solution:
Statements:

Some stones are cubes.

No cube is a glass.

All bats are cubes.

Some stones being bats is a possibility. Some stones are cubes. All bats are cubes. Thus, some stones being bats is possibility. So, conclusion I is true.

No bat is a glass. No cube is a glass. All bats are cubes. Thus, No bat is a glass. So, conclusion II is true.

All cubes are bats. All bats are cubes. SO all cubes cannot be bats. So, conclusion III is false.

No stone is a glass. There is no relation between stone and glass. So, conclusion IV is false.

Hence, only conclusions I and II follow.
