बौद्ध शिला-कट वास्तुकला के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) चैत्य मुख्य रूप से एक आवासीय परिसर है जिसे केंद्रीय हॉल और छोटे-छोटे व्यक्तिगत कक्षों के साथ डिजाइन किया गया है ताकि वर्षा ऋतु के दौरान भटकते भिक्षुओं को आवास मिल सके।

ii) विहार प्रार्थना और सभा हॉल के रूप में कार्य करता है, जो आमतौर पर आयताकार आकार का होता है और एक छोर पर संगठित पूजा के लिए एक स्तूप होता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
statement (i) is incorrect:

· A Chaitya is not a residential complex.

· It is a prayer hall used for congregational worship.

· Key features of a Chaitya:

o Long apsidal hall

o Stupa at one end

o Used for ritual worship and prayer

statement (ii) is incorrect:

· A Vihara is not a prayer hall with a stupa.

· It is a residential monastery meant for monks.

· Key features of a Vihara:

o Central rectangular hall

o Small cells around the hall for monks

o Sometimes a shrine added later, but originally residential

Further Insights

• Chaityas are generally apsidal in shape

• Viharas became larger as monasteries grew

• Ajanta has both Chaityas and Viharas

• Early Viharas had no idols

• Stupas symbolise the presence of the Buddha

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the nature of India's public debt:

i) A high proportion of external debt is considered safer than internal debt as it brings foreign currency into the domestic economy.

ii) India's public debt profile is characterized by a low currency risk because most of its borrowings are denominated in Rupees and held by domestic institutions.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत के सार्वजनिक ऋण की प्रकृति के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) बाहरी ऋण का उच्च अनुपात आंतरिक ऋण की तुलना में अधिक सुरक्षित माना जाता है क्योंकि यह घरेलू अर्थव्यवस्था में विदेशी मुद्रा लाता है।

ii) भारत के सार्वजनिक ऋण प्रोफ़ाइल की विशेषता कम मुद्रा जोखिम है क्योंकि इसका अधिकांश उधार रुपये में है और घरेलू संस्थानों के पास है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: A
options.text: Both statements i and ii are correct
options.text_hi: दोनों कथन i और ii सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither statement i nor ii is correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन i सही है और न ही ii सही है

questions.solution:
External debt, though it brings foreign currency, exposes the country to exchange rate risk, repayment pressure, and external shocks. Hence, a high proportion of external debt is riskier, not safer.

India's public debt is largely internal, denominated in domestic currency, and held by domestic institutions, which significantly reduces currency risk.

Further Insights:

• External debt carries exchange rate and rollover risks

• Internal debt allows better monetary and fiscal coordination

• India's debt profile is often cited as structurally stable

• Currency composition matters more than debt size

questions.question: Which of the following was NOT an administrative or economic reform of Sikandar Lodi aimed at strengthening central control?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सिकंदर लोदी के केंद्रीय नियंत्रण को मजबूत करने के लिए किए गए प्रशासनिक या आर्थिक सुधारों में से नहीं था?

options.label: A
options.text: He introduced a standard land-measurement system called Gaj-i-Sikandari.
options.text_hi: उन्होंने गज-ए-सिकंदरी नामक एक मानक भूमि-मापन प्रणाली पेश की।

options.label: B
options.text: He shifted the capital from Delhi to Agra to govern more effectively.
options.text_hi: उन्होंने अधिक प्रभावी शासन के लिए राजधानी दिल्ली से आगरा स्थानांतरित कर दी।

options.label: C
options.text: He treated Afghan nobles as his equals and followed tribal traditions like sitting on the floor with them.
options.text_hi: उन्होंने अफगान कुलीनों को अपने समकक्ष माना और उनके साथ जमीन पर बैठने जैसी जनजातीय परंपराओं का पालन किया।

options.label: D
options.text: He removed certain taxes on grain and internal trade to reduce prices.
options.text_hi: उन्होंने कीमतें कम करने के लिए अनाज और आंतरिक व्यापार पर कुछ कर हटा दिए।

questions.correct_text: He treated Afghan nobles as his equals and followed tribal traditions like sitting on the floor with them.
questions.solution:
Sikandar Lodi did not follow Afghan tribal equality. Unlike his father Bahlul Lodi, he strengthened royal authority by enforcing strict discipline among nobles and emphasizing the supremacy of the Sultan.

He expected nobles to follow court etiquette and obedience, which helped centralize power.

The Gaj-i-Sikandari was introduced to standardize land measurement, helping in fair and efficient revenue collection.

He founded Agra as the capital in 1506 to better manage the eastern regions of the Sultanate.

He reduced certain taxes on essential goods to control prices and improve public welfare.

Further insights

• Sikandar Lodi was the most powerful ruler of the Lodi dynasty

• He emphasized centralization over tribal customs

• Agra later became a major Mughal capital

• Land-revenue reforms strengthened the state economy

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding India's performance at the ISSF World Cup Final 2025 in Doha:

i) Simranpreet Kaur Brar won the gold medal in the women's 25 m pistol event, equalling a Junior World Record previously set by an Olympic champion.

ii) India finished at the top of the overall medal tally by securing a total of five medals, including two gold medals.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
दोहा में ISSF वर्ल्ड कप फाइनल 2025 में भारत के प्रदर्शन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) सिमरनप्रीत कौर बरार ने महिला 25 मीटर पिस्टल इवेंट में स्वर्ण पदक जीता, जो एक ओलंपिक चैंपियन द्वारा पहले स्थापित जूनियर विश्व रिकॉर्ड के बराबर था।

ii) भारत ने कुल पांच पदक जीतकर, जिनमें दो स्वर्ण पदक शामिल हैं, कुल पदक तालिका में शीर्ष स्थान प्राप्त किया।

उपरोक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: A
options.text: Both statements i and ii are correct
options.text_hi: दोनों कथन i और ii सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither statement i nor ii is correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन i सही है और न ही ii सही है

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is correct.

Simranpreet Kaur Brar won the gold medal in the women's 25 m pistol event at the ISSF World Cup Final 2025 in Doha and equalled the Junior World Record with her final score.

Statement (ii) is incorrect.

India did not finish at the top of the overall medal tally.

India finished second overall, earning a total of six medals (including two golds, three silvers, and one bronze). China topped the standings with more medals.

Further Insights

• India recorded its best-ever medal haul at a World Cup Final.

• India won two gold medals - one by Simranpreet and another by Suruchi Phogat.

• India also secured three silver medals.

• China topped the medals table with four golds and nine medals overall.

questions.question: Which institution acts as the nodal agency in India for nominating cultural elements to the UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity?
questions.question_hi: भारत में मानवता की अमूर्त सांस्कृतिक विरासत की यूनेस्को प्रतिनिधि सूची में सांस्कृतिक तत्वों को नामित करने के लिए कौन सा संस्थान नोडल एजेंसी के रूप में कार्य करता है?
questions.solution:
The Sangeet Natak Akademi is the national nodal agency for:

· Identifying

· Documenting

· Preparing nominations

of India's intangible cultural heritage (ICH) for UNESCO.

It deals with performing arts, rituals, traditions, and living cultural practices, which fall under ICH.

Further Insights

• ICH includes rituals, festivals, oral traditions, crafts

• Yoga and Garba are on UNESCO's ICH list

• Community participation is mandatory for nominations

• ICH focuses on living heritage, not monuments

• India ratified the UNESCO ICH Convention in 2005

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the TRISHNA Mission?
questions.question_hi: त्रिश्ना मिशन का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?

options.label: A
options.text: A joint deep-sea exploration mission by ISRO and NASA to study minerals on the ocean floor.
options.text_hi: महासागर के तल पर खनिजों का अध्ययन करने के लिए इसरो और नासा की संयुक्त गहरे समुद्र अन्वेषण मिशन।

options.label: B
options.text: A joint satellite mission of ISRO and CNES to monitor Earth's surface using thermal infrared imaging.
options.text_hi: थर्मल इन्फ्रारेड इमेजिंग का उपयोग करके पृथ्वी की सतह की निगरानी के लिए इसरो और CNES का संयुक्त उपग्रह मिशन।

options.label: C
options.text: A joint Moon mission by ISRO and JAXA to search for water ice at the Moon's South Pole.
options.text_hi: चंद्रमा के दक्षिणी ध्रुव पर जल बर्फ की खोज के लिए इसरो और JAXA का संयुक्त चंद्र मिशन।

options.label: D
options.text: An Indian space telescope to study distant stars, exoplanets, and black holes.
options.text_hi: दूर के सितारों, एक्सोप्लैनेट्स, और ब्लैक होल का अध्ययन करने के लिए एक भारतीय अंतरिक्ष दूरबीन।

questions.correct_text: A joint satellite mission of ISRO and CNES to monitor Earth's surface using thermal infrared imaging.
questions.solution:
TRISHNA (Thermal InfraRed Imaging Satellite for High-resolution Natural resource Assessment) is a joint satellite mission of ISRO and CNES (France).

Its main objective is to:

· Measure land surface temperature

· Monitor water stress, agriculture, forests, and climate-related processes

It uses high-resolution thermal infrared sensors, which are crucial for natural resource management.

Further Insights

• Thermal infrared data helps detect drought and crop stress

• TRISHNA supports climate change and water-cycle studies

• Land surface temperature is different from air temperature

questions.question: Which Indian city is the designated host for the 7th India International Seaweed Expo and Summit 2026?
questions.question_hi: 7वें इंडिया इंटरनेशनल सीवीड एक्सपो और समिट 2026 के लिए नामित मेजबान भारतीय शहर कौन सा है?
questions.solution:
The 7th India International Seaweed Expo & Summit 2026 is scheduled to be held on January 29 - 30, 2026 at the ICAR-Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute (ICAR-CMFRI) in Kochi, Kerala.

Kochi is hosting the event as part of India's push to promote seaweed as a sunrise sector and boost sustainable blue economy development, with global delegates expected to participate.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the three core components used to calculate the Human Capital Index (HCI):

i) The 'Survival' pillar is measured by the probability of a child surviving until the age of five.

ii) The 'Health' component is measured exclusively by the adult survival rate, which reflects the proportion of 15-year-olds who survive until the age of 60.

iii) The 'School' component uses Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling (LAYS) to capture both the quantity and quality of education.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
मानव पूंजी सूचकांक (HCI) की गणना के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले तीन मुख्य घटकों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) 'जीवित रहने' स्तंभ को पांच वर्ष की आयु तक बच्चे के जीवित रहने की संभावना द्वारा मापा जाता है।

ii) 'स्वास्थ्य' घटक को केवल वयस्क जीवित रहने की दर द्वारा मापा जाता है, जो 15 वर्ष के बच्चों में से 60 वर्ष की आयु तक जीवित रहने वाले अनुपात को दर्शाता है।

iii) 'स्कूल' घटक शिक्षा की मात्रा और गुणवत्ता दोनों को पकड़ने के लिए लर्निंग-एडजस्टेड ईयर्स ऑफ स्कूलिंग (LAYS) का उपयोग करता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement (i) is correct

Under the HCI framework developed by the World Bank,

the Survival component is measured by the under-5 survival rate.

Statement (iii) is correct

· The school component uses Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling (LAYS).

· LAYS combines:

o Years spent in school (quantity)

o Actual learning outcomes (quality)

Statement (ii) is incorrect

· The Health component is not measured exclusively by adult survival rate.

· It includes:

o Adult survival rate (15 to 60 years)

o Child health indicators (such as stunting in children)

The word "exclusively" makes the statement wrong.

Further Insights (Human Capital Index):

• HCI values range from 0 to 1

• India's HCI score reflects future workforce productivity

• Education quality matters more than enrollment alone

• Child stunting reduces lifetime productivity

questions.question: Which digital application is mainly used by the National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) for conducting the four-yearly tiger census in India using camera traps?
questions.question_hi: भारत में राष्ट्रीय बाघ संरक्षण प्राधिकरण (NTCA) द्वारा कैमरा ट्रैप का उपयोग करके चार वर्षीय बाघ जनगणना करने के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा डिजिटल एप्लिकेशन उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution:
M-STrIPES (Monitoring System for Tigers - Intensive Protection and Ecological Status) is a mobile-based application.

It is specifically designed for:

· Recording camera-trap data

· Monitoring tiger movements

· Collecting field-level information during the All-India Tiger Estimation exercise.

NTCA uses this app to manage the world's largest camera-trapping survey conducted every four years

SAFAR

Related to air quality monitoring and weather forecasting.

BHUVAN

A satellite-based geo-portal developed by ISRO, Used for mapping and spatial analysis.

Further Insights

• India conducts the tiger census every four years

• The survey uses camera traps + field signs

• India has the largest tiger population in the world

• NTCA works under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

questions.question: Which of the following subjects was NOT among those transferred from the State List to the Concurrent List by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा विषय 42वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 1976 द्वारा राज्य सूची से समवर्ती सूची में स्थानांतरित नहीं किया गया था?

options.label: B
options.text: Protection of wild animals and birds
options.text_hi: जंगली जानवरों और पक्षियों की सुरक्षा

questions.solution:
The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976 shifted certain subjects from the State List to the Concurrent List to strengthen the role of the Union in policymaking.

However, public health and sanitation were not transferred and continue to remain in the State List.

This subject largely involves local governance, hospitals, sanitation systems, and disease control, which are best handled at the state and local levels.

Education was transferred from the State List to the Concurrent List by the 42nd Amendment.

This allowed both the Union and States to legislate on education to ensure uniform standards nationwide.

Protection of wild animals and birds

This subject was also shifted to the Concurrent List to enable coordinated national wildlife conservation policies.

Administration of justice (excluding Supreme Court and High Courts) was moved to the

Concurrent List to bring consistency in judicial administration across states.

Further insights

• The 42nd Constitutional Amendment is also known as the "Mini-Constitution"

• It aimed to increase centralization during the Emergency period

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the Special Public Prosecutor by the Ministry of Home Affairs to represent the National Investigation Agency (NIA) in the Red Fort blast case?
questions.question_hi: राष्ट्रीय जांच एजेंसी (NIA) का प्रतिनिधित्व करने के लिए गृह मंत्रालय द्वारा रेड फोर्ट विस्फोट मामले में विशेष लोक अभियोजक के रूप में किसे नियुक्त किया गया है?
questions.solution: Senior advocate Madhav Khurana has been appointed as the Special Public Prosecutor by the Union Home Ministry to represent the NIA in the Red Fort blast case, handling trial proceedings before the NIA Special Court and the Delhi High Court.

questions.question: Under India's new criminal laws, what is the legal process called when a court conducts a trial and gives a verdict even if the accused has absconded and does not appear before the court?
questions.question_hi: भारत के नए आपराधिक कानूनों के तहत, उस कानूनी प्रक्रिया को क्या कहा जाता है जब कोई अदालत मुकदमा चलाती है और दोषी के फरार होने और अदालत के समक्ष उपस्थित न होने पर भी फैसला सुनाती है?
questions.solution:
Trial in Absentia means conducting a trial in the absence of the accused.

Under the new criminal justice framework, courts are empowered to:

· Proceed with the trial

· Examine evidence

· Deliver judgment

even if the accused is a proclaimed offender who has absconded.

Further Insights

• Introduced to ensure speedy justice

• Targets fugitive and absconding offenders

• Reduces misuse of procedural delays

• Strengthens victim-centric justice

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution allows the President to nominate 12 members to the Rajya Sabha for their special knowledge in art, science, literature, and social service?
questions.question_hi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद राष्ट्रपति को कला, विज्ञान, साहित्य और सामाजिक सेवा में उनके विशेष ज्ञान के लिए राज्यसभा में 12 सदस्यों को नामित करने की अनुमति देता है?
questions.solution:
Article 80 deals with the composition of the Rajya Sabha.

It authorises the President of India to nominate 12 members who have special knowledge or practical experience in:

Literature

Science

Art

Social service

Further Insights (Indian Polity):

• Rajya Sabha is the permanent House of Parliament

• One-third of its members retire every two years

• Nominated members have full voting rights

• They can join a political party within six months

• Nomination ensures diverse expertise in law-making

questions.question: Who was named the World Athlete of the Year (Men's category) at the 2025 World Athletics Awards after remaining undefeated in the pole vault for two consecutive years?
questions.question_hi: 2025 विश्व एथलेटिक्स पुरस्कारों में दो लगातार वर्षों तक पोल वॉल्ट में अजेय रहने के बाद पुरुष वर्ग में विश्व एथलीट ऑफ द ईयर किसे नामित किया गया था?
questions.solution:
Swedish pole vault superstar Armand "Mondo" Duplantis was named the Men's World Athlete of the Year at the 2025 World Athletics Awards. He remained undefeated in all 16 competitions during the season, set four world records, and won both indoor and outdoor world titles - making him the first male pole vaulter in modern history to stay unbeaten for two consecutive years

Further Insights

• Sydney McLaughlin-Levrone was named Women's World Athlete of the Year.

• Duplantis also earned Men's Field Athlete of the Year honours.

• Emmanuel Wanyonyi won Men's Track Athlete of the Year.

• Sabastian Sawe was rewarded in the out-of-stadium category.

• Duplantis's unbeaten run included indoor and outdoor titles.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the glaciers of the Indian subcontinent:

i) The Siachen Glacier, located in the Karakoram Range, is the largest glacier in the world and serves as the source of the river Teesta River.

ii) The Karakoram Anomaly refers to a unique phenomenon where glaciers in the Karakoram Range remain stable or expand despite the global trend of glacial retreat.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप के ग्लेशियरों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) सियाचिन ग्लेशियर, जो काराकोरम रेंज में स्थित है, विश्व का सबसे बड़ा ग्लेशियर है और यह तीस्ता नदी का स्रोत है।

ii) काराकोरम विसंगति एक अनूठी घटना को संदर्भित करती है जहाँ काराकोरम रेंज के ग्लेशियर वैश्विक ग्लेशियल पीछे हटने की प्रवृत्ति के बावजूद स्थिर रहते हैं या बढ़ते हैं।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: A
options.text: Both statements i and ii are correct
options.text_hi: दोनों कथन i और ii सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither statement i nor ii is correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन i सही है और न ही ii सही है

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is incorrect

The Siachen Glacier is the largest glacier in the Himalayas and the longest in India, but not the largest in the world.

It does not give rise to the Teesta River.

Teesta originates from Tso Lhamo Lake in Sikkim, in the Eastern Himalayas.

Siachen feeds the Nubra River, a tributary of the Indus.

Statement (ii) is correct

The Karakoram Anomaly is a well-documented geographical phenomenon.

Unlike most glaciers worldwide, many Karakoram glaciers are stable or advancing due to:

Heavy winter snowfall

Lower summer melting

Unique climatic and topographic conditions

Further Insights (Glaciers + Climate):

• The Karakoram Range lies mostly in cold desert conditions

• Teesta River is part of the Ganga - Brahmaputra river system, not Indus

• Most Himalayan glaciers are retreating rapidly due to climate change

• Karakoram Anomaly challenges simplistic climate - glacier models

questions.question: In the evolution of the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue (QUAD), what was the importance of the 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami?
questions.question_hi: चतुर्भुज सुरक्षा संवाद (QUAD) के विकास में, 2004 के भारतीय महासागर सुनामी का क्या महत्व था?

options.label: A
options.text: It led to a formal military alliance among the four countries.
options.text_hi: इसने चार देशों के बीच एक औपचारिक सैन्य गठबंधन की स्थापना की।

options.label: B
options.text: It showed how the four countries could work together in disaster relief through a joint coordination group.
options.text_hi: इसने दिखाया कि चार देश आपदा राहत में एक संयुक्त समन्वय समूह के माध्यम से कैसे मिलकर काम कर सकते हैं।

options.label: C
options.text: It marked the first official use of the term "Indo-Pacific" by all four countries.
options.text_hi: इसने सभी चार देशों द्वारा "इंडो-पैसिफिक" शब्द के पहले आधिकारिक उपयोग को चिह्नित किया।

options.label: D
options.text: It resulted in the permanent deployment of a joint naval force in the Indian Ocean.
options.text_hi: इसका परिणाम भारतीय महासागर में एक संयुक्त नौसेना बल की स्थायी तैनाती के रूप में हुआ।

questions.correct_text: It showed how the four countries could work together in disaster relief through a joint coordination group.
questions.solution:
After the 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami, India, the United States, Japan, and Australia came together informally to coordinate humanitarian assistance and disaster relief. This arrangement, known as the Tsunami Core Group, demonstrated their collective naval, logistical, and coordination capacity.

This cooperation laid the practical foundation for future strategic dialogue, which later evolved into the QUAD.

Further insights

• The Tsunami Core Group is often seen as the informal precursor to the QUAD

• QUAD is a strategic dialogue, not a military alliance

• Disaster relief is a key non-traditional security role of navies

• QUAD was formally revived in 2017

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974 - 1978):

i) Prioritized the Minimum Needs Programme.

ii) Focused heavily on poverty alleviation.

iii) Completed its full five-year tenure.

iv) Terminated early by Morarji Desai.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें जो पंचवर्षीय योजना (1974 - 1978) के संबंध में हैं:

i) न्यूनतम आवश्यकताएँ कार्यक्रम को प्राथमिकता दी।

ii) गरीबी उन्मूलन पर भारी ध्यान केंद्रित किया।

iii) अपनी पूरी पांच वर्षीय अवधि पूरी की।

iv) मोरारजी देसाई द्वारा समय से पहले समाप्त की गई।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
The Fifth Five-Year Plan placed strong emphasis on poverty alleviation through targeted welfare measures and introduced the Minimum Needs Programme (MNP) to ensure basic necessities.

However, the plan did not complete its full tenure and was terminated early in 1978 after a change in government led by Morarji Desai.

Further insights

• The Fifth Plan's main slogan was "Garibi Hatao"

• Minimum Needs Programme targeted health, education, housing, and drinking water

• It marked a shift from growth-centric to welfare-centric planning

• The plan period coincided with the Emergency (1975 - 77)

• The Rolling Plan replaced fixed planning after the Fifth Plan's termination

questions.question: What is the primary objective of implementing the Public - Private Partnership (PPP) model for monument conservation in India?
questions.question_hi: भारत में स्मारक संरक्षण के लिए सार्वजनिक-निजी भागीदारी (PPP) मॉडल को लागू करने का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?

options.label: A
options.text: To transfer ownership of protected monuments to private companies
options.text_hi: संरक्षित स्मारकों का स्वामित्व निजी कंपनियों को स्थानांतरित करने के लिए

options.label: B
options.text: To increase entry ticket prices and maximise revenue
options.text_hi: प्रवेश टिकट की कीमतें बढ़ाने और राजस्व अधिकतम करने के लिए

options.label: C
options.text: To improve visitor amenities, upkeep, and maintenance of monuments
options.text_hi: आगंतुक सुविधाओं, रखरखाव, और स्मारकों के संरक्षण में सुधार करने के लिए

options.label: D
options.text: To restrict public access and allow monuments to be viewed only from a distance
options.text_hi: सार्वजनिक पहुंच को प्रतिबंधित करने और स्मारकों को केवल दूर से देखने की अनुमति देने के लिए

questions.correct_text: To improve visitor amenities, upkeep, and maintenance of monuments
questions.solution:
Under the PPP model (such as the Adopt a Heritage initiative), private entities support:

· Better visitor facilities

· Cleanliness and basic infrastructure

· Improved maintenance and management

Ownership and control remain with the government, mainly under the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI).

The aim is heritage preservation with public access, not commercialization.

Further Insights

• The Adopt a Heritage scheme was launched in 2017

• ASI remains the final authority over protected monuments

• PPP reduces financial burden on the government

• Heritage conservation supports cultural tourism

questions.question: Which of the following is the name of the fifth edition of the joint military exercise between India and Malaysia held at the Mahajan Field Firing Range in Rajasthan in December 2025?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा नाम भारत और मलेशिया के बीच दिसंबर 2025 में राजस्थान के महाजन फील्ड फायरिंग रेंज में आयोजित संयुक्त सैन्य अभ्यास के पांचवें संस्करण का है?
questions.solution:
The fifth edition of the joint military exercise between India and Malaysia, Harimau Shakti 2025, was conducted at the Mahajan Field Firing Range, Rajasthan, from December 5 to 18, 2025.

The exercise focuses on enhancing interoperability and joint training, particularly sub-conventional operations and counter-terror scenarios under the United Nations Chapter VII mandate.

questions.question: The first personal computer (PC) for the home user in 1981 was introduced by
questions.question_hi: 1981 में घरेलू उपयोगकर्ता के लिए पहला पर्सनल कंप्यूटर (पीसी) किसके द्वारा प्रस्तुत किया गया था?
questions.solution: IBM introduced its first personal computer (PC) for the home user in 1981 and Apple introduced Macintosh machines in 1984. The popularity of the PC surged by the introduction of Graphical User Interface (GUI) based operating systems by Microsoft and others in place of computers with only command line interface, like UNIX or DOS.

questions.question: ______ is a piece of computer hardware used for saving, carrying and pulling out data.
questions.question_hi: ______ कंप्यूटर हार्डवेयर का एक हिस्सा है जिसका उपयोग डेटा को सेव करने, ले जाने और बाहर निकालने के लिए किया जाता है।
questions.solution:
· A storage device is a piece of computer hardware used for saving, carrying and pulling out data. It can keep and retain information short-term or long-term.

· Storage devices are the devices which are used to retrieved from and saved to the data and information such as hard drives, memory sticks (pen drives), compact discs, DVDs and tape drives.

questions.question: Which audio format is an open-source, lossless codec that compresses audio without losing sound quality?
questions.question_hi: कौन सा ऑडियो फॉर्मेट एक ओपन-सोर्स, लॉसलेस कोडेक है जो ध्वनि गुणवत्ता खोए बिना ऑडियो को संपीड़ित करता है?
questions.solution:
FLAC (Free Lossless Audio Codec) is an open-source audio format that compresses audio without removing any original sound data. After decompression, the audio is bit-for-bit identical to the original recording.

Further Insights

· Lossless formats are preferred in professional audio editing and archiving.

· FLAC files are larger than MP3 but much smaller than uncompressed WAV files.

· Audiophiles prefer FLAC for high-fidelity music playback.

· Lossy formats trade sound quality for storage efficiency.

questions.question: Which among the following is used to convert low level language into machine level language?
questions.question_hi: निम्नस्तरीय भाषा को मशीन स्तरीय भाषा में बदलने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से किसका उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution: Assembler is the program used in order to convert low level language or assembly language used in the computer into machine language so that it can be processed by the CPU of the system

questions.question: Which of the following is a technology that uses wireless internet connectivity?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी तकनीक वायरलेस इंटरनेट कनेक्टिविटी का उपयोग करती है?
questions.solution: WiMAX (Worldwide Interoperability for Microwave Access) is a wireless communications standard designed to provide mobile broadband connectivity across cities and countries through a variety of devices. WiMAX is a long range system, covering many kilometres and is typically used where DSL or Cable Internet Access cannot be used; this could be difficulty in laying out cables for home or offices located in remote locations but need access to the Internet.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a primary function or native capability of Microsoft Excel?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन Microsoft Excel का प्राथमिक कार्य या मूल क्षमता नहीं है?

options.label: A
options.text: Data Visualization: Creating dynamic charts, pivot tables, and graphs to represent numerical trends.
options.text_hi: डेटा विज़ुअलाइज़ेशन: संख्यात्मक रुझानों का प्रतिनिधित्व करने के लिए गतिशील चार्ट, पिवट टेबल और ग्राफ़ बनाना।

options.label: B
options.text: Automated Calculation: Using a library of logical, financial, and mathematical formulas to process large datasets.
options.text_hi: स्वचालित गणना: बड़े डेटा सेट को संसाधित करने के लिए तार्किक, वित्तीय और गणितीय सूत्रों की एक लाइब्रेरी का उपयोग करना।

options.label: C
options.text: RDBMS Management: Acting as a full-scale Relational Database Management System to handle millions of complex table relationships with SQL.
options.text_hi: RDBMS प्रबंधन: SQL के साथ लाखों जटिल तालिका संबंधों को संभालने के लिए एक पूर्ण-स्केल रिलेशनल डेटाबेस प्रबंधन प्रणाली के रूप में कार्य करना।

options.label: D
options.text: Data Sorting and Filtering: Organizing unstructured information into specific hierarchies and extracting subsets based on criteria.
options.text_hi: डेटा छंटाई और फ़िल्टरिंग: असंरचित जानकारी को विशिष्ट पदानुक्रमों में व्यवस्थित करना और मानदंडों के आधार पर उपसमूह निकालना।

questions.correct_text: RDBMS Management: Acting as a full-scale Relational Database Management System to handle millions of complex table relationships with SQL.
questions.solution:
Excel is NOT a full-scale Relational Database Management System (RDBMS).

It cannot efficiently manage millions of records, complex table relationships, or advanced SQL-based database operations like a true database system.

Further Insights

· Excel is best suited for small to medium-sized datasets.

· Databases are better for handling multi-user, large-scale data.

· Excel supports formulas, charts, and pivot tables but not advanced SQL.

· RDBMS systems ensure data integrity and relationships at scale.

· Excel is mainly an analysis tool, not a backend data server.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a search Engine?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प एक सर्च इंजन नहीं है?
questions.solution: Search engine is a platform on which a user can search the internet content. Google, Yahoo, Bing, Baidu, and DuckDuckGo are popular search engines. Google is one of the most used search engines worldwide that is used with the Chrome browser. So, almost everyone is familiar with it.

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate term: Microsoft Word is a ____________ processing program.
questions.question_hi:
रिक्त स्थान की उचित शब्द से पूर्ति कीजिए:

माइक्रोसॉफ्ट वर्ड एक ____________ प्रोसेसिंग प्रोग्राम है।
questions.solution: Microsoft Word is a word processing program, which means it is designed specifically for creating, editing, and formatting documents containing text. Word processing programs like Microsoft Word provide various tools and features for efficient document creation, including text formatting options, spell check, grammar check, and the ability to insert images and tables. Microsoft Word is widely used in both personal and professional settings for tasks such as writing letters, creating reports, designing flyers, and much more. It is part of the Microsoft Office suite of productivity applications and has become the industry standard for word processing.

questions.question: Based on the size, the computers are of four types. Which of the following is not one of them?
questions.question_hi: आकार के आधार पर कंप्यूटर चार प्रकार के होते हैं। निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा उनमें से एक नहीं है?
questions.solution:
On the basis of size, the computer can be of four types:

· Microcomputer

· Minicomputer

· Mainframe computer

· Supercomputer

questions.question: Which shortcut key is used to cut selected text in most operating systems?
questions.question_hi: अधिकांश ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम में सेलेक्टेड टेक्स्ट को कट करने के लिए किस शॉर्टकट की (key) का प्रयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution:
The shortcut key combination 'Ctrl + X' is commonly used to cut selected text or files in most operating systems. To paste the text shortcut key combination of 'Ctrl + V' is used.

Shortcut key combination 'Ctrl + S' is used to save a file.

questions.question: Resolution of printer is measured in ____.
questions.question_hi: प्रिंटर का रिज़ोल्यूशन ____ में मापा जाता है।
questions.solution:
· Print resolution is measured using dots per inch (dpi), which literally measures the number of individual dots of ink or toner printers can apply to a square inch of paper.

· Higher dpi means there are more dots available to create color gradations and capture fine detail for crisp, colorful print images.

questions.question: Which of the following port is used for connecting Printer and Scanner?
questions.question_hi: प्रिंटर और स्कैनर को कनेक्ट करने के लिए निम्न में से किस पोर्ट का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution: A wired printer comes with a USB port that allows connecting the printer to the USB port of the computer using a USB printer cable. USB is a plug and play interface that allows a computer to communicate with peripheral and other devices.

questions.question: Which of the following printer works by spraying ionized ink on a sheet of paper?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा प्रिंटर कागज की शीट पर आयनित स्याही छिड़क कर काम करता है?
questions.solution: Ink-jet printers work by spraying ionized ink at a sheet of paper. Magnetized plates in the ink's path direct the ink onto the paper in the desired shapes. Ink-jet printers are capable of producing high quality print approaching that produced by laser printers. A typical ink-jet printer provides a resolution up to 1440*720 dots per inch.

questions.question: Which option best explains the Principle of Least Privilege, as used in User Account Control (UAC)?
questions.question_hi: सबसे कम विशेषाधिकार के सिद्धांत को सबसे अच्छी तरह से कौन सा विकल्प समझाता है, जैसा कि उपयोगकर्ता खाता नियंत्रण (UAC) में उपयोग किया जाता है?

options.label: A
options.text: All users are given full administrative rights by default
options.text_hi: सभी उपयोगकर्ताओं को डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से पूर्ण प्रशासनिक अधिकार दिए जाते हैं

options.label: B
options.text: Programs run with only the minimum permissions needed to perform their task
options.text_hi: कार्यक्रम केवल अपने कार्य को पूरा करने के लिए आवश्यक न्यूनतम अनुमतियों के साथ चलते हैं

options.label: C
options.text: The system gives root access to all third-party applications
options.text_hi: सिस्टम सभी तृतीय-पक्ष अनुप्रयोगों को रूट एक्सेस देता है

options.label: D
options.text: Administrative rights are completely disabled for every user
options.text_hi: प्रत्येक उपयोगकर्ता के लिए प्रशासनिक अधिकार पूरी तरह से अक्षम हैं

questions.correct_text: Programs run with only the minimum permissions needed to perform their task
questions.solution:
The Principle of Least Privilege means:

· Users and applications are given only those permissions that are absolutely necessary

· Extra permissions are granted only when required, often after user approval (via UAC prompt)

This reduces the risk of:

· Malware damage

· Accidental system changes

· Security breaches

Further Insights (Cybersecurity Basics):

• Least privilege limits the impact of malware

• UAC prompts appear only when higher access is needed

• It improves system stability and security

• Common in modern operating systems

questions.question: In MS Word, print option is displayed in:
questions.question_hi: एमएस वर्ड में, प्रिंट विकल्प, ________ में प्रदर्शित होता है।
questions.solution:
Print option is hidden in the 'File Menu' of the MS word. Print preview automatically displays when you click on the Print tab in the Backstage view. Whenever you make a change to a print-related setting, the preview is automatically updated.

Click the File tab, and then click Print. To go back to your document, click the File tab. A preview of your document automatically appears. To view each page, click the arrows below the preview.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a feature in MS Excel?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी सुविधा MS एक्सेल में नहीं है?
questions.solution:
Autograph is not a feature in MS Excel. MS Excel has a feature called 'Signature Line'. A signature line resembles a typical signature placeholder that might appear in a printed document. However, it works differently. When a signature line is inserted into an Excel file, the author can specify information about the intended signer, and instructions for the signer. When an electronic copy of the file is sent to the intended signer, this person sees the signature line and a notification that their signature is requested.

Other options are features in MS Excel.

In the Ribbon, Insert > Text > Text Box.

In the Ribbon, Insert > Text > Header and Footer.

In the Ribbon, Insert > Text > Word Art.

In the Ribbon, Insert > Charts

questions.question: Which one of the following is the function of the operating system?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम का एक कार्य है?
questions.solution: An operating system (OS) can be considered to be a resource manager which manages all the resources of a computer, i.e., its hardware including CPU, RAM, Disk, Network and other input-output devices. It also controls various application software and device drivers, manages system security and handles access by different users. It is the most important system software. Examples of popular OS are Windows, Linux, Android, Macintosh and so on

questions.question: Which of the following pairs of cyber threats and their descriptions is NOT correctly matched?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित साइबर खतरों और उनके विवरणों में से कौन सा जोड़ा सही ढंग से मेल नहीं खाता है?

options.label: A
options.text: Phishing  -  Tricking users into giving sensitive information like passwords through fake emails or messages
options.text_hi: फिशिंग - उपयोगकर्ताओं को नकली ईमेल या संदेशों के माध्यम से पासवर्ड जैसी संवेदनशील जानकारी देने के लिए धोखा देना

options.label: B
options.text: Man-in-the-Middle attack  -  An attacker secretly intercepts and may change communication between two users
options.text_hi: मैन-इन-द-मिडल हमला - एक हमलावर गुप्त रूप से दो उपयोगकर्ताओं के बीच संचार को इंटरसेप्ट करता है और इसे बदल भी सकता है

options.label: C
options.text: DDoS attack  -  An attack meant to steal confidential data by repeatedly trying to log in illegally
options.text_hi: DDoS हमला - एक हमला जो अवैध रूप से बार-बार लॉगिन करने की कोशिश करके गोपनीय डेटा चुराने के लिए किया जाता है

options.label: D
options.text: Ransomware  -  Malware that locks or encrypts files and demands money to unlock them
options.text_hi: रैनसमवेयर - मैलवेयर जो फाइलों को लॉक या एन्क्रिप्ट करता है और उन्हें अनलॉक करने के लिए पैसे की मांग करता है

questions.correct_text: DDoS attack  -  An attack meant to steal confidential data by repeatedly trying to log in illegally
questions.solution:
A DDoS (Distributed Denial of Service) attack is not about stealing data.

Its real aim is to:

· Overload servers or networks

· Make a website or service unavailable to users

It mainly affects availability, not confidentiality.

Further Insights (Cybersecurity Basics):

• DDoS affects availability

• Phishing targets users, not systems

• MitM compromises data integrity

• Ransomware is one of the fastest-growing threats

• Cyber attacks often target the CIA triad (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability)

questions.question: How many nibble create one byte?
questions.question_hi: एक बाइट में कितने निबल होते हैं?
questions.solution:
· A bit (binary digit) is the smallest unit of data that a computer can process and store. A bit is always in one of two physical states, similar to an on/off light switch. The state is represented by a single binary value, usually a 0 or 1.

· In computers and digital technology, a nibble is four binary digits or half of an eight-bit byte.

· Hence, 1 byte = 2 nibble.

questions.correct_text: To control the flow of data between the sender and receiver
questions.solution:
RTS (Request To Send) and CTS (Clear To Send) are hardware flow control signals.

They ensure that:

· The sender transmits data only when the receiver is ready

· Data is not lost due to buffer overflow

Further Insights

• RTS/CTS is used mainly in RS-232 communication

• It is a form of hardware flow control

• Prevents buffer overflow at the receiver end

• Different from software flow control (XON/XOFF)

• Improves reliability, not speed

"

⇒ Total Surface Area = Lateral surface Area + Area of Base

⇒90 = Lateral Surface Area + 30

⇒ Lateral surface Area = 60 cm 2

Now, Area of each lateral surface = 6 cm 2 .

questions.question: The sum of the interior angles of a polygon is 7 times the sum of its exterior angles (one at each vertex). How many diagonals does the polygon have?
questions.question_hi: एक बहुभुज के आंतरिक कोणों का योग उसके बाहरी कोणों के योग (प्रत्येक शीर्ष पर एa) का 7 गुना है। उस बहुभुज के कितने विकर्ण हैं?
questions.solution:
Let n = number of sides

Sum of exterior angles = 360

Sum of interior angles = (n − 2) X 180

Given, (n − 2) X 180 = 7 X 360

n − 2 = 14

n = 16

Number of diagonals = n(n − 3)/2

= 16(16 − 3)/2

= 16 X 13/2

= 104

questions.question: The average weight of a group of men is 70 kg. When two men weighing 80 kg and 90 kg join the group, the average weight increases by 2 kg. How many men were there originally?
questions.question_hi: एक समूह के पुरुषों का औसत वजन 70 किग्रा है। जब 80 किग्रा और 90 किग्रा वजन वाले दो पुरुष समूह में शामिल होते हैं, तो औसत वजन 2 किग्रा बढ़ जाता है। मूल रूप से कितने पुरुष थे?
questions.solution:
Let, the original number of men be x.

Total weight of original group = 70x kg

New total weight = 70x + 80 + 90 = (70x + 170) kg

So, (70x + 170) / (x + 2) = 72

=> 70x + 170 = 72x + 144

=> 2x = 26

=> x = 13

questions.question: Rhea started walking straight from her house to go to her school. During her journey, she turned 15 times right and 14 times left. She is finally walking towards south to reach her school. In which direction did she start walking?
questions.question_hi: रिया अपने घर से सीधे अपने स्कूल जाने के लिए चलना शुरू किया। अपनी यात्रा के दौरान, उसने 15 बार दाएं और 14 बार बाएं मुड़ा। वह अंत में अपने स्कूल तक पहुँचने के लिए दक्षिण की ओर चल रही है। उसने किस दिशा में चलना शुरू किया था?
questions.solution:
Since one left turn and one right turn essentially balance each other out and return you to your initial direction, we can subtract the totals:

Right turns: 15

Left turns: 14

Net Result: 15 right turns - 14 left turns = 1 right turn.

Each right/left turn = 90 degrees.

Thus, one right turn from the starting direction gives the final direction.

Final direction = South

One right turn (i.e., 90 degree) from East gives South

Therefore, Rhea started walking towards the East.

questions.solution:
LUMINANCE

In alphabetical order:

ACEILMNNU

The letter that is third from the left: E

The one that is sixth from the right: I

The number of letters between E and I are F, G and H

So, three letters are there in the English alphabetical series.

Thus, option (b) is the correct answer.

questions.question: If 6 → 35, 8 → 47, 10 → 59, then 12 → ?
questions.question_hi: यदि 6 → 35, 8 → 47, 10 → 59, तो 12 → ?
questions.solution:
The relation follows the pattern 6n − 1.

For n = 6: 6 X 6 − 1 = 35,

For n = 8: 6 X 8 − 1 = 47,

For n = 10: 6 X 10 − 1 = 59.

Using the same rule for n = 12: 6 X 12 − 1 = 71.

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'TRAVEL' is coded as '1816320710', 'DONATE' is coded as '217123187'. What is code for 'LYRICS' in the code language?

questions.solution:
A (1)B (2)C (3)D (4)E (5)F (6)G (7)H (8)I (9)J (10)K (11)L (12)M (13)
Z (26)Y (25)X (24)W (23)V (22)U (21)T (20)S (19)R (18)Q (17)P (16)O (15)N (14)

Logic:-

Consonants: Position - 2

Vowels: Position + 2

'TRAVEL' is coded as '1816320710'

T (20)R (18)A (1)V (22)E (5)L (12)TRAVEL
20-2=1818-2=161+2=322-2=205+2=712-2=101816320710

'DONATE' is coded as '217123187'

D (4)O (15)N (14)A (1)T (20)E (5)DONATE
4 - 2 = 215+2=1714-2=121+2=320-2=185+2=7217123187

For 'LYRICS'-

L (12)Y (25)R (18)I (9)C (3)S (19)LYRICS
12-2=1025-2=2318-2=169+2=113-2=119-2=1710231611117

Thus, 'LYRICS' is coded as '10231611117'.

questions.question:
Read the given statement and courses of action carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement is true, decide which of the given courses of action logically follows for pursuing.

Statement: A railway punctuality analysis shows repeated passenger train delays because unscheduled freight overtakes are being allowed during peak commuter windows. The division has been instructed not to reduce passenger services during the ongoing seasonal rush.

Course of action I: Enforce strict freight slotting outside peak windows and use real-time control to prevent unscheduled overtakes during commute hours.

Course of action II: Permanently cut passenger train frequency on the route to reduce complaints about delays.
questions.question_hi:
दिए गए कथन और कार्यवाही के विकल्पों को ध्यान से पढ़ें। मानते हुए कि कथन में दी गई जानकारी सत्य है, निर्णय लें कि दिए गए कार्यवाही के विकल्पों में से कौन सा तर्कसंगत रूप से अनुसरण करता है।

कथन: एक रेलवे समयपालन विश्लेषण में बार-बार यात्री ट्रेनों की देरी दिखाई गई है क्योंकि पीक कम्यूटर विंडो के दौरान अनियोजित मालगाड़ियों को ओवरटेक करने की अनुमति दी जा रही है। विभाग को मौजूदा मौसमी भीड़ के दौरान यात्री सेवाओं को कम न करने का निर्देश दिया गया है।

कार्यवाही विकल्प I: पीक विंडो के बाहर सख्त मालगाड़ी स्लॉटिंग लागू करें और कम्यूटर घंटों के दौरान अनियोजित ओवरटेक को रोकने के लिए वास्तविक समय नियंत्रण का उपयोग करें।

कार्यवाही विकल्प II: देरी की शिकायतों को कम करने के लिए मार्ग पर यात्री ट्रेन की आवृत्ति को स्थायी रूप से कम करें।

options.label: A
options.text: Only course of action II follows

options.label: B
options.text: Both course of action I and II follow

options.label: C
options.text: Either course of action I or II follows

options.label: D
options.text: Only course of action I follows
options.text_hi: केवल कार्यवाही I लागू होती है

questions.correct_text: Only course of action I follows
questions.solution:
Course of action I targets the identified cause of delays and improves punctuality without reducing passenger services.

Course of action II conflicts with the instruction not to reduce passenger services and avoids fixing the stated operational issue.

questions.question:
Each item describes a situation and is followed by four possible responses. Indicate the response you find most appropriate. Choose only one response for each item. The responses will be evaluated based on the level of appropriateness for the given situation.

An invigilator notices a student quietly using a chit during an exam. The student is a known topper and says, "Please ignore it, I'm under pressure." The exam rules clearly treat this as unfair means. What is the most appropriate response?
questions.question_hi:
प्रत्येक आइटम एक स्थिति का वर्णन करता है और उसके बाद चार संभावित प्रतिक्रियाएँ होती हैं। उस प्रतिक्रिया को चिह्नित करें जो आपको सबसे उपयुक्त लगे। प्रत्येक आइटम के लिए केवल एक प्रतिक्रिया चुनें। प्रतिक्रियाओं का मूल्यांकन दी गई स्थिति के लिए उपयुक्तता के स्तर के आधार पर किया जाएगा।

एक परीक्षक एक छात्र को परीक्षा के दौरान चुपचाप चिट का उपयोग करते हुए देखता है। छात्र एक ज्ञात टॉपर है और कहता है, "कृपया इसे नजरअंदाज करें, मैं दबाव में हूँ।" परीक्षा के नियम इसे स्पष्ट रूप से अनुचित साधन मानते हैं। सबसे उपयुक्त प्रतिक्रिया क्या है?

options.label: A
options.text: Ignore it since the student is the topper
options.text_hi: इसे नजरअंदाज करें क्योंकि छात्र टॉपर है

options.label: B
options.text: Warn privately and let it continue
options.text_hi: निजी रूप से चेतावनी दें और इसे जारी रहने दें

options.label: C
options.text: Take the chit but allow the exam normally
options.text_hi: चिट ले लें लेकिन परीक्षा सामान्य रूप से होने दें

options.label: D
options.text: Stop the act and report as per the rules
options.text_hi: कार्य को रोकें और नियमों के अनुसार रिपोर्ट करें

questions.correct_text: Stop the act and report as per the rules
questions.solution:
The invigilator's duty is to maintain fairness and follow the stated exam rules.

Option D is appropriate because it treats all students equally and protects the integrity of the exam.

Pressure is not a valid reason to break rules when others are competing honestly.

Option A is unfair and biased.

Option B still allows cheating and creates unequal conditions.

Option C reduces evidence but avoids the required action, so it fails the rule-based responsibility.

questions.question: What comes next: 2, 4, 9, 19, 36, ?

questions.solution:
A. (12+5) X 4=80

After interchanging: (4 X 5)+12 = 20+12 = 32

B. (4+7) X 12=88

After interchanging: (12 X 7)+4 = 84+4 = 88

C. (4+9) X 12=96

After interchanging: (12 X 9)+4 = 108+4 = 112

D. (12+3) X 4=72

After interchanging: (4 X 3)+12 = 12+12 = 24

Hence, option 'B' is correct.

questions.question:
The question given below consists of a statement, followed by two arguments numbered I and II. You have to decide which of the arguments is a 'strong' argument and which is a 'weak' argument.

Statement: Should a city introduce a congestion fee of Rs 250 for private cars entering the central business area during peak hours?

Argument I: Yes, it can reduce unnecessary car trips and the collected money can be used to improve public transport.

Argument II: No, traffic mostly happens because of sudden rain, so charging a fee will not make any real difference.
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दिया गया प्रश्न एक कथन और उसके बाद दो तर्कों I और II से बना है। आपको यह तय करना है कि कौन सा तर्क 'मजबूत' है और कौन सा 'कमजोर'।

कथन: क्या एक शहर को पीक घंटों के दौरान केंद्रीय व्यावसायिक क्षेत्र में प्रवेश करने वाली निजी कारों के लिए 250 रुपये का भीड़भाड़ शुल्क लगाना चाहिए?

तर्क I: हाँ, यह अनावश्यक कार यात्राओं को कम कर सकता है और एकत्रित धन का उपयोग सार्वजनिक परिवहन को बेहतर बनाने के लिए किया जा सकता है।

तर्क II: नहीं, ट्रैफिक ज्यादातर अचानक बारिश के कारण होता है, इसलिए शुल्क लगाने से कोई वास्तविक फर्क नहीं पड़ेगा।

options.label: A
options.text: Both arguments I and II are strong
options.text_hi: दोनों तर्क I और II मजबूत हैं

options.label: C
options.text: Neither argument I nor II is strong
options.text_hi: न तो तर्क I मजबूत है और न ही II

questions.solution:
Argument I directly addresses the purpose of the fee and gives a practical outcome (less congestion & better transport funding).

Argument II shifts the main cause to rain and treats it as the dominant reason for traffic without support; even if rain affects traffic, it does not logically cancel the impact of pricing on travel choices.

So, only Argument I is strong.

Option (a): H Ω R @ E % L ! D

H Ω R means 'H is the spouse of R'

R @ E means 'R is the father of E'

E % L means 'E is the sister of L'

L ! D means 'L is the mother of D'

H is the grandmother of D.

So, option (a) is correct.

Option (b): D % L @ K Ω S ! H

D % L means 'D is the sister of L'

L @ K means 'L is the father of K'

K Ω S means 'K is the spouse of S'

S ! H means 'S is the mother of H'

H is either grandson or granddaughter of D.

So, option (b) is incorrect.

Option (c): H Ω G ! N Ω R % D

H Ω G means 'H is the spouse of G'

G ! N means 'G is the mother of N'

N Ω R means 'N is the spouse of R'

R % D means 'R is the sister of D'

H is the father-in-law of D's sister.

So, option (c) is incorrect.

Option (d): H ! E Ω T % D @ C

H ! E means 'H is the mother of E'

E Ω T means 'E is the spouse of T'

T % D means 'T is the sister of D'

D @ C means 'D is the father of C'

H is the father-in-law of D's sister.

So, option (d) is incorrect.

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements:

Statements:

Some Devil is Ghost

All Ghost are Witch

No Witch is Spirit

Conclusions:

I: Some Ghost is not Spirit

II: Some Devil is Witch

III: Some Spirit is not Witch

कथन:

कुछ Devil, Ghost हैं।

सभी Ghost, Witch हैं।

कोई Witch, Spirit नहीं है।

निष्कर्ष:

I: कुछ Ghost, Spirit नहीं हैं।

II: कुछ Devil, Witch हैं।

III: कुछ Spirit, Witch नहीं हैं।

options.text_hi: केवल I और III अनुसरण करते हैं

options.label: D
options.text: All I, II and III follow
options.text_hi: I, II और III सभी अनुसरण करते हैं

questions.correct_text: All I, II and III follow
questions.solution:
Statements:

Some Devil is Ghost

All Ghost are Witch

No Witch is Spirit

Some Ghost is not Spirit: All Ghost are Witch. No Witch is Spirit. Thus, Some Ghost is not Spirit. So, conclusion I is true.

Some Devil is Witch: Some Devil is Ghost. All Ghost are Witch. Thus, Some Devil is Witch. So, conclusion II is true.

Some Spirit is not Witch: No Witch is Spirit. Thus, Some Spirit is not Witch. So, conclusion III is true.

Hence, All conclusions I, II and III follow.

questions.question:
A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.

She said to her brother, "You must not touch my laptop without asking me first."

options.label: A
options.text: She said to her brother that he must not touch her laptop without asking her first.

options.label: B
options.text: She told her brother that he must not touched her laptop without asking her first.

options.label: C
options.text: She forbade her brother to touch her laptop without asking her first.

options.label: D
options.text: She asked her brother that he should not touch her laptop without asking her first.

questions.correct_text: She forbade her brother to touch her laptop without asking her first.
questions.solution:
Correct option first: Option C is correct because "must not" shows strong prohibition, and "forbade + object + to + verb" matches that strength cleanly.

Rule: Strong negative commands/prohibitions can be reported as "forbade + object + to + verb."

Example: "You must not enter," he said → He forbade me to enter.

"You must not touch my laptop.." becomes "forbade her brother to touch her laptop.."

Pronouns shift: "my" becomes "her" and "me" becomes "her."

Final correct sentence: She forbade her brother to touch her laptop without asking her first.

Incorrect options:

·A. Keeps "must not" as-is; while sometimes possible, SSC-style reporting often expects a clearer reporting verb for prohibition here.

·B. Wrong verb form ("must not touched").

·D. Uses "asked..that" and weakens the force; also the structure is not the cleanest for prohibition.

questions.question:
A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.

Rohan said, "I have already sent the payment, but the app is still showing 'pending'."

options.label: A
options.text: Rohan said that he had already sent the payment, but the app was still showing 'pending'.

options.label: B
options.text: Rohan said that he has already sent the payment, but the app is still showing 'pending'.

options.label: C
options.text: Rohan told that he had already sent the payment, but the app still showed 'pending'.

options.label: D
options.text: Rohan said that I had already sent the payment, but the app was still showing 'pending'.

questions.correct_text: Rohan said that he had already sent the payment, but the app was still showing 'pending'.
questions.solution:
Correct option first: Option A is correct because it reports two linked facts and shifts present perfect and present continuous into past forms.

Rule: Present perfect → past perfect, and present continuous → past continuous in indirect speech when the reporting verb is in the past.

Example: "I have finished," he said → He said that he had finished.

"I have already sent" becomes "he had already sent."

"is still showing" becomes "was still showing."

Final correct sentence: Rohan said that he had already sent the payment, but the app was still showing 'pending'.

Incorrect options:

·B. Keeps "has/is" without backshift even though the reporting verb is past ("said").

·C. Uses "told that" incorrectly (it should be "told me/him" or "said that").

·D. Changes the subject wrongly to "I," which changes the meaning.

Directions : In the following passage, some words have been omitted. Read the passage carefully and choose the most appropriate option from the given alternatives to fill in each blank. One word in the passage is mentioned in bold. Choose the most appropriate option in the question related to the highlighted word.

Modern archives are no longer silent rooms lined with dust-covered shelves; instead, they have evolved into dynamic ecosystems where information is continuously curated, questioned, and reinterpreted. As digital storage expands, institutions must decide not only what to preserve but also how to make records ______(1) accessible. This process often depends on metadata, which acts as a contextual bridge between raw data and human understanding. Without such framing, information risks becoming obscure rather than enlightening. Although (2) automation accelerates classification, it cannot entirely replace human judgment, which remains essential for ethical appraisal and cultural sensitivity. ______(3), archivists are increasingly required to balance efficiency with responsibility, ensuring that preservation does not distort intent. If this balance is neglected, archives may appear comprehensive while ______(4) reinforcing gaps, biases, or misinterpretations that future generations will struggle to correct.

questions.question: Identify the part of speech of the highlighted word. (2)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is (b) conjunction.

The word "Although" introduces a subordinate clause expressing contrast between "automation accelerates classification" and the idea that it "cannot entirely replace human judgment." A word used to connect a subordinate clause to a main clause while showing contrast functions as a subordinating conjunction.

(a) Preposition: A preposition must be followed by a noun or pronoun, not a full clause.

(c) Adverb: An adverb modifies a verb, adjective, or another adverb, which is not the case here.

(d) Adjective: An adjective modifies a noun directly, which "Although" does not do.

questions.question:
Choose the best passive form of the sentence.

Who is cleaning the balcony right now?

options.label: A
options.text: By whom the balcony is being cleaned right now?

options.label: B
options.text: By whom is the balcony cleaned right now?

options.label: C
options.text: By whom was the balcony being cleaned right now?

options.label: D
options.text: By whom is the balcony being cleaned right now?

questions.correct_text: By whom is the balcony being cleaned right now?
questions.solution:
Option (d) is correct because the active sentence is present continuous ("is cleaning"). The passive of present continuous is "is/are being + V3", and the question keeps inversion: "By whom is .. being cleaned?"

Rule of Voice Transformation: Present Continuous →"is/are being + V3"; in questions, keep the helping verb before the subject.

Example: "Why are they painting the gate?"→"Why is the gate being painted?"

Why other options are wrong:

(a): Word order is wrong; "is" must come before "the balcony" in a question.

(b): Uses simple present passive ("is cleaned"), not present continuous passive.

(c): Uses past continuous passive ("was being cleaned"), tense mismatch.

questions.question:
Choose the option that changes the sentence into active voice in the most natural way, without changing the meaning.

questions.correct_text: The shop is repairing my phone while I use a spare device.
questions.solution:
Correct Option: B. "The shop is repairing my phone while I use a spare device."

Rule of Voice Transformation: Present continuous passive "is/are being + past participle" becomes present continuous active "is/are + verb-ing."

Example: "The room is being painted." → "They are painting the room."

"Is being repaired" becomes "is repairing," and we bring "the shop" as the doer.

"While I use a spare device" stays the same because it adds extra information.

· A is incorrect because "repairs" sounds like the phone is doing the repairing.

· C changes the time from present to past.

· D is illogical.

Final correct sentence: The shop is repairing my phone while I use a spare device.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. If I craned my neck up, I could see the stars.

B. I sat on my couch, a virtual reality headset strapped to my face, my feet hovering over a campfire.

C. Two trickster poets, young indigenous men, approached me and looked me straight in the eye.

D. The intimacy of their gaze was a little uncomfortable, even though I knew they couldn't see me.
questions.solution:
If we read the sentences carefully, we can see that D follows C as C tells us that two young trickster poets approached the author and stared him down and D tells us that the intimacy of the same men's eyes (mentioned in C) made the author a little uncomfortable, even though he knew they weren't real. Then, B can be identified as the first sentence as it mentions that the author's feet hovered over a bonfire while he sat on his couch with a virtual reality headset attached to his face. Then, A tells us that he could see the stars if he craned his neck up, due to the virtual reality headset (mentioned in B). Then C and D follow A (which are already explained).

Therefore, the correct answer is: (b) BACD.

B. Engaging in shadow work means embarking on a journey to bring these hidden parts into the light of consciousness, integrating them to achieve a more complete and balanced self.

C. The term "shadow" alludes to the metaphorical darkness where these parts reside, away from the light of our conscious awareness.

D. These hidden aspects, known as our shadow selves, often harbour qualities that we've been taught to deem as negative or undesirable.
questions.solution:
Sentence A comes first and introduces the topic of discussion - shadow work and explains what it is.

"These hidden aspects" in sentence D refers to the unconscious parts of the personality discussed in sentence A.

So, sentence D follows.

Now, sentence C comes next and further explains the sub-term "shadow".

Hence, option (a) is the answer.

questions.question:
A sentence is provided in indirect speech. Pick the most accurate direct speech form.

Karan said that he would carry an umbrella in case it rained.

options.label: A
options.text: "I will carry an umbrella in case it rains," Karan said.

options.label: B
options.text: "I would carry an umbrella in case it rained," Karan said.

options.label: C
options.text: "I will carried an umbrella in case it rains," Karan said.

options.label: D
options.text: "I can carry an umbrella in case it rains," Karan said.

questions.correct_text: "I will carry an umbrella in case it rains," Karan said.
questions.solution:
Correct option: (a) "I will carry an umbrella in case it rains," Karan said.

"Would carry" becomes "will carry" in direct speech.

"In case" works like a condition, so we use present tense: "in case it rains."

Rule used: Rule of Speech Conversion (future plan + conditional clause in simple present).

Example: She said that she would keep food ready in case guests arrived →"I will keep food ready in case guests arrive," she said.

Incorrect options:

(b): Keeps indirect form (would, rained).

(c): "will carried" is incorrect; after "will," use base verb "carry."

(d): "can" changes the meaning to ability, not intention.

questions.question:

Someone has kept the keys inside the fridge by mistake.

options.text: The keys have been keeping inside the fridge by mistake.

options.label: D
options.text: The keys have been kept inside the fridge by mistake.

questions.correct_text: The keys have been kept inside the fridge by mistake.
questions.solution:
Option (d) is correct because "has kept" is Present Perfect. The passive of Present Perfect is "has/have been + V3", so it becomes "have been kept".

Rule of Voice Transformation: Present Perfect (active) → has/have been + V3 (passive).

Example: "They have finished the work."→"The work has been finished."

Why other options are wrong:

(a): Simple past passive, tense mismatch.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the following passage and answer the questions based on the passage:

Cloud seeding is a scientific technique used to enhance precipitation by modifying natural cloud processes. It is based on the principle that many clouds already contain water vapour but lack sufficient ice crystals or condensation nuclei needed to trigger rainfall. By introducing specific substances into such clouds, scientists attempt to stimulate the formation of raindrops or snowflakes, thereby increasing the likelihood of precipitation.

The most commonly used seeding agents are silver iodide, sodium chloride, and dry ice. Silver iodide is particularly effective because its crystalline structure closely resembles that of natural ice. When released into suitable clouds, usually through aircraft, rockets, or ground-based generators, it acts as an artificial nucleus around which supercooled water droplets can freeze. As these ice crystals grow heavier, they fall under gravity, melting into raindrops as they pass through warmer air layers. In warm-cloud seeding, salts such as sodium chloride are dispersed to encourage smaller droplets to collide and merge into larger drops capable of falling as rain.

Cloud seeding does not create clouds from nothing; rather, it works only when appropriate atmospheric conditions already exist. Factors such as humidity, temperature, wind patterns, and cloud type play a crucial role in determining its success. This limitation explains why cloud seeding results are often inconsistent and difficult to measure with precision.

Despite these uncertainties, artificial rainfall has been adopted in several regions facing water scarcity, drought, or erratic monsoon behaviour. It is viewed as a supplementary measure rather than a permanent solution to water shortages. Scientists continue to study its efficiency, environmental impact, and long-term consequences. While cloud seeding demonstrates how human ingenuity can influence natural processes to some extent, it also highlights the complexity of weather systems and the limits of technological intervention in controlling nature.

questions.question:
A sentence is given in active voice. Identify the correct passive form.

You should have switched off the lights before leaving.

options.label: A
options.text: The lights should switch off before leaving.

options.label: B
options.text: The lights should be switching off before leaving.

options.label: C
options.text: The lights should have been switched off before leaving.

options.label: D
options.text: The lights must have been switched off before leaving.

questions.correct_text: The lights should have been switched off before leaving.
questions.solution:
Option (c) is correct because "should have switched off" is a modal perfect form. In passive, it becomes "should have been + V3".

Rule of Voice Transformation: Modal + have + V3 (active) → Modal + have been + V3 (passive).

Example: "He should have called her."→"She should have been called by him."

Why other options are wrong:

(a): Missing "been" and has wrong structure.

(b): Wrong tense/structure; it suggests an ongoing action, not a completed one.

(d) : Changes the modal from should to must, changing meaning (advice → strong assumption/necessity).

Note: ("By you" is optional and usually omitted in such sentences.)

Rule: Irony shows a gap between what is expected and what actually happens.

· B. Metaphor is direct comparison; none is made here.

· C. Onomatopoeia is a sound word like "bang" or "buzz"; not present here.

questions.correct_text: Satire exposes social flaws while promoting critical awareness.
questions.solution:
Solution:

The passage presents satire as a powerful social and cultural tool that blends humour with criticism to reveal societal flaws and encourage reflection. It explains that satire highlights human follies, hypocrisy, and institutional failures through irony and exaggeration, making uncomfortable truths easier to confront. Beyond criticism, satire promotes critical thinking, social correction, freedom of expression, and public awareness, while also acknowledging its limitations. Thus, the central idea is that satire helps society recognize its shortcomings and stimulates thoughtful engagement.

Therefore, option (c) is correct.
questions.passage:
Directions : Read the passage and answer the questions:

Satire occupies a unique position in society as a literary and cultural tool that combines humour with criticism. Unlike direct moral instruction or political argument, satire exposes human follies, social hypocrisies, and institutional failures through irony, exaggeration, and wit. By making people laugh, satire lowers resistance to uncomfortable truths and invites audiences to reflect on issues they might otherwise ignore or resist.

One of the primary functions of satire is social correction. Satirists highlight absurdities in behaviour, language, and belief systems, thereby encouraging individuals to reassess their values. Whether targeting political corruption, social pretensions, or cultural stereotypes, satire acts as a mirror that reflects society's flaws in a distorted but recognisable form. This distortion makes criticism more palatable and often more memorable than serious discourse.

Satire also plays a significant role in safeguarding freedom of expression. In contexts where direct criticism may invite censorship or punishment, satire provides an indirect yet powerful means of dissent. Through symbolic narratives, caricatures, and parody, satirists can question authority while maintaining plausible deniability. As a result, satire has historically flourished in restrictive environments as a subtle form of resistance.

However, satire is not without limitations. Its impact depends heavily on the audience's interpretive ability and cultural awareness. Misunderstood satire may reinforce the very attitudes it seeks to challenge, or be dismissed as mere entertainment. Moreover, excessive reliance on mockery can lead to cynicism rather than constructive reform.

Despite these risks, satire remains an essential instrument of critical engagement. By blending humour with insight, it stimulates public consciousness, promotes intellectual scepticism, and sustains the dialogue between power and accountability in modern society.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Deban and Satang patted one another on the back for coming up with such a clever idea.
questions.solution:
The error lies in option (b).

'One another' is used when more than two people are involved.

For example: The ten people were fighting amongst one another.

On the other hand, 'each other' is used when two persons are involved.

For example: Arnab and Raj are talking to each other.

Similarly, in this context, 'Deban and Satang' are two people.

Hence, 'each other' must replace 'one another'.

Thus, the error is in option (b) one another on the back.

Therefore, the corrected form of the sentence is: Deban and Satang patted each other on the back for coming up with such a clever idea.

'Hardly' (adverb) means 'narrowly or scarcely'. It does not give any meaning to the sentence. The use of 'hard' is appropriate because as an adverb, it means 'constantly, regularly, or habitually engaged in earnest and energetic work'. So, 'work hard' is the correct phrase. It gives the meaning that Girisha was concerned about whether or not her brother was able to work regularly and with energy during this crucial phase of the examinations.

Hence, option (a) is correct.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

In the mid-20th century, the concept of artificial intelligence (AI) emerged as a revolutionary field, inspired by the human brain's ability to learn and adapt. Pioneers like Alan Turing questioned whether machines could think, laying the groundwork for AI research. Early developments focused on rule-based systems, where computers followed predefined instructions to solve problems, such as playing chess. The 1980s saw a surge in expert systems, designed to mimic human expertise in specific domains like medicine and finance, but funding dwindled during the "AI winter" due to overhyped expectations and computational constraints.

Despite its potential to solve global challenges like climate modelling and healthcare diagnostics, AI's energy consumption and dependency on quality data pose sustainability hurdles. Collaboration between academia, industry, and policymakers is essential to harness AI's benefits while mitigating risks. Ultimately, AI is not a replacement for human creativity but a tool to augment it, transforming industries and daily life in ways unimaginable a few decades ago.
