questions.question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate adverb:

The manual explains the procedure ____, so even beginners rarely make mistakes.
questions.solution:
The blank describes how the manual "explains," so we need an adverb (manner).

Option D: lucidly means "in a clear, easy-to-understand way."

Grammar rule: Use an adverb to describe a verb (how an action is done).

Example: "She spoke politely."

· Option A is wrong because "lucid" is an adjective; it describes a noun, not the verb "explains."

· Option B is wrong because "lucidity" is a noun, not suitable here.

· Option C is wrong because it's a comparative adjective phrase and still doesn't act as an adverb here.

Final sentence: The manual explains the procedure lucidly, so even beginners rarely make mistakes.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Sylvia has been _________ ever since her mother became so ill.
questions.solution:
Let's look at the meanings of the given phrases.

Done away with: remove or put an end to something.

Fall back: retreat.

Cast down: feel depressed.

Gave away: give something freely as a gift or donation.

We can only use a participle verb after 'been'. Since 'fall' is a base verb, option (b) is eliminated. Among the remaining options, only the verb 'cast down' fits correctly in the sentence because the words 'with' and 'away' would need an object after them which is missing.

Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.

Note:

"Participle: A word formed from a verb (e.g. going, gone, being, been) and used as an adjective (e.g. working woman, burnt toast) or a noun (e.g. good breeding). In English participles are also used to make compound verb forms (e.g. is going, has been). Consider the sentences given below:

Dancing at the party, the women fell on the ground.

Encouraged by her parents, Rita went on to pursue her passion.

The highlighted word in the first sentence is of the form Verb + ing and is used as a present participle. It is used to denote an action that is going on or incomplete or imperfect.

The highlighted word in the second sentence is of the form verb + ed. It is used as a past participle. It denotes completed action or state of the thing spoken of.

A past participle ends with the following: -ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n.

One should take great care and never get confused between a gerund and present participle. They use the same forms but perform different functions: a gerund is a verbal noun, while a present participle is a verbal adjective."

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank(s).

The local community came _____ to support families _____ by a devastating fire.
questions.solution:
The verbs 'created' or 'directed' in the second position don't provide a coherent sentence. So, they are eliminated. The sentence talks about the community and the fire incident. Of the remaining two options, option (b) contains a more appropriate combination of words. The words 'lately' and 'influence' don't provide a coherent sentence.

Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.

The complete sentence is: The local community came together to support families affected by a devastating fire.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Raj decided to _____ the profession of a professional chef.
questions.solution:
Takeover- Become responsible for a task in succession to another

Take in- Include or encompass

Take out- Escort someone to a social event or place of entertainment

Take up- Become interested or engaged in a pursuit

The sentence talks about Raj's decision to pursue the career of a professional chef. Among the options, 'take over', 'take in' and 'take out' are contextually irrelevant and so they are negated. 'Take up' matches the context of the sentence and describes the action done by Raj with respect to his choice of career and is also grammatically correct.

Hence, the correct answer is option (d).

Note:

Phrasal verb: A phrase that consists of a verb with a preposition or adverb or both, the meaning of which is different from the meaning of its separate parts. Example: She has always looked down on me. Here, the phrasal verb 'to look down on someone' doesn't mean that you are looking down from a higher place at someone who is below you; it means that you think that you are better than someone.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Her engaging smile, her winsome ______, and her impeccable behaviour soon endeared her to the public.
questions.solution:
A noun would fit in the given blank so as to be modified by the adjective 'winsome'. Since the sentence conveys that the people were really impressed by her positive attitude, 'manner' is the apt choice. Negative words 'negligence' and 'hopelessness' will not bring out a positive impact, so these are eliminated. 'Archive' does not connect with the sentence on the contextual level.

Hence, option (d) is correct.

questions.question: What is the primary objective of the Committee on Subordinate Legislation?
questions.question_hi: उप-प्रावधान समिति का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?

options.label: A
options.text: To draft new bills and present them to the Lok Sabha for approval.
options.text_hi: नए विधेयक तैयार करना और उन्हें लोक सभा में अनुमोदन के लिए प्रस्तुत करना।

options.label: B
options.text: To investigate the conduct of Members of Parliament and recommend disciplinary action.
options.text_hi: सांसदों के आचरण की जांच करना और अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई की सिफारिश करना।

options.label: C
options.text: To audit the financial expenditures of the Central Government to prevent corruption.
options.text_hi: भ्रष्टाचार को रोकने के लिए केंद्रीय सरकार के वित्तीय व्यय का लेखा परीक्षा करना।

options.label: D
options.text: To examine whether the rules, regulations, and bylaws framed by the Executive stay within the limits of the original Act.
options.text_hi: जांच करना कि कार्यपालिका द्वारा बनाए गए नियम, विनियम और उपनियम मूल अधिनियम की सीमाओं के भीतर हैं या नहीं।

questions.correct_text: To examine whether the rules, regulations, and bylaws framed by the Executive stay within the limits of the original Act.
questions.solution:
The Committee on Subordinate Legislation scrutinizes delegated (subordinate) legislation to ensure that the Executive does not exceed the powers granted by Parliament under the parent Act.

Drafting bills is the role of the Executive/Legislative process

Investigating MPs' conduct is handled by Ethics/Privileges Committees.

Auditing government expenditure is done by the CAG and examined by the PAC.

Further insights

The committee exists in both Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha.

It examines rules, regulations, notifications, and bylaws.

It checks for excessive delegation of legislative power.

The committee can recommend modifications or annulment of rules.

This scrutiny strengthens parliamentary control over the Executive.

questions.question: Which operation was launched by the Railway Protection Force (RPF) in 2018 to rescue children in need of care and protection?
questions.question_hi: रेलवे सुरक्षा बल (RPF) द्वारा 2018 में किस ऑपरेशन की शुरुआत की गई थी ताकि देखभाल और संरक्षण की आवश्यकता वाले बच्चों को बचाया जा सके?
questions.solution:
Operation Nanhe Farishte was launched by the RPF in 2018 with the specific aim of identifying and rescuing children found in distress or at risk on railway premises and trains including runaway, abandoned, missing, or vulnerable children and ensuring they are handed over for care and protection.

Further insights

• Nanhe Farishte has rescued tens of thousands of children across India since 2018.

• RPF hands rescued children over to Child Welfare Committees or NGOs for rehabilitation.

• The operation helps prevent child trafficking, exploitation, and abandonment.

• RPF also runs other missions such as Jeevan Raksha (life rescue) and Operation NARCOS (anti-drug efforts).

questions.question: According to the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), forensic investigation of a crime scene has been made mandatory for offences punishable by a minimum of how many years of imprisonment?
questions.question_hi: भारतीय नागरिक सुरक्षा संहिता (BNSS) के अनुसार, अपराध स्थल की फोरेंसिक जांच उन अपराधों के लिए अनिवार्य कर दी गई है जिनके लिए न्यूनतम कितने वर्षों की कैद का दंड निर्धारित है?
questions.solution:
Under the BNSS, forensic investigation at the crime scene is mandatorily required for offences that carry a minimum punishment of 7 years or more. This provision aims to strengthen evidence collection, reduce reliance on confessions, and improve conviction rates through scientific methods.

Further insights

BNSS replaces the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC), 1973.

Mandatory forensics aims to reduce custodial violence and false confessions.

Use of digital and electronic evidence is formally recognised.

questions.question: What is the meaning of a "two-blast" whistle signal in an archery competition?
questions.question_hi: तीरंदाजी प्रतियोगिता में "दो-ध्वनि" सीटी संकेत का क्या अर्थ है?

options.label: A
options.text_hi: धनुर्धर तुरंत शूटिंग बंद कर दें।

options.label: B
options.text: Archers should move from the waiting line to the shooting line.
options.text_hi: धनुर्धर प्रतीक्षा रेखा से शूटिंग रेखा की ओर बढ़ें।

options.label: C
options.text: Archers can move forward to collect their arrows.
options.text_hi: धनुर्धर अपने तीर इकट्ठा करने के लिए आगे बढ़ सकते हैं।

options.label: D
options.text: Shooting is officially allowed to begin.
options.text_hi: शूटिंग आधिकारिक रूप से शुरू करने की अनुमति है।

questions.correct_text: Archers should move from the waiting line to the shooting line.
questions.solution:
In standard archery competition rules, a two-blast whistle signal instructs archers to step forward from the waiting line to the shooting (firing) line, but not to shoot yet. Shooting is permitted only after the next signal.

Further insights

1 whistle → Start shooting

2 whistles → Move to shooting line

3 whistles → Collect arrows

5 or more whistles → Stop shooting immediately

questions.question:
Regarding the political units of the Early Vedic (Rig Vedic) period, consider the following statements:

i) The 'Jana' represented the largest political unit, which was primarily tribal in nature.

ii) The 'Rajan' (King) exercised absolute and unlimited power over the tribe, independent of any assemblies.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
प्रारंभिक वैदिक (ऋग्वैदिa) काल के राजनीतिक इकाइयों के संबंध में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) 'जन' सबसे बड़ी राजनीतिक इकाई का प्रतिनिधित्व करता था, जो मुख्य रूप से जनजातीय प्रकृति की थी।

ii) 'राजन' (राजा) जनजाति पर पूर्ण और असीमित शक्ति का प्रयोग करता था, जो किसी भी सभा से स्वतंत्र था।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is correct.

In the Early Vedic period, the Jana was the largest political and social unit. Society was tribal, not territorial, and people identified themselves by their tribe (such as Bharatas, Purus, Yadus) rather than by land or kingdom.

Statement (ii) is incorrect.

The Rajan did not have absolute or unlimited power. His authority was checked by tribal assemblies such as:

Sabha

Samiti

Vidatha

These bodies played an important role in decision-making, indicating that Early Vedic polity had a participatory and consultative nature.

Hence, the king was not independent of assemblies.

Further insights

Early Vedic society was tribal, not territorial.

Sabha and Samiti reflect early democratic elements.

The king was considered a protector, not an absolute ruler.

Taxes were irregular and mostly voluntary offerings (bali).

questions.question: Which of the following wave components is INCORRECTLY matched with its definition?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा तरंग घटक अपनी परिभाषा के साथ गलत मेल खाता है?

options.label: A
options.text: Crest: The highest point of a wave cycle.
options.text_hi: क्रेस्ट: एक तरंग चक्र का सबसे ऊँचा बिंदु।

options.label: B
options.text: Frequency: The number of wave cycles that pass a fixed point per unit of time.
options.text_hi: आवृत्ति: एक निश्चित बिंदु से प्रति इकाई समय में गुजरने वाले तरंग चक्रों की संख्या।

options.label: C
options.text: Wavelength: The horizontal distance between two consecutive crests.
options.text_hi: तरंगदैर्घ्य: दो लगातार क्रेस्ट के बीच की क्षैतिज दूरी।

options.label: D
options.text: Trough: The vertical distance between a crest and the equilibrium line.
options.text_hi: ट्रफ: एक क्रेस्ट और संतुलन रेखा के बीच की ऊर्ध्वाधर दूरी।

questions.correct_text: Trough: The vertical distance between a crest and the equilibrium line.
questions.solution:
A trough is the lowest point of a wave cycle below the equilibrium (mean) position, not a distance.

The definition given in option (d) actually describes amplitude, which is the vertical distance from the equilibrium line to a crest or trough.

Further insights

Amplitude is the maximum displacement from the equilibrium position.

Crest and trough exist in transverse waves only.

Wavelength is inversely related to frequency for a given wave speed.

Frequency is measured in hertz (Hz).

Mechanical waves require a medium to travel.

questions.question: Which of the following was the primary reason for the introduction of the 'Rolling Plan' in India?
questions.question_hi: भारत में 'रोलिंग प्लान' के परिचय का मुख्य कारण निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा था?

options.label: A
options.text: To address the hyperinflation caused by the 1971 Indo-Pak war.
options.text_hi: 1971 के Indo-Pak युद्ध के कारण हुई अतिमहंगाई को संबोधित करने के लिए।

options.label: B
options.text: To replace the centralized planning of the Fifth Five-Year Plan following a change in the central government.
options.text_hi: केंद्र सरकार में बदलाव के बाद पंचवर्षीय योजना की केंद्रीकृत योजना को बदलने के लिए।

options.label: C
options.text: To implement a new strategy focused exclusively on the liberalization of the Indian economy.
options.text_hi: भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के उदारीकरण पर विशेष रूप से केंद्रित एक नई रणनीति लागू करने के लिए।

options.label: D
options.text: To provide a temporary planning bridge due to the failure of the Monsoon in two consecutive years.
options.text_hi: लगातार दो वर्षों में मानसून की विफलता के कारण एक अस्थायी योजना पुल प्रदान करने के लिए।

questions.correct_text: To replace the centralized planning of the Fifth Five-Year Plan following a change in the central government.
questions.solution:
The Rolling Plan was introduced in 1978 by the Janata Party government after it came to power and scrapped the Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974 - 79) formulated by the previous Congress government.

The new government rejected rigid centralized planning and introduced the Rolling Plan to allow greater flexibility, enabling targets and allocations to be revised annually based on current economic conditions.

Further insights

The Rolling Plan had three components: annual plan, medium-term plan, and long-term perspective.

It was abandoned in 1980 when Congress returned to power.

India returned to Five-Year Plans with the Sixth Plan (1980 - 85).

Rolling Plans reduce rigidity but increase uncertainty in long-term investments.

questions.question: Who was the Viceroy of India when Mahatma Gandhi issued the "Do or Die" slogan during the Quit India Movement (1942)?
questions.question_hi: भारत के उपराज्यपाल कौन थे जब महात्मा गांधी ने भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन (1942) के दौरान "करो या मरो" का नारा दिया था?
questions.solution:
Lord Linlithgow was the Viceroy of India from 1936 to 1943. The Quit India Movement and the famous "Do or Die" call were launched in August 1942, squarely during his tenure.

Further insights

The Quit India Movement was launched on 8 August 1942 in Bombay.

Linlithgow ordered the immediate arrest of Congress leaders.

The movement marked a shift to mass civil resistance.

It significantly weakened British control during World War II.

Wavell succeeded Linlithgow in 1943, inheriting the aftermath.

questions.question: Which of the following is the primary objective of the National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA) in India?
questions.question_hi: भारत में राष्ट्रीय एंटी-डोपिंग एजेंसी (NADA) का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा है?

options.label: A
options.text: To provide high-quality training and coaching to Olympic athletes.
options.text_hi: ओलंपिक खिलाड़ियों को उच्च गुणवत्ता वाला प्रशिक्षण और कोचिंग प्रदान करना।

options.label: B
options.text: To build and maintain sports stadiums and infrastructure across the country.
options.text_hi: देश भर में खेल स्टेडियम और बुनियादी ढांचे का निर्माण और रखरखाव करना।

options.label: C
options.text: To manage the selection of players for the Indian National Cricket Team.
options.text_hi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय क्रिकेट टीम के खिलाड़ियों के चयन का प्रबंधन करना।

options.label: D
options.text: To ensure a dope-free sports environment and implement anti-doping rules.
options.text_hi: डोप-फ्री खेल वातावरण सुनिश्चित करना और एंटी-डोपिंग नियमों को लागू करना।

questions.correct_text: To ensure a dope-free sports environment and implement anti-doping rules.
questions.solution:
NADA's core mandate is to prevent doping in sports, conduct testing, promote awareness, and enforce anti-doping regulations in line with international standards.

Further insights

NADA works in alignment with the World Anti-Doping Code.

It conducts in-competition and out-of-competition testing.

Education programs target athletes, coaches, and support staff.

Anti-doping rules apply across all recognized sports in India.

Violations can lead to suspensions, bans, or disqualification.

questions.question:
Match the following British Parliamentary Acts with their main features:

List-I (Act) List-II (Feature)
i) Regulating Act of 17731) Supreme Court at Fort William
ii) Pitt's India Act of 17842) Board of Control
iii) Charter Act of 18333) Governor-General of Bengal became Governor - General of India
iv) Government of India Act of 19194) Dyarchy in Provinces

Select the correct answer:
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित ब्रिटिश संसदीय अधिनियमों को उनके मुख्य विशेषताओं के साथ मिलाएं:

सूची-I (अधिनियम) सूची-II (विशेषता)
i) 1773 का रेगुलेटिंग एक्ट1) फोर्ट विलियम में सुप्रीम कोर्ट
ii) 1784 का पिट का इंडिया एक्ट2) बोर्ड ऑफ कंट्रोल
iii) 1833 का चार्टर एक्ट3) बंगाल के गवर्नर-जनरल बने भारत के गवर्नर-जनरल
iv) 1919 का गवर्नमेंट ऑफ इंडिया एक्ट4) प्रांतों में द्विध्रुवीय शासन

सही उत्तर चुनें:
questions.solution:
Regulating Act of 1773 → Supreme Court at Fort William

The Regulating Act of 1773 established the Supreme Court at Fort William (Calcutta) to administer justice under British law. This was part of the first parliamentary effort to regulate the East India Company's governance in India.

ii) Pitt's India Act of 1784 → Board of Control

Pitt's India Act of 1784 created a Board of Control to supervise political affairs of the East India Company, bringing the administration closer under British government oversight.

iii) Charter Act of 1833 → Governor-General of India

The Charter Act of 1833 centralized authority by making the Governor-General of Bengal the Governor-General of India, reflecting administrative consolidation.

iv) Government of India Act of 1919 → Dyarchy in Provinces

The Government of India Act of 1919 introduced Dyarchy in the provinces, where subjects were divided between elected Indian ministers and officials.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the cytoskeleton of a cell:

i) Microtubules are hollow structures made of tubulin. They help in movement of organelles and form the spindle during cell division.

ii) Intermediate filaments are strong and stable fibres that help maintain cell shape and support the nucleus.

iii) Microfilaments (actin filaments) are the largest cytoskeletal fibres and mainly keep organelles fixed in place.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
कोशिका के साइटोस्केलेटन के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) माइक्रोट्यूब्यूल खोखले संरचनाएं होती हैं जो ट्यूबुलिन से बनी होती हैं। ये अंगाणुओं की गति में मदद करती हैं और कोशिका विभाजन के दौरान स्पिंडल बनाती हैं।

ii) इंटरमीडिएट फाइबर मजबूत और स्थिर रेशे होते हैं जो कोशिका के आकार को बनाए रखने और नाभिक का समर्थन करने में मदद करते हैं।

iii) माइक्रोफिलामेंट्स (एक्टिन फाइबर) सबसे बड़े साइटोस्केलेटल रेशे होते हैं और मुख्य रूप से अंगाणुओं को अपनी जगह पर स्थिर रखते हैं।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement (i) is correct.

Microtubules are made of tubulin, are hollow, and act as tracks for organelle movement. They also form the mitotic spindle during cell division.

Statement (ii) is correct.

Intermediate filaments are strong, rope-like fibres that give the cell mechanical strength, help maintain cell shape, and support the nucleus.

Statement (iii) is incorrect.

Microfilaments are not the largest cytoskeletal components - they are the smallest. They mainly help in cell movement, muscle contraction, and shape changes, not in keeping organelles stationary.

Further insights

Microtubules are the largest cytoskeletal fibres.

Microfilaments are the thinnest cytoskeletal fibres.

Intermediate filaments provide tensile strength.

Cytoskeleton helps in intracellular transport.

All three components work together to maintain cell structure and function.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding turmeric as a natural indicator:

i) Turmeric paper remains yellow when it comes into contact with acidic substances like lemon juice.

ii) When an alkaline substance, such as soap solution, is applied to turmeric, it changes color to reddish-brown.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
हल्दी को एक प्राकृतिक संकेतक के रूप में लेकर निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) हल्दी का कागज नींबू के रस जैसे अम्लीय पदार्थों के संपर्क में आने पर पीला रहता है।

ii) जब एक क्षारीय पदार्थ, जैसे साबुन का घोल, हल्दी पर लगाया जाता है, तो इसका रंग लाल-भूरा हो जाता है।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Both statements (i) and (ii) are correct.

Statement (i) is correct because turmeric does not change color in acidic or neutral solutions and remains yellow.

Statement (ii) is correct because turmeric reacts with bases (alkalis) and turns reddish-brown due to a chemical change in curcumin.

Further insights

Turmeric is a natural indicator, unlike synthetic indicators like phenolphthalein.

Curcumin is the active compound responsible for color change.

Turmeric is useful in simple lab tests and school experiments.

questions.question: Who is the winner of the prestigious Booker Prize for fiction for the year 2025?
questions.question_hi: 2025 के लिए प्रतिष्ठित बुकर पुरस्कार के विजेता कौन हैं?
questions.solution:
David Szalay is the winner of the Booker Prize 2025 for his novel Flesh. The award was presented at a ceremony in London, and the judging panel selected Szalay's book as the best work of long-form fiction published in English in the UK and Ireland during the eligibility period.

Further insights

• The Booker Prize is awarded annually to the best English-language novel published in the UK or Ireland.

• Winners receive ≤50,000 and global recognition.

• Shortlisted authors each get a smaller honorarium as part of the prize process.

• The prize was broadened in 2014 to include authors of any nationality if published in the UK or Ireland.

• Past winners include literary luminaries like Margaret Atwood, Kazuo Ishiguro, and Arundhati Roy.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Demographic Transition Model (DTM):

i) In Stage 1 (High Stationary), both birth rates and death rates are high, resulting in a stable but low total population.

ii) In Stage 3 (Late Expanding), the death rate begins to rise significantly due to industrial pollution and urban stress.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
डेमोग्राफिक ट्रांजिशन मॉडल (DTM) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) चरण 1 (उच्च स्थिर) में, जन्म दर और मृत्यु दर दोनों उच्च होते हैं, जिससे कुल जनसंख्या स्थिर लेकिन कम होती है।

ii) चरण 3 (देर से विस्तार) में, औद्योगिक प्रदूषण और शहरी तनाव के कारण मृत्यु दर में महत्वपूर्ण वृद्धि होने लगती है।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
In Stage 1 of the Demographic Transition Model, both birth rates and death rates are high. Because these rates largely cancel each other out, the total population remains low and relatively stable.

Statement (ii) is incorrect.

In Stage 3 (Late Expanding), the death rate does not rise. Instead:

Death rate remains low and stable

Birth rate declines sharply due to education, urbanisation, contraception, and improved living standards

Further insights

Stage 2 is marked by rapid population growth due to falling death rates.

Stage 3 shows population stabilisation trends.

Most developing countries fall in Stage 2 or Stage 3.

Industrialisation and education strongly influence birth rates.

Stage 4 has low birth and death rates, leading to a stable population.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the reintroduction of cheetahs in India:

i) The African cheetah was selected for reintroduction because the Asiatic cheetah is extinct in India and survives only in very small numbers in Iran.

ii) Kuno National Park was chosen as the first destination primarily due to its suitable grassland habitat and adequate prey base.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में चीता पुनः परिचय के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) अफ्रीकी चीता को पुनः परिचय के लिए चुना गया क्योंकि एशियाई चीता भारत में विलुप्त हो चुका है और केवल ईरान में बहुत कम संख्या में जीवित है।

ii) कुनो नेशनल पार्क को मुख्य रूप से इसके उपयुक्त घास के मैदान के आवास और पर्याप्त शिकार आधार के कारण पहला गंतव्य चुना गया था।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is correct.

The Asiatic cheetah became extinct in India in 1952 and now survives only in critically low numbers in Iran. Because translocation from Iran was not feasible, African cheetahs were chosen for reintroduction.

Statement (ii) is correct.

Kuno National Park was selected because it has:

Open grassland and savanna-like habitat

Sufficient prey species such as chital and sambar

Low human disturbance and long-term conservation planning

Further insights

Cheetahs were declared extinct in India in 1952.

The project is part of India's species restoration programme.

Kuno National Park is located in Madhya Pradesh.

Cheetahs help restore grassland ecosystems.

This is the world's first intercontinental large carnivore translocation.

questions.question: What is India's rank in the World Justice Project (WJP) Rule of Law Index 2025?
questions.question_hi: विश्व न्याय परियोजना (WJP) नियम कानून सूचकांक 2025 में भारत की रैंक क्या है?
questions.solution:
India is placed 86th out of 143 countries in the 2025 World Justice Project Rule of Law Index - a global ranking that assesses how the rule of law is experienced and perceived in practice, based on surveys and expert data.

Further insights

The WJP Rule of Law Index is based on eight factors, including constraints on power, absence of corruption, open government, and justice systems.

Denmark ranked 1st globally in the 2025 index.

About 68% of countries declined in their rule of law score in 2025.

India's rank dropped by six places compared to the previous year.

Rule of law rankings reflect legal fairness, judicial independence, and protection of rights.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik) scheme:

i) The primary objective of the scheme is to make air travel affordable and improve connectivity to unserved and underserved airports.

ii) Following the implementation of this scheme, India has become the world's largest domestic aviation market.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
UDAN (उड़े देश का आम नागरिa) योजना के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) इस योजना का मुख्य उद्देश्य हवाई यात्रा को सस्ती बनाना और बिना सेवा वाले तथा कम सेवा वाले हवाई अड्डों से कनेक्टिविटी में सुधार करना है।

ii) इस योजना के कार्यान्वयन के बाद, भारत विश्व का सबसे बड़ा घरेलू विमानन बाजार बन गया है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is correct.

The UDAN scheme was launched to enhance regional air connectivity by making flights affordable and linking unserved and underserved airports through viability gap funding and capped airfares.

Statement (ii) is incorrect.

India has not become the world's largest domestic aviation market due to UDAN. India is among the fastest-growing aviation markets, but countries like the United States still lead in domestic air traffic.

Further insights

UDAN is part of the National Civil Aviation Policy (NCAP) 2016.

Airfares on UDAN routes are capped for a fixed period.

Airlines receive viability gap funding to operate on low-demand routes.

The scheme supports tier-2 and tier-3 cities.

UDAN boosts tourism, trade, and regional development.

questions.question: Which of the following geographical features is famously known as the "Chicken's Neck" of India?
questions.question_hi: भारत के "चिकन नेक" के रूप में प्रसिद्ध निम्नलिखित भौगोलिक विशेषताओं में से कौन सी है?
questions.solution:
The Siliguri Corridor is a narrow stretch of land in West Bengal that connects mainland India with the North-Eastern states. Because of its narrow width and strategic importance, it is popularly called the "Chicken's Neck" of India.

Palk Strait → A water body separating India and Sri Lanka.

Radcliffe Line → Boundary line between India and Pakistan.

McMahon Line → Boundary line between India and China.

Further insights

The Siliguri Corridor lies between Nepal and Bangladesh.

It is crucial for defence, trade, and transport to the North-East.

Major road, rail, and pipeline routes pass through this region.

Any disruption here can affect eight North-Eastern states.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY):

i) The scheme provides a health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.

ii) It is a completely central-sector scheme, with 100% of the funding provided by the Union Government.

iii) The benefits of the scheme are portable across the country, allowing beneficiaries to get cashless treatment at any empanelled hospital in India.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (AB-PMJAY) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) यह योजना प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष द्वितीयक और तृतीयक देखभाल अस्पताल में भर्ती के लिए ₹5 लाख का स्वास्थ्य कवरेज प्रदान करती है।

ii) यह पूरी तरह से केंद्रीय क्षेत्र की योजना है, जिसमें 100% धनराशि केंद्र सरकार द्वारा प्रदान की जाती है।

iii) योजना के लाभ पूरे देश में पोर्टेबल हैं, जिससे लाभार्थी भारत के किसी भी पैनल अस्पताल में नकद रहित उपचार प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements (i) and (iii) are correct.

Statement (i) is correct because AB-PMJAY provides ₹5 lakh health cover per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.

Statement (iii) is correct because the scheme offers national portability, enabling beneficiaries to avail cashless treatment anywhere in India at empanelled hospitals.

Statement (ii) is incorrect.

AB-PMJAY is not a central-sector scheme. It is a centrally sponsored scheme, where funding is shared between the Centre and States (usually 60:40; 90:10 for NE and Himalayan states).

Further insights

AB-PMJAY is part of the broader Ayushman Bharat initiative.

It targets poor and vulnerable families identified through SECC data.

The scheme follows a cashless and paperless model.

Public and private hospitals can be empanelled under PMJAY.

Health is a State subject, hence cost sharing is constitutionally aligned.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Break-Even Point (BEP):

i) If the selling price per unit increases while fixed cost and variable cost remain constant, the break-even point shifts upward, meaning more units must be sold to break even.

ii) In a Break-Even (Cost - Volume - Profit) Chart, the Break-Even Point is the point where the Total Revenue line intersects the Total Cost line, and the area beyond this point indicates profit (margin of safety).

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
ब्रेक-ईवन पॉइंट (BEP) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) यदि प्रति इकाई विक्रय मूल्य बढ़ता है जबकि स्थिर लागत और परिवर्तनीय लागत स्थिर रहती है, तो ब्रेक-ईवन पॉइंट ऊपर की ओर स्थानांतरित हो जाता है, जिसका अर्थ है कि ब्रेक-ईवन तक पहुंचने के लिए अधिक इकाइयां बेचना आवश्यक है।

ii) ब्रेक-ईवन (लागत - मात्रा - लाभ) चार्ट में, ब्रेक-ईवन पॉइंट वह बिंदु होता है जहाँ कुल राजस्व रेखा कुल लागत रेखा को काटती है, और इस बिंदु के बाद का क्षेत्र लाभ (सुरक्षा मार्जिन) को दर्शाता है।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो मैं और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (ii) is correct.

In a Break-Even or Cost - Volume - Profit (CVP) Chart, the Break-Even Point is defined as the point where Total Revenue equals Total Cost. At this point, there is no profit and no loss. Once sales move beyond this intersection point, Total Revenue exceeds Total Cost, resulting in profit, often referred to as the margin of safety.

Statement (i) is incorrect.

If the selling price per unit increases while fixed and variable costs remain constant, the contribution per unit increases. As a result, fewer units are required to recover fixed costs, so the break-even point actually shifts downward, not upward.

Higher selling price → higher contribution

Higher contribution → lower BEP units

Further insights

Break-Even Point helps determine minimum sales required to avoid losses.

Contribution = Selling Price − Variable Cost.

Margin of Safety shows how much sales can fall before losses start.

Fixed costs remain constant irrespective of output level in the short run.

CVP analysis assumes linear cost and revenue behavior.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Article 131 of the Indian Constitution:

i) Under Article 131, the Supreme Court of India has the exclusive power to hear disputes between the Government of India and one or more States.

ii) This jurisdiction extends to disputes involving a private citizen against the Government of India or a State.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 131 के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) अनुच्छेद 131 के तहत, भारत का सर्वोच्च न्यायालय भारत सरकार और एक या अधिक राज्यों के बीच विवाद सुनने का विशेष अधिकार रखता है।

ii) यह अधिकार क्षेत्र एक निजी नागरिक और भारत सरकार या किसी राज्य के बीच विवादों तक भी विस्तृत है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is correct.

Article 131 grants the Supreme Court exclusive original jurisdiction in disputes between governments - that is, the Union and States, or between States - when the dispute involves a question of law or fact on which a legal right depends.

Statement (ii) is incorrect.

Article 131 does not cover disputes involving private individuals. Cases involving citizens are handled under other jurisdictions (writs, civil/criminal appeals), not Article 131.

Further insights

Article 131 applies only when a legal right is involved.

The jurisdiction is original (cases start directly in the Supreme Court).

Disputes may be Union vs State(s) or State vs State(s).

Private parties are outside the scope of Article 131.

questions.question: Which of the following structures is NOT located within the complex of Fatehpur Sikri?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित संरचनाओं में से कौन सी फतेहपुर सीकरी के परिसर के भीतर स्थित नहीं है?
questions.solution:
Moti Masjid is not part of the Fatehpur Sikri complex. It is located inside the Agra Fort and was built later during the reign of Shah Jahan. Therefore, it does not belong to the architectural layout of Fatehpur Sikri, which was primarily constructed by Akbar.

Buland Darwaza - It is the grand ceremonial gateway of Fatehpur Sikri, built to commemorate Akbar's victory over Gujarat.

Panch Mahal - A five-storeyed palace within Fatehpur Sikri, used for leisure and relaxation.

Salim Chishti's Tomb - A famous white marble Sufi shrine located inside the Fatehpur Sikri complex.

Further insights

Fatehpur Sikri served as Akbar's capital for a brief period.

Red sandstone is the dominant building material in Fatehpur Sikri.

The complex reflects a blend of Persian, Islamic, and Indian architectural styles.

Salim Chishti's Tomb is one of the few marble structures in the complex.

questions.question:
In the following question, a statement of Assertion (A) is followed by a statement of Reason (R). Mark the correct choice as:

Assertion (A): In 1828, Gomdhar Konwar led an armed uprising of the Ahom nobility against the British East India Company in Assam.

Reason (R): The British authorities, honoring the Treaty of Yandabo, immediately restored the Ahom monarchy and withdrew their troops from the Brahmaputra Valley.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में, एक कथन 'दावा (A)' के बाद एक कथन 'कारण (R)' दिया गया है। सही विकल्प को चिह्नित करें:

दावा (A): 1828 में, गोमधर कंवर ने असम में ब्रिटिश ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के खिलाफ अहोम कुलीनता का सशस्त्र विद्रोह नेतृत्व किया।

कारण (R): ब्रिटिश अधिकारियों ने, यंदाबो संधि का सम्मान करते हुए, तुरंत अहोम राजशाही को बहाल किया और ब्रह्मपुत्र घाटी से अपनी सेना वापस ले ली।

options.label: A
options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options.text_hi: दोनों (A) और (R) सही हैं, और (R) (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण है।

options.label: B
options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
options.text_hi: दोनों (A) और (R) सही हैं, लेकिन (R) (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है।

questions.solution:
Assertion (A) is true

After the British annexation of Assam following the First Anglo-Burmese War, Gomdhar Konwar, an Ahom prince, led a revolt in 1828 against British rule.

The uprising reflected resistance by the Ahom nobility, who were dissatisfied with British administrative control and loss of traditional authority.

Reason (R) is false

The Treaty of Yandabo (1826) ended the Anglo-Burmese War and transferred Assam to British control.

However:

The British did NOT restore the Ahom monarchy permanently

They did NOT withdraw their troops

Instead, they gradually annexed Assam and brought it under Company administration

Temporary arrangements with Ahom rulers were later abolished, leading to revolts like that of Gomdhar Konwar.

Further insights

Gomdhar Konwar's revolt is among the earliest anti-British uprisings in Assam.

The British initially used indirect rule, later shifting to full annexation.

Several Ahom princes resisted British authority between 1828 - 1833.

Assam was placed under Bengal Presidency administration initially.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the recent UNESCO recognition for Lucknow:

i) Lucknow has been officially designated as a 'Creative City of Gastronomy' by UNESCO, recognizing its rich culinary heritage.

ii) The announcement was made by the UNESCO Director-General on World Cities Day during the 43rd General Conference held in Samarkand.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
लखनऊ के लिए हाल ही में यूनेस्को मान्यता के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) लखनऊ को यूनेस्को द्वारा आधिकारिक रूप से 'क्रिएटिव सिटी ऑफ गैस्ट्रोनॉमी' के रूप में नामित किया गया है, जो इसकी समृद्ध पाक विरासत को मान्यता देता है।

ii) यह घोषणा यूनेस्को के महानिदेशक द्वारा विश्व शहर दिवस पर समरकंद में आयोजित 43वें महासभा सम्मेलन के दौरान की गई थी।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is correct.

Lucknow was officially designated as a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy in 2025 for its rich culinary heritage and food traditions.

Statement (ii) is correct.

The announcement was made on World Cities Day (31 October 2025) during the 43rd session of the UNESCO General Conference held in Samarkand, Uzbekistan.

Further insights

• Lucknow becomes the second Indian city after Hyderabad to be named a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy.

• The title highlights Lucknow's Awadhi cuisine, including kebabs, biryanais, and dum-pukht traditions.

• The UNESCO Creative Cities Network promotes culture and creativity for sustainable urban development.

• The 43rd UNESCO General Conference included the designation of 58 new creative cities across the world.

questions.question:
Match the transmission modes in Column A with their correct communication characteristics in Column B:

Column A (Mode) Column B (Characteristic)
i) Simplex1) Simultaneous two-way communication
ii) Half-Duplex2) Unidirectional (one-way) communication
iii) Full-Duplex3) Bi-directional but only one direction at a time

Select the correct option:
questions.question_hi:
स्तंभ A में ट्रांसमिशन मोड को स्तंभ B में उनके सही संचार लक्षणों के साथ मिलाएं:

स्तंभ A (मोड) स्तंभ B (लक्षण)
i) सिम्प्लेक्स1) एक साथ दो-तरफा संचार
ii) हाफ-डुप्लेक्स2) एकतरफा (एक-तरफा) संचार
iii) फुल-डुप्लेक्स3) द्वि-मार्गी लेकिन एक समय में केवल एक दिशा

सही विकल्प चुनें:
questions.solution:
Simplex → Unidirectional (2)

Data flows only in one direction. There is no return path.

Half-Duplex → Bi-directional but one direction at a time (3)

Both devices can transmit and receive, but not simultaneously.

Full-Duplex → Simultaneous two-way communication (1)

Data flows in both directions at the same time.

Further insights

Television broadcasting uses Simplex mode.

Walkie-talkies operate on Half-Duplex.

Telephone calls use Full-Duplex.

Full-Duplex improves bandwidth efficiency.

questions.question: Which type of computer is often referred to as a "supercomputer" due to its exceptional processing power?
questions.question_hi: अपनी असाधारण प्रसंस्करण शक्ति के कारण किस प्रकार के कंप्यूटर को अक्सर "सुपर कंप्यूटर" कहा जाता है?
questions.solution: While the term "supercomputer" may evoke thoughts of cutting-edge technology, it is important to note that not all supercomputers are quantum computers. Mainframe computers, known for their high-performance capabilities and ability to handle complex computations, are commonly associated with the term "supercomputer." Microcomputers are smaller-scale personal computers, while mini computers are mid-sized computers. Quantum computers, on the other hand, utilize quantum mechanics principles for enhanced processing power, but are not necessarily synonymous with the term "supercomputer."

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Fiber Optic communication:

i) Fiber optic cables are immune to electromagnetic interference (EMI) because they transmit data using light instead of electricity.

ii) Fiber optic signals suffer from very low attenuation, allowing data to travel much longer distances than copper wires without needing frequent boosters.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
फाइबर ऑप्टिक संचार के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) फाइबर ऑप्टिक केबल विद्युत के बजाय प्रकाश का उपयोग करके डेटा संचारित करते हैं, इसलिए वे विद्युतचुंबकीय हस्तक्षेप (EMI) से मुक्त होते हैं।

ii) फाइबर ऑप्टिक सिग्नल में बहुत कम क्षय होता है, जिससे डेटा तांबे के तारों की तुलना में बहुत लंबी दूरी तक बिना बार-बार बूस्टर की आवश्यकता के यात्रा कर सकता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is correct

Fiber optic cables use light signals, so electromagnetic noise does not affect them.

Statement (ii) is correct

Light signals in fiber lose very little strength, so data can travel long distances without repeaters.

Further insights

Fiber optics offer higher bandwidth than copper.

They are widely used in internet backbone networks.

Fiber is lighter and thinner than copper cables.

More secure, as tapping fiber is difficult.

Common in 5G and broadband infrastructure.

questions.question: Which of the following is not an input device?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प एक इनपुट डिवाइस नहीं है?
questions.solution: Here all are input devices except plotter, plotter is an output device that uses a pen, pencil, marker or other writing tools for making vector graphics. A plotter is a special kind of output channel like a printer, that produces images on paper. This is generally used in AUTOCAD, CAD/CAM etc.

questions.question: Which bar shows the total page of count in MS Word?
questions.question_hi: कौन-सा बार MS वर्ड में काउंट का कुल पेज दर्शाता है?
questions.solution: The Status bar is located at the Bottom of the word window In MS word. The status bar is the area at the bottom of the Word window. It indicates information about the current document. It displays information about what page you are on, as well as your line number on the page and character number on the line.

questions.question: To reload a webpage, press the ____ button.
questions.question_hi: किसी वेबपेज को रीलोड करने के लिए, ____ बटन दबाएं।
questions.solution:
· In general, refresh is a way of describing reloading or updating what is being displayed or stored.

· For example, if you are on a web page, refreshing the page displays the most recent content published on that page.

· Essentially, you're asking the site to send your computer the newest version of the page you're viewing.

questions.question: Which of the following is a type of malware that downloads onto a computer disguised as a legitimate program?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प एक ऐसा मैलवेयर है जो कि वैध प्रोग्राम के छद्म रूप में कंप्यूटर में डाउनलोड होता है?
questions.solution: Trojan horse is a type of malware that presents itself as legitimate software. It may perform actions on a computer that is genuine but will install malware actions.

questions.question: Which among the following is necessary without which a computer does not perform booting operation?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प एक आवश्यक भाग है जिसके बिना कंप्यूटर बूटिंग ऑपरेशन नहीं करता है?
questions.solution: An operating system is system software that manages computer hardware, software resources, and provides common services for computer programs. OS is necessary to perform booting operations in a computer. Some examples of OS include Windows Server, Linux, and FreeBSD. Time-sharing operating systems schedule tasks for efficient use of the system and may also include accounting software for cost allocation of processor time, mass storage, printing, and other resources.

questions.question: Which of the following is used to connect web pages?
questions.question_hi: वेब पेजों को जोड़ने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से किसका उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution: In a website, a hyperlink (or link) is an item like a word or button that points to another location. When you click on a link, the link will take you to the target of the link, which may be a webpage, document or other online content. Websites use hyperlinks as a way to navigate online content.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a component of a Computer Network?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प कंप्यूटर नेटवर्क का घटक नहीं है?
questions.solution:
The five components of a computer network are:

· Sender (Device)

· Sender Equipment (Encoder)

· Communication Channel (Cables, Wireless)

· Receiver Equipment (Decoder)

· Receiver (Device)

questions.question: In terms of computer, what is meant by Octet?
questions.question_hi: कंप्यूटर के संदर्भ में ऑक्टेट का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.solution:
A Byte is also known as Octet.

The octet is a unit of digital information in computing and telecommunications that consists of eight bits.

1 Nibble = 4 bits.

questions.question: Which of the following is a type of computer virus?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक प्रकार का कंप्यूटर वायरस है?
questions.solution: A Macro virus, that is, a virus written in macro language is an example of a type of computer virus. In 1999, a virus was seen to infect computers through word documents and emails and was known as the Melissa virus. That is an example of Macro virus. Mega virus and Mimi virus are viruses found in nature and are not computer viruses.

questions.question: What is the shortcut key that is used to close MS PowerPoint?
questions.question_hi: MS पावर प्वाइंट को बंद करने के लिए किस शॉर्टकट की (key) का प्रयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution:
Some of the shortcut keys used in MS PowerPoint:

Ctrl+ MAdd a new slide
Alt+ HHome Tab
Alt + GDesign Tab
Ctrl+ QClose PowerPoint

questions.question: _____ is a graphical file management utility for the Windows operating system (OS).
questions.question_hi: ________, विंडोज ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम (OS) के लिए एक ग्राफिकल फाइल मैनेजमेंट यूटिलिटी है।
questions.solution:
· Microsoft Windows Explorer is a graphical file management utility for the Windows operating system (OS).

· Windows Explorer is a file browser found in Microsoft Windows 95 and above to explore and manage the drives, folders, and files on the computer.

· Although similar, Microsoft Windows Explorer is not the same as "My Computer" and is not "Microsoft Internet Explorer", even though Internet Explorer is sometimes improperly referred to as Explorer.

questions.question: Which of the following is known as Junk E-mail?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किसे जंक ई-मेल के रूप में जाना जाता है?
questions.solution:
Junk email refers to unsolicited or unwanted emails, often sent in bulk.

These are usually advertisements, phishing attempts, or promotional content.

This type of email is more commonly known as spam.

Other options:

b) Deleted email - Simply refers to any email that has been removed.

c) Malware - Refers to malicious software, not a type of email.

d) None of the above - Incorrect, because "Spam email" is the correct term for junk email.

questions.question: What is the primary role of Patch Management software in a computer network?
questions.question_hi: कंप्यूटर नेटवर्क में पैच प्रबंधन सॉफ़्टवेयर की प्राथमिक भूमिका क्या है?

options.label: A
options.text: To create a complete backup of the entire hard drive every day.
options.text_hi: पूरे हार्ड ड्राइव का हर दिन पूर्ण बैकअप बनाने के लिए।

options.label: B
options.text: To monitor and limit the amount of internet data used by employees.
options.text_hi: कर्मचारियों द्वारा उपयोग किए गए इंटरनेट डेटा की मात्रा की निगरानी और सीमा निर्धारित करने के लिए।

options.label: C
options.text: To act as a physical shield that prevents unauthorized people from entering the server room.
options.text_hi: एक भौतिक ढाल के रूप में कार्य करने के लिए जो अनधिकृत लोगों को सर्वर कक्ष में प्रवेश करने से रोकता है।

options.label: D
options.text: To automatically identify, test, and install updates for software and operating systems.
options.text_hi: स्वचालित रूप से सॉफ़्टवेयर और ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम के लिए अपडेट की पहचान, परीक्षण और स्थापना करने के लिए।

questions.correct_text: To automatically identify, test, and install updates for software and operating systems.
questions.solution:
Patch Management software is designed to detect missing updates, test patches, and deploy them automatically across systems.

These patches fix security vulnerabilities, bugs, and performance issues.

It ensures all systems remain secure and up to date in a networked environment.

Further insights

Unpatched systems are a major cause of cyberattacks.

Patch management reduces the risk of zero-day vulnerabilities.

Large organizations use centralized patch deployment.

Patch testing prevents system crashes after updates.

questions.question: Dot-Matrix Printers, Line Printers, and Daisy wheel printer are examples of
questions.question_hi: डॉट-मैट्रिक्स प्रिंटर, लाइन प्रिंटर और डेज़ी व्हील प्रिंटर किसके उदाहरण हैं?
questions.solution:
· Printers are output devices that print information in the form of text/images on a paper.

· Impact Printers and Non-impact printers are the two types of printers.

· The impact printers print the characters by striking them on the ribbon which is then pressed on the paper.

· Examples: Dot-Matrix Printers, Line Printers, Daisy wheel printer, Drum printer, Chain printer, Band printer.

questions.question: Which term best describes the strong security features in Microsoft Office, such as data encryption and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), that protect users from advanced cyber threats?
questions.question_hi: माइक्रोसॉफ्ट ऑफिस में मजबूत सुरक्षा विशेषताओं जैसे डेटा एन्क्रिप्शन और मल्टी-फैक्टर ऑथेंटिकेशन (MFA) को सबसे अच्छी तरह से कौन सा शब्द वर्णित करता है, जो उपयोगकर्ताओं को उन्नत साइबर खतरों से बचाता है?
questions.solution:
The term robust is used to describe systems that are strong, well-designed, and capable of resisting failures or attacks.

Microsoft Office security features like data encryption and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) provide multiple layers of protection, making the system resilient against advanced cyber threats.

Further insights (One-liners):

Data encryption protects information by converting it into unreadable code.

MFA adds an extra verification step beyond passwords.

Robust security reduces the risk of unauthorized access.

Layered security is more effective than single-level protection.

questions.question: Which among the following are the primary memory of computers?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प कंप्यूटर की प्राथमिक मेमोरी है?
questions.solution:
Primary memory or main memory holds only those data and instructions on which computer is currently working. It has limited capacity and data gets lost when power is switched off.

It is divided into two subcategories: RAM and ROM

questions.question: Which key combination is used to insert a "Line Break" or start a new line of text within the same cell in MS Excel?
questions.question_hi: MS Excel में एक ही सेल के भीतर "लाइन ब्रेक" डालने या नई पंक्ति शुरू करने के लिए कौन सा कुंजी संयोजन उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution:
Alt + Enter inserts a line break inside the same cell in MS Excel.

It allows multiple lines of text without moving to another cell.

This is especially useful when writing addresses, descriptions, or notes in one cell.

Further insights

Line breaks work best with Wrap Text enabled.

Alt + Enter does not increase row height automatically.

Multiple line breaks can be added within the same cell.

This shortcut works in formula bar and cell edit mode.

questions.question: The sum of two numbers A and C is 50 more than B. If the value of A is 14.28% more than the value of C and the value of B is 40, the value of B is what percent more/less than the value of A?

questions.question: A shelf contains 8 math books, 6 biology books, and 9 English books. Two books are selected at random, one by one, without replacement. If the first book chosen is an English book, then find the probability that the second book is Biology.
questions.question_hi: एक शेल्फ में 8 गणित की किताबें, 6 जीवविज्ञान की किताबें, और 9 अंग्रेज़ी की किताबें हैं। दो किताबें यादृच्छिक रूप से, एक-एक करके, बिना प्रतिस्थापन के चुनी जाती हैं। यदि पहली चुनी गई किताब अंग्रेज़ी की है, तो दूसरी किताब जीवविज्ञान की होने की संभावना ज्ञात करें।
questions.solution:
Total books = 8 + 6 + 9 = 23

Total books after one English book selected = 8 + 6 + 8 = 22

Hence, the required probability = 6/22 = 3/11

questions.question: The sum of 4 numbers is 172. The largest number is 8 more than the second largest number. The average of the largest, the second smallest and the smallest number is 40. If the difference between the second largest number and the smallest number is 29, what is the sum of the smallest number and the largest number?
questions.question_hi: 4 संख्याओं का योग 172 है। सबसे बड़ी संख्या दूसरी सबसे बड़ी संख्या से 8 अधिक है। सबसे बड़ी, दूसरी सबसे छोटी और सबसे छोटी संख्या का औसत 40 है। यदि दूसरी सबसे बड़ी संख्या और सबसे छोटी संख्या के बीच का अंतर 29 है, तो सबसे छोटी संख्या और सबसे बड़ी संख्या का योग क्या है?
questions.solution:
Let the numbers be A>B>C>D.

Given conditions:

A+B+C+D = 172 (I)

A = B+8 (II)

(A+C+D)/3 = 40

=> A+C+D = 120 (III)

B - D = 29 (IV)

From (I) and (III), B = 52

From (II), A = 60

From (IV), D = 52 - 29 = 23

Required sum = A+D = 83

questions.question: The simple interest rate offered by a union bank is 4% in the first year. Starting from the second year, the simple interest rate offered by the bank is 1% more than the simple interest rate offered by the bank in the previous year. After how many years will the total simple interest earned on the deposit be 30% more than the initial amount deposited?
questions.question_hi: यूनियन बैंक द्वारा पहले वर्ष में दी जाने वाली साधारण ब्याज की दर 4% है। दूसरे वर्ष से आरंभ होकर, बैंक द्वारा दी जाने वाली साधारण ब्याज की दर पिछले वर्ष में बैंक द्वारा दी जाने वाली साधारण ब्याज की दर से 1% अधिक होती है। कितने वर्षों बाद जमा धनराशि पर प्राप्त होने वाला कुल साधारण ब्याज जमा की गई प्रारंभिक धनराशि से 30% अधिक होगा?
questions.solution:
Interest earned in the first year = Rs.4

Interest earned in the second year = Rs.5

And interest earned in the nth year = Rs.130

So,

4 + 5 + 6 + ....... + n = 130

1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 6 + ..... + n = 130 + 6

n x (n + 1)/2 = 136

n x (n + 1) = 272

Therefore, the value of n is 16.

Number of years = 16 - 3 = 13

questions.question: On Planet X, a robotic probe deploys an iron rod to stabilize against a towering alien tree. The rod makes an angle A with the planet's flat surface, where tan A = 60/11. The height of the tree is exactly 120 meters, as scanned by the probe. Find the horizontal distance between the base of the rod and the base of the alien tree.
questions.question_hi: ग्रह X पर, एक रोबोटिक प्रोब एक विशाल एलियन वृक्ष के सामने स्थिर होने के लिए एक लोहे की छड़ लगाता है। यह छड़ ग्रह की समतल सतह के साथ कोण A बनाती है, जहाँ tan⁻A = 60/11 है। प्रोब द्वारा स्कैन किए गए पेड़ की ऊँचाई ठीक 120 मीटर है। छड़ के आधार और एलियन वृक्ष के आधार के बीच क्षैतिज दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Tan A = 60/11 = Height of tree/distance of the foot of rod from the foot of tree

Given,

Height of tree = 120 m

60 units = 120 m

1 unit = 2 m

11 units = 22 m

Distance of the foot of rod from the foot of tree is 22 m.

questions.question: In a triangle ABC, AB = 33 cm, AC = 56 cm, and BC = 65 cm. From vertex A, a median AD is drawn that meets BC at point D. If G is the point on AD that denotes centroid, then find the length of AG.
questions.question_hi: त्रिभुज ABC में, AB = 33 cm, AC = 56 cm और BC = 65 cm है। शीर्ष A से, एक माध्यिका AD खींची जाती है, जो BC से बिंदु D पर मिलती है। यदि AD पर बिंदु G केन्द्रक को दर्शाता है, तो AG की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिये।
questions.solution:
Sides of the triangle are 33 cm, 56 cm, and 65 cm.

We know that (33, 56, 65) is a Pythagorean triplet.

Therefore, ABC is a right triangle.

Median (AD) = Hypotenuse/2 = 65/2 cm

We know that centroid divides the median in the ratio of 2: 1.

So, AG = AD * 2/3 = (65/2) * (2/3) = 21.66 cm

questions.question: In a triangle PQR, internal angle bisector of Q and external angle bisector of R meet at point S. If ∠P = 78˚ then find the value of ∠QSR.
questions.question_hi: एक त्रिभुज PQR में ∠Q का आंतरिक कोण समद्विभाजक और ∠R का बाह्य कोण समद्विभाजक बिंदु S पर मिलते हैं। यदि ∠P = 78˚ है, तो ∠QSR का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Short trick- ∠QSR = ∠QPR/2 = 78°/2 = 39°

Since the measure of angle formed by interior angle bisector of one base angle and exterior angle bisector of the other base angle is half the measure of the third angle (vertex angle).

questions.question: A man has ₹90 in the form of ₹1, ₹2, and ₹5 coins. The number of ₹2 coins is twice the number of ₹5 coins, and the number of ₹1 coins is 10 more than the number of ₹5 coins. Find the number of coins of ₹1.
questions.question_hi: एक व्यक्ति के पास ₹1, ₹2, और ₹5 के सिक्कों के रूप में कुल ₹90 हैं। ₹2 के सिक्कों की संख्या ₹5 के सिक्कों की संख्या का दोगुना है, और ₹1 के सिक्कों की संख्या ₹5 के सिक्कों की संख्या से 10 अधिक है। ₹1 के सिक्कों की संख्या ज्ञात करें।
questions.solution:
Let the number of ₹5 coins = x

Number of ₹2 coins = 2x

Number of ₹1 coins = x + 10

According to question,

x * 5 + 2x * 2 + (x + 10) * 1 = 90

5x + 4x + x + 10 = 90

10x = 80

x = 8

number of ₹1 coins = 8 + 10 = 18

questions.question: Varun started a partnership by investing Rs. 50000. After 8 months, Sneha joined with Rs. 60000. At the end of one year, they decided to donate 20% of their total profit to charity and divide the remaining profit in proportion to their capital contributions. If Varun's share exceeds Sneha's by Rs. 6000, how much money did they donate to charity?
questions.question_hi: वरुण ने 50000 रुपये निवेश करके साझेदारी शुरू की। 8 महीने बाद, स्नेहा 60000 रुपये के साथ शामिल हुई। एक वर्ष के अंत में, उन्होंने अपने कुल लाभ का 20% दान करने और शेष लाभ को उनके पूंजी योगदान के अनुपात में विभाजित करने का निर्णय लिया। यदि वरुण का हिस्सा स्नेहा से 6000 रुपये अधिक है, तो उन्होंने दान में कितनी राशि दी?
questions.solution:
Varun's contribution * Time/Sneha's contribution * Time = (50000 X 12)/(60000 X 4)

= 5: 2

Let the total profit be Rs. P

Charity = 20% of P = 0.2P

Remaining = P - 0.2P = Rs. 0.8P

Varun's share = 5/7 X 0.8P = Rs. 4P/7

Sneha's share = 2/7 X 0.8P = Rs. 1.6P/7

Difference be their share = Rs. 6000

(4 - 1.6) * P/7 = 6000

P = Rs. 17500

Hence, donation = 0.2 X 17500 = Rs. 3500

questions.question: If point C is the midpoint of points A(-3, -7) and B(5, 1) and D is the midpoint of points A and C, then what is the co-ordinates of point D?

Midpoint of points A(a1, a2) and B(b1, b2) is C(c1, c2)-

(x, y) = ((-3 + 5)/2, (-7 + 1)/2)

(x, y) = (2/2, -6/2)

(x, y) = (1, -3)

(m, n) = (-2/2, -10/2)

(m, n) = (-1, -5)

questions.question: If arithmetic mean of x and 1/x is n, then the arithmetic mean of x3 and 1/x3 will be -
questions.question_hi: यदि x और 1/x का अंकगणितीय माध्य n है, तो x3 और 1/x3 का अंकगणितीय माध्य होगा -
questions.solution:
(x + 1/x)/2 = n

x + 1/x = 2n

(x + 1/x)3 = (2n)3

x3 + 1/x3 + 3*x*1/x*(x + 1/x) = 8n3

x3 + 1/x3 = 8n3 - 6n

(x3 + 1/x3)/2 = 4n3 - 3n = n(4n2 - 3)

questions.question: A circle is inscribed in ΔABC which touches sides - AB, BC and AC at the points - P, R and Q, respectively. If AB - BC = 4 cm, AB - AC = 2 cm, and the perimeter of ΔABC = 32 cm then AC (in cm) = ?
questions.question_hi: ΔABC के अंतर्गत एक वृत्त बनाया गया है जो क्रमशः बिंदुओं P, R और Q पर भुजाओं AB, BC और AC को स्पर्श करता है। यदि AB - BC = 4 cm, AB - AC = 2 cm और ΔABC का परिमाप = 32 cm है, तो AC (cm में)= ?
questions.solution:
AB - BC = 4

BC = AB - 4

and AB - AC = 2

AC = AB - 2

Since perimeter of ΔABC = 32 cm

AB + BC + CA = 32

AB + AB - 4 + AB - 2 = 32

3AB - 6 = 32

3AB = 32 + 6 = 38

AB = 38/3 cm

AC = 38/3 - 2 = (38-6)/3 = 32/3 cm

questions.question: Worker A can complete a work in '2Y' number of days and worker B can complete the same work in '3Y' number of days while worker A, B, and C together can do it in 'Y' number of days. If for the whole work they get Rs.120Y, and the share of C in it is Rs.160, then find the value of Y.
questions.question_hi: मज़दूर A एक कार्य को '2Y' दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है और मज़दूर B समान कार्य को '3Y' दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है जबकि एक साथ मज़दूर A, B और C कार्य को 'Y' दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। यदि सम्पूर्ण कार्य के लिए उन्हें 120Y रुपये मिलते हैं और इसमें C का हिस्सा 160 रुपये है, तो Y का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Let total work = LCM of 2Y, 3Y, and Y = 6Y units

Efficiency of worker A = 6Y/2Y = 3 units per day

Efficiency of worker B = 6Y/3Y = 2 units per day

Efficiency of worker A + B + C = 6Y/Y = 6 units per day

Efficiency of worker C = 6 - 5 = 1 unit per day

Given,

Share of C = Rs.160

120Y * 1/6 = 160

Y = 960/120

Y = 8.

questions.question: A solid spherical ball of radius 84 cm is melted and recast into 66 identical cuboids. If the length of the cuboid is 42 cm and the height of the cuboid is 7/8 of breadth of the cuboid, then find the breadth of the cuboid.
questions.question_hi: 84 cm त्रिज्या वाली एक ठोस गोलाकार गेंद को पिघलाया जाता है और 66 समान घनाभ में पुनः ढाल दिया जाता है। यदि घनाभ की लंबाई 42 cm है और घनाभ की ऊँचाई, घनाभ की चौड़ाई का 7/8 भाग है, तो घनाभ की चौड़ाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Radius of solid spherical ball = 84 cm

Let the breadth of cuboid = 'b' cm

Height of cuboid = 7b/8 cm

Length of cuboid = 42 cm

Volume of spherical ball = 66* Volume of cuboid

4/3*22/7*84*84*84 = 66* 42 * b * 7b/8

b2 = 1024

b = 32 cm

questions.question: A container having volume 2310 cm3 is in the shape of a cone standing on one end of the cylinder. If the radius and height of the cylinder are 7cm and 12cm respectively then find the height of the cone.
questions.question_hi: 2310 cm3 आयतन वाला एक कंटेनर बेलन के एक सिरे पर खड़े एक शंकु के आकार का है। यदि बेलन की त्रिज्या और ऊँचाई क्रमशः 7cm और 12 cm है, तो शंकु की ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Let, height of the cone = H cm

r = 7 cm, h = 12 cm

Volume of container = 2310 cm3

Πr2h + 1/3 * πr2H = 2310

πr2 (h + H/3) = 2310

(22/7) * 7 * 7 (12 + H/3) = 2310

154 (12 + H/3) = 2310

(12 + H/3) = 2310/154

(12 + H/3) = 15

H/3 = 3

H = 9 cm

Here some problem or solution of the problem is given in the statement you have to choose the appropriate logical deduction for given statement.

Statement:

After an examination board introduced random seating plus CCTV coverage in selected centres, reported cheating complaints dropped by at least 20% compared to the previous cycle. Officials noted that many centres still lack cameras, so the board plans to expand CCTV coverage and tighten invigilator training.

III. The drop in complaints was more than 20%.

एक परीक्षा बोर्ड ने चयनित केंद्रों में यादृच्छिक बैठने और सीसीटीवी कवरेज शुरू करने के बाद, रिपोर्ट की गई धोखाधड़ी की शिकायतें पिछले चक्र की तुलना में कम से कम 20% घट गईं। अधिकारियों ने नोट किया कि कई केंद्रों में अभी भी कैमरे नहीं हैं, इसलिए बोर्ड सीसीटीवी कवरेज का विस्तार करने और पर्यवेक्षक प्रशिक्षण को कड़ा करने की योजना बना रहा है।

निष्कर्ष:

I. यादृच्छिक बैठना और सीसीटीवी धोखाधड़ी की शिकायतों को कम करने में मदद करता है।

II. इन परिवर्तनों से पहले, हर शिकायत गलत थी।

III. शिकायतों में गिरावट 20% से अधिक थी।

questions.question: In a family, Veera is the daughter-in-law of Arya. Barun is the grandfather of Hitanshi. Ilesh is the son of Krish. Arya and Barun are married couples. Hitanshi is the sister of Ilesh. Krish is the husband of Veera. How Arya is related to Ilesh?

questions.solution:
Ilesh is the son of Krish. Hitanshi is the sister of Ilesh. Krish is the husband of Veera.

Veera is the daughter-in-law of Arya. Barun is the grandfather of Hitanshi. Arya and Barun are married couples.

Hence, Arya is the grandmother of Ilesh.

questions.solution:
In a class of 80 students, Deepak is 19th from the front. There are 38 students behind Sharad. Kavya is 25th from the front.
18 students

questions.question:
'A @ B' means 'A is the mother of B'

'A % B' means 'A is the sister of B'

'A # B' means 'A is the father of B'

'A & B' means 'A is the wife of B'

As per which of the following expressions 'M is the grandmother of Q'?
questions.question_hi:
'A @ B' का अर्थ है 'A, B की माता है'

'A % B' का अर्थ है 'A, B की बहन है'

'A # B' का अर्थ है 'A, B का पिता है'

'A & B' का अर्थ है 'A, B की पत्नी है'

निम्नलिखित में से किस अभिव्यक्ति के अनुसार 'M, Q की दादी/नानी है'?
questions.solution:
Option (a): L & M # P # C @ Q

L & M means 'L is the wife of M'

M # P means 'M is the father of P'

P # C means 'P is the father of C'

C @ Q means 'C is the mother of Q'

M is father of grandfather of Q.

Option (b): M @ N & O # P % Q

M @ N means 'M is the mother of N'

N & O means 'N is the wife of O'

O # P means 'O is the father of P'

P % Q means 'P is the sister of Q'

M is the grandmother of Q.

Option (c): Q % C # N & D @ M

Q % C means 'Q is the sister of C'

C # N means 'C is the father of N'

N & D means 'N is the wife of D'

D # M means 'D is the father of M'

M is either grandson or granddaughter of Q's brother.

Option (d): M & P # L % O & Q

M & P means 'M is the wife of P'

P # L means 'P is the father of L'

L % O means 'L is the sister of O'

O & Q means 'O is the wife of Q'

M is the mother-in-law of Q.

Thus, the answer is option (b).

questions.question:
Choose the option that correctly changes the imperative sentence into passive voice.

Don't leave the wet umbrella on the sofa.

options.label: A
options.text: The wet umbrella is not left on the sofa.

options.label: B
options.text: Let the wet umbrella not be left on the sofa.

options.label: C
options.text: The wet umbrella should not leaving on the sofa.

options.label: D
options.text: The wet umbrella was not left on the sofa.

questions.correct_text: Let the wet umbrella not be left on the sofa.
questions.solution:
Option (b) is correct because negative imperatives can be converted using "Let + object + not + be + V3". It keeps the instruction tone without changing meaning.

Rule of Voice Transformation: Imperative →"Let + object + be + V3"; for negative, add "not" before "be".

Example: "Do not open the lid."→"Let the lid not be opened."

Why other options are wrong:

(a): Sounds like a general statement, not a clear instruction in the same way.

(c): Grammatically incorrect; "should not leaving" is wrong.

(d): Changes meaning to a past event, not an instruction.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the following passage and answer the questions based on the passage:

Colour blindness, medically known as colour vision deficiency, is a visual condition in which a person has difficulty distinguishing certain colours. It occurs due to a problem in the cone cells of the retina, which are responsible for perceiving colour. Normally, the human eye has three types of cones-red, green, and blue-each sensitive to different wavelengths of light. When one type of cone is absent, defective, or not functioning properly, the brain receives incomplete colour information, leading to confusion between specific colours. The most common forms of colour blindness involve red - green confusion, followed by blue-yellow deficiency, while complete colour blindness (seeing only in shades of grey) is extremely rare. In most cases, colour blindness is genetic and inherited through the X chromosome, which explains why it is more common in males than females. However, colour vision deficiency can also be acquired later in life due to eye diseases, ageing, brain injury, or side effects of certain medications. Early detection of colour blindness is important, especially in children, as it can affect learning, reading charts, and classroom activities without being immediately obvious. The condition is usually detected using standardised colour vision tests, the most widely used being the Ishihara test, which consists of coloured dot plates forming numbers or patterns. Other tests, such as arrangement tests and digital screening tools, help identify the type and severity of colour vision deficiency. Early screening-ideally during preschool or early school years-allows parents and teachers to adapt learning methods accordingly. As far as treatment is concerned, most inherited forms of colour blindness cannot be cured, as they involve genetic abnormalities in cone cells. However, certain assistive technologies can help manage the condition. Specially designed colour-filter glasses, mobile applications, and screen settings enhance contrast and colour differentiation. In cases of acquired colour blindness, treating the underlying cause-such as managing eye disease or adjusting medication-may partially restore colour perception. While gene therapy is being researched, it is still experimental and not widely available.

options.label: D
options.text: Highlighting technological advances in vision correction

questions.solution:
Solution:

The passage moves systematically from defining colour blindness to explaining its causes, methods of detection, and available management options. This comprehensive focus is reflected throughout the text, making option (b) the most accurate statement of the central idea.

questions.question:
Which type of sentence is the following from the passage?

"As far as treatment is concerned, most inherited forms of colour blindness cannot be cured, as they involve genetic abnormalities in cone cells."

options.label: A
options.text: Simple sentence with a single clause

questions.solution:
Solution:

Main Clause: "most inherited forms of colour blindness cannot be cured"

Subordinate Clause 1 (Adverbial Clause of Condition/Viewpoint): "As far as treatment is concerned"

Subordinate Clause 2 (Adverbial Clause of Cause): "as they involve genetic abnormalities in cone cells"

Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

Note: The main clause can stand alone as a complete thought. The subordinate clauses cannot stand alone and modify the main clause, which is the defining characteristic of a complex sentence.
