The first letter is replaced by next fifth alphabet; the second letter is replaced by its reverse pair and the third letter is replaced by previous fifth alphabet as per the English alphabetical series.

Similarly,

questions.question:
A sentence is provided in indirect speech. Choose the correct direct speech option.

Rahul said that he would buy groceries after he checked what was missing at home.

options.label: A
options.text: "I will buy groceries after I check what is missing at home," Rahul said.

options.label: B
options.text: "I would buy groceries after I checked what was missing at home," Rahul said.

options.label: C
options.text: "I will buy groceries after I checked what is missing at home," Rahul said.

options.label: D
options.text: "I shall bought groceries after I check what is missing at home," Rahul said.

questions.correct_text: "I will buy groceries after I check what is missing at home," Rahul said.
questions.solution:
Correct option: (a) "I will buy groceries after I check what is missing at home," Rahul said.

"Would buy" becomes "will buy" in direct speech.

After "after," use simple present for future meaning: "after I check.."

"What was missing" becomes "what is missing" because Rahul is talking at that moment about the present situation at home.

Rule used: Rule of Speech Conversion (future time clause + present reference correction).

Example: She said that she would cook after she checked the fridge →"I will cook after I check the fridge," she said.

Incorrect options:

(b): Keeps indirect speech form (would, checked, was).

(c): Wrong tense in time clause: should be check, not checked.

(d): "shall bought" is wrong; after "shall," use base verb "buy.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes the tone of the passage?
questions.solution: The passage explains the concept of Chinese whispers, its causes, implications, and relevance in modern communication in a reasoned and explanatory manner. It neither mocks nor strongly condemns the phenomenon but analyses it objectively. Hence, the tone is analytical and explanatory, making option (c) the correct answer.
questions.passage:
Directions : Read the following passage and answer the questions based on the passage:

The term Chinese whisper refers to a communication process in which a message is passed from one person to another, gradually changing in content as it moves along a chain of speakers. Commonly used as a classroom game or metaphor, the concept highlights how information can become distorted through repetition, misunderstanding, or selective interpretation. Although the phrase has playful origins, the phenomenon it describes reveals serious insights into human communication and the reliability of transmitted information.

Chinese whisper effect lies the imperfect nature of listening and memory. Each individual receives a message, interprets it through personal assumptions, and then reproduces it in a slightly altered form. Small inaccuracies are introduced at each stage, often resulting in a final version that differs drastically from the original. This process demonstrates how communication is not a simple act of transfer but one of reconstruction influenced by cognition, language competence, and context.

In contemporary society, the mechanism of Chinese whispers extends far beyond casual conversation. It is evident in the spread of rumours, misinformation, and partially verified news, especially in digital and social media environments. When information passes rapidly through multiple users without verification, distortion becomes almost inevitable. Emotional tone, personal bias, and ideological positioning further intensify this transformation, making the message more sensational or misleading.

The phenomenon also underscores the importance of clarity, accuracy, and accountability in communication. Institutions such as the media, educational systems, and administrative bodies must ensure that messages remain consistent as they pass through various levels. Understanding the logic behind Chinese whispers encourages individuals to question sources, verify facts, and recognise the limitations of second-hand information. Thus, what begins as a simple game ultimately serves as a powerful metaphor for the challenges of communication in both interpersonal and public discourse.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

In the heart of a bustling city, where towering skyscrapers reached for the sky, lived a young orphan named Joseph. With a heart full of determination and a mind filled with curiosity, Joseph embarked on a quest to find his long-lost biological parents. Every day after school, Joseph would sneak into the old library, poring over dusty records and faded photographs. He would spend hours deciphering old birth certificates and piecing together fragments of information, hoping to uncover a clue that would lead him to his past. His friends at the orphanage would often ask why he was so obsessed with his origins. Joseph would smile and say, "I just want to know where I come from. Maybe my parents are out there, looking for me too." As time passed, Liam's determination caught the attention of Ms. Thompson, the librarian. She was intrigued by his dedication and offered to help him in his search. Together, they dug deeper into the archives, their bond growing stronger with every discovery.

One day, buried beneath layers of old papers, they stumbled upon a faded letter. With trembling hands, Joseph unfolded it and read the words that changed his life forever. The letter was from his mother, expressing her love and regret for having to give him up for adoption. She mentioned a special locket that she had left for him as a symbol of their connection. Armed with newfound hope, Joseph set out to find the locket that would lead him to his parents. He followed the clues and embarked on a journey that took him through bustling markets, tranquil parks, and hidden alleyways. Along the way, he encountered kind strangers who offered him guidance and encouragement. Finally, under the shade of an ancient oak tree, Joseph found the locket - a delicate silver heart on a chain. Clutching it tightly, he felt an overwhelming sense of belonging. With a heart full of gratitude, Joseph returned to the orphanage, where he shared his journey with Ms. Thompson and his friends.

"Lost and Found" could be a plausible title, but it doesn't capture the specific aspect of the protagonist's search for his identity and parents.

"An Orphan's Quest for Treasure" is not accurate as the main quest is not about material treasure but about finding his biological parents and connecting with his past.

"The Library Chronicles" might describe the setting, but it doesn't convey the personal and emotional journey that Joseph undertakes to understand his identity.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

They sang a duet. They harmonized their voices perfectly.

options.label: A
options.text: They were singing a duet. They were harmonizing their voices perfectly.

options.label: B
options.text: A duet was singing. Their voices were harmonized perfectly.

options.label: C
options.text: They were sung a duet. They were harmonized their voices perfectly.

options.label: D
options.text: A duet was sung by them. Their voices were harmonized perfectly by them.

questions.correct_text: A duet was sung by them. Their voices were harmonized perfectly by them.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

The usage of a "to be" form of verbs [here 'was' and 'were'] is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

In Passive Voice, the preposition "by" is used before the object. However, it is optional in some cases.

The Active voice in this question is in Past Indefinite. Thus, the Passive voice will also be in Past Indefinite.

The format of Active voice is: Subject + V2 + Object.

Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be: Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + was/were + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).

For example:

Real Madrid won the Champions League. (Active Voice)

The Champions League was won by Real Madrid. (Passive Voice)

The options except (d) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: A duet was sung by them. Their voices were harmonized perfectly by them.

Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The inaugural speech is to be done by you. Felicitation of guests is also to be done by you.

options.label: A
options.text: You are doing the inaugural speech. You are also doing felicitating the guests.

options.label: B
options.text: You are to do the inaugural speech. You are also to do felicitating the guest.

options.label: C
options.text: You are to do the inaugural speech. You are also to do felicitation of guests.

options.label: D
options.text: You are about to doing the inaugural speech. You are also to doing the felicitating the guest.

questions.correct_text: You are to do the inaugural speech. You are also to do felicitation of guests.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" (be' in this case) verb and the preposition "by" is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

In Active voice, the sentence should be in Infinitive form (to + V1).

The format in Passive voice is: Object of the Active voice (Subjective case) + am/is/are/was/were + to + be + V3 + by + Subject of the Active voice (Objective case).

Thus, the format in Active voice is: Subject + am/is/are/was/were + to + V1 + Object.

For example:

She is to be helped by you. (Passive)

You are to help her (Active)

The options except (c) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

Note:

V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).

questions.question:
A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.

The chef said, "Please don't add extra salt to the soup."

options.label: A
options.text: The chef ordered not to add extra salt to the soup.

options.label: B
options.text: The chef said that please don't add extra salt to the soup.

options.label: C
options.text: The chef requested that I didn't add extra salt to the soup.

options.label: D
options.text: The chef requested them not to add extra salt to the soup.

questions.correct_text: The chef requested them not to add extra salt to the soup.
questions.solution:
Correct option first: Option d is correct because "Please don't.." is a polite negative request, best reported as "requested + object + not to + verb."

Rule: Polite requests change to "requested/asked + object + (not) to + verb."

Example: "Please don't shout," she said → She requested him not to shout.

"Please don't add.." becomes "requested them not to add.."

Final correct sentence: The chef requested them not to add extra salt to the soup.

Incorrect options:

·a. Missing the person who was told, so the sentence is incomplete for SSC-style reporting.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

He said to me, "Why can't you shut your mouth for a minute?"

options.label: A
options.text: He asked me that why can't I shut my mouth for a minute.

options.label: B
options.text: He asked me why I couldn't shut my mouth for a minute.

options.label: C
options.text: He asked me why he couldn't shut your mouth for a minute.

options.label: D
options.text: He asked me why I can't shut my mouth for a minute.

questions.correct_text: He asked me why I couldn't shut my mouth for a minute.
questions.solution:
Option (b) is the correct answer.

In the case of Interrogative sentences like this, "said" in Direct Speech is changed into "enquired (of)", "wanted to know", "asked", etc.

In Indirect speech, the verb is always placed after the subject, unlike in Direct Speech.

For example:

The teacher said to him, "What is your name?" (Direct Speech)

The teacher asked him what his name was. (Indirect Speech)

Also, the sentence in the Direct Speech is in the Simple Present tense. So, the tense in the Indirect Speech should be in the Simple Past tense.

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

 The reporting verb 'said to' is changed into 'asked'.

 The modal verb 'can' is changed into 'could'.

 The pronoun 'you' is changed into 'I'.

 The possessive adjective 'your' is changed into 'my'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: He asked me why I couldn't shut my mouth for a minute.

questions.question: The sound device in "silent swimmers slid through the stream" is:
questions.solution:
Correct option is Alliteration (Option a) because several words start with the same "s" sound.

Alliteration means repetition of the starting consonant sound in nearby words.

Example: "busy bees buzz."

Option b Assonance is wrong because assonance is repetition of vowel sounds, not starting consonant sounds.

Option c Pun is wrong because there is no double-meaning joke on a word.

Option d Simile is wrong because there is no comparison using "like" or "as."

Final sentence: silent swimmers slid through the stream.

questions.question: How does AR promote active learning in education?

options.label: A
options.text: By enabling students to actively explore and discover new concepts

options.label: B
options.text: By facilitating the passive absorption of information by students

options.label: C
options.text: By restricting interaction with the physical environment

options.label: D
options.text: By emphasising visual learning methods exclusively

questions.correct_text: By enabling students to actively explore and discover new concepts
questions.solution:
The first paragraph of the passage mentions, 'Moreover, AR promotes active learning by encouraging exploration and discovery. Instead of passively absorbing information, students engage with content in dynamic ways.' This excerpt highlights how augmented reality (AR) enables students to actively engage with learning materials. This active engagement contrasts with traditional learning methods that rely on passive absorption of information from textbooks or static images (option b). Accordingly, (a) is correct.

Option (c) is not correct. The passage does not mention that AR restricts interaction with the physical environment. In fact, AR enhances interaction by overlaying virtual objects and environments onto the physical world, allowing students to interact with both realms simultaneously.

Option (d) is not correct. The passage also highlights the benefits of AR for auditory learners (receiving audio instructions or explanations overlaid with physical objects). Therefore, AR's benefits are not limited to visual learning methods exclusively. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.
questions.passage:
Directions : Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

Augmented Reality (AR) is revolutionising education by enhancing learning experiences through its ability to merge digital information with the real world. This innovative technology enables students to interact with virtual objects and environments overlaid on their physical surroundings, thereby transforming abstract concepts into tangible, immersive learning experiences. One of the primary benefits of AR in education is its capability to visualise complex information. Subjects that traditionally rely on textbooks and two-dimensional images, such as biology and chemistry, can now be taught using interactive 3D models. For example, students can dissect virtual organisms or manipulate molecular structures in real time, gaining a deeper understanding of spatial relationships and processes that are difficult to grasp through static illustrations alone. Moreover, AR promotes active learning by encouraging exploration and discovery. Instead of passively absorbing information, students engage with content in dynamic ways. Historical events can be recreated in AR, allowing learners to witness pivotal moments firsthand at historical sites or even in their classrooms. This contextualization not only makes history more vivid and memorable but also facilitates deeper connections between past events and present-day implications.

AR also enhances collaborative learning environments. Students can collaborate on projects where they design and interact with virtual simulations together. In fields like architecture and engineering, teams can prototype and visualise complex structures in real-world contexts, fostering teamwork, problem-solving skills, and creative thinking. Furthermore, AR supports personalised learning experiences by catering to individual learning styles and paces. Visual learners benefit from interactive visualisations, while auditory learners can receive audio instructions or explanations overlaid with physical objects. This adaptability helps educators tailor educational content to meet diverse student needs, promoting inclusivity and equity in the classroom.

Despite these advantages, integrating AR into education poses challenges such as cost, infrastructure requirements, and the need for teacher training. Schools must invest in suitable devices and software, ensure robust internet connectivity, and provide educators with adequate support and professional development opportunities to effectively integrate AR into their teaching practices.

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: C

options.label: D
options.text: AR requires students to learn at the same pace.

questions.correct_text: AR offers different learning materials for visual and auditory learners.
questions.solution:
The second paragraph of the passage mentions, 'Furthermore, AR supports personalised learning experiences by catering to individual learning styles and paces. Visual learners benefit from interactive visualisations, while auditory learners can receive audio instructions or explanations overlaid onto physical objects.' This indicates that AR adapts to the needs of different types of learners by providing tailored content. Therefore, option (c) is the correct answer as it aligns with the passage's description of how AR supports personalised learning.

Option (a) is not correct. The passage indicates that AR supports personalised learning experiences. It caters to individual learning styles and paces, suggesting that not all students receive the same AR experience.

Option (b) is not correct. The passage does not explicitly mention AR providing content solely based on a student's interests. Instead, it emphasises AR's ability to cater to individual learning styles (visual and auditory) rather than specific interests.

Option (d) is incorrect. The passage does not suggest that AR imposes a uniform pace of learning on all students. In fact, it mentions that AR supports personalised learning by adapting to individual paces. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

questions.solution: The underlined phrase in the sentence and the phrase in options (a) & (c) cannot be used in the sentence as they make the sentence grammatically incorrect; the modal verbs 'will' and 'would' take a verb in its base form after them; 'taken' [V3] and 'taking' [V4] are not the base forms of verb. questions.question: Which of the following can fit in the blank 3?
questions.solution:
We need a word that appropriately modifies "rich traditions" and fits grammatically after the verb "celebrate." Let's examine each option:

Option a): This is a possessive relative pronoun, used to show ownership or association, typically in clauses like: "The country whose culture is ancient.." In the sentence, "whose rich traditions" would imply the traditions belong to someone/something. But the sentence structure "celebrate whose rich traditions" is ungrammatical here.

Option b): "That" can be a determiner or relative pronoun. Using "celebrate that rich traditions" is incorrect - the article "that" doesn't work directly before a plural noun like "traditions" without a prior reference or restrictive clause.

Option c): Demonstrative determiner referring to multiple things that are either near in thought or just being introduced. "These rich traditions" is grammatically correct. This makes perfect sense, as the festivals are celebrating these specific, present, or relevant traditions.

Option d): "Which" as a determiner is used in interrogatives (e.g., Which book do you want?). In this context, it doesn't fit grammatically.

Hence, option (c) is the answer.

Note: Relative pronouns: A relative pronoun is used to connect a clause or phrase to a noun or pronoun. The clause modifies, or describes, the noun. The most common relative pronouns are who, whom, whose, which, and that. For example: She is the girl who received the award for bravery from our Home Minister.

Determiner: A modifying word that determines the kind of reference a noun or noun group has, for example, 'a', 'the', 'every', 'much', 'many', etc.

Demonstrative Adjectives/determiners: Demonstrative adjectives include this, that, these and those. These modify or describe a noun and come before a noun while demonstrative pronouns replace a noun. Example: I like that T-shirt of yours.

questions.question: Which of the following can fit in the blank 5?
questions.solution:
The sentence talks about the effect of modernization on preserving cultural customs, implying a possible negative impact. So, we're looking for a modal verb that appropriately shows likelihood or possibility, not certainty or obligation.

Option a): "May" indicates a possibility, meaning that modernization could challenge the preservation of customs, but it's not certain. This is the most appropriate choice because it aligns with the uncertainty of the statement. It expresses the idea that while modernization could pose a threat, it is not guaranteed.

Option b): "Ought to challenge" implies modernization should challenge tradition, which contradicts the intended concern in the sentence.

Option c): "Will" expresses certainty.

Using "will" would suggest that modernization definitely challenges the preservation of customs, which is too strong a statement in this case, as the passage is discussing potential risks, not certainties.

Option d): "Must" implies necessity or certainty. This would be inappropriate because the sentence doesn't suggest that the challenge is inevitable but rather something that could happen.

Hence, option (a) is the answer.

questions.question:
Some sentences are given below. While the first and the last sentences (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the four sentences in between are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

S1. Cryptocurrency is a form of digital or virtual asset that uses cryptography to secure transactions, control the creation of new units, and verify the transfer of assets.

A. This decentralized nature means they are not controlled by any single entity like a government or bank, which is a core part of their appeal.

B. Unlike traditional currencies issued by central authorities, most cryptocurrencies operate on a distributed public ledger technology, typically a blockchain.

C. However, this lack of central regulation also contributes to high volatility, security risks from hacking, and its use in illicit activities.

D. The blockchain records all transactions in a network of computers, ensuring transparency and resistance to modification by any single party.

S6. Consequently, while it offers a revolutionary vision for the future of finance, its path to mainstream acceptance is fraught with significant technical and regulatory hurdles.
questions.solution:
S1 defines cryptocurrency. Sentence B provides a key point of contrast with "traditional currencies," introducing the concept of the "distributed public ledger technology" or "blockchain." Sentence D elaborates on what "The blockchain" does, explaining how it records transactions. Sentence A explains the implication of the system described in B and D, which is its "decentralized nature." Sentence C then introduces a contrasting point with "However," discussing the negative consequences of "this lack of central regulation" mentioned in A. The sequence BDAC flows logically from the underlying technology to its key characteristic, its implications, and finally its drawbacks, setting the stage for the concluding sentence S6.

Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. It also has been increasingly recognized for its positive effect on mental health.

B. Psychiatrists often encourage their patients to develop an exercise routine.

C. Exercise has been known to have beneficial effects on cardiovascular health.

D. And a recent review concludes that physicians should recommend exercise as a treatment for depression.
questions.solution:
The sentences talk about exercise and its benefits. Sentence C is the first sentence in the order as it introduces the central object of discussion which is 'exercise'. Sentence A follows C in the order as A talks about another benefit of exercise apart from cardiovascular health that is mentioned in C. Sentences B and D form a pair that describes the work done by psychiatrists with respect to exercise and the conclusion of a recent review that supports the work done by psychiatrists. Therefore, the correct order of the sentences is CABD.

Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. It was first worn by Brünnhilde, the protagonist of Richard Wagner's epic opera cycle, Der Ring des Nibelungen.

B. Weeks before Halloween, I found myself pacing the aisles of a costume store as I had volunteered to help with my child's classroom party, and though I had a witch hat at home I wanted an outfit that would be more commanding.

C. A few months later, I happened to come across the origins of this costume.

D. I decided on a horned Viking helmet with long blond braids glued on.
questions.solution:
If we read through the sentences, we can see that D is followed by C because D tells us that the author settled on a horned Viking helmet with glued-on long blond braids and C tells us that the author found onto the beginnings of the same outfit a few months later. Also, A tells us that the custom mentioned in C was first worn by Brünnhilde, who was the protagonist of Richard Wagner's epic opera cycle. Thus, A must follow C. Also, B can fit as the introductory sentence as the author tells us that he found himself wandering the aisles of a costume store weeks before Halloween because he had agreed to help with his child's school celebration and, despite having a witch hat at home, he needed a more intimidating suit.

Therefore, the correct answer is: (a) BDCA.

questions.question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate tense:

By the end of this quarter, the company ___ three regional offices to reduce delivery time.
questions.solution:
Option c is correct because the action will be completed before a specific future time ("by the end of this quarter").

Rule (Future Perfect): Use "will have + past participle" to show completion before a future deadline.

Example: "By next week, they will have finished the project."

· Option a is wrong because simple present does not show completion before the deadline in this context.

· Option b is wrong because it is past tense, but the time is in the future.

· Option d is wrong because it is passive and also does not fit the meaning here (the company is doing the action).

Final correct sentence: By the end of this quarter, the company will have opened three regional offices to reduce delivery time.

But if you ______ to spare before you do catch the bus, be sure to pop in.
questions.solution:
Have a moment to spare - to have a free time

Filling the blank option (b) gives the meaning that the subject is being asked to pop in (give a brief visit) if he/she has some free time before catching the bus.

Other options render the sentence meaningless.

The correct sentence is: But if you have a moment to spare before you do catch the bus, be sure to pop in.

Hence, option (b) is the answer.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The organization provides __________ support to underprivileged children in the community which shows their lack of responsibility.
questions.solution:
Let's look at the meanings of the given options.

Prodigious: extremely great in ability, amount, or strength.

Abundant: more than enough.

Profuse: produced or given in large amounts.

Inadequate: not good enough or too low in quality.

"Inadequate" is the correct answer as it means not sufficient or not enough, which would describe the level of support from the irresponsible organization. The other options do not represent insufficiency.

Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

The complete sentence is: The organization provides inadequate support to underprivileged children in the community which shows their lack of responsibility.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into three segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

He likes painting, dancing, / and to explore various/ forms of artistic expression.
questions.solution:
One of the grammar rules is to make sure that sentence elements that are parallel in meaning are parallel in structure. So, 'to explore' needs to be replaced by 'exploring' in order to rectify the error. Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

The final corrected sentence: He likes painting, dancing, and exploring various forms of artistic expression.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into three segments. Identify the segment that contains an error. If the sentence is free of any errors, mark 'No error' as your answer.

The wall's sheets, adorned with vibrant/ wallpaper, contribute to the overall aesthetic of the/ room, enhancing its ambience and style.

options.label: A
options.text: the wall's sheets, adorned with vibrant

options.label: B
options.text: wallpaper, contribute to the overall aesthetic of the

options.label: C
options.text: room, enhancing its ambience and style

questions.correct_text: the wall's sheets, adorned with vibrant
questions.solution:
The term "the wall's sheets" is not appropriate. The apostrophe is not used in the case of non-living things. The correction involves removing the apostrophe from "wall's" and simply writing 'the sheets of the wall' instead. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

The corrected sentence would be: The sheets of the wall, adorned with vibrant wallpaper, contribute to the overall aesthetic of the room, enhancing its ambience and style.

questions.question:
Select the sentence that uses the given idiom correctly.

Bite off more than you can chew

options.label: A
options.text: She bit off more than she could chew when she decided to run a marathon without any training.

options.label: B
options.text: The manager always bites off more than he can chew when he orders food at a restaurant.

options.label: C
options.text: I like to bite off more than I can chew when I study for exams because it motivates me to work harder.

options.label: D
options.text: They bit off more than they could chew when they refused to buy the house for which they couldn't afford the mortgage.

questions.correct_text: She bit off more than she could chew when she decided to run a marathon without any training.
questions.solution:
The idiom "bite off more than you can chew" means to take on a task that is too difficult or demanding for one's abilities or resources. It usually has a negative connotation. Option (a) uses the idiom correctly, as it implies that she took on a challenge that was beyond her capacity and likely failed or suffered. The other options either use the idiom in a positive or neutral way or in a literal sense, which is not appropriate.

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in the positive degree of comparison.

She writes more neatly than her classmates.

options.label: A
options.text: She writes more neatly than her classmates.

options.label: B
options.text: Her classmates write less neatly than she does.

options.label: C
options.text: She and her classmates have more neatness in writing.

options.label: D
options.text: Her classmates don't write as neatly as she does.

questions.correct_text: Her classmates don't write as neatly as she does.
questions.solution:
The given sentence is in the comparative degree, which means it compares one thing or person with another and shows that it has a higher or lower degree of quality. The comparative degree is formed by adding 'er' to an adjective or adverb or using 'more' before an adjective or adverb whichever is suitable. To change a sentence from the comparative degree to the positive degree, we need to remove 'more' in this case.

Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

Other options are in a comparative degree.

Note:

Adjectives: Words which are used with a noun/pronoun to describe or point out, the person, animal, place, or thing which the noun names, or to tell the number or quantity, are called Adjectives.

· The Positive Degree is used to denote the mere existence of some quality of what we speak about. It is used when no comparison is made.

· The Comparative degree denotes a higher degree of quality than the positive and is used when two things are compared.

· The Superlative degree indicates the highest degree of quality and is used when more than two things (or sets of things) are compared.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the administration of tribal areas in India:

Statement I: The Sixth Schedule provides for the administration and control of Scheduled Areas and Scheduled Tribes in most Indian states, excluding the North-Eastern region.

Statement II: The Fifth Schedule deals specifically with the tribal areas of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram through Autonomous District Councils.

Which of the following is correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में जनजातीय क्षेत्रों के प्रशासन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: छठा अनुसूची अधिकांश भारतीय राज्यों में अनुसूचित क्षेत्र और अनुसूचित जनजातियों के प्रशासन और नियंत्रण के लिए प्रावधान करता है, जिसमें पूर्वोत्तर क्षेत्र शामिल नहीं है।

कथन II: पांचवां अनुसूची असम, मेघालय, त्रिपुरा और मिजोरम के जनजातीय क्षेत्रों से संबंधित है, जो स्वायत्त जिला परिषदों के माध्यम से प्रबंधित होते हैं।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही है?

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement I and II are correct
options.text_hi: दोनों कथन I और II सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement I nor II is correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I सही है और न ही कथन II सही है

questions.correct_text: Neither Statement I nor II is correct
questions.solution:
Statement I is Incorrect

The Sixth Schedule does NOT exclude the North-Eastern region.

In fact, it is specifically meant for tribal areas in the North-East, covering Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram, and provides for Autonomous District and Regional Councils.

Statement II is Incorrect

The Fifth Schedule does NOT apply to Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram.

These states are governed under the Sixth Schedule, not the Fifth.

The Fifth Schedule applies to Scheduled Areas in non-North-Eastern states like Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, etc., and does not create Autonomous District Councils.

Further Insights:

• Sixth Schedule gives legislative, executive, and judicial powers to Councils

• Fifth Schedule areas are administered through the Governor

• Autonomous District Councils can make laws on land, forest, and customs

• The Sixth Schedule reflects India's asymmetric federalism

• Tribal administration aims to protect culture, land, and self-governance

questions.question: What was the name of the relief mission launched by the Indian Army in August 2025 to rescue people during the floods in Punjab?
questions.question_hi: अगस्त 2025 में पंजाब में बाढ़ के दौरान लोगों को बचाने के लिए भारतीय सेना द्वारा शुरू किए गए राहत मिशन का नाम क्या था?
questions.solution:
During the devastating floods in Punjab in August 2025, the Indian Army launched a major relief and rescue operation named Operation Rahat to evacuate stranded people, deliver essential supplies, and provide humanitarian assistance.

This operation included extensive deployment of army columns and aviation assets, working with civil authorities and disaster response forces to reach cut-off areas and save lives.

Operation Madad - This name has been used by the Indian Navy and Army for other disaster responses (e.g., Kerala floods), but not for the 2025 Punjab flood mission.

Operation Meghdoot - This is the longstanding Indian Army mission to control the Siachen Glacier.

Operation Maitri - A major relief operation launched for the 2015 Nepal earthquake, not for Punjab floods.

Further Insights:

• Operation Rahat involved Army aviation and ground columns to evacuate civilians and deliver supplies.

• The operation was coordinated with NDRF and SDRF teams for efficient disaster response.

• Similar "Rahat" missions have been used in past flood and disaster responses.

• Modern humanitarian missions use multi-agencies to reach cut-off regions quickly.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the current Formula 1 Grand Prix points system:

Statement I: A driver who finishes in 1st place receives 25 points, while the 10th place finisher receives 1 point.

Statement II: An extra point for the Fastest Lap is awarded to any driver on the grid, regardless of their final finishing position.

Which of the following is correct?
questions.question_hi:
वर्तमान फॉर्मूला 1 ग्रांड प्रिक्स पॉइंट सिस्टम के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: जो ड्राइवर 1वें स्थान पर समाप्त करता है उसे 25 अंक मिलते हैं, जबकि 10वें स्थान पर समाप्त करने वाले को 1 अंक मिलता है।

कथन II: फास्टेस्ट लैप के लिए अतिरिक्त अंक किसी भी ड्राइवर को दिया जाता है, चाहे उनकी अंतिम फिनिशिंग पोजीशन कुछ भी हो।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही है?

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement I and II are correct
options.text_hi: दोनों कथन I और II सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement I nor Statement II is correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I सही है और न ही कथन II सही है

questions.solution:
Statement I is correct

Under the current points system (in use as of the 2026 season), the winner of a Formula 1 Grand Prix earns 25 points and the driver finishing 10th earns 1 point. Only the top ten classified drivers score points in a race.

Statement II is incorrect.

While Formula 1 previously awarded an extra point for the fastest lap, that bonus was only given if the driver also finished inside the top ten. Additionally, the fastest-lap point was removed starting with the 2025 season, and hence is not currently awarded regardless of finishing position.

Further Insights:

• Points for Grand Prix races are awarded to the top ten finishers only.

• The current system (25-18-15..1) has been in place since 2010.

• A bonus point for fastest lap existed from 2019 to 2024 with conditions.

• Fastest lap points were discontinued starting in 2025.

• Sprint races have a separate, smaller points allocation.

questions.question: Which of the following conditions is caused by the excessive secretion of Growth Hormone in adults, leading to thickened bones in the face and hands?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी स्थिति वयस्कों में वृद्धि हार्मोन के अत्यधिक स्राव के कारण होती है, जिससे चेहरे और हाथों की हड्डियाँ मोटी हो जाती हैं?
questions.solution:
Excess growth hormone (GH) after adulthood causes acromegaly. Since the growth plates are already closed, height doesn't increase; instead, bones of the face, hands, and feet thicken, and soft tissues enlarge.

Gigantism

Caused by excess GH in childhood, leading to abnormally tall height.

Dwarfism

Due to deficiency of GH during childhood.

Cretinism

Caused by thyroid hormone deficiency, not growth hormone.

Further Insights:

• GH is secreted by the pituitary gland

• Acromegaly develops slowly and is often diagnosed late

• Gigantism and acromegaly differ mainly by age of onset

• Hormonal disorders often show system-wide effects

• Early diagnosis helps prevent organ complications

questions.question:
Match the following Grades of Fire Temples with their respective descriptions:

Fire Temple GradeDescription
i) Atash BehramA. The basic grade; used for local prayers and household rituals
ii) Agiyari (Adarian)B. The highest grade; created by the union of 16 different fires
iii) Atash DadgahC. The middle grade; established for smaller towns or communities

Choose the correct matching option:
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित अग्नि मंदिरों की श्रेणियों को उनके संबंधित विवरणों के साथ मिलाएं:

अग्नि मंदिर श्रेणीविवरण
i) अतश बेहरमA. मूल श्रेणी; स्थानीय प्रार्थनाओं और घरेलू अनुष्ठानों के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है
ii) अगियारी (अडरियन)B. उच्चतम श्रेणी; 16 विभिन्न अग्नियों के मिलन से निर्मित
iii) अतश ददगाहC. मध्य श्रेणी; छोटे शहरों या समुदायों के लिए स्थापित

सही मिलान विकल्प चुनें:

options.label: A
options.text: i - B, ii - C, iii - A
options.text_hi: i - B, ii - C, iii - A

options.label: B
options.text: i - C, ii - B, iii - A
options.text_hi: i - C, ii - B, iii - A

options.label: C
options.text: i - B, ii - A, iii - C
options.text_hi: i - B, ii - A, iii - C

options.label: D

questions.correct_text: i - B, ii - C, iii - A
questions.solution:
i) Atash Behram → B

Atash Behram is the highest grade of fire temple, consecrated using 16 different types of fires through an elaborate ritual.

ii) Agiyari (Adarian) → C

Agiyari (also called Atash Adarian) is the middle grade, generally serving towns or community congregations.

Atash Dadgah is the basic grade, commonly used for local worship and household-level rituals.

Further Insights:

• Fire temples belong to the Zoroastrian (Parsi) religion

• India has some of the oldest surviving fire temples

• Most Parsis in India live in western India, especially Mumbai

questions.question: Which of the following terms best describes a life-saving medicine for which consumers will continue to pay even if the price increases significantly?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा शब्द जीवन रक्षक दवा का सबसे अच्छा वर्णन करता है जिसके लिए उपभोक्ता कीमत में काफी वृद्धि होने पर भी भुगतान करना जारी रखेंगे?
questions.solution:
Life-saving medicines are essential goods. People cannot easily reduce their consumption even when prices rise, because the medicine is necessary for survival. This situation is called inelastic demand, where quantity demanded changes very little despite a large change in price.

Further Insights:

• Essential goods usually have low price elasticity of demand

• Insulin and cancer drugs are classic examples of inelastic demand

• Governments often regulate prices of such goods to ensure affordability

• Luxury goods usually show elastic demand

• Demand elasticity helps in pricing and taxation policies

i) Pygmy HogA. Western Ghats

Choose the correct matching option:
questions.question_hi:
भारत की निम्नलिखित गंभीर रूप से संकटग्रस्त (CR) प्रजातियों को उनके प्राथमिक आवास के साथ मिलाएं:

प्रजातिप्राथमिक आवास
i) पिग्मी हॉगA. पश्चिमी घाट
ii) मलबार सिवेटB. मानस राष्ट्रीय उद्यान
iii) ग्रेट इंडियन बस्टर्डC. डेजर्ट नेशनल पार्क

सही मिलान विकल्प चुनें:

options.label: A
options.text: i - B, ii - A, iii - C
options.text_hi: i - B, ii - A, iii - C

options.label: B
options.text: i - A, ii - B, iii - C
options.text_hi: i - A, ii - B, iii - C

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Vikram-32 microprocessor:

i) It is India's first indigenous 32-bit microprocessor designed specifically for use in ISRO's rockets and satellites.

ii) The chip was designed by the Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC) and manufactured at the Semiconductor Laboratory (SCL) in Mohali.

Which of the following is correct?
questions.question_hi:
विक्रम-32 माइक्रोप्रोसेसर के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) यह भारत का पहला स्वदेशी 32-बिट माइक्रोप्रोसेसर है जिसे विशेष रूप से इसरो के रॉकेट और उपग्रहों में उपयोग के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है।

ii) इस चिप को विक्रम साराभाई स्पेस सेंटर (VSSC) द्वारा डिज़ाइन किया गया था और इसे मोहाली के सेमीकंडक्टर लैबोरेटरी (SCL) में निर्मित किया गया था।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही है?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement i is Correct

The Vikram-32, officially named VIKRAM3201, is India's first fully indigenous 32-bit microprocessor and has been developed for space applications such as use in ISRO launch vehicles and satellites. Its design enables it to withstand the harsh environments of rocket launches and space operations.

Statement ii is Correct

The chip was designed by the Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC) in collaboration with the Semi-Conductor Laboratory (SCL) located in Mohali, where it was also fabricated and packaged using local semiconductor facilities.

Further Insights:

• Vikram-32 succeeds the earlier 16-bit Vikram1601 used in ISRO launch vehicles since 2009.

• Vikram-32 is radiation hardened and can function in extreme space conditions.

• The chip uses a custom instruction set suitable for critical avionics computing.

• Its first batches were validated during a PSLV mission.

• Development aligns with India's Atmanirbhar Bharat semiconductor push.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the ocean floor:

Statement I: The Continental Shelf is the shallowest part of the ocean and is the primary zone for global commercial fishing and offshore oil extraction.

Statement II: The Continental Slope is a gentle incline that marks the end of the ocean and the beginning of the deep abyssal plains.

Which of the following is correct?
questions.question_hi:
महासागर तल के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: महाद्वीपीय शेल्फ महासागर का सबसे उथला भाग है और यह वैश्विक वाणिज्यिक मछली पकड़ने और समुद्र तट से दूर तेल निष्कर्षण का मुख्य क्षेत्र है।

कथन II: महाद्वीपीय ढलान एक सौम्य ढलान है जो महासागर के अंत और गहरे अबिसल मैदानों की शुरुआत को दर्शाता है।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही है?

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement I and II are correct
options.text_hi: दोनों कथन I और II सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement I nor II is correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I सही है और न ही II सही है

questions.solution:
Statement I is Correct

The continental shelf is the shallowest part of the ocean floor. It receives plenty of sunlight and nutrients, making it the most productive fishing zone. It is also rich in oil and natural gas, which is why offshore drilling mainly happens here.

Statement II is Incorrect

The continental slope is not gentle; it is steep. It marks the transition from the continental shelf to the deep ocean floor, but it does not mark the end of the ocean. Beyond the slope lies the abyssal plain, not the "end" of the ocean.

Further Insights:

• Continental shelves are widest along passive margins

• Most marine biodiversity is found on continental shelves

• Abyssal plains are among the flattest surfaces on Earth

• Continental slopes often contain submarine canyons

• Ocean-floor features are studied using sonar and satellite data

questions.question: What was the main objective of the Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb in getting the Fatwa-e-Alamgiri compiled by a group of scholars?
questions.question_hi: मुगल सम्राट औरंगजेब का फतवा-ए-आलमगीरी को विद्वानों के एक समूह द्वारा संकलित करवाने का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?

options.label: A
options.text: To give priority to local village customs and reduce the role of Islamic law.
options.text_hi: स्थानीय गांव की प्रथाओं को प्राथमिकता देने और इस्लामी कानून की भूमिका को कम करने के लिए।

options.label: B
options.text: To create a uniform law book based on the Hanafi school so that courts followed the same rules across the empire.
options.text_hi: हनाफ़ी स्कूल पर आधारित एक समान कानून पुस्तक बनाने के लिए ताकि साम्राज्य भर में अदालतें एक ही नियमों का पालन करें।

options.label: C
options.text: To prepare a military rulebook to reform the mansabdari system and increase revenue from the Deccan.
options.text_hi: मंसबदारी प्रणाली में सुधार करने और दक्कन से राजस्व बढ़ाने के लिए एक सैन्य नियमावली तैयार करने के लिए।

options.label: D
options.text: To translate Hindu law books into Persian and merge Hindu and Islamic laws into one system.
options.text_hi: हिंदू कानून की पुस्तकों का फारसी में अनुवाद करने और हिंदू और इस्लामी कानूनों को एक प्रणाली में मिलाने के लिए।

questions.correct_text: To create a uniform law book based on the Hanafi school so that courts followed the same rules across the empire.
questions.solution:
Aurangzeb ordered the compilation of the Fatwa-e-Alamgiri to standardise Islamic law across the Mughal Empire.

It was based on the Hanafi school of Sunni Islam and served as a uniform legal reference for qazis and judges.

Further Insights:

• The Fatwa-e-Alamgiri is also known as Al-Fatawa al-Alamgiriyya

• It was compiled by about 500 Islamic scholars

• It is written mainly in Arabic

• It influenced Islamic legal practice even beyond the Mughal period

• Aurangzeb reversed several liberal policies of Akbar in religious matters

questions.question: What is the primary objective of the established national assessment center, PARAKH under NEP 2020?
questions.question_hi: NEP 2020 के तहत स्थापित राष्ट्रीय मूल्यांकन केंद्र, PARAKH का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?

options.label: A
options.text: To increase the number of textbooks for primary school students.
options.text_hi: प्राथमिक विद्यालय के छात्रों के लिए पाठ्यपुस्तकों की संख्या बढ़ाने के लिए।

options.label: B
options.text: To set norms and standards for student assessment across all recognized boards.
options.text_hi: सभी मान्यता प्राप्त बोर्डों में छात्र मूल्यांकन के लिए मानक और मानदंड निर्धारित करने के लिए।

options.label: C
options.text: To conduct a nationwide entrance exam for recruitment into the Indian Army.
options.text_hi: भारतीय सेना में भर्ती के लिए एक राष्ट्रीय स्तर की प्रवेश परीक्षा आयोजित करने के लिए।

options.label: D
options.text: To manage the distribution of mid-day meals in rural government schools.
options.text_hi: ग्रामीण सरकारी स्कूलों में मध्याह्न भोजन के वितरण का प्रबंधन करने के लिए।

questions.correct_text: To set norms and standards for student assessment across all recognized boards.
questions.solution:
PARAKH (Performance Assessment, Review and Analysis of Knowledge for Holistic Development) was established under the National Education Policy 2020 as India's National Assessment Centre. Its core objective is to set norms, standards and guidelines for student assessment and evaluation for all recognised school education boards in the country. This includes promoting uniform and holistic assessments, helping boards move away from rote-based testing, and ensuring consistency and quality in evaluations across different states and boards.

Further Insights:

• PARAKH stands for Performance Assessment, Review and Analysis of Knowledge for Holistic Development.

• It was established as an independent assessment centre under NCERT in 2023.

• Its mandate includes guiding large-scale and school-based assessments.

• PARAKH aims to reduce dependence on rote learning and promote competency-based assessment.

questions.question: Which of the following pairs of Author and their Book is incorrectly matched?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा लेखक और उनकी पुस्तक का जोड़ा गलत मेल खाता है?

options.label: A
options.text: Dadabhai Naoroji  -  Poverty and Un-British Rule in India
options.text_hi: दादाभाई नौरोजी - भारत में गरीबी और गैर-ब्रिटिश शासन

options.label: B
options.text: Jawaharlal Nehru  -  The Discovery of India

options.label: C
options.text: Bal Gangadhar Tilak  -  Annihilation of Caste
options.text_hi: बाल गंगाधर तिलक - जाति का विनाश

options.label: D
options.text: Subhas Chandra Bose  -  The Indian Struggle

questions.correct_text: Bal Gangadhar Tilak  -  Annihilation of Caste
questions.solution:
Annihilation of Caste was not written by Bal Gangadhar Tilak.

It was authored by Dr. B. R. Ambedkar and is a powerful critique of the caste system in India.

Dadabhai Naoroji wrote Poverty and Un-British Rule in India, explaining the Drain of Wealth Theory.

Jawaharlal Nehru authored The Discovery of India while in prison.

Subhas Chandra Bose wrote The Indian Struggle, describing India's freedom movement.

Further Insights:

• Annihilation of Caste was written in 1936

• Dadabhai Naoroji is known as India's Grand Old Man

• The Indian Struggle covers the period 1920 - 1942

• Nehru wrote The Discovery of India during Ahmednagar Fort imprisonment

questions.question: Which of the following statements correctly describes the working and recent developments of the International Solar Alliance (ISA) as of 2026?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन 2026 तक अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सौर गठबंधन (ISA) के कार्य और हाल के विकास को सही ढंग से वर्णित करता है?

options.label: A
options.text: Membership of ISA is limited only to countries located between the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn.
options.text_hi: ISA की सदस्यता केवल उन देशों तक सीमित है जो कर्क रेखा और मकर रेखा के बीच स्थित हैं।

options.label: B
options.text: The "Towards 1000" plan aims to mobilise USD 1 trillion in investments and support the installation of 1,000 GW of solar power capacity by 2030.
options.text_hi: "टुवर्ड्स 1000" योजना का उद्देश्य 2030 तक 1,000 GW सौर ऊर्जा क्षमता की स्थापना के लिए 1 ट्रिलियन USD के निवेश को जुटाना है।

options.label: C
options.text: The OSOWOG initiative aims to build a solar power grid only within India to achieve national energy security.
options.text_hi: OSOWOG पहल का उद्देश्य राष्ट्रीय ऊर्जा सुरक्षा प्राप्त करने के लिए केवल भारत के भीतर एक सौर ऊर्जा ग्रिड बनाना है।

options.label: D
options.text: The SUNRISE Network provides high-interest loans to European countries for setting up solar power projects.
options.text_hi: SUNRISE नेटवर्क यूरोपीय देशों को सौर ऊर्जा परियोजनाओं की स्थापना के लिए उच्च ब्याज दर वाले ऋण प्रदान करता है।

questions.correct_text: The "Towards 1000" plan aims to mobilise USD 1 trillion in investments and support the installation of 1,000 GW of solar power capacity by 2030.
questions.solution:
Statement (b) is correct.

The ISA's 'Towards 1000' strategy is a flagship framework to mobilise USD 1 trillion in investments and support the installation of 1,000 GW (1,000 gigawatts) of solar capacity by 2030.

Further Insights:

• ISA was jointly launched by India and France in 2015

• ISA's headquarters is located at Gurugram, Haryana

• OSOWOG aims to enable 24 X 7 renewable energy access globally

• ISA focuses strongly on Africa, Small Island States, and developing countries

questions.question: Under the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 (BSA), which replaced the Indian Evidence Act, 1872, what major change has been made regarding electronic records?
questions.question_hi: भारतीय साक्ष्य अधिनियम, 2023 (BSA) के तहत, जिसने भारतीय साक्ष्य अधिनियम, 1872 को प्रतिस्थापित किया, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रिकॉर्ड्स के संबंध में क्या प्रमुख परिवर्तन किया गया है?

options.label: A
options.text: Digital records are treated only as secondary evidence.
options.text_hi: डिजिटल रिकॉर्ड्स को केवल द्वितीयक साक्ष्य के रूप में माना जाता है।

options.label: B
options.text: A printed paper copy is compulsory to prove any digital record.
options.text_hi: किसी भी डिजिटल रिकॉर्ड को साबित करने के लिए एक मुद्रित कागजी प्रति अनिवार्य है।

options.label: C
options.text: Courts are no longer allowed to record statements through video conferencing.
options.text_hi: अदालतों को अब वीडियो कॉन्फ्रेंसिंग के माध्यम से बयान दर्ज करने की अनुमति नहीं है।

options.label: D
options.text: Digital records such as emails and server data are treated as primary evidence.
options.text_hi: डिजिटल रिकॉर्ड जैसे ईमेल और सर्वर डेटा को प्राथमिक साक्ष्य माना जाता है।

questions.correct_text: Digital records such as emails and server data are treated as primary evidence.
questions.solution:
The Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 has brought a major reform by explicitly recognising electronic records as primary evidence.

This means that original digital datasuch as emails, server logs, call data records, CCTV footage, or electronic documentscan be directly relied upon by courts without automatically treating them as secondary evidence.

Further Insights:

• The law aligns evidence rules with digital governance and e-courts

• It reduces dependence on Section 65B - type procedural hurdles

• Cybercrime and financial fraud cases benefit the most

• Electronic evidence includes audio, video, and metadata

• The reform improves speed and efficiency in trials

questions.question: Which of the following pairs of Forest Type and its Characteristic/Location is incorrectly matched?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा वन प्रकार और उसकी विशेषता/स्थान का जोड़ा गलत मेल खाता है?

options.label: A
options.text: Tropical Evergreen  -  Receive more than 200 cm rainfall; found in Western Ghats.
options.text_hi: उष्णकटिबंधीय सदाबहार - 200 सेमी से अधिक वर्षा प्राप्त करते हैं; पश्चिमी घाटों में पाए जाते हैं।

options.label: B
options.text: Tropical Deciduous  -  Trees shed leaves in summer; most widespread in India.
options.text_hi: उष्णकटिबंधीय पर्णपाती - पेड़ गर्मियों में पत्ते गिराते हैं; भारत में सबसे व्यापक।

options.label: C
options.text: Mangrove Forests  -  Grow in saline coastal mud; found in Sundarbans.
options.text_hi: मैंग्रोव वन - खारे तटीय कीचड़ में उगते हैं; सुंदरबन में पाए जाते हैं।

options.label: D
options.text: Tropical Thorn  -  Trees like Pine and Deodar; found in high-altitude Himalayas.
options.text_hi: उष्णकटिबंधीय कांटेदार - पाइन और देवदार जैसे पेड़; उच्च-altitude हिमालय में पाए जाते हैं।

questions.correct_text: Tropical Thorn  -  Trees like Pine and Deodar; found in high-altitude Himalayas.
questions.solution:
Tropical Thorn forests do not have trees like pine and deodar, nor are they found in high-altitude Himalayan regions.

Instead, Tropical Thorn forests:

Grow in arid and semi-arid regions

Have trees like acacia, babul, cactus

Are found in Rajasthan, Gujarat, parts of Deccan Plateau

Pine and Deodar are typical of Montane (Coniferous) forests, not Tropical Thorn forests.

Further Insights:

• Pine and deodar belong to Montane forests

• Thorn forests help prevent soil erosion in deserts

• Tropical Deciduous forests are also called Monsoon forests

• Mangroves protect coasts from cyclones and tsunamis

• Forest type depends mainly on rainfall and temperature

questions.question: According to the NARI 2025 report, which of the following cities has been ranked as one of the safest for women in India?
questions.question_hi: NARI 2025 रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा शहर भारत में महिलाओं के लिए सबसे सुरक्षित शहरों में से एक के रूप में रैंक किया गया है?
questions.solution:
As per the NARI 2025 report (National Analysis on Rape Incidents), Kohima has been ranked among the safest cities for women in India.

The ranking is based on factors such as:

Low incidence of crimes against women

Better community vigilance

Strong social cohesion and reporting mechanisms

Further Insights:

• NARI focuses on crime data and safety indicators for women

• Smaller cities often show better community-level safety

• Crime reporting rates influence city rankings

• Urban safety depends on policing, social structure, and awareness

• Safety rankings help guide policy and policing reforms

questions.question: Which of the following diplomats was appointed as India's next Ambassador to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) prior to 2026?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस राजनयिक को 2026 से पहले भारत का संयुक्त अरब अमीरात (यूएई) के लिए अगला राजदूत नियुक्त किया गया था?
questions.solution:

This appointment was made prior to 2026, and he was designated to succeed Sunjay Sudhir as India's envoy in Abu Dhabi.

Further Insights:

• Dr. Deepak Mittal previously served as India's Ambassador to Qatar.

• He played a key role in diplomatic contacts with the Taliban during his tenure in Doha.

• The UAE hosts one of the largest Indian diaspora communities in the world.

• Strong India - UAE ties include energy, trade, and strategic cooperation.

• Ambassadorial postings often reflect bilateral diplomatic priorities.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Residuary Powers of legislation in India:

i) Under Article 248, the Parliament has the exclusive power to make any law with respect to any matter not enumerated in the Concurrent List or the State List, including the power to impose a tax.

ii) The Indian Constitution follows the American model of federalism by vesting these residuary powers in the Centre to ensure national integration and a strong Union.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में विधायिका के अवशिष्ट शक्तियों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) अनुच्छेद 248 के तहत, संसद को समवर्ती सूची या राज्य सूची में उल्लिखित किसी भी विषय के संबंध में कोई भी कानून बनाने का विशेष अधिकार प्राप्त है, जिसमें कर लगाने का अधिकार भी शामिल है।

ii) भारतीय संविधान अमेरिकी संघीयता मॉडल का पालन करता है जो राष्ट्रीय एकता और एक मजबूत संघ सुनिश्चित करने के लिए इन अवशिष्ट शक्तियों को केंद्र में निहित करता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement i is correct

Article 248 of the Constitution explicitly grants residuary legislative powers to Parliament.

This means Parliament can legislate on any subject not mentioned in the Union List, State List, or Concurrent List, and this power also extends to taxation on such subjects.

Statement ii is incorrect.

The Indian Constitution does not follow the American model in this respect.

Instead, residuary powers in India are vested in the Centre on the lines of the Canadian model of federalism, not the American one.

Further Insights:

• Residuary powers are mentioned in Article 248 and Entry 97 of the Union List

• In the USA, residuary powers belong to States

• In Canada and India, residuary powers belong to the Centre

• This arrangement strengthens unity and national integrity

• New subjects like cyber laws and space technology fall under residuary powers

questions.question: In which city did Minakshi Hooda and JaismineLamboria win their gold medals at the 2025 World Boxing Championships?
questions.question_hi: 2025 विश्व मुक्केबाजी चैंपियनशिप में मिनाक्षी हूडा और जैस्मिनलाम्बोरिया ने अपने स्वर्ण पदक किस शहर में जीते?
questions.solution:
Minakshi Hooda and JaismineLamboria won gold medals at the 2025 World Boxing Championships held in Liverpool, England. The event took place at the Liverpool Arena, and both boxers clinched their respective titles in their weight categories, contributing to India's best-ever performance at an overseas World Championships.

Further Insights:

• The 2025 World Boxing Championships were hosted in Liverpool Arena, England.

• JaismineLamboria won gold in the 57 kg category.

• Minakshi Hooda won gold in the 48 kg category.

• The event saw one of India's strongest overseas performances in boxing.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Ryotwari System introduced by the British in India:

i) It was primarily implemented in the Madras and Bombay Presidencies by Sir Thomas Munro and Alexander Read.

ii) The system established a direct settlement between the Government and individual cultivators (Ryots), recognizing them as landowners.

iii) The land revenue rates were fixed permanently and could not be changed, regardless of soil quality or time.

Which of the following combinations is correct?
questions.question_hi:
ब्रिटिशों द्वारा भारत में लागू किए गए रैयतवारी प्रणाली के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) इसे मुख्य रूप से मद्रास और बॉम्बे प्रेसिडेंसी में सर थॉमस मुनरो और अलेक्जेंडर रीड द्वारा लागू किया गया था।

ii) इस प्रणाली ने सरकार और व्यक्तिगत कृषकों (रैयतों) के बीच सीधे समझौते की स्थापना की, उन्हें भूमि स्वामी के रूप में मान्यता दी।

iii) भूमि राजस्व दरें स्थायी रूप से निर्धारित की गई थीं और मिट्टी की गुणवत्ता या समय की परवाह किए बिना उन्हें बदला नहीं जा सकता था।

निम्नलिखित संयोजनों में से कौन सा सही है?
questions.solution:
Statement i is Correct

The Ryotwari System was introduced mainly in the Madras and Bombay Presidencies, and its key architects were Thomas Munro and Alexander Read.

Statement ii is Correct

Under this system, the government dealt directly with individual peasants (ryots). Ryots were treated as owners of land, subject to payment of land revenue.

Statement iii is Incorrect

Revenue under the Ryotwari System was not fixed permanently. It was revised periodically based on factors like soil fertility, crop conditions, and market prices. Permanent fixation was a feature of the Permanent Settlement, not Ryotwari.

Further Insights:

• Ryotwari System contrasted with the Permanent Settlement (Zamindari)

• It was common in South and Western India

• High revenue demand often led to peasant indebtedness

• Periodic revisions created uncertainty for farmers

• The system increased administrative burden on the British

questions.question: Which of the following statements correctly identifies a primary characteristic of Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) as compared to Foreign Institutional Investment (FII)?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन विदेशी प्रत्यक्ष निवेश (FDI) की एक प्राथमिक विशेषता को विदेशी संस्थागत निवेश (FII) की तुलना में सही ढंग से पहचानता है?

options.label: A
options.text: It is considered volatile "hot money" capital.
options.text_hi: इसे अस्थिर "हॉट मनी" पूंजी माना जाता है।

options.label: B
options.text: It involves purchasing shares only in stock markets.
options.text_hi: यह केवल स्टॉक बाजारों में शेयर खरीदने से संबंधित है।

options.label: C
options.text: It represents a long-term investment in physical assets.
options.text_hi: यह भौतिक संपत्तियों में दीर्घकालिक निवेश का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।

options.label: D
options.text: It allows for quick exit during market risks.
options.text_hi: यह बाजार जोखिमों के दौरान त्वरित निकास की अनुमति देता है।

questions.correct_text: It represents a long-term investment in physical assets.
questions.solution:
Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) involves long-term investment by a foreign entity in physical or productive assets such as factories, infrastructure, technology, or management control in a host country.

The investor usually has lasting interest and control, which makes FDI stable and less volatile compared to FII.

Further Insights:

• FDI brings technology transfer and employment

• FII is more sensitive to market fluctuations

• FDI improves productive capacity of the economy

• Developing countries prefer FDI for economic stability

• India liberalised FDI norms in sectors like defence and insurance

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the SAMBHAV ecosystem:

Statement I: It is an indigenous communication system developed to replace commercial apps like WhatsApp for secure military use.

Statement II: The system operates on 5G technology and features multi-layer encryption to ensure data security for soldiers.

Which of the following is correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें जो SAMBHAV इकोसिस्टम के बारे में हैं:

कथन I: यह एक स्वदेशी संचार प्रणाली है जिसे सुरक्षित सैन्य उपयोग के लिए वॉट्सऐप जैसे व्यावसायिक ऐप्स की जगह लेने के लिए विकसित किया गया है।

कथन II: यह प्रणाली 5G तकनीक पर कार्य करती है और सैनिकों के डेटा सुरक्षा के लिए मल्टी-लेयर एन्क्रिप्शन की विशेषता रखती है।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही है?

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement I and II are correct
options.text_hi: दोनों कथन I और II सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement I nor II is correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I सही है और न ही II सही है

questions.correct_text: Both Statement I and II are correct
questions.solution:
Statement I is correct

The SAMBHAV ecosystem (Secure Army Mobile Bharat Version) is an indigenously developed secure mobile communication ecosystem used by the Indian Army to replace unsecure commercial apps such as WhatsApp for sensitive military communication.

Statement II is correct.

SAMBHAV operates on contemporary 5G technology and uses multi-layered encryption to ensure secure, end-to-end communication for defence personnel.

Further Insights:

• SAMBHAV stands for Secure Army Mobile Bharat Version.

• It includes apps like M-Sigma as secure alternatives to commercial messaging.

• It is network-agnostic, meaning it can operate across different cellular networks.

• SAMBHAV supports secure sharing of documents, images and videos.

• The system aligns with the Atmanirbhar Bharat vision for defence tech.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the schools of ancient Indian art:

Statement I: The Mathura School of art was a purely indigenous development that produced sculptures for Buddhist, Hindu, and Jain religions.

Statement II: The Gandhara School was heavily influenced by Greco-Roman styles and primarily used white marble to depict the life of Buddha.

Which of the following is correct?
questions.question_hi:
प्राचीन भारतीय कला के विद्यालयों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन II: गंधार कला विद्यालय पर ग्रीको-रोमन शैलियों का भारी प्रभाव था और मुख्य रूप से बुद्ध के जीवन को चित्रित करने के लिए सफेद संगमरमर का उपयोग किया गया।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही है?

options.label: C

questions.solution:

The Mathura School of art developed indigenously in India. It produced images of Buddhist, Hindu, and Jain deities, using local traditions, symbols, and themes. This makes Statement I correct.

While the Gandhara School was indeed influenced by Greco-Roman art, it did not primarily use white marble.

Instead, Gandhara sculptures were mostly made from grey schist stone and stucco.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the transition from the 11th Five-Year Plan to the 12th Five-Year Plan in India:

i) The 11th Five-Year Plan focused on "Faster and More Inclusive Growth", while the 12th Five-Year Plan expanded this by adding "Sustainable" to its main theme.

ii) During the 11th Five-Year Plan period, the Right to Education (RTE) Act was enacted, and the Plan aimed to reduce the school dropout rate to about 20%.

iii) The 12th Five-Year Plan fixed a public health spending target of 5% of GDP to bring down the Total Fertility Rate (TFR) to 2.1.

iv)Both the 11th and 12th Five-Year Plans gave importance to agriculture by setting an agricultural growth target of 4%.

Which of the following combinations represents the correct statements?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में 11वें पंचवर्षीय योजना से 12वें पंचवर्षीय योजना के संक्रमण के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) 11वीं पंचवर्षीय योजना "तेजी से और अधिक समावेशी विकास" पर केंद्रित थी, जबकि 12वीं पंचवर्षीय योजना ने अपने मुख्य विषय में "सतत" जोड़कर इसे विस्तारित किया।

ii) 11वीं पंचवर्षीय योजना की अवधि के दौरान, शिक्षा का अधिकार (RTE) अधिनियम पारित किया गया था, और योजना का उद्देश्य स्कूल ड्रॉपआउट दर को लगभग 20% तक कम करना था।

iii) 12वीं पंचवर्षीय योजना ने कुल प्रजनन दर (TFR) को 2.1 तक लाने के लिए सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) का 5% सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य व्यय लक्ष्य निर्धारित किया।

iv) 11वीं और 12वीं दोनों पंचवर्षीय योजनाओं ने कृषि को महत्व दिया और 4% कृषि विकास लक्ष्य निर्धारित किया।

निम्नलिखित संयोजनों में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement i is correct.

The 11th Plan emphasized Faster and More Inclusive Growth.

The 12th Plan upgraded this idea to Faster, Sustainable and More Inclusive Growth.

Statement ii is correct.

The Right to Education Act, 2009 was enacted during the 11th Plan period, and the Plan focused on reducing school dropout rates significantly (around 20%).

Statement iv is correct.

Both Plans recognized agriculture as a priority sector and aimed for an average agricultural growth rate of 4%.

statement iii is incorrect.

The 12th Plan did not set a health spending target of 5% of GDP.

The target was around 2 - 2.5% of GDP, not 5%.

Further Insights:

• Five-Year Plans were prepared by the Planning Commission

• The 12th Plan period was 2012 - 2017

• RTE made education a Fundamental Right (Article 21A)

• Agricultural growth is key for rural income and food security

• The 12th Plan stressed human development and skill formation

questions.question: What does the term 'computer virus' mean?
questions.question_hi: 'कंप्यूटर वायरस' शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?

options.label: A
options.text: A set of instructions or code
options.text_hi: निर्देशों या कोड का एक सेट

options.label: B
options.text_hi: एक कोड जो हार्डवेयर को नियंत्रित करता है

options.label: C
options.text: A software layer between the operating system and hardware
options.text_hi: ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम और हार्डवेयर के बीच एक सॉफ़्टवेयर परत

options.label: D
options.text: A program that manages memory functions
options.text_hi: एक प्रोग्राम जो मेमोरी कार्यों का प्रबंधन करता है

questions.correct_text: A set of instructions or code
questions.solution: Computer virus is a portion of a computer program code that has been designed to furtively copy itself into other such codes or computer files. It is usually created to destroy data and program code or, in the case of ransomware, to extort payment. A virus consists of a set of instructions or code that attaches itself to other computer programs, usually in the computer's operating system, and becomes part of them.

questions.question: What type of storage device uses non-volatile memory chips for data storage?
questions.question_hi: डेटा संग्रहण के लिए गैर-वाष्पशील मेमोरी चिप्स का उपयोग करने वाला संग्रहण उपकरण किस प्रकार का होता है?
questions.solution: Solid State Drives (SSDs) use non-volatile memory chips, typically NAND flash memory, for data storage. Unlike traditional Hard Disk Drives (HDDs) which store data on spinning magnetic disks, SSDs have no moving parts. This makes SSDs faster, more durable, and less susceptible to physical damage compared to HDDs. Optical drives use optical technology to read and write data from optical discs such as CDs and DVDs. Flash drives, also known as USB flash drives or thumb drives, use NAND flash memory for storage and are portable storage devices.

questions.question: Antivirus is used to remove _______software from the computer.

questions.solution: An antivirus product is a program designed to detect and remove viruses and other kinds of malicious software from your computer or laptop. Malicious software - known as malware - is code that can harm your computers and laptops, and the data on them.

questions.question: ________ is a program that acts as an interface between a computer user and computer hardware.

questions.solution: An Operating System (OS) is a program that acts as an interface between a computer user and computer hardware. It performs all the basic tasks and controls the peripheral devices such as disk drives and printers. Examples of operating systems are - Linux (Ubuntu), Windows (Windows XP, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, iOS, Chrome OS, DOS etc.

questions.question: Which memory is used to reduce the average time to access data from the Main memory?
questions.question_hi: मुख्य मेमोरी से डेटा को एक्सेस करने के लिए लगने वाले औसत समय को कम करने के लिए किस मेमोरी का प्रयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution: Cache memory is an extremely fast memory type that acts as a buffer between RAM and the CPU. It holds frequently requested data and instructions so that they are immediately available to the CPU when needed. Cache memory is used to reduce the average time to access data from the Main memory. Cache memory is costlier than main memory or disk memory. There are various different independent caches in a CPU, which store instructions and data.

questions.question: Which 16-bit register in the Intel 8085 microprocessor stores the address of the next instruction to be executed?
questions.question_hi: इंटेल 8085 माइक्रोप्रोसेसर में कौन सा 16-बिट रजिस्टर अगले निष्पादित होने वाले निर्देश का पता संग्रहीत करता है?
questions.solution:
The Program Counter (PC) is a 16-bit register in the Intel 8085 that stores the memory address of the next instruction to be fetched and executed by the CPU.

After each instruction fetch, the PC is automatically updated to point to the next instruction.

Further Insights:

• The Program Counter is essential for sequential execution

• 8085 has a 16-bit address bus, allowing access to 64 KB memory

• PC works closely with the Instruction Register (IR)

• Jump and call instructions modify the PC directly

• Stack operations use a different 16-bit register: the Stack Pointer (SP)

questions.question: In Microsoft Excel, which function is used to replace error codes like #N/A or #DIV/0! with a custom text or a zero?

questions.solution:

questions.question: What is called for the set of rules for transferring files on the World Wide Web (WWW)?

questions.solution: HTTP means Hyper Text Transfer protocol .HTTP is the underlying protocol used by the World Wide Web and this protocol defines how messages are formatted and transmitted, and what actions Web servers and browsers should take in response to various commands. For example, entering a URL in the browser- this actually sends an HTTP command to the Web server directing it to fetch and transmit the requested Web page. The other main standard that controls how the World Wide Web works is HTML, which covers how Web pages are formatted and displayed.
