questions.question: What type of error does the compiler show if illegal operations are performed in a program?
questions.question_hi: यदि किसी प्रोग्राम में अवैध संचालन किए जाते हैं तो कंपाइलर किस प्रकार की त्रुटि दिखाता है?
questions.solution:
Syntax Error When the rules of the programming language are not followed, the compiler will show syntax error.

Semantic Error: Semantic errors are reported by the compiler when the statements written in the program are not meaningful to the compiler.

Logical Error: Logical errors are those errors that occur in the output of the program. The presence of logical errors leads to undesired or incorrect output.

Runtime Error: Runtime errors are those errors that occur during the execution of a program. It generally occurs due to some illegal operation performed in the program.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding email protocols:

Statement I: SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) is primarily used for sending or "pushing" an email from a client to a server.

Statement II: POP3 (Post Office Protocol) is a modern protocol that keeps a copy of the email on the server, allowing for synchronization across multiple devices.

Which of the following is correct?
questions.question_hi:
ईमेल प्रोटोकॉल के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: SMTP (सिंपल मेल ट्रांसफर प्रोटोकॉल) मुख्य रूप से क्लाइंट से सर्वर को ईमेल भेजने या "पुश" करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।

कथन II: POP3 (पोस्ट ऑफिस प्रोटोकॉल) एक आधुनिक प्रोटोकॉल है जो सर्वर पर ईमेल की एक प्रति रखता है, जिससे कई उपकरणों के बीच सिंक्रनाइज़ेशन की अनुमति मिलती है।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही है?

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement I and II are correct
options.text_hi: दोनों कथन I और II सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement I nor II is correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I सही है और न ही II सही है

questions.solution:
Statement I is Correct

SMTP is used to send emails - from an email client to the mail server and between mail servers. It "pushes" messages out.

Statement II is Incorrect

POP3 is not a modern sync protocol. It typically downloads emails to a single device and often removes them from the server, which does not support synchronization across multiple devices.

(That syncing behavior is a feature of IMAP, not POP3.)

Further Insights:

• IMAP keeps emails on the server and syncs across devices

• SMTP works with ports 25, 465, and 587

• POP3 commonly uses port 110 (995 with SSL)

• Modern email services prefer IMAP + SMTP

• Protocol choice affects access, storage, and syncing

questions.question: Which of the following is used to filter data in a form in Microsoft Access?
questions.question_hi: माइक्रोसॉफ्ट एक्सेस में एक फॉर्म में डेटा को फिल्टर करने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से किसका उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution:
Filtering data in a form is a common operation in Microsoft Access. It allows users to limit the records displayed in a form to a subset of the data that meets certain criteria.

To filter data in a form, you can use the Filter by Selection option. This allows you to select a value in a field and then apply a filter to show only records that have the same value. For example, you could select a customer name in a customer form and filter the records to show only orders from that customer.

Filter by Query is another option to filter data in a form. It allows you to create a custom query that specifies the filtering criteria and then apply the query to the form to display the filtered records.

Filter by Form is a mode that allows users to apply complex filters to a form by entering values in a set of filter fields. This mode provides a more flexible way to filter data by allowing users to specify multiple criteria using a combination of logical operators.

Filter by Time is not an option for filtering data in a form in Microsoft Access.

questions.question: Which file extension is typically associated with Windows sound files?

questions.question: In the four-layer architecture of an IoT surveillance system, which layer is responsible for the actual sensing of data through cameras and motion detectors?
questions.question_hi: आईओटी निगरानी प्रणाली की चार-परत वास्तुकला में, कौन सी परत कैमरों और गति डिटेक्टरों के माध्यम से वास्तविक डेटा संवेदन के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
questions.solution:
The Perception Layer is the physical sensing layer of an IoT system.

It includes sensors and actuators such as cameras, motion detectors, temperature sensors, and RFID tags that collect raw data from the environment.

Further Insights:

• IoT architecture often follows Perception → Network → Middleware → Application

• The Network Layer uses Wi-Fi, LTE, or 5G

• Middleware handles data storage and processing

• Application Layer supports monitoring and alerts

• Security is crucial at the Perception Layer to prevent data tampering

questions.question: The base of a prism is a square of side 6 cm. If the lateral surface area of the prism is 180 cm², then the difference between the height of the prism and the side of the square is:
questions.question_hi: एक प्रिज्म का आधार 6 सेमी की भुजा वाला वर्ग है। यदि प्रिज्म का पार्श्व पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 180 सेमी² है, तो प्रिज्म की ऊँचाई और वर्ग की भुजा के बीच का अंतर है:
questions.solution:
Perimeter = 4 * 6 = 24 cm.

Lateral surface area = perimeter·height = 24 * h = 180

=> h = 180/24 = 7.5 cm.

Difference = h − side

= 7.5 − 6

= 1.5 cm.

questions.question: Tanya can do a piece of work in 18 days. Tanya and Prateek complete the work together and were paid Rs 68 and Rs 102 respectively based on their works done. How many days must they have taken to complete the work together?
questions.question_hi: तान्या एक कार्य के भाग को 18 दिनों में कर सकती है। तान्या और प्रतीक ने एक साथ कार्य पूरा किया और उनके किये गए कार्य के आधार पर उन्हें क्रमशः 68 और 102 रुपये का भुगतान किया गया, तो कार्य को एक साथ पूरा करने के लिए उन्होंने कितने दिन लिए होंगे?
questions.solution:
The ratio of money given to Tanya and Prateek is 2:3.

Their work done would also be in the same ratio. Thus, their time will be 3:2 (inverse of 2:3).

So, if Tanya takes 18 days Prateek would take 12 days to complete the work.

Therefore, the number of days required would be (1/18 + 1/12)t = 1 i.e., t = 36/5 = 7.2 days

In a triangle ABC, AB is extended to E such that ∠CBE = 130°. If 6∠A = 7∠C, find the value of ∠A.
questions.question_hi: एक त्रिभुज ABC में, AB को E तक इस प्रकार बढ़ाया गया कि ∠CBE = 1300 है। यदि 6∠A = 7∠C है, तो ∠A का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
6∠A = 7∠C

∠A : ∠C = 1/6 : 1/7 = 7:6

∠A + ∠C = 130° [ An exterior angle of a triangle is equal to the sum of the two opposite interior angles]

∠A = 7/(7 + 6) x 130°

=> ∠A = 7/13 x 130°

=> ∠A = 70°

questions.question: The angle of elevation from the top of a pole to the top of a tower is 45˚ and the angle of elevation of the top of the pole from the foot of a tower is 60˚ . The height of the pole is 50m. Find the height of the tower.
questions.question_hi: एक खम्भे के शीर्ष से एक मीनार के शीर्ष तक का उन्नयन कोण 45˚ है तथा मीनार के आधार से खम्भे के शीर्ष का उन्नयन कोण 60˚ है। खम्भे की ऊँचाई 50m है, तो मीनार की ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिये।
questions.solution:
In ∆CDE-

tan60˚ = DE/CD

√3 = 50/CD

CD = 50/√3 m

BE = 50/√3 m

In ∆ABE-

tan45˚ = AB/BE

1 = AB/BE

AB = BE = 50/√3 m

AC = 50 + 50/√3

= 50(√3+1)/√3m

questions.question: A cylindrical tank of radius 7 m is partially filled with water up to a height of 10 m. N solid spherical metal balls of radius 3.5 m is dropped into the tank and gets completely submerged. If the rise in the water level in the tank is 3.5 m, then find the curved surface area of 'N + 3' spherical metal balls.
questions.question_hi: एक बेलनाकार टैंक जिसकी त्रिज्या 7 मीटर है, आंशिक रूप से पानी से भरा हुआ है जिसकी ऊंचाई 10 मीटर है। त्रिज्या 3.5 मीटर के N ठोस गोलाकार धातु के गोले टैंक में डाले जाते हैं और पूरी तरह से डूब जाते हैं। यदि टैंक में पानी का स्तर 3.5 मीटर बढ़ जाता है, तो 'N + 3' गोलाकार धातु के गोलों का घुमावदार सतह क्षेत्र ज्ञात करें।
questions.solution:
Radius of cylinder = 7 m

Volume displaced = Volume of N spherical balls

Π * 72 * 3.5 = N * 4/3 * π * 3.53

1 = N * 4/3 * 0.52

N = 3

Curved surface area of 'N + 3' spherical metal balls =>

= (3 + 3) * 4 * 22/7 * 3.52

= 924 m2

questions.question: Nishu bought an earphone for Rs.1200. He sells it at after allowing two successive discounts of 8% and 20% on the cost price respectively. Find his loss.
questions.question_hi: नीशु ने एक ईयरफोन रु.1200 में खरीदा। वह क्रय मूल्य पर क्रमशः 8% और 20% की दो क्रमिक छूट देने के बाद इसे बेचता है। उसके द्वारा प्राप्त किए गए हानि को ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Cost price of earphone = Rs.1200

Selling price of earphone after two successive discounts of 8% and 20% respectively = 1200 * (92/100) * (80/100)

= 48 * 92/5 = Rs.883.2

Loss = CP - SP = 1200 - 883.2 = Rs.316.8

questions.question: A solid metal sphere of radius 8 cm is melted and recast into smaller spheres, each of radius 2 cm. How many smaller spheres are formed?
questions.question_hi: 8 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले एक ठोस धातु के गोले को पिघलाकर छोटे गोले बनाए जाते हैं, जिनमें से प्रत्येक का त्रिज्या 2 सेमी होता है। कितने छोटे गोले बनाए जाते हैं?
questions.solution:
Volume of a sphere = (4/3) X π X r3

Let, the number of smaller spheres be n

Volume of original sphere = n X volume of one smaller sphere

(4/3) X π X 83 = n X (4/3) X π X 23

=> 83 = n X 23

=> 512 = 8n

=> n = 64

questions.question: In ∆KLM, point A is an incentre of the triangle and AB is perpendicular LM. If ∠LAB = 56°, then what is the value of ∠KLM?
questions.question_hi: ∆KLM में, बिंदु A त्रिभुज का अंतःकेंद्र है और AB लंबवत LM है। यदि ∠LAB = 56° है, तो ∠KLM का मान कितना है?
questions.solution:
According to the question,

Since point A is an incentre of the triangle. So, AL and AM are angle bisector.

Thus, in ∆LAB,

∠LAB + ∠ABL + ∠BLA = 180°

=> 56 + 90 + ∠BLA = 180°

=> ∠BLA = 34°

Hence, ∠KLM = 34 * 2 = 68°

9: 10

questions.question: The average mark obtained by 43 students in a class is 68. If the eight lowest marks are removed, the average is increased by 4 marks. Find the average marks of the eight lowest marks scored by students.
questions.question_hi: एक कक्षा में 43 विद्यार्थियों को प्राप्त औसत अंक 68 है। यदि आठ सबसे कम अंक हटा दिए जाते हैं, तो औसत में 4 अंक की वृद्धि होती है। विद्यार्थियों को प्राप्त आठ सबसे कम अंकों के औसत अंक ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
The total marks of 43 students = 43 * 68 = 2924

The total marks of 35 students = 35 * (68 + 4) = 2520

The average marks of 8 lowest marks scored by students = 404/8 = 50.5

questions.question: If X, Y, and Z are the numbers of vertices, edges, and faces of a right prism with a regular heptagonal base, what is the value of 3(X − Z) + Y?
questions.question_hi: यदि X, Y, और Z एक समकोणीय प्रिज्म के शीर्षों, भुजाओं, और मुखों की संख्या हैं जिसका आधार एक नियमित सप्तकोण है, तो 3(X − Z) + Y का मान क्या है?
questions.solution:
For a heptagonal prism:

Vertices, X = 2 X 7 = 14

Edges, Y = 7 (base) + 7 (top) + 7 (lateral) = 21

Faces, Z = 7 (lateral) + 2 = 9

Hence, 3(X − Z) + Y = 3(14 − 9) + 21 = 36

questions.question: A square park has a side of 28 m. Inside the park, there is a rectangular walking path in the centre having length 20 m. Also, two identical circular sprinklers are installed at two opposite corners of the park, each watering a circular region of radius 7 m. If the area of the park that remains dry (i.e., not covered by the walking path or the sprinkler regions) is 316 m2, then find the breadth of the walking path.
questions.question_hi: एक वर्गाकार पार्क की एक भुजा 28 मीटर है। पार्क के अंदर, केंद्र में एक आयताकार चलने का रास्ता है जिसकी लंबाई 20 मीटर है। साथ ही, पार्क के दो विपरीत कोनों पर दो समान वृत्ताकार स्प्रिंकलर लगाए गए हैं, जो प्रत्येक 7 मीटर त्रिज्या वाले वृत्तीय क्षेत्र को पानी देते हैं। यदि पार्क का वह क्षेत्र जो सूखा रहता है (अर्थात्, जो चलने के रास्ते या स्प्रिंकलर क्षेत्रों से कवर नहीं होता) 316 वर्ग मीटर है, तो चलने के रास्ते की चौड़ाई ज्ञात करें।
questions.solution:
Let the width of the path = X m

Length of path = 20 m

Side of square park = 28 m

Radius of circle = 7 m

Area of the park that remains dry = 316 m2

Area of square park - area of rectangle - Area of two circles = 316

28 * 28 - 20X - 2 * 22/7 * 7 * 7 = 316

784 - 20X - 308 = 316

20X = 160

X = 8 m

So, the breadth of the walking path = 8 m

questions.question:
In a certain code language, 'Shark Dolphin Seal' is coded as '5!1 5*4 5#2', 'Dolphin Octopus Lobster' is coded as '5&6 5%8 5*4' and 'Seal Lobster Crocodile' is coded as '5#2 5^9 5%8'. Which of the following statement/s is/are true?

I. The code for 'Shark' is '5!1'.

II. The code for 'Octopus' is '5&6'.

III. The code for 'Crocodile' is '5^9'.
questions.question_hi:
एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में, 'Shark Dolphin Seal' को '5!1 5*4 5#2' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है, 'Dolphin Octopus Lobster' को '5&6 5%8 5*4' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है और 'Seal Lobster Crocodile' को '5#2 5^9 5%8' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

I. 'Shark' का कोड '5!1' है।

II. 'Octopus' का कोड '5&6' है।

III. 'Crocodile' का कोड '5^9' है।
questions.solution:
In a certain code language,

'Shark Dolphin Seal' is coded as '5!1 5*4 5#2',

'Dolphin Octopus Lobster' is coded as '5&6 5%8 5*4'

'Seal Lobster Crocodile' is coded as '5#2 5^9 5%8'

The code for 'Dolphin' = 5*4

The code for 'Seal' = 5#2

The code for 'Lobster' = 5%8

Thus,

questions.question:
You are given a question and two statements. Identify which statement(s) alone or together are sufficient to answer the question.

Question: Three positive integers add up to 12. How many of them are even?

Statements:

I. Exactly two of the numbers are odd.

II. One of the numbers is 3.
questions.question_hi:
आपको एक सवाल और दो स्टेटमेंट दिए गए हैं। पहचानें कि कौन सा स्टेटमेंट अकेले या दोनों मिलकर सवाल का जवाब देने के लिए काफी हैं।

सवाल: तीन पॉजिटिव इंटीजर का जोड़ 12 है। उनमें से कितने सम संख्याएँ हैं?

स्टेटमेंट:

I. संख्याओं में से ठीक दो विषम संख्याएँ हैं।

II. संख्याओं में से एक 3 है।

options.label: B
options.text_hi: केवल कथन II ही पर्याप्त है

options.label: C
options.text: Statements I and II together are sufficient
options.text_hi: कथन 1 और 2 दोनों ही पर्याप्त हैं।

options.label: D
options.text: Neither statement I nor II is sufficient
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I और न ही कथन II पर्याप्त है

questions.solution:
From Statement I alone:

Exactly two of the numbers are odd.

If two numbers are odd, the third number must be even.

Odd + odd = even

Even + even = even

Since the total sum is 12 (even), this condition is satisfied.

Hence, the number of even integers is fixed as 1.

So, Statement I alone is sufficient.

From Statement II alone:

One of the numbers is 3.

3 is odd.

Remaining sum = 12 − 3 = 9

Possible pairs for 9:

1 and 8

2 and 7

4 and 5

In these cases, the count of even numbers is not uniquely determined.

Hence, the question cannot be answered definitively.

So, Statement II alone is not sufficient.

questions.question:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement is true, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statement.

Statement:

The new government policy aims to reduce carbon emissions by 50% within the next decade.

Conclusions:

I. The government will ban all the vehicles that run on fossil fuel immediately.

II. The government will shut down all the coal-fired power plants.
questions.question_hi:
दिये गये कथन और निष्कर्ष को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िये। कथन में दी गई जानकारी को सत्य मानते हुए, निर्धारित कीजिये कि दिये गये निष्कर्षों में से कौन-सा/से निष्कर्ष दिये गये कथन का तार्किक रूप से अनुसरण करता/करते है/हैं।

कथन:

सरकार की नई नीति का लक्ष्य अगले दशक के भीतर कार्बन उत्सर्जन में 50% तक की कमी करना है।

निष्कर्ष:

I. सरकार जीवाश्म ईंधन से चलने वाले सभी वाहनों पर अतिशीघ्र प्रतिबंध लगाएगी।

II. सरकार कोयले से चलने वाले सभी विद्युत संयंत्रों को बंद कर देगी।

options.label: A
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है

options.label: B
options.text: Both Conclusion I and Conclusion II follow
options.text_hi: निष्कर्ष I और निष्कर्ष II दोनों अनुसरण करते हैं

options.label: C
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष II अनुसरण करता है

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Conclusion I nor Conclusion II follows
options.text_hi: न तो निष्कर्ष I और न ही निष्कर्ष II अनुसरण करता है

questions.correct_text: Neither Conclusion I nor Conclusion II follows
questions.solution:
The given statement mentions a new government policy targeting a 50% reduction in carbon emissions within the next decade.

Let's reevaluate the conclusions:

I. The government will ban all vehicles running on fossil fuel immediately.

This conclusion cannot be logically inferred from the given statement. While the policy aims to reduce carbon emissions, it does not explicitly state an immediate ban on all fossil fuel-based vehicles. The policy may involve a phased approach, incentives for electric vehicles, or other measures to achieve the emission reduction goal.

II. The government will shut down all coal-fired power plants.

Similarly, this conclusion does not necessarily follow from the statement. While the policy aims to reduce carbon emissions, it does not directly indicate the immediate closure of all coal-fired power plants. The government could consider various strategies to achieve emission reductions, which might involve cleaner technologies, energy diversification, or gradual phase-outs.

Hence, neither Conclusion I nor Conclusion II follows.

questions.solution:
Mirror letters follow A -> Z, B -> Y, C -> X, ..

Right 1st letter = mirror of the 1st left letter

Right 2nd letter = mirror of the 2nd left letter − 2

Option (1): CU - XD

C → X

U → F

F − 2 = D

Option (2): MJ - NO

M → N

J → Q

Q − 2 = O

Option (3): PE - KT

P → K

E → V

V − 2 = T

Option (4): HR - SF

H → S

R → I

I − 2 = G (Rule NOT satisfied.)

So, option D is the odd one out.

questions.question:
A question is given, followed by two statements numbered (I) and (II). You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements is sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and select the appropriate answer.

Seven persons- P, Q, R, S, T, U and V live in a seven-storeyed building but not necessarily in the same order. The bottommost floor is 1 above that 2 and so on. Only one person lives on each floor. Who among the following lives on the bottommost floor?

Statement I: Two floors are between R and T. R lives above T and U. T lives immediately above S and immediately below P. U lives above Q and below V.

Statement II: Three floors are between R and S. P lives immediately below U and immediately above T. Only one floor is below S. T lives above Q.
questions.question_hi:
एक प्रश्न दिया गया है, जिसके बाद दो कथन क्रमांकित (I) और (II) हैं। आपको यह निर्णय लेना है कि कथनों में दी गई जानकारी प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है या नहीं। दोनों कथनों को पढ़ें और उपयुक्त उत्तर चुनें।

सात व्यक्ति- P, Q, R, S, T, U और V एक सात मंजिला इमारत में रहते हैं लेकिन जरूरी नहीं कि उसी क्रम में। सबसे निचली मंजिल 1 है, उसके ऊपर 2 है और इसी तरह। प्रत्येक मंजिल पर केवल एक व्यक्ति रहता है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सबसे निचली मंजिल पर रहता है?

कथन I: R और T के बीच दो मंजिलें हैं। R, T और U के ऊपर रहता है। T, S के ठीक ऊपर और P के ठीक नीचे रहता है। U, Q के ऊपर और V के नीचे रहता है।

कथन II: R और S के बीच तीन मंजिलें हैं। P, U के ठीक नीचे और T के ठीक ऊपर रहता है। S के नीचे केवल एक मंजिल है। T, Q के ऊपर रहता है।

options.label: A

questions.question:
Examine the following inequality and choose the conclusion(s) that follow:

A < B ≤ C = D < E

Conclusions:

I. A < D

II. C < E
questions.question_hi:
निम्न असमानता की जांच करें और उन निष्कर्षों का चयन करें जो निकलते हैं:

A < B ≤ C = D < E

निष्कर्ष:

I. A < D

II. C < E

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो निष्कर्ष I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Given statement: A < B ≤ C = D < E

A < B ≤ C = D

A < D. So, Conclusion I is true.

C = D < E

C < E. So, Conclusion II is true.

Hence, both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.question:
In the following question, two statements are given and two conclusions are given below these statements. Choose the option which shows the conclusions which logically follow the given statements, disregarding the commonly known facts.

Statements:

All Pens are Objects

Only a few Pens are Blue

Conclusions:

I. All Pens are Blue

II. No Objects are Pens
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में, दो कथन दिए गए हैं और इन कथनों के नीचे दो निष्कर्ष दिए गए हैं। उस विकल्प को चुनें जो दिए गए कथनों से तार्किक रूप से निष्कर्षों को दर्शाता है, सामान्यतः ज्ञात तथ्यों की परवाह किए बिना।

कथन:

सभी पेन वस्तुएं हैं

केवल कुछ पेन नीले हैं

निष्कर्ष:

I. सभी पेन नीले हैं

II। कोई वस्तु पेन नहीं है

options.label: A
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है

options.label: B
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष II अनुसरण करता है

options.label: C
options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
options.text_hi: दोनों निष्कर्ष I और II अनुसरण करते हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
options.text_hi: न तो निष्कर्ष I और न ही II अनुसरण करता है

questions.correct_text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
questions.solution:
Statements:

All Pens are Objects

Only a few Pens are Blue

All Pens are Blue: Only a few Pens are Blue means some Pens are Blue and some Pens are not Blue. So, conclusion I is false.

No Objects are Pens: All Pens are Objects. Thus, some Objects are definitely Pens. So, conclusion II is false.

Hence, neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows.

Study the information carefully and answer the following question.

'A # B' means 'A is the sister of B but B is not sister of A'

'A % B' means 'A is the father-in-law of B'

'A $ B' means 'A is the child of B'

'A % B' का अर्थ है 'A, B का ससुर है'

यदि 'R & G # M $ K % P # N' है, तो कौन-सा/से विकल्प सही है/हैं?

options.label: A
options.text: R is the father of N

options.label: B
options.text: R is the father-in-law of K

options.label: D
options.text: M is the sister-in-law of N

questions.correct_text: R is the father-in-law of K
questions.solution:
It is given that:

'A # B' means 'A is the sister of B but B is not sister of A'

'A % B' means 'A is the father-in-law of B'

'A $ B' means 'A is the child of B'

'A & B' means 'A is the maternal grandfather of B'

After decoding the expression, 'R & G # M $ K % P # N' we get:

R is the maternal grandfather of G.

G is the sister of M but M is not sister of G.

M is the child of K.

K is the father-in-law of P.

P is the sister of N but N is not sister of P.

Only option (b) is correct.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

He says to me, "You will not have to worry about all that."

options.label: A
options.text: He told me that I would not have to worry about all that.

options.label: B
options.text: He tells me that I would not have to worry about all that.

options.label: C
options.text: He says to me that I am not worried about all that.

options.label: D
options.text: He tells me that I will not have to worry about all that.

questions.correct_text: He tells me that I will not have to worry about all that.
questions.solution:
When the reporting verb in Direct Speech is in Present Tense or Future Tense, there is no change in the tense in the Indirect Speech. Though, the pronouns will change accordingly.

For Example:

Arnab says, "I want to be the best English teacher in India." (Direct Speech)

Arnab says that he wants to be the best English teacher in India. (Indirect Speech)

Subham will say, "Kaustav is always late." (Direct Speech)

Subham will say that Kaustav is always late. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

· The reporting verb 'says' is changed into 'tells'.

· The pronoun 'you' is changed into 'I'.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (d): He tells me that I will not have to worry about all that.

questions.question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the passage is split into four parts - P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

1) Lifelong learning has become increasingly important in the modern world.

P. Consequently, individuals must regularly update their knowledge and skills.

Q. Rapid technological advancements constantly reshape the demands of the workplace.

R. Workers who adapt to these changes remain competitive in their professions.

S. Educational institutions and organisations therefore promote continuous learning opportunities.

6) Such efforts help individuals remain relevant in a changing environment.
questions.solution: The passage begins with the importance of lifelong learning. Q logically follows because it introduces technological changes affecting workplaces. R then explains that workers who adapt to these changes remain competitive. P presents the consequence that individuals must continually update their knowledge and skills. S concludes by stating that institutions promote continuous learning opportunities. Thus, the correct sequence is QRPS. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Sergeant Frank Spike sat behind his desk and stared out of the window.

B. He is not happy as the retirement package was barely enough money to take a short holiday.

C. Outside, a steady stream of traffic passed by, each car moving slowly in the cold, grey rain.

D. This was his final month before he retired from the police.
questions.solution: Sentence A comes first as it introduces us to the main subject of the passage (Sergeant Frank Spike). C follows A as it talks about the things he saw when he stared out of the window. So, AC is a pair. Sentence D states that he is going to retire soon and B follows D as it states that he is not happy with the retirement package. Therefore, ACDB becomes the correct order among the given options. Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Micro, small and medium enterprises (MSME) account for over 99% of India's businesses.

B. MSMEs are the largest employer in India outside of agriculture, employing over 11.1 crore people, or 45% of all workers.

C. Every year on June 27, World MSME Day provides us with the opportunity to appreciate their valuable contributions.

D. Yet, these businesses are the ones that have faced the harshest of environments over the last few years.
questions.solution: Sentence A comes first as it introduces the main subject of the passage 'Micro, small and medium enterprises'. AB is a pair as it talks about the importance of MSME in the business sector. Sentence C states that World MSME Day provides us with the opportunity to appreciate their valuable contributions. Sentence D states that D in spite of all these contributions MSMEs are the ones that have faced the harshest of environments. Therefore, ABCD becomes the correct order among the given options. Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

Sunrise Foods, just a few blocks from my house, is marked by a glossy freestanding sign, a cheery egg-yolk yellow against an often grey, wintering Toronto sky. Back in December, just before I turned 14, Tracey recruited a bunch of us from the school lunch table to work here in her uncle's new bagel and smoked fish store. Now, six months on, all my peers are gone. But I have learned to tell whitefish chubs with their oily, golden hue from goldeye that wrinkles away from the skin. I've learned how to sheath my arm in a plastic bag and plunge it into a barrel of gutted herring, floating in their vegetable oil pond. How to act like I wasn't afraid to touch the fish until I wasn't afraid to touch the fish.

At the barrel I re-tie my white apron over the green Roots Athletics T-shirt I bought with my first paycheck, protecting it from oil splashes that never wash out. My dirty-blonde waves are pinned on top of my head with a clip of faux pearls. A berry-scented hair spray from a purple bottle helps disguise the fish smell. I'd had an argument with my mother just before I was hired at Sunrise. She was annoyed that the sleeves of my winter coat no longer reached my wrists, that I was yanking my shirt sleeves down to my mittens to cover the gap. My growing body and its expense had slipped her mind. I had to agree to chip in my birthday money, but I got to choose the store and the new coat. Then it hit me: birthday cards only come once a year. I really needed a job.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

The mother said to his son, "May God shine His light on you"

options.label: A
options.text: The mother wished his son that he might shine His light on God.

options.label: B
options.text: The mother wished his son that God shines His light on him.

options.label: C
options.text: The mother wished his son that God might shine His light on him.

options.label: D
options.text: Shine light on my son wished by His mother.

questions.correct_text: The mother wished his son that God might shine His light on him.
questions.solution:
These kinds of sentences are called Optative Sentences.

Optative Sentences are usually prayers or wishes.

In these kinds of sentences, "said" in the Direct Speech is changed into "prayed", "wished", etc.

"That" is used in place of Inverted Commas while transforming the sentence from Direct Speech to Indirect Speech.

While changing from Direct Speech to Indirect Speech, the sentence is changed into its Assertive form i.e., "Subject + might/may + V1 + Object".

For example:

The father said to his son, "May God bless you!"

The father wished his son that God might bless him.

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

· The reporting verb 'said to' is changed into 'wished'.

· 'May' is changed into 'might'.

· The pronoun 'you' is changed into 'him'.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (c): The mother wished his son that God might shine His light on him.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes the tone of the passage?
questions.solution: The passage presents a balanced explanation of two internet technologies: Wi-Fi connected through fibre broadband and Air Fibre. It discusses their advantages, limitations, and practical applications without expressing strong personal opinions or emotional language. The discussion focuses on objective comparison in terms of speed, stability, infrastructure, and accessibility. Therefore, the tone of the passage is analytical and explanatory. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.
questions.passage:
Directions : Read the passage and answer the questions:

In the ever expanding age of digital connectivity, both Wi-Fi and Air Fibre have emerged as prominent solutions for delivering internet access to homes and businesses. Wi-Fi typically refers to a wireless network created through a broadband connection such as fibre or cable, allowing multiple devices within a limited area to connect to the internet without physical cables. Air Fibre, on the other hand, delivers broadband through radio signals transmitted between towers and receivers installed at the user's premises. The growing demand for high-speed internet has led many consumers to compare these technologies not only in terms of speed but also reliability, accessibility, and cost.

One of the main advantages of Wi-Fi connected through fibre broadband is stability. Since the primary data transmission occurs through underground or optical fibre cables, the connection is generally less affected by weather conditions or signal interference. Fibre-based networks are capable of providing extremely high speeds and consistent performance, making them suitable for activities such as streaming, online gaming, and remote work. However, the limitation lies in infrastructure availability. Fibre cables must be physically installed in a particular area, and in many remote or newly developed regions, this infrastructure may not yet exist.

Air Fibre attempts to overcome this limitation by using wireless transmission from nearby communication towers. Because it does not rely on extensive underground cabling, it can often be deployed more quickly and can bring internet access to areas where fibre installation would be expensive or slow. This makes it particularly useful in semi-urban or rural locations. Nevertheless, Air Fibre connections may sometimes experience fluctuations in speed due to environmental factors such as heavy rain, obstacles between towers, or network congestion. Ultimately, the comparison between Wi-Fi through fibre and Air Fibre reflects a trade-off between stability and flexibility. Fibre-based Wi-Fi offers highly reliable and consistent performance where infrastructure is available, while Air Fibre provides broader accessibility and faster deployment in underserved areas.

Therefore, the limitation mentioned in the passage is the need for installed fibre infrastructure. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

The other options are not suitable homophones of 'bear', which means to endure or carry something or to give birth to something. 'Beer' means an alcoholic drink made from malted grain, 'bier' means a movable frame on which a coffin or corpse is placed, and 'pier' means a structure projecting into a body of water.

questions.question:
Complete the following collocation.

They had a ______ discussion about the company's future strategies.
questions.solution:
The phrase "deep discussion" is a strong collocation, meaning a serious and in-depth conversation about a topic.

Deep discussion - Correct, as it means a thoughtful and thorough discussion about the company's future strategies.

Heavy discussion - Incorrect, as "heavy" is not commonly used with "discussion" in this context.

Narrow discussion - Incorrect, as "narrow" suggests a limited focus rather than an in-depth conversation.

Thin discussion - Incorrect, as "thin" means lacking substance, which contradicts the idea of strategic planning.

Thus, the correct answer is "deep."

So, the complete sentence is: They had a deep discussion about the company's future strategies.

Hence, option (d) is the answer.

questions.question: What is the synonym of "Obdurate"?
questions.solution: Obdurate means "stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or course of action." The closest meaning should therefore indicate firmness or stubborn resistance. Intransigent means "unwilling to change one's views or agree about something," which closely matches the meaning of obdurate. The other options do not express this meaning: compliant means willing to follow rules or requests, amenable means open to suggestion or persuasion, and malleable means easily influenced or shaped. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Bring me my Cuban cigars.

options.label: A
options.text: Let my Cuban cigars be bought to me.

options.label: B
options.text: Let my Cuban cigars be brought to me.

options.label: C
options.text: It is requested that you bring me my Cuban cigars.

options.label: D
options.text: Cuban cigars should be brought to me.

questions.correct_text: Let my Cuban cigars be brought to me.
questions.solution:
·The correct answer is (b) Let my Cuban cigars be brought to me.

·The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive Voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

·The usage of a helping verb is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

·The question in Active voice is in the imperative form.

·An imperative sentence is used to express order, suggestion, request, etc.

·They begin with a principal verb.

·Here, the imperative sentence in Active voice is an order.

·The format in Active voice is: V1 + Object.

·Thus, the format in Passive voice will be: Let + Subject (Objective case) + be + V3.

·For example:

o Start the match. (Active)

o Let the match be started. (Passive)

·The options except (b) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.

·Therefore, the correct answer is:Let my Cuban cigars be brought to me.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

Eisha said to the waiter, "Where is the restroom?"

options.label: A
options.text: Eisha asked the waiter where the restroom was being.

options.label: B
options.text: Eisha asked from the waiter where the restroom had been.

options.label: C
options.text: Eisha asked the waiter where the restroom was.

options.label: D
options.text: Eisha asked the waiter where the restroom is.

questions.correct_text: Eisha asked the waiter where the restroom was.
questions.solution:
In the case of Interrogative sentences like this, "said" in Direct Speech is changed into "enquired (of)", "wanted to know", "asked", etc.

In Indirect speech, the verb is always placed after the subject, unlike in Direct Speech.

When changing these types of sentences from Direct Speech to Indirect Speech, "Who" becomes "Whom".

For example:

Ravi said to me, "Who have you visited in the afternoon?" (Direct Speech)

Ravi asked me whom I had visited this afternoon. (Indirect Speech)

Also, the sentence in the Direct Speech is in the present indefinite tense. So, the tense in the Indirect Speech should be in the past indefinite tense.

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

· The verb 'Is' changes to 'was'.

· The reporting verb 'Said to' changes to 'asked'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: (c).

Option b) is eliminated as the word 'meeting' would be more suitable when referring to a person, not an animal.

Option d) is eliminated as the plural word 'fights' cannot fit in after singular qualifier(s) 'a/an'.

questions.solution:
The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive Voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

The usage of a "to be" form of verb ["is" in this case] is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

In Passive Voice, the preposition "by" is used before the object. However, it is optional in some cases.

The Active voice in this question is in the Present Indefinite, as indicated by the verb "checks". Thus, the Passive voice will also be in the Present Indefinite.

The format of the Active voice is: Subject + V1/V5 + Object.

Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be: Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + am/is/are + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).

For example:

Active: She writes letters.

Passive: Letters are written by her.

The correct grammatical structure is shown in option (a).

Therefore, the correct answer is: (a).

questions.question: The figure of speech used in "We must all hang together, or, most assuredly, we shall all hang separately"?
questions.solution:
A pun is a form of wordplay that exploits the different possible meanings of a word or the fact that there are words that sound alike but have different meanings.

This quote by Benjamin Franklin uses a pun on the word "hang":

"hang together": To stay united, to stick together as a group.

"hang separately": To be executed by hanging, one by one.

The statement's power comes from this clever play on words, delivering a grim warning with wit.

Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.

Option a): A paradox is a self-contradictory statement. This statement is a logical warning, not a contradiction.

Option b): Antithesis contrasts two ideas ("hang together" vs. "hang separately"), but the core device that makes the line work is the dual meaning of the word "hang," which is a pun.

Option d): An oxymoron is a combination of two contradictory words (e.g., "sweet sorrow").

questions.question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

If the firefighters had come in time, the boy could have been save.
questions.solution:
'Could + have' is used for the past ability while indicating that the action did not take place. It is followed by a participle form of a verb. So, 'save' will be replaced with 'saved'.

Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.

NOTE/-

Participle: A word formed from a verb (e.g. going, gone, being, been) and used as an adjective (e.g. working woman, burnt toast) or a noun (e.g. good breeding). In English, participles are also used to make compound verb forms (e.g. is going, has been). Consider the sentences given below: Dancing at the party, the women fell on the ground. Encouraged by her parents, Rita went on to pursue her passion. The highlighted word in the first sentence is of the form Verb + ing and is used as a present participle. It is used to denote an action that is going on or incomplete or imperfect. The highlighted word in the second sentence is of the form verb + ed. It is used as a past participle. It denotes the completed action or state of the thing spoken of. A past participle ends with the following: -ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n. One should take great care and never get confused between a gerund and a present participle. They use the same forms but perform different functions: a gerund is a verbal noun, while a present participle is a verbal adjective.
