questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Panchayati Raj Institutions:

i) Every Panchayat has a fixed tenure of five years from the date of its first meeting.

ii) If a Panchayat is dissolved prematurely, fresh elections must be held within three months for a full new five-year term.

iii) The responsibility for conducting and supervising Panchayat elections lies with the Election Commission of India.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
पंचायती राज संस्थाओं के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) प्रत्येक पंचायत की पहली बैठक की तिथि से पांच वर्षों की निश्चित अवधि होती है।

ii) यदि किसी पंचायत को समय से पहले भंग कर दिया जाता है, तो पूरी नई पांच वर्षीय अवधि के लिए तीन महीनों के भीतर नए चुनाव कराए जाने चाहिए।

iii) पंचायत चुनाव कराने और पर्यवेक्षण करने की जिम्मेदारी भारत के चुनाव आयोग की होती है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement (i) is correct

Under Article 243E of the Indian Constitution, a Panchayat has a fixed tenure of five years from the date appointed for its first meeting. This provision was introduced through the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992, which gave constitutional status to Panchayati Raj Institutions and ensured stability in local self-government.

Statement (ii): Incorrect

The Constitution mandates that elections must be held within six months, not three months, if a Panchayat is dissolved prematurely. Also, the newly elected Panchayat does not always get a fresh full five-year term. It only serves the remaining period of the dissolved Panchayat.

Statement (iii): Incorrect

Elections to Panchayats are not conducted by the Election Commission of India (ECI). Instead, they are conducted by the State Election Commission, which is established in each state under Article 243K of the Constitution.

Further Insights

• The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act (1992) granted constitutional status to Panchayati Raj Institutions.

• Panchayati Raj added Part IX (Articles 243 - 243O) to the Constitution.

• State Election Commissions conduct elections for Panchayats and Municipalities.

• Panchayats operate at three levels: Village, Intermediate (Block), and District in most states.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the technical differences between International Cricket formats for men and women:

i) The radius of the inner fielding restriction circle is 30 yards (27.4 m) for Men's cricket, while it is 27 yards (24.68 m) for Women's cricket.

ii) A standard Men's Test match is scheduled for 5 days with a minimum of 90 overs per day, whereas a standard Women's Test match is traditionally played over 4 days with a minimum of 100 overs per day.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
पुरुषों और महिलाओं के लिए अंतरराष्ट्रीय क्रिकेट प्रारूपों के तकनीकी अंतर के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) पुरुष क्रिकेट के लिए आंतरिक क्षेत्ररक्षण वृत्त की त्रिज्या 30 गज (27.4 मी) है, जबकि महिला क्रिकेट के लिए यह 27 गज (24.68 मी) है।

ii) एक मानक पुरुष टेस्ट मैच 5 दिनों के लिए निर्धारित होता है जिसमें प्रति दिन न्यूनतम 90 ओवर होते हैं, जबकि एक मानक महिला टेस्ट मैच पारंपरिक रूप से 4 दिनों में खेला जाता है जिसमें प्रति दिन न्यूनतम 100 ओवर होते हैं।

उपरोक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (ii) is correct.

In Men's Test cricket, matches are scheduled for 5 days, and teams are expected to bowl a minimum of 90 overs per day.

In Women's Test cricket, matches are traditionally scheduled for 4 days, and because of the shorter match duration, the expected workload increases to 100 overs per day (about 17 overs per hour)

Statement (i) is incorrect.

The 30-yard (27.4 m) inner fielding circle is the standard measurement used in international cricket for fielding restrictions in the men's game.

However, women's cricket does not use a 27-yard circle. Instead, the infield radius is about 23 metres (~25.15 yards) in women's limited-overs formats.

Further Insights

• The governing body of international cricket is the International Cricket Council (ICC).

• Women's cricket generally uses a lighter ball (around 140 - 151 g) than men's cricket.

• The follow-on rule differs: 150-run lead in women's Tests vs 200 runs in men's Tests.

questions.question: Which of the following simple permanent plant tissues consists of dead cells with thick, lignified walls and provides mechanical strength to parts like the hard shell of a coconut?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित सरल स्थायी पौधे के ऊतकों में से कौन सा मृत कोशिकाओं से बना होता है जिनकी दीवारें मोटी और लिग्निफाइड होती हैं और जो नारियल के कठोर खोल जैसे भागों को यांत्रिक शक्ति प्रदान करता है?
questions.solution:
Sclerenchyma is a type of simple permanent plant tissue made up of dead cells with very thick, lignified cell walls. The presence of lignin makes the walls extremely rigid and strong, allowing this tissue to provide mechanical support and protection to different plant parts.

Sclerenchyma cells occur mainly in two forms:

Fibres - long, narrow cells providing strength.

Sclereids (stone cells) - short, irregular cells responsible for hardness in structures like nut shells and coconut husk.

The hard shell of coconut and the gritty texture in fruits like pears are caused by sclereids, a type of sclerenchyma.

Parenchyma

Parenchyma consists of living cells with thin cell walls. It mainly helps in storage, photosynthesis, and healing

Collenchyma

Collenchyma is made of living cells with unevenly thickened walls. It provides flexible support to growing parts like stems and leaves

Aerenchyma

Aerenchyma contains large air spaces and is common in aquatic plants to help with gas exchange and buoyancy

Further Insights

• Plant tissues are broadly classified into meristematic and permanent tissues.

• Simple permanent tissues include parenchyma, collenchyma, and sclerenchyma.

• Sclerenchyma cells lose their protoplasm at maturity, becoming dead cells.

• Lignin is the chemical responsible for rigidity in plant cell walls.

questions.question: According to the Second Law of Thermodynamics, what is the spontaneous direction of heat flow in an isolated system?
questions.question_hi: थर्मोडायनामिक्स के दूसरे नियम के अनुसार, एक पृथक प्रणाली में ऊष्मा प्रवाह की स्वाभाविक दिशा क्या है?

options.label: A
options.text: From a body at higher temperature to a body at lower temperature.
options.text_hi: एक शरीर से जो उच्च तापमान पर है, दूसरे शरीर की ओर जो निम्न तापमान पर है।

options.label: B
options.text: From a body at lower temperature to a body at higher temperature.
options.text_hi: एक शरीर से जो निम्न तापमान पर है, दूसरे शरीर की ओर जो उच्च तापमान पर है।

options.label: C
options.text: Heat remains stationary unless the system is disturbed by gravity.
options.text_hi: ताप तब तक स्थिर रहता है जब तक कि प्रणाली को गुरुत्वाकर्षण द्वारा बाधित न किया जाए।

options.label: D
options.text: Heat flows only between two bodies having the same entropy levels.
options.text_hi: ताप केवल उन दो शरीरों के बीच प्रवाहित होता है जिनके एंट्रॉपी स्तर समान होते हैं।

questions.correct_text: From a body at higher temperature to a body at lower temperature.
questions.solution:
The Second Law of Thermodynamics states that heat naturally flows from a region of higher temperature to a region of lower temperature in an isolated system. This process occurs spontaneously because it increases the Entropy of the system.

Heat will continue to flow in this direction until thermal equilibrium is reached, meaning both bodies reach the same temperature and no further net heat transfer occurs.

For example, when a hot cup of tea is placed in a cooler room, heat flows from the tea to the surrounding air until both reach the same temperature.

Further Insights

• The Second Law introduces the concept of entropy, representing disorder in a system.

• Perpetual motion machines of the second kind are impossible due to this law.

• The law explains why natural processes are irreversible.

• Refrigerators and heat pumps transfer heat from cold to hot using external energy.

• Thermal equilibrium occurs when two bodies reach the same temperature and no net heat transfer happens.

questions.question:
Match the Multi-Purpose River Valley Projects in List-I with the Rivers they are built upon in List-II:

List-I (Project)List-II (river)
i) Bhakra Nangal ProjectA) Bhagirathi River
ii) Hirakud DamB) Sutlej River
iii) Tehri DamC) Narmada River
iv) Sardar Sarovar DamD) Mahanadi River

Choose the correct match:
questions.question_hi:
सूची-I में बहुउद्देश्यीय नदी घाटी परियोजनाओं को सूची-II में उन नदियों के साथ मिलाएं जिन पर वे निर्मित हैं:

सूची-I (परियोजना)सूची-II (नदी)
i) भाखड़ा नांगल परियोजनाA) भागीरथी नदी
ii) हीराकुंड बांधB) सतलज नदी
iii) तेहरी बांधC) नर्मदा नदी
iv) सरदार सरोवर बांधD) महानदी

सही मिलान चुनें:
questions.solution:
i) Bhakra-Nangal Project - Sutlej River

The Bhakra-Nangal Project is constructed on the Sutlej River in Himachal Pradesh and Punjab. It is one of India's earliest and largest multipurpose river valley projects, used for irrigation, flood control, and hydroelectric power.

ii) Hirakud Dam - Mahanadi River

Hirakud Dam, located in Odisha near Sambalpur, is built across the Mahanadi River. It is one of the longest earthen dams in the world and helps control floods and provide irrigation.

iii) Tehri Dam - Bhagirathi River

Tehri Dam in Uttarakhand is built on the Bhagirathi River, which is one of the main headstreams of the Ganga. It is a major hydroelectric and irrigation project.

iv) Sardar Sarovar Project - Narmada River

The Sardar Sarovar Dam is constructed on the Narmada River in Gujarat. It is part of the Narmada Valley Development Project and provides irrigation, drinking water, and electricity.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the World Bank Group (WBG):

i) The International Development Association (IDA) and the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) are specifically designed to support private sector development and investment.

ii) The International Finance Corporation (IFC) and the Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency (MIGA) primarily provide loans and grants to governments.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
विश्व बैंक समूह (WBG) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) अंतर्राष्ट्रीय विकास संघ (IDA) और अंतर्राष्ट्रीय पुनर्निर्माण और विकास बैंक (IBRD) विशेष रूप से निजी क्षेत्र के विकास और निवेश का समर्थन करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किए गए हैं।

ii) अंतर्राष्ट्रीय वित्त निगम (IFC) और बहुपक्षीय निवेश गारंटी एजेंसी (MIGA) मुख्य रूप से सरकारों को ऋण और अनुदान प्रदान करते हैं।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is incorrect

IBRD and IDA mainly provide financial assistance to governments, not specifically to the private sector.

IBRD lends to middle-income and creditworthy low-income country governments.

IDA provides concessional loans and grants to the poorest countries, mainly through government programs.

Private sector development within the World Bank Group is primarily handled by the IFC and MIGA, not by IBRD or IDA.

Statement (ii) is incorrect

IFC and MIGA do not mainly provide loans and grants to governments.

IFC finances private sector companies and projects (equity, loans, advisory services).

MIGA provides political risk insurance and guarantees to encourage private investment in developing countries.

Further Insights

• The World Bank Group has five institutions: IBRD, IDA, IFC, MIGA, and the International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes (ICSID).

• IBRD and IDA together are commonly referred to as the "World Bank."

• IDA loans are interest-free or very low interest with long repayment periods.

• IFC can invest directly in private companies through equity participation.

• MIGA provides political risk insurance against risks like expropriation, war, or breach of contract.

questions.question: A tax specifically imposed on goods or activities that generate negative externalities (such as tobacco, alcohol, or pollution) to discourage their consumption is known as a:
questions.question_hi: एक कर जो विशेष रूप से उन वस्तुओं या गतिविधियों पर लगाया जाता है जो नकारात्मक बाहरी प्रभाव उत्पन्न करती हैं (जैसे तंबाकू, शराब, या प्रदूषण) ताकि उनके उपभोग को हतोत्साहित किया जा सके, उसे कहा जाता है:
questions.solution:
Pigouvian Tax is a tax imposed on activities that produce negative externalities, meaning costs imposed on society that are not reflected in the market price.

The concept was proposed by the British economist Arthur Cecil Pigou. The purpose of this tax is to internalize the external cost, forcing producers or consumers to bear the true social cost of their actions.

Examples include taxes on:

Tobacco and alcohol (to reduce health costs to society)

Carbon emissions (to reduce environmental pollution)

Plastic bags or pollutants

By increasing the price of harmful goods, governments aim to discourage consumption and reduce social harm.

A progressive tax is a tax where the tax rate increases as income increases, such as income tax in many countries.

An ad valorem tax is calculated as a percentage of the value of a product (e.g., GST, customs duties).

Minimum Alternate Tax (MAT) ensures that companies with large profits but many exemptions still pay a minimum level of tax.

Further Insights

• Negative externalities occur when economic activities impose costs on third parties.

• Carbon taxes are a common example of Pigouvian taxes used to fight climate change.

• Pigouvian taxes aim to achieve socially optimal production and consumption levels.

• Subsidies can also be used for positive externalities like education and healthcare.

• Many countries impose "sin taxes" on tobacco and alcohol, which function as Pigouvian taxes.

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding the **Environment Protection Act 1986 (EPA), 1986, is INCORRECT?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन **पर्यावरण संरक्षण अधिनियम 1986 (EPA), 1986** के संबंध में गलत है?

options.label: A
options.text: It was enacted by the Parliament of India in the wake of the Bhopal Gas Tragedy.
options.text_hi: यह भारत की संसद द्वारा भोपाल गैस त्रासदी के बाद बनाया गया था।

options.label: B
options.text: It is known as an "Umbrella Act" because it provides a framework for coordinating various central and state authorities.
options.text_hi: इसे "छत्र अधिनियम" कहा जाता है क्योंकि यह विभिन्न केंद्रीय और राज्य प्राधिकरणों के समन्वय के लिए एक ढांचा प्रदान करता है।

options.label: C
options.text: The Act empowers the State Governments to set emission standards, which shall prevail over Central Government directions in case of a conflict.
options.text_hi: यह अधिनियम राज्य सरकारों को उत्सर्जन मानक निर्धारित करने का अधिकार देता है, जो किसी भी विवाद की स्थिति में केंद्रीय सरकार के निर्देशों पर प्राथमिकता रखेंगे।

options.label: D
options.text: It allows a common citizen to sue a polluter, provided a 60-day notice is given to the prescribed authority.
options.text_hi: यह एक सामान्य नागरिक को प्रदूषक के खिलाफ मुकदमा दायर करने की अनुमति देता है, बशर्ते कि निर्धारित प्राधिकरण को 60 दिनों का नोटिस दिया गया हो।

questions.correct_text: The Act empowers the State Governments to set emission standards, which shall prevail over Central Government directions in case of a conflict.
questions.solution:
Statement (c) is incorrect

Under the Environment Protection Act, the Central Government has overriding authority to set environmental standards, including emission and discharge standards.

The Act empowers the Central Government to coordinate actions, regulate pollution levels, and issue binding directions to state authorities. If there is any conflict between central and state rules, Central Government standards prevail, not the state government's standards.

Further Insights

• The EPA was enacted under Article 253 of the Constitution to implement international environmental commitments.

• It enables the government to declare eco-sensitive zones and protected areas.

• The Act empowers authorities to close industries or regulate operations to control pollution.

questions.question: Which propulsion technology was recently tested by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) to enhance the range and speed of long-range air-to-air missiles?
questions.question_hi: हाल ही में रक्षा अनुसंधान और विकास संगठन (DRDO) द्वारा किस प्रणोदन तकनीक का परीक्षण किया गया था ताकि लंबी दूरी की हवा से हवा में मार करने वाली मिसाइलों की रेंज और गति बढ़ाई जा सके?
questions.solution:
DRDO demonstrated the Solid Fuel Ducted Ramjet (SFDR) technology at the Integrated Test Range in Chandipur, Odisha. This propulsion system is specifically designed to power future long-range air-to-air missiles.

SFDR is an air-breathing ramjet propulsion system that uses atmospheric oxygen during flight instead of carrying an onboard oxidizer. This reduces weight and allows the missile to maintain high supersonic speeds for longer durations, significantly increasing its range and engagement capability.

The technology is expected to power future missiles such as the Astra Mk-III (Gandiva) long-range air-to-air missile.

Further Insights:

• It is being developed by DRDO's Defence Research & Development Laboratory (DRDL), Hyderabad.

• It uses a nozzle-less booster and thrust modulation system for controlled propulsion.

• Only a few countries possess SFDR/ramjet missile propulsion technology, making it strategically significant for India.

questions.question: Who won the Global Teacher Prize 2026 for transforming neglected and abandoned walls into educational murals and open-air learning spaces?
questions.question_hi: नेग्लेक्टेड और परित्यक्त दीवारों को शैक्षिक भित्ति चित्रों और खुले वातावरण में सीखने की जगहों में बदलने के लिए ग्लोबल टीचर प्राइज 2026 किसने जीता?
questions.solution:
Rouble Nagi won the Global Teacher Prize 2026, awarded by the Varkey Foundation in collaboration with UNESCO. She was recognized for transforming abandoned and neglected walls into educational murals, effectively turning public spaces into interactive learning environments for children in marginalized communities.

Further Insights

• The Global Teacher Prize is often called the "Nobel Prize for Teaching."

• It carries a $1 million award funded by GEMS Education and the Varkey Foundation.

• The prize recognizes teachers who make exceptional contributions to education worldwide.

• Ranjitsinh Disale (India) previously won the prize in 2020.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding specific landforms created by weathering and erosion:

i) Inselbergs are landforms characterized by piles of rounded rock boulders, commonly found in granitic landscapes.

ii) Tors are isolated, steep-sided hills or small mountains that rise abruptly from a surrounding plain.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें जो मौसम और अपरदन द्वारा बनाए गए विशिष्ट स्थलाकृतियों के बारे में हैं:

i) इंसलबर्ग्स वे स्थलाकृतियाँ हैं जो गोलाकार चट्टानी बोल्डरों के ढेरों द्वारा विशेषीकृत होती हैं, जो आमतौर पर ग्रेनाइटिक परिदृश्यों में पाई जाती हैं।

ii) टॉर्स अलग-थलग, खड़ी-किनारी वाली पहाड़ियाँ या छोटे पहाड़ होते हैं जो आसपास के मैदान से अचानक उठते हैं।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is incorrect.

The description given (piles of rounded rock boulders in granitic regions) actually refers to tors, not inselbergs. Tors form due to differential weathering of jointed granite, producing stacked rounded boulders.

Statement (ii) is incorrect.

The description of isolated, steep-sided hills rising abruptly from plains actually describes inselbergs. Inselbergs are residual hills left behind after long-term erosion removes surrounding softer rock.

Thus, the characteristics of tors and inselbergs have been interchanged, making both statements incorrect.

Further Insights

• Inselbergs are commonly found in tropical and desert landscapes.

• Famous examples of inselbergs include Uluru in Australia.

• Tors are typical features of granite landscapes in temperate climates.

• Tors often develop through exfoliation and spheroidal weathering.

• Long-term denudation processes leave resistant rocks standing as inselbergs.

questions.question: Which of the following is a direct consequence of a persistent and high Current Account Deficit (CAD) on a country's economy?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक देश की अर्थव्यवस्था पर लगातार और उच्च चालू खाता घाटे (CAD) का प्रत्यक्ष परिणाम है?

options.label: A
options.text: Appreciation of the domestic currency due to an influx of foreign capital.
options.text_hi: विदेशी पूंजी के प्रवाह के कारण घरेलू मुद्रा का मूल्यवृद्धि।

options.label: B
options.text: Decrease in the cost of imported raw materials for domestic industries.
options.text_hi: घरेलू उद्योगों के लिए आयातित कच्चे माल की लागत में कमी।

options.label: C
options.text: Automatic conversion of all trade deficits into national Gold Reserves.
options.text_hi: सभी व्यापार घाटों का स्वचालित रूप से राष्ट्रीय स्वर्ण भंडार में रूपांतरण।

options.label: D
options.text: Depreciation of the domestic currency due to increased demand for foreign exchange.
options.text_hi: विदेशी मुद्रा की बढ़ती मांग के कारण घरेलू मुद्रा का मूल्यह्रास।

questions.correct_text: Depreciation of the domestic currency due to increased demand for foreign exchange.
questions.solution:
A Current Account Deficit (CAD) occurs when a country's total imports of goods, services, and transfers exceed its exports. To pay for these extra imports, the country needs more foreign currency (like US dollars).

As demand for foreign currency rises, the domestic currency tends to weaken (depreciate) in the foreign exchange market. Persistent CAD therefore often leads to pressure on the domestic currency, causing depreciation.

For example, if India imports more oil, electronics, and gold than it exports, it must buy more dollars to pay for those imports. This increased demand for dollars makes the Indian Rupee weaker relative to the dollar.

Further Insights

• The current account is a major component of the Balance of Payments (BoP).

• Major contributors to India's CAD include crude oil, gold, and electronics imports.

• A moderate CAD can be sustainable if financed by stable capital inflows like FDI.

• Persistent high CAD may lead to foreign exchange reserve depletion.

• Currency depreciation due to CAD can also increase inflation by making imports costlier.

questions.question: Who is the author of the famous philosophical work titled The Hindu View of Life?
questions.question_hi: प्रसिद्ध दार्शनिक कृति जिसका शीर्षक है हिन्दू जीवन दृष्टिकोण के लेखक कौन हैं?
questions.solution:
"The Hindu View of Life" is a well-known philosophical book written by Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan. The work originated from a series of lectures he delivered at Manchester College, Oxford in 1926.

In this book, Radhakrishnan explains the philosophical foundations, spiritual traditions, and tolerance inherent in Hinduism. He highlights Hinduism as a dynamic and inclusive way of life rather than a rigid religious system.

The book played an important role in introducing Hindu philosophical thought to Western audiences.

Swami Vivekananda

Swami Vivekananda wrote works like Raja Yoga and Karma Yoga

Raja Ram Mohan Roy

He was a major social reformer and founded the Brahmo Samaj

Sri Aurobindo

Sri Aurobindo wrote works such as The Life Divine

Further Insights

• Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan served as the second President of India (1962 - 1967).

• His birthday 5 September is celebrated as Teacher's Day in India.

• He was one of the most influential interpreters of Indian philosophy in the West.

• His other famous works include Indian Philosophy.

• He also served as Vice-President of India (1952 - 1962) before becoming President.

questions.question: Which of the following was a major factor contributing to the defeat of the Vijayanagara Empire at the Battle of Talikota (1565)?
questions.question_hi: तलिकोटा की लड़ाई (1565) में विजयनगर साम्राज्य की हार में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा प्रमुख कारक था?

options.label: A
options.text: The use of advanced horse-mounted archery by the Portuguese in support of the Sultanates.
options.text_hi: सुल्तानात के समर्थन में पुर्तगालियों द्वारा उन्नत घुड़सवार धनुर्विद्या का उपयोग।

options.label: B
options.text: The internal betrayal by two key commanders, known as the Gilani brothers, during the heat of the battle.
options.text_hi: युद्ध के दौरान दो प्रमुख कमांडरों, जिन्हें गिलानी भाइयों के नाम से जाना जाता है, द्वारा आंतरिक विश्वासघात।

options.label: C
options.text: The sudden death of the de facto ruler Aliya Rama Raya due to a natural illness before the battle began.
options.text_hi: युद्ध शुरू होने से पहले प्राकृतिक बीमारी के कारण वास्तविक शासक अलीया रामा राय का अचानक निधन।

options.label: D
options.text: The refusal of the Bijapur Sultanate to join the "Grand Alliance" against Vijayanagara.
options.text_hi: विजयनगर के खिलाफ "महान गठबंधन" में बीजापुर सुल्तानात का शामिल होने से इनकार।

questions.correct_text: The internal betrayal by two key commanders, known as the Gilani brothers, during the heat of the battle.
questions.solution:
A crucial factor behind the defeat of the Vijayanagara Empire was the defection of the Gilani brothers, who were high-ranking Muslim commanders serving in the Vijayanagara army. During the battle, they switched sides to join the Deccan Sultanates, causing confusion and weakening the Vijayanagara forces.

This betrayal disrupted the military formation of Vijayanagara at a decisive moment. Soon after, Aliya Rama Raya was captured and executed, which demoralized the army and led to the collapse of resistance. The allied Deccan Sultanates then decisively defeated Vijayanagara forces.

Further Insights

• The Battle of Talikota (1565) is also called the Battle of Rakshasa-Tangadi.

• The opposing alliance consisted mainly of Bijapur, Ahmadnagar, Golconda, and Bidar Sultanates.

• After the battle, the victorious armies sacked and destroyed the capital city Hampi.

• The defeat marked the decline of Vijayanagara's political dominance in South India.

questions.question:
Arrange the following milestones in the development of the Periodic Table in the correct chronological order (from earliest to latest):

i) Mendeleev's Periodic Law

ii) Dobereiner's Triads

iii) Modern Periodic Law proposed by Henry Moseley

iv) Newlands' Law of Octaves

Choose the correct option:
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित मील के पत्थरों को आवर्त सारणी के विकास में सही कालानुक्रमिक क्रम में व्यवस्थित करें (सबसे पहले से सबसे बाद तक):

i) मेंडेलीव का आवर्त नियम

ii) डोबरेनर के त्रिक

iii) हेनरी मोसली द्वारा प्रस्तावित आधुनिक आवर्त नियम

iv) न्यूलैंड्स का ऑक्टेव्स का नियम

सही विकल्प चुनें:
questions.solution:
ii) Dobereiner's Triads (1829)

Johann Wolfgang Dobereiner grouped certain elements into triads (groups of three) where the atomic mass of the middle element was roughly the average of the other two.

iv) Newlands' Law of Octaves (1864)

John Newlands arranged elements by increasing atomic mass and noticed that every eighth element had similar properties, similar to musical octaves.

i) Mendeleev's Periodic Law (1869)

Dmitri Mendeleev organized elements by increasing atomic mass and left gaps for undiscovered elements, predicting their properties accurately.

iii) Moseley's Modern Periodic Law (1913)

Henry Moseley showed that elements should be arranged by atomic number instead of atomic mass, which corrected anomalies in Mendeleev's table.

Further Insights

• The modern periodic table contains 118 confirmed elements.

• Periodicity arises from repeating electron configurations.

• Mendeleev predicted elements like Gallium and Germanium before their discovery.

• Noble gases were added later as a new group in the periodic table.

• The modern table is arranged into periods (rows) and groups (columns).

questions.question: According to the Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) 2025 released in February 2026, what is India's rank among 182 countries?
questions.question_hi: फरवरी 2026 में जारी भ्रष्टाचार धारणा सूचकांक (CPI) 2025 के अनुसार, 182 देशों में भारत की रैंक क्या है?
questions.solution:
The Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI) 2025, released by Transparency International, ranked India at 91st position out of 182 countries with a score of 39 out of 100.

India's ranking improved from 96th in 2024 to 91st in 2025, indicating a slight improvement in perceived levels of public sector corruption.

The CPI measures perceived corruption in the public sector, using data from expert assessments and business surveys. Countries are scored on a scale from 0 (highly corrupt) to 100 (very clean).

Further Insights

• The CPI has been published annually since 1995 by Transparency International.

• Countries are scored from 0 (high corruption) to 100 (very clean).

• Denmark ranked 1st as the least corrupt country in CPI 2025.

• South Sudan and Somalia ranked among the most corrupt countries.

• The CPI measures perceptions of corruption in the public sector, not actual corruption cases.

questions.question:
Match the British-era monuments in List-I with their primary Architectural Style / Purpose in List-II:

List-I (Monument)List-II (Style / Purpose)
i) Victoria MemorialA) Victorian Italianate Gothic Revival
ii) Gateway of IndiaB) War Memorial (Triumphal Arch)
iii) India GateC) Indo-Saracenic Style
iv) Chhatrapati Shivaji TerminusD) Blend of British and Mughal Elements

Choose the correct match:
questions.question_hi:
सूची-I में ब्रिटिश युग के स्मारकों को उनकी मुख्य वास्तुशिल्प शैली / उद्देश्य के साथ सूची-II में मिलाएं:

सूची-I (स्मारक)सूची-II (शैली / उद्देश्य)
i) विक्टोरिया मेमोरियलA) विक्टोरियन इटालियनेट गॉथिक रिवाइवल
ii) गेटवे ऑफ इंडियाB) युद्ध स्मारक (विजय द्वार)
iii) इंडिया गेटC) इंडो-सारसेनिक शैली
iv) छत्रपति शिवाजी टर्मिनसD) ब्रिटिश और मुगल तत्वों का मिश्रण

सही मिलान चुनें:
questions.solution:
i) Victoria Memorial - Indo-Saracenic Style

The Victoria Memorial in Kolkata combines British classical architecture with Mughal and Islamic design elements, which is characteristic of the Indo-Saracenic architectural style widely used by the British in India.

ii) Gateway of India - Blend of British and Mughal Elements

The Gateway of India was built to commemorate the visit of King George V and Queen Mary in 1911. Its architecture mixes Islamic arches and Gujarati decorative styles with European planning, creating a fusion of British and Mughal influences.

iii) India Gate - War Memorial (Triumphal Arch)

India Gate in New Delhi is a war memorial honoring Indian soldiers who died in World War I and the Third Anglo-Afghan War. Architect Edwin Lutyens designed it as a triumphal arch, similar to European war memorial arches.

iv) Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus - Victorian Italianate Gothic Revival

This railway station (formerly Victoria Terminus) is a classic example of Victorian Gothic Revival architecture, influenced by Italian Gothic structures, featuring pointed arches, turrets, and elaborate stone carvings.

Further Insights

• The Indo-Saracenic style blended Islamic, Hindu, and European architectural elements.

• Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus is a UNESCO World Heritage Site (2004).

questions.question:
Given below are two statements, one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):

Assertion (A): The human body follows a 24-hour internal biological cycle known as the Circadian Rhythm, which is primarily regulated by the hormone Melatonin.

Reason (R): Exposure to blue light from electronic screens stimulates the Pineal Gland to increase the secretion of Melatonin during the day.

Choose the most appropriate answer:
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं, एक को आशय (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) के रूप में चिह्नित किया गया है:

आशय (A): मानव शरीर एक 24-घंटे के आंतरिक जैविक चक्र का पालन करता है जिसे सर्केडियन रिदम कहा जाता है, जिसे मुख्य रूप से हार्मोन मेलाटोनिन द्वारा नियंत्रित किया जाता है।

कारण (R): इलेक्ट्रॉनिक स्क्रीन से निकलने वाली नीली रोशनी के संपर्क में आने से पीनियल ग्रंथि मेलाटोनिन के स्राव को दिन के दौरान बढ़ाने के लिए उत्तेजित होती है।

सबसे उपयुक्त उत्तर चुनें:

options.label: A
options.text: Both A and R are correct and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R सही हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या है।

options.label: B
options.text: Both A and R are correct but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R सही हैं लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options.label: C
options.text: A is correct but R is incorrect.
options.text_hi: A सही है लेकिन R गलत है।

options.label: D
options.text: A is incorrect but R is correct.
options.text_hi: A गलत है लेकिन R सही है।

questions.correct_text: A is correct but R is incorrect.
questions.solution:
The Assertion (A) is correct.

The human body operates on a roughly 24-hour biological cycle called the Circadian Rhythm, which regulates sleep - wake patterns, body temperature, hormone release, and metabolism. A key hormone controlling this rhythm is melatonin, which is secreted by the pineal gland, especially at night to promote sleep.

The Reason (R) is incorrect.

Blue light exposure actually suppresses melatonin secretion, rather than stimulating it. When people use electronic devices (phones, laptops, tablets) at night, the blue light signals the brain that it is still daytime, thereby reducing melatonin production and delaying sleep.

Further Insights

• The master biological clock controlling circadian rhythm is located in the Suprachiasmatic Nucleus of the hypothalamus.

• Melatonin secretion usually peaks during nighttime.

• Circadian rhythms influence sleep, digestion, hormone release, and body temperature.

• Disruption of circadian rhythm is linked to sleep disorders and metabolic diseases.

• Night shift work can cause circadian misalignment and long-term health effects.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an internal lead agency or functional mission operating under the framework of NITI Aayog?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा NITI आयोग के ढांचे के तहत संचालित आंतरिक प्रमुख एजेंसी या कार्यात्मक मिशन नहीं है?
questions.solution:
The National Development Council (NDC) is not an internal unit of NITI Aayog. It was established in 1952 to strengthen and mobilize support for national plans and was associated with the Planning Commission. After the Planning Commission was replaced by NITI Aayog in 2015, the NDC effectively ceased to function and is not part of the NITI Aayog structure.

The Team India Hub acts as a coordination platform between the Central Government and States/UTs. It facilitates cooperative federalism and policy implementation within the NITI Aayog framework.

Development Monitoring and Evaluation Office (DMEO)

DMEO is an internal office of NITI Aayog responsible for monitoring and evaluating government programs and policies to improve their effectiveness.

Atal Innovation Mission (AIM)

AIM is a flagship initiative under NITI Aayog aimed at promoting innovation, entrepreneurship, and startups through programs like Atal Tinkering Labs and Atal Incubation Centers.

Further Insights

• NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission in 2015.

• The Chairperson of NITI Aayog is the Prime Minister of India.

• NITI Aayog promotes cooperative and competitive federalism among states.

• Atal Innovation Mission runs initiatives like Atal Tinkering Labs (ATLs) in schools.

• DMEO focuses on data-driven policy evaluation and outcome monitoring.

questions.question: In a landmark 2026 judgment (Dr. Jaya Thakur v. Union of India), the Supreme Court declared that access to dignified menstrual health is an integral part of which Fundamental Right?
questions.question_hi: 2026 के एक महत्वपूर्ण फैसले (डॉ. जया ठाकुर बनाम भारत संd) में, सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने घोषित किया कि गरिमापूर्ण मासिक धर्म स्वास्थ्य तक पहुंच किस मौलिक अधिकार का अभिन्न हिस्सा है?
questions.solution:
In Dr. Jaya Thakur v. Union of India (2026), the Supreme Court ruled that menstrual health and hygiene are integral to the Right to Life and dignity under Article 21 of the Constitution. The Court held that lack of access to menstrual hygiene facilities undermines human dignity, bodily autonomy, and equality, which are core elements of Article 21.

The Court also issued directions to governments to ensure free sanitary pads, proper toilets, and menstrual hygiene management facilities in schools, recognizing that these are essential for ensuring girls' education and dignity.

Further Insights

• Article 21 has been expanded through landmark cases like Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India.

• The Court used a continuing mandamus to monitor implementation of menstrual hygiene measures.

• The judgment emphasized menstrual health as linked to education and gender equality.

questions.question: Which of the following Constitutional Amendment Acts is INCORRECTLY matched with the language(s) it added to the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा संवैधानिक संशोधन अधिनियम भारतीय संविधान के आठवें अनुसूची में जोड़ी गई भाषा(ओं) के साथ गलत मेल खाता है?

options.label: B
options.text: 71st Constitutional Amendment Act 1992  -  Konkani, Manipuri, and Nepali
options.text_hi: 71वां संवैधानिक संशोधन अधिनियम 1992 - कोंकणी, मणिपुरी, और नेपाली

options.label: C
options.text: 92nd Constitutional Amendment Act 2003  -  Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, and Santhali
options.text_hi: 92वां संवैधानिक संशोधन अधिनियम 2003 - बोडो, डोगरी, मैथिली, और संथाली

questions.solution:
The 97th Constitutional Amendment Act (2011) deals with cooperative societies, introducing Article 43B and adding Part IX-B to the Constitution. It has nothing to do with adding languages to the Eighth Schedule.

The language Odia was not added through the 97th Amendment. Instead, the 96th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2011 simply changed the spelling of "Oriya" to "Odia" in the Eighth Schedule.

Further Insights

• The Eighth Schedule originally had 14 languages in 1950.

• After several amendments, the schedule now contains 22 languages.

• The 22nd language addition occurred in 2003 (92nd Amendment).

• Scheduled languages are used for official purposes, competitive exams, and parliamentary proceedings.

questions.question: Which component of the Earth's hydrosphere consists of all the frozen water - including glaciers, ice sheets, and permafrost - and plays a vital role in cooling the planet?
questions.question_hi: पृथ्वी के जलमंडल का कौन सा घटक सभी जमे हुए पानी - जिसमें ग्लेशियर, हिमपटल, और स्थायी हिम शामिल हैं - से बना है और ग्रह को ठंडा करने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है?
questions.solution:
The Cryosphere refers to all the frozen components of the Earth's hydrosphere. It includes:

Glaciers, Ice sheets (Greenland and Antarctica), Sea ice,Permafrost, Snow cover ,Frozen lakes and rivers

The cryosphere plays a critical role in regulating Earth's climate because ice and snow have high albedo, meaning they reflect a large portion of solar radiation back into space. This reflection helps cool the planet and maintain global temperature balance.

The Lithosphere consists of rocks, soil, and tectonic plates

The Troposphere is the lowest layer of the atmosphere where weather occurs.

The Stratosphere is another atmospheric layer above the troposphere and contains the ozone layer

Further Insights

• About 69% of Earth's freshwater is stored in glaciers and ice caps.

• The Antarctic Ice Sheet holds the largest amount of frozen water on Earth.

• Permafrost thawing can release greenhouse gases like methane.

• Loss of sea ice contributes to accelerated global warming (ice-albedo feedback).

• The cryosphere strongly interacts with the Hydrosphere and the climate system.

questions.question: Carlos Alcaraz became the youngest man to complete a career Grand Slam in 2026 by defeating which player in the Australian Open final?
questions.question_hi: कार्लोस अल्काराज़ 2026 में ऑस्ट्रेलियन ओपन फाइनल में किस खिलाड़ी को हराकर करियर ग्रैंड स्लैम पूरा करने वाले सबसे कम उम्र के पुरुष बने?
questions.solution:
At the Australian Open 2026, Carlos Alcaraz defeated Novak Djokovic in the men's singles final. The match ended 2-6, 6-2, 6-3, 7-5, giving Alcaraz his first Australian Open title and completing his Career Grand Slam (winning all four major tennis tournaments: Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon, and US Open).

With this victory, Alcaraz became the youngest male player in history to complete a Career Grand Slam at age 22.

Further Insights

• A Career Grand Slam means winning all four major tennis tournaments at least once.

• The four majors are Australian Open, French Open (Roland Garros), Wimbledon, and US Open.

• Alcaraz became only the ninth man in tennis history to achieve a Career Grand Slam.

• The 2026 Australian Open final was Djokovic's first loss in an Australian Open final.

• Alcaraz won his 7th Grand Slam title with this victory.

questions.question: Who has been assigned the additional charge of Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of NITI Aayog following the completion of B. V. R. Subrahmanyam's tenure in February 2026?

questions.question: The agricultural festival of Nuakhai, celebrated primarily in Western Odisha, is dedicated to which of the following?
questions.question_hi: पश्चिमी ओडिशा में मुख्य रूप से मनाया जाने वाला कृषि त्योहार नुआखाई किसके समर्पित है?

options.text: The arrival of the Monsoon season

options.label: B
options.text: The worship of the Sun God (Surya)

options.label: C
options.text: The welcoming of the first new grain of the harvest
options.text_hi: फसल के पहले नए अनाज का स्वागत

options.label: D

questions.solution:
Nuakhai is a major agrarian harvest festival celebrated mainly in the western regions of Odisha such as Sambalpur, Balangir, and Bargarh. The word Nuakhai comes from two Odia words:

"Nua" meaning new

"Khai" meaning food or grain

The festival marks the first consumption of newly harvested rice. Farmers offer the new grain to their presiding deity, often Goddess Samaleswari, before eating it themselves. It symbolizes gratitude for the harvest and the beginning of the new agricultural cycle.

Further Insights

• It is one of the most important festivals in Western Odisha.

• The festival promotes community bonding and family reunions.

• Rituals include NuakhaiJuhar, where younger people greet elders and seek blessings.

questions.question: Which among the following is equivalent to binary value 101010?

questions.solution:
Octal equivalent

101010 is divided into groups of 3 bits and its equivalent is written as shown below

(101010)2 = (52)8

Decimal equivalent

101010 = 1*25+0*24+1*23+0*22+1*21+0*20 = 32 + 8 + 2 = (42)10

Hexadecimal equivalent

101010 is divided into groups of 4 bits and equivalent is written as shown below (Note: prefixing zeros does not change the value)

(101010)2 = (2A)16

questions.question: Which of the following is the simplest sorting algorithm that works by repeatedly swapping the adjacent elements if they are in the wrong order?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सबसे सरल सॉर्टिंग एल्गोरिदम है जो एडजसेंट एलिमेंट को गलत क्रम में होने पर बार-बार स्वैप करके काम करता है?
questions.solution:
Bubble Sort is the simplest sorting algorithm that works by repeatedly swapping the adjacent elements if they are in the wrong order.

Example:

First Pass:

(5 1 4 2 8) - > (1 5 4 2 8), Here, algorithm compares the first two elements, and swaps since 5 > 1.

(1 5 4 2 8) - > (1 4 5 2 8), Swap since 5 > 4

(1 4 5 2 8) - > (1 4 2 5 8), Swap since 5 > 2

(1 4 2 5 8) - > (1 4 2 5 8), Now, since these elements are already in order (8 > 5), the algorithm does not swap them.

Second Pass:

(1 4 2 5 8) - > (1 4 2 5 8)

(1 4 2 5 8) - > (1 2 4 5 8), Swap since 4 > 2

(1 2 4 5 8) - > (1 2 4 5 8)

(1 2 4 5 8) - > (1 2 4 5 8)

Now, the array is already sorted, but our algorithm does not know if it is completed. The algorithm needs one whole pass without any swap to know it is sorted.

Third Pass:

(1 2 4 5 8) - > (1 2 4 5 8)

(1 2 4 5 8) - > (1 2 4 5 8)

(1 2 4 5 8) - > (1 2 4 5 8)

(1 2 4 5 8) - > (1 2 4 5 8)

questions.question: Which of the following terms refers to the network of physical objects - such as smart appliances and wearable devices - that are embedded with sensors and software to collect and exchange data over the internet?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा शब्द भौतिक वस्तुओं के नेटवर्क को संदर्भित करता है - जैसे स्मार्ट उपकरण और पहनने योग्य डिवाइस - जिनमें सेंसर और सॉफ़्टवेयर लगे होते हैं ताकि वे इंटरनेट के माध्यम से डेटा एकत्रित और आदान-प्रदान कर सकें?
questions.solution:
The Internet of Things (IoT) refers to a system where physical devices are connected to the internet and can communicate with each other by collecting and sharing data through sensors, software, and connectivity technologies.

Examples of IoT devices include:

Smart home appliances (smart refrigerators, thermostats)

Wearable devices (fitness trackers, smartwatches)

Smart cars

Industrial sensors

Smart city infrastructure

These devices automatically collect data, send it to servers or cloud platforms, and often respond intelligently based on that data.

Cloud Computing refers to storing and processing data on remote servers instead of local computers. It supports IoT systems but is not the network of smart devices itself.

Virtual Reality creates simulated digital environments using special headsets. It is unrelated to connected physical devices.

Blockchain is used for secure and decentralized record-keeping, especially in cryptocurrencies and digital transactions.

Further Insights

• IoT is a key component of Smart Cities initiatives.

• IoT devices often rely on cloud platforms for data storage and analytics.

• Common communication technologies used in IoT include Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Zigbee, and 5G.

• Security challenges in IoT include data privacy and device hacking risks.

• IoT is widely used in healthcare, agriculture, transportation, and smart homes.

questions.question: Which of the following cryptographic protocols is primarily used by Gmail to provide "End-to-Server" encryption, ensuring that emails are protected while in transit between the user and Google's servers?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित क्रिप्टोग्राफिक प्रोटोकॉल में से कौन सा मुख्य रूप से Gmail द्वारा "एंड-टू-सर्वर" एन्क्रिप्शन प्रदान करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, यह सुनिश्चित करते हुए कि ईमेल उपयोगकर्ता और Google के सर्वरों के बीच ट्रांजिट में सुरक्षित रहें?
questions.solution:
Transport Layer Security (TLS) is the protocol used by Gmail to encrypt communication between the user's device and Google's servers.

TLS provides encryption, authentication, and data integrity, ensuring that emails cannot be intercepted or read by attackers while traveling across the internet.

In Gmail, TLS is used to secure:

Web access (HTTPS) when users open Gmail in a browser

Email transmission between mail servers when supported

This form of protection is called "end-to-server encryption", meaning the email is encrypted while traveling from the user's device to Google's server.

Hypertext Transfer Protocol transfers web data but does not provide encryption. Secure communication uses HTTPS,which is HTTP over TLS.

Simple Mail Transfer Protocol is used to send emails, but it does not inherently provide encryption unless combined with TLS.

File Transfer Protocol is used for file transfers and is not used for email encryption.

Further Insights

• TLS is the successor to the older Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) protocol.

• Gmail uses HTTPS (HTTP + TLS) for secure browser communication.

• End-to-server encryption is different from end-to-end encryption, where only sender and receiver can read the message.

questions.question: Which of the following terms refers to the practice of storing the same data in multiple geographic locations to ensure it remains accessible even if one server or data center fails?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा शब्द एक ही डेटा को कई भौगोलिक स्थानों में संग्रहीत करने की प्रथा को संदर्भित करता है ताकि यह सुनिश्चित किया जा सके कि यदि एक सर्वर या डेटा सेंटर विफल हो जाए तो भी यह सुलभ रहे?
questions.solution:
Data Redundancy refers to the practice of keeping multiple copies of the same data in different locations or systems.

This technique is commonly used in cloud computing, distributed databases, and backup systems to ensure high availability and fault tolerance. If one server, storage device, or data center fails, the system can retrieve the same data from another location, preventing data loss and service interruption.

For example, large cloud providers like Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud store data in multiple geographic regions to maintain reliability.

Data Fragmentation involves dividing data into smaller pieces to improve database performance or storage efficiency, not duplicating it.

Data Compression reduces file size to save storage space or bandwidth, but it does not create multiple copies.

Data Encryption protects data by converting it into a coded format. It focuses on security, not redundancy.

Further Insights

• Data redundancy improves fault tolerance in distributed systems.

• It is widely used in RAID storage systems for data protection.

• Cloud providers use multi-region replication for redundancy.

• Excessive redundancy can increase storage costs and management complexity.

• Redundancy is a key concept in disaster recovery and backup strategies.

questions.correct_text: To enable non-linear navigation by allowing the presenter or user to jump to specific slides, external websites, or different files rather than following a fixed slide-by-slide order.
questions.solution:
In Microsoft PowerPoint, hyperlinks and action buttons are interactive tools that allow the presenter to navigate non-linearly within a presentation. Instead of moving strictly from one slide to the next, the presenter can:

Jump to specific slides within the presentation

Open external web pages

Open documents or files

Run programs or play media

Action Buttons are predefined shapes with icons (like Home, Forward, Back, etc.) that perform specific actions during a slideshow, while Hyperlinks connect text or objects to another slide or resource.

This feature is commonly used in interactive presentations, quizzes, kiosks, and training modules.

Further Insights

• Hyperlinks can be applied to text, images, shapes, or objects in PowerPoint.

• Action buttons are mainly used in Slide Show mode for interactive navigation.

• PowerPoint allows linking to slides, websites, email addresses, or other files.

• Interactive presentations often use branching navigation with hyperlinks.

• Hyperlinks and action buttons are widely used in educational quizzes and kiosk presentations.

questions.question: Which among the following enables a selected hardware component to fetch the memory of the computer system without any interference ?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक सिलेक्टेड हार्डवेयर कॉम्पोनेन्ट को बिना किसी हस्तक्षेप के कंप्यूटर सिस्टम की मेमोरी फेच करने में सक्षम बनाता है?
questions.solution:
Direct memory access (DMA) is a method that allows an input/output (I/O) device to send or receive data directly to or from the main memory, bypassing the CPU to speed up memory operations. In other words, DMA is used to send data directly from a peripheral to the motherboard without involving the microprocessor, so that the process does not interfere with overall computer operation.

In older computers, four DMA channels were numbered 0, 1, 2 and 3. When the 16-bit industry standard architecture (ISA) expansion bus was introduced, channels 5, 6 and 7 were added.

The process is managed by a chip known as a DMA controller (DMAC).

questions.question: Excel formula has different parts. With respect to the formula "=PI() *A2ˆ2",what does A2 represent?
questions.question_hi: एक्सेल सूत्र के विभिन्न भाग होते हैं। सूत्र "=PI() *A2ˆ2" के संदर्भ में, A2 क्या दर्शाता है?
questions.solution:
A formula can contain any or all of the following: functions, references, operators, and constants.

1) Functions: The PI() function returns the value of pi: 3.142...

2) References: A2 returns the value in cell A2.

3) Constants: Numbers or text values entered directly into a formula, such as 2.

4) Operators: The ^ (caret) operator raises a number to a power, and the * (asterisk) operator multiplies numbers.

options.label: A
options.text: To provide high-speed data redundancy by automatically mirroring files across multiple geographic server locations to ensure information remains safe even during localized natural disasters.
options.text_hi: स्वचालित रूप से फ़ाइलों को कई भौगोलिक सर्वर स्थानों में मिरर करके उच्च गति डेटा पुनरावृत्ति प्रदान करना ताकि स्थानीय प्राकृतिक आपदाओं के दौरान भी जानकारी सुरक्षित रहे।

options.label: B

options.text_hi: स्थानीय कंप्यूटर के हार्डवेयर को भौतिक रूप से एन्क्रिप्ट और स्थायी रूप से लॉक करना ताकि ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम तक किसी को भी सक्रिय उच्च गति इंटरनेट कनेक्शन के बिना पहुंच न हो सके।

options.label: D
options.text: To facilitate remote accessibility by allowing users to retrieve, edit, and share their stored documents from any compatible device in the world, provided there is a stable network connection.
options.text_hi: दूरस्थ पहुंच को सुविधाजनक बनाना जिससे उपयोगकर्ता किसी भी संगत डिवाइस से, जहां भी स्थिर नेटवर्क कनेक्शन हो, अपने संग्रहीत दस्तावेज़ों को पुनः प्राप्त, संपादित और साझा कर सकें।

questions.correct_text: To physically encrypt and permanently lock the hardware of the local computer so that the operating system cannot be accessed by anyone without an active high-speed internet connection.
questions.solution:
Cloud storage services store data on remote servers maintained by cloud providers, and they focus on data availability, backup, scalability, and remote access.

They do not lock or encrypt the physical hardware of a user's computer or restrict operating system access. That function would relate to device security or disk encryption tools, not cloud storage.

Further Insights

• Cloud storage eliminates the need for large physical storage infrastructure.

• Many providers use distributed data centers across regions for reliability.

• Cloud storage supports automatic backup and version history.

• Security features often include data encryption and access controls.

• Cloud storage is a core component of Cloud Computing.

questions.question: Which of the following defines Ethernet-based networks as well as the name of the working group assigned to develop these standards?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा ईथरनेट-आधारित नेटवर्क को परिभाषित करता है साथ ही उन मानकों को विकसित करने के लिए नियुक्त कार्य समूह का नाम भी बताता है?
questions.solution:
IEEE 802.3 is a set of standards put forth by the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) that define Ethernet-based networks as well as the name of the working group assigned to develop these standards.

A delivery vehicle travels 80 km at 40 km/h, then 120 km at 60 km/h, and then 200 km at 80 km/h. What is its average speed (in km/h) for the entire trip?
questions.question_hi: एक डिलीवरी वाहन 40 किमी/घंटा की गति से 80 किमी, फिर 60 किमी/घंटा की गति से 120 किमी और फिर 80 किमी/घंटा की गति से 200 किमी की यात्रा करता है। पूरी यात्रा के दौरान इसकी औसत गति (किमी/घंटा में) क्या है?
questions.solution:
Average speed = Total distance / Total time

Total distance = 80 + 120 + 200 = 400 km

Time taken to cover 80 km = 80 ÷ 40 = 2 h

Time taken to cover 120 km = 120 ÷ 60 = 2 h

Time taken to cover 200 km = 200 ÷ 80 = 2.5 h

Total time = 2 + 2 + 2.5 = 6.5 h

Average speed = 400 ÷ 6.5 = 61.538.. ≈ 61.54 km/h

LSA = πrl

100π = π * 5√5 * r

r = 4√5 cm

Height = √(l2 - r2) = √[(5√5)2 − (4√5)2]

= √45

= 3√5 cm

Hence, volume = (1/3)πr2h = 1/3 * π * 80 * 3√5 = 80π√5 cm3

questions.question: The ratio of cost price to the selling price of an article is 5:7 respectively. The shopkeeper marked up the article by 60%. Had the shopkeeper bought the article for Rs.300 more and sold it at Rs.270 more on marked price giving no discount, then profit percent becomes 40%. What is the initial amount of discount offered on the sale of that article?
questions.question_hi: एक वस्तु के क्रय मूल्य और विक्रय मूल्य का अनुपात क्रमशः 5:7 है| दुकानदार वस्तु को 60% अधिक मूल्य से अंकित करता है| यदि दुकानदार ने वस्तु 300 रु अधिक में खरीदी थी और अंकित मूल्य पर बिना कोई छूट देते हुए 270 रु अधिक में बेची थी, तो लाभ प्रतिशत 40% हो जाता है| वस्तु की बिक्री पर प्रदान किए गए छूट की प्रारम्भिक धनराशि कितनी है?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price and selling price of the article be Rs 5x and Rs 7x respectively.

marked price of article = 160% of 5x = 8x

New cost price of article = (5x + 300)

New selling price of article = 140% of (5x + 300) = (8x + 270)

7x + 420 = 8x + 270

x = 150

Initial amount of discount offered = 8x - 7x = x = Rs.150

questions.question: How many different acute angled scalene triangles can be formed such that the perimeter is 19?
questions.question_hi: कितने विभिन्न न्यून कोणीय विषमबाहु त्रिभुज बनाए जा सकते हैं, जिनका परिमाप 19 हो?
questions.solution:
Let the sides of the scalene triangle be a, b, c such that a > b > c.

Also since it is an acute angled triangle (b + c) > a and b2 + c2 > a2

Thus 'a' can assume values between 7 and 9 only.

Thus the values that a, b and c can assume such that a + b + c = 19 are as follows.

If a = 7, (b + c) = 12

No possible cases as (7, 6, 6) is not a scalene triangle

If a = 8, (b + c) = 11

Possible cases are (8, 7, 4), (8, 6, 5) but only (8, 7, 4) satisfies b2 + c2 > a2

If a = 9, (b + c) = 10

Possible cases are (9, 8, 2), (9, 7, 3), (9, 6, 4) but none of them satisfy b2 + c2 > a2

Thus only 1 triangle is possible having dimensions of (8, 7, 4).

questions.question: K sold an item to L at 20% profit. L sold it to M at a profit of 10% of K's cost. M then sold it to N at 25% profit on M's purchase price. If N paid Rs.975, find K's original cost.
questions.question_hi: K ने एक वस्तु L को 20% लाभ पर बेची। L ने इसे M को K की लागत का 10% लाभ पर बेचा। फिर M ने इसे N को M की खरीद मूल्य पर 25% लाभ पर बेचा। यदि N ने Rs.975 भुगतान किया, तो K की मूल लागत ज्ञात करें।
questions.solution:
Let K's cost = x

After K→L: SP1 = x X 1.20 =1.2x

After L→M: profit =10% of x =0.10x => SP2 =1.2x +0.10x =1.30x

After M→N: SP3 =1.30x X 1.25 =1.625x

1.625x =975 => x =975/1.625 =600

questions.question: Jinat and Parul alone can complete the whole work in 48 days and 36 days respectively and Parul and Mugdha together can complete the whole work in 221⁄2 days. If they took a contract of work for Rs. 9400 and finished the work by working together, then what is the difference between the shares of Jinat and Mugdha?
questions.question_hi: जीनत और पारुल अकेले सम्पूर्ण कार्य को क्रमशः 48 दिनों और 36 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं तथा एक साथ कार्य करते हुए पारुल और मुग्धा सम्पूर्ण कार्य को 22(1/2) दिनों में पूरा कर सकती हैं। यदि वे एक साथ कार्य करते हुए रु. 9400 में कार्य को पूरा करने का अनुबंध करते हैं, तो धनराशि में जीनत और मुग्धा के हिस्सों के बीच का अंतर कितना है?
questions.solution:
Jinat and Parul alone can complete the whole work in 48 days and 36 days respectively

Parul and Mugdha together can complete the whole work in 22(1/2) days

So, no. of days in which Mugdha alone can complete the whole work = 1/(2/45 - 1/36) = 60 days

So, ratio of efficiencies of Jinat, Parul and Mugdha respectively = 1/48: 1/36: 1/60 = 15: 20: 12

Thus, required difference = (15 - 12)/47 * 9400 = Rs. 600

questions.question: If A + B = 45° and (1 + tan A)(1 + tan B) = 2x, find x.
questions.question_hi: यदि A + B = 45° तथा (1 + tan A)(1 + tan B) = 2x, तो x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
tan(A + B) = tan 45° = 1

tan(A + B) = (tan A + tan B)/(1 − tan A tan B)

=> tan A + tan B = 1 − tan A tan B

(1 + tan A)(1 + tan B) = 1 + tan A + tan B + tan A tan B

=> 1 + (1 − tan A tan B) + tan A tan B = 2

Therefore 2x = 2

=> x = 1

Express Method

We know that if A + B = 45°, then (1 + tanA) (1 + tanB) = 2.

Therefore,

2x = 2

x = 1

questions.question: Punit starts from station A at speed of 30 km/h and takes 10 minutes more time to reach station B. If he travels at 24 km/h from station A and takes 18 minutes more time to reach station B, then what is the distance between station A and station B?
questions.question_hi: पुनीत स्टेशन A से 30 किमी / घंटा की गति से शुरू करता है और स्टेशन B तक पहुँचने में 10 मिनट अधिक समय लेता है। यदि वह स्टेशन A से 24 किमी / घंटा की गति से यात्रा करता है और स्टेशन B तक पहुँचने में 18 मिनट अधिक समय लेता है, तो स्टेशन A और स्टेशन B के बीच की दूरी कितनी है?
questions.solution:
Let distance between stations A and B = d km and usual time taken = t hours

So, d/30 = t + 10/60

=> t = d/30 - 1/6

And d/24 = t + 18/60

=> d/24 = d/30 - 1/6 + 18/60

=> d = 16 km

Express Method

Distance = (speed_1 x speed_2) x time (in hours)/Difference between speeds

= (30 x 24) x (8/60) x (1/6)

= 16 km

4 : 30 :: 7 : ?
questions.solution:
Rule: Multiply the number by 5 and then add 10.

For 4:

4 X 5 = 20; 20 + 10 = 30.

For 7:

7 X 5 = 35; 35 + 10 = 45.

Thus, the answer is 45.

questions.question:
In a certain code language:

· 'tiger lion zebra' => 'r5 7k 3z'

· 'lion horse rabbit' => '7k h2 u3'

· 'rabbit tiger monkey' => 'u3 r5 m9'

How is 'monkey' written in that language?
questions.question_hi:
एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में:

· 'tiger lion zebra' => 'r5 7k 3z'

· 'lion horse rabbit' => '7k h2 u3'

· 'rabbit tiger monkey' => 'u3 r5 m9'

'monkey' उस भाषा में कैसे लिखा जाता है?
questions.solution:
1) Comparing the first and second phrases, the common word is 'lion' and the common code is '7k'. So, lion = 7k.

2) Comparing the second and third phrases, the common word is 'rabbit' and the common code is 'u3'. So, rabbit = u3.

3) Comparing the first and third phrases, the common word is 'tiger' and the common code is 'r5'. So, tiger = r5.

4) In the third phrase, the only remaining word is 'monkey', and the only remaining code is 'm9'. Therefore, monkey = m9.

Delete 3rd letter, M

Remaining letters, C O P L E X T Y

Positions now, 1 C, 2 O, 3 P, 4 L, 5 E, 6 X, 7 T, 8 Y

6th letter = X

questions.question:
In this question, two statements I and II have been given. These statements may be independent causes or effects of independent causes or a common cause. One of the statements maybe the effect of the other statement. Read both statements and select the correct answer.

I. At the Mumbai International Airport, five sequential flights are delayed. Passengers at the airport are hustling through the waiting area.

II. There is a network problem in the airport control area. Some aircraft in the surrounding Mumbai zones have lost signal.
questions.question_hi:
इस प्रश्न में, दो कथन I और II दिए गए हैं। ये कथन स्वतंत्र कारण या स्वतंत्र कारणों के प्रभाव या एक सामान्य कारण हो सकते हैं। एक कथन दूसरे कथन का प्रभाव हो सकता है। दोनों कथनों को पढ़ें और सही उत्तर चुनें।

I. मुंबई अंतर्राष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डे पर, पाँच क्रमिक उड़ानें देरी से चल रही हैं। हवाई अड्डे पर यात्री प्रतीक्षालय में भागदौड़ कर रहे हैं।

II. हवाई अड्डे के नियंत्रण क्षेत्र में नेटवर्क की समस्या है। मुंबई के आसपास के क्षेत्रों में कुछ विमानों का सिग्नल खो गया है।

options.label: A
options.text: Both I and II are independent causes
options.text_hi: I और II दोनों स्वतंत्र कारण हैं

options.label: B
options.text: I is the cause and II is its possible effect
options.text_hi: I कारण है और II इसका संभावित प्रभाव है

options.label: C
options.text: II is the cause and I is its possible effect
options.text_hi: II कारण है और I इसका संभावित प्रभाव है

The airport control area is experiencing a network issue. In the nearby Mumbai zones, some planes have lost signals. Thus, five consecutive flights at Mumbai International Airport have been delayed and travellers are hurrying through the airport's waiting area.

questions.question:
Choose the conclusion(s) which logically follow from the given statements.

Statements:

A significant portion of the food produced globally is wasted before it reaches consumers.

Reducing food wastage can help in addressing global hunger issues.

Many organizations and governments are now taking steps to reduce food waste.

Conclusions:

I: Reducing food wastage can completely eradicate hunger worldwide.

II: Governments are actively involved in reducing food wastage.

III: The global food production system has inefficiencies that lead to wastage
questions.question_hi:
दिए गए कथनों में से तार्किक रूप से अनुसरण करने वाले निष्कर्ष का चयन कीजिए।

कथन:

विश्व स्तर पर उत्पादित भोजन का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा उपभोक्ताओं तक पहुँचने से पहले ही बर्बाद हो जाता है।

खाद्य अपव्यय को कम करने से वैश्विक भूखमरी की समस्या का समाधान करने में मदद मिल सकती है।

कई संगठन और सरकारें अब खाद्य अपव्यय को कम करने के लिए कदम उठा रही हैं।

निष्कर्ष:

I: खाद्य अपव्यय को कम करने से दुनिया भर में भूखमरी पूरी तरह से समाप्त हो सकती है।

II: सरकारें खाद्य अपव्यय को कम करने में सक्रिय रूप से शामिल हैं।

III: वैश्विक खाद्य उत्पादन प्रणाली में अक्षमताएँ हैं जो अपव्यय का कारण बनती हैं।

options.label: A
options.text_hi: निष्कर्ष I और II अनुसरण करते हैं

options.label: B
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष II अनुसरण करता है

options.label: C
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष III अनुसरण करता है

options.label: D
options.text_hi: निष्कर्ष II और III अनुसरण करते हैं

questions.solution:
Conclusion I does not logically follow, as reducing food wastage alone may not completely eradicate hunger due to other factors such as distribution and access to food.

Conclusion II follows because the statement mentions government steps to reduce food waste.

Conclusion III also follows because inefficiencies in the food production system are implied by the mention of wastage before the food reaches consumers.

So, option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to replace the * signs and balance the given equation.

270 * 9 * 3 * 5 * 2 * 4 = 48
questions.question_hi:
* चिह्नों को प्रतिस्थापित करने और दिए गए समीकरण को संतुलित करने के लिए गणितीय चिह्नों का सही संयोजन चुनें।

270 * 9 * 3 * 5 * 2 * 4 = 48
questions.solution:
Using the operators from option (C), the equation becomes 270 ÷ 9 ÷ 3 X 5 + 2 - 4 = 48.

Evaluating from left to right:

• 270 ÷ 9 = 30

• 30 ÷ 3 = 10

• 10 X 5 = 50

• 50 + 2 = 52

• 52 - 4 = 48

The equation is balanced.

questions.question: In a certain code language, if 'WORLD' is coded as 41291523, then what will be the code for 'QUICK' in that language?
questions.question_hi: एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में, यदि 'WORLD' को 41291523 के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है, तो उस भाषा में 'QUICK' के लिए कोड क्या होगा?
questions.solution:
The positional values of alphabets in English series are:

A=1, B=2, C=3, ..., Z=26.

The reverse alphabets are A↔Z, B↔Y, C↔X, and so on.

The pattern followed is that each letter is coded with the positional value of its reverse alphabet.

For 'WORLD':

The reverse of W is D, and its position is 4.

The reverse of O is L, and its position is 12.

The reverse of R is I, and its position is 9.

The reverse of L is O, and its position is 15.

The reverse of D is W, and its position is 23.

So, 'WORLD' is coded as 41291523.

Similarly, for 'QUICK':

The reverse of Q is J, and its position is 10.

The reverse of U is F, and its position is 6.

The reverse of I is R, and its position is 18.

The reverse of C is X, and its position is 24.

The reverse of K is P, and its position is 16.

So, 'QUICK' will be coded as 106182416.

· The green bowl is not made of plastic; Bowl E and B are made of plastic.

So bowl G is of green colour.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the passage and answer the questions:

Living far from one's native place or country often brings with it a quiet but persistent discomfort, most noticeably in the aspect of food. Meals are not merely a means of sustenance; they are deeply tied to memory, culture, and a sense of belonging. When individuals move away from home, they may find themselves surrounded by unfamiliar cuisines, different cooking styles, and altered flavours that fail to resonate with what they have grown up eating. Even when alternatives are available, they rarely replicate the authenticity of home-cooked meals. Over time, this gap between familiarity and availability begins to weigh heavily, turning everyday eating into a reminder of distance rather than comfort.

The absence of one's go-to meal or comfort food can have a surprisingly profound emotional impact. A simple dish, often taken for granted back home, carries with it the warmth of family, tradition, and routine. When that dish becomes inaccessible or is only poorly imitated, it leaves a sense of incompleteness. One may attempt to recreate it, but the difference in ingredients, water, or even cooking conditions often alters the taste. As a result, the experience feels inadequate, almost like a memory that cannot be fully relived. In such moments, food ceases to satisfy the soul, even if it fills the stomach.

Moreover, this culinary disconnect gradually intensifies the feeling of displacement. Social gatherings, festivals, and even daily routines are closely associated with specific foods, and their absence can make one feel detached from their own cultural identity. While people eventually adapt to new cuisines, the longing for familiar tastes never truly disappears. It lingers in small cravings, in comparisons, and in the constant search for something that feels "just right." In this sense, living away from home is not just a geographical shift but an emotional one, where the lack of familiar food becomes a subtle yet powerful reminder of what has been left behind.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the passage and answer the questions:

Living far from one's native place or country often brings with it a quiet but persistent discomfort, most noticeably in the aspect of food. Meals are not merely a means of sustenance; they are deeply tied to memory, culture, and a sense of belonging. When individuals move away from home, they may find themselves surrounded by unfamiliar cuisines, different cooking styles, and altered flavours that fail to resonate with what they have grown up eating. Even when alternatives are available, they rarely replicate the authenticity of home-cooked meals. Over time, this gap between familiarity and availability begins to weigh heavily, turning everyday eating into a reminder of distance rather than comfort.

The absence of one's go-to meal or comfort food can have a surprisingly profound emotional impact. A simple dish, often taken for granted back home, carries with it the warmth of family, tradition, and routine. When that dish becomes inaccessible or is only poorly imitated, it leaves a sense of incompleteness. One may attempt to recreate it, but the difference in ingredients, water, or even cooking conditions often alters the taste. As a result, the experience feels inadequate, almost like a memory that cannot be fully relived. In such moments, food ceases to satisfy the soul, even if it fills the stomach.

Moreover, this culinary disconnect gradually intensifies the feeling of displacement. Social gatherings, festivals, and even daily routines are closely associated with specific foods, and their absence can make one feel detached from their own cultural identity. While people eventually adapt to new cuisines, the longing for familiar tastes never truly disappears. It lingers in small cravings, in comparisons, and in the constant search for something that feels "just right." In this sense, living away from home is not just a geographical shift but an emotional one, where the lack of familiar food becomes a subtle yet powerful reminder of what has been left behind.

questions.question: Which of the following is the most suitable title for the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: The Rise of Social Media Platforms in the 21<sup>st</sup> century

options.label: B
options.text: The Impact of Interconnected Content on Public Perception

options.label: C
options.text: The Popularity of Short Video Content on Social Media platforms

questions.correct_text: The Impact of Interconnected Content on Public Perception
questions.solution: Among the given options, (b) The Impact of Interconnected Content on Public Perception is the best fit because the passage focuses on how similar content across platforms influences opinions, spreads misinformation, and shapes collective thinking. This central idea is developed across all three paragraphs, particularly in paragraphs 2 and 3. Hence, (b) is the correct answer. Options (a), (c), and (d) are too narrow or do not capture the critical aspect of influence and perception discussed in the passage.
questions.passage:
Directions : Read the passage and answer the questions:

In the digital age, social media has become a powerful force in shaping what people see, think, and discuss. With platforms under Meta Platforms increasingly interconnected, the boundaries between different apps have blurred significantly. Content that appears on Instagram is often repurposed and circulated on YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and Threads. As a result, users across platforms are frequently exposed to the same videos, trends, and narratives, creating a sense that everyone is consuming identical content regardless of where they scroll. This interconnected ecosystem has made content highly transferable, reducing diversity in what people encounter online.

This uniformity of content has deeper implications than mere repetition. When millions of users engage with the same posts, ideas gain rapid visibility and acceptance, often without critical evaluation. In such an environment, fake news or misleading information can spread like wildfire. A single piece of unverified content, once amplified across multiple platforms, begins to appear credible simply due to its widespread presence. Similarly, negative propaganda directed towards an individual or institution can quickly turn into what seems like a unanimous public opinion. The repetition of the same narrative across different apps creates an illusion of truth, making it difficult for users to distinguish between fact and manipulation.

Moreover, algorithms play a crucial role in reinforcing this cycle by promoting content that generates high engagement, often prioritising sensationalism over accuracy. This leads to echo chambers where users repeatedly encounter the same viewpoints, further strengthening their beliefs without exposure to alternative perspectives. Therefore, in an era where content is interconnected and rapidly disseminated, it becomes essential for individuals to be mindful of their digital consumption. One must question the authenticity of what they watch, verify information before accepting it, and avoid blindly sharing content. Responsible consumption is no longer a choice but a necessity, as the information we engage with has the power to shape opinions, influence behaviour, and impact society at large.

This idea is stated in paragraph 3. Hence, (c) is the correct answer. Options (a), (b), and (d) are incorrect as they contradict the passage's discussion of algorithm-driven content repetition.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The security guard remained prepared and alert, diligently patrolling the premises.
questions.solution:
On the ball: This idiom is used to describe someone who is alert, competent, and fully aware of what is going on. In the context of the sentence, if we replace "prepared and alert" with "On the ball," the sentence would read, "The security guard remained on the ball, diligently patrolling the premises." This conveys the idea that the security guard is not only prepared but also actively aware and competent in carrying out their duties. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

On the fence: This idiom means to be undecided or neutral about a situation.

Air rage: This term refers to disruptive or violent behaviour on an aircraft.

Off one's rocker: This idiom means to be crazy or mentally unstable.

When the car came near to (1)/ where she was standing it stopped, (2)/ and out of it stepped two damsels grand dressed. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution: The adverb 'grandly' should be used in place of the adjective 'grand', as it is being used to modify the adjective 'dressed'. Hence, option (c) is the right answer.

questions.solution:
'Speculation' means the process of thinking. 'Contemplation' means being highly concentrated in thought. So, the two words can be used as synonyms of each other. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.
