Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भूकंप के दौरान बॉडी वेव्स के व्यवहार के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: पी-वेव्स प्रकृति में ट्रांसवर्स होती हैं और केवल ठोस पदार्थों के माध्यम से ही यात्रा कर सकती हैं, जो वैज्ञानिकों को पृथ्वी के तरल बाहरी कोर की पहचान करने में मदद करता है।

कथन II: एस-वेव्स प्रकृति में लॉन्गिट्यूडिनल होती हैं और सबसे तेज़ भूकंपीय तरंगें हैं, जो ठोस, तरल और गैसों के माध्यम से यात्रा करने में सक्षम हैं।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: दोनों कथन I और कथन II सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement I nor Statement II is correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I सही है और न ही कथन II सही है

questions.correct_text: Neither Statement I nor Statement II is correct
questions.solution:
Statement I is incorrect.

P-waves, also called Primary waves, are longitudinal waves and not transverse waves. They are the fastest seismic waves and can travel through solids, liquids, and gases. Because they can pass through both solid and liquid layers, they do not directly help identify the liquid outer core.

Statement II is also incorrect.

S-waves, also called Secondary waves, are transverse waves and not longitudinal waves. They are slower than P-waves and can travel only through solid materials. They cannot pass through liquids or gases.

Further insights

• Body waves consist of two types namely P-waves and S-waves.

• P-waves are the first waves recorded by seismographs during an earthquake.

• S-waves create stronger ground shaking compared to P-waves.

• Surface waves travel along the Earth's surface and usually cause the most damage during earthquakes.

• The absence of S-waves in certain regions created the concept of the S-wave shadow zone, which helped reveal the internal structure of the Earth.

questions.question:
Match the Medieval Indian Dynasties (List I) with their specific historical significance or achievements (List II):

List I (Dynasties)List II (Significance)
i) Pala DynastyA) Acted as the frontline defense at Kabul and Gandhara against Turkic invasions.
ii) Gurjara-Pratihara DynastyB) Established Vikramshila University and ended the period of Matsyanyaya.
iii) Rashtrakuta DynastyC) Known for the monolithic Kailasa Temple and dominating both North and South India.
iv) Hindu Shahi DynastyD) Served as a protective shield or bulwark against early Arab expansions for centuries.

Which of the following is the correct matching sequence?
questions.question_hi:
मध्यकालीन भारतीय राजवंशों (सूची I) को उनके विशिष्ट ऐतिहासिक महत्व या उपलब्धियों (सूची II) के साथ मिलाएं:

सूची I (राजवंश)सूची II (महत्व)
i) पाल राजवंशA) तुर्क आक्रमणों के खिलाफ काबुल और गांधार में अग्रिम रक्षा के रूप में कार्य किया।
ii) गुर्जर-प्रतिहार राजवंशB) विक्रमशिला विश्वविद्यालय की स्थापना की और मत्स्यन्याय की अवधि समाप्त की।
iii) राष्ट्रकूट राजवंशC) एकल शिला कैलासा मंदिर के लिए प्रसिद्ध और उत्तर तथा दक्षिण भारत दोनों पर प्रभुत्व रखा।
iv) हिंदू शाही राजवंशD) प्रारंभिक अरब विस्तारों के खिलाफ सदियों तक एक सुरक्षात्मक ढाल या किला के रूप में सेवा की।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही मिलान क्रम है?
questions.solution:
The Pala Dynasty is correctly matched with statement B.

The Pala rulers of Bengal, especially Dharmapala, founded Vikramshila University which became a major centre of Buddhist learning. They also ended the period of Matsyanyaya, a condition of political disorder in Bengal where stronger rulers dominated weaker ones.

The Gurjara-Pratihara Dynasty is correctly matched with statement D.

They played a major role in resisting early Arab invasions in western India after the Arab conquest of Sindh. Because of this resistance, they acted as a protective shield against Arab expansion into the interior of India.

The Rashtrakuta Dynasty is correctly matched with statement C.

The Rashtrakutas were powerful rulers of the Deccan and are famous for constructing the Kailasa Temple at Ellora, a massive monolithic rock-cut temple. They also dominated large parts of both northern and southern India during their peak.

The Hindu Shahi Dynasty is correctly matched with statement A.

The Hindu Shahis ruled regions around Kabul and Gandhara and acted as the first line of defense against Turkic invasions from Central Asia before the establishment of Muslim rule in north-western India.

Further insights

• The Pala rulers were important patrons of Mahayana Buddhism and supported institutions like Nalanda and Vikramshila.

• The Gurjara-Pratihara, Pala, and Rashtrakuta dynasties were involved in the famous Tripartite Struggle for control of Kannauj.

• The Kailasa Temple at Ellora was built during the reign of Rashtrakuta king Krishna I and is carved out of a single rock.

• The Hindu Shahi rulers such as Jayapala and Anandapala fought several battles against Mahmud of Ghazni.

• The Tripartite Struggle shaped the political history of early medieval northern India for nearly two centuries.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes the primary objective of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) as a statutory regulatory body?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा भारत के प्रतिभूति और विनिमय बोर्ड (SEBI) के एक सांविधिक नियामक निकाय के रूप में प्राथमिक उद्देश्य का सर्वोत्तम वर्णन करता है?

options.label: A
options.text: To provide high-interest loans to large corporate houses for infrastructure development
options.text_hi: बड़े कॉर्पोरेट घरानों को अवसंरचना विकास के लिए उच्च ब्याज दर वाले ऋण प्रदान करना

options.label: B
options.text: To protect the interests of investors and promote the development of the securities market
options.text_hi: निवेशकों के हितों की रक्षा करना और प्रतिभूति बाजार के विकास को बढ़ावा देना

options.label: C
options.text: To manage the fiscal deficit of the Union Government and control inflation
options.text_hi: संघ सरकार के वित्तीय घाटे का प्रबंधन करना और मुद्रास्फीति को नियंत्रित करना

options.label: D
options.text: To act as the sole custodian of India's foreign exchange reserves and gold
options.text_hi: भारत के विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार और सोने का एकमात्र संरक्षक के रूप में कार्य करना

questions.correct_text: To protect the interests of investors and promote the development of the securities market
questions.solution:
The primary objective of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) is to protect the interests of investors in the securities market and to regulate and promote the development of the securities market in India. SEBI ensures transparency, fairness, and efficiency in the functioning of stock markets and financial intermediaries.

Further insights

• SEBI was established in 1988 and was given statutory powers through the SEBI Act in 1992.

• SEBI regulates stock exchanges, stock brokers, mutual funds, and other market intermediaries.

• It can impose penalties and take action against insider trading and market manipulation.

• SEBI introduced measures such as electronic trading and disclosure norms to improve market transparency.

• The headquarters of SEBI is located in Mumbai.

questions.question:
With reference to the 'Indian Currency' microsite recently launched by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), consider the following statements:

Statement I: The microsite is designed to serve as a comprehensive digital destination to educate the public about currency design and the specific security features of banknotes.

Statement II: To assist in identifying genuine currency, the portal provides a 360° view of each note along with detailed explanations of features like watermarks and latent images.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
हाल ही में भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (RBI) द्वारा लॉन्च किए गए 'भारतीय मुद्रा' माइक्रोसाइट के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: यह माइक्रोसाइट मुद्रा डिज़ाइन और बैंकनोट्स की विशिष्ट सुरक्षा विशेषताओं के बारे में जनता को शिक्षित करने के लिए एक व्यापक डिजिटल गंतव्य के रूप में डिज़ाइन की गई है।

कथन II: असली मुद्रा की पहचान में सहायता के लिए, पोर्टल प्रत्येक नोट का 360° दृश्य प्रदान करता है साथ ही वॉटरमार्क और लेटेंट इमेज जैसी विशेषताओं के विस्तृत विवरण भी देता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: कथन I और कथन II दोनों सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement I nor Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I सही है और न ही कथन II सही है

questions.correct_text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
questions.solution:
Statement I is correct.

The Reserve Bank of India launched a dedicated "Indian Currency" microsite to educate the public about Indian banknotes. The platform acts as a one-stop digital destination providing reliable information on currency design, security features, and other related aspects of banknotes issued by the RBI.

Statement II is also correct.

One of the key features of the microsite is the interactive 360-degree view of banknotes, which allows users to closely examine each note and understand important security features such as watermarks, latent images, micro-lettering, and color-shifting ink.

Further insights

• The microsite is accessible through the portal indiancurrency.rbi.org.in.

• It includes multimedia tools such as videos, animations, and interactive games to improve financial literacy.

• A dedicated section explains procedures for exchanging damaged or old banknotes.

• The initiative helps reduce the circulation of counterfeit currency by educating the public.

• The platform complements RBI's broader financial awareness initiatives such as "RBI Kehta Hai" and the MANI (Mobile Aided Note Identifier) app.

questions.question: The historical text 'Humayun-nama', which provides a rare insight into the domestic life of the Mughal royal household, was authored by:
questions.question_hi: ऐतिहासिक ग्रंथ 'हुमायुन-नामा', जो मुग़ल शाही परिवार के घरेलू जीवन की एक दुर्लभ झलक प्रदान करता है, इसके लेखक थे:
questions.solution:
The book Humayun-nama was written by Gulbadan Begum, who was the daughter of Babur and the half-sister of Humayun. She wrote this work during the reign of Emperor Akbar at his request. The text is an important historical source because it provides details about the life of Humayun and the internal affairs of the Mughal royal family.

Further insights

• Humayun-nama was originally written in Persian.

• The book provides a rare female perspective on Mughal court life.

• Gulbadan Begum later participated in a pilgrimage to Mecca during Akbar's reign.

• Babur wrote his own autobiography known as Baburnama.

• Akbar encouraged the recording of historical works to preserve the history of the Mughal Empire.

questions.question:
With reference to Mendel's Laws of Inheritance, consider the following statements:

Statement I: The Law of Segregation posits that the two alleles for a specific trait separate during the formation of gametes, ensuring a offspring receives only one allele from each parent.

Statement II: The Law of Independent Assortment states that the inheritance of an allele for one trait does not affect the inheritance of an allele for another trait.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
मेंडेल के वंशानुक्रम के नियमों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: पृथक्करण का नियम यह कहता है कि किसी विशेष लक्षण के दो एलील युग्माणु के निर्माण के दौरान अलग हो जाते हैं, जिससे संतान को प्रत्येक माता-पिता से केवल एक एलील प्राप्त होता है।

कथन II: स्वतंत्र संयोजन का नियम यह कहता है कि एक लक्षण के लिए एलील का वंशानुक्रम दूसरे लक्षण के लिए एलील के वंशानुक्रम को प्रभावित नहीं करता।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: कथन I और कथन II दोनों सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement I nor Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I सही है और न ही कथन II सही है

questions.correct_text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
questions.solution:
Statement I is correct.

The Law of Segregation, proposed by Gregor Mendel, states that each organism possesses two alleles for a trait and these alleles separate during the formation of gametes. As a result, each gamete carries only one allele for that trait, and the offspring receives one allele from each parent.

Statement II is also correct.

The Law of Independent Assortment states that genes for different traits are inherited independently of one another during gamete formation, provided the genes are located on different chromosomes or are far apart on the same chromosome.

Further insights

• Gregor Mendel conducted his experiments using pea plants in the 19th century.

• The Law of Dominance explains why dominant traits appear in the F1 generation.

• The Law of Independent Assortment applies mainly to genes located on different chromosomes.

• Linked genes located on the same chromosome may not follow independent assortment.

• Mendel's work laid the foundation for the modern field of genetics.

questions.question:
In the following question, a statement of Assertion (A) is followed by a statement of Reason (R). Mark the correct choice.

Assertion (A): The Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) are fundamental in the governance of the country, yet they are non-justiciable in a court of law.

Reason (R): The primary objective of the DPSP is to transition the Indian administration from a "Police State" into a "Welfare State" by ensuring socio-economic justice.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में, एक कथन है - दावे (A) के बाद कारण (R) दिया गया है। सही विकल्प चुनें।

दावा (A): राज्य नीति के निर्देशात्मक सिद्धांत (DPSP) देश के शासन में मौलिक हैं, फिर भी वे न्यायालय में न्यायोचित नहीं हैं।

कारण (R): DPSP का मुख्य उद्देश्य भारतीय प्रशासन को "पुलिस राज्य" से "कल्याणकारी राज्य" में बदलना है, जो सामाजिक-आर्थिक न्याय सुनिश्चित करता है।

options.label: A
options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
options.text_hi: दोनों (A) और (R) सही हैं और (R) (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण है

options.label: B
options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
options.text_hi: दोनों (A) और (R) सही हैं लेकिन (R) (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है

questions.correct_text: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
questions.solution:
Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).

Assertion (A) is correct.

The Directive Principles of State Policy are described in Article 37 of the Constitution as fundamental in the governance of the country. However, they are non-justiciable, meaning they cannot be enforced by courts if the government fails to implement them.

Reason (R) is also correct.

The main aim of the Directive Principles is to establish a welfare state by promoting social and economic justice. They guide the government in creating policies that improve living standards, reduce inequality, and provide social welfare.

However, Reason (R) does not explain why the Directive Principles are non-justiciable.

The reason they are non-justiciable is because the Constitution intentionally made them guidelines rather than enforceable rights, allowing the government flexibility in implementing them based on resources and priorities.

Further insights

• Directive Principles are mentioned in Part IV of the Indian Constitution from Articles 36 to 51.

• They were inspired by the Directive Principles of the Irish Constitution.

• Fundamental Rights are justiciable whereas Directive Principles are non-justiciable.

• The Supreme Court in the Minerva Mills case emphasized harmony between Fundamental Rights and Directive Principles.

questions.question: Which of the following pairs of "Minerals and their Primary Ore/Source" is incorrectly matched?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा "खनिज और उनका प्राथमिक अयस्क/स्रोत" जोड़ा गलत मेल खाता है?
questions.solution:
Cinnabar is not an ore of copper. It is the primary ore of mercury. Copper is mainly extracted from ores such as chalcopyrite, cuprite, and malachite.

Bauxite is correctly matched. Bauxite is the principal ore of aluminium and is widely used for aluminium extraction through the Bayer and Hall - Héroult processes.

Hematite is correctly matched. Hematite is one of the most important ores of iron and contains a high percentage of iron, making it widely used in iron production.

Galena is correctly matched. Galena is the most important ore of lead and contains lead sulfide.

Further insights

• Bauxite is a sedimentary rock that mainly contains aluminium oxides.

• Hematite has a high iron content and gives a reddish color when powdered.

• Galena often contains traces of silver along with lead.

• Chalcopyrite is the most common ore used for copper extraction.

questions.question: Which of the following pairs regarding the 'Loss of Citizenship' is incorrectly matched?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से 'नागरिकता की हानि' के संबंध में कौन सा जोड़ा गलत मेल खाता है?

options.label: A
options.text: Renunciation  -  Voluntarily giving up citizenship through a formal declaration.
options.text_hi: त्याग - एक औपचारिक घोषणा के माध्यम से स्वेच्छा से नागरिकता छोड़ना।

options.label: B
options.text: Termination  -  Automatic loss of citizenship upon acquiring the nationality of another country.
options.text_hi: समाप्ति - किसी अन्य देश की नागरिकता प्राप्त करने पर स्वचालित रूप से नागरिकता का नुकसान।

options.label: C
options.text: Deprivation  -  Compulsory removal of citizenship by the government due to fraud or disloyalty.
options.text_hi: वंचना - धोखाधड़ी या अविश्वास के कारण सरकार द्वारा नागरिकता को जबरन हटाना।

options.label: D
options.text: Incorporation of Territory  -  Losing citizenship by residing in a foreign country for more than six months.
options.text_hi: क्षेत्र का समावेशन - किसी विदेशी देश में छह महीने से अधिक रहने पर नागरिकता खोना।

questions.correct_text: Incorporation of Territory  -  Losing citizenship by residing in a foreign country for more than six months.
questions.solution:
Incorporation of Territory does not refer to losing citizenship due to residence in another country. Instead, it refers to a situation where a new territory becomes part of India. In such cases, the Government of India specifies who among the people of that territory will become citizens of India.

Further insights

• The Citizenship Act, 1955 governs acquisition and loss of Indian citizenship.

• India does not permit full dual citizenship.

• Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) is not the same as dual citizenship.

• Termination of citizenship applies mainly to adult citizens who voluntarily acquire foreign nationality.

• Deprivation of citizenship can occur only after following a legal procedure by the central government.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes an 'Ecotone' in an environmental context?
questions.question_hi: पर्यावरणीय संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'इकोटोन' का सबसे अच्छा वर्णन करता है?

options.label: A
options.text: A specific region where only a single species can survive due to extreme weather.
options.text_hi: एक विशिष्ट क्षेत्र जहाँ केवल A ही प्रजाति अत्यधिक मौसम के कारण जीवित रह सकती है।

options.label: B
options.text: A man-made ecosystem designed specifically for urban vertical farming.
options.text_hi: एक मानव-निर्मित पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र जो विशेष रूप से शहरी ऊर्ध्वाधर खेती के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है।

options.label: C
options.text: The deepest part of an ocean where sunlight cannot reach.
options.text_hi: महासागर का सबसे गहरा हिस्सा जहाँ सूर्य का प्रकाश नहीं पहुँच पाता।

options.label: D
options.text: A transition area or junction between two or more diverse biological communities.
options.text_hi: दो या अधिक विविध जैविक समुदायों के बीच एक संक्रमण क्षेत्र या जंक्शन।

questions.correct_text: A transition area or junction between two or more diverse biological communities.
questions.solution:
An Ecotone is a transitional zone where two different ecosystems or biological communities meet and interact. This region often contains species from both ecosystems and sometimes unique species that are specially adapted to the transitional environment.

Further insights

• Ecotones often have greater biodiversity than the adjacent ecosystems.

• The increased diversity in ecotones is known as the edge effect.

• Examples include forest-grassland boundaries and estuaries where rivers meet the sea.

• Ecotones can be narrow or wide depending on environmental conditions.

• They play an important role in ecological balance and species interaction.

questions.question: Which term describes the pattern of arrangement of leaves on the stem or branch of a plant?
questions.question_hi: पत्तियों के तने या शाखा पर व्यवस्थित होने के पैटर्न को कौन सा शब्द दर्शाता है?
questions.solution:
Phyllotaxy refers to the arrangement or pattern of leaves on the stem or branch of a plant. This arrangement helps ensure that leaves receive maximum sunlight and proper air circulation for photosynthesis.

Venation

it refers to the arrangement of veins in the leaf blade, not the arrangement of leaves on the stem.

Placentation

it describes the arrangement of ovules inside the ovary of a flower.

Inflorescence

it refers to the arrangement of flowers on the floral axis or stem.

Further insights

• There are three main types of phyllotaxy: alternate, opposite, and whorled.

• Alternate phyllotaxy means a single leaf grows at each node in an alternating pattern.

• Opposite phyllotaxy means two leaves grow at the same node on opposite sides.

• Whorled phyllotaxy means more than two leaves arise from the same node.

• Phyllotaxy helps plants reduce shading of lower leaves and improve light absorption.

questions.question: What is the approximate escape velocity required for a spacecraft to completely break free from Earth's gravitational influence?
questions.question_hi: पृथ्वी के गुरुत्वाकर्षण प्रभाव से पूरी तरह मुक्त होने के लिए एक अंतरिक्ष यान को आवश्यक अनुमानित पलायन वेग क्या है?
questions.solution:
Escape velocity is the minimum velocity required for an object to completely overcome the gravitational pull of a planet without further propulsion. For Earth, this velocity is approximately 11.2 kilometers per second.

The value of escape velocity depends on the mass and radius of the planet. Earth's strong gravity requires a relatively high escape speed compared to smaller celestial bodies like the Moon.

Further insights

• Escape velocity of the Moon is about 2.38 km/s, which is much lower due to its smaller mass.

• Escape velocity does not depend on the mass of the object being launched.

• The formula for escape velocity is derived from gravitational potential energy and kinetic energy.

• If atmospheric resistance is ignored, the same escape velocity applies regardless of launch direction.

• Large planets like Jupiter have extremely high escape velocities because of their massive gravitational pull.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new chief head coach of the Indian Women's Hockey Team as of January 2026?
questions.question_hi: जनवरी 2026 तक भारतीय महिला हॉकी टीम के नए मुख्य मुख्य कोच के रूप में किसे नियुक्त किया गया है?
questions.solution:
Sjoerd Marijne has been officially appointed as the head coach (chief coach) of the Indian Women's Hockey Team in January 2026. He previously coached the Indian women to a historic 4th place finish at the Tokyo Olympics and has returned to strengthen the squad ahead of major events.

Further Insights

Marijne's appointment comes ahead of the FIH Women's Hockey World Cup Qualifiers in March 2026.

questions.question:
With reference to the traditional Indian festival 'Nuakhai', consider the following statements:

Statement I: It is an agrarian festival celebrated primarily in Western Odisha and Chhattisgarh to welcome the season's new rice harvest.

Statement II: The core ritual involves offering the first grains of the harvest to the presiding deity as a mark of gratitude before communal consumption.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
पारंपरिक भारतीय त्योहार 'नुआखाई' के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: यह एक कृषि आधारित त्योहार है जो मुख्य रूप से पश्चिमी ओडिशा और छत्तीसगढ़ में मौसमी नई धान की फसल का स्वागत करने के लिए मनाया जाता है।

कथन II: मुख्य अनुष्ठान में फसल के पहले अनाज को समुदाय द्वारा सेवन से पहले कृतज्ञता के रूप में अधिष्ठात्री देवता को अर्पित करना शामिल है।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: कथन I और कथन II दोनों सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement I nor Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I सही है और न ही कथन II सही है

questions.correct_text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
questions.solution:
Statement I is correct

Nuakhai is a major agrarian festival celebrated mainly in Western Odisha and also in some parts of Chhattisgarh. It marks the arrival of the new rice harvest and holds great cultural and agricultural significance for the local communities.

Statement II is also correct.

The central ritual of the festival involves offering the first portion of the newly harvested rice to the presiding deity or family deity. Only after this offering is made do people consume the new grain and celebrate with family and community members.

Further insights

• Nuakhai is celebrated on the day following the Ganesh Chaturthi festival.

• The term Nuakhai means eating the new rice.

• The festival strengthens social bonds through family gatherings and community feasts.

• A traditional ceremony called Nuakhai Juhar is performed where people greet elders and seek blessings.

• The festival is also celebrated by Odia communities living outside Odisha.

questions.question: The Cabinet Mission, sent to India in 1946 to negotiate the transfer of power, consisted of three British Cabinet ministers. Who among the following was NOT a member of this mission?
questions.question_hi: कैबिनेट मिशन, जो 1946 में भारत को सत्ता हस्तांतरण के लिए भेजा गया था, में तीन ब्रिटिश कैबिनेट मंत्री शामिल थे। निम्नलिखित में से कौन इस मिशन का सदस्य नहीं था?
questions.solution:
The Cabinet Mission of 1946 was sent by the British Government to India to discuss constitutional reforms and the transfer of power. The mission consisted of three British Cabinet ministers: Lord Pethick-Lawrence, Sir Stafford Cripps, and A. V. Alexander.

Lord Wavell was not part of the Cabinet Mission. He was the Viceroy of India at that time and interacted with the members of the mission, but he was not one of the delegates sent from Britain.

Further insights

• The Cabinet Mission arrived in India in March 1946.

• It proposed a three-tier federal structure consisting of provinces, groups of provinces, and a central union.

• The plan rejected the immediate demand for Pakistan but allowed provincial groupings.

• The Constituent Assembly of India was formed based on the Cabinet Mission Plan.

• The failure of the plan eventually contributed to the partition of India in 1947.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2025:

i) The Bill seeks to include Chandigarh under Article 240, allowing the President to make regulations for its governance.

ii) The amendment aims to provide Chandigarh with an independent legislature similar to Puducherry.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
संविधान (131वां संशोधन) विधेयक, 2025 के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) यह विधेयक चंडीगढ़ को अनुच्छेद 240 के अंतर्गत लाने का प्रयास करता है, जिससे राष्ट्रपति को इसके शासन के लिए नियम बनाने की अनुमति मिलती है।

ii) यह संशोधन चंडीगढ़ को पुडुचेरी के समान एक स्वतंत्र विधानमंडल प्रदान करने का उद्देश्य रखता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
The Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2025 proposed bringing the Union Territory of Chandigarh under Article 240 of the Constitution. Article 240 empowers the President of India to make regulations for the peace, progress and good governance of certain Union Territories.

If Chandigarh is included under Article 240:

The President can directly frame regulations for Chandigarh.

These regulations would have the same force as an Act of Parliament.

It would align Chandigarh with UTs that do not have legislatures.

Statement ii is Incorrect

The amendment does not aim to create an independent legislature for Chandigarh.

The proposal actually moves Chandigarh towards a governance model similar to UTs without legislatures, where administration is done through Presidential regulations and an administrator.

Further Insights

Article 240 allows the President to make regulations for certain UTs such as Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, and Dadra & Nagar Haveli & Daman & Diu.

These Presidential regulations can override Acts of Parliament applicable to that UT.

Chandigarh is currently administered by the Governor of Punjab acting as its Administrator.

Some UTs with legislatures include Delhi, Puducherry, and Jammu & Kashmir.

Bringing Chandigarh under Article 240 would place it in the category of UTs governed directly by the Centre without a legislature.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the regional distribution of major crops in India:

Statement i: Wheat is the primary crop of the alluvial soils in West Bengal, making it the leading producer of this food grain.

Statement ii: The fertile plains of Northern India, particularly Uttar Pradesh and Punjab, are the dominant regions for wheat cultivation.

Statement iii: Cotton cultivation is primarily concentrated in the "Black Soil" (Regur) regions of the Deccan Plateau, specifically in Gujarat and Maharashtra.

Statement iv: Tea and Coffee are grown extensively in the flat, waterlogged marshy lands of the Indo-Gangetic plains.

Which of the following combinations is correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में प्रमुख फसलों के क्षेत्रीय वितरण के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन i: पश्चिम बंगाल की अलुवियल मिट्टियों की मुख्य फसल गेहूं है, जो इस खाद्य अनाज का प्रमुख उत्पादक बनाती है।

कथन ii: उत्तरी भारत के उपजाऊ मैदान, विशेष रूप से उत्तर प्रदेश और पंजाब, गेहूं की खेती के प्रमुख क्षेत्र हैं।

कथन iii: कपास की खेती मुख्य रूप से दक्कन पठार के "काली मिट्टी" (रेगुर) क्षेत्रों में केंद्रित है, विशेष रूप से गुजरात और महाराष्ट्र में।

कथन iv: चाय और कॉफी का व्यापक रूप से इंडो-गैंगेटिक मैदानों के समतल, जलजमाव वाले दलदली क्षेत्रों में उगाया जाता है।

निम्नलिखित संयोजनों में से कौन सा सही है?

options.label: A
options.text: Only statements ii and iii are correct
options.text_hi: केवल कथन ii और iii सही हैं

options.label: B
options.text: Only statements i and ii are correct
options.text_hi: केवल कथन i और ii सही हैं

options.label: C
options.text: Only statements ii, iii and iv are correct
options.text_hi: केवल कथन ii, iii और iv सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Only statements i, iii and iv are correct
options.text_hi: केवल कथन i, iii और iv सही हैं

questions.correct_text: Only statements ii and iii are correct
questions.solution:
Statement ii is correct.

The fertile alluvial plains of Northern India, particularly Uttar Pradesh and Punjab, are the main regions for wheat cultivation in India. These areas have suitable climate conditions such as cool winters and well-irrigated fertile soils, which support large-scale wheat production.

Statement iii is also correct.

Cotton is mainly grown in regions with black soil, also known as regur soil. These soils retain moisture well and are ideal for cotton cultivation. Major cotton-producing states include Gujarat and Maharashtra in the Deccan Plateau region.

Statement i is incorrect

Because West Bengal is not the leading producer of wheat in India. The state mainly produces rice due to its climatic conditions and abundant rainfall. Wheat production is comparatively limited there.

Statement iv is incorrect

Because tea and coffee are not grown in flat, waterlogged plains. These crops require well-drained soils and are mainly grown in hilly or elevated regions such as Assam, Darjeeling, Nilgiri hills, and the Western Ghats.

Further insights

• India is one of the largest producers of wheat in the world.

• Black soil is rich in minerals and has high moisture-retaining capacity which benefits cotton cultivation.

• Rice is the dominant crop of West Bengal due to high rainfall and fertile deltaic soils.

• Tea plantations in India are mainly found in Assam, West Bengal, and the Nilgiri hills.

• Coffee cultivation in India is concentrated in the hilly regions of Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu.

questions.question:
With reference to the Attorney General (AG) and the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India, consider the following statements:

Statement I: The Attorney General has the right to speak and provide legal advice during the proceedings of both Houses of Parliament, although he does not possess the right to vote.

Statement II: The Comptroller and Auditor General can only be removed from office by the President in the same manner and on the same grounds as a Judge of the Supreme Court.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत के अटॉर्नी जनरल (AG) और नियंत्रक एवं महालेखा परीक्षक (CAG) के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: अटॉर्नी जनरल को संसद के दोनों सदनों की कार्यवाही के दौरान बोलने और कानूनी सलाह देने का अधिकार है, हालांकि उसे मतदान का अधिकार नहीं है।

कथन II: नियंत्रक एवं महालेखा परीक्षक को केवल राष्ट्रपति द्वारा उसी प्रकार और उन्हीं आधारों पर पद से हटाया जा सकता है जैसे कि सुप्रीम कोर्ट के न्यायाधीश को हटाया जाता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: कथन I और कथन II दोनों सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement I nor Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I सही है और न ही कथन II सही है

questions.correct_text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
questions.solution:
Statement I is correct.

The Attorney General of India is the chief legal advisor to the Government of India. According to Article 88 of the Constitution, the Attorney General has the right to participate in the proceedings of both Houses of Parliament, their joint sittings, and any parliamentary committees of which he may be a member. However, he does not have the right to vote.

Statement II is also correct.

The Comptroller and Auditor General of India enjoys strong security of tenure. According to Article 148 of the Constitution, the CAG can be removed from office only by the President in the same manner and on the same grounds as a Judge of the Supreme Court. This means removal requires a special majority in Parliament.

Further insights

• The Attorney General of India is appointed by the President under Article 76 of the Constitution.

• The Attorney General must be qualified to become a judge of the Supreme Court.

• The CAG is known as the guardian of the public purse.

• The CAG audits accounts of the Union government, state governments, and public sector undertakings.

• The reports of the CAG are examined by the Public Accounts Committee of Parliament.

questions.question: Which of the following pairs of "Books and Authors" is incorrectly matched?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित "पुस्तकें और लेखक" के जोड़ों में से कौन सा गलत मेल खाता है?

options.label: D
options.text: Annihilation of Caste  -  B. R. Ambedkar
options.text_hi: जाति का विनाश - बी. आर. अम्बेडकर

questions.solution:
The book Satyarth Prakash was written by Swami Dayanand Saraswati, the founder of the Arya Samaj, and not by Swami Vivekananda. The book was written in 1875 and it presents the philosophy of the Arya Samaj and advocates a return to the teachings of the Vedas.

Tuhfat-ul-Muwahhidin was written by Raja Ram Mohan Roy. It is one of his early works where he discussed the concept of monotheism and criticized idol worship.

Gita Rahasya was written by Bal Gangadhar Tilak while he was imprisoned in Mandalay. In this book, he interpreted the Bhagavad Gita and emphasized the philosophy of Karma Yoga, which focuses on performing one's duty.

Annihilation of Caste was written by B. R. Ambedkar. In this work, he strongly criticized the caste system and argued for social equality and justice.

Further insights

• Raja Ram Mohan Roy is known as the father of the Indian Renaissance and founded the Brahmo Samaj.

• Swami Dayanand Saraswati established the Arya Samaj in 1875 to promote Vedic values.

• Bal Gangadhar Tilak popularized the slogan Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it.

• B. R. Ambedkar was the chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constitution.

• Annihilation of Caste was originally prepared as a speech for a reformist conference but was later published as a book.

questions.question:
Match the famous Sports Trophies/Events (List I) with their respective Sports (List II):

List I (Trophy/Event)List II (Sport)
i) Beighton CupA) Polo
ii) Thomas CupB) Rowing (Snake Boat Race)
iii) Ezra CupC) Hockey
iv) Nehru TrophyD) Badminton

Which of the following is the correct matching sequence?
questions.question_hi:
प्रसिद्ध खेल ट्रॉफी/इवेंट्स (सूची I) को उनके संबंधित खेलों (सूची II) के साथ मिलाएं:

सूची I (ट्रॉफी/इवेंट)सूची II (खेल)
i) बेइगटन कपA) पोलो
ii) थॉमस कपB) रोइंग (स्नेक बोट रेस)
iii) एजरा कपC) हॉकी
iv) नेहरू ट्रॉफीD) बैडमिंटन

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही मिलान क्रम है?
questions.solution:
The Beighton Cup is correctly matched with Hockey.

It is one of the oldest field hockey tournaments in India and is traditionally associated with Kolkata. The tournament has a long history and has been an important competition in Indian hockey.

The Thomas Cup is correctly matched with Badminton.

It is the world men's team championship in badminton and is organized by the Badminton World Federation.

The Ezra Cup is correctly matched with Polo.

It is one of the prestigious polo tournaments in India and has historically been associated with polo competitions held in Kolkata.

The Nehru Trophy is correctly matched with Rowing (Snake Boat Race).

It is associated with the famous Nehru Trophy Boat Race held annually in Kerala on the Punnamada Lake where traditional snake boats compete.

Further insights

• The Thomas Cup was first held in 1948 - 49 and is often called the World Men's Team Championship in badminton.

• The Nehru Trophy Boat Race started in 1952 after Jawaharlal Nehru witnessed a snake boat race in Kerala.

• The Beighton Cup tournament began in 1895 making it one of the oldest hockey tournaments.

• The Ezra Cup polo tournament is traditionally associated with the Calcutta Polo Club.

• The Nehru Trophy Boat Race is held annually on Punnamada Lake in Alappuzha, Kerala.

questions.question:
With reference to the 'Paradox of Thrift' in macroeconomics, consider the following statements:

Statement I: According to this theory, an increase in the individual saving rate during a recession leads to a decrease in the total national income and aggregate demand.

Statement II: The paradox suggests that while saving is a virtue for a single person, it can become a vice for the collective economy if it leads to lower overall consumption and production.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
मैकроइकॉनॉमिक्स में 'पैरेडॉक्स ऑफ थ्रिफ्ट' के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: इस सिद्धांत के अनुसार, मंदी के दौरान व्यक्तिगत बचत दर में वृद्धि से कुल राष्ट्रीय आय और समग्र मांग में कमी आती है।

कथन II: यह पैरेडॉक्स सुझाव देता है कि जबकि बचत एक व्यक्ति के लिए गुण है, यह सामूहिक अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए दोष बन सकती है यदि इससे कुल उपभोग और उत्पादन कम हो जाता है।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: कथन I और कथन II दोनों सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement I nor Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I सही है और न ही कथन II सही है

questions.correct_text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
questions.solution:
Statement I is correct.

The Paradox of Thrift, a concept associated with John Maynard Keynes, explains that when individuals increase their savings during an economic slowdown, overall consumption in the economy decreases. Since consumption is a major component of aggregate demand, a fall in spending leads to lower production, reduced income, and possibly unemployment, which ultimately reduces total national income.

Statement II is also correct.

The paradox highlights that saving is beneficial for an individual because it increases personal financial security. However, when many individuals increase savings simultaneously, total spending in the economy falls, which reduces production and economic growth.

Further insights

• The concept of the Paradox of Thrift was popularized by economist John Maynard Keynes.

• Consumption is the largest component of aggregate demand in most economies.

• During recessions, governments often encourage spending to stimulate economic activity.

• Fiscal stimulus policies such as tax cuts or public spending are used to counter reduced consumption.

• The paradox mainly applies in the short run when economic resources are underutilized.

questions.question:
With reference to the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species (CITES), consider the following statements:

Statement I: CITES is a legally binding international organization that aims to ensure that cross-border trade in wild animals and plants does not endanger their survival.

Statement II: Species listed under Appendix I of the convention, such as the Asian Elephant and the Tiger, are subject to a total ban on international commercial trade.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार में संकटग्रस्त प्रजातियों पर सम्मेलन (CITES) के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: CITES एक कानूनी रूप से बाध्यकारी अंतरराष्ट्रीय संगठन है जिसका उद्देश्य यह सुनिश्चित करना है कि जंगली जानवरों और पौधों का सीमा पार व्यापार उनके अस्तित्व के लिए खतरा न बने।

कथन II: सम्मेलन के परिशिष्ट I में सूचीबद्ध प्रजातियाँ, जैसे कि एशियाई हाथी और बाघ, अंतरराष्ट्रीय वाणिज्यिक व्यापार पर पूरी तरह से प्रतिबंधित हैं।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: दोनों कथन I और कथन II सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement I nor Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I सही है और न ही कथन II सही है

questions.solution:
Statement I is incorrect.

CITES is not an international organization; it is an international agreement or convention between governments. Although the provisions of the convention are legally binding on the member countries, CITES itself functions as a treaty framework rather than as a separate organization.

Statement II is correct.

Species listed under Appendix I of CITES are considered the most endangered species threatened with extinction. International commercial trade in these species is generally prohibited except under very special circumstances such as scientific research.

Further insights

• CITES came into force in 1975 to regulate international wildlife trade.

• Species under Appendix II are not necessarily threatened with extinction but require controlled trade.

• Appendix III includes species protected in at least one country that has asked other CITES parties for assistance in controlling trade.

• India is a signatory to CITES and implements its provisions through the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972.

• The CITES Secretariat is administered by the United Nations Environment Programme and is located in Geneva.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding data transmission methods in computer networks:

Statement I: In Asynchronous transmission, data is sent in a continuous stream without any gaps, relying on a shared internal clock signal between the sender and the receiver.

Statement II: Synchronous transmission uses "Start" and "Stop" bits to frame each byte of data, allowing the receiver to know exactly when a new block of information begins and ends.
questions.question_hi:
कंप्यूटर नेटवर्क में डेटा ट्रांसमिशन विधियों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: एसिंक्रोनस ट्रांसमिशन में, डेटा को बिना किसी अंतराल के निरंतर प्रवाह में भेजा जाता है, जो प्रेषक और रिसीवर के बीच साझा आंतरिक क्लॉक सिग्नल पर निर्भर करता है।

कथन II: सिंक्रोनस ट्रांसमिशन प्रत्येक डेटा बाइट को फ्रेम करने के लिए "स्टार्ट" और "स्टॉप" बिट्स का उपयोग करता है, जिससे रिसीवर को पता चलता है कि जानकारी का नया ब्लॉक कब शुरू होता है और कब समाप्त होता है।

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: कथन I और कथन II दोनों सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement I nor Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I सही है और न ही कथन II सही है

questions.correct_text: Neither Statement I nor Statement II are correct
questions.solution:
Statement I is incorrect.

Asynchronous transmission does not send data in a continuous stream. In this method, data is transmitted character by character with gaps between them. It does not rely on a shared clock signal. Instead, each character is framed with start and stop bits to help the receiver identify the beginning and end of the data unit.

Statement II is also incorrect.

Synchronous transmission does not use start and stop bits for each byte. Instead, it sends data in a continuous stream or blocks with the help of a synchronized clock signal between the sender and receiver. This allows efficient high-speed data transfer.

Further insights:

• Asynchronous transmission is commonly used in serial communication such as keyboard and modem communication.

• Synchronous transmission is faster and more efficient for large data transfers.

• Start and stop bits help synchronize the receiver in asynchronous communication.

• Synchronous communication requires precise clock synchronization.

• Modern high-speed networks mostly rely on synchronous data transmission techniques.

questions.question: The search engine sends a program called _____ that searches the web pages in the Internet for the keyword.
questions.question_hi: सर्च इंजन _____ नामक एक प्रोग्राम भेजता है जो कि कीवर्ड के लिए इंटरनेट में वेब पेजों की खोज करता है।
questions.solution:
A search engine is a complex program that searches documents containing a specified set of keywords. A search engine basically works in three phases:

• The search engine sends a program (called the spider) that searches the web pages in the Internet for the keyword.

• After the spider fetches the result, another software called the indexer reads these results. The indexer then creates an index based on the words contained in each of the documents returned by the spider.

• After indexing, the search engine presents only the documents matching the search criteria to the user.

questions.question: Which programming language is specifically recognized as the first high-level language and is primarily used for complex scientific and engineering calculations?
questions.question_hi: कौन सी प्रोग्रामिंग भाषा विशेष रूप से पहली उच्च-स्तरीय भाषा के रूप में मान्यता प्राप्त है और मुख्य रूप से जटिल वैज्ञानिक और इंजीनियरिंग गणनाओं के लिए उपयोग की जाती है?
questions.solution:
FORTRAN (Formula Translation) is widely recognized as the first high-level programming language designed specifically for scientific and engineering computations. It was developed in the 1950s by a team led by John Backus at IBM. FORTRAN was created to allow scientists and engineers to write programs using mathematical formulas instead of low-level machine code. It became extremely popular for numerical analysis, scientific simulations, and engineering calculations.

Further insights:

• FORTRAN was first released by IBM in 1957.

• It is widely used in scientific computing and numerical modeling.

• Many early supercomputers used FORTRAN for simulations and calculations.

• COBOL was developed in 1959 mainly for business applications.

questions.question: IPv6 addresses consist of
questions.solution:
IPv6 addresses consist of 128 bits, instead of 32 bits, and include a scope field that identifies the type of application suitable for the address.

The IPv4 address is a 32-bit number that uniquely identifies a network interface on a machine. An IPv4 address is typically written in decimal digits, formatted as four 8-bit fields that are separated by periods. Each 8-bit field represents a byte of the IPv4 address.

questions.question: Which system is responsible for translating human-readable website names (like www.google.com) into numerical IP addresses that computers use to identify each other on a network?
questions.question_hi: कौन सा सिस्टम मानव-पठनीय वेबसाइट नामों (जैसे www.google.com) को संख्यात्मक IP पतों में अनुवादित करने के लिए जिम्मेदार है, जिसका उपयोग कंप्यूटर नेटवर्क पर एक-दूसरे की पहचान करने के लिए करते हैं?
questions.solution:
DNS is correct. The Domain Name System (DNS) is responsible for converting human-readable domain names such as www.google.com

into numerical IP addresses like 142.250.190.78. Computers communicate using IP addresses, but it is easier for humans to remember domain names. DNS acts like a directory or phonebook of the internet that matches domain names with their corresponding IP addresses.

Further insights:

• DNS was introduced in 1983 to replace earlier host file systems.

• Every website on the internet has a unique IP address.

• DNS servers are organized in a hierarchical structure.

• DNS queries are usually handled automatically when a user enters a web address in a browser.

• Without DNS, users would have to remember numerical IP addresses for every website.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Desktop Operating Systems:

Statement I: macOS is a proprietary operating system developed by Apple that is designed to run exclusively on Mac hardware.

Statement II: Linux is a closed-source operating system where the source code is kept private by a single corporation to ensure system security.
questions.question_hi:
डेस्कटॉप ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: macOS एक स्वामित्व वाला ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम है जिसे Apple द्वारा विकसित किया गया है और जो विशेष रूप से Mac हार्डवेयर पर चलाने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है।

कथन II: Linux एक बंद-स्रोत ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम है जहाँ स्रोत कोड को एक ही निगम द्वारा निजी रखा जाता है ताकि सिस्टम सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित की जा सके।

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: दोनों कथन I और कथन II सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement I nor Statement II are correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I सही है और न ही कथन II सही है

questions.solution:
Statement I is correct.

macOS is a proprietary operating system developed by Apple Inc. It is specifically designed to run on Apple's Macintosh computers. Apple controls both the hardware and software ecosystem, and macOS is officially supported only on Mac devices.

Statement II is incorrect.

Linux is not a closed-source operating system. It is an open-source operating system, meaning its source code is publicly available and can be modified, distributed, and improved by developers around the world. Linux is maintained by a global community and organizations such as the Linux Foundation, not by a single corporation.

Further insights:

• Linux was first created by Linus Torvalds in 1991.

• Popular Linux distributions include Ubuntu, Fedora, and Debian.

• macOS is based on the Unix operating system architecture.

• Linux is widely used in servers, supercomputers, and cloud computing.

• Android operating system is based on the Linux kernel.

questions.question: A solid silver sphere of radius 10 cm is melted and reshaped into smaller spheres, each of radius 2 cm. If the total surface area of all the smaller spheres is k times the surface area of the original sphere, then find k.
questions.question_hi: एक ठोस चांदी का गोला जिसका त्रिज्या 10 सेमी है, उसे पिघलाकर छोटे गोले बनाए जाते हैं, जिनमें से प्रत्येक का त्रिज्या 2 सेमी है। यदि सभी छोटे गोलों का कुल सतही क्षेत्रफल मूल गोले के सतही क्षेत्रफल का k गुना है, तो k का मान ज्ञात करें।
questions.solution:
Let the number of smaller spheres be n

(4/3) X π X 103 = n X (4/3) X π X 23

103 = n X 23

1000 = 8n

n = 125

Total surface area of all smaller spheres

= 125 X 4 X π X 22

= 125 X 16π

= 2000π

Surface area of the original sphere = 4 X π X 102

= 400π

k = (total surface area of all smaller spheres) / (surface area of original sphere)

= 2000π / 400π

= 5

questions.question: The shadow of a tower standing on level ground is found to be 51 m shorter when the Sun's altitude is 60° than when it is 45°. Find the height (in meters) of the tower.

1 = AD/BD

√3 = AD/(AD - 51)

√3AD - 51√3 = AD

AD (√3 - 1) = 51√3

AD = 51√3/(√3 - 1) m

questions.question: A prism has a base that is a right-angled triangle. The legs adjacent to the right angle measure 30 cm and 56 cm. The prism's height is 18 cm and its material density is 4 g/cm3. Find the mass of the prism in kilograms.
questions.question_hi: एक प्रिज्म का आधार एक समकोण त्रिभुज है। समकोण के सन्निकट भुजाएँ 30 सेमी और 56 सेमी मापती हैं। प्रिज्म की ऊँचाई 18 सेमी है और इसके पदार्थ का घनत्व 4 ग्राम/सेमी3 है। प्रिज्म का द्रव्यमान किलोग्राम में ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Area of triangular base = ½·(30·56) = 1/2·1680 = 840 cm2.

Prism volume = base area·height = 840·18 = 15120 cm3.

Mass = density * volume

= 4 g/cm3·15120 cm3;

questions.question: Triangles XYZ and ABC are similar triangle. The areas of triangles XYZ and ABC are 72 cm2 and 162 cm2 respectively. If side XY is 10 cm then what is the value of side AB?

questions.solution:
If two triangles are similar then the ratio of the area of both triangles is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides.

Area of ∆XYZ/Area of ∆ABC = (XY/AB)2

72/162 = (10/AB)2

4/9 = (10/AB)2

questions.question: PQ and RS are two chords of a circle intersecting each other at point T, ∠PTR = 90° and PR = 35 cm. If the length of QT and TR is 15 cm and 21 cm respectively, then what is the length of RS?

questions.solution:
In ∆PRT -

352 = PT2 + 212

PT2 = 1225 - 441 = 784

PT = 28 cm

If two chords of a circle intersect internally or externally, then the product of the lengths of the segments are equal.

PT*QT = ST*TR

28*15 = ST*21

ST = 20 cm

RS = RT + ST = 21 + 20 = 41 cm

questions.question: A rectangular courtyard of length 33.6 m and breadth 21.6 m is paved with identical rectangular slabs. The perimeter of each slab is 208 cm, and the ratio of its length to breadth is 7:6. If 12 workers can each lay 45 slabs per hour, then in how many hours will the paving be completed?
questions.question_hi: 33.6 मीटर लंबे और 21.6 मीटर चौड़े आयताकार आँगन में एक समान आयताकार स्लैब बनायी गई हैं। प्रत्येक स्लैब का परिमाप 208 cm है और उसकी लंबाई और चौड़ाई का अनुपात 7:6 है। यदि 12 कर्मचारी प्रत्येक घंटे 45 स्लैब बना सकते हैं, तो स्लैब बनाने का काम कितने घंटों में पूरा होगा?
questions.solution:
Perimeter of a rectangle = 2(length + breadth)

Let the length and breadth of each slab be 7x cm and 6x cm

2(7x + 6x) = 208

26x = 208

x = 8

Length of slab = 7 X 8 = 56 cm

Breadth of slab = 6 X 8 = 48 cm

Area of one slab = 56 X 48

= 2688 cm2

Area of courtyard = 33.6 m X 21.6 m

= 725.76 m2

= 725.76 X 10000

= 7257600 cm2

Number of slabs = (area of courtyard) / (area of one slab)

= 7257600 / 2688

= 2700

Total slabs laid by 12 workers in 1 hour = 12 X 45

= 540

Required time = total slabs / slabs laid in 1 hour = 2700 / 540

= 5 hours

questions.question: A takes 15 days to complete the work and ratio between the efficiency of B and C to do a work is 2:3. B and C started working together and take 12 days to complete it. If A started working with B first and then C on alternate days then find the number of days required to complete the work?
questions.question_hi: A को कार्य पूरा करने में 15 दिन लगते हैं तथा B और C की कार्य क्षमता के बीच का अनुपात 2:3 है। B और C ने एक साथ कार्य शुरू किया और इसे पूरा करने में उन्हें 12 दिन लगे। यदि A ने पहले B और फिर C के साथ एकांतर दिनों में कार्य शुरू किया, तो कार्य को पूरा करने के लिए आवश्यक दिनों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिये?
questions.solution:
A=15, B+C = 12

Ratio of efficiency between B and C = 2:3

Ratio of days worked between B and C = 3:2

Let B = 3p days, C= 2p days

(1/3p) +(1/2p) = 1/12

8 days work = 52 units

Next (A+B) will work and finish work = 6units

Finally A+C will work for 2/7 days to finish 60 units of work

So, total time taken = 8+1+ 2/7 = 9(2/7) days

PR = 110000 .... (1)

questions.question: A train has a capacity of 600 seats of which 20% are in the Executive Class and the rest being Chair Cars. During one journey, the train was booked to 80% of its capacity. questions.solution:
20% of 600 = 120

So the number of tickets booked in Executive class = 90% of 120 = 108

Total tickets booked = 80% of 600 = 480

So tickets booked in chair cars = 480 - 108 = 372

No of chair cars seats = 600 - 120 = 480

So the percentage = 372/480 x 100 = 77.5%

questions.question: The average score of 30 students is 68. If the five lowest scores average 54 and the five highest scores average 90, what is the average of the remaining 20 scores?

questions.solution:
Total score of all 30 students = 30 X 68 = 2040

Total of lowest 5 scores = 5 X 54 = 270

Total of highest 5 scores = 5 X 90 = 450

Total of remaining 20 scores = 2040 − 270 − 450 = 1320

Average of remaining 20 scores = 1320/20 = 66

questions.question: In a certain code language, "BAD" is coded as "6 3 4". How is the word "ACE" coded in that language?
questions.question_hi: एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में, "BAD" को "6 3 4" के रूप में कोडित किया गया है। उस भाषा में "ACE" को कैसे कोडित किया जाता है?
questions.solution:
a word is encoded by writing the alphabetical positions of its letters in reverse order, then adding 2 to each number. For example, the word "BAD" is encoded as follows:

• Reverse the letters: D, A, B

• Their positions: D = 4, A = 1, B = 2

• Add 2: 4+2 = 6, 1+2 = 3, 2+2 = 4

So "BAD" becomes "6 3 4"

For "ACE":

• Find alphabetical positions: A = 1, C = 3, E = 5.

• Reverse the order: E, C, A (i.e., 5, 3, 1).

• Add 2 to each: 5+2 = 7, 3+2 = 5, 1+2 = 3.

Thus, the encoded form is "7 5 3".

Therefore, the correct answer is option (1).

questions.question:
In a certain code language:

· 'red blue green' => 'r2 b8 g3'

· 'blue yellow orange' => 'b8 y9 o6'

· 'orange red purple' => 'o6 r2 p4'

How is 'purple' written in that language?
questions.question_hi:
एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में:

· 'red blue green' => 'r2 b8 g3'

· 'blue yellow orange' => 'b8 y9 o6'

· 'orange red purple' => 'o6 r2 p4'

'purple' उस भाषा में कैसे लिखा जाता है?
questions.solution:
1) Comparing the first and second phrases, the common word is 'blue' and the common code is 'b8'. So, blue = b8.

2) Comparing the second and third phrases, the common word is 'orange' and the common code is 'o6. So, orange = o6.

3) Comparing the first and third phrases, the common word is 'red' and the common code is 'r2'. So, red = r2

4) In the third phrase, the only remaining word is 'purple', and the only remaining code is 'p4'. Therefore, purple = p4.

questions.question:

Statement:

Large music festivals bring revenue and cultural visibility to a city. However, in several neighbourhood venues, repeated events have led to high noise levels, littering, and strain on local sanitation systems. The city council is now mandating strict sound limits and a refundable cleanliness deposit for organisers.

II. All attendees deliberately litter and ignore civic rules.

Which conclusion necessarily follows?
questions.question_hi:
यहाँ कथन में कुछ समस्या या समस्या का समाधान दिया गया है, आपको दिए गए कथन के लिए उपयुक्त तार्किक निष्कर्ष चुनना है।

कथन:

बड़े संगीत महोत्सव एक शहर में राजस्व और सांस्कृतिक दृश्यता लाते हैं। हालांकि, कई पड़ोस के स्थानों में, बार-बार होने वाले कार्यक्रमों के कारण उच्च ध्वनि स्तर, कूड़ा-करकट, और स्थानीय स्वच्छता प्रणालियों पर दबाव पड़ा है। नगर परिषद अब आयोजकों के लिए सख्त ध्वनि सीमाएँ और वापसी योग्य स्वच्छता जमा राशि अनिवार्य कर रही है।

निष्कर्ष:

I. संगीत महोत्सव जहाँ भी आयोजित होते हैं, हमेशा सामुदायिक जीवन को नष्ट कर देते हैं।

II. सभी उपस्थित लोग जानबूझकर कूड़ा फेंकते हैं और नागरिक नियमों की अनदेखी करते हैं।

III. परिषद महोत्सवों के नकारात्मक प्रभावों को कम करने के लिए नियंत्रण लागू कर रही है।

कौन सा निष्कर्ष अनिवार्य रूप से निकलता है?

options.label: C
options.text: Only conclusions I and III are correct.
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष I और III सही हैं।

options.label: D
options.text: Only conclusions II and III are correct.
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष II और III सही हैं।

questions.solution:
Conclusion I does not follow because the statement speaks about problems in several cases, not an unavoidable outcome everywhere.

Conclusion II does not follow because it claims intention and applies to all attendees, which is not stated.

Conclusion III follows because the statement clearly mentions sound limits and a deposit aimed at reducing harm.

Hence, only III is correct

questions.question:
In each question below is given a statement followed by two courses of action numbered I and II. You have to assume everything in the statement to be true and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the suggested courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.

Statement: Consumers report skin rashes after using a locally sold "herbal" hair oil, and preliminary checks suggest many bottles are unlabelled and sold without any manufacturing details.

Course of action I: Ban the sale of all hair oils in the entire state for one year, including licensed brands.

Course of action II: Advise people to stop bathing for a week so that skin reactions do not occur.
questions.question_hi:
नीचे प्रत्येक प्रश्न में एक कथन दिया गया है जिसके बाद दो कार्यवाही क्रमांकित I और II हैं। आपको कथन में दी गई सभी बातों को सत्य मानना है और कथन में दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर यह निर्णय लेना है कि सुझाई गई कौन-सी कार्यवाही तर्कसंगत रूप से अनुसरण की जानी चाहिए।

कथन: उपभोक्ताओं ने स्थानीय रूप से बेचे जाने वाले "हर्बल" हेयर ऑयल के उपयोग के बाद त्वचा पर रैश की शिकायत की है, और प्रारंभिक जांच से पता चलता है कि कई बोतलें बिना लेबल के और बिना किसी निर्माण विवरण के बेची जा रही हैं।

कार्यवाही I: पूरे राज्य में एक वर्ष के लिए सभी हेयर ऑयल की बिक्री पर प्रतिबंध लगा दें, जिसमें लाइसेंस प्राप्त ब्रांड भी शामिल हैं।

कार्यवाही II: लोगों को सलाह दें कि वे एक सप्ताह तक नहाना बंद कर दें ताकि त्वचा की प्रतिक्रियाएं न हों।

options.label: A
options.text: Only course of action II follows.
options.text_hi: केवल कार्यवाही II का पालन होता है।

options.label: B
options.text: Neither course of action I nor II follows.
options.text_hi: न तो कार्यवाही I का और न ही II का पालन होता है।

options.label: C
options.text: Both courses of action I and II follow.
options.text_hi: दोनों कार्यवाही I और II का पालन होता है।

options.label: D
options.text: Only course of action I follows.
options.text_hi: केवल कार्यवाही I का पालन होता है।

questions.correct_text: Neither course of action I nor II follows.
questions.solution:
Course of action I is not logical because the issue is with unlabelled or suspect products; banning every hair oil, including licensed ones, is unnecessary and excessive.

Course of action II is irrelevant and unsafe; bathing has no direct link to preventing reactions caused by a specific product.

Therefore, neither action I nor II follows, so option b.

questions.question: How many meaningful English words can be formed from P, S, O and T, using each letter mandatorily but only once in each word?
questions.question_hi: P, S, O और T से कितने सार्थक अंग्रेजी शब्द बनाए जा सकते हैं, जिनमें प्रत्येक अक्षर का अनिवार्य रूप से लेकिन प्रत्येक शब्द में केवल एक बार प्रयोग किया गया हो?
questions.solution:
The meaningful English words using letters P, S, O and T without repetition are

OPTS, POST, POTS, SPOT, STOP, TOPS.

OPTS means to choose or decide to do or have something after thinking about it.

POST means the system or organization for collecting and dealing with letters, packages, etc.

POTS (plural form is pots) is a round container that is used for cooking food in.

SPOT means a small round mark on a surface.

STOP means to no longer continue or make something not continue.

TOPS means to be in the highest position on a list because you are the most important, successful, etc.

In the following question, three statements are given and three conclusions are given below these statements. Choose the option which shows the conclusions which logically follow from the given statements, disregarding the commonly known facts.

Statements:

All City are State

All State are Country

All Country are Continent

Conclusions:

I: Some Continent is State.

II: All City are Continent.

III: Some Country is City.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में तीन कथन दिए गए हैं और इन कथनों के नीचे तीन निष्कर्ष दिए गए हैं। उस विकल्प का चयन कीजिए जो सामान्य रूप से ज्ञात तथ्यों की अवहेलना करते हुए, दिए गए कथनों का तार्किक रूप से अनुसरण करने वाले निष्कर्ष/निष्कर्षों को दर्शाता है।

कथन:

सभी City, State हैं।

सभी State, Country हैं।

सभी Country, Continent हैं।

निष्कर्ष:

I: कुछ Continent, State है।

II: सभी City, Continent हैं।

III: कुछ Country, City है।

options.label: A
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है

options.label: B
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष II अनुसरण करता है

options.label: C
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष III अनुसरण करता है

options.label: D
options.text: All conclusions I, II and III follow
options.text_hi: निष्कर्ष I, II और III सभी अनुसरण करते हैं

questions.correct_text: All conclusions I, II and III follow
questions.solution:
Statements:

All City are State

All State are Country

All Country are Continent

Some Continent is State: All State are Country. All Country are Continent. Thus, some Continent is State. So, conclusion I is true.

All City are Continent: All City are State. All State are Country. All Country are Continent. Thus, All City are Continent. So, conclusion II is true.

Some Country is City: All City are State. All State are Country. Thus, Some Country is City. So, conclusion III is true.

Hence, all conclusions I, II and III follow.

questions.question_hi:
दिए गए विकल्पों में से उस संख्या का चयन कीजिये जो निम्नलिखित शृंखला में प्रश्न चिह्न (?) को प्रतिस्थापित कर सकती है।

2, 8, 3, 27, 4, 64, 5, 125, 6, 216, 7, ?
questions.solution:
Here, the 2nd number from the left end is the cube of the 1st number from the left end.

The 4th number from the left end is the cube of the 3rd number from the left end.

The 6th number from the left end is the cube of the 5th number from the left end.

The 8th number from the left end is the cube of the 7th number from the left end.

The 10th number from the left end is the cube of the 9th number from the left end.

The 12th number from the left end is the cube of the 11th number from the left end.

Thus, the cube of 7 is 343.

questions.question_hi:
नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों में, एक या अधिक कथन दिए गए हैं, जिसके बाद चार विकल्प दिए गए हैं, जिनमें से प्रत्येक एक निष्कर्ष देता है जो अनुसरण कर सकता है या नहीं कर सकता है। उस निष्कर्ष का चयन कीजिए, जो निम्नलिखित निष्कर्ष को दर्शाता है।

व्यक्ति परिवार के किसी सदस्य को खोने पर किसी को फूल देते हैं। राजेश ने हाल ही में अपने भाई को एक हादसे में खो दिया है।

options.label: A
options.text: It would be customary to give flowers to Rajesh.
options.text_hi: राजेश को फूल दिए जाने की प्रथा निभानी होगी।

options.label: B
options.text_hi: राजेश को फूल भेंट किए गए।

options.label: C
options.text: The only reason anyone ever receives flowers is that they lost a family member.
options.text_hi: किसी को भी फूल मिलने का एकमात्र कारण यह है कि उन्होंने परिवार के किसी सदस्य को खो दिया।

options.label: D
options.text: Flowers are the only thing that is given to persons who have lost a family member.
options.text_hi: फूल ही एक ऐसी चीज है जो उन लोगों को दी जाती है, जिन्होंने परिवार के किसी सदस्य को खो दिया है।

questions.correct_text: It would be customary to give flowers to Rajesh.
questions.solution: B is incorrect as we have not been told that he was given flowers, so we cannot say this for sure. C is incorrect as the passage gives us one reason for giving someone flowers, which does not automatically imply that it is the only reason to give flowers to someone. D is incorrect as the passage only talks about flowers, not anything else, so we do not know if anything else is given or not in such an event. A is the right answer, as it can be inferred that it would be conventional to give Rajesh flowers, as he has just lost a family member.

questions.question: Which word from the passage is derived by adding a Greek-origin suffix meaning "creation" or "formation" of structures?
questions.solution:
a) Morphogenesis - Correct. The suffix "-genesis" comes from Greek genesis, meaning "origin" or "creation." Morphogenesis specifically refers to the formation of tissues or body structures.

b) Dedifferentiation - Incorrect. This refers to specialized cells reverting to a less specialized state; it emphasizes reversal, not creation.

c) Ontogenetic - Incorrect. Ontogenetic refers to the developmental history of an organism, not specifically the formation of structures at a given time.

d) Apoptosis - Incorrect. Apoptosis refers to programmed cell death, the opposite of tissue formation.

Hence, the correct answer is option (a).
questions.passage:
Directions : Read the following passage and answer the questions based on the passage:

Starfish, members of the class Asteroidea, exhibit a remarkable capacity for regeneration, a phenomenon that has long captivated biologists seeking to elucidate the complex cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying tissue reconstruction and organismal resilience. Unlike many metazoans whose regenerative abilities are confined to localized tissue repair, starfish can reconstruct entire limbs and, in certain circumstances, regenerate complete individuals from fragmented portions of their central disc, provided a sufficient segment of the central body remains intact. This extraordinary regenerative prowess, frequently referred to as autotomy-induced morphogenesis, involves a highly coordinated sequence of events beginning with the dedifferentiation of specialized cells at the site of injury into a pluripotent state, which allows proliferation and subsequent redifferentiation into multiple distinct cell lineages. The ensuing stages encompass the dynamic reorganization of the extracellular matrix, the establishment of polarity axes, and the incremental redevelopment of skeletal ossicles, ambulacral grooves, and water vascular system components indispensable for locomotion, respiration, and feeding. Significantly, regenerative efficiency varies among species, environmental conditions, nutritional status, and the size of the excised fragment, indicating that both intrinsic genetic regulation and extrinsic ecological factors modulate the process. Extensive research has revealed that regenerative success is contingent upon the temporal and spatial expression of evolutionarily conserved genes associated with cellular proliferation, apoptosis inhibition, and morphogen gradient formation, highlighting striking parallels with developmental pathways typically observed during embryogenesis. Moreover, regenerative events are accompanied by elaborate biochemical signalling, including activation of mitogenic factors, cytokines, and transcriptional regulators, which collectively re-establish the complex pentaradial symmetry characteristic of the starfish body plan. Investigations into starfish regeneration thus provide profound insights into developmental plasticity, tissue homeostasis, and the evolutionary persistence of regenerative capacities in echinoderms, offering potential translational implications for regenerative medicine, tissue engineering, and biomimetic design. In this context, regeneration is revealed not merely as a reparative response but as a genetically orchestrated ontogenetic genesis, in which cellular and tissue-level processes are reinitiated, coordinated, and executed to restore functional morphology, exemplifying the latent capacity of adult organisms to recapitulate developmental programs long after initial embryogenesis has concluded, and illustrating the remarkable adaptability and resilience inherent to certain marine invertebrates.

questions.question: Which of the following best illustrates a paradox mentioned in the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: Adult starfish are incapable of any tissue repair yet can survive severe injury.

options.label: B
options.text: Starfish regeneration involves reactivating developmental programs long after embryogenesis.

options.label: C
options.text: Regeneration occurs only in favourable environmental conditions, not through genetic regulation.

options.label: D
options.text: Starfish can regenerate limbs but cannot restore their pentaradial symmetry.

questions.correct_text: Starfish regeneration involves reactivating developmental programs long after embryogenesis.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option (b). The passage highlights the paradox in the statement: "adult organisms [can] recapitulate developmental programs long after initial embryogenesis has concluded." This is paradoxical because developmental programs are typically associated with embryos, yet adult starfish can reactivate them to regenerate entire limbs and even complete individuals.

Option (a) is incorrect because the passage explicitly states that starfish can repair tissues and regenerate limbs.

Option (c) is incorrect because the passage notes that regeneration is influenced by both environmental conditions and genetic regulation, not solely one factor.

Option (d) is incorrect because the passage emphasizes that regeneration re-establishes pentaradial symmetry, so this is not paradoxical but expected.

questions.question:
What grammatical function does the phrase "allows proliferation and subsequent redifferentiation into multiple distinct cell lineages" serve in the sentence?

"This extraordinary regenerative prowess.. involves a highly coordinated sequence of events beginning with the dedifferentiation of specialized cells at the site of injury into a pluripotent state, which allows proliferation and subsequent redifferentiation into multiple distinct cell lineages."
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option (d). The phrase "allows proliferation and subsequent redifferentiation into multiple distinct cell lineages" is part of a verb phrase where "allows" is the main verb, describing the action that dedifferentiated cells can perform. The phrase explains what the pluripotent cells do in the regenerative process.

Option (a) is incorrect because it does not modify a noun directly; "which" introduces the relative clause, but the phrase itself describes an action.

Option (b) is incorrect because it does not function as a purpose clause; it states a capability, not a reason.

Option (c) is incorrect because the phrase is not functioning solely as an object; it is the action enabled by the cells' pluripotent state.

Note:

Relative Clause: A relative clause is one that's connected to the main clause of the sentence by a word such as who, whom, which, that, or whose.

Example: He adopted a puppy that had brown eyes and black fur. The highlighted part is the relative clause.

questions.question:
A sentence is provided in indirect speech. Select the correct direct speech option.

The traveller requested the receptionist to wake him up before the first ferry left the harbour.

options.label: A
options.text: The traveller said to the receptionist, "Please woke me up before the first ferry leaves the harbour."

options.label: B
options.text: The traveller said to the receptionist, "Please wake me up before the first ferry leaves the harbour."

options.label: C
options.text: The traveller said to the receptionist, "Would you wake me up before the first ferry left the harbour?"

options.label: D
options.text: The traveller said to the receptionist, "Please wake him up before the first ferry leaves the harbour."

questions.correct_text: The traveller said to the receptionist, "Please wake me up before the first ferry leaves the harbour."
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option b.

Rule of Speech Conversion:

A request in indirect speech becomes a polite sentence in direct speech.

We usually use "please" or another polite form.

The pronoun changes back to the speaker's point of view.

Example:

Indirect: She requested me to wait outside.

Direct: She said to me, "Please wait outside."

Here, the traveller is speaking about himself.

So "him" changes to "me".

"Requested" shows politeness, so "Please wake me up..." is the best form.

"Left the harbour" returns naturally to "leaves the harbour".

So the correct direct speech is:

The traveller said to the receptionist, "Please wake me up before the first ferry leaves the harbour."

• Option a is wrong because "Please woke" is incorrect. After "please", we use the base verb.

• Option c is wrong because "left the harbour" remains in the reported past form.

• Option d is wrong because "him" should become "me" in direct speech.

Final correct sentence:

The traveller said to the receptionist, "Please wake me up before the first ferry leaves the harbour."

questions.question:
A sentence is provided in indirect speech. Select the correct direct speech option.

The captain suggested that we should review the evacuation map before the storm reached the coast.

options.label: A
options.text: The captain said, "We should review the evacuation map before the storm reached the coast."

options.label: B
options.text: The captain said, "Let we review the evacuation map before the storm reaches the coast."

options.label: C
options.text: The captain suggested, "Let us review the evacuation map before the storm reached the coast."

options.label: D
options.text: The captain said, "Let us review the evacuation map before the storm reaches the coast."

questions.correct_text: The captain said, "Let us review the evacuation map before the storm reaches the coast."
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option d.

Rule of Speech Conversion:

A suggestion for a group action often becomes "Let us..." in direct speech.

This is the common and natural way to show advice or suggestion.

The later action is restored in natural present form.

Example:

Indirect: He suggested that we should leave early.

Direct: He said, "Let us leave early."

Here, the sentence is not an order.

It is a suggestion for everyone together.

So "we should review" changes to "Let us review".

"Reached the coast" becomes "reaches the coast".

So the correct direct speech is:

The captain said, "Let us review the evacuation map before the storm reaches the coast."

• Option a is wrong because "We should review" keeps the reported style.

• Option b is wrong because "Let we" is grammatically incorrect. The correct phrase is "Let us".

• Option c is wrong because "reached the coast" still remains in the reported past form.

Final correct sentence:

The captain said, "Let us review the evacuation map before the storm reaches the coast."
