questions.solution: An Ethernet crossover cable is a crossover cable for Ethernet used to connect computing devices together directly. It is most often used to connect two devices of the same type, e.g. two computers (via their network interface controllers) or two switches to each other.

questions.question: The rules and regulations of any computer digital messages are called as_____
questions.question_hi: किसी भी कंप्यूटर डिजिटल मैसेजों के नियम एवं विनियमों को __________ कहा जाता है।
questions.solution: The proper descriptions of digital message formats as well as rules are known communication protocols. The main function of these protocols is to exchange messages from one computer system to another. These are significant in telecommunications systems as they consistently send and receive messages. These protocols cover error detection & correction, signalling, and authentication. They can also explain the semantics, syntax & brings analog & digital communications together

questions.question: Which MS Excel function returns the current system date and automatically updates whenever the worksheet is recalculated?
questions.question_hi: एमएस एक्सेल का कौन सा फ़ंक्शन वर्तमान सिस्टम तिथि लौटाता है और वर्कशीट के पुनर्गणना होने पर स्वचालित रूप से अपडेट हो जाता है?
questions.solution:
· TODAY() returns only the current date and updates automatically.

· NOW() returns both date and time.

· DATE() constructs a date from year, month, and day values.

· DAY() extracts the day from a given date.

questions.question: Which option in word processing software allows you to make text or objects appear lighter and more transparent in the background?
questions.question_hi: वर्ड प्रोसेसिंग सॉफ़्टवेयर में कौन-सा विकल्प आपको बैकग्राउंड में टेक्स्ट या ऑब्जेक्ट को हल्का तथा अधिक ट्रांसपैरेंट करने की अनुमति देता है?
questions.solution:
In word processing software, the option that allows you to make text or objects appear lighter and more transparent in the background is "Watermark."

· Watermarks are often used for various purposes, such as adding a logo, a stamp of "Confidential," or other background elements to documents to indicate their status, purpose, or branding.

· Watermarks are typically semi-transparent and do not interfere with the readability of the main content.

questions.question: Which one of the following statements regarding device driver is correct?
questions.question_hi: डिवाइस ड्राइवर के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही है?

options.label: A
options.text: It is a type of system software.
options.text_hi: यह एक प्रकार का सिस्टम सॉफ्टवेयर है।

options.label: B
options.text: It ensures proper functioning of a device.
options.text_hi: यह किसी डिवाइस के उचित कामकाज को सुनिश्चित करता है।

options.label: C
options.text: It acts as an interface between the device and the operating system.
options.text_hi: यह डिवाइस और ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम के बीच एक इंटरफेस के रूप में कार्य करता है।

questions.solution: As the name signifies, the purpose of a device driver is to ensure proper functioning of a particular device. When it comes to the overall working of a computer system, the operating system does the work. But everyday new devices and components are being added to a computer system. It is not possible for the operating system alone to operate all of the existing and new devices, where each device has diverse characteristics. The responsibility for overall control, operation and management of a particular device at the hardware level is delegated to its device driver. The device driver acts as an interface between the device and the operating system. It provides required services by hiding the details of operations performed at the hardware level of the device. Just like a language translator, a device driver acts as a mediator between the operating system and the attached device.

questions.question: Which device is used to carry digital data on analog lines?
questions.question_hi: एनालॉग लाइनों पर डिजिटल डेटा ले जाने के लिए किस डिवाइस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution: Modem is a short term for modulator-demodulator. A modem is a device or program that enables a computer to transmit data over, for example, telephone or cable lines. Computer information is stored digitally, whereas information transmitted over telephone lines is transmitted in the form of analog waves.

questions.question: Which of the following is the most common form of IP addressing?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा IP एड्रेसिंग का सबसे सामान्य रूप है?
questions.solution:
A unicast address is an address that identifies a unique node on a network. Unicast addressing is available in IPv4 and Ipv6 and typically refers to a single sender or a single receiver, although it can be used in both sending and receiving.

Unicast is the most common form of IP addressing.

questions.question: _____ storage device is used to store or retrieve data items one after the other, without regard to logical record bounds.
questions.question_hi: लॉजिकल रिकॉर्ड बाउंड के बिना _____ स्टोरेज डिवाइस का प्रयोग डेटा आइटम्स को एक दूसरे के बाद स्टोर या पुनः प्राप्त (रिट्रीव) करने के लिए किया जाता है।
questions.solution:
· A serial (or sequential) access storage device is one that stores files one-by-one in a sequence.

· Serial access is used to store or retrieve data items one after the other, without regard to logical record bounds.

· For each data file opened, the data pointers keep track of the data item currently being accessed.

· As you store or retrieve data, the pointers move serially forward through the data file.

questions.question: Uploading a file means:
questions.question_hi: फ़ाइल अपलोड करने का मतलब है:

questions.correct_text: Sending data from local system to server
questions.solution:
Uploading refers specifically to the process of transferring data from a local computer to a remote server or the Internet.

Explanation:

· When you post a photo on Instagram or send an email attachment, you are Uploading.

· Downloading is the reverse: receiving data from a server to your local system.

Further Insights:

· Internet Service Providers (ISPs) usually offer slower upload speeds than download speeds (Asymmetric connection).

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about search engines:

1) Crawlers index web pages automatically.

2) Search engines store actual web pages permanently.

3) Keywords improve search accuracy.

Which are correct?
questions.question_hi:
सर्च इंजन के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) क्रॉलर वेब पेजों को स्वचालित रूप से इंडेक्स करते हैं।

2) सर्च इंजन वास्तविक वेब पेजों को स्थायी रूप से संग्रहीत करते हैं।

3) कीवर्ड खोज की सटीकता में सुधार करते हैं।

इनमें से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because search engines store a "cache" or index of pages, not the entire live website permanently.

Explanation of Statements:

· 1. is Correct. Search engines use automated scripts called Crawlers (or Spiders) to browse the web and follow links to find new content.

· 2. is Incorrect. Search engines do not store the "actual" pages permanently. They store a snapshot in their Index. If a website is deleted by its owner, it will eventually disappear from the search results too.

· 3. is Correct. The choice of Keywords is the primary way search engines determine the relevance of a page to a user's query.

Further Insights:

· SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is the practice of structuring a website so that crawlers can index it more effectively.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Windows Explorer:

1) File extensions can be hidden by default.

2) Libraries physically store files.

3) Search in Explorer supports filters like date and size.

Which are correct?
questions.question_hi:
विंडोज एक्सप्लोरर के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) फ़ाइल एक्सटेंशन डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से छिपे हो सकते हैं।

2) लाइब्रेरी फ़ाइलों को भौतिक रूप से संग्रहीत करती हैं।

3) एक्सप्लोरर में खोज दिनांक और आकार जैसे फ़िल्टर का समर्थन करती है।

इनमें से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because Libraries are virtual "containers" that point to files stored in other folders.

Explanation of Statements:

· 1. is Correct. By default, Windows hides extensions (like .docx or .jpg) for "known file types" to make the interface look cleaner.

· 2. is Incorrect. Libraries do not store files physically; they aggregate files from different physical locations (like My Documents and a USB drive) into a single view.

· 3. is Correct. The search bar in Windows Explorer allows users to use syntax like size:large or datemodified:yesterday.

Further Insights:

· Enabling "File name extensions" in the View tab is a recommended security practice to avoid clicking on disguised malware (e.g., invoice.pdf.exe).

A scanner is an electronic device which can capture images from physical items and convert them into digital formats, which in turn can be stored in a computer, and viewed or modified using software applications.

questions.question: A right circular cylinder is cut by a plane parallel to its base such that the upper smaller cylinder has half the height of the original cylinder. Find the ratio of the volume of the smaller cylinder to the remaining lower part.

questions.solution:
Volume of a cylinder is directly proportional to its height when radius remains same.

If the smaller cylinder has half the original height, then:

Volume of smaller cylinder = 1/2 Volume of original cylinder

Remaining volume = 1 - ½ = ½

Therefore,

required ratio = ½ : ½

= 1: 1

questions.question: A and B together can do a piece of work in 24 days, B and C together can do the same piece of work in 48 days, and C and A together can do the same piece of work in 12 days. A and B start the work and after working for 10 days, B is replaced by C. Find the total time taken to do the work.
questions.question_hi: एक साथ A और B एक कार्य को 24 दिनों में कर सकते हैं, एक साथ B और C समान कार्य को 48 दिनों में कर सकते हैं तथा एक साथ C और A समान कार्य को 12 दिनों में कर सकते हैं। A और B कार्य शुरू करते हैं और 10 दिनों तक कार्य करने के बाद, B को C से प्रतिस्थापित कर दिया जाता है। कार्य पूरा करने में लिया गया कुल समय ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Total work = L.C.M of 24, 48, and 12 = 48 units

Efficiency = total work/ time taken

Efficiency of A and B = 48/24 = 2

Efficiency of C and A = 48/12 = 4

Work done by A and B in 10 days = 2 * 10 = 20 units

Time taken by A and C to do the remaining work = (48 - 20)/ 4 = 7 days

Total time = 10 + 7 = 17 days

questions.question: Find the volume of a right prism based on a regular hexagon of height 14 cm if its total surface area is 480√3 cm2.

Let a = side of hexagon,

h = 14 cm.

Total surface area TSA = Lateral + 2 * (base area)

480√3 = (perimeter * h) + 2 * (3√3/2 a2)

480√3 = 6a * 14 + 3√3 a2

option (b):

a2 = 48

= 3√3 (4√3)a2 + 84(4√3)

= 3√3 (48) + 84(4√3)

= 144 √3 + 336 √3

= 480 √3

Hence,

option (b) is correct

questions.question_hi: A, B और C की औसत आयु 48 वर्ष है और B, C और D की औसत आयु 52 वर्ष है। यदि A की आयु 20 वर्ष है, तो D की आयु ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Total age of A, B and C = 48 * 3 = 144

Total age of B, C and D = 52 * 3 = 156

Given age of A = 20 years

Age of B and C = 144 - 20 = 124

Age of D = 156 - 124 = 32 years

questions.question: P, Q, and R are the midpoints of the sides AB, BC, and CA of ΔABC respectively. If the area of ΔPQR is 8 cm², what is the area of ΔABC?

questions.solution:
Given, the area of ΔPQR is 8 cm²

By the property of triangle (joining mid point of the sides)

=> Area of ΔABC = 4 * area of ΔPQR = 4 * 8 = 32 cm²

questions.question: Rohan is designing a decorative tent in the shape of a square-based pyramid. The length of each side of the square base is 24 m and the slant height of each triangular face is 10 m. Find the total area of cloth required to cover all four triangular faces of the tent.
questions.question_hi: रोहन एक चौकोर-आधारित पिरामिड के आकार का सजावटी तम्बू डिजाइन कर रहा है। चौकोर आधार के प्रत्येक पक्ष की लंबाई 24 मीटर है और प्रत्येक त्रिभुजाकार चेहरे की तिरछी ऊंचाई 10 मीटर है। तम्बू के चारों त्रिभुजाकार चेहरों को ढकने के लिए आवश्यक कपड़े का कुल क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात करें।
questions.solution:
Area of 1 triangular face = ½ X base edge X slant height

= ½ X 24 X 10

= 12 X 10

= 120 m2

Since the pyramid has 4 triangular faces,

Total canvas required = 4 X 120

= 480 m2

Therefore,

the correct answer is: 480 m2

questions.question: In a coded inequality, if 'L $ M' means 'L is neither greater than nor equal to M', which of the following is true?
questions.question_hi: एक कूटित असमानता में, यदि 'L $ M' का अर्थ है 'L न तो M से बड़ा है और न ही बराबर है', तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सत्य है?
questions.solution:
The statement 'L $ M' rules out two possibilities.

L is not greater than M.

L is not equal to M.

So, the only remaining possibility is that L is smaller than M.

Hence, option (c) is correct.

questions.question: Which code has a digit-letter sequence that doesn't follow a repeated unit?
questions.question_hi: कौन सा कोड एक अंक-अक्षर अनुक्रम है जो दोहराए गए इकाई का पालन नहीं करता?
questions.solution:
A repeated unit means the first complete block must be copied exactly again.

In option (b), 8A3B6D is repeated as 8A3B6D + 8A3B6D.

In option (c), 4F9H1J is repeated as 4F9H1J + 4F9H1J.

In option (d), 6L2N8P is repeated as 6L2N8P + 6L2N8P.

In option (a), the first block is 2C7E5G, but the second block is 2C7E6G.

The digit before G changes from 5 to 6.

Therefore, 2C7E5G2C7E6G does not follow a repeated unit.

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'harvest valley tractor' is coded as 'mi te go' and 'tractor canal orchard' is coded as 'zu go ra'. How is 'tractor' coded in the given language?
questions.question_hi: एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में, 'harvest valley tractor' को 'mi te go' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है और 'tractor canal orchard' को 'zu go ra' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है। दिए गए भाषा में 'tractor' कैसे कोडित है?
questions.solution:
The common word in both given statements is 'tractor'.

The common code in both coded forms is 'go'.

Therefore, 'tractor' is coded as 'go'.

questions.question:
Which of the following letter-number clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series to make it logically complete?

HLP 16, JNR 19, LPT 24, NRV 31, PTX 42, ?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा अक्षर-संख्या समूह दिए गए श्रेणी में प्रश्न चिह्न (?) की जगह लेगा ताकि यह तार्किक रूप से पूर्ण हो सके?

HLP 16, JNR 19, LPT 24, NRV 31, PTX 42, ?
questions.solution:
First letter:

H + 2 = J,

J + 2 = L,

L + 2 = N,

N + 2 = P,

P + 2 = R

Second letter:

L + 2 = N,

N + 2 = P,

P + 2 = R,

R + 2 = T,

T + 2 = V

Third letter:

P + 2 = R,

R + 2 = T,

T + 2 = V,

V + 2 = X,

X + 2 = Z

Number pattern:

16 + 3 = 19

19 + 5 = 24

24 + 7 = 31

31 + 11 = 42

42 + 13 = 55

The increments follow ascending prime numbers: 3, 5, 7, 11, 13

The numbers added are consecutive prime numbers.

Hence, the required cluster is RVZ 55

questions.question:
If 'M' stands for '-', 'N' stands for '+', 'O' stands for '÷', and 'P' stands for 'x', what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

50 N 30 O 5 P 4 M 18 = ?
questions.question_hi:
यदि 'M' का अर्थ '-' है, 'N' का अर्थ '+' है, 'O' का अर्थ '÷' है, और 'P' का अर्थ 'x' है, तो निम्नलिखित समीकरण में प्रश्न चिह्न (?) की जगह क्या आएगा?

50 N 30 O 5 P 4 M 18 = ?
questions.solution:
Given expression: 50 N 30 O 5 P 4 M 18

Symbol meanings:

M → -

N → +

O → ÷

P → X

Rewrite the expression:

= 50 + 30 ÷ 5 X 4 - 18

= 50 + 6 X 4 - 18

= 50 + 24 - 18

= 74 - 18

= 56

questions.question: Based on the alphabetical order, three of the following four are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does not belong to that group? (Note: The odd man out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
questions.question_hi: वर्णमाला क्रम के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित चार में से तीन किसी न किसी तरह से समान हैं और इस प्रकार एक समूह बनाते हैं। वह कौन सा है जो उस समूह से संबंधित नहीं है? (ध्यान दें: अलग तत्व व्यंजन/स्वर की संख्या या अक्षर समूह में उनकी स्थिति पर आधारित नहीं है।)
questions.solution:
(a) ZXTN:

Z (-2) = X;

X (-4) = T;

T (-6) = N. (Pattern: -2, -4, -6)

(c) VTPJ:

V (-2) = T;

T (-4) = P;

P (-6) = J. (Pattern: -2, -4, -6)

(d) SQMG:

S (-2) = Q;

Q (-4) = M;

M (-6) = G. (Pattern: -2, -4, -6)

Checking Option b:

(b) OMID:

O (-2) = M;

M (-4) = I;

I (-5) = D. (Pattern: -2, -4, -5)

Since option (b) deviates from the -2, -4, -6 shift pattern for the final letter, it is the odd one out.

questions.question: If NOVEL is coded as the sum of mirror positions of letters at odd places and normal positions of letters at even places, what will be the code?

questions.solution:
ABCDEFGHIJKLM
12345678910111213
26252423222120191817161514
ZYXWVUTSRQPON

Odd-place letters are N, V and L.

Even-place letters are O and E.

Mirror position of N = 13

Normal position of O = 15

Mirror position of V = 5

Normal position of E = 5

Mirror position of L = 15

Code = 13 + 15 + 5 + 5 + 15 = 53

questions.question:
A question is given, followed by two statements numbered (I) and (II). You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements is sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and select the appropriate answer.

Question: Six people have different heights when compared to each other. No two people are of the same height. Who among the following is the tallest?

Statements:

(I) Only two people are taller than Ram. John is taller than Tinu but shorter than Ram. Geeta is taller than John but shorter than Ram. Jia is taller than Ram.

(II) At least four people are shorter than Jia. Geeta is taller than John and Tinu. Ram is taller than Geeta but shorter than Jia.
questions.question_hi:
एक प्रश्न दिया गया है, जिसके बाद दो कथन संख्यांकित (I) और (II) दिए गए हैं। आपको यह निर्धारित करना है कि कथनों में दी गई जानकारी प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है या नहीं। दोनों कथनों को पढ़ें और उचित उत्तर चुनें।

प्रश्न: एक-दूसरे की तुलना में करने पर छह व्यक्तियों के कद अलग-अलग हैं। कोई भी दो व्यक्ति समान कद के नहीं हैं। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सबसे लंबा है?

कथन:

(I) केवल दो व्यक्ति राम से लम्बे हैं। जॉन, टीनू से लंबा है लेकिन राम से नाटा है। गीता, जॉन से लम्बी है लेकिन राम से नाटी है। जिया, राम से लम्बी है।

(II) कम से कम चार व्यक्ति जिया से नाटे हैं। गीता, जॉन और टीनू से लम्बी है। राम, गीता से लंबा है लेकिन जिया से नाटा है।

options.label: A

options.label: B
options.text: Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not.
options.text_hi: अकेले कथन II में दी गई जानकारी प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि अकेले कथन I में दी गई जानकारी प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।

options.label: C
options.text: Data in statements I and II together is sufficient to answer the question.

options.text: Data in statements I and II together is not sufficient to answer the question.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statement:

Some Table is chairs.

All Chairs are Fan

No Fan is Desk

Conclusion:

II. All Table can never be Desk
questions.question_hi:
दिये गये कथनों और निष्कर्षों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िये। यह मानते हुए कि कथनों में दी गई जानकारी सत्य है, भले ही यह सर्वज्ञात तथ्यों से भिन्न प्रतीत होती हों, निर्धारित कीजिये कि दिये गये निष्कर्षों में से कौन-सा/से निष्कर्ष कथनों का तार्किक रूप से अनुसरण करता/करते है/हैं।

Assertion: Travelling solo can have a positive impact on your personality.

questions.question_hi:

questions.question:

928 ÷ 4 - 24 x 8 + 86 = 126
questions.question_hi:

questions.question:
In the question given below, there are two statements (i) and (ii). These statements may be either independent causes or may be effects of independent causes or a common cause. One of these statements may be the effect of the other statement. Read both the statements and decide which of the following answer choices correctly depicts the relationship between these two statements.

Statements:

I. Excess fat in your blood can lead to chronic liver inflammation and long-term liver damage.

II. Consuming too many calories, especially from high-calorie foods, drinks and getting less sleep, which can make it harder to control appetite.
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दिए गए प्रश्न में दो कथन (i) और (ii) दिए गए हैं। ये कथन या तो स्वतंत्र कारण हो सकते हैं या स्वतंत्र कारणों या किसी सामान्य कारण के प्रभाव हो सकते हैं। इनमें से एक कथन दूसरे कथन का प्रभाव हो सकता है। दोनों कथनों को पढ़ें और निर्धारित करें कि निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा उत्तर विकल्प इन दो कथनों के बीच के संबंध को सही ढंग से दर्शाता है।

कथन:

I. आपके रक्त में अतिरिक्त वसा से जीर्ण यकृत सूजन और दीर्घकालिक यकृत क्षति हो सकती है।

II. बहुत अधिक कैलोरी का सेवन, विशेष रूप से उच्च कैलोरी वाले खाद्य पदार्थों, पेय पदार्थों से और कम नींद लेना, इनसे भूख को नियंत्रित करना कठिन हो सकता है।

options.label: A
options.text: Statement I is the cause and statement II is the effect
options.text_hi: कथन I कारण है और कथन II प्रभाव है

options.label: B
options.text: Statement II is the cause and statement I is the effect
options.text_hi: कथन II कारण है और कथन I प्रभाव है

options.label: C
options.text: Both statements I and II are effects of an independent cause
options.text_hi: कथन I और II दोनों एक स्वतंत्र कारण के प्रभाव हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Both statements I and II are effects of some common cause
options.text_hi: कथन I और II दोनों किसी सामान्य कारण के प्रभाव हैं

questions.correct_text: Statement II is the cause and statement I is the effect
questions.solution:
Excess fat in your blood can lead to chronic liver inflammation and long-term liver damage. This is the effect of obesity.

Consuming too many calories, especially from high-calorie foods, drinks and getting less sleep, which can make it harder to control appetite. This is the cause of obesity.

Hence, Statement II is the cause and statement I is the effect.

questions.solution:
A person walks 3 meters east from the starting point. Then, they turn left and walk 8 meters. After that, they turn right again and walk 3 meters.

So, the person is in the northeast direction from the starting point and the shortest distance = (6)² + (8)² = 36 + 64 = 100 = (10)² = 10m

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate options that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I discovered an old friend in the bookstore yesterday.
questions.solution:
Came across: This is the correct option. "Came across" means to encounter or find something or someone unexpectedly. In the context of the sentence, it accurately conveys the idea of unexpectedly discovering an old friend in the bookstore. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

Came around: "Came around" can mean to visit or to change one's opinion. However, in the context of discovering an old friend in a bookstore, it does not convey the intended meaning.

Came apart: "Came apart" generally means to separate or break into pieces. This option does not fit the context of finding an old friend.

Came after: "Came after" usually implies pursuing someone or something. It doesn't convey the idea of unexpectedly finding someone, so it is not suitable for this sentence.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank(s).

Do you have a pen to write __ or else I will buy one __ you?
questions.solution:
There are certain words in English language which are mandatorily followed by specific prepositions; 'write' is one such word.

Write is usually followed by 'with', so 'with' is used in the first blank. When we say 'write with', it means that we are holding a pen/pencil in our hands and making marks on paper.

'For' is used to refer to in support of or in favour of a person or policy, on behalf of or to the benefit of. Here in the given sentence, a pen is being bought to the benefit of someone, so, 'for' is used in the second blank.

Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.

'Of' is used while expressing the relationship between a part and a whole, or while expressing the relationship between a scale or measure and a value.

'On' is used when the objects are physically in contact with or supported by a surface.

'From' is used to indicate the point in space at which a journey starts.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

While playing hide and seek she hid _____ the curtains.
questions.solution:
'Behind' indicates 'later in time/towards the back'. 'Of' is used for expressing the relationship between a part and a whole. 'About' indicates concern/approximation. 'Onto' indicates 'to a position over a place'. 'Behind' is the most suitable word here which is giving a meaningful sentence that she hid towards the back of the curtains.

Hence, option (a) is the correct choice.

questions.question:

questions.solution:
The correct option to fill in the blank is "attend". 'Attend' means to be present at or participate in an event. In the given context, it indicates that all pupils are expected to be present at a school assembly. Other words do not fit the given context. 'Suspect' means to believe something to be true, typically without evidence. 'Suppose' means to assume something to be the case. 'Pretend' means to act as if something is the case when it is not. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

The complete sentence is: All pupils are expected to attend school assembly.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate phrasal verb to fill in the blank.

During our hike, we ______ a beautiful waterfall hidden in the forest.
questions.solution:
The most appropriate phrasal verb to fill in the blank is "came across." "Come across" means to find something unexpectedly or by chance. In the context of the given sentence, it indicates the discovery of a beautiful waterfall during the hike. Other phrasal verbs do not fit the context of the sentence. "Took after" means to resemble someone, "brought back" means to return with something, and "worked out" means to exercise or to solve a problem. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

The complete sentence is: During our hike, we came across a beautiful waterfall hidden in the forest.

NOTE:

Phrasal verb: A phrase that consists of a verb with a preposition or adverb or both, the meaning of which is different from the meaning of its separate parts. Example: She has always looked down on me. Here, the phrasal verb 'to look down on someone' doesn't mean that you are looking down from a higher place at someone who is below you; it means that you think that you are better than someone.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Aravind said that while he was asleep, the courier arrived.

options.label: A
options.text: Aravind said, "While I was asleep, the courier arrived."

options.label: B
options.text: Aravind said, "While I had slept, the courier had arrived."

options.label: C
options.text: Aravind said, "While he sleeps, the courier arrives."

options.label: D
options.text: Aravind said, "While he had slept, the courier has to arrive."

questions.correct_text: Aravind said, "While I was asleep, the courier arrived."
questions.solution:
If the sentence is in the Past tense, the form of tense doesn't change when it is used in the time clause.

One way of identifying the time clause is that the Time clause always begins with the following:
When
Whenever
While
As
Since
After
Before
Until
As soon as

For example:

Arun told him that when George called him, he responded. (Indirect speech)

Arun told him, "When George called me, I responded." (Direct speech)

The following things in the sentence will change when changed from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:

Said that-> said

He-> I

From the given options, one that follows the above-mentioned conditions for Direct speech is option (a) "Aravind said, "While I was asleep, the courier arrived"."

Hence, the correct answer is option (a).

Complicated - Consisting of many interconnecting parts or elements; intricate.

Detailed - Having many details or facts; showing attention to detail.

Addicted - Physically and mentally dependent on a particular substance.

questions.solution: Option B is the right answer. In this context, the article 'the' before 'moment' has the same meaning as 'this'. According to grammar rules, 'this' is changed to 'that', when converting direct to indirect speech. Here, 'the' must change into 'that'. Options A and D are eliminated, as they do not follow this rule. The present continuous tense, 'is + verb (ing)' turns into the past continuous form 'was + verb (ing)'. Following this rule, Option C is eliminated.

questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

My little daughter has saved the little money whom I gave her.
questions.solution:
According to the rule, 'everything, nothing, all, none, no, everyone, the few, the little, the same' takes 'that' after them.

So, none of the options is correct except for the one mentioned in option (a).

Hence, option (a) is correct.

questions.question:
Select the appropriate option to replace the underlined word with the adverb of time.

Fifteen thousand bird watchers visit around.
questions.solution:
'Soon now, later, then, tomorrow, today, day after tomorrow, everyday, weekly, annually, quarterly, yearly, yesterday, last month, tonight, last week, immediately, etc.' are some examples of adverbs of time. They tell us when an action is done or occurs.

'Rarely' is an example of adverb of frequency [which tells us how often an action is performed]. 'Badly and terribly' are examples of adverb of quality [which tell us about the degree, quality, intensity, concentration or even extent and depth of a particular action].

The correct sentence with the adverb of time is- 'Fifteen thousand bird watchers visit annually.'

Hence, option (d) is correct.

questions.question: Select the sentence that uses the idiom correctly.

options.label: A
options.text: He was feeling very cold shoulder even during a hot day.

options.label: B
options.text: My cold shoulder does not allow me to move my hand any further.

options.label: C
options.text: I got the cold shoulder from Anna at the party.

options.label: D
options.text: My shoulder got cold in the winters.

questions.correct_text: I got the cold shoulder from Anna at the party.
questions.solution:
'Cold shoulder' means to deliberately ignore someone. The use of the idiom is correctly mentioned in the statement of option (c). It suggests that the subject was feeling ignored.

Hence, option (c) is correct.

questions.question:
Identify the error in the following sentence.

He sat quiet in the cozy corner of the library, engrossed in the pages of his favourite novel.
questions.solution:
The error is in the word "quiet." The correct adverb form is "quietly" to describe how he sat. Adverbs modify verbs, and in this case, "quietly" provides more detail about the manner in which he sat. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

The corrected sentence would be: "He sat quietly in the cozy corner of the library, engrossed in the pages of his favourite novel."

questions.question: The figure of speech used in "The storm raged like an angry giant across the valley" is _.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is (c) Simile. A simile employs "like" or "as" to liken one thing to another, here comparing the storm's fury to "an angry giant" to vividly illustrate its destructive power and scale.

Hyperbole is incorrect because it overstates for dramatic effect (e.g., "The storm destroyed everything in a single breath"), but this uses a measured comparison rather than impossible exaggeration.

Personification is incorrect as it would directly give human qualities to the storm (e.g., "The storm pounded its fists"), without the "like" that separates the storm from the giant.

Onomatopoeia is incorrect since it mimics sounds (e.g., "The storm roared and crashed"), focusing on noise imitation, not visual or emotional analogy.

Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

questions.question:
Choose the option that will replace the error highlighted in bold.

The sudden change in government policy is likely to effect the livelihood of small farmers and have a long-term affect on rural employment.
questions.solution:
Affect (verb) means to influence.

Effect (noun) means result or outcome.

Thus, affect the livelihood and have a long-term effect are correct. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

Corrected sentence: The sudden change in government policy is likely to affect the livelihood of small farmers and have a long-term effect on rural employment.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in superlative degree of comparison.

He is smarter than his classmates.

options.label: A
options.text: He is smart among his classmates.

options.label: B
options.text: He is smarter than any of his classmates.

options.label: D
options.text: He is the smartest among his classmates.

questions.correct_text: He is the smartest among his classmates.
questions.solution:
The adjective is 'smarter' and it is in the comparative degree, which means it compares one thing or person with another and shows that it has a higher or lower degree of quality. To change a sentence from the comparative degree to the superlative degree, we need to add -est to the positive degree adjective 'smart' and use the word 'the' before it. The superlative degree shows that something or someone has the highest degree of quality among all the others in a group.

Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

Option (a) is in positive degree. Option (b) is in comparative degree.

Note:

Adjectives: Words which are used with a noun/pronoun to describe or point out, the person, animal, place, or thing which the noun names, or to tell the number or quantity, are called Adjectives.

· The Positive Degree is used to denote the mere existence of some quality of what we speak about. It is used when no comparison is made.

· The Comparative degree denotes a higher degree of quality than the positive and is used when two things are compared.

· The Superlative degree indicates the highest degree of quality and is used when more than two things (or sets of things) are compared.

questions.question: What is the exact one-word name for a long thrusting spear historically used by infantry soldiers fighting in tight formation?
questions.solution:
Option (a) is correct because a PIKE is specifically a very long spear used by foot soldiers in formation. The rule-based clue is "long thrusting spear" plus "infantry soldiers"; both together eliminate weapons mainly meant for throwing or cavalry use.

• Option (b) JAVELIN is designed primarily for throwing, not for sustained close-formation thrusting.

• Option (c) HALBERD is a pole weapon with an axe-blade and spike, not simply a long thrusting spear.

• Option (d) LANCE is chiefly associated with mounted warriors rather than infantry ranks.

questions.question:
Choose the sentence that uses a homonym of the underlined word:

The bat flew silently across the dark cave.

options.label: A
options.text: He swung the bat and hit the ball out of the ground.

options.label: B
options.text: The bat hung upside down inside the cave.

options.label: C
options.text: A small bat emerged from the hollow tree.

options.label: D
options.text: The bat spread its wings and disappeared into the night.

questions.correct_text: He swung the bat and hit the ball out of the ground.
questions.solution:
In the question, "bat" refers to a flying mammal.

A homonym is a word that has the same spelling or pronunciation but a different meaning.

Option (a) uses "bat" to mean a piece of sports equipment used in games such as cricket or baseball, which is a different meaning.

Options (b), (c), and (d) all refer to the animal, which is the same meaning as the sentence in the question.

Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question: According to the passage, how do employers in many foreign countries typically interpret a period of travel?

options.label: A
options.text: As a disruption that weakens a candidate's professional credibility

options.label: B
options.text: As a phase reflecting curiosity, initiative, and experiential learning

options.label: C
options.text: As an indulgent break that delays measurable career progression

options.label: D
options.text: As a temporary withdrawal from structured and skill-based development

questions.correct_text: As a phase reflecting curiosity, initiative, and experiential learning
questions.solution: Among the given options, (b) is the best fit because the passage clearly states that employers "regard travel as a sign of curiosity and initiative," and do not consider it a gap but a meaningful phase of learning. Hence, (b) is the correct answer. Option (a) is incorrect as it reflects a negative perception not attributed to foreign employers. Option (c) is incorrect because travel is viewed positively, not as indulgence. Option (d) is incorrect since travel is recognised as contributing to skill development rather than a withdrawal from it.
questions.passage:
Directions : Read the following passage and answer the questions based on the passage:

In an increasingly interconnected world, the meaning of "productivity" is being redefined, yet cultural perceptions continue to shape how life choices are evaluated. In many foreign countries, taking time off to travel the world is often viewed as a valuable and enriching experience. It is seen as an opportunity for personal growth, cultural exposure, and the development of soft skills such as adaptability, communication, and independence. Employers in such contexts frequently regard travel as a sign of curiosity and initiative, qualities that contribute positively to a candidate's profile. Consequently, a travel period is not considered a "gap" but rather a meaningful phase of experiential learning. In contrast, the perception in India tends to be more rigid and conventional. Any break from formal education or employment is often labelled as a "gap," regardless of how productively that time may have been utilised. Whether an individual spends the period travelling, learning new skills, volunteering, or pursuing personal interests, the absence of a structured job or academic engagement is frequently viewed with suspicion. This mindset stems from a deeply ingrained emphasis on stability, continuity, and measurable achievement. A linear career trajectory is still widely regarded as the ideal, leaving little room for unconventional paths. Such a perspective, however, overlooks the evolving nature of work and learning in the modern era. As global workplaces increasingly value creativity, critical thinking, and cross-cultural competence, experiences gained outside traditional frameworks can be highly relevant. The challenge, therefore, lies not only in changing employer attitudes but also in reshaping societal definitions of success and productivity. Bridging this gap in perception requires a shift towards recognising diverse forms of growth. Until then, the difference remains stark: what is celebrated as exploration in one context continues to be questioned as a gap in another.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is identified as a primary reason for the rigid perception of career gaps in India?

options.label: C
options.text: The absence of global exposure among the working population

options.label: D
options.text: The emphasis on stability, continuity, and measurable achievement

questions.correct_text: The preference for informal learning over structured education systems
questions.solution: Among the given options, (d) is the best fit because the passage explicitly mentions that this mindset "stems from a deeply ingrained emphasis on stability, continuity, and measurable achievement." Hence, (d) is the correct answer. Option (a) is incorrect as institutional support is not discussed. Option (c) is incorrect since global exposure is not cited as the cause. Option (b) is incorrect because the issue lies in valuing structured paths, not preferring informal ones.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

Let the culprit be punished.

options.label: A
options.text: Punishment to the culprit is to be given.

questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the be-form verb 'be punished' and the preposition 'by' is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

In Active voice (look at the options), it should be in the imperative form.

An imperative sentence is used to express order, request, suggestion, etc.

In Passive voice, the sentence begins with "Let".

Here, the imperative sentence in Active voice is an order.

The format in Passive voice is: Let + Subject (Objective case) + be + V3.

Thus, the format in Active voice is: V1 + Object.

For example:

Let the match be started. (Passive)

Start the match. (Active)

From the given options, the sentence that follows the above mentioned conditions for Active voice is option (b) "Punish the culprit."

Hence, the correct answer is option (b).

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

James said to me, "How did they get my cell?"

options.label: A
options.text: James asked me how they had gotten my cell.

options.label: B
options.text: James asked me how they had gotten his cell.

options.label: C
options.text: James asked him how they got his cell.

options.label: D
options.text: James asked me how had they gotten his cell.

questions.correct_text: James asked me how they had gotten his cell.
questions.solution:
In the case of Interrogative sentences like this, "said" in Direct Speech is changed into "enquired (of)", "wanted to know", "asked", etc.

In Indirect speech, the verb is always placed after the subject, unlike in Direct Speech.

For example:

The teacher said to him, "What is your name?" (Direct Speech)

The teacher asked him what his name was. (Indirect Speech)

Also, the sentence in the Direct Speech is in the Past Simple tense. So, the tense in the Indirect Speech should be in the Past Perfect tense.

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

· The reporting verb 'said to' is changed into 'asked'.

· The verb 'did get' (past simple) is changed into 'had gotten' (past perfect).

· The possessive determiner 'my' is changed into 'his'.

None of the options except (b) follows these changes. Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: James asked me how they had gotten his cell.

Note:-

Possessive Determiners/Adjectives: Words like 'my', 'our', 'your', 'his', 'her', 'its', and 'their' are known as possessive adjectives (or possessive determiners). They come before nouns and indicate ownership of the noun. Example: "The teacher asked the students to open their drawing books."

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Often provided by non-governmental organizations, development aid encompasses various forms, including financial grants, technical expertise and infrastructure development.

B. Development assistance not only addresses immediate needs but also focuses on long-term strategies to enable self-sufficiency and resilience.

C. The aim is to support developing countries in addressing fundamental issues such as healthcare, education, agriculture, and infrastructure.

D. However, effective aid requires careful planning, coordination, and accountability to ensure resources are utilized efficiently and that local ownership and participation are prioritized.
questions.solution: Sentence A introduces the topic by explaining what development aid is and its various forms, often provided by non-governmental organizations. Sentence C follows by describing the aim of development aid, which is to support developing countries in addressing fundamental issues like healthcare, education, agriculture, and infrastructure. So, these two form a pair. Sentence B elaborates on this aim by mentioning that development assistance not only addresses immediate needs but also focuses on long-term strategies for self-sufficiency and resilience. So, C and B also form a pair. Sentence D concludes the paragraph by explaining that effective aid requires careful planning, coordination, and accountability to ensure resources are utilized efficiently. The correct order is ACBD. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph:

1) Online education has gained popularity in recent years. 2. However, unequal access to technology remains a major concern. 3. Digital platforms allow learners to study at their own pace. 4. This flexibility has attracted working professionals and remote learners.
questions.solution:
The paragraph opens with the rise of online education (1). Sentence (3) explains a key feature, followed by its impact on learners (4). Sentence (2) presents a limitation to conclude the idea.

Therefore, the correct sequence is 1,3,4,2.

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Choose the correct antonym of "VILIFY":
questions.solution:
To "Vilify" means to speak ill of or defame.

"Praise" is the correct antonym as it means to commend or express approval.

"Denigrate", "Malign", and "Defame" are synonyms sharing the same negative meaning.

Hence, option (a) is correct.

questions.question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
questions.solution:
Option (c) has been spelt incorrectly. The correct spelling is 'neither' which means not one of two. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

'Obedient' means willing to comply with commands.

'Martyr' means one who sacrifices one's life.

'Harass' means to annoy someone frequently.

questions.question:
Choose the right antonym for the word that is given in bold.

We need to sortie a fighter to patrol the area until we have safely evacuated all of the troops still there.
questions.solution:
'Sortie' means an attack made by troops coming out from a position of defense. 'Retreat' means to move backwards in order to leave a battle or in order not to become involved in a battle. 'Invade' means to enter another country with an army in order to take control of it. 'Pacify' means to make somebody who is angry or upset be calm or quiet. 'Dispel' means to belittle the value or importance of someone or something.

So, 'retreat' is the right antonym.

Hence, option (a) is correct.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

Can the trick be shown by the magician?

options.label: A
options.text: Can the magician show the trick?

options.label: B
options.text: Could the magician show the trick?

options.label: C
options.text: Can the magician have shown the trick?

options.label: D
options.text: The trick can be shown by the magician?

questions.correct_text: Can the magician show the trick?
questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the 'to be form of verb' and the preposition 'by' is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

In Active voice (look at the options), it should be an interrogative sentence. The answer to this question will be either "yes" or "no".

These types of sentences usually begin with a Modal Auxiliary verb (Can).

In Passive voice, the format is: Modal + Subject (Objective case) + be + V3 + by + Object (Subjective case)?

Therefore, the format of the sentence which begins with Modals in Active voice is: Modal + Subject + V1 + Object?

For example:

Can this be eaten by her? (Passive)

Can she eat this? (Active)

The options except (a) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

NOTE/-

Modal verb: A verb used with another verb to express an idea such as possibility that is not expressed by the main verb. The modal verbs in English are "can," "could," "may," "might," "must," "ought," "shall," "should," "will," and "would." They do not change their form (spelling) and they have no infinitive or participle (past/present). Example: I can speak Spanish. Here 'can' expresses the ability of the person to speak (main verb) Spanish. This ability cannot be expressed by the main verb 'speak'.

questions.question:
Which part of the following sentence contains a spelling error?

Her performance (1) was appreciated by everyone (2), and she recieved (3) a standing ovation (4).
questions.solution: In the sentence, the word "recieved" in part (3) is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is "received", following the rule "i before e except after c." Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Juvenile
questions.solution:
Innocent- a pure, guileless, or naive person.

Criminal- a person who has committed a crime.

Model- a person or thing regarded as an excellent example of a specified quality.

The meaning of the word 'juvenile' is 'a young person'. Among the given options, the word that matches the meaning of the given word is option (d), 'youngster'.

Hence, the correct answer is option (d).

questions.solution:
It is mentioned in the passage that 'As the music started and the audience held their breath, Lily and Mia took the stage, exuding a magnetic energy that captivated everyone in the room. Their flawless synchronization and the seamless fusion of their contrasting styles left the crowd in awe.'

Hence, option (d) is correct.
questions.passage:
Directions : Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

In a small town nestled among rolling hills, two talented young girls named Lily and Mia found themselves united by their shared passion for dance. They were stepsisters, brought together by their parents' union, but their bond went far beyond mere family ties. Lily, with her graceful movements and impeccable technique, had been training in ballet since she was a little girl. Her dedication and unwavering focus earned her recognition as a rising star in the local dance community. Mia, on the other hand, possessed an innate sense of rhythm and different energy that made her a natural in hip-hop and contemporary styles. Initially, jealousy and competition threatened to overshadow their relationship. Each girl felt overshadowed by the other's strengths, believing that their own talents would forever be in the other's shadow. But as they spent more time together, dancing side by side in their living room and sharing dreams of performing on grand stages, they began to realize the immense power they held as a team. Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Every cloud has a silver lining

options.label: A
options.text: Bad things one day eventually lead to good things

options.label: B
options.text: Stuck in a difficult circumstance with no escape

questions.correct_text: Bad things one day eventually lead to good things
questions.solution:
'Every cloud has a silver lining' means bad things one day eventually lead to good things or even the worst things have some positive side. So, the correct option is option a).

· The figurative expression for 'stuck in a difficult circumstance with no escape' is - back against the wall.

· The figurative expression for 'eating too excessively' is - eat like a horse.

· The figurative expression for 'being ignored' is - left out in cold.

questions.question:
With reference to Article 14, consider the following statements:

1. "Equality before law" is a negative concept borrowed from the U.K., while "equal protection of the laws" is a positive concept influenced by the U.S.

2. Article 14 prohibits class legislation but allows reasonable classification if there is an intelligible differentia with a rational nexus to the objective.

3. Special provisions for women and children necessarily violate Article 14 unless backed by a constitutional amendment.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
अनुच्छेद 14 के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. "कानून के समक्ष समानता" यू.के. से उधार ली गई एक नकारात्मक अवधारणा है, जबकि "कानूनों का समान संरक्षण" यू.एस. से प्रभावित एक सकारात्मक अवधारणा है।

2. अनुच्छेद 14 वर्ग विधान पर प्रतिबंध लगाता है, लेकिन उचित वर्गीकरण की अनुमति देता है यदि उद्देश्य के लिए तर्कसंगत संबंध के साथ एक समझदार अंतर है।

3. महिलाओं और बच्चों के लिए विशेष प्रावधान आवश्यक रूप से अनुच्छेद 14 का उल्लंघन करते हैं जब तक कि संवैधानिक संशोधन द्वारा समर्थित न हों।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा कथन सही है / हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 2 are correct. They accurately describe the two facets of the Right to Equality under Article 14 and the established judicial test for its application.

Statement 3 is incorrect because the Constitution itself, under Article 15(3), explicitly permits the state to make special provisions for women and children.

Explanation of Statements:

1 is Correct. Article 14 combines two distinct but related concepts of equality:

"Equality before law": This concept is of British origin, associated with A.V. Dicey's "Rule of Law." It is considered a negative concept because it implies the absence of any special privileges in favour of any individual. It commands the state not to discriminate and ensures that every person is subject to the ordinary law of the land.

"Equal protection of the laws": This phrase is borrowed from the 14th Amendment of the U.S. Constitution. It is a positive concept as it obligates the state to take action to ensure equality. It means that all persons similarly circumstanced should be treated alike both in the privileges conferred and liabilities imposed by the laws. It allows for treating unequals differently to achieve substantive equality.

2 is Correct. The Supreme Court of India has consistently held that Article 14 does not mean absolute equality. It forbids class legislation (making arbitrary distinctions between groups) but permits reasonable classification. For a classification to be valid, it must satisfy two conditions, often called the "twin tests":

(i) Intelligible Differentia: The classification must be founded on an understandable difference that distinguishes persons or things that are grouped together from others left out of the group.

(ii) Rational Nexus: The difference must have a rational relation to the object sought to be achieved by the statute in question.

3 is Incorrect. This statement is false. While Article 14 provides for general equality, the Constitution itself creates certain exceptions to achieve social justice. Article 15(3) explicitly states: "Nothing in this article shall prevent the State from making any special provision for women and children." Therefore, laws providing special benefits or protections for women and children are constitutionally valid and do not violate Article 14. They are seen as examples of reasonable classification aimed at addressing historical and social disadvantages. No constitutional amendment is required to make such provisions.

Further insights:

The Right to Equality under Article 14 is a fundamental right available to all persons within the territory of India, including citizens, non-citizens, and legal persons like corporations.

In later judgments, such as E.P. Royappa v. State of Tamil Nadu, the Supreme Court has expanded the interpretation of Article 14, stating that equality is a dynamic concept and is antithetical to arbitrariness. Thus, any state action that is arbitrary is also considered a violation of Article 14.

questions.question: Who among these was part of the Indian pair along with Mukesh Nelavalli that won gold in 10m air pistol mixed team event defeated strong pairs including China and set a world record score of 487.7 at the ISSF World Cup held in Granada in April 2026?
questions.question_hi: इनमें से कौन मूकश नेलावली के साथ भारतीय जोड़ी का हिस्सा था जिसने 10 मीटर एयर पिस्टल मिश्रित टीम इवेंट में स्वर्ण पदक जीता, जिसमें चीन सहित मजबूत जोड़ों को हराया और अप्रैल 2026 में ग्रेनाडा में आयोजित ISSF वर्ल्ड कप में 487.7 का विश्व रिकॉर्ड स्कोर बनाया?
questions.solution:
India's Palak Gulia and Mukesh Nelavalli broke the world record en route to winning a gold medal in the 10m air pistol mixed team competition at the ISSF World Cup for rifle and pistol in Granada. The win was impressive, as the field included the world champion Chinese pair of Kai Hu and Qianxun Yao, along with Paris Olympics bronze medallist Veronika Major and Akos Nagy of Hungary. With Nelavalli, making his senior debut, shooting a score of 294 as compared to Gulia's score of 287, the Indian pair qualified in second spot behind the Chinese pair. An hour later, the Indian pair won the title, with a 2.9-point lead over the second-placed Chinese pair, setting a new world record and junior world record score of 487.7.

As per the new mixed team final format, the top four teams will fight for medals, instead of just the top two as it was earlier. The new final format sees a mixed team firing five shots each in 250 seconds in the first three series before three elimination series consisting of three single shots each.

Nelavalli came into the final with 11 inner tens in the qualification and his first series of 50.7 as compared to Gulia's series of 49.4 meant that the Indian team (100.1) led the Chinese pair (99.7) by 0.4 points with the Hungarian pair placed at the third spot (98.8) and the American pair of Nathalia Tobar and Nickolaus Mowrer placed at the fourth spot (96.6).

The Indian pair would extend their lead over the second-placed Chinese pair to 2.6 points with Gulia shooting a series of 51.3 and Nelavalli a score of 51.6 after the second series. The last five-shot series saw the Indian pair extending their lead over the Chinese pair to 4.3 points with Gulia shooting a score of 51.4 and Nelavalli a score of 51.0 for a total score of 305.4 with the Chinese trailing at 301.1.

The elimination series would see the USA pair bowing out first followed by Hungary, with the Indian pair in the lead by 3.3 points over the Chinese after the fourth and a lead of 2.6 points after the penultimate series. Gulia, who had won the 10m air pistol title in 2023 Hangzhou Asian Games, shot the highest total in the elimination series with a score of 31.5 while Nelavalli shot 30.5 for the Indian pair to win the title.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Malnutrition related disorders in Humans.

I. Marasmus is caused by deficiency of both protein and calories.

II. Kwarshiorkar is caused by deficiency of only protein.

III. Both Marasmus and Kwarshiorkar causes wasting of muscles and thinning of limbs.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
मनुष्यों में कुपोषण संबंधी विकारों के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. मरास्मस प्रोटीन और कैलोरी दोनों की कमी के कारण होता है।

II. क्वार्शियोरकर केवल प्रोटीन की कमी के कारण होता है।

III. मरास्मस और क्वार्शियोरकर दोनों मांसपेशियों की बर्बादी और अंगों के पतले होने का कारण बनते हैं।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा सही है / हैं?
questions.solution:
Dietary deficiencies of proteins and total food calories causes Protein-energy malnutrition.

(PEM) may affect large sections of the population during drought, famine and political turmoil. This happened in Bangladesh during the liberation war and in Ethiopia during the severe drought in mid-eighties.

PEM affects infants and children to produce Marasmus and Kwashiorkar.

Marasmus is produced by a simultaneous deficiency of proteins and calories.

It is found in infants less than a year in age, if mother's milk is replaced too early by other foods which are poor in both proteins and caloric value.

This often happens if the mother has second pregnancy or childbirth when the older infant is still too young.

In Marasmus, protein deficiency impairs growth and replacement of tissue proteins; extreme emaciation of the body and thinning of limbs results, the skin becomes dry, thin and wrinkled. Growth rate and body weight decline considerably.

Even growth and development of brain and mental faculties are impaired.

Kwashiorkar is produced by protein deficiency unaccompanied by calorie deficiency.

It results from the replacement of mother's milk by a high calorie, low protein diet in a child more than one year in age.

Like marasmus, kwashiorkor shows wasting of muscles, thinning of limbs, failure of growth and brain development.

But unlike marasmus, some fat is still left under the skin; moreover, extensive oedema and swelling of body parts are seen.

Source: NCERT 11th

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding ISRO's SPADEX (Space Docking Experiment) mission:

I. The SPADEX mission was designed to demonstrate autonomous rendezvous and docking of two satellites in orbit.

II. Successful docking technology is considered important for future missions such as space stations, satellite servicing, and human spaceflight programmes.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
ISRO के SPADEX (स्पेस डॉकिंग एक्सपेरिमेंट) मिशन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. SPADEX मिशन का उद्देश्य कक्षा में दो उपग्रहों के स्वायत्त रेंज़देवस और डॉकिंग को प्रदर्शित करना था।

II. सफल डॉकिंग तकनीक को भविष्य के मिशनों जैसे कि अंतरिक्ष स्टेशन, उपग्रह सेवा, और मानव अंतरिक्ष कार्यक्रमों के लिए महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Statement I is correct. SPADEX (Space Docking Experiment) was developed by ISRO to demonstrate the capability of two spacecraft to autonomously rendezvous and dock in orbit.

Statement II is correct. Docking technology is a critical capability for future space endeavours, including space stations, in-orbit servicing, and India's human spaceflight programme.

I. Alauddin Khalji fixed prices and curbed hoarding in Delhi through market controls and a shahana-i-mandi.

questions.question_hi:
मध्यकालीन भारत में किए गए प्रशासनिक या आर्थिक सुधारों के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सत्य है/हैं?

I. अलाउद्दीन खिलजी ने बाज़ार नियंत्रण और शाहना-ए-मंडी के माध्यम से दिल्ली में कीमतें तय कीं और जमाखोरी पर अंकुश लगाया।

II. मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक ने राजधानी को दौलताबाद स्थानांतरित किया और टोकन मुद्रा के साथ प्रयोग किया।

III. शेरशाह सूरी ने चांदी के रुपिया का मानकीकरण किया और ग्रैंड ट्रंक रोड में सुधार किया।
questions.solution:
All three statements are correct.

Explanation of Statements:

Statement I is Correct. Alauddin Khalji (reigned 1296-1316) is renowned for his extensive market control policies in and around his capital, Delhi. To maintain a large standing army on a limited budget, he fixed the prices of essential commodities, from grains to horses and slaves. He set up separate markets, appointed a high-ranking officer called the Shahna-i-Mandi (controller of the market) to enforce the regulations strictly, and implemented severe punishments for hoarding and black-marketing.

Statement II is Correct. Muhammad bin Tughluq (reigned 1325-1351) was an ambitious ruler known for his radical and often ill-fated experiments. Two of his most famous (or infamous) projects were:

Transfer of Capital: In 1327, he ordered the transfer of the capital from Delhi to Devagiri in the Deccan, which he renamed Daulatabad, to have a more centrally located capital. The forced and poorly managed relocation caused immense hardship.

Token Currency: In 1329, inspired by similar practices in China and Persia, he introduced a token currency, issuing brass and copper coins whose face value was equal to that of silver tankas. The experiment failed catastrophically due to widespread counterfeiting, which the state could not prevent.

Statement III is Correct. Sher Shah Suri (reigned 1540-1545), despite his short reign, was a brilliant administrator whose reforms laid the groundwork for the later Mughal administration. His key achievements include:

Currency Reform: He introduced a standardized silver coin called the rupiya (which remained a standard for centuries and is the precursor to the modern rupee) and a copper coin called the dam.

Infrastructure: He rebuilt and greatly improved the "Sadak-i-Azam" (Great Road), a major arterial route that later came to be known as the Grand Trunk Road (GT Road), planting trees and building sarais (inns) along its length for travelers and merchants.

questions.solution:
In a breakthrough for wildlife conservation in Assam, a study by the Wildlife Institute of India (WII) has confirmed the presence of dholes, or Asiatic wild dogs, in the Kaziranga Karbi Anglong Landscape (KKAL), a region where they were believed to be locally extinct since the 1990s.

The dhole (Cuon alpinus) is listed as endangered on the IUCN Red List and a Schedule II species in the Indian Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972, where hunting or trade of dholes is prohibited and violations can attract penalties.

Besides the tiger, the dhole is the only large carnivore in India that is under the International Union for Conservation of Nature's 'endangered' category.

Dholes play an important role as apex predators in forest ecosystems.

questions.solution:
Jansuraksha schemes like Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana and Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana have settled claims of about Rs. 25,160 crore since their launch in 2015, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said. Jan Suraksha schemes Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY), Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY), and Atal Pension Yojana (APY) envisioned to extend affordable financial protection to all, particularly the under-served and vulnerable sections of society, were launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on May 9, 2015. These flagship schemes, which completed 11 years, aim to broaden the insurance and pension landscape by shielding citizens against life's uncertainties and fostering long-term financial resilience. Citing data on the 11th anniversaries of the Jan Suraksha Schemes, Sitharaman said that over 270 million, 580 million and 90 million enrolments have been done under PMJJBY, PMSBY and APY, respectively. On PMJJBY, she said the scheme has settled claims worth more than Rs.21,500 crore for over 1.07 million families. Under PMSBY scheme, Sitharaman said it has settled claims worth nearly Rs.3,660 crore for over 184 thousand families.

Launched in 2015, PMJJBY offers life insurance cover for death due to any cause at an annual premium of Rs.436. Eligible individuals between 18 and 50 years can enrol through participating banks or post offices. It provides Rs.2 lakh to the nominee in the event of the subscriber's death.

As of April 29, the scheme has recorded 127.2 million female enrolments and 80.9 million enrolments from PMJDY account holders, the finance ministry said in a statement.

The PMSBY scheme offers accidental death and disability insurance to individuals aged 18 to 70 years at a nominal premium of Rs.20 per annum.

The scheme pays Rs.2 lakh for accidental death or total disability and Rs.1 lakh for partial disability.

As on April 29, 2026, the scheme has recorded 274.5 million female enrolments and 193 million enrolments from PMJDY account holders, it said.

Atal Pension Yojana aims to provide old-age income security to unorganised sector workers. It guarantees a monthly pension of Rs.1,000 to Rs.5,000 after the age of 60, depending on the contribution. The scheme is administered by the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) under the National Pension System (NPS) framework.

Open to bank account holders aged 18 to 40 years who are not income tax payers, the scheme has seen over 76.6 million enrolments till April 2025.

Subscribers can choose monthly, quarterly, or half-yearly contribution modes.

In case of a subscriber's death before the age of 60, the spouse may continue contributing until the original retirement age or withdraw the accumulated corpus.

As on April 30, 2026, more than 90.4 million individuals have enrolled in the scheme, it added.

Consider the following statements about the Tenth Schedule of the Indian Constitution:

I. It was included in the Constitution via the 52nd Amendment Act in 1985.

II. It sets the provisions for disqualification of elected members on the grounds of defection to another political party.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारतीय संविधान की दसवीं अनुसूची के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. इसे 1985 में 52वें संशोधन अधिनियम के माध्यम से संविधान में शामिल किया गया था।

II. यह किसी अन्य राजनीतिक दल में दलबदल के आधार पर निर्वाचित सदस्यों की अयोग्यता के प्रावधान निर्धारित करता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
The Tenth Schedule was inserted in the Constitution via 52nd amendment act in 1985.

It lays down the process by which legislators may be disqualified on grounds of defection by the Presiding Officer of a legislature based on a petition by any other member of the House.

A legislator is deemed to have defected if he either voluntarily gives up the membership of his party or disobeys the directives of the party leadership on a vote. This implies that a legislator defying (abstaining or voting against) the party whip on any issue can lose his membership of the House.

The law applies to both Parliament and state assemblies.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:

I. Salinity of the Ocean water decreases with depth

II. Salinity at the surface of the Ocean water increases due to condensation.

Which of the above statement(s) is / are correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. महासागर के पानी की लवणता गहराई के साथ घटती है।

II. महासागर के पानी की सतह पर लवणता संघनन के कारण बढ़ जाती है।

उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II.

questions.solution:
Vertical Distribution of Salinity

Salinity changes with depth, but the way it changes depends upon the location of the sea. Salinity at the surface increases by the loss of water to ice or evaporation, or decreased by the input of fresh waters, such as from the rivers. (Statement II is Incorrect) Salinity at depth is very much fixed, because there is no way that water is 'lost', or the salt is 'added.' There is a marked difference in the salinity between the surface zones and the deep zones of the oceans. The lower salinity water rests above the higher salinity dense water. Salinity, generally, increases with depth and there is a distinct zone called the halocline, where salinity increases sharply. (Statement I is Incorrect) Other factors being constant, increasing salinity of seawater causes its density to increase. High salinity seawater, generally, sinks below the lower salinity water. This leads to stratification by salinity.

Source: CLASS-11 NCERT PHYSICAL GEOGRAPHY

Consider the following statements about the Cost of National Income.

I. Market cost means the cost at which goods reach the market after adding the indirect taxes

II. India currently calculates its national income at factor cost as it provides an accurate measure.

Which of the statements is/are incorrect?
questions.question_hi:
राष्ट्रीय आय की लागत के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. बाजार लागत का अर्थ है वह लागत जिस पर अप्रत्यक्ष करों को जोड़ने के बाद सामान बाजार तक पहुंचता है।

II. भारत वर्तमान में कारक लागत पर अपनी राष्ट्रीय आय की गणना करता है क्योंकि यह एक सटीक उपाय प्रदान करता है।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन गलत है?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Value of total produced goods and services may be calculated at either the "factor cost" or the "market cost". FACTOR COST is the 'input cost' the producer has to incur in the process of producing something such as interest on loans, raw materials, labour, rent, power. While the MARKET COST is derived after adding the indirect taxes to the factor cost of the product. Hence, statement 1 is correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect. India officially used to calculate its national income at factor cost. Since January 2015, the CSO has switched over to calculating it at 'market cost'.

questions.question: In badminton, if the server wins a point when the score is currently an odd number (e.g., 3, 5, or 7), from which side of the court must they execute the next serve?
questions.question_hi: बैडमिंटन में, यदि सर्वर वर्तमान में स्कोर विषम संख्या (जैसे, 3, 5, या 7) होने पर अंक जीतता है, तो उन्हें अगला सर्व किस पक्ष से करना चाहिए?

options.label: C
options.text: Directly behind the baseline center line
options.text_hi: बेसलाइन केंद्र रेखा के ठीक पीछे

options.label: D
options.text: Any side chosen by the server
options.text_hi: सर्वर द्वारा चुनी गई कोई भी ओर

questions.solution:
In badminton singles and doubles, the serving side serves:

From the right service court when their score is even (0, 2, 4, 6, ...).

From the left service court when their score is odd (1, 3, 5, 7, ...).

If the server wins a rally, they score a point and continue serving. Therefore, if their score becomes an odd number (such as 3, 5, or 7), the next serve must be delivered from the left service court.

3. कालानुक्रमिक रूप से, यह त्योहार मक्का की वार्षिक पवित्र यात्रा हज की आधिकारिक शुरुआत को चिह्नित करता है।
