questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Eid-ul-Zuha commemorates the historical narrative of Prophet Ibrahim's absolute devotion to God, where a ram was ultimately substituted in place of his son. It is celebrated by sacrificing livestock and dividing the meat into three parts: for the family, relatives/friends, and the poor.

Statement 2 is correct: Unlike solar-based festivals, Islamic festivals follow the lunar Hijri calendar. Eid-ul-Zuha falls exactly on the 10th day of the final month, Dhu al-Hijjah.

Statement 3 is incorrect: Eid-ul-Zuha does not mark the commencement of the Hajj; rather, it marks the culmination or climax of the pilgrimage. The main rituals of Hajj actually begin earlier (on the 8th of Dhu al-Hijjah), and the day immediately preceding Eid is the crucial Day of Arafah.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements.

I. Cnidarians such as Hydra are diploblastic and typically show radial symmetry in adults.

II. Flatworms (Platyhelminthes) are triploblastic acoelomates with early cephalization and more complex tissues.

Which of the above statement is/are true?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. हाइड्रा जैसे निडेरियन द्विब्लास्टिक होते हैं और वयस्क अवस्था में आमतौर पर रेडियल समरूपता दर्शाते हैं।

II. चपटे कृमि (प्लैटीहेल्मिन्थेस) त्रिब्लास्टिक एकोएलोमेट्स होते हैं जिनमें प्रारंभिक सेफलाइजेशन और अधिक जटिल ऊतक होते हैं।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सत्य है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो मैं और न ही दूसरा

questions.solution:
Statement I is TRUE.

Diploblastic nature:

-Cnidarians have only two germ layers: ectoderm (outer layer) and endoderm (inner layer)

-Between these layers is a non-cellular mesoglea (jelly-like substance), not a true third germ layer

-This makes them diploblastic organisms

Radial symmetry:

-Cnidarians typically exhibit radial symmetry, meaning body parts are arranged around a central axis

-They can be divided into similar halves by multiple planes passing through the central axis

-Examples: Hydra, jellyfish, sea anemones, corals

-This symmetry is well-suited for their sessile or free-floating lifestyle

Statement II is TRUE.

Triploblastic acoelomates:

-Flatworms have three germ layers: ectoderm, mesoderm, and endoderm

-They are acoelomates - they lack a body cavity (coelom)

-The space between body wall and organs is filled with solid tissue (parenchyma)

Cephalization:

-Flatworms show early cephalization - concentration of sensory organs and nervous tissue at the anterior (head) end

-They have eyespots, sensory lobes, and a more organized nervous system compared to cnidarians

-This represents an evolutionary advancement

More complex tissues:

-The presence of mesoderm allows formation of more complex organ systems

-They have primitive organs including excretory structures (flame cells), reproductive organs, and rudimentary digestive systems

-More tissue specialization compared to diploblastic organisms

questions.question:
Which of the following statement is/are correct?

Statement 1: When silver nitrate reacts with sodium chloride, a white precipitate of silver chloride is formed.

Statement 2: The reaction between silver nitrate and sodium chloride is an example of a double displacement reaction.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

कथन 1: जब सिल्वर नाइट्रेट सोडियम क्लोराइड के साथ प्रतिक्रिया करता है, तो सिल्वर क्लोराइड का एक सफेद अवक्षेप बनता है।

कथन 2: सिल्वर नाइट्रेट और सोडियम क्लोराइड के बीच की प्रतिक्रिया द्वि-विस्थापन प्रतिक्रिया का एक उदाहरण है।

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो 1 और न ही 2 सही है

questions.solution:
Both statements are correct. Statement 1 accurately describes the observable outcome of the chemical reaction, and Statement 2 correctly classifies the type of reaction that is occurring.

Explanation of Statements:

Statement 1 is correct. When aqueous solutions of silver nitrate (AgNO₃) and sodium chloride (NaCl) are mixed, they react to form silver chloride (AgCl) and sodium nitrate (NaNO₃). According to solubility rules, silver chloride is insoluble in water, causing it to separate from the solution as a solid white precipitate. The balanced chemical equation is:

AgNO₃(aq) + NaCl(aq) → AgCl(s) + NaNO₃(aq)

Statement 2 is correct. The reaction is a classic example of a double displacement reaction (also known as a metathesis reaction). In this type of reaction, the cations and anions of the two reactant compounds exchange partners. Here, the silver cation (Ag⁺) pairs with the chloride anion (Cl⁻), and the sodium cation (Na⁺) pairs with the nitrate anion (NO₃⁻) to form the products.

Further insights:

A double displacement reaction that results in the formation of an insoluble solid is specifically called a precipitation reaction. The formation of the stable, insoluble AgCl precipitate is the driving force for this reaction.

This particular reaction is a standard test in qualitative chemical analysis to confirm the presence of chloride ions in a solution. Adding silver nitrate solution to an unknown sample will produce this characteristic white precipitate if chloride ions are present.

questions.question:
Consider the following regarding laterite soils.

I. They are poor in organic content.

II. They are suitable for cultivating cashew nuts.

III. They don't require fertilizers.

IV. These soils have mainly developed in the Peninsular plateau.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
लैटेराइट मिट्टी के संबंध में निम्नलिखित पर विचार करें।

I. इनमें कार्बनिक तत्व कम होते हैं।

II. ये काजू की खेती के लिए उपयुक्त हैं।

III. इन्हें उर्वरकों की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है।

IV. ये मिट्टी मुख्य रूप से प्रायद्वीपीय पठार में विकसित हुई हैं।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement I and II are correct: Laterite soils are poor in organic matter, nitrogen, phosphate, calcium while iron oxides and potash are in excess. Also, the humus content is removed by bacteria. Hence, they are not suitable for cultivation. However, they are suitable for a few tree-based crops such as cashew nuts.

In Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Andhra Pradesh cashew nuts are cultivated commercially on laterite soils.

Statement III is incorrect: As they are poor in many nutrients, application of manures and fertilizers are required for making soils fertile for cultivation.

Statement IV is correct: Laterite soils have mainly developed in the higher areas of the Peninsular plateau. The laterite soils are commonly found in Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Madhya Pradesh and the hilly areas of Odisha and Assam.

Source: India: Physical Environment NCERT

questions.question: Which historical trend is best illustrated by the architectural transition from the simple rock-cut caves of the early Mauryan and Gupta eras to the massive, structural stone temples of the medieval period in India?
questions.question_hi: भारत में प्रारंभिक मौर्य और गुप्त युगों की सरल चट्टान-कट गुफाओं से मध्यकालीन काल के विशाल, संरचनात्मक पत्थर के मंदिरों तक के वास्तुशिल्प परिवर्तन द्वारा कौन सा ऐतिहासिक प्रवृत्ति सबसे अच्छी तरह से प्रदर्शित होती है?

options.label: A
options.text: The complete abandonment of local religious iconography
options.text_hi: स्थानीय धार्मिक मूर्तिकला का पूर्ण परित्याग

options.label: B
options.text: The evolution of permanent community religious spaces from monastic retreats to grand dynastic monuments
options.text_hi: स्थायी सामुदायिक धार्मिक स्थानों का विकास मठीय आश्रयों से भव्य राजवंशीय स्मारकों तक

options.label: C
options.text: A decline in the technical proficiency and geometrical precision of master stone artisans
options.text_hi: प्रमुख पत्थर कारीगरों की तकनीकी दक्षता और ज्यामितीय सटीकता में गिरावट

options.label: D
options.text: The total replacement of indigenous structural designs with imported Central Asian engineering models
options.text_hi: देशीय संरचनात्मक डिजाइनों की पूरी तरह से केंद्रीय एशियाई इंजीनियरिंग मॉडलों से प्रतिस्थापन

questions.correct_text: The evolution of permanent community religious spaces from monastic retreats to grand dynastic monuments
questions.solution:
Why Option B is correct: Early rock-cut architecture (like the Barabar or early Ajanta caves) primarily served as isolated, simple retreats for monks and ascetics. As regional empires grew and consolidated power during the medieval period (such as the Cholas, Chalukyas, and Chandelas), rulers began commissioning large, freestanding structural stone temples. These structures served not just as places of worship, but as grand socio-economic hubs and monuments to dynastic prestige, reflecting a shift toward institutionalized public religion.

Why Option A is incorrect: Local religious iconography did not disappear; rather, it became significantly more complex, varied, and thoroughly integrated into the walls and spires of structural temples.

Why Option C is incorrect: Technical proficiency actually advanced dramatically over time, moving from carving out existing hillsides to constructing free-standing, multi-tiered stone geometries with advanced interlocking masonry.

Why Option D is incorrect: While external interactions did influence elements over centuries, the transition from rock-cut caves to structural temples was an overwhelmingly organic, indigenous evolution of native architectural treatises (Shilpa Shastras).

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding food webs:

A) A single organism can occupy more than one trophic position in a food web.

B) Alteration in the population size of one species can influence other species that are not directly connected to it.

C) The presence of multiple feeding pathways ensures greater conservation of energy at each trophic transfer.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
खाद्य जाल के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

A) एक जीव खाद्य जाल में एक से अधिक पोषण स्तर ग्रहण कर सकता है।

B) एक प्रजाति की जनसंख्या के आकार में परिवर्तन अन्य प्रजातियों को प्रभावित कर सकता है जो उससे प्रत्यक्ष रूप से जुड़ी नहीं हैं।

C) अनेक पोषण मार्गों की उपस्थिति प्रत्येक पोषण स्तर के स्थानांतरण पर ऊर्जा के अधिक संरक्षण को सुनिश्चित करती है।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
In a food web, organisms can feed at more than one trophic level.

Eg: A decline in predators may increase herbivores, leading to overgrazing of plants.

Changes in one species can cause indirect effects on other species through cascading interactions.

Eg: A decline in predators may increase herbivores, leading to overgrazing of plants.

Multiple feeding links do not reduce energy loss.

Energy loss follows the 10% law, meaning only about 10% of energy is transferred to the next trophic level, regardless of how many feeding pathways exist.

Further insights

A food web is a network of interconnected food chains.

Energy flow in ecosystems is always unidirectional.

Only about 10% of energy is passed to the next trophic level.

Food webs increase ecosystem stability, not energy efficiency.

Omnivores often occupy multiple trophic levels.

Top predators regulate ecosystem balance through trophic cascades.

Energy loss occurs mainly due to respiration and heat.

Shorter food chains are more energy efficient than longer ones.

questions.question:
In the context of Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana, consider the following statements.

I. The scheme is meant for old age protection and social security of Small and Marginal Farmers (SMF).

II. Farmers would receive a minimum assured pension of Rs 5000/- per month after attaining the age of 40 years.

Which among the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
प्रधानमंत्री किसान मान धन योजना के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. यह योजना छोटे और सीमांत किसानों (एसएमएफ) की वृद्धावस्था सुरक्षा और सामाजिक सुरक्षा के लिए है।

II. किसानों को 40 वर्ष की आयु प्राप्त करने के बाद प्रति माह 5000 रुपये की न्यूनतम सुनिश्चित पेंशन मिलेगी।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Statement I is correct, but Statement II is incorrect.

The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY) does aim to provide social security to small and marginal farmers, but the pension amount and the age at which it becomes payable are different from what is stated in the second statement.

Explanation of Statements:

Statement I is correct. The PM-KMY is a government scheme specifically designed to provide a social safety net for Small and Marginal Farmers (SMF) in their old age when they have little or no savings and may lose their source of livelihood. A Small and Marginal Farmer is defined as one who owns cultivable land up to 2 hectares.

Statement II is incorrect. This statement contains two factual errors:

Pension Amount: The scheme provides a minimum assured pension of ₹3000 per month, not ₹5000.

Pension Age: The pension is payable after the beneficiary attains the age of 60 years, not 40 years.

Further insights:

Nature of Scheme: PM-KMY is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme.

Entry Age: Farmers in the age group of 18 to 40 years are eligible to join the scheme.

Contribution: The eligible farmer is required to make a monthly contribution of between ₹55 to ₹200, depending on their age of entry. The Central Government makes a matching contribution to the farmer's pension fund.

Ministry: The scheme is administered by the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare, Government of India.

Family Pension: In case of the death of the farmer, their spouse is entitled to receive 50% of the pension as a family pension.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements on the Ganga system:

1) The Ganga is named at Devprayag after the confluence of the Alaknanda and Bhagirathi.

2) The Yamuna joins the Ganga at Prayagraj.

3) The Son joins the Ganga at Varanasi.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
गंगा प्रणाली पर निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) अलकनंदा और भागीरथी के संगम के बाद देवप्रयाग में गंगा का नाम रखा गया है।

2) यमुना प्रयागराज में गंगा में मिलती है।

3) सोन नदी वाराणसी में गंगा में मिलती है।

ऊपर दिए गए कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 2 are correct, while statement 3 is incorrect. The Ganga is formed at Devprayag, and its largest tributary, the Yamuna, joins it at Prayagraj. However, the Son river joins the Ganga near Patna, not Varanasi.

Explanation of Statements:

1 is Correct. The river is known as the Ganga (or Ganges) only after the confluence of its two main headstreams, the Alaknanda and the Bhagirathi, at the holy town of Devprayag in Uttarakhand. Before this point, the Bhagirathi is often considered the source stream, originating from the Gangotri Glacier.

2 is Correct. The Yamuna is the longest and most significant right-bank tributary of the Ganga. It originates from the Yamunotri Glacier in the Himalayas and flows almost parallel to the Ganga for a long distance before merging with it at the Triveni Sangam in Prayagraj (formerly Allahabad).

3 is Incorrect. The Son River is another major southern (right-bank) tributary of the Ganga, originating from the Amarkantak Plateau. It flows north-northeastwards and joins the Ganga at Danapur, just upstream of Patna in Bihar, not at Varanasi.

Further insights:

The formation of the Alaknanda river itself involves a series of confluences in the Himalayas known as the Panch Prayag:

Vishnuprayag: Alaknanda meets Dhauliganga

Nandaprayag: Alaknanda meets Nandakini

Karnaprayag: Alaknanda meets Pindar

Rudraprayag: Alaknanda meets Mandakini

Devprayag: Alaknanda meets Bhagirathi (forms the Ganga)

The Ganga has numerous left-bank tributaries that join it from the north, including the Ramganga, Gomti, Ghaghara, Gandak, and Kosi.

questions.question:
Regarding literacy in Census 2011, consider the following statements:

1. Effective literacy rate is calculated for population aged 7 years and above.

2. Between 2001 and 2011, the increase in female literacy rate (in percentage points) exceeded that of males.

3. Kerala remained the most literate state with its literacy rate exceeding 90%.
questions.question_hi:
जनगणना 2011 में साक्षरता के संबंध में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. प्रभावी साक्षरता दर की गणना 7 वर्ष और उससे अधिक आयु की जनसंख्या के लिए की जाती है।

2. 2001 और 2011 के बीच, महिला साक्षरता दर में वृद्धि (प्रतिशत अंकों में) पुरुषों की तुलना में अधिक थी।

3. केरल 90% से अधिक साक्षरता दर के साथ सबसे अधिक साक्षर राज्य बना रहा।
questions.solution:
All three statements are correct.

Explanation of Statements:

Statement 1 is correct. Since the 1991 Census, India has used the concept of "effective literacy rate." A person is considered literate if they are aged 7 years or above and can read and write with understanding in any language. The population aged 0-6 years is treated as illiterate by definition, so it is excluded from the calculation to provide a more accurate picture of literacy among the population that can reasonably be expected to have learned these skills.

Statement 2 is correct. The Census of 2011 revealed a positive trend in bridging the gender gap in literacy.

The male literacy rate increased from 75.26% in 2001 to 80.9% in 2011 (an increase of 5.6 percentage points).

The female literacy rate increased from 53.67% in 2001 to 64.6% in 2011 (an increase of 10.9 percentage points).

Clearly, the increase in the female literacy rate was significantly higher than that of the male literacy rate during this decade.

Statement 3 is correct. Kerala continued its tradition of having the highest literacy rate among all states in India. According to the 2011 Census, Kerala's literacy rate was 94.0%, comfortably exceeding the 90% mark. It was followed by Lakshadweep (91.85%) and Mizoram (91.33%). Bihar had the lowest literacy rate at 61.8%.

Further insights:

The overall literacy rate in India in 2011 was 73.0%.

The gap between male and female literacy rates, while still significant, narrowed from 21.59 percentage points in 2001 to 16.3 percentage points in 2011, indicating progress towards gender parity in education.

questions.question:
Match the Following Network Devices(List I) with its Function(List II)

List-IList-II
A. Hub1. Connects different networks
B. Switch2. Broadcasts data
C. Router3. Uses MAC address
D. Firewall4. Filters network traffic
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित नेटवर्क उपकरणों (सूची I) का उनके कार्य (सूची II) से मिलान करें

A. हब1. विभिन्न नेटवर्कों को जोड़ता है
B. स्विच2. डेटा प्रसारित करता है
C. राउटर3. MAC एड्रेस का उपयोग करता है
D. फ़ायरवॉल4. नेटवर्क ट्रैफ़िक को फ़िल्टर करता है
questions.solution:
A-2 (Hub): A "dumb" device that sends incoming data to every connected port (broadcast).

B-3 (Switch): An "intelligent" device that uses MAC addresses to send data only to the specific destination.

C-1 (Router): Acts as a gateway to connect different networks (like your home network to the Internet).

D-4 (Firewall): A security barrier that filters traffic based on safety rules.

Read the following about Computer Software and choose the correct option:-

(i) Computer Software is a programming code executed on a computer processor.

questions.question_hi:
कंप्यूटर सॉफ्टवेयर के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़ें और सही विकल्प चुनें :-

(i) कंप्यूटर सॉफ्टवेयर, कंप्यूटर प्रोसेसर पर निष्पादित एक प्रोग्रामिंग कोड है।

Computer Software:

questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित शब्दों को उनके सही कार्य से मिलाएँ:

A. डिस्क डीफ़्रेग्मेंटेशन1. उपयोगकर्ता की पहचान सत्यापित करता है
B. प्रमाणीकरण2. डिस्क पर खंडित डेटा को पुनर्व्यवस्थित करता है
C. VPN3. सुरक्षित एन्क्रिप्टेड नेटवर्क टनल
D. फ़ायरवॉल4. आने-जाने वाले ट्रैफ़िक को नियंत्रित करता है
questions.solution:
A. Disk Defragmentation: Over time, files stored on a hard drive (HDD) become scattered in different physical locations. Defragmentation picks up these pieces and puts them back together in a contiguous order, which reduces the movement of the read/write head and speeds up the computer.

B. Authentication: This is the "Who are you?" step of security. Common methods include Knowledge (passwords), Possession (security tokens), or Inherence (fingerprints/FaceID).

C. VPN (Virtual Private Network): A VPN masks your IP address and encrypts your data, essentially creating a "tunnel" through the internet. This prevents hackers or ISPs from seeing your browsing activity.

D. Firewall: Acting as a barrier between a trusted internal network and an untrusted external network (like the internet), a firewall inspects "packets" of data to decide whether to let them through or block them.

questions.question:
Consider the below statements.

i. A polymorphic virus changes its code signature every time it replicates to avoid detection.

ii. A macro virus can infect documents and spreadsheets through embedded scripting languages.

iii. A stealth virus hides its presence by intercepting system calls that would reveal its location.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दिए गए कथनों पर विचार करें।

i. एक पॉलीमॉर्फिक वायरस पहचान से बचने के लिए हर बार प्रतिकृति बनाते समय अपना कोड हस्ताक्षर बदलता है।

ii. एक मैक्रो वायरस एम्बेडेड स्क्रिप्टिंग भाषाओं के माध्यम से दस्तावेजों और स्प्रेडशीट को संक्रमित कर सकता है।

iii. एक स्टील्थ वायरस सिस्टम कॉल को रोककर अपनी उपस्थिति छुपाता है जिससे उसका स्थान पता चल जाता है।

उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा कथन सही है?
questions.solution:
All three statements (i, ii, and iii) are correct descriptions of different types of computer viruses and their mechanisms.

Explanation of Statements:

i. A polymorphic virus changes its code signature every time it replicates to avoid detection. This statement is correct. Polymorphic viruses are designed to mutate their own code, creating slightly different, but still functional, versions of themselves with each infection. This constant change makes it difficult for signature-based antivirus software to identify and block them using a fixed definition.

ii. A macro virus can infect documents and spreadsheets through embedded scripting languages. This statement is correct. Macro viruses are written in the macro languages used by software applications, most commonly Microsoft Office programs like Word and Excel. They embed their malicious code into documents. When an infected document is opened and macros are enabled, the virus runs, infecting the user's system and other documents.

iii. A stealth virus hides its presence by intercepting system calls that would reveal its location. This statement is correct. Stealth viruses are a category of malware that actively tries to hide itself from the operating system and antivirus software. One common technique is to intercept low-level system requests (system calls) for information. For example, if an antivirus program requests to read a file that the virus has infected, the stealth virus can intercept this request and present the original, uninfected version of the file, thereby avoiding detection.

Further Insights:

These virus types are not mutually exclusive; a single piece of malware can incorporate multiple techniques. For instance, a virus could be both polymorphic and stealthy to maximize its chances of evading detection.

The evolution of these advanced virus types necessitated the development of more sophisticated antivirus techniques, such as heuristic analysis and behavioral monitoring, which look for suspicious actions rather than just matching known code signatures.

questions.question:
Which of the following is a benefit of e-banking in India?

A) Convenience

B) Accessibility

C) Cost savings

D) Increased risk of fraud
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा भारत में ई-बैंकिंग का लाभ है?

A) सुविधा

B) अभिगम्यता

C) लागत बचत

D) धोखाधड़ी का खतरा बढ़ गया
questions.solution:
E-banking in India offers several benefits, such as:

Convenience: E-banking provides customers with the convenience of accessing banking services anytime and anywhere through a computer or mobile device.

Accessibility: E-banking makes banking services accessible to more people, including those in remote or rural areas.

Cost savings: E-banking is typically less expensive for both customers and banks than traditional banking methods, as it eliminates the need for physical branches and reduces administrative costs.

Increased risk of fraud: While e-banking has many benefits, it does come with some risks, including an increased risk of fraud. However, this is not considered a benefit of e-banking.

questions.question: Which of the following memory unit communicates directly with the CPU?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी मेमोरी यूनिट सीधे सीपीयू से संचार करती है?
questions.solution:
• Primary Memory is the unit which directly communicates with the CPU is known as Primary Memory.

Further Insight:

• Primary Memory

○ Primary memory is the computer memory that the processor accesses first or directly.

○ It temporarily stores running applications and services, allowing the processor to access them during execution.

○ It is also known as primary storage or main memory.

○ Random Access Memory (RAM) is a type of primary memory.

• Auxiliary Memory

○ It is also referred to as secondary storage or external memory.

○ It is a non-volatile memory, meaning it retains data even when the device is powered off.

○ It is not directly accessed by the CPU; instead, it is accessed via input/output channels.

• Secondary Memory

○ It operates slower compared to primary memory.

○ It Used to store data and information permanently.

○ Data from secondary memory is transferred to primary memory before the CPU can access it.

○ It includes storage devices like hard disks, CD-ROMs, and DVDs.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:

1. The TEXT() function in Excel converts a numeric value into text in a specified format.

2. After applying the TEXT() function, the resulting value can still be used directly for arithmetic calculations.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. एक्सेल में TEXT() फ़ंक्शन एक संख्यात्मक मान को निर्दिष्ट प्रारूप में टेक्स्ट में परिवर्तित करता है।

2. TEXT() फ़ंक्शन लागू करने के बाद, परिणामी मान का उपयोग अंकगणितीय गणनाओं के लिए सीधे किया जा सकता है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is Correct. The primary purpose of the TEXT() function is to take a number and turn it into a string of text while applying a specific format (like currency, date, or percentage).

Syntax: TEXT(value, format_code)

Example: =TEXT(0.5, "0%") results in the text "50%".

Statement 2 is Incorrect. The TEXT() function explicitly changes the data type from Numeric to Text (String).

-Most arithmetic functions (like SUM) will ignore text values.

-While Excel sometimes tries to "coerce" text back into numbers if you use a direct operator (like +), it is highly unreliable and often results in a #VALUE! error, especially if the format includes non-numeric characters like currency symbols or letters.

-Once converted, the value is essentially treated like a word rather than a number.

questions.question: Which of the following virus can spread in multiple ways infecting both program files and System Sectors?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा वायरस प्रोग्राम फाइलों और सिस्टम सेक्टर दोनों को संक्रमित करने वाले कई तरीकों से फैल सकता है?
questions.solution:
Multipartite Virusinfects and spreads in multiple ways. It can infect both program files and system sectors.

Macro Virus - Such viruses spread when an infected document is opened, often through e-mail attachments.

Direct Action Virus - This virus comes into action when a file containing virus is executed. It remains dormant otherwise.

Polymorphic Virus - This virus changes its code each time an infected file is executed. It does this to evade antivirus programs.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:

i. The References tab in MS Word allows users to insert footnotes, endnotes, citations, and manage sources.

ii. The Layout tab is used only for changing document themes and style sets.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i. एमएस वर्ड में संदर्भ टैब उपयोगकर्ताओं को फुटनोट्स, एंडनोट्स, उद्धरण सम्मिलित करने और स्रोतों का प्रबंधन करने की अनुमति देता है।

ii. लेआउट टैब का उपयोग केवल दस्तावेज़ थीम और शैली सेट बदलने के लिए किया जाता है।

options.label: D

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about pipelining in CPU:

1. Pipelining improves instruction throughput.

2. Pipelining allows overlapping of instruction execution.

3. Pipelining reduces the execution time of individual instructions.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
सीपीयू में पाइपलाइनिंग के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. पाइपलाइनिंग से इंस्ट्रक्शन थ्रूपुट में सुधार होता है।

2. पाइपलाइनिंग से इंस्ट्रक्शन निष्पादन में ओवरलैपिंग संभव होती है।

3. पाइपलाइनिंग से व्यक्तिगत इंस्ट्रक्शन के निष्पादन समय में कमी आती है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 (Correct): Throughput (the total number of tasks finished per second) increases.

Statement 2 (Correct): It works like an assembly line; while one instruction is being decoded, the next one is already being fetched.

Statement 3 (Incorrect): The time it takes for one specific instruction to travel through all stages (latency) does not decrease; it might actually increase slightly.

questions.question: The cost prices of sugar and tea are in the ratio 5 : 8, while their selling prices are in the ratio 7 : 10. If the profit percentage on sugar is 40%, then the profit percentage on tea is:
questions.question_hi: चीनी और चाय की लागत मूल्य का अनुपात 5 : 8 है, जबकि उनकी बिक्री मूल्य का अनुपात 7 : 10 है। यदि चीनी पर लाभ प्रतिशत 40% है, तो चाय पर लाभ प्रतिशत है:
questions.solution:
Let CPs of sugar and tea be 5x and 8x.

Profit on sugar = 40%

So, SP of sugar = 5x * 140/100 = 7x

Given SP ratio = 7 : 10

Therefore, SP of tea = 10x

CP of tea = 8x

Profit % on tea = [(10x − 8x)/8x] * 100

= (2x/8x) * 100

= 25%

questions.question: A parallelogram has adjacent sides 20 cm and 12 cm with included angle 30°. Find its area.
questions.question_hi: एक समांतर चतुर्भुज के आसन्न भुजाएँ 20 सेमी और 12 सेमी हैं जिनके बीच का कोण 30° है। इसका क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Area = ab sinθ = ab sin30°

= 20 X 12 X ½

= 120 cm2

questions.question: Prerna started a business by investing 0.75 lakh. Mansee joins the business by investing 1 lakh after few months. After how many months Mansee joined the business if at the end of the year profit was divided between Mansee and Prerna in the ratio of 13: 18?
questions.question_hi: प्रेरणा ने 0.75 लाख का निवेश करते हुए एक व्यवसाय शुरू किया। मानसी कुछ महीनों के बाद 1 लाख के निवेश से व्यवसाय में शामिल होती है। यदि वर्ष के अंत में लाभ मानसी और प्रेरणा के बीच 13: 18 के अनुपात में विभाजित किया जाता है, तो कितने महीनों के बाद मानसी व्यवसाय में शामिल हुईं?
questions.solution:
Let's assume Mansee invested the amount for 'N' months.

Therefore, total investment made by Mansee = N lakh

Total investment made by Prerna = (0.75 X 12) lakh = 9

Hence the ratio in which profit will be divided between Mansee and Prerna = N: 9

Hence; N/9 = 13/18

=> N = 13/18 X 9

=> N = 13/2 = 6 (1/2)

Therefore, we can say that Mansee invested after 5 (1/2) months.

questions.question: If the standard deviation of first N natural numbers is 2√13, then find the value of 'N - 1'.
questions.question_hi: यदि पहले N प्राकृतिक संख्याओं का मानक विचलन 2√13 है, तो 'N - 1' का मान ज्ञात करें।
questions.solution:
Standard deviation of first n natural numbers = √[(N2 - 1)/12]

√[(N2 - 1)/12] = 2√13

(N2 - 1)/12 = 52

N2 - 1 = 624

N2 = 625

N = 25

N - 1 = 24

questions.question: The total surface area of the hemisphere is 4158 cm2. If the sphere's radius is equal to the radius of the hemisphere, then find the curved surface area of the sphere.

questions.question: A bag contains 6 black balls, 4 blue balls, and 5 pink balls. Two balls are drawn at random. What is the probability that one ball drawn is black and the other is blue?
questions.question_hi: एक बैग में 6 काले गेंदें, 4 नीली गेंदें, और 5 गुलाबी गेंदें हैं। दो गेंदें यादृच्छिक रूप से निकाली जाती हैं। एक गेंद काली और दूसरी नीली होने की संभावना क्या है?
questions.solution:
Total balls = 6 + 4 + 5 = 15

Total ways to draw two balls = 15C2 = 105

Favourable outcomes = 6C1 * 4C1 = 6 * 4 = 24

Hence, the required probability = 24/105 = 8/35

questions.question: If the angles of a triangle are in the ratio of 5 : 6 : 7, what is the type of such triangle?
questions.question_hi: यदि किसी त्रिभुज के कोणों का अनुपात 5 : 6 : 7 है, तो यह त्रिभुज किस प्रकार का होगा?
questions.solution:
First angle = 5/(5 + 6 + 7) * 180° = 50°

Second angle = 6/(5 + 6 + 7) * 180° = 60°

Third angle = 7/(5 + 6 + 7) * 180° = 70°

This triangle is acute as well as scalene at the same time.

Statement I:

questions.question: The average of x numbers is y and average of y numbers is x, then the average of all the numbers taken together is:

questions.solution:
Average of x numbers = y

Addition of x numbers = xy

Average of y numbers = x

Addition of y numbers = xy

Average of all numbers = (xy + xy)/(x + y) = 2xy/(x + y)

questions.question: If 10 men can complete a piece of work in 12 days by working 7 hours a day, then in how many days can 14 men do the same work by working 6 hours a day?

questions.solution:
M1H1D1 = M2H2D2

=> 10 * 7 * 12 = 14 * 6 * D2

=> D2 = 840/(14 * 6)

=> D2 = 10 days

questions.question: 'P' speaks the truth 5 out of 12 times and 'Q' speaks the truth 8 out of 21 times. What is the probability that they contradict each other in stating the same fact?
questions.question_hi: 'P' 12 में से 5 बार सच बोलता है और 'Q' 21 में से 8 बार सच बोलता है। क्या संभावना है कि वे एक ही तथ्य बताते हुए एक-दूसरे का खंडन करें?
questions.solution:
Probability of P tell a lie = 1 - 5/12 = 7/12

Probability of Q tell a lie = 1 - 8/21 = 13/21

Hence, the required probability = 5/12 * 13/21 + 7/12 * 8/21

= 65/252 + 56/252

= 121/252

questions.question: Pipe A can fill a cistern in 16 minutes. But there is a leakage developed on the cistern due to which it got filled in 20 minutes. Find the time taken by leakage alone to empty the cistern.
questions.question_hi: पाइप A एक टंकी को 16 मिनट में भर सकता है। लेकिन टंकी में रिसाव होने के कारण टंकी 20 मिनट में भरती है। अकेले रिसाव द्वारा टंकी को खाली करने में लगने वाला समय ज्ञात कीजिये।
questions.solution:
Let the leakage can empty the cistern in X minutes

Part of cistern got filled in 1 minutes = 1/16

Part of cistern got empty in 1 minutes due to leakage = 1/X

According to question,

1/X + 1/16 = 1/20

1/X = 1/20 - 1/16

1/X = (4 - 5)/80

X = - 80(negative sign indicates emptying of cistern)

questions.question: In a triangle PQR, S is a point of QR such that QS = SR. If PS = 18 cm, then find the length of TS. Given that T is the centroid of triangle PQR.

Given that QS = SR and T is the centroid. So, PS will be the median of triangle PQR.

We know that the centroid divides the median in the ratio of 2: 1.

Given PS = 18 cm

So, TS = 18 * 1/3 = 6 cm

questions.question: In a certain code language, (I) 'parcel reached office' is written as 'di ke mu', (II) 'parcel reached home' is written as 'di ke sa', (III) 'urgent parcel home' is written as 'ti di sa', and (IV) 'office security check' is written as 'mu zo pa' What will be the code for 'reached home'?
questions.question_hi: एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में, (I) 'parcel reached office' को 'di ke mu' लिखा जाता है, (II) 'parcel reached home' को 'di ke sa' लिखा जाता है, (III) 'urgent parcel home' को 'ti di sa' लिखा जाता है, और (IV) 'office security check' को 'mu zo pa' लिखा जाता है। 'reached home' का कोड क्या होगा?
questions.solution:
Compare (I) 'parcel reached office' = di ke mu and (III) 'urgent parcel home' = ti di sa

The common word is parcel, and the common code is di, so di = parcel

Now use (II) 'parcel reached home' = di ke sa

Since di = parcel, the remaining codes ke and sa are for reached and home

Use (III) ti di sa again: di = parcel, so sa = home and ti = urgent

Therefore in (II), the remaining code ke = reached

Hence 'reached home' is coded as ke sa (Option B)

questions.question: In a certain coding pattern, BARN is written as SWFG. How will SAND be written in that pattern?
questions.question_hi: एक निश्चित कोडिंग पैटर्न में, BARN को SWFG के रूप में लिखा जाता है। उस पैटर्न में SAND को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions.solution:
The rule is:

Each letter is increased by 5 positions in the alphabet.

Then the obtained letters are written in reverse order.

Check with BARN:

B => G

A => F

R => W

N => S

So, BARN becomes G F W S

=> S W F G (in reverse order)

Now apply the same rule to SAND.

S => X

A => F

N => S

D => I

So, SAND becomes X F S I

=> I S F X (in reverse order)

72 B 8 A 4 C 16 D 12 = ?
questions.solution:
Given expression: 72 B 8 A 4 C 16 D 12

Symbol meanings:

A → X

B → ÷

C → +

D → -

Rewrite the expression:

= 72 ÷ 8 X 4 + 16 - 12

= 9 X 4 + 16 - 12

= 36 + 16 - 12

= 52 - 12

= 40

questions.question: In a vertical pile of 158 admission forms, a blue form was shifted 28 places upward and then became 95th from the bottom. What was its earlier position from the bottom?
questions.question_hi: 158 प्रवेश फॉर्मों के एक ऊर्ध्वाधर ढेर में, एक नीला फॉर्म 28 स्थान ऊपर स्थानांतरित किया गया और फिर नीचे से 95वां हो गया। इसका पहले नीचे से स्थान क्या था?
questions.solution:
Formula: Position from top = Total objects − Position from bottom + 1

New position of the blue form from the top = 158 − 95 + 1

= 63 + 1

= 64

The blue form was shifted 28 places upward.

So, its earlier position from the top = 64 + 28

= 92

Formula: Position from bottom = Total objects − Position from top + 1

Earlier position from the bottom = 158 − 92 + 1

= 66 + 1

= 67

questions.question:
'S $ D' means 'S is the father of D's son'.

'S % D' means 'S is the brother of D'.

'S ^ D' means 'S is the daughter of D'.

'S + D' means 'S is the mother D'.

If T $ F + W % Z + L ^ R, then who among the following is the granddaughter of T?
questions.question_hi:
'S $ D' का अर्थ 'S, D के पुत्र का पिता है'।

'S % D' का अर्थ 'S, D का भाई है'।

'S ^ D' का अर्थ 'S, D की पुत्री है'।

'S + D' का अर्थ 'S, D की माता है'।

यदि T $ F + W % Z + L ^ R है,तो तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन T की पोती/नातिन है?
questions.solution:
It is given that:

'S $ D' means 'S is the father of D's son'.

'S % D' means 'S is the brother of D'.

'S ^ D' means 'S is the daughter of D'.

'S + D' means 'S is the mother D'.

After decoding the expression, 'T $ F + W % Z + L ^ R', we get:

T is the father of F's son.

F is the mother of W.

W is the brother of Z.

Z is the mother of L.

L is the daughter of R.

Thus, L is the granddaughter of T.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

Our institutions are producing unemployable Indians and Polytechnic Institutes are the biggest example of this fact. I studied for a diploma in textile technology in which we were to be taught how to use weaving, spinning and other aspects of making yarn and fabric. The first thing to know is that polytechnics are filled with people who do not want to be there. Most of us were not studious enough or ambitious enough to want to school further. questions.question: What is the tone of the author at the end of the passage?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option a).

The tone at the end of the passage is a complex mix of fear and awe.

Fearful: The narrator's "blood ran cold," and their hand "trembled." These are physical reactions to fear and shock upon realizing the immense and potentially dangerous power the map holds.

Awestruck: At the same time, the narrator is filled with a sense of wonder and profound realization. Phrases like "a living document of creation," "the world... was not a fixed and finished thing... but a draft waiting for an author," and the final, powerful statement, "And in my hand, I held the quill," convey a sense of awe at the incredible possibilities and the narrator's new role as a creator.

The combination of these two emotions makes "Fearful yet awestruck" the most accurate description of the final tone.

b) Detached and indifferent: This is incorrect. The narrator is deeply and emotionally involved.

c) Joyful and triumphant: This is not quite right. While there's a sense of power, the narrator's fear ("blood ran cold") indicates the feeling is more overwhelming than purely joyful or triumphant.

d) Regretful and sorrowful: The narrator shows no regret for their actions; instead, they are contemplating what they might do next.
questions.passage:
Directions :Read the following passage and answer the questions based on the passage:

The scent of our guild hall was a mix of aging parchment, walnut ink, and the sharp tang of binding glue. For months, my apprenticeship to Master Elara had consisted of the mundane: grinding pigments, stretching vellum, and endless practice of the Rose of the Winds. My hands, stained with a permanent map of blue and ochre inks, ached for a real chart. Then, one rain-swept afternoon, Elara unrolled the Imago Mundi. It was a vast, ancient thing, its edges frayed like a forgotten coastline. The parchment was brittle, the seas a faded aquamarine, and the landmasses were shapes I had never seen in any modern atlas. My task, Elara explained in her hushed, reverent voice, was not merely to copy it, but to renew it. I was to trace every line, re-ink every letter, and breathe life back into its faded splendor. For days, I worked with a devotion bordering on worship. My quill, a feather from a sea eagle, followed the ghost of the original cartographer's hand. I traced jagged mountain ranges that seemed to breathe cold air onto my fingers and deserts so vast they made me thirsty. It was while I was inking a small, unnamed archipelago in the far western sea that the first strange thing happened. I had added a tiny spring to the largest island, a flourish of my own born of a whim, marking it with a droplet of cerulean blue. The next morning, when I returned to my work, a small, damp patch had bloomed on the vellum, precisely where I had drawn the spring. It smelled of fresh rain. Dismissing it as a spilled water pot, I continued. Later, while tracing the edges of the Great Northern Forest, I grew frustrated with a particularly gnarled section. On impulse, I drew a new, clearer path through the dense woods, a clean line of burnt umber. The ink had barely dried when a tremor ran through the stone floor of the guild hall. Master Elara rushed in, her face pale. "A path has opened," she whispered, her eyes wide with a fear I did not understand. "The traders are saying a clear road has appeared overnight in the Great Forest, where none was before." My blood ran cold. I stared at the map, at the lines I had drawn. They were not just ink on parchment. They were cause and effect, a living document of creation. My hand trembled as I looked at the vast, empty spaces on the ancient chart - the Terra Incognita. What would happen if I drew a new mountain? A new river? A new city? The world, I realized, was not a fixed and finished thing to be recorded, but a draft waiting for an author. And in my hand, I held the quill.

questions.solution:

This event precedes the drawing of the forest path and the subsequent tremor, making it the correct answer.

options.label: A
options.text: A period of formal education in theory

options.label: B
options.text: A phase of learning under guidance and training

options.label: C
options.text: A stage of independent professional work

options.label: D
options.text: A ceremonial initiation into a guild

questions.correct_text: A phase of learning under guidance and training
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option b).

An apprenticeship is a system where a person, the apprentice, works for a skilled employer or master for a fixed period to learn a particular craft or trade.

The passage clearly illustrates this relationship: The narrator is the apprentice. "Master Elara" is the skilled expert providing guidance. The work described ("grinding pigments, stretching vellum") is the practical, on-the-job training.

This situation perfectly matches the definition in option (b).

a) is incorrect because the tasks described are practical and hands-on, not purely theoretical.

c) is incorrect because an apprenticeship is a stage of learning, before one becomes an independent professional.

d) is incorrect because an initiation is a single ceremony, whereas the passage describes the apprenticeship as a period lasting "for months."

questions.question: What is the grammatical role of the clause "when I returned to my work" in the sentence - "The next morning, when I returned to my work, a small, damp patch had bloomed on the vellum, precisely where I had drawn the spring."

options.label: A
options.text: It functions as an adjective clause modifying morning.

options.label: B
options.text: It functions as an adverbial clause of time modifying had bloomed.

options.label: C
options.text: It functions as a noun clause acting as the subject of the sentence.

options.label: D
options.text: It functions as a relative clause describing the patch.

questions.correct_text: It functions as an adverbial clause of time modifying had bloomed.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option b).

Main Clause: "a small, damp patch had bloomed on the vellum"

Clause in Question: "when I returned to my work"

The clause answers the question "When?". Specifically, it tells us when the action of the main verb ("had bloomed") was discovered or took place.

Adverbs and adverbial phrases/clauses answer questions like when, where, why, and how. Therefore, the clause is an adverbial clause of time. It modifies the verb "had bloomed" by providing the time context for that action.

Option a): While it follows the word "morning," it isn't describing or defining the morning itself. It's setting the time for the main action of the sentence. An adjective clause would be something like, "The morning that I started my work was cold and rainy."

Option c): A noun clause acts as a noun. The subject of the sentence is "a small, damp patch." The clause cannot be the subject.

Option d): A relative (or adjectival) clause must describe a noun. This clause does not describe the "patch"; it describes when the patch was seen. Also, relative clauses typically follow the noun they modify, and this one is at the beginning of the sentence.

Note:

Relative Clause: A relative clause is one that's connected to the main clause of the sentence by a word such as who, whom, which, that, or whose.

Example: He adopted a puppy that had brown eyes and black fur. The highlighted part is the relative clause.

Directions : In the following passage, some of the words have been left out and replaced by a blank represented by an alphabet. First read the passage and try to understand what it is about. Then fill in the blanks as per the questions given.

Often, medical science, despite all the incredible things it can now do, cannot find any explanation for symptoms that we have, and we have to accept ___(A)___ suggestions for the cause of our problems, like too much stress or allergies. For people with what are called "contested illnesses," however, that uncertainty can become unbearable. As months and months of pain and suffering persist ___(B)___, the need to find answers mounts. Those answers, many insist, should not be "there is nothing wrong with you" or "it's just depression." Contested illnesses include conditions like chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS, also called myalgic encephalomyelitis or ME), fibromyalgia, multiple chemical sensitivities, and chronic Lyme disease. Contested illnesses have uncertain causes, unclear treatments, and disputed medical, legal and cultural definitions. These conditions are called "contested" because some people, including physicians and scientists, ___(C)___ their existence. This has led to the formation of patient advocacy organizations like Solve ME/CFS, the National Fibromyalgia and Chronic Pain Association, and the International Lyme and Associated Disease Society. Each of these organizations provide ___(D)___ about their respective illnesses, lobby for increased research funding, and advocate for acceptance of the illnesses as distinct biological entities. In some ___(E)___, organized medical groups have clashed with people suffering with contested illnesses.

questions.question: Which word/phrase should come at (B)?
questions.solution: 'Unabated' means 'without becoming weaker in strength or force' and it is an adjective which is usually used after verbs. For example: the fighting continued unabated throughout the night. It is the only word that fits perfectly here, and it is modifying the word 'suffering'; telling us about the 'suffering'. Option D is the correct answer.

Contested illnesses include conditions like chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS, also called myalgic encephalomyelitis or ME), fibromyalgia, multiple chemical sensitivities, and chronic Lyme disease. Contested illnesses have uncertain causes, unclear treatments, and disputed medical, legal and cultural definitions. These conditions are called "contested" because some people, including physicians and scientists, ___(C)___ their existence. This has led to the formation of patient advocacy organizations like Solve ME/CFS, the National Fibromyalgia and Chronic Pain Association, and the International Lyme and Associated Disease Society. Each of these organizations provide ___(D)___ about their respective illnesses, lobby for increased research funding, and advocate for acceptance of the illnesses as distinct biological entities. In some ___(E)___, organized medical groups have clashed with people suffering with contested illnesses.

questions.question: Which word/phrase should come at (E)?
questions.solution: A noun is needed in the blank. The word 'some' takes a plural noun after it if the noun has a plural form. In other cases, it takes an uncountable noun. 'Instance' means 'an example or single occurrence of something.' Its plural is 'instances'. Option D is the correct answer. All the other options are grammatically or contextually incorrect.

questions.question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A place where dead bodies are kept
questions.solution:
A morgue is a facility where dead bodies are temporarily stored, typically for identification, autopsy, or investigation, especially in cases of unnatural or suspicious deaths.

A cemetery is a designated area where the dead are buried.

A vault is a large room or chamber used for storage, especially an underground one. While it can house bodies, it is not as commonly used as a temporary storage place for bodies before burial or cremation like a morgue or mortuary.

A crematorium is a facility where dead bodies are cremated (burned to ashes).

Hence, option (d) is correct.

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined. Select the option that contains an error.

The committee decided to send invitations to the daughters-in-laws of all the prominent families for the annual charity event.
questions.solution:
"Daughters-in-laws" in option a) is incorrect.

A compound noun forms the plural by making the principal word plural. The correct plural form of "daughter-in-law" is "daughters-in-law," not "daughters-in-laws."

The correct sentence should be: The committee decided to send invitations to the daughters-in-law of all the prominent families for the annual charity event.

Hence, option (a) is the answer.

questions.question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

After tasting all three of the chef's new dessert creations, (1)/ the food critic declared that the chocolate lava cake (2)/ was clearly the more delicious and visually appealing option (3)/ on the entire redesigned dessert menu. (4)

options.label: A
options.text: After tasting all three of the chef's new dessert creations, (1)

options.label: B
options.text: was clearly the more delicious and visually appealing option (3)

options.label: C
options.text: on the entire redesigned dessert menu (4)

options.label: D
options.text: the food critic declared that the chocolate lava cake (2)

questions.correct_text: was clearly the more delicious and visually appealing option (3)
questions.solution:
The error is in the use of the comparative degree instead of the superlative degree.

The comparative degree (using "-er" or "more") is used when comparing two items. (e.g., "This cake is more delicious than that one.")

The superlative degree (using "-est" or "most") is used when comparing three or more items. (e.g., "This is the most delicious cake of all.")

Part (1) of the sentence explicitly states that the critic tasted "all three of the chef's new dessert creations." Since the comparison involves three items, the superlative form is required.

The corrected sentence should read: "After tasting all three of the chef's new dessert creations, the food critic declared that the chocolate lava cake was clearly the most delicious and visually appealing option on the entire redesigned dessert menu."

Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.

Note: · The Positive Degree is used to denote the mere existence of some quality of what we speak about. It is used when no comparison is made.

· The Comparative degree denotes a higher degree of quality than the positive and is used when two things are compared.

· The Superlative degree indicates the highest degree of quality and is used when more than two things (or sets of things) are compared.

questions.question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

When the lead actor finally appeared on stage, (1)/ the audience gives him a standing ovation (2)/ and applauded enthusiastically for several minutes (3)/ before the director signalled for silence. (4)

options.label: A
options.text: the audience gives him a standing ovation (2)

options.label: B
options.text: and applauded enthusiastically for several minutes (3)

options.label: C
options.text: When the lead actor finally appeared on stage, (1)

options.label: D
options.text: before the director signalled for silence (4)

questions.correct_text: the audience gives him a standing ovation (2)
questions.solution:
The error is a matter of verb tense consistency. The sentence describes a series of events that happened in the past.

"When the lead actor finally appeared..." (past tense)

"...and applauded enthusiastically..." (past tense)

"...before the director signalled for silence." (past tense)

All the other main verbs are in the past tense. The verb "gives" in part (2) is in the present tense, which breaks the sequence. It should be in the past tense to match the rest of the sentence. Its past tense form is "gave".

The corrected sentence should read: "When the lead actor finally appeared on stage, the audience gave him a standing ovation and applauded enthusiastically for several minutes before the director signalled for silence."

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The tailor will first baste the dress together with loose stitches for a fitting.

options.label: A
options.text: She remembered to baste the turkey every 30 minutes to keep it moist.

options.label: B
options.text: The instructions say to baste the sleeves onto the bodice before sewing.

options.label: C
options.text: He used a contrasting thread to baste the hem so he could see it easily.

options.label: D
options.text: To prepare for sewing, baste the pattern pieces together.

questions.correct_text: She remembered to baste the turkey every 30 minutes to keep it moist.
questions.solution:
A homonym is a word that is spelled and pronounced the same as another word but has a different meaning.

In the original sentence, "baste" is a sewing term that means to tack or sew with long, loose, temporary stitches.

In options (b), (c), and (d), "baste" is used with the exact same sewing meaning.

In option (a), "baste" is a cooking term that means to pour juices or melted fat over food (especially meat) during cooking to keep it moist. This is a completely different meaning, making it the correct homonym.

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Identify the word that doesn't fit the part of speech needed.

The sudden rise in temperature caused the metal to expand rapid during testing.
questions.solution:
The word that doesn't fit the part of speech needed is b) rapid.

The sentence requires an adverb to modify the verb expand, indicating how the metal expanded.

"Rapid" is an adjective, so it cannot modify the verb. The correct adverb is "rapidly."

The correct sentence would be: "The sudden rise in temperature caused the metal to expand rapidly during testing."

a): expand - verb; correctly describes the action.

c): sudden - adjective; correctly modifies "rise."

d): temperature - noun; correctly used as the subject's reference.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can replace the bracketed segment in the given sentence.

The shipment (arrive) at the warehouse yesterday evening.
questions.solution:
The sentence discusses a past event (evident from 'yesterday'), which means we need to use the correct past tense form of the verb "arrive". "Arrived" (option c) is the simple past tense form of the verb "arrive", which correctly indicates that the shipment reached the warehouse yesterday evening.

Option (a) is not correct. "Will arrive" indicates future tense, which does not fit with the context of the sentence describing a past event.

Option (b) is also incorrect. "Have arrived" is the present perfect tense, indicating an action that occurred at an unspecified time before now, not specifically yesterday evening.

Option (d) is incorrect as well. "Arriving" is the present participle form of the verb "arrive", which does not fit with the past tense context of the sentence. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

The correct sentence is: The shipment arrived at the warehouse yesterday evening.

NOTE:

"Participle: A word formed from a verb (e.g. going, gone, being, been) and used as an adjective (e.g. working woman, burnt toast) or a noun (e.g. good breeding). In English, participles are also used to make compound verb forms (e.g. is going, has been). Consider the sentences given below:

Dancing at the party, the woman fell on the ground.

Encouraged by her parents, Rita went on to pursue her passion.

The highlighted word in the first sentence is of the form Verb + ing and is used as a present participle. It is used to denote an action that is going on or incomplete, or imperfect.

The highlighted word in the second sentence is of the form verb + ed. It is used as a past participle. It denotes the completed action or state of the thing spoken of.

A past participle ends with the following: -ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n.

One should take great care and never get confused between a gerund and a present participle. They use the same forms but perform different functions: a gerund is a verbal noun, while a present participle is a verbal adjective."

questions.question: Choose the sentence with correct collocation for the word 'cold'.

The correct answer is d) I think I am beginning to catch a cold.

"Catch a cold" is a very strong and standard collocation in English. It's the most idiomatic way to express that you are becoming sick with a cold.

questions.question:
Direction: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order.

P. They grew their state from a small town near the Tiber River in Italy into a vast empire containing more than 50 million inhabitants.

Q. The founding of the city of Rome in 753 BC; the establishment of the Roman empire in 27 BC; and the fall of the Roman empire in the 5th century AD.

S. Key moments in Rome's development include.
questions.solution:
"

Sentence R becomes our opening sentence here as it introduces us to the main subject (The Romans) of these jumbles. Later on, the sentence continues to talk about the Romans using the pronoun ‘they’. Then, sentence S tells us about the key moments in Rome’s development, which, sentence Q completes.

"

questions.question:
Direction: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order.

P. Several dozen indigenous leaders and representatives of Amazon communities have gathered.

Q. “I don’t want anyone to die in front of me. I don’t want everyone to kill each other,” prominent Raoni chief Metuktire told the meeting.

R. And his threats to throw their homelands open to mining concerns.

S. In the heart of the threatened rainforest to form an alliance against Brazil President Jair Bolsonaro’s environmental policy.

"

"

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

My friend advised me not to tick that answer.

options.label: A
options.text: My friend said to me, "Don't be ticking this answer."

options.label: B
options.text: My friend said to me, "Don't tick this answer."

options.label: C
options.text: My friend said to me, "You won't tick this answer."

options.label: D
options.text: My friend said to me, "Didn't tick that answer."

questions.correct_text: My friend said to me, "Don't tick this answer."
questions.solution:
Imperative Sentences in Direct Speech sometimes begin with Negative Commands like "Don't"

As required, "Said/ Say" in Direct Speech is changed into "Asked/ Ask", "Told/ Tell", "Advised/ Advised" etc. in Indirect Speech.

"Not + To+ Verb" is used in these sentences in Indirect Speech. For example, "don't go" changes into "not to go" in Indirect Speech.

Thus, going by the options is one of the best techniques to solve these questions.

For example:

My friend advised me not to go to Kolkata. (Indirect Speech)

My friend said to me, "Don't go to Kolkata". (Direct Speech)

The following things in the sentence will change when changed from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:

Indirect SpeechDirect Speech
advisedsaid to
not toDon't
thatthis

Therefore, the correct answer is: (b) My friend said to me, "Don't tick this answer."

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Has he applied for the post?

options.label: A
options.text: Had the post been applied by him?

options.label: B
options.text: Have the post been applied by him?

options.label: C
options.text: Has the post been applied for by him?

options.label: D
options.text: Did the post been applied by him?

questions.correct_text: Has the post been applied for by him?
questions.solution:
The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive Voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

The usage of a "to be" form of the verb ['been' here] is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

In Passive Voice, the preposition "by" is used before the object. However, it is optional in some cases.

The question in the active voice is an interrogative sentence. The answer to this question will be either "yes" or "no".

These types of sentences usually begin with a helping verb like: have, has and had.

The format of such a sentence in the active voice is: Have/Has/Had + Subject + V3 + Object?

Therefore, in Passive voice, the format will be: Have/Has/Had + Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + been + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case)?

For example:

Has Rohit written the letter? (Active)

Has the letter been written by Rohit? (Passive)

The options except (c) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.

Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

Note:

V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).

A Preposition is a word placed before a noun or a pronoun or a noun equivalent (pronoun, adverb, gerund, infinitive, adverbial clause, or any clause that can be used as the object of the preposition) and shows a relationship in space or time or a logical relationship between two or more people, places, or things in a sentence.

Examples

I. The teacher scolded the child for being late.

II. We're going to a party.

· The words in bold are called prepositions because they normally take position before (pre) a noun/pronoun or a noun equivalent (pronoun, adverb, gerund, infinitive, adverbial clause, or any clause that can be used as the object of the preposition.

· The noun/pronoun which is used with a preposition is called its Object.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

My grandfather said to me, "I bought this antique pocket watch from a small shop in London many years ago."

options.label: A
options.text: My grandfather told me that he had bought that antique pocket watch from a small shop in London many years before.

options.label: B
options.text: My grandfather told me that he bought that antique pocket watch from a small shop in London many years before.

options.label: C
options.text: My grandfather told me that he was buying that antique pocket watch from a small shop in London many years ago.

options.label: D
options.text: My grandfather told me that he have bought that antique pocket watch from a small shop in London many years ago.

questions.correct_text: My grandfather told me that he had bought that antique pocket watch from a small shop in London many years before.
questions.solution:
The sentence in the Direct Speech is in Past Simple Tense. Therefore, the sentence in the Indirect Speech should be in Past Perfect Tense.

Past Simple (Subject + V2 + Object) should be converted into Past Perfect (Subject + had + V3 + Object).

For example:

He said, "Arya sent me a book." (Direct Speech)

He said that Arya had sent him a book. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

"said to" changes to "told".

"I" changes to "he".

"bought" changes to "had bought".

"this" changes to "that".

"ago" changes to "before".

Therefore, the correct answer is: "My grandfather told me that he had bought that antique pocket watch from a small shop in London many years before."

Hence, option (a) is correct.

Note: V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).

questions.question:
Choose the word from the options that is most similar in meaning to the given word.

Opprobrium
questions.solution: 'Opprobrium' means 'Harsh criticism or censure.'. Options a) and d) can be rejected as they are unrelated to the word. 'Praise' means 'Express warm approval or admiration of.'. Hence, option c) can also be rejected as it is the exact opposite. 'Felicitous' means 'Well chosen or suited to the circumstances.'. 'Indolent' means 'Wanting to avoid activity or exertion; lazy.'. Hence, option b) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

Information has been gathered by the reporters.

options.label: A
options.text: The reporters have gathered the information.

options.label: B
options.text: The reporters have gather the information.

options.label: C
options.text: The reporters had gathered the information.

questions.correct_text: The reporters have gathered the information.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the helping verb [has] and the preposition 'by' is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

The Passive voice in this question is in Present Perfect. Thus, the Active voice will also be in the present perfect.

In Passive voice, the format is: Subject (Objective case) + has/have + been + V3 + by + Object (Subjective case).

Thus, the format of the active voice is: Subject + has/have + V3 + Object.

For example:

A new horse has been bought by Arya. (Passive Voice)

Arya has bought a new horse. (Active Voice)

The options except (a) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (a): The reporters have gathered the information.

questions.question:

A self-governing country or region.
questions.solution:
'Autonomy' means a self-governing country or region. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

'Anatomy' means the science that deals with the form and structure of organic bodies.
