questions.question:
Select the sentence which gives the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Under the weather

options.label: A
options.text: Due to the heavy downpour, the children were forced to stay indoors and play games.

options.label: B
options.text: He was in a very bad mood after having a serious argument with his close friend.

options.label: C
options.text: She had to cancel her plans for the evening because she was feeling a bit unwell.

options.label: D
options.text: Despite the chilly wind, he went for his regular morning walk in the park today.

questions.correct_text: She had to cancel her plans for the evening because she was feeling a bit unwell.
questions.solution:
The idiom "under the weather" means to feel slightly ill or sick.

Option (a): This talks about the literal weather, not a person's health. Incorrect.

Option (b): This describes a bad mood due to an argument, not a physical illness. Incorrect.

Option (c): This shows someone cancelling plans because they feel unwell, which is the exact meaning of the idiom. Correct.

Option (d): This is about someone being unaffected by the literal weather. Incorrect.

Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

My friend said to me, "Let us go to the new Italian restaurant tonight because I have heard great reviews about it."

options.label: A
options.text: My friend proposed that let us go to the new Italian restaurant that night because he had heard great reviews about it.

options.label: B
options.text: My friend suggested to me that we should go to the new Italian restaurant that night because he had heard great reviews about it.

options.label: C
options.text: My friend suggested to me to go to the new Italian restaurant tonight because he has heard great reviews about it.

options.label: D
options.text: My friend told me that we should go to the new Italian restaurant that night because I have heard great reviews about it.

questions.correct_text: My friend suggested to me that we should go to the new Italian restaurant that night because he had heard great reviews about it.
questions.solution:
When "Let" is used as a proposal/suggestion, "Said/said to" is changed to "proposed/proposed to" or "suggested/suggested to". "That" is added in indirect speech. "Let" is removed in the indirect speech. The modal verb "should" is added in indirect speech.

Example: He said, "Let us go to the amusement park." (Direct Speech)

He suggested that they should go to the amusement park. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

"said to" changes to "suggested to".

"Let us go" changes to "that we should go".

"tonight" changes to "that night".

"I" changes to "he".

"have heard" [Present Perfect tense in direct speech] changes to "had heard" [Past Perfect tense in indirect speech].

Therefore, the correct answer is: "My friend suggested to me that we should go to the new Italian restaurant that night because he had heard great reviews about it."

Hence, option (b) is correct.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

It's worth praising the fact that the engineer provided a __________ solution to the complex engineering problem.
questions.solution:
Let's look at the meanings of the given options.

Feasible: able to be made, done, or achieved.

Implausible: difficult to believe, or unlikely.

Unattainable: not able to be achieved.

Sporadic: happening sometimes; not regular or continuous.

"Feasible" is the correct answer as it means possible or practical, which would be appropriate for a solution to a complex engineering problem. The other options do not represent practicality.

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

The complete sentence is: It's worth praising the fact that the engineer provided a feasible solution to the complex engineering problem.

questions.question:
Fill in the blank with the correct verb form.

The crowd suddenly ___ silent when the lights went out.
questions.solution:
Solution:

Both actions belong to the simple past time frame. The verb fall follows the pattern fall - fell - fallen, so "fell" is apt.

Complete sentence: The crowd suddenly fell silent when the lights went out.

Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The noise pollution emanated ____ the busy city streets.
questions.solution:
The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is 'from'. The preposition 'from' is used to indicate the origin or starting point of something. In the sentence, "The noise pollution emanated from the busy city streets," 'from' accurately describes the source of the noise pollution, which is the busy city streets. Other prepositions are not correct for the given context. The preposition 'on' is commonly used to indicate a surface or position in contact with a surface. The preposition 'after' typically indicates the time following (an event or another period of time). The preposition 'for' is used to indicate the purpose or intended recipient. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

NOTE:

"A preposition is a word placed before a noun or a pronoun or a noun equivalent (pronoun, adverb, gerund, infinitive, adverbial clause, or any clause that can be used as the object of the preposition) and shows a relationship in space or time or a logical relationship between two or more people, places, or things in a sentence.

Examples

I. The teacher scolded the child for being late.

II. We're going to a party.

· The words in bold are called prepositions because they normally take position before (pre) a noun/pronoun or a noun equivalent (pronoun, adverb, gerund, infinitive, adverbial clause, or any clause that can be used as the object of the preposition.

· The noun/pronoun which is used with a preposition is called its Object."

questions.question:
Select the correct synonym of the given word.

INVEIGLEMENT
questions.solution: 'Inveiglement' refers to 'coaxing or flattery intended to persuade someone to do something'. 'Cajolery' is synonymous with it; hence, the answer is option d). 'Colloquial', 'idiomatic', 'demotic' are ordinary talks.

questions.question: Choose the one-word substitution for:"To confuse or annoy."
questions.solution:
'Crux' refers to the main point or the essence of something.

'Staid' refers to someone serious and self-restrained.

'Placate' means to make someone less angry or hostile.

'Vex' is the correct answer and means to annoy someone.

Hence, (a) is the right answer.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the 'SHINE' app launched by the Indian Railways:

I. The app was created as an extra way for workers to report sexual harassment, alongside the existing internal complaints committees.

II. Only permanent railway employees can use the app to file a complaint; it cannot be used to report incidents for visitors or contract workers.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारतीय रेलवे द्वारा लॉन्च किए गए 'SHINE' ऐप के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. यह ऐप यौन उत्पीड़न की रिपोर्ट करने के लिए एक अतिरिक्त तरीका के रूप में बनाया गया था, जो मौजूदा आंतरिक शिकायत समितियों के साथ-साथ है।

II. केवल स्थायी रेलवे कर्मचारी ही शिकायत दर्ज करने के लिए इस ऐप का उपयोग कर सकते हैं; इसे आगंतुकों या संविदा कर्मचारियों के लिए घटनाओं की रिपोर्ट करने के लिए उपयोग नहीं किया जा सकता।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Statement I is correct: The SHINE app serves as an additional, digital method to make reporting easier and works alongside the traditional internal committees already in place.

Statement II is incorrect: The app is not restricted only to permanent staff. It explicitly allows people to report incidents on behalf of outsiders, visitors, and contractual laborers who do not have personal accounts on the system.

The Indian Railways has launched a customised app for women employees to lodge complaints about sexual harassment at the workplace. Sexual Harassment Incident Notification for Empowerment (SHINE) was made operational on the occasion of the International Women's Day on March 8, 2026. This facility would be in addition to the existing internal complaints committee formed in every organisation in compliance with the Visakha guidelines of the Supreme Court in 1997 and Government of India instructions to protect women at workplace issued from time to time. With SHINE, women employees can lodge complaints through the Human Resources Management System (HRMS). According to railway sources, SHINE also allows reporting incidents or complaints on behalf of outsiders (visitors), contractual staff, students and others who may not have access to the app. SHINE had been developed to make the mechanism more confidential and to be addressed in an expeditious manner.

questions.question:
Consider the following Assertion (A) and Reason (R) and choose the correct option.

Assertion (A): The French Open is the only Grand Slam tennis tournament played on clay courts.

Reason (R): The French Open is held at Stade Roland Garros in Paris, a venue known for its clay-surface courts.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथन (A) और कारण (R) पर विचार करें और सही विकल्प चुनें।

कथन (A): फ्रेंच ओपन एकमात्र ग्रैंड स्लैम टेनिस टूर्नामेंट है जो मिट्टी के कोर्ट पर खेला जाता है।

कारण (R): फ्रेंच ओपन पेरिस के स्टेड रॉलैंड गैरोस में आयोजित किया जाता है, जो अपने मिट्टी के सतह वाले कोर्ट के लिए जाना जाता है।

options.label: A
options.text: Both A and R are individually true and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R व्यक्तिगत रूप से सत्य हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या है।

options.label: B
options.text: Both A and R are individually true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R व्यक्तिगत रूप से सत्य हैं लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options.label: C
options.text: A is true but R is false.
options.text_hi: A सत्य है लेकिन R असत्य है।

options.label: D
options.text: A is false but R is true.
options.text_hi: A असत्य है लेकिन R सत्य है।

questions.correct_text: Both A and R are individually true and R is the correct explanation of A.
questions.solution:
The French Open is the only Grand Slam played on clay; the other three Grand Slams are played on grass (Wimbledon) and hard courts (Australian Open and US Open).

Roland Garros in Paris is the host venue of the French Open and its main courts use clay, which directly explains why this Grand Slam is played on clay.

Further Insights:

- Wimbledon is hosted by the All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club, London, and is played on grass courts.

- The Australian Open is hosted at Melbourne Park (Melbourne) and is played on hard courts.

- The US Open is hosted at the USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center (New York City) and is played on hard courts.

- French Open trophies: men's singles - Coupe des Mousquetaires; women's singles - Suzanne Lenglen Cup.

- Wimbledon trophies: men's singles - Gentlemen's Singles Trophy; women's singles - Venus Rosewater Dish.

- Australian Open trophies: men's singles - Norman Brookes Challenge Cup; women's singles - Daphne Akhurst Memorial Cup.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Dravida (South Indian) temple architecture:

1) The vimana is the tower that rises directly above the garbhagriha (sanctum).

2) The gopuram is the pyramidal tower built directly above the garbhagriha (sanctum).

Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
द्रविड़ (दक्षिण भारतीय) मंदिर वास्तुकला के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) विमान वह मीनार है जो सीधे गर्भगृह (संकट) के ऊपर उठती है।

2) गोपुरम वह पिरामिडीय मीनार है जो सीधे गर्भगृह (संकट) के ऊपर बनाई जाती है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct because in Dravida temples the vimana is the superstructure over the sanctum.

Statement 2 is incorrect because a gopuram is the monumental gateway tower on the enclosure wall, not the tower over the sanctum.

Further Insights:

- The enclosure walls around a Dravida temple complex are called prakaras; gopurams are built as entrance gateways through these prakaras.

- Mandapa is the pillared hall attached to or near the sanctum; common types include ardha-mandapa, maha-mandapa and kalyana-mandapa.

- In many later Dravida complexes (especially Vijayanagara - Nayaka phase), gopurams often became taller and more dominant than the vimana.

- The finial placed at the top of the vimana is often called a stupi (kalasha-like element).

- Examples of major Dravida temples include the Brihadeeswara Temple (Thanjavur) and the Meenakshi Temple (Madurai).

questions.question: An increase in the Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) by RBI generally has what effect on money supply?
questions.question_hi: आरबीआई द्वारा नकद आरक्षित अनुपात (CRR) में वृद्धि का आमतौर पर मुद्रा आपूर्ति पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है?

options.label: A
options.text: It increases banks' lendable funds, raising money supply
options.text_hi: यह बैंकों के उधार देने योग्य फंड को बढ़ाता है, जिससे मुद्रा आपूर्ति बढ़ती है

options.label: B
options.text: It reduces banks' lendable funds, lowering money supply
options.text_hi: यह बैंकों के उधार देने योग्य फंड को कम करता है, जिससे मुद्रा आपूर्ति घटती है

options.label: C
options.text: It has no effect on banks' lending capacity
options.text_hi: इसका बैंकों की उधार देने की क्षमता पर कोई प्रभाव नहीं पड़ता

options.label: D
options.text: It directly increases currency in circulation
options.text_hi: यह सीधे परिसंचरण में मुद्रा बढ़ाता है

questions.correct_text: It reduces banks' lendable funds, lowering money supply
questions.solution:
CRR is the percentage of banks' Net Demand and Time Liabilities (NDTL) kept as cash reserves with RBI.

When RBI raises CRR, banks must park a higher portion of deposits with RBI.

This reduces the funds available for lending and credit creation.

Lower credit creation contracts liquidity, so money supply generally decreases.

Further Insights:

- CRR is maintained with RBI and banks do not earn interest on CRR balances.

- Repo rate is the rate at which RBI lends short-term funds to banks; higher repo tends to reduce borrowing by banks and tighten liquidity.

- Reverse repo rate is the rate at which RBI absorbs liquidity from banks; higher reverse repo encourages banks to park funds with RBI.

- SLR is maintained by banks in the form of liquid assets (like government securities, cash, gold) and affects lending capacity along with CRR.

- Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) decides the policy repo rate under India's inflation targeting framework.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Archimedes' Principle:

i) The buoyant force acting on an object submerged in water is equal to the weight of the object itself.

ii) An object will float if the weight of the fluid displaced by it is greater than or equal to its own weight.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
आर्किमिडीज़ के सिद्धांत के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) पानी में डूबे हुए वस्तु पर लगने वाली उभार बल वस्तु के अपने वजन के बराबर होती है।

ii) यदि किसी वस्तु द्वारा विस्थापित द्रव का वजन उसके अपने वजन के बराबर या उससे अधिक होता है तो वह वस्तु तैरती है।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कौन से कथन सही हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is incorrect.

According to Archimedes' Principle, the buoyant force on an object is equal to the weight of the fluid displaced, not the weight of the object.

Statement (ii) is correct.

An object floats when the weight of the displaced fluid is equal to or greater than the weight of the object. This balance allows the object to stay afloat.

Further Insights

Ships float because they displace large volumes of water.

Floating depends on density, not just weight.

Buoyant force acts upward.

Denser objects sink if they displace less fluid.

Archimedes' Principle applies to liquids and gases.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about parliamentary sessions:

1) The President summons each House of Parliament so that the gap between two sessions is not more than six months.

2) Prorogation of a House causes all pending Bills in that House to lapse.

3) Dissolution applies to the Lok Sabha, while the Rajya Sabha is a continuing House.

Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
संसदीय सत्रों के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) राष्ट्रपति प्रत्येक संसद के सदन को बुलाते हैं ताकि दो सत्रों के बीच का अंतराल छह महीने से अधिक न हो।

2) किसी सदन का प्रोरोगेशन उस सदन में सभी लंबित विधेयकों को समाप्त कर देता है।

3) विघटन लोक सभा पर लागू होता है, जबकि राज्य सभा एक सतत् सदन है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Under Article 85, the President summons each House, and six months shall not intervene between the last sitting in one session and the first sitting in the next.

Statement 2 is incorrect: Prorogation ends a session, but Bills do not lapse due to prorogation; lapsing of Bills is linked mainly to dissolution of the Lok Sabha (with certain exceptions).

Statement 3 is correct: The Lok Sabha can be dissolved; the Rajya Sabha is a permanent House with members retiring by rotation.

Further Insights:

- "Budget, Monsoon and Winter sessions" are conventional names; the Constitution does not prescribe these session labels.

- Summoning, prorogation and dissolution are done by the President, generally on the aid and advice of the Council of Ministers.

- Adjournment terminates a sitting (meeting) of the House, while prorogation terminates an entire session.

- A Bill pending in the Lok Sabha generally lapses on dissolution, but a Bill pending in the Rajya Sabha does not lapse due to dissolution of the Lok Sabha.

- The Budget Session usually includes the President's Address and discussion on the Motion of Thanks in the early part of the session.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct about the PM-KISAN scheme?

1) It is administered by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare under the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare.

2) It provides Rs 6,000 per year as income support in three equal instalments to eligible landholding farmer families.

3) It covers tenant farmers and sharecroppers even if they do not own cultivable land.

4) State/UT governments identify eligible beneficiaries and upload their details for release of assistance.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा/से कथन पीएम-किसान योजना के बारे में सही है/हैं?

1) इसे कृषि एवं किसान कल्याण मंत्रालय के तहत कृषि एवं किसान कल्याण विभाग द्वारा संचालित किया जाता है।

2) यह पात्र भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को तीन समान किस्तों में प्रति वर्ष 6,000 रुपये आय सहायता प्रदान करता है।

3) यह किरायेदार किसानों और साझेदारों को भी कवर करता है भले ही उनके पास खेती योग्य जमीन न हो।

4) राज्य/केंद्र शासित प्रदेश सरकारें पात्र लाभार्थियों की पहचान करती हैं और सहायता जारी करने के लिए उनके विवरण अपलोड करती हैं।
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: PM-KISAN is under the Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare.

Statement 2 is correct: the assistance is Rs 6,000 per year paid in three instalments of Rs 2,000 each.

Statement 3 is incorrect: PM-KISAN is for landholding farmer families; tenant farmers/sharecroppers without land ownership are not covered under the core eligibility.

Statement 4 is correct: States/UTs verify/identify beneficiaries and forward/upload data for payment processing.

Further Insights:

- PM-KISAN is a Central Sector scheme (100% funded by the Government of India).

- The scheme was launched in 2019 to supplement the financial needs of farmer families for agricultural and allied activities.

- Institutional landholders are excluded from PM-KISAN benefits.

- Certain higher-income categories (e.g., income tax payers and some government employee/pensioner categories as per scheme guidelines) are excluded.

- The scheme is implemented using a dedicated PM-KISAN portal for beneficiary registration/verification workflow by States/UTs.

questions.question:
Identify the correct statement(s).

Statement I: Opportunity cost is the value of the next best alternative foregone when a choice is made.

Statement II: On a concave Production Possibility Curve (PPC), opportunity cost remains constant as you move along the curve.
questions.question_hi:
सही कथन पहचानें।

कथन I: अवसर लागत वह मूल्य है जो अगली सर्वश्रेष्ठ विकल्प को त्यागने पर प्राप्त होता है जब कोई विकल्प चुना जाता है।

कथन II: एक अवतल उत्पादन संभावना वक्र (PPC) पर, अवसर लागत वक्र के साथ चलते समय स्थिर रहती है।

options.label: B
options.text_hi: कोई भी कथन सत्य नहीं है।

options.label: C
options.text: Statement I is true but Statement II is false.
options.text_hi: कथन I सत्य है लेकिन कथन II असत्य है।

options.label: D
options.text: Statement I is false but Statement II is true.
options.text_hi: कथन I असत्य है लेकिन कथन II सत्य है।

questions.correct_text: Statement I is true but Statement II is false.
questions.solution:
Opportunity cost is the foregone alternative's value; this is a standard definition.

A concave PPC implies increasing opportunity cost due to resource heterogeneity, not constant cost.

Further Insights:

- A straight-line PPC represents constant opportunity cost.

- Points inside PPC indicate underutilization; points on PPC indicate efficiency.

- Outward shifts in PPC reflect growth (more resources/better technology).

- Movement along PPC shows trade-offs; both goods cannot increase simultaneously along the boundary.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:

1) Article 208 of the Constitution empowers the Rajya Sabha to make rules for regulating its procedure and conduct of business.

2) Rules framed under Article 208 regulate debates, questions, motions, voting, and discipline inside the State Legislature.

Which of the statements given above is/are incorrect?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) संविधान का अनुच्छेद 208 राज्यसभा को अपनी कार्यप्रणाली और कामकाज को विनियमित करने के लिए नियम बनाने का अधिकार देता है।

2) अनुच्छेद 208 के अंतर्गत बनाए गए नियम राज्य विधानमंडल के भीतर वाद-विवाद, प्रश्न, प्रस्ताव, मतदान और अनुशासन को विनियमित करते हैं।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से कथन गलत है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Article 208 empowers the State Legislature to frame rules for:

· Debates

· Questions

· Motions

· Voting

· Discipline and order inside the House

Statement 1 - Incorrect

· Article 208 applies to the State Legislature, not to the Rajya Sabha.

· The Rajya Sabha (and Lok Sabha) derive rule-making powers from Article 118.

Further insights

· Article 118 → Rules of procedure of Parliament.

· Article 208 → Rules of procedure of State Legislatures.

· Each House frames its own rules, subject to the Constitution.

· Procedural rules ensure orderly conduct of legislative business.

questions.question:
Consider the following regarding Panchayati Raj institution:

i. Reservation of seats for SCs, STs, and OBCs in all three levels of panchayat.

ii. Direct elections to the post of chairperson at all three levels.

iii. Constitution of state finance commission after every five years.

iv. Reservation of one-third of seats for women at all three levels.

Which of the above are compulsory provisions under part IX of the Constitution?
questions.question_hi:
पंचायती राज संस्था के संबंध में निम्नलिखित पर विचार करें:

i. पंचायत के तीनों स्तरों में अनुसूचित जाति, अनुसूचित जनजाति और अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग के लिए सीटों का आरक्षण।

ii. तीनों स्तरों पर अध्यक्ष पद के लिए प्रत्यक्ष चुनाव।

iii. प्रत्येक पांच वर्ष में राज्य वित्त आयोग का गठन।

iv. तीनों स्तरों पर एक तिहाई सीटें महिलाओं के लिए आरक्षित।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से प्रावधान संविधान के भाग IX के अंतर्गत अनिवार्य हैं?
questions.solution:
The 73rd amendment act made reservation of seats for SCs and STs mandatory and reservation for OBCs were left to the will of state legislatures. So statement i is false.

The act provides for indirect elections to post of chairperson at both intermediate and district level. Election to the post of chairperson at village level was to be decided by respective state legislatures. So statement ii is false.

The act makes constitution of state finance commission by the state government obligatory. Similarly, the reservation of 1/3rd of seats for women is a compulsory provision under the act. So iii and iv are true.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the traditional ritual art form Patayani (Padayani) of Kerala:

1. Predominantly performed in the Central Travancore region, Patayani is a week-long theatrical ritual dance held in Bhadrakali temples to appease the wrath of the goddess.

2. The massive, iconic headgears and masks worn by the dancers (Kolams) are newly crafted for each performance using entirely natural materials such as unbaked clay, charcoal, turmeric, and arecanut palm spathes.

3. The central performance is rhythmically accompanied by an ensemble where the Thappu-a single-sided leather percussion instrument with a circular wooden rim-serves as the primary musical instrument.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
केरल के पारंपरिक अनुष्ठान कला रूप पाटयानी (पदायनी) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. मुख्य रूप से सेंट्रल त्रावणकोर क्षेत्र में प्रदर्शन किया जाने वाला पाटयानी एक सप्ताह लंबा नाट्यात्मक अनुष्ठान नृत्य है जो भद्रकाली मंदिरों में देवी के क्रोध को शांत करने के लिए आयोजित किया जाता है।

2. नर्तकों (कोलम) द्वारा पहने जाने वाले विशाल, प्रतीकात्मक सिरोपीठ और मुखौटे प्रत्येक प्रदर्शन के लिए पूरी तरह से प्राकृतिक सामग्री जैसे कि बिना पकाई गई मिट्टी, कोयला, हल्दी, और सुपारी के पत्तों से नए सिरे से बनाए जाते हैं।

3. केंद्रीय प्रदर्शन को तालबद्ध रूप से एक समूह द्वारा संगीतबद्ध किया जाता है जहाँ थप्पू - एक तरफा चमड़े का ताल वाद्य यंत्र जिसमें वृत्ताकार लकड़ी की सीमा होती है - मुख्य वाद्य यंत्र के रूप में कार्य करता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Patayani (which literally translates to a "row of soldiers") is historically unique to the Central Travancore belt (particularly Pathanamthitta and Alappuzha districts). It is staged late at night in the courtyards of Bhagavathi (Kali) temples, telling mythological stories meant to calm Goddess Bhadrakali after her combat victory over the demon Darikan.

Statement 2 is correct: A hallmark of Patayani is that its elaborate crowns and masks (Kolams) representing various entities (like Bhairavi, Kalan, and Yakshi) are not preserved. They are freshly handcrafted prior to each performance utilizing organic ingredients like arecanut palm spathes (Paala), coconut fronds, charcoal powder, and turmeric paste for paints, and are safely discarded after the ritual concludes.

Statement 3 is correct: The acoustic signature of a Patayani performance is driven primarily by the Thappu, a flat, broad circular wooden frame drum covered on one side with cured hide. It dictates the intricate footwork and specific rhythmic patterns (Marma, Lakshmi, Champa) unique to this indigenous ritual theater.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Phylum Arthropoda:

1) Arthropods possess a chitinous exoskeleton and grow by moulting (ecdysis).

2) Most arthropods have an open circulatory system with a haemocoel.

3) Arthropods have an unsegmented body and their appendages are not jointed.

Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
फाइलम आर्थ्रोपोडा के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) आर्थ्रोपोड्स के पास एक काइटिनस बाह्य कंकाल होता है और वे मोल्टिंग (इक्डिसिस) द्वारा बढ़ते हैं।

2) अधिकांश आर्थ्रोपोड्स के पास एक खुला परिसंचरण तंत्र होता है जिसमें हीमोकॉएल होता है।

3) आर्थ्रोपोड्स का शरीर असंख्य खंडों वाला नहीं होता है और उनके अंग संयुक्त नहीं होते हैं।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: the exoskeleton is made of chitin, and growth occurs by periodic shedding (ecdysis).

Statement 2 is correct: the circulatory system is typically open, and blood (haemolymph) bathes organs in a haemocoel.

Statement 3 is incorrect: arthropods characteristically have a segmented body and jointed appendages.

Further Insights:

- Examples of arthropods include insects (cockroach), arachnids (spider), crustaceans (prawn), and myriapods (centipede).

- Segmentation in arthropods is often grouped into tagmata such as head - thorax - abdomen (insects) or cephalothorax - abdomen (many arachnids and crustaceans).

- Respiration in arthropods varies: tracheae in insects, book lungs in many arachnids, and gills in many crustaceans.

- Excretion commonly occurs via Malpighian tubules in insects and green (antennal) glands in many crustaceans.

- Arthropods typically have a dorsal heart and a ventral nerve cord.

- Compound eyes are common in many arthropods, especially insects and crustaceans.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about population density in Census 2011:

1) Population density is defined as the number of persons per square kilometre of area.

2) As per Census 2011, India's all-India population density is 382 persons per sq. km.

3) In Census 2011, population density is expressed as persons per hectare.

Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
जनसंख्या घनत्व के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें, जनगणना 2011 में:

1) जनसंख्या घनत्व को क्षेत्रफल के प्रति वर्ग किलोमीटर व्यक्तियों की संख्या के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है।

2) जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, भारत की समग्र जनसंख्या घनत्व 382 व्यक्ति प्रति वर्ग किलोमीटर है।

3) जनगणना 2011 में, जनसंख्या घनत्व व्यक्तियों को हेक्टेयर के रूप में व्यक्त किया गया है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Population density in Census terms is calculated as total population divided by area in square kilometres, so statement 1 is correct.

Census 2011 reports India's population density as 382 persons per sq. km., so statement 2 is correct.

Density is expressed per sq. km. (not per hectare), so statement 3 is incorrect.

Further Insights:

- Census 2011 is the 15th Census of India and the 7th after Independence.

- Population density = Population/Area (in sq. km.) for a given administrative unit (India/State/District).

- Census 2011 all-India population: 121.08 crore (1,210.9 million approx.).

- Census 2011 all-India literacy rate: 74.04%.

- Census 2011 data were released by the Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (Ministry of Home Affairs).

questions.question: In March 2026, which institution formally launched the report titled 'Realizing the Export Potential of India's Sports Equipment Manufacturing Sector'?
questions.question_hi: मार्च 2026 में, किस संस्था ने आधिकारिक रूप से 'भारत के खेल उपकरण निर्माण क्षेत्र की निर्यात क्षमता को साकार करना' शीर्षक वाली रिपोर्ट लॉन्च की?

options.label: A
options.text: Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI)

options.label: C
options.text: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
options.text_hi: उद्योग संवर्धन और आंतरिक व्यापार विभाग (DPIIT)

questions.solution:
NITI Aayog's report on India's Sports Equipment Manufacturing Sector Launched A report titled 'Realizing the Export Potential of India's Sports Equipment Manufacturing Sector' was formally launched, outlining India's ambition to emerge as a global hub for sports goods manufacturing and exports. The report focuses exclusively on the sports equipment manufacturing segment, a sector with significant untapped export potential.

The report identifies the Sports Equipment Manufacturing Sector as highly labour-intensive and fiscally advantageous, offering strong opportunities for employment generation and industrial growth.

A key target outlined in the report is to scale India's sports goods exports to approximately USD 8.1 billion by 2036.

To achieve this, the report recommends a comprehensive strategy including structural and administrative reforms to ease business operations, fiscal incentives to enhance global competitiveness.

It has also called for development of new and upgraded sports manufacturing clusters, establishment of world-class testing and certification infrastructure, promotion of 'Brand India' in global sports goods markets, and encouraging partnerships with leading international players.

Addressing the gathering, Secretary (Sports) Shri Hari Ranjan Rao said, "Sports goods have recently been incorporated into the Allocation of Business Rules of the Ministry, reflecting their strategic importance.'

He further stated that 'Khelo Bharat Niti 2025 and the proposed National Sports Governance Act act as key enablers in strengthening India's sports ecosystem.

Secretary (Sports) also outlined that the Ministry is working continuously towards realizing the Hon'ble Prime Minister's vision of leveraging sports as a driver of economic growth, global branding, and youth development.

This report marks a significant step towards unlocking India's potential in the global sports manufacturing value chain and positioning the country as a competitive, innovation-driven, and export-oriented hub.

Representatives from key sports manufacturing clusters in Jalandhar and Meerut, along with officials from the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports and NITI Aayog, also were present during the report launch.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements and choose the correct from below.

Statement 1: The Simon Commission (1928) was boycotted across India because it lacked Indian members. Black-flag demonstrations with the slogan "Simon Go Back" marked its reception.

Statement 2: To frame an Indian constitutional alternative, the Motilal Nehru-led committee produced the Nehru Report (1928), recommending dominion status, federalism, and joint electorates with reservations.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें और नीचे दिए गए कथनों में से सही कथन चुनें।

कथन 1: साइमन आयोग (1928) का पूरे भारत में बहिष्कार किया गया क्योंकि इसमें भारतीय सदस्य नहीं थे। "साइमन वापस जाओ" के नारे के साथ काले झंडे वाले प्रदर्शनों ने इसका स्वागत किया।

कथन 2: भारतीय संवैधानिक विकल्प तैयार करने के लिए, मोतीलाल नेहरू के नेतृत्व वाली समिति ने नेहरू रिपोर्ट (1928) तैयार की, जिसमें डोमिनियन स्टेटस, संघवाद और आरक्षण के साथ संयुक्त निर्वाचक मंडल की सिफारिश की गई।

options.label: A
options.text: Both statements are correct and Statement 2 is the correct explanation of Statement 1.
options.text_hi: दोनों कथन सही हैं और कथन 2, कथन 1 की सही व्याख्या है।

options.label: B
options.text: Both statements are correct but Statement 2 is not the correct explanation of Statement 1.
options.text_hi: दोनों कथन सही हैं, लेकिन कथन 2, कथन 1 की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options.label: C
options.text: Statement 1 is correct but Statement 2 is incorrect.
options.text_hi: कथन 1 सही है लेकिन कथन 2 गलत है।

options.label: D
options.text: Statement 1 is incorrect but Statement 2 is correct.
options.text_hi: कथन 1 गलत है लेकिन कथन 2 सही है।

questions.correct_text: Both statements are correct but Statement 2 is not the correct explanation of Statement 1.
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct about the all-White commission and nationwide boycott.

Statement 2 is correct about the Nehru Report's context and key proposals, but it does not explain the cause of the boycott; it was a response to it.

Although both statements are factually correct, Statement 2 does not explain why the Simon Commission was boycotted.

The boycott happened because the Commission had no Indian members, not because an alternative constitution was being drafted.

Further Insights:

- Lajpat Rai was fatally injured during anti-Simon protests in Lahore.

- Jinnah's Fourteen Points (1929) criticized the Nehru Report's stance, especially on separate electorates.

- The Lahore Congress (Dec 1929) adopted Purna Swaraj; 26 January 1930 was celebrated as Independence Day.

- The Simon Commission ultimately fed into the Round Table Conferences; the 1935 Act introduced provincial autonomy.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements are true about the nitrogen cycle?

1) Nitrification converts ammonium to nitrate under aerobic conditions via specialized bacteria.

2) Denitrification reduces nitrate to gaseous N2 (and N2O) under anaerobic conditions.

3) Biological nitrogen fixation is performed only by higher plants such as legumes.
questions.question_hi:
नाइट्रोजन चक्र के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन से कथन सत्य हैं?

1) नाइट्रीकरण विशेष जीवाणुओं द्वारा वायवीय परिस्थितियों में अमोनियम को नाइट्रेट में परिवर्तित करता है।

2) विनाइट्रीकरण अवायवीय परिस्थितियों में नाइट्रेट को गैसीय N₂ (और N₂O) में अपचयित करता है।

3) जैविक नाइट्रोजन स्थिरीकरण केवल फलीदार पौधों जैसे उच्च पौधों द्वारा ही किया जाता है।
questions.solution:
Nitrosomonas/Nitrobacter oxidize NH4+ → NO2-; → NO3-; aerobically - 1 is correct.

Denitrifiers (e.g., Pseudomonas) reduce NO3-; to N2/N2O anaerobically - 2 is correct.

Fixation is by microbes (free-living or symbiotic); plants host symbionts - 3 is incorrect.

Further Insights:

- Cyanobacteria (e.g., Anabaena) fix N2 in aquatic systems and paddy fields.

- Anammox bacteria convert NH4+ + NO2-; → N2 under anaerobic conditions.

- Excess nitrate can leach to groundwater, posing health risks (methemoglobinemia).

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding 'Peninsular Plateau: Rocks and Relief'.

1) The Deccan Trap basalts formed from fissure eruptions in late Cretaceous time, creating step-like relief.

2) Bundelkhand granites and gneisses represent some of the oldest rocks of the Indian shield.

3) The Western Ghats are a fold mountain chain formed by the Himalayan collision.

Identify the incorrect statement.
questions.question_hi:
प्रायद्वीपीय पठार: चट्टानें और भू-आकृति' के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

1) दक्कन ट्रैप बेसाल्ट का निर्माण क्रेटेशियस काल के उत्तरार्ध में दरार विस्फोटों से हुआ, जिससे सीढ़ीनुमा भू-आकृति बनी।

2) बुंदेलखंड ग्रेनाइट और नीस भारतीय ढाल की कुछ सबसे पुरानी चट्टानों का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं।

3) पश्चिमी घाट हिमालयी टकराव से निर्मित एक वलित पर्वत श्रृंखला है।

गलत कथन की पहचान करें।

options.label: D
options.text_hi: इनमें से कोई भी गलत नहीं है

questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 2 are correct: Deccan Traps are flood basalts; Bundelkhand has Archean - Proterozoic cratonic rocks.

Statement 3 is incorrect: Western Ghats are a fault scarp/escarpment (rifted passive margin), not a fold mountain chain.

Further Insights:

- The Peninsular Plateau is geologically stable (part of the Indian shield).

- The Malwa and Deccan plateaus are basaltic; Chotanagpur is rich in coal and iron ore.

- The Narmada - Tapti rift valleys trend westward to the Arabian Sea.

- Aravalli is among the world's oldest fold mountain systems (heavily denuded).

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about seasonal wind shift in the Indian monsoon:

1) The northward shift of the Inter-Tropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) in June - July helps draw moist southwesterly winds towards India.

2) The northeast monsoon generally gives more rainfall to the Coromandel Coast because the winds pick up moisture over the Bay of Bengal.

Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारतीय मानसून में मौसमी वायु परिवर्तन के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) जून - जुलाई में इंटर-ट्रॉपिकल कन्वर्जेंस ज़ोन (ITCZ) का उत्तर की ओर स्थानांतरण भारत की ओर नम दक्षिण-पश्चिमी हवाओं को आकर्षित करने में मदद करता है।

2) उत्तर-पूर्वी मानसून आमतौर पर कोरोमंडल तट को अधिक वर्षा देता है क्योंकि हवाएं बंगाल की खाड़ी से नमी प्राप्त करती हैं।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: in summer the ITCZ shifts northwards, and the low-pressure belt over the subcontinent helps pull in moisture-laden southwesterlies.

Statement 2 is correct: in Oct - Dec, winds blow from land to sea but become moisture-laden over the Bay of Bengal and then rain over southeast India (Coromandel Coast).

Further Insights:

- Southwest monsoon is also called the "advancing monsoon" and typically reaches Kerala around 1 June.

- Northeast monsoon is also called the "retreating monsoon" and is most important for Tamil Nadu rainfall (main season: Oct - Dec).

- The southwest monsoon has two main branches: Arabian Sea branch and Bay of Bengal branch.

- The Somali Jet (low-level jet) strengthens moisture transport over the Arabian Sea during the southwest monsoon.

- Withdrawal of the southwest monsoon from northwest India usually begins in early September and is generally completed from the entire country by late October.

questions.question:
Match the award-winning authors from the Sahitya Akademi Awards 2025 listed in Column A with their respective literary works listed in Column B:

Column A (Author)Column B (Literary Work)
A. Navtej Sarna1. Jeete Jee Allahabad
B. Mamta Kalia2. Thamiz Sirukathaiyin Thadangal
C. Sa Tamilselvan3. Crimson Spring
D. Jitender Kumar Soni4. Bharkhama

Choose the correct matching combination from the options given below:
questions.question_hi:
साहित्य अकादमी पुरस्कार 2025 से पुरस्कार विजेता लेखकों को कॉलम A में उनके संबंधित साहित्यिक कार्यों के साथ कॉलम B में मिलाएं:

A. नवतेज सरना1. जीते जी इलाहाबाद
B. ममता कालिया2. तमिज़ सिरुकथायिन थडंगल
C. स तमिलसेलवन3. क्रिमसन स्प्रिंग
D. जितेन्द्र कुमार सोनी4. भारखमा

नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही मिलान संयोजन चुनें:
questions.solution:
A. Navtej Sarna ➔ 3. Crimson Spring: The former diplomat was awarded the prestigious literary honor in the English language category for his historical novel Crimson Spring.

B. Mamta Kalia ➔ 1. Jeete Jee Allahabad: The noted Hindi writer won the award in the memoir genre for her acclaimed work Jeete Jee Allahabad.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements are correct regarding trophic levels in a grazing food chain?

1) Producers occupy the first trophic level and convert solar energy into chemical energy.

2) Primary consumers usually feed directly on producers.

3) Decomposers form the highest trophic level and obtain energy mainly by hunting other organisms.

4) Energy transferred to the next trophic level generally decreases sharply, often approximated by the 10% law.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन से कथन चरागाह खाद्य श्रृंखला में ट्रॉफिक स्तरों के संबंध में सही हैं?

1) उत्पादक पहले ट्रॉफिक स्तर पर होते हैं और सौर ऊर्जा को रासायनिक ऊर्जा में परिवर्तित करते हैं।

2) प्राथमिक उपभोक्ता आमतौर पर सीधे उत्पादकों पर भोजन करते हैं।

3) अपघटक उच्चतम ट्रॉफिक स्तर बनाते हैं और मुख्य रूप से अन्य जीवों का शिकार करके ऊर्जा प्राप्त करते हैं।

4) अगले ट्रॉफिक स्तर को स्थानांतरित की गई ऊर्जा आमतौर पर तीव्र रूप से घटती है, जिसे अक्सर 10% नियम द्वारा अनुमानित किया जाता है।
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: producers (autotrophs) form the first trophic level and synthesize food using sunlight.

Statement 2 is correct: primary consumers are herbivores that eat producers.

Statement 3 is incorrect: decomposers break down dead organic matter; they are not "highest trophic level" hunters.

Statement 4 is correct: only a small fraction of energy passes to the next level (commonly stated as ~10%).

Further Insights:

- Decomposers mainly include bacteria and fungi; they recycle nutrients back to the ecosystem.

- Detritivores (e.g., earthworms) feed on dead organic matter and help in decomposition.

- A food web is a network of interconnected food chains and is more stable than a single food chain.

- The pyramid of energy is always upright because energy is lost as heat at each trophic transfer.

- Biomagnification is the increase in concentration of persistent pollutants (e.g., DDT, mercury) at higher trophic levels.

questions.question:
Which of the below statement is/are true about rootkit virus?

I. A rootkit hides malicious processes or files from the operating system, making detection difficult.

II. Rootkits primarily spread by replicating themselves across a network like worms.
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से रूटकिट वायरस के बारे में सही है/हैं?

I. रूटकिट ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम से दुर्भावनापूर्ण प्रक्रियाओं या फ़ाइलों को छुपाता है, जिससे इसका पता लगाना मुश्किल हो जाता है।

II. रूटकिट मुख्य रूप से वर्म्स की तरह नेटवर्क पर खुद को दोहराकर फैलते हैं।

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Statement I is correct.

Statement II is incorrect because rootkits are designed for stealth and persistence, not for self-replication across networks.

Explanation of Statements:

I is Correct. This is the defining characteristic of a rootkit. It is a type of malware designed to gain unauthorized "root" or administrative-level access to a computer system and then hide its own existence, as well as the existence of other malicious software (like Trojans or keyloggers). It achieves this by modifying core components of the operating system, making its processes, files, and registry entries invisible to both the user and standard security software.

II is Incorrect. This statement incorrectly describes the propagation method of a worm. A worm is a standalone malware program whose primary function is to replicate itself and spread to other computers, typically by exploiting network vulnerabilities. A rootkit, on the other hand, does not self-replicate or spread on its own. It is typically installed on a target system through other means, such as by a Trojan, a user unknowingly running a malicious program, or by exploiting a software vulnerability. Its goal is to maintain and conceal access, not to spread.

questions.question: Which of the following is a diskette enclosed in a plastic jacket that has an opening where the read/write head can be positioned?

questions.solution:
Floppy disks are smaller, simpler, and cheaper disk units that consist of a flexible, removable, plastic diskette coated with magnetic material.

The diskette is enclosed in a plastic jacket, which has an opening where the read/write head can be positioned.

A hole in the centre of the diskette allows a spindle mechanism in the disk drive to position and rotate the diskette.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding USB ports:

1) USB supports hot plugging.

2) USB devices require system reboot before use.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
यूएसबी पोर्ट के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) यूएसबी हॉट प्लगिंग का समर्थन करता है।

2) यूएसबी उपकरणों को उपयोग से पहले सिस्टम रीबूट की आवश्यकता होती है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because USB is a "Plug and Play" technology that does not require a system restart for devices to be recognized.

Explanation of Statements:

· 1. is Correct. "Hot plugging" (or hot swapping) allows users to connect or disconnect peripherals while the computer is running without causing damage or requiring a reboot.

· 2. is Incorrect. USB devices are designed for immediate use. The operating system automatically detects the hardware and loads the necessary drivers as soon as it is plugged in.

Further Insights:

· USB (Universal Serial Bus) has evolved through various versions (USB 2.0, 3.0, USB-C) to provide higher data transfer speeds and power delivery.

questions.question: _____ is a specialized, high-speed network that provides network access to storage devices.
questions.question_hi: _____ एक विशेषीकृत और हाई-स्पीड नेटवर्क है जो स्टोरेज डिवाइस को नेटवर्क एक्सेस प्रदान करता है।
questions.solution:
· A Storage Area Network (SAN) is a specialized, high-speed network that provides network access to storage devices.

· SANs are typically composed of hosts, switches, storage elements, and storage devices that are interconnected using a variety of technologies, topologies, and protocols. SANs may span multiple sites.

· A SAN presents storage devices to a host such that the storage appears to be locally attached.

· This simplified presentation of storage to a host is accomplished through the use of different types of virtualization.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about cookies:

2) Cookies can be used for session tracking.

3) Cookies can directly damage hardware.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
कुकीज़ के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

2) कुकीज़ का उपयोग सत्र ट्रैकिंग के लिए किया जा सकता है।

3) कुकीज़ हार्डवेयर को सीधे नुकसान पहुंचा सकती हैं।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 2 are correct.

Statement 3 is incorrect because cookies are simple text files and do not have the capability to execute code or damage hardware.

Explanation of Statements:

· 1. is Correct. Cookies store small pieces of data like your preferred language or theme for a specific website.

· 2. is Correct. They allow websites to remember you are logged in as you navigate from one page to another (session management).

· 3. is Incorrect. Cookies are non-executable text data. They cannot contain viruses, run programs, or physically affect the computer's components.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding processes in an operating system:

2. Context switching allows the CPU to switch between multiple processes.

3. Context switching increases CPU execution speed by reducing overhead.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम में प्रक्रियाओं के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

3. संदर्भ स्विचिंग ओवरहेड को कम करके सीपीयू निष्पादन गति को बढ़ाता है।

questions.solution:
Statement 1 - Correct: A program becomes a process when it is loaded into memory and executed.

Statement 2 - Correct: Context switching enables multitasking by saving and restoring process states.

Statement 3 - Incorrect: Context switching introduces overhead and does not increase CPU speed.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Windows operating system features:

a. Windows Task Scheduler allows users to run programs automatically at specified times or events.

b. BitLocker Drive Encryption in Windows encrypts entire volumes and can use TPM hardware to enhance security.

c. Windows Sandbox provides a persistent isolated environment where installed software remains available after restart.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
विंडोज ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम सुविधाओं के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

a. विंडोज टास्क शेड्यूलर उपयोगकर्ताओं को निर्दिष्ट समय या घटनाओं पर स्वचालित रूप से प्रोग्राम चलाने की अनुमति देता है।

b. विंडोज में बिटलॉकर ड्राइव एन्क्रिप्शन पूरे वॉल्यूम को एन्क्रिप्ट करता है और सुरक्षा बढ़ाने के लिए टीपीएम हार्डवेयर का उपयोग कर सकता है।

c. विंडोज सैंडबॉक्स एक स्थायी पृथक वातावरण प्रदान करता है जहां स्थापित सॉफ़्टवेयर पुनरारंभ के बाद भी उपलब्ध रहता है।

उपर्युक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement a is CORRECT.

-Task Scheduler is a built-in Windows component that allows users to schedule tasks to run automatically

-Tasks can be triggered by specific times (daily, weekly, at startup, etc.)

-Tasks can also be triggered by events (system events, user login, specific conditions)

-Users can schedule programs, scripts, and other executables to run with various configurations

Statement b is CORRECT.

-BitLocker provides full disk/volume encryption for Windows drives

-It encrypts entire volumes (system drive, fixed drives, removable drives)

-BitLocker can utilize TPM (Trusted Platform Module) hardware for enhanced security

-TPM stores encryption keys securely and helps verify system integrity before unlocking the drive

-BitLocker can also work without TPM using password or USB key authentication

Statement c is INCORRECT.

-Windows Sandbox provides a temporary and disposable isolated environment

-It is NOT persistent - all changes are discarded when you close the Sandbox

-Every time you open Windows Sandbox, you get a clean installation of Windows

-Any software installed or files saved in the Sandbox are lost after closing it

-This is actually a key security feature, ensuring a fresh, clean environment each time

questions.question: Which of the following feature allows you to type keyboard shortcuts one key at a time rather than having to hold down all of the keys at once?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी फीचर आपको सभी की (key) को एक साथ दबाए रखने के बजाय कीबोर्ड शॉर्टकट को एक बार में एक की (key) टाइप करने की अनुमति देती है?
questions.solution:
Sticky Keys enables the user to enter key combinations by pressing keys in sequence rather than simultaneously. This will benefit users who are unable to press or have difficulty pressing shortcut key combinations.

You can have the computer make a "beep" sound when you start typing a keyboard shortcut with sticky keys turned on. This is useful if you want to know that sticky keys are expecting a keyboard shortcut to be typed, so the next key press will be interpreted as part of a shortcut.

questions.question: Which file type is most likely compressed for faster downloading?
questions.question_hi: तेज़ डाउनलोडिंग के लिए किस प्रकार की फ़ाइल को संपीड़ित किए जाने की सबसे अधिक संभावना है?
questions.solution:
The file type most likely to be compressed for size reduction is .zip.

Explanation of Extensions:

· .txt: A plain text file.

· .zip: An archive file format that supports lossless data compression. It "zips" one or more files into a smaller container.

· .bmp: A bitmap image file, which is usually uncompressed and very large.

· .wav: A standard audio file format, typically uncompressed.

Further Insights:

· Compression helps in saving storage space and reducing the time required to send files over the internet.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of the ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) in networking?
questions.question_hi: नेटवर्किंग में ICMP (इंटरनेट कंट्रोल मैसेज प्रोटोकॉल) का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?

options.label: B
options.text: To provide secure access to websites
options.text_hi: वेबसाइटों तक सुरक्षित पहुँच प्रदान करना

options.label: C
options.text: To diagnose network-related issues and errors
options.text_hi: नेटवर्क से संबंधित समस्याओं और त्रुटियों का निदान करना

questions.correct_text: To diagnose network-related issues and errors
questions.solution:
The primary purpose of ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) in networking is to diagnose network-related issues and errors. ICMP is a network layer protocol used to send error messages and operational information about network conditions. It plays a vital role in network troubleshooting and diagnostics.

ICMP is commonly used for tasks such as:

· Ping: ICMP Echo Request and Echo Reply messages are used for testing network connectivity and measuring round-trip times between devices.

· Traceroute: ICMP Time Exceeded messages are employed in traceroute tools to trace the path of packets through a network and identify potential issues along the route.

· Network error reporting: ICMP is used to notify devices of network-related errors, such as "Destination Unreachable" messages sent when a router cannot forward a packet to its destination.

questions.question: ________ is a technology that recognizes text within a digital image and converts the document to an editable text file.

questions.solution:
• Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is a technology that recognizes text within a digital image. It converts the document to an editable text file.

• Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) is an electronic method that scans the document and reads the data from the marked fields and results can be transmitted into the computer.

• Digitizer allows users to draw and manipulate graphics on the screen. It is also known as a graphics tablet. These kinds of tablets are typically designed for CAD/CAM professionals.

एमएस वर्ड के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. "संपादन प्रतिबंधित करें" सुविधा आपको किसी दस्तावेज़ पर स्वरूपण और संपादन अनुमतियों को सीमित करने की अनुमति देती है।

II. अन्य समीक्षकों के परिवर्तनों को स्वीकार या अस्वीकार करने से पहले "परिवर्तन ट्रैक करें" को चालू करना होगा।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Statement I: The "Restrict Editing" feature allows you to limit formatting and editing permissions on a document.

This is CORRECT.

The "Restrict Editing" feature in MS Word allows you to control what types of changes users can make to a document

-You can restrict formatting to specific styles

-You can limit editing to specific types (comments only, tracked changes only, filling in forms, or no changes at all)

-You can also protect specific parts of the document while allowing editing in other sections

-This feature is found under Review tab > Protect group > Restrict Editing

Statement II: "Track Changes" must be turned ON before accepting or rejecting changes from other reviewers.

This is INCORRECT.

-You do NOT need to have "Track Changes" turned ON to accept or reject changes

-If other reviewers have made tracked changes (with their Track Changes ON), those changes are already recorded in the document

-You can review, accept, or reject those existing tracked changes at any time, regardless of whether Track Changes is currently ON or OFF in your view

-The "Accept" and "Reject" buttons work on changes that have already been tracked, not on future changes

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about IP address:

1. IPv4 uses 32-bit addressing.

2. IPv6 was introduced mainly to improve data encryption.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
आईपी पते के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. IPv4 32-बिट एड्रेसिंग का उपयोग करता है।

2. IPv6 को मुख्य रूप से डेटा एन्क्रिप्शन को बेहतर बनाने के लिए पेश किया गया था।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is Correct:IPv4 (Internet Protocol version 4) uses a 32-bit address scheme. This allows for approximately 2^32 (about 4.3 billion) unique IP addresses. These addresses are typically written in "dotted decimal" notation, such as 192.168.1.1.

Statement 2 is Incorrect: While IPv6 does have built-in support for IPsec (security), it was not introduced mainly to improve encryption. The primary reason for the introduction of IPv6 was the exhaustion of IPv4 addresses.

IPv6 uses a 128-bit address space, providing 2^128 (undecillions) of addresses, ensuring that we do not run out of unique identifiers for the billions of new devices (IoT, smartphones, etc.) connecting to the internet.

questions.question: In which of the following data transmission modes, the data can be transferred in both directions, but not at the same time?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस डेटा ट्रांसमिशन मोड में, डेटा को दोनों दिशाओं में स्थानांतरित किया जा सकता है, लेकिन समान समय में नहीं?
questions.solution:
· Simplex Mode: In this type, the data can be transferred in only one direction. The only one can transmit and the other can receive the data. Example - Keyboard (Input) and Monitor (output), Loud Speaker, Television, Fire alarm system etc.

· Half Duplex Mode: In this type, the data can be transferred in both directions, but not at the same time. Example - Walkie-talkie.

· Full Duplex Mode: In this type, the data can be transferred in both direction on the same transmission path. Two lines are used for sending and receiving the data. Example - Telephone network.

questions.question: The probability of Prashant, Qamar and Rajat finishing their projects is 1/2, 1/3 and 2/3. What is the probability that at least 2 of them complete their projects?
questions.question_hi: प्रशांत, क़मर और रजत द्वारा अपनी परियोजनाओं को पूरा करने की प्रायिकता 1/2, 1/3 और 2/3 है। उनमें से कम से कम 2 व्यक्तियों द्वारा अपनी परियोजनाओं को पूरी करने की प्रायिकता कितनी है?
questions.solution:
P(at least 2 of them complete)

= P(Prashant and Qamar complete, Rajat does not) + P(Qamar and Rajat complete, Prashant does not) + P(Rajat and Prashant complete, Qamar does not) + P(all of them complete)

= (1/2)*(1/3)*(1/3) + (1/3)*(2/3)*(1/2) + (2/3)*(1/2)*(2/3) + (1/2)*(1/3)*(2/3)

= 1/2

questions.question: If x is an odd number and y is an even number, then which of the following is an odd number?
questions.question_hi: यदि x एक विषम संख्या है और y एक सम संख्या है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक विषम संख्या है?
questions.solution:
x = odd, so let x = 2n + 1, where n is any positive integer

y = even, so let y = 2m, where m is any positive integer

x + y + 1 = 2n + 1 + 2m + 1 = 2n + 2m + 2 = 2(n + m + 1), which is even

xy = (2n + 1)2m = 2m(2n + 1), which is even

xy + y = 2m(2n + 1) + 2m = 2m(2n + 2), which is even

x + y + 2 = 2n + 1 + 2m + 2 = 2n + 2m + 3 = 2(n + m + 1) + 1, so it is odd.

questions.question: Are the numbers 90, 162, 225 and 315 in proportion?

options.label: B
options.text: No, they are not in proportion.
options.text_hi: नहीं, वे अनुपात में नहीं हैं।

options.text: Only 90 and 162 are not in proportion.
options.text_hi: केवल 90 और 162 अनुपात में नहीं हैं।

questions.correct_text: No, they are not in proportion.
questions.solution:
Ratio of 90 to 162 = 90: 162 = 5: 9

And the ratio of 225: 315 = 5: 7

So, 90: 162 ≠ 225: 315

Hence, they are not in proportion.

questions.question: The salaries of Charan and Rajat are in the ratio of 5 : 4 respectively. If the salary of each increases by ₹3,000, then the new ratio becomes 6 : 5 respectively. What was the initial salary of Charan?

Let the salaries of Charan and Rajat are 5a and 4a respectively. Then,

(5a + 3000): (4a + 3000) = 6: 5

25a + 15000 = 24a + 18000

a = 3000

Therefore, Charan's salary = 5a = 5 * 3000 = ₹15000

questions.question: Price of onion is decreased by 32% and its consumption in a family is increased by 15%. What will be the change in the expenditure of the family?
questions.question_hi: प्याज की कीमत में 32% की कमी होती है और एक परिवार में इसकी खपत में 15% की वृद्धि होती है। परिवार के खर्च में कितना बदलाव आएगा?
questions.solution:
Expenditure = price x consumption

Because of the 32% decrease in price, the net expenditure decreased by 32% but at the same time consumption increased by 15% because of which expenditure increased by 15%. hence, the net change in expenditure = -32 + 15 + [(-32 x 15)/100]

= -17 - 4.8 = -21.8% = 21.8% decrease

questions.question: X and Y together can complete a work in 28 days, Y and Z together can complete it in 36 days, while Z and X can complete it in 42 days, find the time taken by Z alone to complete the work?
questions.question_hi: एक साथ X और Y एक काम को 28 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं, एक साथ Y और Z इसे 36 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं, जबकि Z और X इसे 42 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं, तो अकेले Z द्वारा काम पूरा करने में लिया गया समय ज्ञात कीजिये?
questions.solution:
Total work = LCM of 12, 36 and 42 = 252 unit

Efficiency of (X + Y) = 252/28 = 9 unit......(i)

Efficiency of (Y + Z) = 252/36 = 7 unit........(ii)

Efficiency of (Z + X) = 252/42 = 6 unit.......(iii)

Adding eq (i), (ii) and (iii) we get,

Efficiency of 2 (X + Y + Z) = 22

Efficiency of (X + Y + Z) = 22/2 = 11 unit......(iv)

Subtracting eq(i) from (iv) we get,

Efficiency of Z = 11 - 9 = 2 unit

Required time = 252/2 = 126 days

questions.question: Initial speed of a person is 3 km/hr. If he increases his speed by 2 km/hr each hour. Find the time taken by the person to cover 899 km.
questions.question_hi: एक व्यक्ति की प्रारंभिक चाल 3 km/hr है। यदि वह प्रत्येक घंटे अपनी चाल 2 km/hr बढ़ाता है, तो 899 km की दूरी तय करने में व्यक्ति को कितना समय लगेगा?
questions.solution:
Speed of person in 1st hour = 3 km/hr

It increases by 2 km/hr each hour

Speed of the person will form an AP 3, 5, 7,..............

Sum = 899

Sn = n/2 [2a + (n - 1)d]

899 = n/2 [ 2*3 + (n - 1)2]

1798 = n [6 + 2n - 2]

1798 = 4n + 2n2

2n2 + 4n - 1798 = 0

n2 + 2n - 899 = 0

(n + 31)(n - 29) = 0

n = 29

Total time taken = 29 hours

questions.question: A shopkeeper sold 35 pens together for Rs.840 while he purchased the 25 pens together for Rs.500, then profit amount earned after selling 30 pens is equal to:
questions.question_hi: एक दुकानदार ने एक साथ 35 पेन 840 रुपये में बेचे जबकि उसने एक साथ 25 पेन 500 रुपये में खरीदे, तो 30 पेन बेचने के बाद अर्जित लाभ की धनराशि बराबर है:
questions.solution:
Selling price of 35 pens = Rs.840

SP of a pen = 840/35 = Rs.24

Cost price of 25 pens = Rs.500

CP of a pen = 500/25 = Rs.20

Profit amount earned after selling 30 pens = 30 * (24 - 20) = Rs.120

'E & F' means E is F's daughter.

'E $ F' means E is F's mother.

'E Ω F' means E is F's spouse.

'E Σ F' means E is F's maternal grandfather.

As per which of the following expression, 'H is the grandfather of T'?
questions.question_hi:
'E & F' का अर्थ E, F की पुत्री है।

'E $ F' का अर्थ E, F की माता है।

'E Ω F' का अर्थ E, F का/की जीवनसाथी है।

'E Σ F' का अर्थ E, F का मैटरनल ग्रैंडफादर (नाना) है।

निम्नलिखित में से किस व्यंजक के अनुसार, 'H, T का दादा/नाना (ग्रैंड फादर) है'?
questions.solution:
It is given that,

'E & F' means E is F's daughter.

'E $ F' means E is F's mother.

'E Ω F' means E is F's spouse.

'E Σ F' means E is F's maternal grandfather.

After decoding, we get:

Option (a) H Ω G & T

H is G's spouse.

G is T's daughter.

Here, H is the son-in-law of T. So, option (a) is incorrect.

Option (b) H Σ U & S $ T

H is U's maternal grandfather.

U is S's daughter.

S is T's mother.

Here, H is the grandfather of T. So, option (b) is correct.

Option (c) T $ U $ S Ω H

T is U's mother.

U is S's mother.

S is H's spouse.

Here, H is either grandson-in-law or granddaughter-in-law of T. So, option (c) is incorrect.

Option (d) T Σ G & H

T is G's maternal grandfather.

G is H's daughter.

Here, H is the daughter of T or daughter-in-law/son-in-law of T. So, option (d) is incorrect.

questions.question:
If P stands for ' - ', Q stands for 'x', R stands for '+', S stands for '=' and T stands for '÷', then which of the following expression is balanced?

I. 2 Q 15 R 19 P 20 S 35 P 6

II. 19 R 3 S 18 T 6 Q 9

III. 31 S 15 Q 4 P 18 R 20 T 5
questions.solution:
P stands for ' - ', Q stands for 'x', R stands for '+', S stands for '=' and T stands for '÷'.

Thus, the expression will be:

I. 2 x 15 + 19 - 20 = 35 - 6

So, 30 + 19 - 20 = 35 - 6

49 - 20 = 35 - 6

29 = 29. So, the equation is balanced.

II. 19 + 3 = 18 ÷ 6 x 9

So, 19 + 3 = 27

22 ≠ 27. So, the equation is not balanced.

III. 31 = 15 x 4 - 18 + 20 ÷ 5

So, 31 = 60 - 18 + 4

31 = 64 - 18

31 ≠ 46. So, the equation is not balanced.

questions.solution:
Six athletics A1, A2, A3, A4, A5 and A6 are standing in a linear row (but not necessarily in the same order).

They are facing towards the south.

A3 and A4 are at the ends.

Case 1A3A4
Case 2A4A3

A1 is neighbour of A5 and A6.

Therefore, the final arrangement is:

Thus, only III is correct.

questions.question:

Barney said to Ted, "Don't ever call me Swarley as it hurts my feelings and I really hate this name."

questions.solution:
Imperative Sentences sometimes begin with Negative Commands like "Don't".

As required, "Said/ Say" is changed into "Asked/ Ask", "Told/ Tell", "Advised/ Advised" etc.

"Not + To+ Verb" is used in these sentences. For example, "don't go" changes into "not to go"

For example:

My friend said to me, "Don't go to Kolkata"." (Direct Speech)

My friend advised me not to go to Kolkata. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

Direct SpeechIndirect Speech
said totold
Don't evernot to ever
call mecall him
my feelingshis feelings
I reallyhe really
hatehated
this namethat name

Therefore, the correct answer is: (c) Barney told Ted not to ever call him Swarley as it hurts his feelings and he really hated that name.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

A new marketing strategy for the upcoming product launch is being designed by the creative team right now.

options.label: A
options.text: The creative team designed a new marketing strategy right now for the upcoming product launch.

options.label: B
options.text: The creative team is designing a new marketing strategy right now for the upcoming product launch.

options.label: C
options.text: The creative team designing a new marketing strategy right now for the upcoming product launch.

options.label: D
options.text: The creative team will be designing a new marketing strategy right now for the upcoming product launch.

questions.correct_text: The creative team is designing a new marketing strategy right now for the upcoming product launch.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" verb ['being'] and the preposition 'by' is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

The Passive voice in this question is in Present Continuous tense. Thus, the Active voice will also be in Present Continuous.

In Passive voice, the format is: Object of the Active voice (Subjective case) + am/is/are + being + V3 + by + Subject of the Active voice (Objective case).

Thus, the format of Active voice is: Subject + am/is/are + V1 + ing + Object.

For example:

A document is being typed by Arnab. (Passive Voice)

Arnab is typing a document. (Active Voice)

The options except (b) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (b): The creative team is designing a new marketing strategy right now for the upcoming product launch.

Note: V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).

questions.question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

By the time the emergency response team arrived at the remote village, (1)/ local volunteers already evacuated most of the residents (2)/ from the areas that were most at risk (3)/ due to the rapidly rising floodwaters. (4)

options.label: A
options.text: local volunteers already evacuated most of the residents (2)

options.label: B
options.text: By the time the emergency response team arrived at the remote village, (1)

options.label: C
options.text: due to the rapidly rising floodwaters (4)

options.label: D
options.text: from the areas that were most at risk (3)

questions.correct_text: local volunteers already evacuated most of the residents (2)
questions.solution:
The error in part (2) is in the verb tense. The sentence describes two actions that happened in the past: the emergency team arriving and the volunteers evacuating the residents.

The phrase "By the time..." sets up a sequence. It indicates that one action was already completed before another past action occurred. In this situation, the action that happened first must be in the past perfect tense (had + past participle), and the action following it must be in the simple past tense.

Action 1 (happened first): The volunteers evacuated the residents.

Action 2 (happened second): The emergency response team arrived.

Therefore, the verb describing the evacuation should be in the past perfect [had...evacuated]. The sentence incorrectly uses the simple past ("evacuated").

The use of the simple past tense verb "arrived" for the action second in sequence is correct.

The corrected sentence should read: "By the time the emergency response team arrived at the remote village, local volunteers had already evacuated most of the residents from the areas that were most at risk due to the rapidly rising floodwaters."

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

Note: Participle: A word formed from a verb (e.g. going, gone, being, been) and used as an adjective (e.g. working woman, burnt toast) or a noun (e.g. good breeding). In English, participles are also used to make compound verb forms (e.g. is going, has been). Consider the sentences given below:

Dancing at the party, the woman fell on the ground.

Encouraged by her parents, Rita went on to pursue her passion.

The highlighted word in the first sentence is of the form Verb + ing and is used as a present participle. It is used to denote an action that is going on or incomplete, or imperfect.

The highlighted word in the second sentence is of the form verb + ed. It is used as a past participle. It denotes the completed action or state of the thing spoken of.

A past participle ends with the following: -ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n.

One should take great care and never get confused between a gerund and a present participle. They use the same forms but perform different functions: a gerund is a verbal noun, while a present participle is a verbal adjective.

questions.question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

When the lead actor finally appeared on stage, (1)/ the audience gives him a standing ovation (2)/ and applauded enthusiastically for several minutes (3)/ before the director signalled for silence. (4)

options.label: A
options.text: the audience gives him a standing ovation (2)

options.label: B
options.text: and applauded enthusiastically for several minutes (3)

options.label: C
options.text: When the lead actor finally appeared on stage, (1)

options.label: D
options.text: before the director signalled for silence (4)

questions.correct_text: the audience gives him a standing ovation (2)
questions.solution:
The error is a matter of verb tense consistency. The sentence describes a series of events that happened in the past.

"When the lead actor finally appeared..." (past tense)

"...and applauded enthusiastically..." (past tense)

"...before the director signalled for silence." (past tense)

All the other main verbs are in the past tense. The verb "gives" in part (2) is in the present tense, which breaks the sequence. It should be in the past tense to match the rest of the sentence. Its past tense form is "gave".

The corrected sentence should read: "When the lead actor finally appeared on stage, the audience gave him a standing ovation and applauded enthusiastically for several minutes before the director signalled for silence."

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The tailor will first baste the dress together with loose stitches for a fitting.

options.label: A
options.text: She remembered to baste the turkey every 30 minutes to keep it moist.

options.label: B
options.text: The instructions say to baste the sleeves onto the bodice before sewing.

options.label: C
options.text: He used a contrasting thread to baste the hem so he could see it easily.

options.label: D
options.text: To prepare for sewing, baste the pattern pieces together.

questions.correct_text: She remembered to baste the turkey every 30 minutes to keep it moist.
questions.solution:
A homonym is a word that is spelled and pronounced the same as another word but has a different meaning.

In the original sentence, "baste" is a sewing term that means to tack or sew with long, loose, temporary stitches.

In options (b), (c), and (d), "baste" is used with the exact same sewing meaning.

In option (a), "baste" is a cooking term that means to pour juices or melted fat over food (especially meat) during cooking to keep it moist. This is a completely different meaning, making it the correct homonym.

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

My friend said to me, "Let us go to the new Italian restaurant tonight because I have heard great reviews about it."

options.label: A
options.text: My friend proposed that let us go to the new Italian restaurant that night because he had heard great reviews about it.

options.label: B
options.text: My friend suggested to me that we should go to the new Italian restaurant that night because he had heard great reviews about it.

options.label: C
options.text: My friend suggested to me to go to the new Italian restaurant tonight because he has heard great reviews about it.

options.label: D
options.text: My friend told me that we should go to the new Italian restaurant that night because I have heard great reviews about it.

questions.correct_text: My friend suggested to me that we should go to the new Italian restaurant that night because he had heard great reviews about it.
questions.solution:
When "Let" is used as a proposal/suggestion, "Said/said to" is changed to "proposed/proposed to" or "suggested/suggested to". "That" is added in indirect speech. "Let" is removed in the indirect speech. The modal verb "should" is added in indirect speech.

Example: He said, "Let us go to the amusement park." (Direct Speech)

He suggested that they should go to the amusement park. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

"said to" changes to "suggested to".

"Let us go" changes to "that we should go".

"tonight" changes to "that night".

"I" changes to "he".

"have heard" [Present Perfect tense in direct speech] changes to "had heard" [Past Perfect tense in indirect speech].

Therefore, the correct answer is: "My friend suggested to me that we should go to the new Italian restaurant that night because he had heard great reviews about it."

Hence, option (b) is correct.

On 13 December 1946, Jawaharlal Nehru introduced the "Objectives Resolution" in the Constituent Assembly.
