questions.question:
Read the given statement and courses of action carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement is true, decide which of the given courses of action logically follows for pursuing.

Statement: Road accidents have increased in a locality because most streetlights stay off for weeks. The electricity department reports that the main issue is damaged underground wiring and delayed maintenance.

Course of action I: Advise citizens to avoid going out after 8 PM and to use personal torches while walking.

Course of action II: Repair/replace the damaged wiring urgently and set a fixed maintenance timeline with accountability for future outages.
questions.question_hi:
दिए गए कथन और कार्यवाही के विकल्पों को ध्यान से पढ़ें। मानते हुए कि कथन में दी गई जानकारी सत्य है, निर्णय लें कि दिए गए कार्यवाही के विकल्पों में से कौन सा तर्कसंगत रूप से अनुसरण करता है।

कथन: एक क्षेत्र में सड़क दुर्घटनाएं बढ़ गई हैं क्योंकि अधिकांश स्ट्रीटलाइट्स सप्ताहों तक बंद रहती हैं। बिजली विभाग की रिपोर्ट है कि मुख्य समस्या क्षतिग्रस्त भूमिगत वायरिंग और देरी से रखरखाव है।

कार्यवाही विकल्प I: नागरिकों को 8 बजे के बाद बाहर जाने से बचने और चलते समय व्यक्तिगत टॉर्च का उपयोग करने की सलाह दें।

कार्यवाही विकल्प II: क्षतिग्रस्त वायरिंग की तुरंत मरम्मत/प्रतिस्थापन करें और भविष्य में बिजली कटौती के लिए जिम्मेदारी के साथ एक निश्चित रखरखाव समयसीमा निर्धारित करें।

options.label: A
options.text: Either course of action I or II follows
options.text_hi: या तो कार्यवाही I या II का पालन होता है

options.label: B
options.text: Only course of action I follows
options.text_hi: केवल कार्यवाही I का पालन होता है

options.label: C
options.text: Both course of action I and II follow
options.text_hi: दोनों कार्यवाही I और II का पालन होता है

options.label: D
options.text: Only course of action II follows
options.text_hi: केवल कार्यवाही II का पालन होता है

questions.correct_text: Only course of action II follows
questions.solution:
The statement says that road accidents have increased because streetlights remain non-functional due to damaged underground wiring and delayed maintenance.

Course of Action I:

Advise citizens to avoid going out after 8 PM and use personal torches.

This may provide temporary relief.

However, it does not address the root cause of the problem, which is faulty wiring and poor maintenance.

Therefore, it does not logically follow as the appropriate course of action.

Course of Action II:

Repair/replace the damaged wiring urgently and establish a fixed maintenance schedule with accountability.

This directly addresses the causes mentioned in the statement.

It is a practical and effective step to reduce accidents.

Therefore, it logically follows.

questions.question: In a certain coding system, "dawn brings calm breeze" is coded as "nvt, kps, rdl, gmh", "breeze brings fresh rain" is coded as "gmh, kps, tqa, wex" and "calm rain brings relief" is coded as "rdl, wex, kps, jyu". How will "breeze calm brings rain" be coded in this coding system?
questions.question_hi: एक निश्चित कोडिंग प्रणाली में, "dawn brings calm breeze" को "nvt, kps, rdl, gmh" के रूप में कोडित किया गया है, "breeze brings fresh rain" को "gmh, kps, tqa, wex" के रूप में कोडित किया गया है और "calm rain brings relief" को "rdl, wex, kps, jyu" के रूप में कोडित किया गया है। इस कोडिंग प्रणाली में "breeze calm brings rain" को कैसे कोडित किया जाएगा?
questions.solution:
Common code in all three sentences is kps, so kps = brings

Common code in first and second is gmh (apart from kps), so gmh = breeze

Common code in first and third is rdl (apart from kps), so rdl = calm

Common code in second and third is wex (apart from kps), so wex = rain

So "breeze calm brings rain" = gmh, rdl, kps, wex

In the question given below, three statements are given followed by two conclusions. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. All dominant is major

II. All minor is forceful

कथन:

कुछ forceful, dominant है।

कुछ minor, major है।

सभी dominant, major है।

I. कोई minor, forceful नहीं है।

II. सभी minor, forceful है।

14 * 6 * 9 * 3 * 8 = 24
questions.solution:
From option (a), we get,

14 + 6 - 9 X 3 ÷ 8 = 14 + 6 - 9 X 0.375

= 14 + 6 - 3.375

=16.625. Thus, option (a) does not satisfy the condition.

From option (b), we get

14 + 6 X 9 ÷ 3 - 8 = 14 + 6 X 3 - 8

= 14 + 18 - 8

=24. Thus, option (b) satisfy the condition.

From option (c), we get,

14 - 6 X 9 + 3 ÷ 8 = 14 - 6 X 9 + 0.375

= 14 - 54 + 0.375

= 0.266. Thus, option (c) does not satisfy the condition.

From option (d), we get,

14 ÷ 6 X 9 + 3 - 8 = 2.33 X 9 + 3 - 8

= 20.9 + 3 - 8

= 15.9. Thus, option (d) does not satisfy the condition.

In a series of workshops conducted daily from 5th to 12th March 2023, the cities and dates were as follows:

Jaipur - 12th March 2023,

Bhopal - 11th March 2023,

Nagpur - 10th March 2023,

Pune - 9th March 2023,

Mumbai - 8th March 2023,

Surat - 7th March 2023,

Vadodara - 6th March 2023,

Ahmedabad - 5th March 2023.

If the workshop in Nagpur was held on a Friday, then on which day of the week was the workshop held in Ahmedabad?
questions.question_hi:
5 से 12 मार्च 2023 तक प्रतिदिन आयोजित कार्यशालाओं की श्रृंखला में, शहर और तिथियां इस प्रकार थीं:

जयपुर - 12 मार्च 2023,

भोपाल - 11 मार्च 2023,

नागपुर - 10 मार्च 2023,

पुणे - 9 मार्च 2023,

मुंबई - 8 मार्च 2023,

सूरत - 7 मार्च 2023,

वडोदरा - 6 मार्च 2023,

अहमदाबाद - 5 मार्च 2023।

यदि नागपुर में कार्यशाला शुक्रवार को आयोजित की गई थी, तो किस दिन अहमदाबाद में आयोजित कार्यशाला सप्ताह का कौन सा दिन था?
questions.solution:
Nagpur date = 10th March 2023 and it is given as Friday.

We need to find the day on 5th March 2023 (Ahmedabad).

Count backward:

10 March → Friday

9 March → Thursday

8 March → Wednesday

7 March → Tuesday

6 March → Monday

5 March → Sunday

So, Ahmedabad workshop day = Sunday.

Statements:

II. Exactly two persons sit between R and the left end.

R, Q के दाएँ से तीसरे स्थान पर बैठा है, और Q बाएँ से पाँचवें स्थान पर है। II. R और बाएँ छोर के बीच ठीक दो व्यक्ति बैठे हैं।

options.label: D

questions.solution:
Using I: Q is 5th from left; R is 3rd to the right of Q → 5 + 3 = 8th from the left. Unique; I alone sufficient.

Using II: "Exactly two persons sit between R and the left end" means R is 3rd from the left. Unique; II alone sufficient.

Either I or II alone is sufficient.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The scientists will have discovered a cure for this disease by next year.

options.label: A
options.text: A cure for this disease will be discovered by the scientists by next year.

options.label: B
options.text: A cure for this disease will have been discovered by the scientists by next year.

options.label: C
options.text: A cure for this disease was discovered by the scientists by next year.

options.label: D
options.text: A cure for this disease is being discovered by the scientists by next year.

questions.correct_text: A cure for this disease will have been discovered by the scientists by next year.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Active Voice ("The scientists") is changed into the object of the Passive Voice ("by the scientists"). The object of the Active Voice ("a cure for this disease") becomes the subject of the Passive Voice.

The usage of a "to be" form of verb is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

The Active voice is in Future Perfect, so the Passive voice must maintain the same tense.

The format of Active voice is: Subject + will/shall + have + V3 + Object.

Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be: Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + will/shall + have been + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case)

For example:

She will have bought the gold. (Active)

The gold will have been bought by her. (Passive)

The incorrect options:

· (a) uses Future Simple ("will be discovered")

· (c) uses Past Simple ("was discovered")

· (d) uses Present Continuous ("is being discovered")

Therefore, the correct answer is (b): A cure for this disease will have been discovered by the scientists by next year.

Note: V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).

questions.solution:
The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive Voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

The usage of a "to be" form of verb ["be" in this case] is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

In Passive Voice, the preposition "by" is used before the object. However, it is optional in some cases.

The Active voice in this question is in Modal Interrogative form, as shown by "Should the enforcement authorities impose strict penalties..".

Thus, the Passive voice will also be in the modal interrogative form.

The format of the Active voice is: Modal + Subject + V1 + Object?

Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be: Modal + Object of the active voice + be + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice.

Example:

Active: Should the officials enforce the rules?

Passive: Should the rules be enforced by the officials?

The correct grammatical structure is reflected in option (a).

Therefore, the correct answer is: (a).

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

The librarian said to the students, "Please maintain complete silence in the reading hall and return the books to their designated shelves."

options.label: A
options.text: The librarian ordered the students to maintain complete silence in the reading hall and to return the books to their designated shelves.

options.label: B
options.text: The librarian requested the students to maintain complete silence in the reading hall and to return the books to their designated shelves.

options.label: C
options.text: The librarian told the students that they should maintain complete silence in the reading hall and return the books to their designated shelves.

options.label: D
options.text: The librarian requested the students that please maintain complete silence in the reading hall and return the books to their designated shelves.

questions.correct_text: The librarian requested the students to maintain complete silence in the reading hall and to return the books to their designated shelves.
questions.solution:
The given sentence is an Imperative Sentence used to make a request. The reporting verbs like "said" are changed into "requested", "ordered", "begged", etc., depending on the context. The word "please" indicates a request, so the reporting verb becomes "requested". "To" is used before the Principal Verbs in the Indirect Speech.

For example:

John said to his assistant, "Bring me a glass of water." (Direct Speech)

John ordered his assistant to bring him a glass of water. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

· "said to" changes to "requested" because of the word "Please".

· The word "Please" is removed.

· The verbs "maintain" and "return" are preceded by "to".

Therefore, the correct answer is: "The librarian requested the students to maintain complete silence in the reading hall and to return the books to their designated shelves."

Hence, option (b) is correct.

questions.question: How many mangrove species are found in the Maldives?
questions.solution: The second paragraph of the passage mentions, 'The Maldives hosts 15 mangrove species across at least 150 islands, of which four exhibit low salt tolerance, while five show moderate tolerance, the paper noted.' Hence, (c) is the correct answer.
questions.passage:
Directions : Read the passage and answer the questions that follow.

In 2020, the Maldives witnessed an alarming dieback of nearly a quarter of its mangrove forests. Now, a new study revealed the culprit: Record-high sea levels, driven by the climate pattern Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD), inundated these vital coastal defenders with salt-laden waters, which caused the forests to slowly decline before perishing. Between 2017 and 2020, the sea levels rose by about 30 millimetres in the small island, drowning the mangroves and putting them in salinity stress. Since 2020, several islands in the Maldives have lost more than half of their mangrove forests. The IOD is a climate pattern that influences wind, sea surface temperatures and rainfall in the Indian Ocean basin. During the positive phase between 2019 and 2020, the western Indian Ocean, where the Maldives is situated, experienced warmer sea surface temperatures and higher sea levels due to ocean expansion, while the eastern Indian Ocean saw cooler waters and reduced sea levels.

Some islands have lost more than 50% of their mangrove forests. Mangroves are highly productive ecosystems that support local livelihoods and provide a natural barrier against coastal erosion, helping mitigate climate change impacts and extreme weather events such as cyclones and typhoons. The Maldives hosts 15 mangrove species across at least 150 islands, of which four exhibit low salt tolerance, while five show moderate tolerance, the paper noted. The dieback primarily affected Bruguiera cylindrica, a species with low salt tolerance and lacking salt glands.

A group of scientists integrated sea level evidence, climate data and remote sensing with field studies of sediment geochemistry and tree ring analysis to examine the mangrove dieback. Satellite images revealed that prolonged exposure to seawater from high sea levels caused a significant influx of saline water, increasing porewater salt concentrations in the soil. The researchers of mangrove wood also revealed that dead trees showed more severe signs of salinity stress compared to living ones.

questions.question: Which of the following is a characteristic of Bruguiera cylindrica?
questions.solution:
The second paragraph of the passage mentions, 'The dieback primarily affected Bruguiera cylindrica, a species with low salt tolerance and lacking salt glands.'

This clearly indicates that Bruguiera cylindrica is characterised by low salt tolerance and the absence of salt glands, which is why it was particularly affected by the salinity stress caused by rising sea levels. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

(a)- The passage clearly states that Bruguiera cylindrica has low salt tolerance, not high.

(c)- The passage does not mention anything about Bruguiera cylindrica being evergreen.

(d)- The passage does not describe Bruguiera cylindrica as having a free-floating habit.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the passage and answer the questions that follow.

In 2020, the Maldives witnessed an alarming dieback of nearly a quarter of its mangrove forests. Now, a new study revealed the culprit: Record-high sea levels, driven by the climate pattern Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD), inundated these vital coastal defenders with salt-laden waters, which caused the forests to slowly decline before perishing. Between 2017 and 2020, the sea levels rose by about 30 millimetres in the small island, drowning the mangroves and putting them in salinity stress. Since 2020, several islands in the Maldives have lost more than half of their mangrove forests. The IOD is a climate pattern that influences wind, sea surface temperatures and rainfall in the Indian Ocean basin. During the positive phase between 2019 and 2020, the western Indian Ocean, where the Maldives is situated, experienced warmer sea surface temperatures and higher sea levels due to ocean expansion, while the eastern Indian Ocean saw cooler waters and reduced sea levels.

Some islands have lost more than 50% of their mangrove forests. Mangroves are highly productive ecosystems that support local livelihoods and provide a natural barrier against coastal erosion, helping mitigate climate change impacts and extreme weather events such as cyclones and typhoons. The Maldives hosts 15 mangrove species across at least 150 islands, of which four exhibit low salt tolerance, while five show moderate tolerance, the paper noted. The dieback primarily affected Bruguiera cylindrica, a species with low salt tolerance and lacking salt glands.

A group of scientists integrated sea level evidence, climate data and remote sensing with field studies of sediment geochemistry and tree ring analysis to examine the mangrove dieback. Satellite images revealed that prolonged exposure to seawater from high sea levels caused a significant influx of saline water, increasing porewater salt concentrations in the soil. The researchers of mangrove wood also revealed that dead trees showed more severe signs of salinity stress compared to living ones.

questions.question:
A sentence is provided in indirect speech. Select the correct direct speech option.

The route planner asked me why I was marking an alternate trail then when the rescue team would leave at daybreak.

options.label: A
options.text: The route planner asked me, "Why were you marking an alternate trail then when the rescue team would leave at daybreak?"

options.label: B
options.text: The route planner asked me, "Why you are marking an alternate trail now when the rescue team will leave at daybreak?"

options.label: C
options.text: The route planner asked me, "Why are you marking an alternate trail now when the rescue team would leave at daybreak?"

options.label: D
options.text: The route planner asked me, "Why are you marking an alternate trail now when the rescue team will leave at daybreak?"

questions.correct_text: The route planner asked me, "Why are you marking an alternate trail now when the rescue team will leave at daybreak?"
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option d.

Rule of Speech Conversion for Wh-Questions:

When indirect speech begins with a wh-word like why, where, when, or how, that wh-word stays in direct speech.

The sentence must return to proper question form.

Time words also return to the speaker's original point of view.

Example:

Indirect: She asked me why I was waiting there then.

Direct: She asked me, "Why are you waiting here now?"

Here, "then" changes back to "now".

"I was marking" changes back to "are you marking".

"Would leave" changes back to "will leave".

So the correct direct speech is:

The route planner asked me, "Why are you marking an alternate trail now when the rescue team will leave at daybreak?"

• Option a is wrong because "were you marking" and "would leave" keep the reported-time view instead of restoring the original speech.

• Option b is wrong because "Why you are marking" is not correct question order.

• Option c is wrong because "would leave" is not restored to direct speech.

Final correct sentence:

The route planner asked me, "Why are you marking an alternate trail now when the rescue team will leave at daybreak?"

questions.question:
A sentence, split into four parts, has been given. Choose the best order which produces the original sentence.

to reduce agricultural emissions(A)/ a historic bill(B)/ and promote biodiversity and sustainable land use(C)/ the EU has accepted(D)
questions.solution:
The correct order is DBAC.

The sentence begins with the introductory phrase "The EU has accepted", which introduces the action taken by the European Union. It is followed by the noun phrase "a historic bill", describing what the EU has accepted. The phrase "to reduce agricultural emissions" specifies one aspect of the bill, indicating its aim. Lastly, the phrase "and promote biodiversity and sustainable land use" describes another aspect of the bill. By arranging these parts in the given order, the sentence forms a coherent and meaningful statement.

Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.

The rearranged sentence is: The EU has accepted a historic bill to reduce agricultural emissions and promote biodiversity and sustainable land use.

Note:

Noun phrase: A noun phrase is built around a single noun. Example: Their website published an article about the importance of focused work. Here 'article' is a noun and the part highlighted is a noun phrase.

questions.question:
A sentence, split into four parts, has been given. Choose the best order which produces the original sentence.

took part in a counter-demonstration(A)/ a slower approach(B)/ that called for(C)/ farmers also (D)
questions.solution:
The correct order is DACB.

The sentence begins with the subject "Farmers also", specifying the group of individuals being discussed. Then it states that the farmers "also took part in a counter-demonstration", indicating their involvement in an opposing protest or demonstration. The subordinate clause "that called for" introduces the purpose or demand of the counter-demonstration. Lastly, it describes the specific purpose or demand, which is "a slower approach". By arranging these parts in the given order, the sentence forms a coherent and meaningful statement.

Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

The rearranged sentence is: Farmers also took part in a counter-demonstration that called for a slower approach.

Note:

Clause: A clause is a group of words that contains a verb (and usually other components too). A clause may form part of a sentence, or it may be a complete sentence in itself. Example:

I. "His products weren't selling"; this is an example of a sentence containing one clause.

II. "After we had had dinner, we went for a walk"; here, the sentence contains two clauses that are separated by a comma.

A clause can be categorised as:

I. Main/independent clause

II. Subordinate/dependent clause

Main/independent clause: In the example 2 given above, the clause "we went for a walk" can be said as the main clause (a clause that is not dependent on any other clause for its meaning, it makes sense on its own; a sentence contains at least one main clause.)

Subordinate/dependent clause: In example 2 given above, the clause "After we had had dinner" is a subordinate clause: it depends on the main clause for its meaning and cannot exist as a sentence on its own.

questions.question:
Arrange the following sentences in the most logical sequence.

2) Rapid urbanization has led to increased pollution and overcrowding.

4) These challenges raised concerns about environmental degradation.

5) Measures like improved public transport and green spaces were introduced.
questions.solution:

Thus, the correct sequence is 2-4-1-3-5. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

Thus, the correct sequence is 2-4-1-5-3. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow:

The adage "Never attribute to malice that which can be adequately explained by stupidity," attributed to Robert J. Hanlon, underscores a critical perspective in understanding human behaviour. This principle suggests that, when faced with negative actions or outcomes, it is often more reasonable to consider incompetence or ignorance before assuming malicious intent. In professional and personal interactions, this approach can lead to more constructive outcomes. For instance, if a colleague fails to meet a deadline, it is easy to suspect sabotage. However, it is more likely that the delay resulted from poor time management or a lack of understanding rather than an intentional effort to undermine a project.

This mindset promotes patience and empathy, encouraging individuals to address issues through education and improvement rather than punishment. By assuming that mistakes are born from ignorance rather than malice, we foster a more positive and collaborative environment. Nonetheless, this adage does not suggest ignoring genuine malicious behaviour. Instead, it advocates for a balanced approach: carefully investigate the cause of an issue without prematurely attributing it to ill intent. This method not only enhances our judgment but also cultivates a culture of understanding and cooperation, turning potential conflicts into opportunities for growth and improvement.

questions.question: The given passage is:
questions.solution:
The given passage discusses a principle ("Never attribute to malice that which can be adequately explained by stupidity") and explains how this perspective influences human behaviour and interactions. It objectively informs the reader about the principle and its implications without telling a story or vividly describing something. Therefore, the passage is expository in nature, as it aims to inform and explain a concept. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

Argumentative: A passage that presents a viewpoint and supports it with evidence and reasoning to persuade the reader. The primary goal is to convince the reader to agree with the author's perspective.

Narrative: A passage that tells a story or recounts events. It often includes characters, a setting, a plot, and a sequence of events. The primary goal is to engage the reader through storytelling.

Descriptive: A passage that vividly describes the characteristics of a person, place, or thing through detailed observations and sensory details. The primary goal is to create a rich, immersive experience for the reader.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

The Nobel Prize in Economics for 2023 was awarded to Claudia Goldin, a Harvard University professor, for "having advanced our understanding of women's labour market outcomes". Goldin's pathbreaking work has shed light on the participation of women in the labour market over the past 200 years, and why the pay gap between men and women refuses to close even as many women are likely to be better educated than men in high-income countries. While her research focused on the United States, her findings are applicable to many other countries. Before Goldin's book was published in 1990, data mainly from the 20th century had been published, and researchers believed that as the economy grew, so did women's labour force participation.

Goldin reached back to older data to reveal that before industrialisation, more women were likely to have been involved in economic activity related to agriculture and various cottage industries. With greater industrialisation, work was concentrated in factories, and women found it difficult to leave their homes and travel to work. This trend reversed in the early 20th century, with the growth of the services sector. Two other factors played a crucial role in women's access to higher education and employment - marriage and delayed motherhood. Goldin's work found that by the beginning of the 20th century, while around 20 per cent of women were gainfully employed, the share of married women was only five per cent.

Goldin also demonstrated that there was another important factor in the slow reduction of the gap between men's and women's rates of employment, namely women's expectations for their future careers. Women's expectations were based on the experience of their mothers, and thus their educational and professional decisions were not taken with the expectation of having a long, uninterrupted, and fruitful career. By the end of the 1960s, women could exercise greater control over childbirth and actually plan careers and motherhood. Women also ventured beyond the services sector, studying subjects like law, economics, and medicine. Now, women were catching up in terms of education and fields of employment. However, one glaring gap still remains and continues to this day - the gender-based pay gap.

However, one glaring gap still remains and continues to this day - the gender-based pay gap."

Goldin also demonstrated that there was another important factor in the slow reduction of the gap between men's and women's rates of employment, namely women's expectations for their future careers. Women's expectations were based on the experience of their mothers, and thus their educational and professional decisions were not taken with the expectation of having a long, uninterrupted, and fruitful career. By the end of the 1960s, women could exercise greater control over childbirth and actually plan careers and motherhood. Women also ventured beyond the services sector, studying subjects like law, economics, and medicine. Now, women were catching up in terms of education and fields of employment. However, one glaring gap still remains and continues to this day - the gender-based pay gap.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

Arthur said to Ada, "Is Tom coming to Birmingham today?"

options.label: A
options.text: Arthur asked Ada that was Tom coming to Birmingham that day.

options.label: B
options.text: Arthur asked Ada if Tom was coming to Birmingham today.

options.label: C
options.text: Arthur asked Ada if Tom was coming to Birmingham that day.

options.label: D
options.text: Arthur asked Ada if Tom had been coming to Birmingham that day.

questions.correct_text: Arthur asked Ada if Tom was coming to Birmingham that day.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is(c) Arthur asked Ada if Tom was coming to Birmingham that day.

Key points:

·In the case of Interrogative sentences like this, "said" in Direct Speech is changed into "enquired (of)", "wanted to know", "asked", etc.

·In Indirect speech, the verb is always placed after the subject, unlike in Direct Speech. Thus, option (c) is incorrect.

·If there is a question in the Direct Speech whose answer can come as "Yes" or "No" in the Indirect Speech, we should use "If" or "Whether" before the Indirect Speech.

·For example:

o Ravi said to me, "Is she studying?" (Direct Speech)

o Ravi asked me if she was studying. (Indirect Speech)

·The following things in the sentence will change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

Direct SpeechIndirect Speech
said toasked
Is TomIf Tom was
todaythat day

·Therefore, the correct answer is:Arthur asked Ada if Tom was coming to Birmingham that day.

questions.question:
In the question given below, a sentence is given with one blank, followed by four options, each having a word which may or may not fit in the blank. From the given options, choose the one that gives the correct word that fits in the blank.

Much like productivity, the internet will have you believe that there's a hundred methods, products, and "hacks" necessary to getting ____________ things organized.
questions.solution: The sentence uses the phrase "the internet will have you believe". According to this, options b) and c) can be eliminated. Option a) is incorrect because possessive pronouns are not followed by nouns, which is the case in the given sentence. Option d), 'your', which is a possessive determiner, is appropriate for the given blank. Hence, d) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.

The ___ of friends giggled together, forming a tight circle in the school hallway.
questions.solution:
The most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank is 'clique'. "Clique" refers to a small, exclusive group of people who associate closely and often exclude others. In the given sentence, it suggests that a group of friends giggled together, forming a tight circle in the school hallway. Other options do not fit the context of the sentence. "Cluck" typically refers to the sound made by a chicken. "Cleek" refers to a hook-shaped instrument. "Click" refers to a short, sharp sound or operating a computer mouse.

The complete sentence is: The clique of friends giggled together, forming a tight circle in the school hallway.

Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

The revised disaster-response circular appears ______ than the earlier draft, especially in the way it assigns responsibility to local officials.
questions.solution:
Option (a) is correct because the sentence makes a direct comparison between the revised circular and the earlier draft. In such cases, the comparative degree is required. MORE BALANCED correctly completes the structure with "than." Rule: when two things are compared using "than," use the comparative form, as in "This road is wider than that one."

• Option (b): MOST BALANCED is superlative, which is used when one is compared with more than two.

• Option (c): AS BALANCED is used in an equality structure and would need "as" later, not "than."

• Option (d): THE MORE BALANCED is not suitable here because the sentence simply needs a normal comparative adjective before "than."

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate preposition to fill in the blank.

Certainly, she has been under a lot __ stress lately.
questions.solution:
'Of' is used while expressing the relationship between a part and a whole, or while expressing the relationship between a scale or measure and a value. Here, in the given sentence, 'of' is used in a similar context. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

'Into' is used while expressing movement or action, with the result that someone or something makes physical contact with something else, or to indicate a route by which someone or something may arrive at a particular destination.

'By' is used to identify the agent performing an action or the means of achieving something.

'For' is used to refer to in support of or in favour of a person or policy, on behalf of or to the benefit of, having the thing mentioned as a reason or cause.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

No government can be long secure ______ a formidable opposition.
questions.solution:
Such a preposition is to be used that can relate well long secure government with formidable opposition. So, 'without' is the correct choice because here 'without' is used to express the necessity of a formidable opposition and conveys that in the absence of a formidable opposition there cannot be long secure government. 'During' is used to express throughout the course or duration of (a period of time). 'Among' is used to express situated more or less centrally in relation to (several other things). 'Beyond' is used to express at or to the further side of.

Hence, option (a) is correct.

Note:

A Preposition is a word placed before a noun or a pronoun or a noun equivalent (pronoun, adverb, gerund, infinitive, adverbial clause, or any clause that can be used as the object of the preposition) and shows a relationship in space or time or a logical relationship between two or more people, places, or things in a sentence.

Examples

1) The teacher scolded the child for being late.

2) We're going to a party.

· The words in bold are called prepositions because they normally take position before (pre) a noun/pronoun or a noun equivalent (pronoun, adverb, gerund, infinitive, adverbial clause, or any clause that can be used as the object of the preposition.

· The noun/pronoun which is used with a preposition is called its Object.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The project will have been finished by our skilled team before ten.

options.label: A
options.text: Our skilled team shall have finished the project before ten.

options.label: B
options.text: Our skilled team will have finished the project before ten.

options.label: C
options.text: Our skilled team has finished the project before ten.

options.label: D
options.text: Our skilled team would have finished the project before ten.

questions.correct_text: Our skilled team will have finished the project before ten.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option B.

The subject of the passive voice is changed into the object of the active voice. Also, the object of the passive voice is changed into the subject of the active voice.

The removal of the helping verb and the preposition 'by' is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from passive to active. The tense does not change.

The syntax that is used for the above sentence:-

Passive voice- subject + will/shall have been + V3 + by + object

Active voice- new subject + will/shall have + V3 + new object

Hence, the correct active voice form is “Our skilled team will have finished the project before ten.”

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is/are CORRECT about the Permanent Settlement system?

I. It made the zamindar deposit a fixed amount of money in the state treasury.

II. Farmers were recognised as hereditary owners of land.

III. It was introduced during Lord Wellesley period.

Select the correct answer using the code.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन स्थायी बंदोबस्त प्रणाली के बारे में सही है/हैं?

I. इसने ज़मींदार को राज्य के खजाने में एक निश्चित राशि जमा करने के लिए बाध्य किया।

II. किसानों को भूमि के वंशानुगत स्वामी के रूप में मान्यता दी गई।

III. इसे लॉर्ड वेलेस्ली के काल में पेश किया गया था।

कोड का उपयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनें।
questions.solution:
Lord Cornwallis introduced the Permanent Settlement in Bengal and Bihar in 1793. So, statement III is not correct.

It made the landlord or zamindar deposit a fixed amount of money in the state treasury. In return zamindars were recognised as hereditary owners of land. This made the zamindar the owner of the land. The amount of revenue to be paid to the Company was fixed for a period of time which made the British financially secured. So, statement II is not correct and statement I is correct.

questions.question: Which of the following statements correctly applies standard basketball rules?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन मानक बास्केटबॉल नियमों को सही ढंग से लागू करता है?

options.label: A
options.text: A moving player who stops after taking two legal steps post-gather can choose either foot as their pivot foot.
options.text_hi: एक गतिशील खिलाड़ी जो दो वैध कदम लेने के बाद रुकता है, वह अपने किसी भी पैर को पिवट फुट के रूप में चुन सकता है।

options.label: B
options.text: If a team is already in the bonus, a common defensive foul committed before a player starts shooting results in a side-line throw-in rather than free throws.
options.text_hi: यदि कोई टीम पहले से ही बोनस में है, तो एक सामान्य रक्षात्मक फाउल जो खिलाड़ी के शूटिंग शुरू करने से पहले किया जाता है, उसके परिणामस्वरूप फ्री थ्रो की बजाय साइड-लाइन थ्रो-इन होता है।

options.label: C
options.text: To legally advance the ball into the frontcourt while dribbling, both of the player's feet and the basketball must completely cross the midcourt line.
options.text_hi: ड्रिब्लिंग करते हुए गेंद को फ्रंटकोर्ट में कानूनी रूप से आगे बढ़ाने के लिए, खिलाड़ी के दोनों पैर और बास्केटबॉल को पूरी तरह से मिडकोर्ट लाइन को पार करना चाहिए।

options.label: D
options.text: Any technical foul called on a head coach automatically adds to the team foul count for that quarter, pushing the opponent closer to the bonus.
options.text_hi: हेड कोच पर लगाए गए किसी भी तकनीकी फाउल से स्वचालित रूप से उस क्वार्टर के लिए टीम फाउल की संख्या बढ़ जाती है, जिससे विरोधी टीम बोनस के करीब पहुंच जाती है।

questions.correct_text: To legally advance the ball into the frontcourt while dribbling, both of the player's feet and the basketball must completely cross the midcourt line.
questions.solution:
To legally advance the ball into the frontcourt while dribbling, both of the player's feet and the basketball must completely cross the midcourt line.

The midcourt line acts as a strict boundary determining whether a team is in their backcourt (defensive half) or frontcourt (offensive half).

Under both FIBA (International) and NBA rules, frontcourt status is not achieved incrementally. For a player who is actively dribbling the ball, all three points of contact-the left foot, the right foot, and the basketball itself-must clear the midcourt line and touch the frontcourt playing surface.

If a player has both feet in the frontcourt but is still bouncing the ball on or behind the midcourt line, the ball is legally considered in the backcourt. Conversely, if the ball and one foot are across, but the trailing foot is touching the midcourt line, it is still a backcourt live ball.

Why the Other Options are Incorrect

Analysis of Option A: A moving player who stops after taking two legal steps post-gather can choose either foot as their pivot foot.

The Rule: When a player gathers the ball while moving, they are allowed two steps to come to a stop, pass, or shoot. The moment the player completes the first step after the gather, that specific foot becomes the designated pivot foot. The second step is legal, but once it touches the floor, the player is locked. They cannot choose to pivot on the second foot; lifting the first foot and putting it back down without releasing the ball is a traveling violation.

Analysis of Option B: If a team is already in the bonus, a common defensive foul committed before a player starts shooting results in a side-line throw-in rather than free throws.

The Rule: The "bonus" or "penalty" state completely overrides standard non-shooting foul penalties. Once a team accumulates enough team fouls in a quarter (or half, depending on the format) to enter the bonus, every single subsequent common defensive foul awards free throws to the fouled team, regardless of whether the player was in the act of shooting or just dribbling near the sideline.

Analysis of Option D: Any technical foul called on a head coach automatically adds to the team foul count for that quarter, pushing the opponent closer to the bonus.

The Rule: Technical fouls assessed to bench personnel, coaches, or even defensive players for unsportsmanlike conduct (like arguing with an official) are categorized as administrative or non-contact infractions. They result in free throws for the opposition immediately, but they do not count toward the team foul total required to reach the penalty bonus. Only personal, common contact fouls count toward that limit.

questions.question:
A 6 V ideal battery is connected in series with two resistors of 2 Ω and 4 Ω.

Consider the statements:

1. The same current flows through both resistors.

2. The circuit current is 1 A.

3. The potential difference across the 2 Ω resistor is 2 V.

Which of the above is/are true?
questions.question_hi:
एक 6 V आदर्श बैटरी 2 Ω और 4 Ω के दो प्रतिरोधकों के साथ श्रृंखला में जुड़ी हुई है।

कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. दोनों प्रतिरोधकों के माध्यम से समान धारा प्रवाहित होती है।

2. सर्किट धारा 1 A है।

3. 2 Ω प्रतिरोधक के बीच विभवांतर 2 V है।

उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से सत्य है/हैं?
questions.solution:
All three statements are correct based on the fundamental principles of DC circuits (Ohm's Law and the properties of series circuits).

Explanation and Calculations:

Given Data:

Voltage of the battery (V) = 6 V

Resistor 1 (R₁) = 2 Ω

Resistor 2 (R₂) = 4 Ω

The resistors are connected in series.

Statement 1: The same current flows through both resistors.

This is correct. It is a defining characteristic of a series circuit. In a series connection, there is only one path for the current to flow, so the current (I) is the same through every component in the circuit.

Statement 2: The circuit current is 1 A.

This is correct. To find the total current, we first need the total equivalent resistance (R_eq) of the series circuit.

For resistors in series: R_eq = R₁ + R₂

R_eq = 2 Ω + 4 Ω = 6 Ω

Now, using Ohm's Law (V = I * R), we can find the total current (I):

I = V / R_eq

I = 6 V / 6 Ω = 1 A

So, the total current flowing through the circuit is 1 Ampere.

Statement 3: The potential difference across the 2 Ω resistor is 2 V.

This is correct. The potential difference (voltage drop) across an individual resistor is found using Ohm's Law with the current flowing through that resistor.

Voltage across R₁ (V₁) = I * R₁

Since I = 1 A and R₁ = 2 Ω:

V₁ = 1 A * 2 Ω = 2 V

So, the potential difference across the 2 Ω resistor is 2 Volts.

Conclusion:

Since all three statements are verified to be correct, the correct option is (D).

Further insights:

We can also verify the voltage drop across the 4 Ω resistor:

Voltage across R₂ (V₂) = I * R₂

V₂ = 1 A * 4 Ω = 4 V

According to Kirchhoff's Voltage Law for a series circuit, the sum of the voltage drops across the resistors must equal the total voltage supplied by the battery:

V₁ + V₂ = 2 V + 4 V = 6 V

This matches the battery voltage, confirming our calculations.

questions.question:
Which of the following statement is/are correct?

Statement I: The gravitational force between Earth and Moon would double if the distance between them doubled.

Statement II: According to Newton's law, gravitational force is proportional to the product of masses and inversely proportional to the square of the separation.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

कथन 1: पृथ्वी और चंद्रमा के बीच की दूरी दोगुनी होने पर उनके बीच का गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल भी दोगुना हो जाएगा।

कथन 2: न्यूटन के नियम के अनुसार, गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल द्रव्यमानों के गुणनफल के समानुपाती और उनके बीच की दूरी के वर्ग के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होता है।

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो मैं और न ही दूसरा

questions.solution:
Gravitational force varies as 1/r2; doubling r reduces force to one-fourth, not double; Statement I is false.

Statement II states the correct law: F = G m1 m2 / r2.

Further Insights:

- Kepler's third law for circular orbits: T2 ∝ r3; orbital speed v ∝ 1/√r for same central mass.

- G ≈ 6.67 X 10−11 N m2 kg−2.

- Weight is mg near Earth; it decreases with altitude as g ∝ 1/r2 from Earth's center.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements.

I. Urvara soils are generally fertile soils.

II. Usara soils contain a large proportion of sodium salts.

Which of the statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. उर्वरा मिट्टी आमतौर पर उपजाऊ मिट्टी होती है।

II. ऊसरा मिट्टी में सोडियम लवण का एक बड़ा अनुपात होता है।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
In ancient times, soils are classified into two main groups,

a) Uravara soils are generally fertile soils rich with organic content.

b) Usara soils are sterile, saline or barren soils. These soils contain a large proportion of salts such as sodium, potassium and magnesium etc.

In medieval times, the soils were classified on the basis of the external features such as texture, colour, the slope of land and moisture content in the soil. Therefore, the soils were identified as sandy, clayey, silty and loamy, etc.

Then, they were also classified on the basis of colour such as red soil, yellow soil, black soil, etc.

Source: India: Physical Environment NCERT

I. भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस (INC) का पहला अधिवेशन (1885) बंबई में हुआ था, जिसकी अध्यक्षता डब्ल्यू.सी. बनर्जी ने की थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the adaptations of a frog.

I. Frogs are poikilothermic, meaning their body temperature fluctuates with the temperature of the environment.

II. On land, a frog respires through its lungs, buccal cavity, and moist skin.

III. During summer sleep (aestivation), gaseous exchange ceases completely until favorable conditions return.

IV. The ability of a frog to change its skin color to blend with the surroundings is known as mimicry.

Which of the following options has all the correct statements?
questions.question_hi:
मेंढक के अनुकूलन के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. मेंढक पॉइकिलोथर्मिक होते हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि उनके शरीर का तापमान पर्यावरण के तापमान के साथ उतार-चढ़ाव करता है।

II. जमीन पर, एक मेंढक अपने फेफड़ों, मुख गुहा और नम त्वचा के माध्यम से श्वसन करता है।

III. ग्रीष्मकालीन निद्रा (एस्टीवेशन) के दौरान, अनुकूल परिस्थितियों के वापस आने तक गैसीय विनिमय पूरी तरह से बंद हो जाता है।

IV. परिवेश के साथ घुलने-मिलने के लिए मेंढक की अपनी त्वचा का रंग बदलने की क्षमता को अनुकरण के रूप में जाना जाता है।

निम्नलिखित में से किस विकल्प में सभी कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement I: This statement is correct. Poikilotherms, or cold-blooded animals, do not maintain a constant internal body temperature; it varies with the ambient temperature.

Statement II: This statement is correct. On land, frogs use three respiratory surfaces: lungs (pulmonary respiration), the lining of the mouth (buccal respiration), and the skin (cutaneous respiration).

Statement III: This statement is incorrect. During aestivation (summer sleep) and hibernation (winter sleep), gaseous exchange does not cease; it occurs through the skin.

Statement IV: This statement is correct. The protective coloration used by frogs for camouflage as mimicry.

questions.question:
With reference to the Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG), consider the following:

1. The CAG is appointed by the President and can be removed in like manner and on like grounds as a judge of the Supreme Court.

2. The Constitution mandates the CAG to audit Panchayats and Municipalities across all States.

3. The CAG's term is six years or until the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier, under the CAG (Duties, Powers and Conditions of Service) Act, 1971.

Which of the above statements is/are NOT correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत के नियंत्रक एवं महालेखा परीक्षक (CAG) के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित पर विचार करें:

1. CAG की नियुक्ति राष्ट्रपति द्वारा की जाती है और उन्हें सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीश की तरह ही और समान आधार पर हटाया जा सकता है।

2. संविधान CAG को सभी राज्यों में पंचायतों और नगर पालिकाओं का लेखा परीक्षण करने का अधिकार देता है।

3. CAG (कर्तव्य, शक्तियां और सेवा की शर्तें) अधिनियम, 1971 के तहत CAG का कार्यकाल छह वर्ष या 65 वर्ष की आयु तक, जो भी पहले हो, होता है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा सही नहीं है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 2 is not correct. The Constitution does not mandate the CAG to audit local bodies; it only enables state legislatures to make such a provision.

Statements 1 and 3 are correct descriptions of the appointment, removal, and service conditions of the CAG. Therefore, the only incorrect statement is 2.

Explanation of Statements:

1 is Correct. This statement accurately describes the appointment and removal process for the CAG, ensuring the independence of the office.

Appointment: Article 148(1) of the Constitution states that the CAG shall be appointed by the President by warrant under his hand and seal.

Removal: The same article provides a high degree of security of tenure by stating that the CAG "shall only be removed from office in like manner and on the like grounds as a Judge of the Supreme Court." This means removal requires a process of impeachment, involving a special majority in both Houses of Parliament on grounds of proved misbehaviour or incapacity.

2 is Not Correct. This statement is false. The Constitution does not mandate the CAG to audit the accounts of local bodies like Panchayats and Municipalities. Article 243J (for Panchayats) and Article 243Z (for Municipalities) state that the legislature of a State may, by law, make provisions with respect to the maintenance and audit of the accounts of these local bodies. The State Legislature can entrust this job to the CAG, but it is not a constitutional mandate for the CAG. The audit of local bodies is primarily the responsibility of state-level audit authorities.

3 is Correct. The term and other conditions of service of the CAG are not detailed in the Constitution itself but are determined by Parliament by law. This has been done through the CAG's (Duties, Powers and Conditions of Service) Act, 1971. This Act specifies that the CAG shall hold office for a term of six years or up to the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier.

Further insights:

The CAG is the head of the Indian Audit and Accounts Department and is the guardian of the public purse.

The primary role of the CAG is to audit all receipts and expenditure of the Government of India and the state governments, including those of bodies and authorities substantially financed by the government.

The CAG submits its audit reports to the President (for Union accounts) and the Governor (for State accounts), who in turn lay them before the Parliament and the State Legislature, respectively. These reports are then examined by the Public Accounts Committee (PAC).

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:

I. There is a fixed tenure for a judge of Supreme Court according to the Indian Constitution.

II. A judge of Supreme Court holds office until he/she attains the age of 65 years.

III. A judge of Supreme Court can resign from office by writing to the Chief Justice of India.

Select the correct statements using the codes given below:
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. भारतीय संविधान के अनुसार सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के न्यायाधीश का कार्यकाल निश्चित होता है।

II. सर्वोच्च न्यायालय का न्यायाधीश 65 वर्ष की आयु प्राप्त करने तक अपने पद पर बना रहता है।

III. सर्वोच्च न्यायालय का न्यायाधीश भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश को पत्र लिखकर अपने पद से इस्तीफा दे सकता है।

नीचे दिए गए कूट का प्रयोग कर सही कथनों का चयन कीजिए:
questions.solution:
Statement I and III are NOT correct.

Statement II is correct.

The Constitution has not fixed the tenure of a judge of the Supreme Court. However, it makes the following three provisions in this regard:

1. He holds office until he attains the age of 65 years. Any question regarding his age is to be determined by such authority and in such manner as provided by Parliament.

2. He can resign his office by writing to the president.

3. He can be removed from his office by the President on the recommendation of the Parliament.

I. Loo - Eastern India

Loo:

questions.solution: Indian teacher Rouble Nagi has won the Global Teacher Prize 2026, receiving the one million dollar award at the World Government Summit in Dubai. The award, presented by GEMS Education in its tenth edition, was handed over by Dubai Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum. Nagi was honoured for transforming neglected walls into interactive educational murals that teach reading, writing, arithmetic, as well as public health and environmental awareness. Over the past two decades, her work has helped integrate more than one million children into formal education using art as a learning tool. She was chosen from over 5,000 nominations from 139 countries. Through her Rouble Nagi Art Foundation, she has set up more than 800 educational centres across India, providing safe and inspiring spaces in over 100 low-income communities and villages. The Global Teacher Prize, presented by GEMS Education and organised by the Varkey Foundation with UNESCO during the World Government Summit, recognises exceptional educators for their outstanding contributions to teaching.

questions.question:
The following question consists of two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R). Examine these two statements carefully and select the correct answer using the codes given below.

Assertion (A): The reign of Shah Jahan marks the transition of Mughal architectural preference from the extensive use of red sandstone to highly polished white marble integrated with pietra dura inlay.

Reason (R): The structural use of white marble allowed Mughal architects to implement true load-bearing double domes for the first time in the Indian subcontinent, solving the internal proportion issues of massive monuments.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित प्रश्न दो कथनों से बना है, एक को Assertion (A) और दूसरे को Reason (R) के रूप में चिह्नित किया गया है। इन दोनों कथनों को ध्यान से पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनें।

Assertion (A): शाहजहां का शासन मुगल वास्तुकला की प्राथमिकता को लाल बलुआ पत्थर के व्यापक उपयोग से अत्यंत चमकदार सफेद संगमरमर के साथ पिएत्रा डुरा इनले के संयोजन की ओर ले जाता है।

Reason (R): सफेद संगमरमर के संरचनात्मक उपयोग ने मुगल वास्तुकारों को भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप में पहली बार सच्चे भार वहन करने वाले डबल गुंबदों को लागू करने की अनुमति दी, जिससे विशाल स्मारकों के आंतरिक अनुपात की समस्याओं का समाधान हुआ।

options.label: A
options.text: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R सही हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या है।

options.label: B
options.text: Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R सही हैं लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options.label: C
options.text: A is true but R is false.
options.text_hi: A सही है लेकिन R गलत है।

options.label: D
options.text: A is false but R is true.
options.text_hi: A गलत है लेकिन R सही है।

questions.correct_text: A is true but R is false.
questions.solution:
Why Assertion (A) is true:

The reign of Emperor Shah Jahan is widely recognized as the "golden age" of Mughal architecture. While his predecessors (Akbar and Jahangir) relied heavily on red sandstone, Shah Jahan transitioned to using highly polished Makrana white marble. He paired this with pietra dura (an Italian decorative technique called parchin kari in South Asia, where semi-precious stones are inlaid into marble), which reached its artistic peak in structures like the Taj Mahal and the Diwan-i-Khas at the Red Fort.

Why Reason (R) is false:

The reason makes a significant historical error regarding both the timeline and structural mechanics of Mughal architecture:

First use of the double dome: The true load-bearing double dome was not introduced by Shah Jahan, nor did it require white marble to be implemented. It was first introduced to the Indian subcontinent during the Delhi Sultanate (Humayun's Tomb, built in the mid-16th century during Akbar's reign, is the first massive, fully realized example of a Persian-style double dome in India).

Purpose of the double dome: The double dome technique creates an outer shell to give the building a grand, imposing height from the outside, while creating a lower, architecturally proportional ceiling on the inside so visitors don't feel dwarfed. This was a structural engineering solution achieved through brick, stone, and mortar masonry, completely independent of whether the exterior finishing veneer was red sandstone or white marble.

questions.question: In an ecological succession, the first plant to colonize an area is called the ____
questions.question_hi: पारिस्थितिक अनुक्रम में, किसी क्षेत्र में बसने वाले पहले पौधे को ____ कहा जाता है।
questions.solution:
Ecological Succession:

Biotic communities are dynamic in nature and change over a period of time. The process by which communities of plant and animal species in an area are replaced or changed into another over a period of time is known as ecological succession.

Succession occurs when a series of communities replace one another due to large scale destruction (natural or manmade). This process continues with one community replacing another until a stable, mature community develops. Succession is a progressive series of changes which leads to the establishment of a relatively stable climax community.

Pioneer community: The first plant to colonize an area is called the pioneer community.

Seral community: The stage leading to the climax community is called successional stages or seres. Each transitional (temporary) community that is formed and replaced during succession is called a stage in succession or a seral community.

Succession would occur faster in area existing in the middle of the large continent. This is because, here seeds of plants belonging to the different seres would reach much faster, establish and ultimately result in the climax community.

questions.question:
Consider the following with regard to the concept of 'Double coincidence of wants'.

I. It refers to diametrically opposite demand of goods or services by both buyer and seller.

II. It forms the basis of markets where there are barter exchanges.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
'इच्छाओं के दोहरे संयोग' की अवधारणा के संबंध में निम्नलिखित पर विचार करें।

I. यह क्रेता और विक्रेता दोनों द्वारा वस्तुओं या सेवाओं की बिल्कुल विपरीत मांग को संदर्भित करता है।

II. यह उन बाजारों का आधार बनाता है जहाँ वस्तु विनिमय होता है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Double coincidence of wants means what one person wants to sell and buy must coincide with what some other person wants to buy and sell. The functioning of barter system necessitates a double coincidence of demand on the part of those involved in exchange of goods and services.

It is absolutely necessary for one party to want exactly what the other party is offering in exchange and vice versa.

If this double coincidence of demand is not matched exactly, no exchange will take place. Hence, both the statements are correct.

कैबिनेट की नियुक्ति समिति (ACC) ने नीलकंठ मिश्रा को विश्व बैंक में कार्यकारी निदेशक नियुक्त किया है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?

I. नीलकंठ मिश्रा वर्तमान में एक्सिस बैंक के मुख्य अर्थशास्त्री हैं।

II. वह UIDAI के अंशकालिक अध्यक्ष के रूप में कार्य करते हैं।

III. वह 14वीं वित्त आयोग के सदस्य थे।
questions.solution:
Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) appointed Neelkanth Mishra as Executive Director at the World Bank headquarters. He will succeed Parmeswaran Iyer, for a tenure of three years from the date of assumption of charge of the post or until further orders, whichever is earlier,' the order read. Further, the ACC also approved extension of tenure of lyer beyond June 19 till joining of Mishra. Mishra is at present working as Chief Economist with Axis Bank. Earlier he worked as Managing Director and Co-Head of Equity Strategy (Asia Pacific) and India Strategist for Credit Suisse. before joining the Axis Group in 2023, he spent nearly two decades at Credit Suisse, where he served as Managing Director, India Strategist, and Co-Head of Equity Strategy for the Asia-Pacific region. His work has spanned macroeconomics, financial markets, public policy and investment strategy.

Apart from his responsibilities in the private sector, Mishra has been associated with several government institutions.

He is a part-time member of the Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister (EAC-PM), which provides advice to the government, specifically to the prime minister, on economic and related matters.

He also serves as part-time Chairperson of the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), the body responsible for Aadhaar. In addition, he is a part-time member of the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (Trai).

Mishra has contributed to several government panels and policy initiatives over the years.

These include the 15th Finance Commission, the 16th Finance Commission, the India Semiconductor Mission, the Revenue Neutral Rate (RNR) Committee related to the Goods and Services Tax (GST), and the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) Review Committee.

With respect to Census 2011 concepts, which of the following statements are true?

2) "Urban area" includes statutory towns and census towns; a census town must meet population, density, and workforce criteria.

3) India's sex ratio (females per 1000 males) in 2011 was above 950.

4) A "household" is limited to a family related only by blood.
questions.question_hi:
जनगणना 2011 की अवधारणाओं के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन से कथन सत्य हैं?

questions.question:
Read the below statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Mark the correct options:

Assertion (A): "Malgudi Days" is a collection of short stories by R.K. Narayan.

Reason (R): The stories revolve around Malgudi, a fictional South Indian town conceived by the author.
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दिए गए कथनों को पढ़िए, जिन्हें अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) के रूप में चिह्नित किया गया है। सही विकल्प चुनिए:

अभिकथन (A): "मालगुडी डेज़" आर.के. नारायण द्वारा रचित लघु कथाओं का संग्रह है।

कारण (R): ये कहानियाँ मालगुडी नामक एक काल्पनिक दक्षिण भारतीय शहर के इर्द-गिर्द घूमती हैं, जिसकी कल्पना लेखक ने की है।

options.label: A
options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
options.text_hi: A और R दोनों सत्य हैं, और R, A की सही व्याख्या है।

options.label: B
options.text: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
options.text_hi: A और R दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options.label: C
options.text: A is true, but R is false
options.text_hi: A सत्य है, लेकिन R असत्य है।

options.label: D
options.text: A is false, but R is true
options.text_hi: A असत्य है, लेकिन R सत्य है।

questions.correct_text: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
questions.solution:
Assertion is true: "Malgudi Days" is indeed a short story collection by R.K. Narayan.

Reason is true: The setting is the fictional town of Malgudi created by Narayan.

R adds a fact about the setting but does not explain why it is a short story collection; hence both are true, but R does not explain A.

Further Insights:

- R.K. Narayan introduced Malgudi in "Swami and Friends" (1935).

- R.K. Narayan's "The Guide" won the Sahitya Akademi Award (1960).

- Arundhati Roy's "The God of Small Things" won the Booker Prize in 1997.

- Aravind Adiga's "The White Tiger" won the Booker Prize in 2008.

- Rabindranath Tagore's "Gitanjali" led to the Nobel Prize in Literature (1913) for Tagore.

- Mulk Raj Anand's "Untouchable" is a key early Indian English novel on social reform.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:

1) Instruction Register stores the currently executing instruction.

2) Program Counter stores the result of arithmetic operations.

Which statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) निर्देश रजिस्टर वर्तमान में निष्पादित हो रहे निर्देश को संग्रहीत करता है।

2) प्रोग्राम काउंटर अंकगणितीय संक्रियाओं के परिणाम को संग्रहीत करता है।

कौन सा कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो 1 और न ही 2 सही हैं

questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is incorrect because the Program Counter tracks instruction addresses, not calculation results.

Explanation of Statements:

1) is Correct. The Instruction Register (IR) holds the specific instruction that the CPU is currently decoding or executing.

2) is Incorrect. The Program Counter (PC) stores the memory address of the next instruction to be fetched. Results of arithmetic operations are typically stored in the Accumulator or general-purpose registers.

Further Insights:

· The PC is automatically incremented after each fetch so that the CPU knows where to go next in the program.

· These registers are part of the CPU's internal architecture and are essential for the control flow of a program.

questions.question: Which input device is most suitable for capturing continuous hand-drawn movements digitally?
questions.question_hi: हाथ से खींची गई निरंतर गतियों को डिजिटल रूप से कैप्चर करने के लिए कौन सा इनपुट डिवाइस सबसे उपयुक्त है?
questions.solution:
The Digitizer is the most suitable device for precise, continuous digital drawing.

Explanation:

A Digitizer (or Graphics Tablet) uses a pressure-sensitive surface and a stylus to capture fine movements. It converts the analog movement of a hand into digital signals with high precision, making it the standard for artists and engineers.

Light pens are older tech for direct screen interaction; Joysticks and Trackballs are primarily for navigation/gaming and lack the precision for "drawing."

Further Insights:

Digitizers are essential in CAD (Computer-Aided Design) for creating blueprints and in digital illustration for pressure-sensitive brush strokes.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the functional units of a computer:

1) Input unit converts external data into machine-readable form.

2) Output unit directly controls the execution of instructions.

3) Storage unit holds data and instructions temporarily or permanently.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
कंप्यूटर की कार्यात्मक इकाइयों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) इनपुट इकाई बाहरी डेटा को मशीन-पठनीय रूप में परिवर्तित करती है।

2) आउटपुट इकाई निर्देशों के निष्पादन को सीधे नियंत्रित करती है।

3) भंडारण इकाई डेटा और निर्देशों को अस्थायी या स्थायी रूप से संग्रहीत करती है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because the execution of instructions is controlled by the Control Unit (CU) within the CPU, not the output unit.

Explanation of Statements:

· 1 is Correct. The Input Unit (e.g., keyboard, mouse) accepts data from the outside world and converts it into binary form (0s and 1s) so the computer can process it.

· 2 is Incorrect. The Output Unit is responsible only for presenting processed results to the user (e.g., monitor, printer). The coordination and execution of instructions are the responsibility of the Control Unit.

· 3 is Correct. The Storage Unit consists of Primary Memory (RAM), which holds data temporarily during processing, and Secondary Memory (Hard Disks), which stores data permanently.

Further Insights:

· All functional units communicate via a set of wires called "Buses" (Data Bus, Address Bus, and Control Bus).

· The interaction between these units is based on the Von Neumann Architecture.

questions.question: Which port is primarily associated with wired network connectivity?
questions.question_hi: वायर्ड नेटवर्क कनेक्टिविटी के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा पोर्ट उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution:
The RJ-45 port is the standard interface for wired Ethernet networking.

Explanation of Options:

· HDMI: Used for transmitting high-definition digital video and audio.

· VGA: An older analog port used solely for video output to monitors.

· RJ-45: This port accepts an Ethernet cable to connect a computer to a local area network (LAN) or a router.

· PS/2: A legacy port used for connecting older keyboards and mice.

Further Insights:

· RJ-45 stands for "Registered Jack 45." It looks like a telephone jack (RJ-11) but is slightly wider with eight pins instead of four or six.

questions.question: Which backup method stores only data changed since the last full backup?
questions.question_hi: कौन सी बैकअप विधि केवल अंतिम पूर्ण बैकअप के बाद परिवर्तित डेटा को ही संग्रहीत करती है?
questions.solution:
The Incremental backup method stores data changed since the last backup of any type.

Explanation:

Incremental Backup: This method only backs up files that have changed since the most recent backup (whether full or incremental). This saves time and storage space.

Differential Backup: This stores all data changed since the last Full backup. It grows in size until the next full backup is performed.

Mirror Backup: An exact real-time clone of the data.

Further Insights:

While incremental backups are fastest to perform, they are the slowest to restore because you need the last full backup plus every incremental piece in the chain.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a Boot sector Virus?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक बूट सेक्टर वायरस नहीं है?
questions.solution:
A boot virus (also known as a boot infector, an MBR virus or DBR virus) targets and infects a specific, physical section of a computer system that contains information crucial to the proper operation of the computer's operating system (OS).

Some common boot sector viruses include Monkey, NYB (also known as B1), Stoned, and Form.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Windows Explorer (File Explorer):

1) Windows Explorer is used to manage files and folders stored on a computer.

2) Windows Explorer can be used to install device drivers.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:

questions.question: What is the port number used for Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure (HTTPS)?
questions.question_hi: हाइपरटेक्स्ट ट्रांसफर प्रोटोकॉल सिक्योर (HTTPS) के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला पोर्ट नंबर क्या है?
questions.solution:
Port number used for Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure (HTTPS) is Port 443.

Port 443 is a virtual point ⁠through which data transmissions are sent and received. This communication endpoint is used by transport layer protocols, like the Transmission Control Protocol (TCP), to divert different types of web traffic to its destination.

questions.question: In Computer, Operating System uses which of the following for paging virtual memory?
questions.question_hi: कंप्यूटर में ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम वर्चुअल मेमोरी की पेजिंग के लिए निम्नलिखित में से किसका उपयोग करता है?
questions.solution:
Page Replacement

· In order to make the most use of virtual memory, we load several processes into memory at the same time. Since we only load the pages that are actually needed by each process at any given time, there is room to load many more processes than if we had to load in the entire process.

· However memory is also needed for other purposes ( such as I/O buffering ), and what happens if some process suddenly decides it needs more pages and there aren't any free frames available? There are several possible solutions to consider:

1) Adjust the memory used by I/O buffering, etc., to free up some frames for user processes. The decision of how to allocate memory for I/O versus user processes is a complex one, yielding different policies on different systems. ( Some allocate a fixed amount for I/O, and others let the I/O system contend for memory along with everything else. )

2) Put the process requesting more pages into a wait queue until some free frames become available.

3) Swap some process out of memory completely, freeing up its page frames.

4) Find some page in memory that isn't being used right now, and swap that page only out to disk, freeing up a frame that can be allocated to the process requesting it. This is known as page replacement, and is the most common solution. There are many different algorithms for page replacement

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding POP3:

1)POP3 downloads emails to the local system.

2)POP3 supports synchronization across multiple devices.

3)POP3 usually removes emails from server after download.

Correct statements are:
questions.question_hi:
POP3 के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) POP3 ईमेल को स्थानीय सिस्टम पर डाउनलोड करता है।

2) POP3 कई उपकरणों में सिंक्रोनाइज़ेशन का समर्थन करता है।

3) POP3 आमतौर पर डाउनलोड के बाद सर्वर से ईमेल हटा देता है।

सही कथन हैं:
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Statement 2 is incorrect because POP3 is not designed for multi-device synchronization.

Explanation of Statements:

1) is Correct. POP3 (Post Office Protocol version 3) is designed to download the entire email from the server to the user's local device.

2) is Incorrect. POP3 is not ideal for multiple devices. If you download an email on your PC, it may not appear on your phone because the protocol lacks a two-way sync feature. This is a feature of IMAP.

3) is Correct. By default, POP3 deletes the email from the mail server once it has been successfully downloaded to the local client.

Further Insights:

· POP3 is useful for users with limited internet connectivity or small server storage limits.

· Modern email users generally prefer IMAP because it keeps the server and all devices in sync.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about a stealth virus:

i. A stealth virus hides its presence by intercepting system calls made by antivirus programs.

ii. A stealth virus permanently damages hardware components of a computer system.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
स्टेल्थ वायरस के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i. एक स्टेल्थ वायरस एंटीवायरस प्रोग्रामों द्वारा किए गए सिस्टम कॉल्स को इंटरसेप्ट करके अपनी उपस्थिति छुपाता है।

ii. एक स्टेल्थ वायरस कंप्यूटर सिस्टम के हार्डवेयर घटकों को स्थायी रूप से नुकसान पहुंचाता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement 1: Hiding Presence (Correct)

A stealth virus is a sophisticated type of malware designed specifically to evade detection by antivirus (AV) software and the operating system.

Mechanism: It intercepts "read" requests or system calls. When an antivirus program tries to scan an infected file, the virus temporarily "hides" itself or displays a clean, uninfected version of the file to the AV software.

Redirection: By controlling the communication between the hardware and the software, it can report that a file's size hasn't changed, even though the virus has added its own code to it.

Statement 2: Permanent Hardware Damage (Incorrect)

Viruses, including stealth viruses, are software-based threats. Their primary goal is to infect files, steal data, or take control of a system.

Software vs. Hardware: While a virus can delete data, corrupt the BIOS/firmware, or cause a system to overheat (by overworking the CPU), it does not physically or permanently "break" hardware components like the motherboard or RAM.

Permanent hardware damage is extremely rare in the world of malware; the damage is almost always logical (to the data) rather than physical (to the circuitry).

questions.question: Which technology is primarily used for two-factor authentication in online banking?

questions.solution:
OTP is the primary technology used for the second layer of authentication in banking.

Explanation:

OTP (One-Time Password): This provides Two-Factor Authentication (2FA). Even if a hacker knows your password (Factor 1), they cannot access your account without the unique code sent to your registered mobile/email (Factor 2).

CAPTCHA: Used to distinguish humans from bots.

Firewall: Used to block unauthorized network traffic.

Further Insights:

OTP is a "dynamic" password that expires within a few minutes, making it highly secure against replay attacks.

questions.question: Abhi and Nikki walk along a circular track in opposite directions. Abhi completes 3 rounds in 1 minute and Nikki completes 4 rounds of the track at the same time. questions.solution:
They are moving in opposite directions, their relative speed = 3 + 4 = 7 rounds per minute

In 1 minute, they complete 7 rounds together, meaning they meet 7 times per minute.

In 2 minutes, the total number of meetings will be: 7 x 2 = 14 times

questions.question: The system of equations 5y + 7 - 15x = 0 and 2y + 3x = 2 has:

questions.solution:
The first equation in this system, 5y + 7 - 15x = 0, i.e., 15x - 5y = 7, corresponds to a line that has slope (15/5) = 3

The second equation in this system, 2y + 3x = 2, is represented by a line that has slope - (3/2).

Since the two slopes are not equal, the lines have to intersect in exactly one point. That one point will be the unique solution.

Total work done by men = (m X m X m) man - hours = m3 MH

Total work done by women = (w X w X m) man - hours = w2m MH

According to the question; m3 = 4w2m

=> m2 = 4w2

=> m = 2w

questions.question: The base of a pyramid is Pentagon and volume of pyramid is 2025 cubic cm. The ratio between the apothem of pentagon and its side length is 3: 5 and difference between them is 6 cm. Find the height of pyramid.

questions.solution:
Let apothem of pentagon = 3x cm and side length of pentagon = 5x cm

ATQ,

5x - 3x = 6

2x = 6 or x = 3.

Apothem of pentagon = 9 cm

Side length of pentagon= 15 cm

Area of pentagon = 5* ½* length of apothem* side length of pentagon

= 5* ½* 9* 15 = 337.5 sq. cm

Volume of pyramid = 1/3* base area* height

2025 = 1/3* 337.5* H

H = 3* 6 = 18 cm.
