questions.question: There are 5 boys and 7 girls on a picnic. A fruit seller sells them 4 bananas, 3 apples, and 5 oranges such that every student gets one fruit each. What is the probability that a person selected at random is a boy and he has either an apple or an orange with him?
questions.question_hi: एक पिकनिक पर 5 लड़के और 7 लड़कियां हैं। एक फल विक्रेता उन्हें 4 केले, 3 सेब और 5 संतरे इस प्रकार बेचता है कि प्रत्येक छात्र को एक-एक फल मिलता है। क्या संभावना है कि यादृच्छिक रूप से चुने गए व्यक्ति में से एक लड़का हो और उसके पास या तो सेब हो या संतरा?
questions.solution:
According to the given question,

The probability of a boy being selected = (number of boys)/ (number of boys + number of girls)

= 5/(5 + 7) = 5/12

The probability of having either an apple or an orange with any boy or girl

= (number of apples + number of oranges)/(number of total fruits)

= (3+5)/12 = 8/12

Now the probability of having either an apple or an orange with the boy who is selected

= (The probability of a boy being selected) X ( The probability of having either an apple or an orange with any boy or girl)

= 5/12 X 8/12 = 5/18

questions.question: The cost of setting up a magazine is Rs. 2800. The cost of miscellaneous items is 80 paise per copy, and the printing cost is Rs. 1.60 per copy in the last month, 2000 copies were printed, but only 1500 copies could be sold at Rs. 5 each. A total of 25% profit on the sale price was realized. There is one more source of income from the magazine, which is advertising. What sum of money was obtained from the advertising in the magazine?
questions.question_hi: एक पत्रिका की स्थापना की लागत 2800 रु. है। विविध की लागत 80 पैसे प्रति प्रतियाँ है और मुद्रण की लागत 1.60 रु. प्रति प्रतियाँ है, पिछले महीने में 2000 प्रतियाँ मुद्रित की गयी थी लेकिन 5 रु. प्रत्येक में केवल 1500 प्रतियाँ ही बेची जा सकीं। विक्रय मूल्य पर 25% लाभ प्राप्त हुआ। पत्रिका से आय का एक अधिक/अतिरिक्त स्रोत है जो विज्ञापन है। पत्रिका में विज्ञापन से कितनी धनराशि प्राप्त हुई?
questions.solution:
"

Setting cost = Rs.2800

Miscellaneous = 0.80 Rs./copy. Total = 1600

Printing = 1.60 Rs./ copy, Total = 3200

CP = 2800 + 3200 + 1600 = Rs.7600

Sold = 1500 copies

SP = 1500 × 5 = 7500

25% on SP = 7500 × 1/4 = Rs.1875

Advertising income = 7600 + 1875 - 7500 = Rs.1975

"

यदि D 1 B 3 A 2 C 3 E 2 D, तो कितने व्यक्ति D से भारी हैं?
questions.solution:
P 1 Q means P is neither heavier nor equal to Q i.e P is lighter than Q (P<Q)

P 2 Q means P is neither lighter nor equal to Q i.e P is heavier than Q (P>Q)

P 3 Q means P is neither heavier nor lighter than Q i.e P is equal to Q (P = Q)

P 1 QP 2 QP 3 Q
P < QP > QP = Q

D 1 B 3 A 2 C 3 E 2 D means D < B = A > C = E > D

B, AC, ED
HeaviestLightest

Four persons are heavier than D.

questions.question:
A situation is given, followed by two conclusions I and II. Read the situation and both conclusions carefully and select the correct answer.

Situation:

Mr. Raj is diagnosed with cancer. A few years ago, he acquired health insurance policies, but because he struggled to make payments on time, the policies expired. At the moment, Mr Raj is not receiving any benefits from the health coverage and must pay for all of his medical expenses.

Conclusions:

I. Insurance coverage can only be obtained if the policies are not expired.

II. Having insurance is crucial in emergency situations.
questions.question_hi:

स्थिति:

श्री राज को कैंसर का पता चला है। कुछ साल पहले, उन्होंने स्वास्थ्य बीमा पॉलिसी ली थी, लेकिन समय पर भुगतान न कर पाने के कारण, पॉलिसी की अवधि समाप्त हो गई। फिलहाल, श्री राज को स्वास्थ्य बीमा से कोई लाभ नहीं मिल रहा है और उन्हें अपने सभी चिकित्सा खर्चों का भुगतान करना होगा।

निष्कर्ष:

I. बीमा कवरेज तभी प्राप्त किया जा सकता है जब पॉलिसी की अवधि समाप्त न हुई हो।

II. आपातकालीन स्थितियों में बीमा होना अत्यंत महत्वपूर्ण है।

options.label: A
options.text_hi: केवल II ही निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है

options.label: B
options.text: Both I and II can be concluded
options.text_hi: I और II दोनों निष्कर्ष निकाले जा सकते हैं

options.label: C
options.text_hi: केवल मैं ही निष्कर्ष निकाल सकता हूँ

options.label: D
options.text: Neither I nor II can be concluded
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है

questions.correct_text: Both I and II can be concluded
questions.solution:
It has been determined that Mr Raj has cancer. He acquired health insurance a few years ago, but the policies lapsed because he had difficulty paying the required payments on time. Mr Raj currently has to spend all of his medical costs out of pocket and does not receive any benefits from the health coverage.

Some or all of the costs would be paid by health insurance if Mr. Raj's policies didn't expire. Thus, having insurance is important. So, both I and II can be concluded.

questions.question:
In this question, a question is followed by two statements numbered (i) and (ii). You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements are sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and decide the appropriate answer.

Question: How is Dipak related to Rishabh?

(i) Shefali is the sister of Krish. Rishabh is the father-in-law of Shefali.

(ii) Jiya is the wife of Rishabh. Shefali is the wife of Dipak.
questions.question_hi:
इस प्रश्न में, एक प्रश्न के बाद (I) और (II) के रूप में क्रमांकित दो कथन दिए गए हैं। आपको यह निर्धारित करना है कि कथनों में दी गई जानकारी प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त हैं या नहीं। दोनों कथनों को पढ़ें और उचित उत्तर निर्धारित करें।

प्रश्न: दीपक, ऋषभ से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?

(i) शिफाली, क्रिश की बहन है। ऋषभ, शिफाली का ससुर है।

(ii) जिया, ऋषभ की पत्नी है। शिफाली, दीपक की पत्नी है।

options.label: A
options.text: (i) alone is sufficient while (ii) alone is not sufficient
options.text_hi: (i) अकेले पर्याप्त है जबकि (ii) अकेले पर्याप्त नहीं है

options.label: B
options.text_hi: (i) और (ii) दोनों एक साथ आवश्यक है

options.label: C
options.text: Either (i) alone or (ii) alone is sufficient
options.text_hi: या तो (i) अकेले या (ii) अकेले पर्याप्त है

options.label: D
options.text: (ii) alone is sufficient while (i) alone is not sufficient
options.text_hi: (ii) अकेले पर्याप्त है जबकि (i) अकेले पर्याप्त नहीं है

questions.solution:
Statement (i): Shefali is the sister of Krish. Rishabh is the father-in-law of Shefali.

There is no information about Dipak. So, statement (i) alone is not sufficient.

Statement (ii): Jiya is the wife of Rishabh. Shefali is the wife of Dipak.

As there is no relation between Dipak and Rishabh.

So, statement (ii) alone is not sufficient.

Combining statements (i) and (ii) -

Statement (i): Shefali is the sister of Krish. Rishabh is the father-in-law of Shefali.

Statement (ii): Jiya is the wife of Rishabh. Shefali is the wife of Dipak.

Dipak is the son of Rishabh.

Hence, Both (i) and (ii) together are needed.

questions.question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence:

The receptionist asked the visitor if he had an appointment with the managing director for the important meeting that was scheduled for that afternoon.

options.label: A
options.text: The receptionist said to the visitor, "Did you have an appointment with the managing director for the important meeting that is scheduled for this afternoon?"

options.label: B
options.text: The receptionist said to the visitor, "If you have an appointment with the managing director for the important meeting that is scheduled for this afternoon?"

options.label: C
options.text: The receptionist told to the visitor, "Do you have an appointment with the managing director for the important meeting that is scheduled for this afternoon?"

options.label: D
options.text: The receptionist said to the visitor, "Do you have an appointment with the managing director for the important meeting that is scheduled for this afternoon?"

questions.correct_text: The receptionist said to the visitor, "Do you have an appointment with the managing director for the important meeting that is scheduled for this afternoon?"
questions.solution:
In Direct speech, the verb is always placed before the subject, unlike in Indirect Speech. If there is a question whose answer can come as "Yes" or "No", we remove the inverted commas and add the conjunction "If" or "Whether" in the Indirect Speech and the verb/s "Is/are/am/was/were" before the subject, in Direct Speech.

For example:

Ravi asked me if she was studying. (Indirect Speech)

Ravi said to me, "Is she studying?" (Direct Speech)

The tense of the Indirect Speech is in the Simple Past. So, the tense in the Direct Speech will be in the Simple Present tense.

The following things in the sentence will change when changed from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:

'Asked' is changed to 'said to'.

'If he had' is changed to 'Do you have'.

'That was' is changed to 'that is'.

'That afternoon' is changed to 'this afternoon'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: The receptionist politely said to the visitor, "Do you have an appointment with the managing director for the important meeting that is scheduled for this afternoon?"

Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

options.label: A
options.text: She told me to please close the heavy wooden door very quietly before I finally leave the cluttered conference room after the long discussion.

options.label: B
options.text: She told me to please close the heavy wooden door very quietly before I had finally left the cluttered conference room after the long discussion.

options.label: C
options.text: She told me to please close the heavy wooden door very quietly before I have finally left the cluttered conference room after the long discussion.

options.label: D
options.text: She requested that I close the heavy wooden door very quietly before I finally left the cluttered conference room after the long discussion.

questions.correct_text: She requested that I close the heavy wooden door very quietly before I finally left the cluttered conference room after the long discussion.
questions.solution:
The task involves converting a sentence from direct speech to indirect (reported) speech.

Key Rules for Reported Speech (Indirect Speech) when converting direct speech to indirect speech:

Change pronouns: The second person (you) shifts based on the reporter's perspective. Here, it becomes "I" (listener).

Backshift tenses: "leave" shifts to "left".

"Said to me, 'Please close...'" changes to "requested that I close...".

Option (d) correctly applies all rules and preserves the original meaning without errors.

Hence, the correct answer is option (d).

Option (a) is in the active voice because "Financial markets" perform the action "appear."

Option (c) is active because "A farmer" performs the action "use."

Option (d) is active because "Financial experts" perform the action "emphasise."

Relative Clause: A relative clause is one that's connected to the main clause of the sentence by a word such as who, whom, which, that, or whose.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the passage and answer the questions:

Financial markets often appear intimidating because they contain specialised terms that describe different investment strategies and risks. However, many of these concepts can be understood through simple examples. Consider a trader who believes that the price of wheat will rise three months from now. Instead of purchasing wheat immediately, the trader enters into a derivative contract - an agreement whose value depends on the future price of an underlying asset. In simple terms, it is a promise-based deal linked to what might happen in the future.

Markets also depend heavily on liquidity, which refers to how easily an asset can be bought or sold without causing a significant change in its price. Cash is considered highly liquid because it can be used immediately, while certain rare assets may take longer to sell. High liquidity generally makes markets more efficient and attractive to investors.

Some investors seek to reduce risk through hedging. A farmer, for example, may use a derivative contract to lock in a future selling price for crops, protecting against unexpected price declines. In contrast, hedge funds often employ a wide range of sophisticated strategies to generate returns. These strategies may include short selling, where an investor borrows an asset and sells it with the expectation of buying it back later at a lower price.

Another commonly discussed concept is leverage. Leverage involves using borrowed money to increase the size of an investment. While this can magnify profits when prices move favourably, it can also amplify losses if the market moves in the opposite direction. For this reason, financial experts frequently emphasise that higher potential rewards are often accompanied by higher risks.

questions.question: Which sentence contains a relative clause?

options.label: B
options.text: "Cash is considered highly liquid because it can be used immediately."

options.label: C
options.text: "A derivative contract is an agreement whose value depends on the future price of an underlying asset."

options.label: D
options.text: "Leverage involves using borrowed money to increase the size of an investment."

questions.correct_text: "A derivative contract is an agreement whose value depends on the future price of an underlying asset."
questions.solution:
Among the given options, (c) is the correct answer because it contains the relative clause "whose value depends on the future price of an underlying asset." A relative clause usually begins with a relative pronoun such as who, whose, which, or that and provides additional information about a noun. Here, the clause describes the noun "agreement." Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

Option (a) is a simple declarative sentence without a relative clause.

Option (b) contains an adverbial clause beginning with "because," not a relative clause.

Option (d) contains a non-finite phrase but no relative clause.

questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

It is me whom is so sorry for putting you in this position.
questions.solution:
In the given sentence, 'it' is a dummy subject. So, the sentence requires a real subject. 'Me' is an objective pronoun. So, we cannot use it in place of a subject. Therefore, the underlined part of the sentence is grammatically incorrect. Option (a) is also incorrect. The relative pronoun 'whom' refers to the object of the sentence. It cannot be used with the subjective pronoun 'I'. So, option (b) is also eliminated. The relative pronoun 'who' refers to the subject of the sentence. Among the given options, option (c) is the correct choice.

Corrected sentence: It is I who am so sorry for putting you in this position.

Note:

Subjective Pronouns: The pronouns I, you, we, he, she, it, and they are known as subjective pronouns because they act as the subjects of verbs: We went to the party.

Objective Pronouns: The pronouns me, you, us, him, her, it, and them are called objective pronouns because they act as the objects of verbs and prepositions: Anjali drove us home.

Relative pronouns: A relative pronoun is used to connect a clause or phrase to a noun or pronoun. The clause modifies or describes the noun. The most common relative pronouns are who, whom, whose, which, and that. For example: She is the girl who received the award for bravery from our Home Minister.

questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

Inconsistency is the key factor for a person who fail time and again.
questions.solution:
In the phrase given in bold, the verb 'fail' corresponds to a plural noun, but 'a person' is a singular noun, and thus, the error in subject-verb agreement is introduced through the phrase. Among the given options, 'failed' in option (b) denotes the past tense, but the given sentence is in the present tense, so it cannot be used. In option (c), the continuous form of the verb (V4) 'failing' requires an auxiliary verb, and since the sentence does not have the auxiliary verb, it cannot be used and thus negated.

Option (a), 'who fails' is the only option in which the singular verb 'fails' is suggested and can replace the incorrect phrase in the sentence.

The correct sentence is: Inconsistency is the key factor for a person who fails time and again.

Hence, the correct answer is option (a).

Note:

V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).

Subject-Verb Agreement: Matching up singular or plural subjects with singular or plural forms of a verb is part of the process called agreement. This can be understood better by the examples given: - "She likes cooking." [singular subject and verb] -- "They like to cook vegetables." [plural subject and verb]

Auxiliary verb: A verb that gives grammatical information that is not given by the main verb of a sentence. It supports the main verb. Auxiliary verbs help to form the various tenses, moods, and voices of other verbs. The principal ones are be, do, and have. Example: She will sing a song tomorrow. Here, 'will' is the auxiliary verb that supports the main verb 'sing'.

questions.question:
Identify the error in the sentence.

The prosecutor was just presented some evidence files to the presiding judge.
questions.solution:
The segment "was just presented" is incorrect because "was" should be followed by a verb in its -ing form (present participle) to form a continuous tense. The phrase "was presenting" correctly forms the past continuous tense, which indicates an action that was in progress in the past.

However, the original sentence uses "was presented", which is a passive construction. For the sentence to remain passive, it would require the correct passive voice structure, such as adding "with," along with other necessary changes.

Thus, the grammatical error lies in the tense usage in segment (a), where "was" should be followed by "presenting" for consistency in verb usage in the active voice. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

The corrected sentence: The prosecutor was just presenting some evidence files to the presiding judge.

questions.question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

Each of the interview panelists were asked (1)/ to independently rate the candidates on a scale (2)/ from one to ten based on their qualifications, (3)/ experience, and overall professional demeanor. (4)

options.label: A
options.text: from one to ten based on their qualifications, (3)

options.label: B
options.text: to independently rate the candidates on a scale (2)

options.label: C
options.text: Each of the interview panelists were asked (1)

questions.correct_text: Each of the interview panelists were asked (1)
questions.solution:
The error in part (1) is in subject-verb agreement.

The subject of the sentence is the pronoun "Each." Pronouns like "Each," "Every," "Either," and "Neither" are always considered singular, even when followed by a prepositional phrase with a plural object (like "of the interview panelists"). Since the subject ("Each") is singular, the verb must also be singular.

The verb used in the sentence is "were," which is plural. The correct singular form is "was."

The corrected sentence should read: "Each of the interview panelists was asked to independently rate the candidates on a scale from one to ten based on their qualifications, experience, and overall professional demeanor."

Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.

Note: Subject-Verb Agreement: Matching up singular or plural subjects with singular or plural forms of a verb is part of the process called agreement. This can be understood better by the examples given: "She likes cooking." [singular subject and verb] -- "They like to cook vegetables." [plural subject and verb]

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Nevertheless, Carlton was always ______ by his friends.
questions.solution:
The blank requires a verb in the past participle form to be used in the Passive voice sentence. Accordingly, only option (d), 'motivated' is a verb in past participle form.

The complete sentence is: Nevertheless, Carlton was always motivated by his friends.

Hence, the correct answer is option (d).

Option A is in the first verb form.

Option B is in the present perfect tense and active voice.

Option C is in the -ing verb form.

Note:

"Participle: A word formed from a verb (e.g. going, gone, being, been) and used as an adjective (e.g. working woman, burnt toast) or a noun (e.g. good breeding). In English, participles are also used to make compound verb forms (e.g. is going, has been). Consider the sentences given below:

Dancing at the party, the women fell on the ground.

Encouraged by her parents, Rita went on to pursue her passion.

The highlighted word in the first sentence is of the form Verb + ing and is used as a present participle. It is used to denote an action that is going on or incomplete or imperfect.

The highlighted word in the second sentence is of the form verb + ed. It is used as a past participle. It denotes the completed action or state of the thing spoken of.

A past participle ends with the following: -ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n.

One should take great care and never get confused between a gerund and a present participle. They use the same forms but perform different functions: a gerund is a verbal noun, while a present participle is a verbal adjective."

"Voice of a sentence - Depending upon the emphasis we want to lay we use a particular voice in a particular context. We use active voice to lay emphasis on the doer of the action while we use passive voice to lay emphasis on the receiver of the action.

Example:

Active- Radha will work. (emphasis on Radha)

Passive- Work will be done by Radha. (emphasis on Work)"

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word 'striking'.
questions.solution:
"Striking" often refers to something that stands out or is noteworthy due to its exceptional qualities or characteristics. "Remarkable" denotes something worthy of attention or comment due to its exceptional nature or striking features. So, the two words can be used as synonyms of each other. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

Mundane- something commonplace, or lacking in distinctive qualities. It is the antonym of 'striking'.

'Ordinary' and 'Average' are the antonyms of the given word.
questions.passage:
Directions : Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow:

Music has a remarkable ability to reach across barriers, evoking emotions, memories, and even physical responses. For individuals living with dementia, a condition characterized by cognitive decline and memory loss, music holds particular significance. The effects of music on dementia patients are profound, often transcending the limitations imposed by the disease. One of the most striking impacts of music on dementia patients is its ability to evoke memories and emotions from the past. Even for individuals with advanced dementia who may struggle to recall recent events or recognize loved ones, familiar songs can trigger memories from earlier stages of their lives. This phenomenon is known as "music-evoked autobiographical memories" and can transport patients back in time, eliciting a sense of comfort, joy, or nostalgia. Music has been shown to reduce agitation, anxiety, and depression in dementia patients. Listening to soothing melodies or participating in music therapy sessions can promote relaxation and a sense of well-being.

Music engages various regions of the brain associated with emotion and reward, releasing neurotransmitters like dopamine, which contribute to feelings of pleasure and contentment. As a result, dementia patients often exhibit improved mood and reduced behavioural symptoms when exposed to music regularly. In addition to its psychological benefits, music can also have a positive impact on cognitive function in individuals with dementia. Participating in musical activities, such as singing, playing instruments, or rhythmic exercises, stimulates neural pathways and promotes neuroplasticity. Studies have shown that music therapy interventions can enhance cognitive skills such as attention, memory, and executive function in dementia patients, contributing to overall cognitive preservation and quality of life. Music, in fact, serves as a means of communication and connection for dementia patients, fostering social interaction and engagement. Group music therapy sessions provide opportunities for individuals to interact with others, share experiences, and express themselves through music when verbal communication becomes challenging. This social engagement is vital for maintaining a sense of identity and connectedness, counteracting the social isolation often experienced by dementia patients.

Studies have shown that music therapy interventions can enhance cognitive skills such as attention, memory, and executive function in dementia patients, contributing to overall cognitive preservation and quality of life. Music, in fact, serves as a means of communication and connection for dementia patients, fostering social interaction and engagement. Group music therapy sessions provide opportunities for individuals to interact with others, share experiences, and express themselves through music when verbal communication becomes challenging. This social engagement is vital for maintaining a sense of identity and connectedness, counteracting the social isolation often experienced by dementia patients.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

The project manager said, "My team is currently implementing a new software solution to streamline our entire workflow process."

options.label: A
options.text: The project manager said that his team was currently implementing a new software solution to streamline their entire workflow process.

options.label: B
options.text: The project manager said that my team is currently implementing a new software solution to streamline our entire workflow process.

options.label: C
options.text: The project manager said that his team had been currently implementing a new software solution to streamline their entire workflow process.

options.label: D
options.text: The project manager said that his team implemented a new software solution to streamline their entire workflow process.

questions.correct_text: The project manager said that his team was currently implementing a new software solution to streamline their entire workflow process.
questions.solution:
The sentence in the Direct Speech is in Present Continuous Tense. Therefore, the sentence in the Indirect Speech should be in Past Continuous Tense.

Present Continuous (Subject + is/am/are + V1 + ing + Object) should be converted into Past Continuous (Subject + was/were + V1 + ing + Object).

For example:

He said, "I am checking the assignment." (Direct Speech)

He said that he was checking the assignment. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

• "My" changes to "his".

• "is currently implementing" changes to "was currently implementing".

• "our" changes to "their".

Therefore, the correct answer is: "The project manager said that his team was currently implementing a new software solution to streamline their entire workflow process."

Hence, option (a) is correct.

Note: V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

Let helpless animals not be treated with cruelty by anyone in the name of entertainment or sport.

options.label: A
options.text: You should not treat helpless animals with cruelty in the name of entertainment or sport.

options.label: B
options.text: No one will treat helpless animals with cruelty in the name of entertainment or sport.

options.label: C
options.text: Do not treat helpless animals with cruelty in the name of entertainment or sport.

options.label: D
options.text: Let us not be treating helpless animals with cruelty in the name of entertainment or sport.

questions.correct_text: Do not treat helpless animals with cruelty in the name of entertainment or sport.
questions.solution:
The given sentence is a negative imperative sentence in the passive voice. An imperative sentence expresses a command, order, or advice.

The passive format for a negative imperative is: Let + Object + not + be + V3.

The active format for a negative imperative is: Do not + V1 + Object.

The agent ('by anyone') is generally understood and is omitted in the active imperative form. Option (a) changes the sentence from a command to a suggestion ('should').

For example:

Let the door not be shut. (Passive)

Do not shut the door. (Active)

The options except (c) don't follow the correct grammatical format for an active negative imperative sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (c): Do not treat helpless animals with cruelty in the name of entertainment or sport.

Note: V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).

questions.question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence:

The witness stated that the suspect had been loitering near the crime scene on the evening when the unfortunate incident took place the previous week.

options.label: A
options.text: The witness said, "The suspect loitered near the crime scene on the evening when the unfortunate incident took place last week."

options.label: B
options.text: The witness said, "The suspect was loitering near the crime scene on the evening when the unfortunate incident took place last week."

options.label: C
options.text: The witness said, "The suspect had been loitering near the crime scene on the evening when the unfortunate incident took place last week."

options.label: D
options.text: The witness said, "The suspect is loitering near the crime scene on the evening when the unfortunate incident took place the previous week."

questions.correct_text: The witness said, "The suspect was loitering near the crime scene on the evening when the unfortunate incident took place last week."
questions.solution:
The sentence in the Indirect Speech is in Past Perfect Continuous Tense. There are two cases when the Indirect Speech is in the Past Perfect Continuous Tense.

• Past Perfect Continuous changes to Past Continuous

• Past Perfect Continuous changes to Present Perfect Continuous

Case 1 is applicable to this question.

Case 1: Past Perfect Continuous (Subject + had + been + V1 + ing + Object) will be converted into Past Continuous (Subject + was/were + V1 + ing + Object).

For example:

He said that he had been watching television the previous night. (Indirect Speech)

He said, "I was watching television last night" (Direct Speech)

The following things in the sentence will change when changed from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:

'Stated' is changed into 'said'.

'Had been loitering' is changed into 'was loitering'.

'The previous week' is changed into 'last week'.

Also, "that" is removed, and inverted commas ("..") are placed in direct speech.

Therefore, the correct answer is: The witness said, "The suspect was loitering near the crime scene on the evening when the unfortunate incident took place last week."

Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

Note: V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

All the necessary arrangements for the international conference have been made by the organizing committee with great attention.

options.label: A
options.text: The organizing committee made all the necessary arrangements for the international conference with great attention.

options.label: B
options.text: The organizing committee was making all the necessary arrangements for the international conference with great attention.

options.label: C

options.label: D
options.text: The organizing committee had made all the necessary arrangements for the international conference with great attention.

questions.correct_text: The organizing committee has made all the necessary arrangements for the international conference with great attention.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" verb ['been'] and the preposition 'by' is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

The Passive voice in this question is in Present Perfect tense. Thus, the Active voice will also be in the Present Perfect.

In Passive voice, the format is: Object of the Active voice (Subjective case) + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject of the Active voice (Objective case).

Thus, the format of the Active voice is: Subject + has/have + V3 + Object.

For example:

A new horse has been bought by Arya. (Passive Voice)

Arya has bought a new horse. (Active Voice)

The options except (c) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (c): The organizing committee has made all the necessary arrangements for the international conference with great attention.

Note: V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).

Option (a) Plate is incorrect because plate is pronounced /pleɪt/, which differs from the pronunciation of plait.

Option (c) Pleat is incorrect because pleat is pronounced /pliːt/ and refers to a fold in fabric.

Option (d) Plight is incorrect because plight is pronounced /plaɪt/ and means a difficult or unfortunate situation.

Hence, Option (b) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Mesopotamian societies made significant contributions to law, literature, and mathematics, with the Code of Hammurabi being one of the earliest written legal codes that influenced legal systems for centuries to come.

B. Located between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers, this region saw the rise of powerful city-states such as Uruk and Babylon, each contributing to the cultural and technological advancements of the time.

C. Despite its eventual decline, the legacy of Mesopotamia continues to influence modern civilization, with many of its innovations serving as the foundation for contemporary societal structures and governance.

D. The ancient civilization of Mesopotamia, often referred to as the "cradle of civilization," was home to some of the earliest known human societies, where writing, agriculture, and urbanization first began to flourish.
questions.solution:
• Sentence D is the first to come in the final order because it is the only sentence that introduces the topic that the sentences discuss.

• It has to be followed by B which mentions the location of the Mesopotamian civilization.

• Sentence A continues the discussion by stating the significant contributions that the civilisation has given to the world, and sentence C concludes the discussion by stating the legacy that the Mesopotamian civilization had created. So, the final order is DBAC.

Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

questions.question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

The concept of synchronicity challenges our conventional understanding of causality. P. He defined it as the simultaneous occurrence of events which appear meaningfully related but have no discernible causal connection. Q. For example, thinking of a long-lost friend and then unexpectedly receiving a call from them moments later would be such an event. R. Unlike simple coincidence, which is random, a synchronistic event is perceived by the individual as having a profound, personal meaning. S. The term was first introduced by Swiss psychoanalyst Carl Jung to explain these strange yet impactful experiences. 6) It suggests a hidden order in the universe, where the inner world of the psyche and the outer world of reality are intertwined.
questions.solution:
The passage explains the psychological concept of synchronicity.

1 introduces the core idea: synchronicity challenging causality.

S logically follows by providing the origin of the concept, attributing the term to Carl Jung.

P builds directly on S by providing Jung's specific definition of the term he introduced.

Q offers a concrete example to illustrate the abstract definition given in P, making the concept easier to understand.

R provides a crucial distinction, clarifying how a "synchronistic event" (like the one in Q) differs from a mere coincidence.

6 serves as a conclusion, summarizing the deeper philosophical implication of the concept.

Thus, the correct and logical sequence is SPQR.

Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements and choose the correct statement(s) from the following:

1) The UDAN scheme has completed five years since its implementation in 2017.

2) It is the flagship scheme of the Ministry of Science and Technology.

3) The Airports Authority of India is the implementing agency of this scheme.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें और निम्नलिखित में से सही कथन चुनें:

1) UDAN योजना ने 2017 में अपने कार्यान्वयन के बाद से पांच साल पूरे कर लिए हैं।

2) यह विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी मंत्रालय की प्रमुख योजना है।

3) भारतीय विमानपत्तन प्राधिकरण इस योजना की कार्यान्वयन एजेंसी है।
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 3 are correct, while statement 2 is incorrect. The UDAN scheme was implemented starting in 2017 and is implemented by the Airports Authority of India. However, it falls under the Ministry of Civil Aviation, not the Ministry of Science and Technology.

Explanation of Statements:

Statement 1 is correct. The UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik) scheme was launched in late 2016, and the first flight under the scheme took off in April 2017. In 2022, the scheme successfully completed five years of operation, having significantly enhanced regional air connectivity across the country.

Statement 2 is incorrect. The UDAN scheme is a Regional Connectivity Scheme (RCS) that falls under the purview of the Ministry of Civil Aviation, not the Ministry of Science and Technology. Its focus is on developing aviation infrastructure and making air travel affordable.

Statement 3 is correct. The Airports Authority of India (AAI) has been designated as the implementing agency for the UDAN scheme. AAI is responsible for managing the bidding process for airlines, providing Viability Gap Funding (VGF), and developing the necessary infrastructure at unserved and underserved airports.

Further insights:

Objective: The primary objective of UDAN is to "let the common citizen of the country fly" by making air travel affordable and widespread, connecting Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities.

Mechanism: The scheme works by providing subsidies to airlines to keep fares on regional routes affordable. A key feature is the capping of airfares for a certain number of seats on UDAN flights.

Funding: The scheme is supported by a Viability Gap Funding (VGF) mechanism, which is partly financed by a levy on flights operating on major trunk routes.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about decomposition process.

I. The breakdown of detritus into smaller particles is called fragmentation.

II. Degradation of detritus into simpler inorganic substances is called as catabolism.

III. In decomposition process first fragmentation occurs, followed by catabolism.

Which among the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
अपघटन प्रक्रिया के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. अपरद का छोटे कणों में टूटना विखंडन कहलाता है।

II. अपरद का सरल अकार्बनिक पदार्थों में विघटन अपचय कहलाता है।

III. अपघटन प्रक्रिया में पहले विखंडन होता है, उसके बाद अपचय होता है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement I is correct: Detritivores such as earthworm, break down detritus into smaller particles. This process is called fragmentation. Due to this process, the surface area of detritus particles is greatly increased.

Statement II is correct: Bacterial and fungal enzymes degrade detritus into simpler inorganic substances. This process is called catabolism.

Added to this process, Leaching also takes place. Here water percolating through soil removes soluble substances, such as sugars and several other nutrients, from the fragmented detritus due to leaching action.

Statement III is incorrect: All the above steps in decomposition operate simultaneously on the detritus.

Source: XIIth Biology, NCERT

Read the following statements marked as Reason and Assertion and choose the correct option.

Assertion (A): In cricket, a batsman given out "leg before wicket" (LBW) can never be dismissed if the ball pitches outside the line of the leg stump, regardless of where the ball strikes the batsman's body or where it would have gone on to hit the stumps.

Reason (R): The LBW law was designed primarily to prevent batsmen from using their pads as a second bat to block deliveries that would otherwise have hit the wicket.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को कारण और दावा के रूप में पढ़ें और सही विकल्प चुनें।

दावा (A): क्रिकेट में, एक बल्लेबाज जिसे "लेग बिफोर विकेट" (LBW) आउट दिया जाता है, कभी भी तब नहीं-dismiss किया जा सकता जब गेंद लेग स्टंप की लाइन के बाहर पिच हो, चाहे गेंद बल्लेबाज के शरीर के किस हिस्से से टकराए या वह स्टंप को हिट करने के लिए कहाँ जाती।

कारण (R): LBW कानून मुख्य रूप से इस लिए बनाया गया था ताकि बल्लेबाज अपने पैड्स का उपयोग दूसरे बल्ले के रूप में न कर सकें और ऐसी गेंदों को ब्लॉक न कर सकें जो अन्यथा विकेट को हिट करतीं।

options.label: A
options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R सही हैं, और R, A की सही व्याख्या है

options.label: B
options.text: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R सही हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है

options.label: C
options.text: A is true, but R is false
options.text_hi: A सही है, लेकिन R गलत है

options.label: D
options.text: A is false, but R is true
options.text_hi: A गलत है, लेकिन R सही है

questions.correct_text: A is false, but R is true
questions.solution:
Assertion (A) - False

The claim in A is an oversimplification that is factually incorrect. While it is true that, under the LBW law, a ball pitching outside the leg stump generally cannot result in an LBW dismissal if the batsman is offering a shot, there is a crucial exception: if the batsman makes no attempt to play the ball (i.e., does not offer a shot), they CAN be given out LBW even if the ball pitches outside the leg stump - provided the ball would have gone on to hit the stumps and the impact occurred in line with the stumps (or outside off-stump in this no-shot scenario). This rule was specifically introduced to prevent batsmen from simply padding away deliveries pitching on or around leg stump without attempting a shot. Therefore, the absolute claim that LBW "can never" apply in such cases is false.

Reason (R) - True

The historical and functional rationale behind the LBW law is correctly stated in R. Before LBW was codified, batsmen could deliberately use their legs and pads to block balls that would have struck the wicket, effectively using their body as an additional, illegal "bat" with no risk of dismissal. The LBW law was introduced (and has been progressively refined, including the no-shot clause mentioned above) specifically to close this loophole and ensure that a batsman cannot avoid dismissal purely by interposing their body in front of the stumps. This remains the foundational principle behind the rule, even as its precise technical conditions have evolved over time.

questions.question:
Identify the correct statement.

1) The Narmada and the Tapi flow through rift valleys and drain into the Arabian Sea.

2) Because of their steep gradients and high velocity, they form large deltas on the west coast.
questions.question_hi:
सही कथन की पहचान कीजिए।

1) नर्मदा और तापी नदियाँ दरार घाटियों से होकर बहती हैं और अरब सागर में गिरती हैं।

2) अपनी तीव्र ढलान और उच्च वेग के कारण, वे पश्चिमी तट पर बड़े डेल्टा बनाती हैं।
questions.solution:
Narmada and Tapi indeed flow westward in rift valleys into the Arabian Sea.

They do not form large deltas; instead, estuaries are common on the west coast due to narrow shelf and energetic conditions.

Further Insights:

- The Narmada Rift Valley separates the Vindhya and Satpura ranges.

- Major projects: Sardar Sarovar (Narmada), Ukai (Tapi).

- The west‑flowing Mahi and Sabarmati also drain into the Arabian Sea.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the recent development missions launched for the North Eastern Region:

1. Under the newly launched Bamboo Projects, two dedicated units for promoting Engineered Bamboo Products will be set up at Karbi Anglong in Assam and Mokokchung in Nagaland.

2. The 'Coffees of Nagaland' mission has identified Tuophema village for Robusta coffee cultivation and Ghotovi village for Arabica coffee cultivation to build a competitive coffee ecosystem.

3. The 'Arunachal Kiwi' mission is a cluster-based initiative backed by a Rs. 167-crore outlay, aiming to capitalize on the state's status as the producer of over 50 percent of India's kiwi.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
उत्तर पूर्वी क्षेत्र के लिए हाल ही में शुरू किए गए विकास मिशनों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. नव-प्रारंभित बांस परियोजनाओं के तहत, असम के कार्बी आंगलोंग और नागालैंड के मोकोकचुंग में इंजीनियर्ड बांस उत्पादों को बढ़ावा देने के लिए दो समर्पित इकाइयां स्थापित की जाएंगी।

2. 'नागालैंड की कॉफी' मिशन ने प्रतिस्पर्धी कॉफी पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र बनाने के लिए रोबस्टा कॉफी की खेती के लिए तुओफेमा गांव और अरेबिका कॉफी की खेती के लिए घोतोवी गांव को चुना है।

3. 'अरुणाचल कीवी' मिशन एक क्लस्टर-आधारित पहल है, जिसे 167 करोड़ रुपये के बजट द्वारा समर्थित किया गया है, जिसका उद्देश्य राज्य की भारत के 50 प्रतिशत से अधिक कीवी उत्पादनकर्ता के रूप में स्थिति का लाभ उठाना है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: The Union Minister launched two Bamboo Projects where two units will specifically come up at Karbi Anglong (Assam) and Mokokchung (Nagaland) to promote Engineered Bamboo Products.

Statement 2 is incorrect: The statement has reversed the coffee varieties for the pilot clusters. The mission actually designates Tuophema village (Kohima district) for Arabica coffee and Ghotovi village (Niuland district) for Robusta coffee, not the other way around.

Statement 3 is correct: The 'Arunachal Kiwi' mission has a planned outlay of around Rs. 167 crore to transform the value chain in Arunachal Pradesh, which currently dominates the sector by contributing more than 50 percent (over 7,050 metric tonnes) of India's annual kiwi production.

Further insights:

1. Bamboo Projects (Assam & Nagaland)

Financial Outlay: Rs. 82.5 crore.

Core Goal: Elevate the Northeast from a frontier region into an economic frontrunner by modernizing traditional setups into commercial ecosystems.

Key infrastructure:

A traditional bamboo artisans cluster to train over 4,400 youth.

Two specialized units for Engineered Bamboo Products located at Karbi Anglong (Assam) and Mokokchung (Nagaland).

Market Access: The North East Cane and Bamboo Development Council signed three MoUs with Amazon, Flipkart, and All Time Plastics to boost commercial trade and partner networking.

2. 'Coffees of Nagaland' Mission

Financial Outlay: Rs. 175 crore.

Core Goal: Transform Nagaland into a premium specialty coffee destination globally. The cluster-based value chain development integrates plantations, post-harvest processing, branding, agri-tourism, and exports.

Pilot Clusters:

Tuophema Village (Kohima District): Dedicated to Arabica coffee.

Ghotovi Village (Niuland District): Dedicated to Robusta coffee.

3. 'Arunachal Kiwi' Mission

Financial Outlay: Around Rs. 167 crore.

Core Goal: Establish Arunachal Pradesh as India's premium organic kiwi hub, ensuring local farmers receive better market prices to compete effectively against expensive imports.

Production Footprint: Arunachal Pradesh currently dominates domestic supply, contributing over 50% of India's total kiwi production (exceeding 7,050 metric tonnes annually).

Infrastructure Strategy: A cluster-based development model that implements more than 30 targeted interventions across six major post-harvest management hubs: Ziro Valley, Dirang, Kalaktang, Shi Yomi, and Dibang Valley.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Pardoning power of President.

I. The exercise of power by the President is not subject to judicial review in any case.

II. The President is not bound to give reasons for his order.

III. The power is to be exercised by the President as a discretionary power.

Select the CORRECT statements using the below codes.
questions.question_hi:
राष्ट्रपति की क्षमादान शक्ति के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. राष्ट्रपति द्वारा शक्ति का प्रयोग किसी भी मामले में न्यायिक समीक्षा के अधीन नहीं है।

II. राष्ट्रपति अपने आदेश के लिए कारण बताने के लिए बाध्य नहीं है।

III. राष्ट्रपति द्वारा इस शक्ति का प्रयोग विवेकाधीन शक्ति के रूप में किया जाना है।

नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके सही कथनों का चयन करें।
questions.solution:
Only statement II is correct.

The Supreme Court examined the pardoning power of the President under different cases and laid down the following principles:

1. The petitioner for mercy has no right to an oral hearing by the President.

2. The President can examine the evidence afresh and take a view different from the view taken by the court.

3. The power is to be exercised by the President on the advice of the union cabinet. So, statement III is NOT correct.

4. The President is not bound to give reasons for his order.

5. The President can afford relief not only from a sentence that he regards as unduly harsh but also from an evident mistake.

6. There is no need for the Supreme Court to lay down specific guidelines for the exercise of power by the President.

7. The exercise of power by the President is not subject to judicial review except where the presidential decision is arbitrary, irrational, mala fide or discriminatory. So, statement I is correct.

8. Where the earlier petition for mercy has been rejected by the President, stay cannot be obtained by filing another petition.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is correct about Earth?

(a) The tilt of Earth's axis is 66.5 degrees.

(b) Earth revolves around the sun from east to west.

(c) Equinoxes are the days when night & days are equal on Earth.

Choose from the below options
questions.question_hi:
पृथ्वी के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही है?

(A) पृथ्वी की धुरी का झुकाव 66.5 डिग्री है।

(B) पृथ्वी सूर्य के चारों ओर पूर्व से पश्चिम की ओर चक्कर लगाती है।

(c) विषुव (Equinoxes) वे दिन होते हैं जब पृथ्वी पर रात और दिन बराबर होते हैं।

नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही का चयन कीजिए
questions.solution:
The Earth's axis is inclined at an angle of 66.5 degrees to the ecliptic plane in which it revolves around the Sun.

Earth revolves around the sun in a direction from west to east in 365.25 days. It takes 24 hours to complete a rotation.

Equinoxes are the days when night & days are equal on Earth.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a feature of perfect market?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी पूर्ण बाज़ार की विशेषता नहीं है?

options.label: B
options.text_hi: फर्म कीमत स्वीकार करने वाली कंपनी है

questions.solution:
Perfect Competition is a market structure in which there is a large number of buyers and sellers who transact homogeneous or similar goods at a price fixed by the market or industry.

Features of perfect competition: -

· Very large number of buyers and sellers

· Homogeneous product

· Firm is a price taker

· Free entry and exit

· Perfect mobility

· No selling costs

· Shape of demand curve

Single seller is a feature of monopoly market structure.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the PM KUSUM Scheme:

i. It aims to promote the use of solar energy among farmers by providing financial assistance for solar pumps.

ii. The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE).

iii. Under this scheme, only large-scale commercial farmers are eligible for the subsidy component.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
पीएम कुसुम योजना के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i. इसका उद्देश्य सौर पंपों के लिए वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करके किसानों के बीच सौर ऊर्जा के उपयोग को बढ़ावा देना है।

ii. यह योजना नवीन और नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा मंत्रालय (एमएनआरई) द्वारा कार्यान्वित की जाती है।

iii. इस योजना के तहत, केवल बड़े पैमाने पर वाणिज्यिक किसान ही सब्सिडी घटक के लिए पात्र हैं।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements i and ii are correct descriptions of the PM KUSUM scheme's objectives and implementation. Statement iii is incorrect because the scheme is designed to be inclusive, benefiting all categories of farmers, not just large-scale commercial ones.

Explanation of Statements:

Statement i is correct. The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM KUSUM) scheme's primary objective is to enhance farmers' income, provide a reliable source of water, and de-dieselise the agriculture sector. It achieves this by providing financial support for the installation of standalone solar-powered agricultural pumps and the solarization of existing grid-connected agricultural pumps.

Statement ii is correct. The PM KUSUM scheme is a flagship initiative of the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE), Government of India. The MNRE is the nodal agency responsible for the overall policy framework, coordination, and implementation of the scheme across the country through state-level agencies.

Statement iii is incorrect. The scheme is not restricted to large-scale commercial farmers. It is open to individual farmers, groups of farmers, farmer producer organisations (FPOs), cooperatives, and panchayats. The scheme's aim is broad-based rural development and energy security, with a particular focus on benefiting small and marginal farmers as well.

Further insights:

The PM KUSUM scheme has three main components:

Component-A: Setting up of 10,000 MW of decentralized grid-connected renewable energy power plants of 500 KW to 2 MW on barren/fallow land.

Component-B: Installation of 20 lakh standalone solar-powered agriculture pumps.

Component-C: Solarization of 15 lakh existing grid-connected agriculture pumps.

The scheme provides a dual benefit to farmers: it reduces their dependence on costly diesel for irrigation and provides them with an opportunity to earn additional income by selling surplus solar power to the electricity distribution companies (DISCOMs).

questions.question:
Evaluate the statements about literacy in Census 2011.

Statement 1. Census 2011 treats a person as literate if they can read and write with understanding in any language, age 7 and above. India's literacy rate crossed 74% in 2011.

Statement 2. Female literacy rose faster than male literacy from 2001 to 2011, yet female literacy in 2011 still stayed under 70% nationally.
questions.question_hi:
जनगणना 2011 में साक्षरता संबंधी कथनों का मूल्यांकन कीजिए।

कथन 1. जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, 7 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु का कोई व्यक्ति किसी भी भाषा में समझ के साथ पढ़ और लिख सकने वाला साक्षर माना जाता है। 2011 में भारत की साक्षरता दर 74% से अधिक हो गई थी।

कथन 2. 2001 से 2011 तक महिला साक्षरता में पुरुष साक्षरता की तुलना में अधिक तेजी से वृद्धि हुई, फिर भी 2011 में राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर महिला साक्षरता 70% से कम रही।
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Literacy definition is 7+ years with reading/writing understanding; the 2011 rate was about 74.04%.

Statement 2 is correct: Female literacy gained more than males in the decade, but was about 65.46% - below 70%.

So, both are correct.

Further Insights:

- Kerala had the highest literacy (2011): ~93.9%; Bihar among the lowest.

- Male literacy (2011): ~82.1%; female literacy: ~65.5%.

- Registrar General & Census Commissioner of India conducts the Census under the Census Act, 1948.

- 2011 Census: total population ~121.09 crore; density 382 persons/km^2.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Insulin.

I. Insulin hormone is a produced by the pancreas.

II. If the sugar levels in blood fall, insulin production in body rises.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
इंसुलिन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. इंसुलिन हार्मोन अग्न्याशय द्वारा निर्मित होता है।

II. यदि रक्त में शर्करा का स्तर गिरता है, तो शरीर में इंसुलिन का उत्पादन बढ़ जाता है।

उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Insulin is a hormone which is produced by the pancreas and helps in regulating blood sugar levels.

It is important that hormones should be secreted in precise quantities. The timing and amount of hormone released are regulated by feedback mechanisms. For example, if the sugar levels in the blood rise, they are detected by the cells of the pancreas which respond by producing more insulin. As the blood sugar level falls, insulin production is reduced. Hence, statement II is incorrect.

If it is not secreted in proper amounts, the sugar level in the blood rises causing many harmful effects.

Source: NCERT 10th

questions.question:
Which of the following statement is/are correct?

Statement I: MOM succeeded in placing a probe into Martian orbit on India's first attempt.

Statement II: It was launched using the GSLV Mk III heavy-lift launcher.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

कथन 1: भारत के पहले ही प्रयास में मंगल ग्रह की कक्षा में एक प्रोब स्थापित करने में मंगल ग्रह मिशन सफल रहा।

कथन 2: इसे GSLV Mk III हेवी-लिफ्ट लॉन्चर का उपयोग करके लॉन्च किया गया था।

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो मैं और न ही दूसरा

questions.solution:
MOM entered Mars orbit on 24 September 2014 on India's first attempt.

It was launched by PSLV-XL (C25), not GSLV Mk III.

Further Insights:

- Approximate mission cost: ~Rs 450 crore.

- Scientific payloads included MCC, MSM, TIS, MENCA, and LAP.

- First Asian mission to reach Mars orbit on maiden attempt.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about interactions among species.

I. Predators help in maintaining species diversity in a community.

II. Competition occurs only when there are limited resources.

III. Parasites that feed on the external surface of the host organism are called ectoparasites.

Which among the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
प्रजातियों के बीच अंतःक्रियाओं के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. शिकारी एक समुदाय में प्रजातियों की विविधता को बनाए रखने में मदद करते हैं।

II. प्रतिस्पर्धा केवल तब होती है जब संसाधन सीमित होते हैं।

III. परजीवी जो मेजबान जीव की बाहरी सतह पर भोजन करते हैं उन्हें बाह्यपरजीवी कहा जाता है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement I is correct: Predators help in maintaining species diversity in a community, by reducing the intensity of competition among competing prey species.

For instance: In the rocky intertidal communities of the American Pacific Coast the starfish Pisaster is an important predator. In a field experiment, when all the starfish were removed from an enclosed intertidal area, more than 10 species of invertebrates became extinct within a year, because of interspecies competition.

Statement II is incorrect: Resources need not be limiting for competition to occur; in interference competition, the feeding efficiency of one species might be reduced due to the interfering and inhibitory presence of the other species, even if resources (food and space) are abundant.

Statement III is correct: Parasites that feed on the external surface of the host organism are called ectoparasites, and parasites that live inside the host body at different sites (liver, kidney, lungs, red blood cells, etc.) are called endoparasites.

questions.question:
Identify the true statement(s).

a. Transition elements are found in Groups 3 to 12 of the modern periodic table.

b. These elements are characterized by the filling of f-orbitals.
questions.question_hi:
सही कथन पहचानें।

a. संक्रमण तत्व आधुनिक आवर्त सारणी के समूह 3 से 12 में पाए जाते हैं।

b. इन तत्वों की विशेषता f-ऑर्बिटल्स का भरा होना है।

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो a और न ही b

questions.solution:
Statement a is correct, but statement b is incorrect. Transition elements are located in the d-block (Groups 3-12) and are characterized by the filling of d-orbitals, not f-orbitals. The elements filling f-orbitals are known as inner transition elements. Therefore, only the first statement is correct.

Explanation of Statements:

Statement a is correct. By definition, the transition elements (or transition metals) are the elements that occupy the d-block of the modern periodic table. This block spans from Group 3 to Group 12.

Statement b is incorrect. The defining characteristic of transition elements is the progressive filling of the electron d-orbitals of an inner shell (specifically, the (n-1)d subshell, where 'n' is the principal quantum number of the outermost shell). Elements that are characterized by the filling of f-orbitals are called the inner transition elements, which consist of the lanthanide and actinide series.

Further insights:

Transition Elements (d-block): These elements are known for having several characteristic properties, including variable oxidation states, formation of colored ions in solution, and strong catalytic activity. These properties are due to the presence of an incompletely filled d-subshell.

Inner Transition Elements (f-block): These are the lanthanides (filling the 4f subshell) and actinides (filling the 5f subshell). They are typically placed below the main body of the periodic table for a more compact layout.

II. It is similar to T-Bills but is issued for maturities more than 365 days.

नकदी प्रबंधन बिल (सीएमबी) के बारे में निम्नलिखित पर विचार करें:

I. यह भारत सरकार के बजट घाटे को पूरा करने के लिए जारी किया जाता है।

II. यह टी-बिल के समान है, लेकिन 365 दिनों से अधिक की परिपक्वता के लिए जारी किया जाता है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
In 2010, Government of India, in consultation with RBI introduced a new short-term instrument, known as Cash Management Bills (CMBs), to meet the temporary mismatches in the cash flow of the Government of India.

The CMBs have the generic character of T-bills but are issued for maturities less than 91 days.

The purpose of the mechanism is to enable the government to get short term money. Another similar method for the government to get short term money is Ways and Means Advances (WMA). Hence, both the statements are incorrect.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Expenditure method in national income accounting.

I. It includes the expenditure incurred by Government, Household consumption and net exports only.

II. The government expenditure includes the transfer payments made to the public such as pensions, scholarship etc.

Which of the following is/ are correct?
questions.question_hi:
राष्ट्रीय आय लेखांकन में व्यय विधि के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. इसमें केवल सरकार, घरेलू उपभोग और शुद्ध निर्यात द्वारा किए गए व्यय शामिल हैं।

II. सरकारी व्यय में जनता को किए गए हस्तांतरण भुगतान जैसे पेंशन, छात्रवृत्ति आदि शामिल हैं।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही है / हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Expenditure method calculates the National Income from the demand side of the economy. It is the sum of aggregate final household consumption, investment, government expenditure and net exports in the economy. Hence, statement 1 is incorrect. It doesn't include the pension, scholarship payments made to the public. These are included under the income method rather. Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.

Source: NCERT XII

questions.question: An object is placed 30 cm in front of a convex lens, and the image is formed 60 cm on the other side of the lens. What is the focal length of the lens?
questions.question_hi: एक वस्तु को उत्तल लेंस के सामने 30 सेमी की दूरी पर रखा गया है, और प्रतिबिंब लेंस के दूसरी ओर 60 सेमी की दूरी पर बनता है। लेंस की फोकस दूरी क्या है?
questions.solution:
The focal length of the lens is 20 cm. This can be calculated using the lens formula.

Given Data:

Object distance (u) = -30 cm (By sign convention, the distance to an object placed in front of the lens is negative).

Image distance (v) = +60 cm (The image is formed on the other side of the lens, which is the direction of light, so it is positive. A positive image distance for a lens indicates a real image).

Focal length (f) = ?

Applying the Lens Formula:

The lens formula relates the object distance (u), image distance (v), and focal length (f):

1/f = 1/v - 1/u

Calculation:

1/f = 1/60 - 1/(-30)

1/f = 1/60 + 1/30

To add the fractions, find a common denominator, which is 60:

1/f = 1/60 + 2/60

1/f = (1 + 2) / 60

1/f = 3 / 60

Simplify the fraction:

1/f = 1 / 20

Therefore, the focal length (f) is:

f = 20 cm

Since the focal length is positive, it confirms that the lens is a convex lens, as expected.

The correct option is 20 cm.

Consider the following statements about Pardoning powers of the President:

I. It is independent of the Judiciary.

II. It is executive power.

III. The President acts as a court of appeal while exercising this power.

Select the INCORRECT statements using the codes given below.
questions.question_hi:
राष्ट्रपति की क्षमादान शक्तियों के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. यह न्यायपालिका से स्वतंत्र है।

II. यह कार्यकारी शक्ति है।

III. राष्ट्रपति इस शक्ति का प्रयोग करते समय अपील न्यायालय के रूप में कार्य करता है।

नीचे दिए गए कूट का उपयोग करके गलत कथनों का चयन करें।
questions.solution:
A Statement I and II are correct. Statement III is NOT correct.

In March 2026, while outlining the strategic rationale for the Asia-Africa Agri Alliance (AAAA), the following statements were made. Identify the correct statement(s) regarding this.

I. Asia and Africa together account for over 40% of global agricultural production.

II. Africa holds 65% of the world's remaining arable land.

III. The AAAA has been constituted as a for-profit consortium.
questions.question_hi:
मार्च 2026 में, एशिया-अफ्रीका एग्री अलायंस (AAAA) के लिए रणनीतिक तर्क प्रस्तुत करते हुए, निम्नलिखित कथन दिए गए थे। इसके संबंध में सही कथन(ओं) की पहचान करें।

I. एशिया और अफ्रीका मिलकर वैश्विक कृषि उत्पादन का 40% से अधिक हिस्सा रखते हैं।

II. अफ्रीका के पास विश्व की शेष उपजाऊ भूमि का 65% हिस्सा है।

III. AAAA को एक लाभकारी संघ के रूप में गठित किया गया है।
questions.solution: Senior ambassadors, diplomats, policymakers and agribusiness leaders representing over ten nations formally launched the Asia-Africa Agri Alliance (AAAA), with the objective of accelerating agricultural trade, investment, technology transfer and policy cooperation between Asia and Africa. Asia and Africa together account for over 40 per cent of global agricultural production and bilateral agri-trade already exceeds $90 billion annually. The continent holds 65 per cent of the world's remaining arable land, a young and rapidly growing workforce, and an agricultural sector projected to reach a $1 trillion market by 2030. The Asia-Africa Agri Alliance (AAAA) has been constituted as a neutral, not-for-profit Section 8 institution to bridge these gaps through institutional, investment-ready and policy-aligned mechanisms, an official statement said.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the temple architecture of the Vijayanagara Empire:

I. The Vijayanagara rulers were great patrons of temple architecture, and the Virupaksha Temple at Hampi is one of the most prominent examples of this style.

II. A notable feature of Vijayanagara temples is the construction of large pillared halls, called "Kalyana Mandapas," used for celebrating the ceremonial marriage of the temple deity.

III. The Vijayanagara style of temple architecture developed entirely independently, with no influence from earlier South Indian dynasties such as the Cholas or Hoysalas.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
विजयनगर साम्राज्य की मंदिर वास्तुकला के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. विजयनगर शासक मंदिर वास्तुकला के महान संरक्षक थे, और हम्पी में विरूपाक्ष मंदिर इस शैली के सबसे प्रमुख उदाहरणों में से एक है।

II. विजयनगर मंदिरों की एक उल्लेखनीय विशेषता बड़े स्तंभित हॉल का निर्माण है, जिन्हें "कल्याण मंडप" कहा जाता है, जो मंदिर देवता के वैवाहिक समारोह के लिए उपयोग किए जाते हैं।

III. विजयनगर शैली की मंदिर वास्तुकला पूरी तरह से स्वतंत्र रूप से विकसित हुई, जिसमें चोल या होयसला जैसे पूर्व दक्षिण भारतीय राजवंशों का कोई प्रभाव नहीं था।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement I is Correct

The Vijayanagara Empire (14th-17th century CE) is well known for its extensive patronage of temple construction, particularly in and around its capital, Hampi. The Virupaksha Temple at Hampi, dedicated to Lord Shiva (as Virupaksha), is one of the oldest and most prominent temples in the city, and it remained an active centre of worship and royal patronage throughout the Vijayanagara period. It stands today as one of the best-preserved monuments of this architectural tradition.

Statement II is Correct

Kalyana Mandapas were a regular and important feature of Vijayanagara temple complexes. These were spacious pillared halls specifically constructed for conducting the ceremonial "marriage" ritual of the temple deity - an important annual festival in South Indian temple traditions. Such mandapas are richly decorated with carved pillars and are a recognizable element of temples built or expanded during this period.

Statement III is Incorrect

Vijayanagara temple architecture did not develop in isolation - it was, in fact, a synthesis of earlier South Indian architectural traditions, drawing heavily on styles inherited from the Chola, Hoysala, and Pandya dynasties. Elements such as the pillared mandapas, vimana (sanctum tower) designs, and sculptural traditions show clear continuity and evolution from these predecessor styles, blended with new Vijayanagara-era innovations like elaborate gopurams and yali-pillared halls. Claiming "entirely independent development with no influence" contradicts the well-established understanding of Vijayanagara architecture as a continuation and elaboration of earlier Dravidian temple traditions.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Windows OS:

1) Windows supports multitasking.

2) Windows provides GUI-based interaction.

3) Windows cannot manage hardware resources.

Which are correct?
questions.question_hi:
विंडोज ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) विंडोज मल्टीटास्किंग का समर्थन करता है।

2) विंडोज ग्राफिकल यूजर इंटरफेस (GUI) आधारित इंटरैक्शन प्रदान करता है।

3) विंडोज हार्डवेयर संसाधनों का प्रबंधन नहीं कर सकता है।

इनमें से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 2 are correct.

Statement 3 is incorrect because managing hardware is a core function of any Operating System.

Explanation of Statements:

1) is Correct. Windows is a multitasking OS, allowing the CPU to switch between multiple running programs (e.g., browsing the web while listening to music) so quickly that they appear to run simultaneously.

2) is Correct. Windows is famous for its Graphical User Interface (GUI), which uses visual elements like icons, menus, and pointers instead of just text-based commands.

3) is Incorrect. One of the primary roles of Windows is to manage hardware resources (CPU, Memory, Disk, I/O devices) using software called "drivers."

Further Insights:

· Windows uses a "Kernel" to handle the most basic hardware communication tasks.

· The "Desktop" is the primary workspace in the Windows GUI environment.

questions.question: SCSI port allows data transmission in a "daisy chain" to up to 7 devices. In daisy chain several devices are connected in _________.
questions.question_hi: SCSI पोर्ट एक "डेज़ी चेन" में 7 डिवाइस तक डेटा ट्रांसमिशन की अनुमति देता है। डेज़ी चेन में कई डिवाइस _________ में जुड़े होते हैं।
questions.solution: Small Computer System Interface (SCSI) Port: SCSI port allows data transmission in a "daisy chain" to up to 7 devices at a speed (32 bits at a time) much higher than serial and parallel ports. The devices that may be connected to SCSI ports are hard-disk drives, CD-ROM drives, scanners, backup units, network adapters etc. In daisy chain several devices are connected in series. If data has to reach the seventh device, then it needs to go through all the six devices first.

questions.question:

2. A switch broadcasts data to all connected devices by default.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?

स्विच के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

2. एक स्विच डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से सभी कनेक्टेड डिवाइसों को डेटा प्रसारित करता है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 (Correct): A switch is an "intelligent" device that learns the MAC addresses of connected devices and sends data only to the specific intended port.

Statement 2 (Incorrect): A Hub broadcasts data to everyone. A Switch uses "Unicast" (point-to-point) communication, which significantly reduces network traffic and prevents collisions.

questions.question: Which device functions as both an input and an output device?
questions.question_hi: कौन सा उपकरण इनपुट और आउटपुट दोनों उपकरणों के रूप में कार्य करता है?
questions.solution:
The Touchscreen is the correct answer as it serves as both an input and an output device.

Explanation of Options:

· Monitor: Primarily an output device that displays visual information.

· Printer: An output device that produces physical copies of digital documents.

· Touchscreen: It is a display (output) that also contains a touch-sensitive layer (input) to register user gestures and commands.

· Scanner: An input device used to convert physical documents into digital images.

Further Insights:

· Other examples of hybrid I/O devices include Modems (sending and receiving data) and Headsets (microphone for input, speakers for output).

questions.question: Which view displays files with detailed attributes like size and date?

questions.solution:

Details View: This view organizes files into a list with multiple columns, showing the name, date modified, file type, and size. You can also sort files by clicking on these column headers.

List View: Simply shows file names in columns without extra data.

Tiles/Icons: Focus more on visual representation/thumbnails.

Further Insights:

In "Details" view, you can right-click the column headers to add even more attributes, like "Authors" or "Dimensions."

questions.question: URL works with _________ to give a name, location to web pages.
questions.question_hi: URL वेब पेजों को नाम, स्थान/लोकेशन देने के लिए _________ के साथ काम करता है।
questions.solution:
URL's, or 'uniform resource locators', are the web browser addresses of internet pages and files. It is the way to locate a file or document on the Internet. The URL specifies the address of a file and every file on the Internet has a unique address. It works with IP addresses to give a name, location to web pages. Web software, such as your browser, uses the URL to retrieve a file from the computer on which it resides. Every URL has three parts to address a page or file:

• Protocol which ends with a '//:'

• Host computer which ends with web extensions such as .com,.org etc.

• Filename or page name which displays the related information.

questions.question: Which of the following email fields is not visible to other recipients and is mainly used to hide email addresses?

Privacy: It is essential for sending mass emails where you want to prevent recipients from seeing each other's contact details.

questions.question: Which feature allows Windows to allocate CPU time among multiple tasks?
questions.question_hi: विंडोज की कौन सी विशेषता उसे एकाधिक कार्यों के बीच सीपीयू समय आवंटित करने की अनुमति देती है?

The Operating System uses Scheduling to decide which task gets the CPU's attention and for how long.

Explanation of Options:

· Scheduling: The process by which the OS manages the execution of multiple processes, ensuring that the CPU is utilized efficiently.

· Spooling: Used primarily for managing printer queues.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about IMAP:

1) IMAP stores emails on the server.

2) IMAP allows access from multiple devices.

3) IMAP deletes emails from server after download.

Correct statements are:
questions.question_hi:
IMAP के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) IMAP ईमेल को सर्वर पर संग्रहीत करता है।

2) IMAP कई उपकरणों से पहुँच की अनुमति देता है।

3) IMAP डाउनलोड होने के बाद सर्वर से ईमेल हटा देता है।

सही कथन हैं:
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 2 are correct.

Statement 3 is incorrect because IMAP synchronizes with the server rather than deleting emails after download.

Explanation of Statements:

1) is Correct. IMAP (Internet Message Access Protocol) leaves the original email on the mail server.

2) is Correct. Because mail stays on the server, you can see the same folders and read/unread status on your phone, laptop, and tablet simultaneously.

3) is Incorrect. Deleting from the server after download is a characteristic of the older POP3 protocol. IMAP only deletes an email if the user specifically chooses to delete it.

Further Insights:

IMAP is better for the modern era of multiple devices, whereas POP3 was designed for a time when users had only one computer and limited server storage.

questions.question:

questions.question_hi:
बहुपक्षीय वायरस के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:
