2) बहुपक्षीय वायरस को हटाना एकल-लक्ष्य वायरस की तुलना में सरल है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा सही है?
questions.solution:
· Statement 1 - Correct: Multipartite viruses attack more than one part of a system (e.g., boot sector + files).

· Statement 2 - Incorrect: They are harder to remove because cleaning one area may reinfect the other.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about routers:

1) Routers operate at the network layer.

2) Routers use MAC addresses for packet forwarding.

3) Routers can connect different networks.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
राउटरों के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) राउटर नेटवर्क लेयर पर काम करते हैं।

2) राउटर पैकेट फॉरवर्डिंग के लिए MAC एड्रेस का उपयोग करते हैं।

3) राउटर विभिन्न नेटवर्कों को जोड़ सकते हैं।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because routers use IP addresses, not MAC addresses, to forward data.

Explanation of Statements:

1) is Correct. Routers operate at the Network Layer (Layer 3) of the OSI model, where logical addressing and routing take place.

2) is Incorrect. Switches use MAC addresses (physical addresses) to move data within a local network. Routers use IP addresses (logical addresses) to move data between different networks.

3) is Correct. The primary job of a router is to act as a gateway, connecting different networks (such as your home LAN to the global Internet).

Further Insights:

Routers maintain a "Routing Table" to determine the most efficient path for a data packet to reach its destination.

Most home routers also include a built-in switch and wireless access point.

questions.question:

questions.question_hi:

2. कुकीज़ उपयोगकर्ता के कंप्यूटर पर प्रोग्राम चला सकती हैं।

questions.solution:
Statement 1 (Correct): Cookies are small text files that remember your login state, language settings, and shopping cart items.

Statement 2 (Incorrect): Cookies are plain text data; they are not executable programs and cannot "run" or "install" anything on your PC.

questions.question: Which practice improves online banking security?
questions.question_hi: कौन सा तरीका ऑनलाइन बैंकिंग सुरक्षा को बेहतर बनाता है?
questions.solution:
Enabling transaction alerts is a critical proactive security measure for online banking.

Explanation of Options:

· (a) Public Wi-Fi: Unsafe as hackers can intercept data on open networks.

· (b) Reusing passwords: Dangerous; if one account is compromised, all are at risk.

· (c) Transaction alerts: Provides immediate notification of any movement in your account, allowing you to report unauthorized activity instantly.

· (d) Saving passwords: Not recommended on shared computers as others can access your sensitive accounts.

questions.question: A company marked a refrigerator 62% above its production price. If the refrigerator is purchased by Seema from the company and she earns 36% profit on her cost price while selling it to a buyer. What is the profit percentage for the company who sells the refrigerator to Seema, if Seema offers a discount of 15% on marked price of the company.
questions.question_hi: एक कंपनी ने एक रेफ्रिजरेटर पर उसके उत्पादन मूल्य से 62% अधिक मूल्य अंकित किया। यदि सीमा कंपनी से रेफ्रिजरेटर खरीदती है और वह इसे एक खरीदार को बेचते समय अपने क्रय मूल्य पर 36% लाभ अर्जित करती है। यदि सीमा कंपनी के अंकित मूल्य पर 15% की छूट प्रदान करती है, तो सीमा को रेफ्रिजरेटर बेचने वाली कंपनी का लाभ प्रतिशत कितना है?
questions.solution:
Let the production cost be Rs.100.

Then marked price of refrigerator = 100 * 162/100 = Rs.162

The price at which Seema sold the refrigerator = 162 * 85/100 = Rs.137.7

Profit% of Seema = 36%

The price at which Seema bought the refrigerator = 137.7 * 100/136

= (1377 * 10/136) = 1377 * 5/68 = Rs.101.25

Company profit% = (101.25 - 100) * 100/100 = 1.25%

questions.question: E is the centroid of the △ABC, where AB, BC and CA are 8 cm, 15 cm and 17 cm respectively. Find the value of BE.
questions.question_hi: बिंदु E, △ABC का केन्द्रक है, जहाँ AB, BC और CA क्रमशः 8 cm, 15 cm और 17 cm है। BE का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
AC = 17 cm

172 = 82 + 152

Now we can say △ABC is a right angle triangle where ∠B = 90°.

Point E is on BD.

As we know, BD is circum-radius.

Circum-radius of △ABC = (Hypotenuse)/2 = 17/2 cm

BD = BE + ED & BE:ED = 2:1

BE = (17/2) x (2/3)

=> BE = 17/3 cm

questions.question: P1 alone can do 2/3rd of the work in 8 days, P2 alone can do 7/12th of the work in 14 days and P3 alone can do 8/15th of the work in 16 days. In how many days can they complete the work, if all three work together?
questions.question_hi: अकेले P1 काम का 2/3 भाग 8 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है, अकेले P2 काम का 7 /12 भाग 14 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है और अकेले P3 काम का 8/15 भाग 16 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। यदि सभी तीन एक साथ काम करते हैं, तो वे काम को कितने दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं?
questions.solution:
Time taken by P1 to complete the whole work alone = 8 * 3/2 = 12 days

Time taken by P2 to complete the whole work alone = 14 * 12/7 = 24 days

Time taken by P3 to complete the whole work alone = 16 * 15/8 = 30 days

Time taken by all three together to complete the work = 1/ [(1/12) + (1/24) + (1/30)]

= 1/ [(10 + 5 + 4)/120]

= 120/19 days

questions.question: In grade 9 of a school, 25 students opted for physics, 20 opted for biology, and 15 opted for Hindi. If the total of students in grade 9 was 50, all of these students opted for at least one of the three subjects mentioned here, and exactly four of these students opted for all these three subjects, what is the probability that a randomly selected student of grade 9 of this school would have opted for exactly one of these three subjects?
questions.question_hi: एक विद्यालय की कक्षा 9 में 25 विद्यार्थियों ने भौतिक विज्ञान, 20 ने जीव विज्ञान और 15 ने हिंदी विषय चुना। यदि कक्षा 9 में कुल विद्यार्थियों की संख्या 50 है, और इन सभी विद्यार्थियों ने कम से कम एक विषय चुना है, तथा ठीक चार विद्यार्थियों ने तीनों विषय चुने हैं, तो इस विद्यालय की कक्षा 9 के किसी यादृच्छिक रूप से चयनित विद्यार्थी द्वारा इन तीनों विषयों में से ठीक एक विषय चुनने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
questions.solution:
Total students = 50

Students who opted two or more subjects = 25 + 20 + 15 - 50 - 4 = 6

Students opted for exactly one subject = 50 - 6 = 44

Hence, the required probability = 44/50 = 0.88

questions.question: Two chords AB and CD of a circle are produced to intersect each other at a point P outside the circle. If AB = 7 cm, BP = 4.2 cm, and PD = 2.8 cm, then the length of CD is:

questions.solution:
When two chords intersect each other at a point P outside the circle.

Then,

PB * PA = PD * PC

4.2 * (PB + AB) = 2.8 * (PD + CD)

4.2 * 11.2 = 2.8 * (2.8 + CD)

16.8 = 2.8 + CD

CD = 14 cm

questions.question: In two triangles ABC and DEF, the two sides of ∆ABC, AB and BC are proportional to the two sides of triangles DEF, DE and EF. The ∠C in ∆ABC is equal to the ∠F in ∆DEF. Which of the following rule will you use to prove the similarity of ∆ABC and ∆DEF?

questions.solution:
From the given conditions, we cannot prove the similarity of both triangles as there is no such rule as SSA.

And in rule SAS, the included angle is the angle between the sides which are given equals.

In the question the angle C and angle F are not included angle. So, the triangles ABC and DEF are not similar.

questions.question: The difference between the simple interest and compound interest (compounded annually) on a sum at 6% rate of interest per annum for 2 years is Rs.345. Find the sum. (correct up to two decimal places)

questions.solution:
For two years, CI - SI = sum * rate2/10000

Here, rate = 6%, CI - SI = 345

So, 345 = sum * 6 * 6/10000

Sum = Rs.95833.33

questions.question: What is the minimum radius (> 2) of a hemisphere whose total surface area is an integer?

questions.solution:
Total surface area of hemisphere = 3πr2

For integer, r must be an integer and value of r is a multiple of n/√π (where n is a positive integer).

r > 2

n/√π > 2

n > 2*√3.14

n > 3.54

n = 4

Minimum value of r = 4/√π

questions.solution:
For the given city:

Population in 2014 = 45000

So, 6 + 25 = 31

So, 31 = 31

Thus, option (d) is correct.

questions.solution:

After interchanging the sign:

520 - 8 + 2 x 46 ÷ 23 = 516

520 - 8 + 2 x 2 = 516

520 - 4 = 516

516 = 516

520 - 8 x 0.043 + 23 = 516

520 - 0.347 + 23 = 516

542.65 is not equal to 516

So, this option is incorrect.

Option (d):

520 + 16 - 2 = 516

P @ Q: P is the father of Q

P & Q: P is the daughter of Q

P ^ Q: P is the mother of Q

If, B # E ^ C $ A @ D & C, then how is D related to B?

निम्नलिखित जानकारी का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिये और निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिये।

P $ Q: P, Q की पत्नी है।

P & Q: P, Q की पुत्री है।

P ^ Q: P, Q की माता है।

questions.solution:
B # E: B is the husband of E

E ^ C: E is the mother of C

C $ A: C is the wife of A

A @ D: A is the father of D

D & C : D is the daughter of C

So, D is the granddaughter of B.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Did they force the Samnites back into their own mountain country?

options.label: A
options.text: Were the Samnites forced back into their own mountain country by them?

options.label: B
options.text: Were the Samnites were forced by them back into their own mountain country?

options.label: C
options.text: Did the Samnites forced by them back into their own mountain country?

options.label: D
options.text: Had the Samnites forced back into their own mountain country by them?

questions.correct_text: Were the Samnites forced back into their own mountain country by them?
questions.solution:
The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive Voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

In Passive Voice, the preposition "by" is used before the object. However, it is optional in some cases.

The question in the Active voice is an interrogative sentence. The answer to this question will be either "yes" or "no".

These types of sentences usually begin with a helping verb like "Did".

The format of such a sentence in the Active voice is: Did + Subject + V1 + Object?

Therefore, in Passive voice, the format will be: Was/Were + Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case)?

For example:

Did he beat you? (Active)

Were you beaten by him? (Passive)

The options except (a) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.

Thus, the correct answer is option (a): Were the Samnites forced back into their own mountain country by them?

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The school had been transformed into an international-level school by the Minister of Education.

options.label: A
options.text: The Minister of Education has transformed the school into an international-level school.

options.label: B
options.text: The Minister of Education had to be transformed the school into an international-level school.

options.label: C
options.text: The Minister of Education had transformed the international-level school into a school.

options.label: D
options.text: The Minister of Education had transformed the school into an international-level school.

questions.correct_text: The Minister of Education had transformed the school into an international-level school.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" verb ("been" in the given sentence) and the preposition "by" is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

The Passive voice in this question is in Past Perfect. Thus, the Active voice will also be in Past Perfect.

In Passive voice, the format is: Object of the Active voice (Subjective case) + had + been + V3 + by + Subject of the Active voice (Objective case).

Thus, the format of the Active voice is: Subject + had + V3 + Object.

For example:

She had been called by me. (Passive Voice)

I had called her. (Active Voice)

The options except (d) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (d): The Minister of Education had transformed the school into an international-level school.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Both things, what the workers feel / and how they survive, / is not contemplated / by us.

options.label: D
options.text: Both things, what the workers feel

questions.solution:
The subject of the given sentence is composed of two noun phrases, 'What the workers feel' and 'how they survive'. The two subjects are combined by 'and'. When the subject of a sentence is composed of two or more nouns or pronouns connected by 'and', use a plural verb. Also, "both" refers to "two". So, 'is' [singular] should be replaced by 'are' [plural] to rectify the sentence. Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

The correct sentence is: Both things, what the workers feel and how they survive, are not contemplated by us.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

I went to / live with them / since I was a / year-and-a-half old.
questions.solution:
The error is in part (c) and the error is the usage of 'since'. The sentence conveys that the speaker went to live with certain people at a certain age, so 'when' is to be used because 'since' is used to show a time in past to present while 'when' is used to show a particular period of time.

Hence, option (c) is correct.

questions.question:
Fill in the blanks with the right pair of words.

I ___ have a lot of work __ do, but I always take small breaks whenever required.
questions.solution:
The given sentence talks about the speaker having a lot of work that needs to be done, but he/she always takes small breaks whenever required. The first blank requires an adverb to show 'in addition', and the second blank requires the infinitive marker [to] for marking the following verb infinitive. 'Too' means also or in addition. Among the given options, 'too' and 'to' fit in the blanks, respectively, as their usage conveys that the speaker also has a lot of work that needs to be done. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

The complete sentence is: I too have a lot of work to do, but I always take small breaks whenever required.

Note:

Infinitive marker: A word or affix attached to the stem of a verb in order to form the full infinitive. In English, to is the infinitive marker.

Infinitive: The infinitive is the base form of a verb, often preceded by to.

Consider the sentences given below:

· To err is human. [like a noun, the infinitive 'to err' is the subject of the verb 'is']

· My father likes to cook. [like a noun, the infinitive 'to cook' is the object of the verb 'likes']

· To vote in elections is our right. [the infinitive 'to vote', like a noun, is the subject of the verb 'is', but, like a verb, it also takes an object (elections)]

· Radha went to the lake to fetch water. [the infinitive 'to fetch', like a noun, is the object of the verb 'went', but, like a verb, it also takes an object (water)]

· The above sentences illustrate various ways in which infinitives are used. It can both act as a noun and a verb.

questions.question:
Fill in the blanks with appropriate words.

The wet ______ shall be dried after the sun _____.
questions.solution:
The first blank requires a noun to be qualified by the adjective 'wet' and the second blank requires a noun to denote the name of the action done by the sun. In options (c) and (d) the nouns 'rise' that is suggested for the first blank is contextually irrelevant as, they cannot be qualified by the adjective 'wet' and so they are negated. In option (b) the noun 'rice' that is suggested for the second blank is again contextually irrelevant as it does not indicate the name of the action done by the sun and so, it is also negated. In option (a), 'rice' (a swamp grass which is widely cultivated as a source of food, especially in Asia) and 'rise' (an upward movement; an instance of rising) is the most appropriate option that suggests the appropriate words for the respective blanks.

Hence, the correct answer is option (a).

Note:

Qualifiers: A word or phrase that limits the meaning of another word or phrase or makes it less general. 'Adverbs' and 'adjectives' are qualifiers.

questions.question:
In the question given below, a sentence is given with one blank, followed by four options, each having a phrase which may or may not fit in the blank. From the given options, choose the one that gives the correct phrase that fits in the blank.

Unless something totally unexpected happens and oil ___________ below $50 a barrel, fares will continue to rise.
questions.solution:
The phrasal verb 'get behind' means to fail to do as much work or pay as much money as you should do by a particular time; 'punch in' means to record the time of one's arrival or beginning work by punching; 'look out' means be vigilant and take notice; 'drop back' means to return to a lower level, value, price, etc. According to the meanings mentioned above, option d) fits in the blank contextually and gives a meaningful sentence. Filling the blank with 'drops back' gives the meaning that unless the oil prices are reduced to $50 a barrel, fares will continue to rise. Other options fail to form a coherent sentence.

The complete sentence is: Unless something totally unexpected happens and oil drops back below $50 a barrel, fares will continue to rise.

Hence, d) is the correct answer.

Note:

A phrasal verb is a phrase that consists of a main verb combined with one or more prepositions or adverbs, creating a meaning that is different from the original verb alone. For example, "give up" means to stop trying, which is distinct from the meanings of "give" and "up" separately.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate fact from the given options.

options.text: The narrator's father closed the shop soon after online stores became popular.

options.label: B
options.text: The narrator's father valued the bookshop primarily as a place for community interaction and exchange of ideas.

options.label: C
options.text: Customers visited the bookshop only to purchase books.

options.label: D
options.text: The bookshop became more profitable with the growth of online stores

questions.correct_text: The narrator's father valued the bookshop primarily as a place for community interaction and exchange of ideas.
questions.solution:
The passage states, "He believed that a bookshop was more than a business; it was a place where ideas were exchanged and friendships were formed." This shows that the narrator's father valued the bookshop as a centre for community interaction and exchange of ideas rather than merely as a source of profit. Therefore, (b) is the correct answer.

(a) is incorrect because the father continued running the shop despite declining sales.

(c) is incorrect because customers visited the shop not only to buy books but also to engage in discussions.

(d) is incorrect because the passage mentions a decline in sales, not increased profitability.
questions.passage:
Directions : Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow:

When I was a child, my father owned a small bookshop in the centre of the town. The shop was not very large, but it seemed enormous to me because every wall was lined with shelves filled with books of every kind. My father opened the shop at nine every morning and rarely closed before sunset. Many customers visited regularly, not only to buy books but also to spend time discussing literature, politics, and current affairs. My father knew most of them by name and often recommended books according to their interests. As the years passed, large shopping centres and online stores began attracting more customers. Gradually, fewer people visited the bookshop. Despite the decline in sales, my father refused to change his routine. He believed that a bookshop was more than a business; it was a place where ideas were exchanged and friendships were formed. Even on days when hardly anyone entered the shop, he carefully arranged the books and waited patiently for visitors. Looking back, I realise that his dedication was not driven by profit but by his love for books and the community that had grown around them.

questions.question: Which of the following is the most suitable title for the passage?
questions.solution:
The passage describes the narrator's father's long-standing commitment to his bookshop despite declining sales and changing market conditions. Throughout the passage, he continues to run the shop because of his love for books and the community associated with them. This makes (b) the most suitable title.

(a) is incorrect because the passage focuses on the father's dedication rather than the general decline of small businesses.

(c) is incorrect because online shopping is mentioned only as a background factor.

(d) is incorrect because the passage is not about the historical development of bookstores.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Gustavo told Pablo that he had to keep calm as the situation was getting worse day by day.

options.label: A
options.text: Gustavo said to Pablo, "You shall keep calm as the situation is getting worse day by day."

options.label: B
options.text: Gustavo says to Pablo, "You have to keep calm as the situation is getting worse day by day."

options.label: C
options.text: Gustavo said to Pablo, "You have to keep calm as the situation is getting worse day by day."

options.label: D
options.text: Gustavo said to Pablo, "You have to keep calm as the situation has been getting worse day by day."

questions.correct_text: Gustavo said to Pablo, "You have to keep calm as the situation is getting worse day by day."
questions.solution:
The sentence in the Indirect Speech is in Simple Past Tense. Therefore, the sentence in the Direct Speech will be in Simple Present Tense.

Simple Past (Subject + had +Object) will be converted into Simple Present (Subject + has/have +Object).

Note: In this case, 'had' and 'have' are acting as the main verbs.

For example:

He said that he had got a new job. (Indirect Speech)

He said, "I have got a new job". (Direct Speech)

The following things in the sentence will change when changed from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:
Indirect SpeechDirect Speech
told...thatsaid to
heYou
had tohave to
was gettingis getting

Also, option (b) is incorrect because the reporting verb doesn't change, so the conversion of 'told' into 'says to' is incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is: (c) Gustavo said to Pablo, "You have to keep calm as the situation is getting worse day by day."

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

"Jay and I went for a walk the other day," said Lalita.

options.label: A
options.text: Lalita said that Jay and she went for a walk the other day.

options.label: B
options.text: Lalita said that Jay and she have gone for a walk the other day.

options.label: C
options.text: Lalita said that Jay and she had gone for a walk the other day.

options.label: D
options.text: Lalita said that Jay and are going for a walk the other day.

questions.correct_text: Lalita said that Jay and she had gone for a walk the other day.
questions.solution:
When converting from direct to indirect speech, the simple past tense (went) will change to past perfect (had gone). A is incorrect as it does not change the tense. B is incorrect, as 'have gone' is in present perfect. D is incorrect, as 'are going' is in present continuous tense. C is the right answer, as 'had gone' is in the past perfect tense.

Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. The scientist explained that the experiment aimed to replicate conditions similar to those found on early Earth.

B. By doing so, the team hoped to uncover clues about how life might have originated billions of years ago.

C. The results of the experiment were groundbreaking, providing evidence to support long-standing theories.

D. It also opened up new avenues of research into the possibility of life on other planets.
questions.solution:
Sentence A starts by introducing the experiment, explaining its aim to replicate conditions similar to early Earth. This sets up the context for the rest of the passage.

Sentence B logically follows, elaborating on the goal of uncovering clues about how life might have originated, which ties directly to the experiment's purpose.

Sentence C comes next, as it discusses the groundbreaking results of the experiment, showing the success of the research and its contribution to supporting theories about life's origins.

Sentence D concludes the passage, explaining that the results opened up new avenues of research, particularly regarding the possibility of life on other planets, expanding the scope of the experiment's significance.

Thus, the correct order is ABCD.

Hence, option (b) is correct.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. But, for most people, such joy is fleeting.

B. There is always something else to strive for - and this keeps most of us in a constant, sometimes painful, state of never-satisfied striving.

C. When a person wants something, they strive towards it and if they come to possess the object of their desire, they are able to experience joy, so long as they are able to rest in the object of their desire.

D. The 13th-century philosopher and theologian Thomas Aquinas wrote that intellectual appetites are part of what has traditionally been called the 'will'.
questions.solution:
The correct sequence of the sentences will be:

D. The 13th-century philosopher and theologian Thomas Aquinas wrote that intellectual appetites are part of what has traditionally been called the 'will'.

C. When a person wants something, they strive towards it and if they come to possess the object of their desire, they are able to experience joy, so long as they are able to rest in the object of their desire.

A. But, for most people, such joy is fleeting.

B. There is always something else to strive for - and this keeps most of us in a constant, sometimes painful, state of never-satisfied striving.

Identifying the first sentence in the paragraph is a basic step to solve the para jumble. Among the given sentences, D can be easily identified as the introductory sentence as it tells us that cognitive appetites are part of what has usually been called the 'will,' according to Thomas Aquinas, a 13th-century philosopher and theologian.

C is in continuation of D as it tells us more about 'intellectual appetites'. When a person desires something, they strive for it, and after they get it, they are able to enjoy as long as they are able to relax.

Thereafter, A carries forward the paragraph as it draws a contrast to the situation made in C. It tells us that for the majority of people, such happiness lasts for a short time only.

B is the concluding sentence as it tells us that there is always something new to strive for, which leaves most of us in a perpetual condition of being never satisfied and always striving, which may be unpleasant.

Therefore, the correct answer is: (c) DCAB.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Oriol and Carla became good friends from then and Oriol visited Carla and her daughter twice a week, and he also helped Carla in paying the school fees.

B. Carla was very happy, and she wanted to do something good for him.

C. Oriol and Carla met each other while on a business trip and talked about their lives.

D. But she didn't have enough money, so she decided to do the best she could to assist Oriol in whatever he does.
questions.solution:
If we read the sentences carefully, we can see that A is followed by B because A states that Carla and Oriol became good friends, and Oriol paid Carla and her daughter visits twice a week, as well as assisted Carla with school payments and B states that Carla was very happy because of that and she desired to do something special for Oriol. Thereafter, D follows B as it tells us that Carla didn't have any money, so she tried to do the best she could to help Oriol with whatever he was doing. The only sentence that is left is C, and it will serve as the introductory sentence as it tells us about how Oriol and Carla met and chatted about their lives.

Therefore, the correct answer is: (a) CABD.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

P. Virtual reality is an immersive, computer-generated scenario that can simulate a real-life experience.

Q. It can also be fantastical, creating an experience that is not possible in ordinary physical reality.

R. This immersive environment can be similar to the real world.

S. Augmented reality systems may also be considered a form of virtual reality.
questions.solution:
P is the first statement, as it introduces us to the topic of the passage, which is 'virtual reality.' R follows P as it talks more about the experience. Q follows R as the word 'also' [in addition; too] is mentioned (thus indicating that Q talks further about what is mentioned in R). S is the last sentence, as it mentions an example of virtual reality. The correct order is PRQS.

Option C is thus the correct answer.

questions.question: Which of the following words can replace the blank marked as (A) in the passage?
questions.solution:
'Any' is either used to put emphasis on a particular type of thing or express a lack of restriction in selecting a thing from a specified type. Also, we use 'any' before nouns to refer to indefinite or unknown quantities or an unlimited entity. Much and little cannot fill the blank as they are followed by uncountable nouns, whereas 'species' is countable. The definite article 'the' should be followed by a noun/noun phrase, which is not the case here.

The most fitting option here is option (a). Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which of the following words can replace the blank marked as (B) in the passage?
questions.solution: Here, we are talking about the parts of a plant. Options (b) and (c) are the correct words because 'root' means the part of a plant which attaches it to the ground or to a support, typically underground, conveying water and nourishment to the rest of the plant via numerous branches and fibres. It is a part of the plant. Now, there is not one root so we will use the plural of the word 'root'. Hence, the correct answer will be option (c).

Many ferns are popular houseplants.

questions.question: Which of the following words can replace the blank marked as (C) in the passage?
questions.solution:
The blank requires a preposition to show the logical relationship between the "wide variety" and sizes and shapes.

· Option a) is incorrect because 'on' is used to show the placement of something on top of something else.

· Option c) is incorrect because 'off' means to cancel.

· Option d) is incorrect because 'in' is used as a function word to indicate inclusion, location, or position within limits.

· Option b) is the only correct answer because the preposition "of" is used to create more general relationships between objects and their nouns and the preposition "of" follows the verb accused. Therefore, the correct answer is option (b).

Note:

A Preposition is a word placed before a noun or a pronoun or a noun equivalent (pronoun, adverb, gerund, infinitive, adverbial clause, or any clause that can be used as the object of the preposition) and shows a relationship in space or time or a logical relationship between two or more people, places, or things in a sentence.

Examples

I. The teacher scolded the child for being late.

II. We're going to a party.

· The words in bold are called prepositions because they normally take position before (pre) a noun/pronoun or a noun equivalent (pronoun, adverb, gerund, infinitive, adverbial clause, or any clause that can be used as the object of the preposition.

· The noun/pronoun which is used with a preposition is called its Object.

Many ferns are popular houseplants.

questions.question: Which of the following words can replace the blank marked as (D) in the passage?
questions.solution:
We need an indefinite article to replace this blank to refer to the noun 'alteration'. The word after blank starts with a vowel so we will use 'an.' The definite article 'the' is used to talk about a particular person or thing, which is not the case here. Indefinite articles 'a' and 'an' are used before non-specific nouns only. 'An' is used before a word with a vowel sound and 'a' before a consonant sound. 'Many' is not an article. Also, it should be followed by a plural noun. Therefore, the correct answer is option (b).

Definite and indefinite articles: In the English language, we have one definite article 'the'; it refers to or introduces, a particular, specific noun. 'An' and 'a' are indefinite articles; they refer to, or introduce, an unspecified noun. 'An' is used before the words starting with a vowel sound whereas 'a' is used before the word which starts a consonant sound.

questions.solution:

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions based on the passage.

As the war in Iran drags into its third month with no clear end in sight, the Prime Minister of India is asking Indians to tighten their belts in ways not seen since the pandemic. Work from home if possible, he urged. Avoid unnecessary foreign travel. Buy less gold. Consume less fuel. The appeal, delivered at a public event in Hyderabad, carried echoes of the Covid years, when the prime minister relied on symbolic mass participation to rally the country around a national cause. Air fares have surged as airlines pass on fuel costs. Overseas holidays are becoming more expensive. Gold imports, a chronic drain on foreign exchange, have become a fresh target, with the government sharply raising import duties on gold and silver to 15%. "What was initially seen as a temporary shock could now turn into a prolonged crisis. If that happens, India could be among the worst-affected economies," says an associate professor of economics at Mumbai-based Indira Gandhi Institute of Development Research. This time, the collective mission is economic survival: save dollars. Unsurprisingly, the message sent a wave of panic across India's financial markets. "My view is we should prepare for paranoia before the event," a veteran Indian banker, told a gathering of industry leaders this week, adding, "We must prepare for the worst." "We have not seen the impact in the last two months of the Middle East war in terms of energy price transmission.. It's coming and it's coming big and consumers have not felt the pressure at all," he said. India's vulnerability is straightforward. The country imports roughly 90% of its crude oil and half its gas needs. With the Strait of Hormuz - the narrow Gulf chokepoint through which much of the world's oil flows - shut for more than two months amid the war, India's import bill has ballooned by billions of dollars. Behind the PM's unusually direct appeal lies a deeper anxiety in Delhi: not that India is running out of dollars, as it did during the balance-of-payments crisis of 1991, but that demand for dollars is beginning to outstrip supply at an uncomfortable pace. Back then, India had barely enough reserves to cover three weeks of imports. Today, it has around $690bn (≤510bn) in reserves - among the world's biggest and enough to finance India's goods imports for 11 months. There is no imminent risk of default. But the pressures are real nonetheless. Oil, gas, fertilizer and gold imports are pushing up demand for dollars just as foreign investment inflows weaken, exports slow down and geopolitical uncertainty rattles markets. India's forex reserves have fallen by $38bn since the Iran war began - one of the sharpest declines in the region.

This comparison highlights a similarity in approach rather than in the scale of the crisis or the nature of restrictions. The focus is on mobilising citizens to adopt certain behaviours in support of a broader national objective. Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

IMD predicts that we will get several inches of snow beginning as early as Saturday night.

options.label: A
options.text: IMD predicts, "We have got several inches of snow beginning as early as Saturday night."

options.label: B
options.text: "We'll get several inches of snow beginning as early as Saturday night," IMD predicted.

options.label: C
options.text: IMD predicts, "We'll get several inches of snow beginning as early as Saturday night."

options.label: D
options.text: "We'll get several inches of snow beginning as early as Saturday night," IMD will predict.

questions.correct_text: IMD predicts, "We'll get several inches of snow beginning as early as Saturday night."
questions.solution:
Since the reporting verb in indirect speech is in the present tense (predicts), it implies that the tense of the sentence in direct speech should be the same. a) There is a change in the tense of the sentence; thus, it is eliminated. b) Tense of reporting verbs is not changed in any case, thus, eliminated because 'predicts' is changed to 'predicted'. d) Again, the reporting verb 'predicts' is changed to 'will predict', which is incorrect, thus, eliminated. c) Reporting verb is kept as it is, and there is no change in the tense of the sentence; there will be no change in the pronoun 'we' because the reporter is a part of 'we'.

Hence, option (c) is correct.

questions.question: Which of the following athletes, a former Asian champion, secured first place in the men's triple jump event at the Indian Athletics Series 2026 held at Sree Kanteerava Stadium in Bengaluru by registering a winning leap of 16.82m?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन से खिलाड़ी, जो पूर्व एशियाई चैंपियन हैं, ने बेंगलुरु के श्री कांतिरावा स्टेडियम में आयोजित इंडियन एथलेटिक्स सीरीज 2026 में पुरुष ट्रिपल जंप इवेंट में 16.82 मीटर की विजेता छलांग लगाकर प्रथम स्थान प्राप्त किया?
questions.solution: At the Indian Athletics Series 2026, Murali Sreeshankar began his season with victory in the men's long jump, registering a best effort of 8.15m. Competing at the Sree Kanteerava Stadium, in Bengaluru, the 27-year-old produced his best jump on the fourth attempt and emerged as the only athlete in the field to cross both the 8.00m mark and the Asian Games qualifying standard of 7.91m. In the men's triple jump, former Asian champion Abdulla Aboobacker secured first place with a leap of 16.82m. National record holder Praveen Chithravel did not compete in the event. Meanwhile, Sarvesh Kushare, who represented India at the Paris 2024 Olympic Games, won the men's high jump with a clearance of 2.23m. Among the other standout performances, Baranica Elangovan impressed in the women's pole vault, while Ancy Sojan narrowly defeated Shaili Singh by just two centimetres to claim the women's long jump title. In the men's javelin throw, Bibin Antony emerged victorious with a best throw of 77.53m.

questions.question:
Read the below statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Mark the correct options:

Assertion (A): The Finance Commission's recommendations are advisory and do not legally bind the Union or the States.

Reason (R): Article 280 requires the President to lay the Commission's report before Parliament along with an explanatory memorandum on the action taken.
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दिए गए कथनों को पढ़ें, जिन्हें अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) के रूप में चिह्नित किया गया है। सही विकल्प चुनें:

अभिकथन (A): वित्त आयोग की सिफारिशें सलाहकारी होती हैं और संघ या राज्यों पर कानूनी रूप से बाध्यकारी नहीं होती हैं।

कारण (R): अनुच्छेद 280 के अनुसार राष्ट्रपति को आयोग की रिपोर्ट संसद के समक्ष कार्रवाई पर स्पष्टीकरण ज्ञापन के साथ प्रस्तुत करनी होती है।

options.label: A
options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
options.text_hi: A और R दोनों सत्य हैं, और R, A की सही व्याख्या है।

options.label: B
options.text: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
options.text_hi: A और R दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options.label: C
options.text: A is true, but R is false
options.text_hi: A सत्य है, लेकिन R असत्य है।

options.label: D
options.text: A is false, but R is true
options.text_hi: A असत्य है, लेकिन R सत्य है।

questions.correct_text: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
questions.solution:
A is true: the Constitution uses the word "recommendations," making them non‑binding.

R is also true: Article 280(3) read with constitutional practice requires laying the report with an "action taken memorandum," but this procedure does not itself make the recommendations advisory; it only shows executive discretion. Hence R does not explain A.

Further Insights:

- Article 280 provides for a Finance Commission every five years or earlier as needed.

- Composition: a Chairperson and four other members; qualifications are set by Parliament by law.

- The 15th Finance Commission (N. K. Singh, Chair) recommended 41% vertical devolution for 2021 - 26.

- Key grant types include local body grants and disaster management grants (aligned with Article 275).

- First Finance Commission: 1951 (Chair: K. C. Neogy).

questions.question:
Tripura's traditional musical instrument 'Tripura Sarinda' has received a Geographical Indication (GI) tag. Which of the following statements is/are correct?

I. Tripura Sarinda received a GI tag.

II. Tripura now has four GI-tagged products.

III. Queen Pineapple and Matabari Peda are GI-tagged products of Tripura.
questions.question_hi:
त्रिपुरा के पारंपरिक संगीत वाद्ययंत्र 'त्रिपुरा सरिंदा' को भौगोलिक संकेत (GI) टैग प्राप्त हुआ है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

I. त्रिपुरा सरिंदा को GI टैग मिला है।

II. त्रिपुरा के अब चार GI टैग वाले उत्पाद हैं।

III. क्वीन पाइनएप्पल और मताबाड़ी पेड़ा त्रिपुरा के GI टैग वाले उत्पाद हैं।
questions.solution: Tripura has secured another milestone in preserving and promoting its cultural heritage, with the traditional 'Tripura Sarinda' receiving a Geographical Indication (GI) tag, Chief Minister Manik Saha said. With the latest addition, Tripura now has four GI-tagged products. Saha said the recognition reflects the dedication, craftsmanship and creativity of the artisans and musicians associated with the traditional instrument. The Chief Minister, who also holds the Information and Cultural Affairs portfolio, noted that Tripura's Queen Pineapple, Risha/Pachra (Rignai) ' the traditional attire of indigenous tribal communities ' and Matabari Peda had previously received GI certification. Matabari Peda, a dairy-based sweet, is traditionally offered as prasad at the 524-year-old Tripura Sundari Temple in Udaipur, Gomati district The temple is one of Hinduism's 51 revered Shakti Peethas. Tripura is also known for its Queen and Kew varieties of pineapple, which thrive in the state's hilly terrain and humid climatic conditions with minimal use of chemical input.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Autogenic and Allogenic succession:

1. Allogenic succession is brought about by living inhabitants of the community itself, while change brought about by outside forces is known as autogenic succession.

2. Autogenic succession is driven by abiotic components, while allogenic succession by biotic components.

Which is/are the correct statements?
questions.question_hi:
स्वजनित और अलोजेनिक अनुक्रम के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. अलोजेनिक अनुक्रम समुदाय के जीवित निवासियों द्वारा लाया जाता है, जबकि बाहरी ताकतों द्वारा लाया गया परिवर्तन अलोजेनिक अनुक्रम के रूप में जाना जाता है।

2. अलोजेनिक अनुक्रम अजैविक घटकों द्वारा संचालित होता है, जबकि अलोजेनिक उत्तराधिकार जैविक घटकों द्वारा।

कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Autogenic and Allogenic Succession

● When succession is brought about by living inhabitants of that community itself, the process is called autogenic succession, while change brought about by outside forces is known as allogenic succession. The statement is interchanged hence statement 1 is incorrect.

● Autogenic succession (caused by plants themselves) is succession driven by the biotic components of an ecosystem. In contrast, allogenic succession (caused by drought, fire, flooding etc.) is driven by the abiotic components of the ecosystem. Statement is given other way, hence statement 2 is incorrect.

questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution provides for the impeachment of the President of India?
questions.question_hi: संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद भारत के राष्ट्रपति पर महाभियोग चलाने का प्रावधान करता है?
questions.solution:
Article 61 of the Constitution of India lays down the detailed "Procedure for impeachment of the President." It is a quasi-judicial process carried out by the Parliament.

The key aspects of the impeachment process under Article 61 are:

Grounds: The President can be impeached only on the grounds of "violation of the Constitution."

Initiation: The charges can be initiated by either the Lok Sabha or the Rajya Sabha.

Procedure: The charges must be signed by at least one-fourth of the members of the House that frames the charges, and a 14-day notice must be given to the President.

Majority: The impeachment resolution must be passed by a majority of not less than two-thirds of the total membership of that House.

Investigation: The other House then investigates the charges. The President has the right to appear and be represented at such an investigation.

Final Passage: If the investigating House also passes the resolution by a majority of two-thirds of its total membership, the President stands removed from office from the date the resolution is passed.

Other options are incorrect:

Article 52: This article simply states, "There shall be a President of India." It establishes the office of the President.

Article 53: This article deals with the executive power of the Union, stating that it shall be vested in the President.

Article 76: This article pertains to the office of the Attorney-General for India.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Bastar Dussehra of Chhattisgarh:

1. Unlike the rest of India, Bastar Dussehra does not celebrate the victory of Rama over Ravana - it is a festival dedicated to the goddess Danteshwari.

2. It is celebrated for approximately 75 days, making it one of the longest festival celebrations in the world.

3. A large wooden chariot called the Reth is pulled by tribal devotees through the streets of Jagdalpur as the central event of the festival.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
छत्तीसगढ़ के बस्तर दशहरा के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. भारत के बाकी हिस्सों के विपरीत, बस्तर दशहरा राम की रावण पर विजय का उत्सव नहीं है - यह देवी दंतेश्वरी को समर्पित त्योहार है।

2. इसे लगभग 75 दिनों तक मनाया जाता है, जो इसे दुनिया के सबसे लंबे त्योहारों में से एक बनाता है।

3. त्योहार के मुख्य आयोजन के रूप में, रेत नामक एक बड़ा लकड़ी का रथ जनजातीय भक्तों द्वारा जगदलपुर की सड़कों पर खींचा जाता है।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Bastar Dussehra is unique - no Ramlila is performed and Ravana is not burned. It is a celebration of Danteshwari Mata, the presiding tribal goddess of the Bastar region, and symbolizes the bond between the royal dynasty and the local tribal communities.

Statement 2 is correct: The festival begins on the new moon (Amavasya) of the Hindu month of Shravan and continues for approximately 75 days - far longer than any other Dussehra celebration in India.

Statement 3 is correct: The Reth (wooden chariot) is freshly constructed each year and pulled by hundreds of tribal devotees through Jagdalpur town. It is the most visible and iconic ritual of the festival.

Further insights:

The Muria tribe of Bastar plays a central role in the festival through the Muria Darbar - a ceremonial assembly where tribal chiefs pay homage to the goddess. The Muria are also known for their Ghotul institution, a communal youth dormitory that serves as the cultural heart of the community.

questions.question:
In hypermetropia, one can see distant objects clearly but not the nearby objects. In this context which of the following is/are the reason(s) for this condition?

I. Focal length of the eye lens is too long

II. Elongation of the eyeball

III. Excessive curvature of the eye lens

Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
questions.question_hi:
दीर्घ-दृष्टि दोष में कोई व्यक्ति दूर की वस्तुओं को तो स्पष्ट देख सकता है, लेकिन निकट रखी वस्तुओं को सुस्पष्ट नहीं देख पाता। इस संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा/से इस स्थिति का/के कारण है/हैं?

I. अभिनेत्र लेंस की फोकस दूरी का अत्यधिक हो जाना

II. नेत्र गोलक का लंबा हो जाना

III. अभिनेत्र लेंस की वक्रता का अत्यधिक हो जाना

नीचे दिए गए कोड का प्रयोग कर सही उत्तर का चयन कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Hypermetropia is also known as far-sightedness . A person with hypermetropia can see distant objects clearly but cannot see nearby objects distinctly.

Statement I is correct and statement II is incorrect: This defect arises either because the focal length of the eye lens is too long, or the eyeball has become too small. This defect can be corrected by using a convex lens of appropriate power.

Statement III is incorrect: Excessive curvature and elongation of eye lens cause myopia. Myopia or nearsightedness is a common vision condition in which a person can see nearer objects clearly, but objects farther away look blurry.

Source: NCERT- Science

questions.question: The term "Inselberg" is associated with:
questions.question_hi: "इंसलबर्ग" शब्द का संबंध निम्नलिखित से है:
questions.solution:
The term is associated with residual landforms in arid regions.

An Inselberg (German for "island mountain") is an isolated hill or mountain that rises abruptly from a gently sloping or virtually level surrounding plain. They are typically made of hard rock (like granite) that has resisted erosion in arid or semi-arid environments.

Further Insights:

The famous "Uluru" (Ayers Rock) in Australia is a world-renowned example of an inselberg.

questions.question:
The Commerce and Industry Ministry released the LEADS 2025 report ranking states and Union Territories on logistics performance across policy, infrastructure, and service delivery. Which of the following statements are correct regarding LEADS 2025?

I. Tamil Nadu and Uttar Pradesh have been categorised as 'Exemplars'.

II. Gujarat and Maharashtra have been categorised as 'High Performers'.

III. Rajasthan has been placed in the 'Accelerators' category.
questions.question_hi:
वाणिज्य और उद्योग मंत्रालय ने नीति, अवसंरचना, और सेवा वितरण के आधार पर राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों के लॉजिस्टिक्स प्रदर्शन को रैंकिंग देने वाली LEADS 2025 रिपोर्ट जारी की। LEADS 2025 के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?

I. तमिलनाडु और उत्तर प्रदेश को 'उदाहरण' के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है।

II. गुजरात और महाराष्ट्र को 'उच्च प्रदर्शनकर्ता' के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है।

III. राजस्थान को 'त्वरक' श्रेणी में रखा गया है।
questions.solution:
Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh, Mizoram and Delhi have been categorised as 'exemplars' in the logistics performance ranking for 2025, according to a report released by the Commerce and Industry Ministry.

The logistics index chart, released as part of LEADS (Logistics ease across different states) 2025 report, is an indicator of the efficiency of logistical services necessary for promoting exports and economic growth.

'Exemplars' represent the top-performing states and Union Territories (UTs) that demonstrate sustained excellence across policy, infrastructure, service delivery and regulatory dimensions in the logistics sector, as per the report.

LEADS is the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade's (DPIIT) flagship national assessment of logistics performance across states and Union Territories and serves as an important benchmarking and reform tool for improving logistics efficiency across the country.

The report was released by Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal in the national capital.

As per the report, 11 states and UTs - Gujarat, Kerala, Maharashtra, Haryana, Telangana, Chhattisgarh, Bihar, Tripura, Meghalaya, Jammu and Kashmir, and Puducherry - have been categorised as "high performers".

High Performers comprise states and UTs that demonstrate strong and consistent outcomes across the majority of performance indicators.

Similarly, 18 states and UTs have been categorised as 'accelerators'.

The category includes Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, Goa, Karnataka, Punjab, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Assam, Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu, Chandigarh, Ladakh, and Lakshadweep.

Accelerators comprise states and Union Territories that have demonstrated notable improvement momentum and a clear reform orientation in recent years.

The 'growth seekers' category includes West Bengal, Rajasthan, Sikkim and Andaman & Nicobar Islands.

Growth Seekers represent states and UTs that are at a foundational stage of logistics system development and institutional strengthening.

The 2025 report moves beyond the traditional 'Achievers, Fast Movers, and Aspirers' model to a more nuanced performance hierarchy.

The new categorisation enhanced classification, enabling sharper benchmarking, targeted reform planning and stronger peer learning among states and UTs at different stages of logistics ecosystem development.

The report reflects the government's focus on integrated, data-driven logistics reforms under the PM GatiShakti National Master Plan and the National Logistics Policy.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Per capita income (PCI).

I. Rise in Per capita income means that on average people are getting more goods and services.

II. Increase in national income always results in increase in the per capita income.

Which of the following is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
प्रति व्यक्ति आय (पीसीआई) के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. प्रति व्यक्ति आय में वृद्धि का अर्थ है कि औसतन लोगों को अधिक वस्तुएं और सेवाएं मिल रही हैं।

II. राष्ट्रीय आय में वृद्धि से हमेशा प्रति व्यक्ति आय में वृद्धि होती है।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution: Per capita income measures average availability of goods and services to an individual during a given year. If per capita income rises it means that on an average people are getting more goods and services. Hence, statement 1 is correct. It is a sign of betterment of people. However, It is not necessary that when national income rises per capita income also rises. It is possible that the rate of growth of population may be faster than the rate of growth of national income. Hence, statement 2 is incorrect. This happened in India in the year 1976-77 when national income rose by 0.9 percent while per capita income fell by 1.3 percent because population grew at a rate of 2.2 per cent which was higher than the rate of growth of national income.

Reforms and Fiscal Policies:

Economic reforms have placed limits on the growth of public expenditure especially in social sectors. questions.question:
Regarding the Mauryan Empire, consider the following.

1) The Arthashastra, though ascribed to Kautilya, likely reached its extant form through later compilation; it details espionage and statecraft.

2) Ashoka appointed Dhamma-Mahamatras to propagate and oversee Dhamma.

3) The chief Mauryan land tax was known as bali.

4) Megasthenes describes seven "classes" in Indian society in his Indica.

Which of the above statement is/are true?
questions.question_hi:
मौर्य साम्राज्य के संबंध में, निम्नलिखित पर विचार करें।

1) अर्थशास्त्र, हालांकि कौटिल्य को जिम्मेदार ठहराया गया था, संभवतः बाद में संकलन के माध्यम से अपने मौजूदा रूप में पहुंचा; यह जासूसी और राज्य कला का विवरण देता है।

2) अशोक ने धम्म का प्रचार और देखरेख करने के लिए धम्म-महामात्रों को नियुक्त किया।

3) मुख्य मौर्य भूमि कर को बलि के रूप में जाना जाता था।

4) मेगस्थनीज ने अपने इंडिका में भारतीय समाज में सात "वर्गों" का वर्णन किया है।

उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा कथन सत्य है / हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1, 2, and 4 are historically accurate descriptions of Mauryan polity, administration, and society.

Statement 3 is incorrect because the primary land tax during the Mauryan period was known as bhaga, not bali.

Explanation of Statements:

1 is True. The Arthashastra is a seminal treatise on statecraft, economic policy, and military strategy. While tradition ascribes it to Kautilya (also known as Chanakya), the prime minister of Chandragupta Maurya, modern scholarly consensus is that the text, as it exists today, is not the work of a single author from a single period. It was likely compiled and redacted over several centuries, with its final form being reached sometime after the Mauryan period (perhaps around the 2nd-3rd century CE). Nevertheless, its core principles are believed to reflect Mauryan-era statecraft, including its detailed discussion of a sophisticated system of espionage and governance.

2 is True. In his Major Rock Edict V, Emperor Ashoka explicitly mentions the creation of a new class of officials called the Dhamma-Mahamatras. Their specific duty was to travel throughout the empire to propagate Dhamma (Ashoka's moral and ethical code), attend to the welfare of various religious sects, and ensure that the principles of Dhamma were being followed by the populace and officials alike.

3 is False. This statement is incorrect. While bali was a type of tribute or tax, the primary and most important land tax during the Mauryan period was the bhaga. It was a share of the agricultural produce collected by the state, typically levied at a rate of one-fourth or one-sixth of the crop. The Samaharta was the chief officer in charge of revenue collection. Bali, in the Mauryan context, was a more general term for tribute or a tax that was not as systematically defined as the bhaga.

4 is True. Megasthenes, the Greek ambassador of Seleucus Nicator to the court of Chandragupta Maurya, wrote a detailed account of India in his book, the Indica. Although the original work is lost, extensive fragments survive in the writings of later Greek and Roman authors. In one of these fragments, Megasthenes describes the Indian population as being divided into seven distinct "classes" or occupational groups: (1) philosophers, (2) farmers, (3) soldiers, (4) herdsmen, (5) artisans, (6) magistrates, and (7) councillors. It is important to note that this was a foreigner's observation and does not perfectly align with the indigenous four-fold varna system (Brahmin, Kshatriya, Vaishya, Shudra).

Further insights:

The Mauryan state was highly centralized, and the Arthashastra provides a theoretical blueprint for such a state, with a vast bureaucracy, a standing army, and an extensive network of spies.

Ashoka's Dhamma was not a new religion but a moral code emphasizing non-violence, respect for elders, tolerance for all sects, and welfare of the people.

Megasthenes' account in the Indica, despite its limitations and potential misunderstandings of Indian society, remains one of the most important foreign sources for the history of the Mauryan period.

questions.question: In June 2025, India reached a major climate milestone by achieving what percentage of its total installed power capacity from non-fossil fuel sources?
questions.question_hi: जून 2025 में, भारत ने जीवाश्म ईंधन के अलावा अन्य स्रोतों से अपनी कुल स्थापित विद्युत क्षमता का कितना प्रतिशत प्राप्त करके जलवायु के क्षेत्र में एक महत्वपूर्ण उपलब्धि हासिल की?
questions.solution:
India has achieved a landmark in its energy transition journey by reaching 50% of its installed electricity capacity from non-fossil fuel sources-five years ahead of the target set under its Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) to the Paris Agreement.

This significant milestone was achieved five years ahead of 2030 target.

India's achievement of 50% non-fossil fuel installed capacity ahead of the target year is a testament to its ambition, innovation, and commitment to sustainable development. It affirms that development and decarbonisation are not contradictory goals, but can in fact reinforce each other.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Rani ki Vav stepwell in Gujarat:

1. Rani ki Vav is located in Patan, Gujarat, and was built in the 11th century by Queen Udayamati in memory of her husband, King Bhimdev I of the Solanki dynasty.

2. It is constructed in the Maru-Gurjara architectural style and is designed as an inverted temple - with its most sacred space (the bottom of the well) being the deepest and most elaborately decorated.

3. Rani ki Vav was designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2014 and its image also features on the ₹100 currency note issued by the Reserve Bank of India.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
गुजरात में रानी की वाव स्टेपवेल के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. रानी की वाव गुजरात के पाटन में स्थित है, और इसे 11वीं सदी में रानी उदयमति ने अपने पति, सोलंकी वंश के राजा भीमदेव I की स्मृति में बनवाया था।

2. यह मारु-गुर्जर स्थापत्य शैली में निर्मित है और इसे एक उल्टे मंदिर के रूप में डिजाइन किया गया है - जिसमें सबसे पवित्र स्थान (कुएं का तल) सबसे गहरा और सबसे सजावटी है।

3. रानी की वाव को 2014 में यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल घोषित किया गया था और इसका चित्र भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक द्वारा जारी ₹100 के नोट पर भी है।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Rani ki Vav (literally "Queen's Stepwell") was commissioned by Queen Udayamati around 1063 CE as a memorial to her husband Bhimdev I (Bhima I), a ruler of the Chaulukya (Solanki) dynasty. Patan was the medieval capital of Gujarat.

Statement 2 is correct: The stepwell is built in the Maru-Gurjara style - a regional variant of Nagara temple architecture. UNESCO's citation describes it as a masterpiece of the inverted temple concept: the deeper one descends, the more intricate and sacred the sculpture becomes, with the lowest level housing a panel of Sheshashayee Vishnu (Vishnu reclining on the cosmic serpent).

Statement 3 is correct: UNESCO inscribed Rani ki Vav as a World Heritage Site in 2014. The RBI subsequently featured its image on the reverse of the ₹100 note (new series), bringing it to everyday national consciousness.

Further insights:

The stepwell contains over 500 principal sculptures and more than 1,000 minor carvings across seven levels of stairs. The dominant iconographic theme is the Dashavatar (ten incarnations of Vishnu). Stepwells (vavs or baolis) were not merely utilitarian water structures - they served as cool resting places, social spaces, and sacred sites, representing one of the most distinctive contributions of the Indian subcontinent to world architecture.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the treaty of Lahore:

I. It was signed following the end of the first Anglo-Sikh war.

II. The treaty led to the selling of Kashmir to Gulab Singh.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
लाहौर की संधि के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. यह प्रथम आंग्ल-सिख युद्ध की समाप्ति के बाद हस्ताक्षरित किया गया था।

II. इस संधि के परिणामस्वरूप कश्मीर गुलाब सिंह को बेच दिया गया।

उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा कथन सही है?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Statement I and II are Correct

The end of the first Anglo-Sikh War forced the Sikhs to sign a humiliating treaty on March 8, 1846. The main features of the Treaty of Lahore were as follows:

War indemnity of more than 1 crore of rupees was to be given to the English.

Since, the Sikhs were not able to pay the entire war indemnity, Kashmir including Jammu was sold to Gulab Singh. The transfer of Kashmir to Gulab Singh was formalized by the treaty of Amritsar on March 16, 1846.

The Jalandhar Doab (between the Beas and the Sutlej) was annexed to the Company's dominions.

A British resident was to be established at Lahore under Henry Lawrence.

The strength of the Sikh army was reduced.

Daleep Singh was recognised as the ruler under Rani Jindan as regent and Lal Singh as wazir.

Source: Modern India, Rajiv Ahir.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate answer from the options given below regarding Arrhenius Theory of Acids and Bases.

Statement 1. According to Arrhenius, acids are substances that increase the concentration of hydrogen ions (H⁺) in aqueous solution.

Statement 2. Bases are substances that increase the concentration of hydroxide ions (OH⁻) in aqueous solution.

Statement 3. The Arrhenius theory is applicable to both aqueous and non-aqueous solvents.
questions.question_hi:
अम्ल और क्षार के अरहेनियस सिद्धांत के संबंध में नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सबसे उपयुक्त उत्तर का चयन करें।

कथन 1. अरहेनियस के अनुसार, अम्ल वे पदार्थ हैं जो जलीय घोल में हाइड्रोजन आयनों (H⁺) की सांद्रता बढ़ाते हैं।

कथन 2. क्षार वे पदार्थ हैं जो जलीय घोल में हाइड्रॉक्साइड आयनों (OH⁻) की सांद्रता बढ़ाते हैं।

कथन 3. अरहेनियस सिद्धांत जलीय और गैर-जलीय दोनों सॉल्वैंट्स पर लागू होता है।
questions.solution:
The Arrhenius theory applies only to aqueous solutions; it cannot explain acid-base behavior in non-aqueous solvents or for compounds without H⁺/OH⁻ ions.

The Arrhenius theory was proposed by Swedish chemist Svante Arrhenius in 1884.

It was one of the earliest scientific explanations of acids and bases, based on the behavior of substances in aqueous (water) solutions.

Main Postulates

(a) Acids: An acid is a substance that dissociates in water to produce hydrogen ions (H⁺).

These hydrogen ions are responsible for the acidic properties.

(b) Bases: A base is a substance that dissociates in water to produce hydroxide ions (OH⁻).

These hydroxide ions cause basic (alkaline) behavior.

Hence only statement 1 and 2 are correct.

questions.question: In Census 2011, literacy rate is calculated for people aged at least how many completed years?
questions.question_hi: 2011 की जनगणना में, साक्षरता दर की गणना कम से कम कितने वर्ष की पूर्ण आयु वाले लोगों के लिए की जाती है?
questions.solution:
Census 2011 treats a person as literate if aged 7 years and above and able to read and write with understanding in any language.

Hence the literacy rate is computed for the population aged 7+.

Further Insights:

- Overall literacy (2011): 74.04% (male 82.14%, female 65.46%).

- Kerala (state) had the highest literacy; Bihar the lowest among states.

- Rural literacy (2011): 67.77%; urban literacy: 84.11%.

- "Effective literacy rate" excludes 0 - 6 population from the denominator.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Santhal Rebellion (Hul) of 1855-56:

1. The Santhal Rebellion was led by two brothers - Sidhu and Kanhu Murmu - who claimed divine inspiration and mobilized Santhal tribal communities across the Rajmahal Hills region of present-day Jharkhand.

2. The primary grievances of the Santhals were against moneylenders (Mahajans), zamindars, and British merchants who collectively exploited them through debt bondage, land alienation, and forced labour.

3. The Santhals declared an independent Santhal homeland (Santhal Raj) and formally announced that the authority of the East India Company's law no longer applied to their territory before the rebellion was suppressed.

4. The British suppressed the rebellion using the army and artillery, and as a direct consequence, the government created a separate administrative region called Santhal Parganas under the Santhal Parganas Settlement Regulation of 1855 to protect tribal land rights.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
1855-56 के संथाल विद्रोह (हुल) के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. संथाल विद्रोह का नेतृत्व दो भाइयों - सिधु और कन्हु मुर्मू - ने किया था, जिन्होंने दिव्य प्रेरणा का दावा किया और वर्तमान झारखंड के राजमहल पहाड़ियों क्षेत्र में संथाल जनजातीय समुदायों को संगठित किया।

2. संथालों की मुख्य शिकायतें साहूकारों (महाजन), ज़मींदारों और ब्रिटिश व्यापारियों के खिलाफ थीं, जो उन्हें कर्ज़दारी, भूमि हड़पने और जबरन श्रम के माध्यम से सामूहिक रूप से शोषित करते थे।

3. संथालों ने एक स्वतंत्र संथाल मातृभूमि (संथाल राज) की घोषणा की और विद्रोह के दबाए जाने से पहले औपचारिक रूप से घोषणा की कि ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के कानून का उनका क्षेत्र पर कोई अधिकार नहीं रहेगा।

4. ब्रिटिशों ने सेना और तोपखाने का उपयोग करके विद्रोह को दबा दिया, और इसके प्रत्यक्ष परिणामस्वरूप, सरकार ने जनजातीय भूमि अधिकारों की रक्षा के लिए 1855 के संथाल परगना निपटान विनियमन के तहत संथाल परगना नामक एक अलग प्रशासनिक क्षेत्र बनाया।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Sidhu and Kanhu Murmu, along with their brothers Chand and Bhairav, were the principal leaders of the Hul (meaning "revolution" in Santali). Sidhu claimed that the Thakur (God) had appeared to him and commanded the Santhals to rise - giving the rebellion both a political and millenarian religious character that galvanized tens of thousands of followers.

Statement 2 is correct: The Santhals had been systematically dispossessed over decades. Mahajan moneylenders charged usurious interest rates that trapped Santhals in perpetual debt. Zamindars extracted illegal levies. British railway contractors used them as near-slave labour for the East Indian Railway construction. The colonial legal system consistently sided with the exploiters, leaving the Santhals with no institutional remedy.

Statement 3 is correct: Before the uprising formally began in June 1855, Sidhu and Kanhu issued a declaration asserting Santhal sovereignty - proclaiming that the rule of the Company (Kampani Raj) was over in their territory and that they now answered only to their own authority and the Thakur. This made it one of the few pre-1857 uprisings to explicitly reject British administrative legitimacy.

Statement 4 is correct: The rebellion was crushed by late 1856 using regular army units and artillery - the Santhals, armed primarily with bows and arrows, could not withstand sustained military force. Sidhu and Kanhu were killed. However, the scale of the uprising forced a policy response - the British created the Santhal Parganas as a non-regulation district with special laws restricting land transfer to non-tribals, an early recognition that tribal land rights needed statutory protection.

Further insights:

The Santhal Rebellion preceded the more famous Revolt of 1857 by two years and is considered one of the largest tribal uprisings in Indian history, with estimates of Santhal dead ranging from 15,000 to 30,000. It directly influenced later tribal protection legislation, including provisions that eventually found their way into the Fifth Schedule of the Indian Constitution, which restricts transfer of tribal land in Scheduled Areas to non-tribals.
