questions.question:
Which of the following statements regarding Volleyball rules are correct?

1. A Libero is a specialist defensive player who wears a different-coloured jersey and is restricted to playing only in the back row - he cannot spike, block, or rotate to the front row.

2. Under the current Rally Point System, a point is awarded on every rally regardless of which team served.

3. A back-row player commits a fault only if he lands in front of the 3-metre attack line after jumping - not if he merely takes off from behind it.
questions.question_hi:
वॉलीबॉल नियमों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों में से कौन सा सही है?

1. एक लाइबेरो एक विशेषज्ञ रक्षात्मक खिलाड़ी होता है जो अलग रंग की जर्सी पहनता है और केवल पीछे की पंक्ति में खेलने तक सीमित होता है - वह स्पाइक नहीं कर सकता, ब्लॉक नहीं कर सकता, या सामने की पंक्ति में रोटेट नहीं कर सकता।

2. वर्तमान रैली पॉइंट सिस्टम के तहत, हर रैली पर एक अंक दिया जाता है चाहे सर्व किस टीम ने किया हो।

3. एक पीछे की पंक्ति का खिलाड़ी तभी गलती करता है जब वह कूदने के बाद 3-मीटर अटैक लाइन के सामने लैंड करता है - केवल तभी नहीं जब वह इसके पीछे से ही कूदता है।
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: The Libero position was introduced by FIVB in 1998. The Libero cannot attack the ball above net height, block, or occupy front-row positions during rotation. Libero substitutions are unlimited and do not count against the team's regular substitution quota.

Statement 2 is correct: The Rally Point System replaced the old side-out scoring system. Every rally now produces a point - whether the serving or receiving team wins it. Sets are played to 25 points (with a 2-point lead), and the deciding fifth set to 15 points.

Statement 3 is incorrect: A back-row attack fault is judged at the moment of take-off, not landing. If a back-row player takes off from in front of or on the 3-metre line to attack the ball above the net height, it is a fault - regardless of where they land.

Further insights:

A Libero cannot serve in FIVB international rules, though some national federations (including the USA) permit the Libero to serve in one rotation position. In beach volleyball (2-player format), there is no Libero position at all.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Karewas.

I. It is an erosional landform in Kashmir Himalayan region.

II. It is famous for cultivation of saffron.

III. It was formed during the Pleistocene Period.

Which among the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
करेवास के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. यह कश्मीर हिमालयी क्षेत्र में एक अपरदनकारी भू-आकृति है।

II. यह केसर की खेती के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

III. इसका निर्माण प्लीस्टोसीन काल के दौरान हुआ था।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement I is incorrect: Karewas are the thick deposits of glacial clay and other materials embedded with moraines. It is a depositional landform not erosional landform.

Statement II is correct: Karewa formations are useful for the cultivation of Zafran, a local variety of saffron.

Statement III is correct: Karewas were formed during the Pleistocene Period (1 million years ago), when the entire Valley of Kashmir was under water. Due to the rise of Pirpanjal, the drainage was impounded and a lake of about 5000 sq. km area was developed and thus a basin was formed.

questions.question:
With reference to Article 21, consider the following statements:

1. After the 44th Amendment, Article 21 cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency.

2. The Supreme Court has held that the right to privacy is part of Article 21.

3. Protection under Article 21 is limited to citizens.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
अनुच्छेद 21 के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. 44वें संशोधन के बाद, अनुच्छेद 21 को राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान भी निलंबित नहीं किया जा सकता है।

2. सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने माना है कि निजता का अधिकार अनुच्छेद 21 का हिस्सा है।

3. अनुच्छेद 21 के तहत संरक्षण नागरिकों तक सीमित है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 2 are correct, while statement 3 is incorrect. Article 21 is a non-suspendable right, and the right to privacy has been affirmed as part of it. However, its protection extends to all persons, not just citizens. Therefore, the correct option is c.

Explanation of Statements:

1 is Correct. The 44th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1978 was a crucial piece of legislation that reversed some of the more controversial provisions of the 42nd Amendment. It inserted Article 359(1A), which explicitly states that the President cannot issue an order to suspend the enforcement of the Fundamental Rights guaranteed by Article 20 (protection in respect of conviction for offences) and Article 21 (protection of life and personal liberty), even during a National Emergency proclaimed under Article 352.

2 is Correct. This statement is also correct. In the landmark judgment of Justice K.S. Puttaswamy (Retd.) vs. Union of India (2017), a nine-judge constitution bench of the Supreme Court unanimously affirmed that the right to privacy is a fundamental right, intrinsic to the right to life and personal liberty guaranteed under Article 21 of the Constitution. This judgment has had far-reaching implications for data protection and individual autonomy in India.

3 is Incorrect. This statement is false. Article 21 begins with the words, "No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law." The use of the word "person" is significant. Unlike some other Fundamental Rights (such as Article 19) which are explicitly available only to "citizens," the protection of Article 21 is available to both citizens and non-citizens (foreigners) who are on Indian soil.

Further insights:

Article 21, "Protection of Life and Personal Liberty," has been the most expansively interpreted article in the Indian Constitution.

Through a process of judicial activism, the Supreme Court has read numerous other rights into Article 21, including the right to a clean environment, the right to livelihood, the right to health, the right to education, and the right to a speedy trial, among others.

The only ground on which a person's life or personal liberty can be curtailed is through a "procedure established by law," which, as per the Maneka Gandhi case, must be a procedure that is fair, just, and reasonable, not arbitrary.

questions.question: Which among the following connects two LANs?
questions.question_hi: निम्न में से कौन दो LAN को कनेक्ट करता है?
questions.solution: In regards to networking (network devices bridge), a bridge is a device that connects two LANs or two segments of the same LAN. Networking bridges are also known as network bridges and bridging. There are two types of bridges: the Transparent bridge and the Source Routing bridge.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about RAM:

1) RAM is volatile in nature.

2) RAM stores data permanently even after power failure.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
RAM के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) RAM अस्थिर प्रकृति की होती है।

2) RAM बिजली गुल होने के बाद भी डेटा को स्थायी रूप से संग्रहीत करती है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because RAM is temporary storage and requires power to maintain data.

Explanation of Statements:

· 1. is Correct. RAM (Random Access Memory) is volatile, meaning all data stored in it is lost immediately when the computer is turned off or loses power.

· 2. is Incorrect. Permanent storage is the role of Secondary Memory (like Hard Disks or SSDs). RAM is designed for high-speed, temporary access to data currently being used by the CPU.

Further Insights:

· RAM is significantly faster than any Hard Disk or SSD.

· Upgrading RAM is one of the most effective ways to improve a computer's ability to multitask.

questions.question: Which among the following is a function of the data link layer?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा डेटा लिंक लेयर का एक कार्य है?
questions.solution:
Framing is a function of the data link layer.

It provides a way for a sender to transmit a set of bits that are meaningful to the receiver. This can be accomplished by attaching special bit patterns to the beginning and end of the frame.

questions.question: Which of the following is Secondary Memory?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी सेकेंडरी मेमोरी है?
questions.solution:
Secondary Memory

This memory stores much larger amounts of data and information for extended periods of time. Data in secondary memory cannot be processed directly by the CPU, it must first be copied into primary memory, i.e., RAM. It is the slower and cheaper form of memory.

Ex: Hard disk Drive, Floppy disk, Magnetic Tape, etc.

questions.question: In MS Excel, if the cells have these values, A1 = 5, A2 = 10, what is the result of: =A12 + A2/5

questions.solution:
To find the result of the expression =A12 + A2/5 with A1 = 5 and A2 = 10, we follow the standard order of operations (BODMAS/PEMDAS):

Step-by-Step Calculation:

1. Substitute the values into the formula:

= (5)2 + 10/5

2.Evaluate the Exponent(A12):

5*5 = 25

3.Evaluate the Division(A2/5):

questions.question:
Which of the following statement is/are true?

1) Windows supports multitasking.

2) Windows is a command-line OS only.

3) Windows manages hardware resources.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सत्य है/हैं?

1) विंडोज मल्टीटास्किंग का समर्थन करता है।

2) विंडोज केवल कमांड-लाइन ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम है।

3) विंडोज हार्डवेयर संसाधनों का प्रबंधन करता है।
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because Windows is primarily a Graphical User Interface (GUI) OS.

Explanation of Statements:

1) is Correct. Windows supports "Pre-emptive Multitasking," allowing users to run multiple applications (like a browser, Word, and music player) at the same time.

2) is Incorrect. Windows is famous for its GUI (icons, windows, mouse). While it has a command line (CMD/PowerShell), it is not a "command-line only" OS like early MS-DOS.

3) is Correct. As an operating system, it acts as the interface between the software and the hardware, managing the CPU, RAM, and storage.

Further Insights:

Windows was first introduced in 1985 as a graphical shell for MS-DOS.

questions.question: ______________ margin helps ensure that text isn't obscured by the binding.

questions.solution:
The gutter margin is a typographical term used to designate an additional margin added to a page layout to compensate for the part of the paper made unusable by the binding process.

A gutter margin adds extra space to the side margin, top margin, or inside margins of a document that you plan to bind. A gutter margin helps ensure that text isn't obscured by the binding.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about cookies:

1) Cookies store session and preference data.

2) Cookies can execute malicious programs.

Which statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
कुकीज़ के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) कुकीज़ सत्र और वरीयता डेटा संग्रहीत करती हैं।

2) कुकीज़ दुर्भावनापूर्ण प्रोग्राम चला सकती हैं।

इनमें से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because cookies are simple text files and lack the ability to execute code.

Explanation of Statements:

1) is Correct. Cookies are used by websites to remember "state" information - such as items in a shopping cart, login credentials, or user-selected themes/preferences.

2) is Incorrect. Cookies are passive data files. They cannot contain viruses or malware that "run" on your system because they are not executable programs.

Further Insights:

While not viruses, "Tracking Cookies" can be a privacy concern as they follow a user's browsing habits across different websites.

"Session Cookies" expire when the browser is closed, while "Persistent Cookies" remain until a set expiration date.

questions.question:
Consider the below statements about Firmware.

Statement 1: Firmware can be updated to fix bugs or add new features without replacing the hardware.

Statement 2: Firmware is considered a type of system software stored in volatile memory.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
फर्मवेयर के बारे में नीचे दिए गए कथनों पर विचार करें।

कथन 1: बग को ठीक करने या हार्डवेयर को बदले बिना नई सुविधाएँ जोड़ने के लिए फर्मवेयर को अपडेट किया जा सकता है।

कथन 2: फर्मवेयर को अस्थिर मेमोरी में संग्रहीत एक प्रकार का सिस्टम सॉफ़्टवेयर माना जाता है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Firmware is a type of system software embedded into hardware components and stored in non-volatile memory (like ROM or Flash memory).

It can be updated to fix bugs or add features, hence Statement 1 is correct, while Statement 2 is incorrect because firmware is not volatile.

questions.question: Which of the following cycles is the basic operation cycle of a computer?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा साइकल कंप्यूटर का मूल/बेसिक ऑपरेशन साइकल है?
questions.solution: An instruction cycle or CPU cycle (sometimes called a fetch-decode-execute cycle) is the basic operation cycle of a computer. It is the process by which a computer retrieves a program instruction from its memory, determines what actions the instruction requires, and carries out those actions.

questions.question: Which CPU architecture uses a single, powerful core supplemented by smaller, energy-efficient cores?
questions.question_hi: कौन-सा CPU आर्किटेक्चर छोटे, ऊर्जा-कुशल कोर द्वारा पूरक एकल, शक्तिशाली कोर का प्रयोग करता है?
questions.solution: The CPU architecture that uses a single, powerful core supplemented by smaller, energy-efficient cores is known as "Big.Little." This architecture is designed to improve energy efficiency in mobile devices and other systems where power consumption is a critical factor. The Big.Little architecture combines high-performance cores (big cores) with low-power cores (LITTLE cores), and the system can switch between them based on the workload demand. This allows the device to use the powerful cores for resource-intensive tasks and switch to the energy-efficient cores for less demanding or background tasks, optimizing both performance and power consumption.

questions.question: What is a "botnet" in the context of computer worms?
questions.question_hi: कंप्यूटर वर्म के संदर्भ में "बॉटनेट" क्या है?

options.label: A
options.text: A network of infected computers controlled by a central server
options.text_hi: संक्रमित कंप्यूटरों का एक नेटवर्क जो एक सेंट्रल सर्वर द्वारा नियंत्रित होता है

questions.correct_text: A network of infected computers controlled by a central server
questions.solution: In the context of computer worms, a "botnet" refers to a network of infected computers (often called "bots" or "zombies") that are under the control of a central server or a command-and-control (C&C) server. Botnets are typically used by cybercriminals to carry out various malicious activities, such as sending spam emails, launching distributed denial of service (DDoS) attacks, spreading malware, and conducting other forms of cyberattacks. The compromised computers within the botnet can be used collectively to carry out these activities without the owners' knowledge or consent.

questions.question: Probability of Ved hitting a target with an arrow is 80% and Probability of Dhairya missing a target with an arrow is 35%. If both of them fire an arrow independently, then what is the probability that only one miss the target?
questions.question_hi: वेद के एक तीर से लक्ष्य भेदने की प्रायिकता 80% है और धैर्य के तीर से लक्ष्य चूकने की प्रायिकता 35% है। यदि वे दोनों स्वतंत्र रूप से एक तीर चलाते हैं, तो केवल एक के निशाना चूकने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
questions.solution:
Probability of Ved hitting a target with an arrow is 80%. i.e., P(A) = 80% then P(A') = 20%

Probability of Dhairya missing a target with an arrow is 35%.. i.e., P(B') = 35%, then P(B) = 65%

Required probability = P(A') * P(B) + P(A) * P(B') = (20/100) * (65/100) + (80/100) * (35/100) = 41/100

questions.question: If (1 + cot x) = k cosec x, then find the value of (k2 − 1)/2.
questions.question_hi: यदि (1 + cot x) = k cosec x है, तो (k2 − 1)/2 का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
(1 + cot x) = k cosec x

=> 1/cosec x + cot x/cosec x = k

=> sin x + cos x = k

Squaring both sides

(sin x + cos x)2 = k2

=> sin2 x + cos2x + 2sin x cos x = k2

=> 1 + 2sin x cos x = k2

=> (sin x cos x)/sinx = (k2 − 1)/2/sinx

=> sin x cotx = (k2 − 1)/2/sinx

=> sin2 x cotx = (k2 − 1)/2

questions.question: The variance of 25 daily returns is 100. Each return x is transformed to y = −3x + 5. Find the new standard deviation.
questions.question_hi: 25 दैनिक रिटर्न का विचरण 100 है। प्रत्येक रिटर्न x को y = -3x + 5 में रूपांतरित किया जाता है। नया मानक विचलन ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Original standard deviation, σₓ = √variance = √100 = 10

Standard deviation is affected only by multiplication or division. If a variable is multiplied by a constant, the standard deviation also gets multiplied by the absolute value of that constant. However, addition or subtraction of any number does not change the standard deviation.

In the given transformation, the original variable is multiplied by 3 and then 5 is added. The multiplication by 3 will affect the standard deviation, while the addition of 5 will have no effect.

Therefore, the new standard deviation = 10 x 3 = 30

questions.question: In a right angled triangle ABC, D is the circumcenter which lies on AC. If BD = 6 cm and BC = 10 cm, then find the length of AB.

Now, using Pythagoras theorem, we get

AC2 = AB2 + BC2

122 = AB2 + 102

AB = 2√11 cm

questions.question: Mr. Shashi Prakash Singh borrows a sum of Rs. 70,000 from IDBI bank as a personal loan and decided to pay it in three annual installments. The rate of interest offered by IDBI for personal loans is 14% compounded annually. However, being a priority customer Shashi got to avail the loan at 2% less interest. The amount paid in the first and second installments are Rs. 30,000 and 32,000 respectively. The approximate amount (in Rupees) that needs to be paid by him after the 3rd year so that the loan gets repaid in totality is:
questions.question_hi: मिस्टर शशि प्रकाश सिंह आईडीबीआई बैंक से व्यक्तिगत ऋण के रूप में 70,000 रुपये की धनराशि उधार लेते हैं और इसे तीन वार्षिक किश्तों में भुगतान करने का निर्णय लेते है। व्यक्तिगत ऋणों के लिए आईडीबीआई द्वारा दी जाने वाली ब्याज की दर 14% वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होती है। हालाँकि, प्राथमिकता वाले ग्राहक होने के नाते शशि को 2% कम ब्याज की दर पर ऋण प्राप्त हुआ। पहली और दूसरी किस्त में भुगतान की गई धनराशि क्रमशः 30,000 रुपये और 32,000 रुपये हैं। ऋण को पूरी तरह से पुनर्भुगतान करने के लिए अनुमानित धनराशि (रुपयों में) कितना है, जिसे उन्हें तीसरे वर्ष के बाद भुगतान करने की आवश्यकता है?
questions.solution:
P = Rs. 70,000; R = 14% - 2% = 12%

Amount after 1st year = 70,000(1+12/100) = Rs. 78,400

Amount repaid after 1st year = Rs. 30,000

Amount left = Rs. 48,400

Amount after 2nd year = 48400(1+12/100) = 54,208

Amount repaid at the end of 2nd year = Rs. 32,000

So, amount left = 22,208

Amount to be repaid at the end of 3rd year = 22,208 (1+12/100) = Rs. 24,872.96

questions.question: In a circle, PQ is the diameter. Two points X and Y are on the circumference of the circle and are opposite side of diameter PQ. If ∠ PQX = 36°, then find ∠ XYQ.
questions.question_hi: एक वृत्त में, PQ व्यास है। X और Y वृत्त की परिधि पर स्थित दो बिंदु हैं तथा वे व्यास PQ के विपरीत दिशा में हैं। यदि ∠ PQX = 36° है, तो ∠ XYQ ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Since PQ is the diameter, so ∠ PXQ = 90° [angle in semicircle]

In Δ PXQ,

∠ XPQ = 180 - (∠ PXQ + ∠ XQP)

∠ XPQ = 180 - (90 + 36) = 54°

We know that angle subtended in same segments are equal.

So, ∠ XPQ = ∠ XYQ

Therefore, ∠ XYQ = 54°

questions.question: P and Q can do a piece of work in 10 days, Q and R in 30 days, and P and R in 40 days, they all worked together for 8 days. Then what percentage of the work would be left to be done?
questions.question_hi: P और Q एक कार्य को 10 दिनों में कर सकते हैं, Q और R 30 दिनों में कर सकते हैं और P और R 40 दिनों में कर सकते हैं। वे सभी 8 दिनों तक एक साथ कार्य करते हैं, तो कार्य का कितना प्रतिशत पूरा किया जाना शेष रह जायेगा?
questions.solution:
Let the total work = LCM of 10, 30, and 40 = 120 units

Efficiency of P and Q = 120/10 = 12 units per day

Efficiency of Q and R = 120/30 = 4 units per day

Efficiency of P and R = 120/40 = 3 units per day

2 * (P + Q + R) = 19

P + Q + R = 9.5

Work done by all three in 8 days = 9.5 * 8 = 76 units

Amount of work left = 120 - 76 = 44 units

Required percentage = 44 * 100/120 = 110/3%

questions.question: The value of a for which the expression x3 + x2 – 5x + a will be divisible by (x – 2) is:
questions.question_hi: 'a' का वह मान ज्ञात कीजिए जिससे x3 + x2 - 5x + a, (x - 2) से विभाज्य हो:
questions.solution:
"

(x – 2) is a factor of polynomial 

f(x) = x3 + x2 – 5x + a   

∴ f(2) = 0    

⇒ 23 + 22 – 5 × 2 + a = 0

questions.question: The average of a series of five numbers, in which each term is greater than its preceding term by 3, is 12. What is the value of the greatest term?
questions.question_hi: पाँच संख्याओं वाली एक शृंखला में प्रत्येक पद अपने पिछले पद से 3 अधिक है तथा उनका औसत 12 है, तो सबसे बड़े पद का मान कितना है?
questions.solution:
The average given is 12.

And there are only five terms. So, 12 must be the third term.

Now fifth term (greatest term) = 12 + 3 + 3 = 18

questions.question: The minimum value of some observation is 79 and range is 21, then what is the maximum value?

We know that,

Max value - Min value = Range

Max value = 21 + 79 = 100

questions.question: When an article is sold at 35 percent discount, then there is a loss of 9 percent. What should be the discount percent to earn a profit of 12 percent?
questions.question_hi: जब किसी वस्तु को 35 प्रतिशत छूट पर बेचा जाता है, तो 9 प्रतिशत की हानि होती है। 12 प्रतिशत का लाभ कमाने के लिए छूट प्रतिशत क्या होना चाहिए?
questions.solution:
Let cost price of article be Rs.100

Selling price at 9% loss = Rs.91

Marked price at 35% discount = 91 * 100/65 = Rs.140

New selling price = 100 * 112/100 = Rs.112

Discount% = (140 - 112) * 100/140

= 28 * 10/14

= 20%

questions.question: Find the total surface area of a cylinder whose diameter of base is 40 cm and height is 9 cm more than the radius of its base.
questions.question_hi: एक बेलन के आधार का व्यास 40 cm और उसकी ऊँचाई उसके आधार की त्रिज्या से 9 cm अधिक है, तो बेलन के संपूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Radius of base = 40/2 = 20 cm

Height = 20 + 9 = 29 cm

Total surface area of cylinder = 2 * π * radius * (radius + height)

= 2 * (22/7) * 20 * 49

= 44 * 140

= 6160 sq. cm

A group of men decided to do a work in 6 days but 15 men dropped out every day, the job was completed at the end of 9th day. Find the men who are in the work initially?
questions.question_hi: पुरुषों के एक समूह ने एक काम को 6 दिनों में पूरा करने का निर्णय लिया लेकिन प्रत्येक दिन 15 व्यक्ति काम छोड़ देते हैं और इस प्रकार काम 9वें दिन के अंत में पूरा होता है। प्रारंभ में काम करने वाले पुरुषों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए?
questions.solution:
Let total men = M

Total work = M × 6 = 6M.

ATQ.

M + (M – 15) + (M – 30)......

questions.solution:
Let the price of mixture be Rs. X per kg.

Using Alligation method,

(300 - X)/(X - 200) = 7/20

6000 - 20X = 7X - 1400

27X = 7400

X = 7400/27

X = 274.07

X = Rs.274

questions.question: Raghav cycling along the boundary of a rectangular park of length 124 m and width 90 m, completes one round of park in 8 minutes. What is the average speed of Raghav?

questions.question: A shopkeeper sold a bottle at 5% profit and a tray at 8% profit. If cost price of the bottle is ₹400 and the selling price of bottle and tray together is ₹2040, then find cost price of the tray.
questions.question_hi: एक दुकानदार ने एक बोतल 5% के लाभ पर और एक ट्रे, 8% के लाभ पर बेची। यदि बोतल का क्रय मूल्य ₹400 है तथा एक साथ बोतल और ट्रे का विक्रय मूल्य ₹2040 है, तो ट्रे का क्रय मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Let the cost price of the tray = ₹100a

Selling price of bottle and tray together = ₹2040

105% of 400 + 108% of 100a = 2040

108a = 2040 - 420 = 1620

a = 15

So, cost price of the tray = 100*15 = ₹1500

questions.question: A circle is inscribed in a quadrilateral LMNO. If LM = 8.6 cm, MN = 7.5 cm and NO = 9.2 cm, then what is the length of OL?
questions.question_hi: चतर्भुज LMNO में एक वृत्त उत्कीर्ण किया जाता है। यदि LM = 8.6 सेमी, MN = 7.5 सेमी और NO = 9.2 सेमी है, तो OL की लम्बाई कितनी है?
questions.solution:
We know that,

When a circle touches all the four sides of a quadrilateral LMNO, then

LM + NO = MN + OL

=> (8.6 + 9.2) = (7.5 + OL)

=> OL = 17.8 - 7.5

=> OL = 10.3 cm

questions.question: If the line y = 6x + 41 passes through (a, 5), then find the value of a.

questions.solution:
Since the line y = 6x + 41 passes through (a, 5),

then, by putting, x = a and y = 5

=> y = 6x + 41

=> 5 = 6a + 41

=> -36 = 6a

=> a = -6

options.label: B
options.text: Q is the niece of U.

P ^ Q ~ R * T ! U

P ^ Q means P is the mother of Q

Q ~ R means Q is the sister of R

Q is the niece of U.

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation.

216 * 18 * 10 * 15 * 2 = 32
questions.question_hi:
गणितीय चिह्नों के उस सही संयोजन का चयन कीजिए जो क्रमिक रूप से * चिह्नों को प्रतिस्थापित करेगा और दिए गए समीकरण को संतुलित करेगा।

216 * 18 * 10 * 15 * 2 = 32
questions.solution:
The given equation is 216 * 18 * 10 * 15 * 2 = 32

Option (a) If * signs are replaced by ÷, x, +, - then the equation will be

216 ÷ 18 x 10 + 15 - 2

= 12 x 10 + 15 - 2

= 120 + 15 - 2

= 135 - 2

= 133.

So, option (a) is incorrect.

Option (b) If * signs are replaced by ÷, x, - , + then the equation will be

216 ÷ 18 x 10 - 15 + 2

= 12 x 10 - 15 + 2

= 120 - 15 + 2

= 122 - 15

= 107

So, option (b) is incorrect.

Option (c) If * signs are replaced by ÷, +, - , x then the equation will be

216 ÷ 18 + 10 - 15 x 2

= 12 + 10 - 30

= 22 - 30

= - 8

So, option (c) is incorrect.

Option (d) If * signs are replaced by ÷, - , +, x then the equation will be

216 ÷ 18 - 10 + 15 x 2

= 12 - 10 + 30

= 42 - 10 = 32

So, option (d) is correct.

III. All time is era

कुछ time, period है

कुछ period, era है

सभी era, generation है

निष्कर्ष:

I. कुछ generation, period है

II. कोई time, era नहीं है

III. सभी time, era है

options.label: A

options.label: D

questions.solution:
Some generation is period: Some period is era and all era is generation. Thus, some generation is period. So, conclusion I is true.

There is a possibility that some time is era because some period is time and some period is era and also a possibility of no time is era. So, conclusion II and conclusion III are false.

All and No is not a complimentary pair. Hence, only conclusion I is true.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The guidelines for the new software implementation have been meticulously followed by the project manager.

options.label: A
options.text: The project manager has been meticulously following the guidelines for the new software implementation.

options.label: B
options.text: The project manager meticulously followed the guidelines for the new software implementation.

options.label: C
options.text: The project manager has meticulously followed the guidelines for the new software implementation.

options.label: D
options.text: The project manager was meticulously following the guidelines for the new software implementation.

questions.correct_text: The project manager has meticulously followed the guidelines for the new software implementation.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" verb [been] and the preposition 'by' is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

The Passive voice in this question is in Present Perfect tense. Thus, the Active voice will also be in Present Perfect.

In Passive voice, the format is: Object of the Active voice (Subjective case) + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject of the Active voice (Objective case).

Thus, the format of Active voice is: Subject + has/have + V3 + Object.

For example:

A new horse has been bought by Arya. (Passive Voice)

Arya has bought a new horse. (Active Voice)

The options except (c) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: "The project manager has meticulously followed the guidelines for the new software implementation."

Hence, option (c) is correct.

questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

The old man retired from his job and lived away the rest of his days in his suburban villa.
questions.solution:
Option a) is the right answer.

"Lived out" is the correct phrasal verb here. It means to spend the remaining part of one's life in a particular way or place, which fits the context of the sentence perfectly.

"Lived away" is not a standard phrasal verb in this context. It may sound like he went away to live somewhere, but it's not standard English.

"Lived by" means to follow or be guided by something (e.g., "He lived by his principles"), which doesnt fit here.

"Lived off" means to survive on resources or someone's income (e.g., "He lived off his pension"), but its not appropriate for describing how someone spent their final years in a place.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

He said that he had completed the science project the previous day and would submit it the next morning.

options.label: A
options.text: He said, "I completed the science project yesterday and will submit it tomorrow morning."

options.label: B
options.text: He said, "I have completed the science project yesterday and would submit it next morning."

options.label: C
options.text: He said, "I had completed the science project the previous day and will submit it the next morning."

options.label: D
options.text: He said, "I completed the science project the previous day and will submit it tomorrow."

questions.correct_text: He said, "I completed the science project yesterday and will submit it tomorrow morning."
questions.solution:
The given sentence is in indirect speech with Past Perfect ("had completed") and future in the past ("would submit"). When converting to direct speech, the tense is not changed by a fixed rule; rather, it is restored to the speaker's original words based on context and natural usage.

Here, the action (completion of the project) is clearly finished in the past, so Simple Past ("completed") is appropriate. Similarly, "would submit" changes to "will submit" as it reflects the speaker's future intention at the time of speaking.

Other changes include:

"the previous day" → "yesterday"

"the next morning" → "tomorrow morning"

"he" → "I"

Among the given options, option (a) correctly restores the natural direct speech form.

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

The reporter said to me, "Why can't you tell me what happened yesterday?"

options.label: A
options.text: The reporter told me why I cannot tell him what happened the previous day.

options.label: B
options.text: The reporter told me why couldn't I tell him what had happened the previous day.

options.label: C
options.text: The reporter told me why I couldn't tell him what had happened the previous day.

options.label: D
options.text: The reporter told to me why I couldn't tell him what happened the previous day.

questions.correct_text: The reporter told me why I couldn't tell him what had happened the previous day.
questions.solution:
In the case of Interrogative sentences like this, "said" in Direct Speech is changed into "enquired (of)", "wanted to know", "asked", etc.

In Indirect speech, the verb is always placed after the subject, unlike in Direct Speech.

For example:

The teacher said to him, "What is your name?" (Direct Speech)

The teacher asked him what his name was. (Indirect Speech)

Also, the sentence in the Direct Speech is in the Past Simple tense. So, the tense in the Indirect Speech should be in the Past Perfect tense.

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

· The reporting verb 'said to' is changed into 'told'.

· 'Can't' is changed into 'couldn't'.

· The verb 'happened' (past simple tense) is changed into 'had happened' (past perfect tense).

· 'Yesterday' is changed into 'the previous day'.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (c): The reporter told me why I couldn't tell him what had happened the previous day.

questions.question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

The poor woman was disheartened when she went to the kitchen and saw that all the milk was wasted.
questions.solution:
In the case of an uncountable noun, 'the' is not used after 'all'.

For example: All sugar is wasted.

In the question, "milk" is an uncountable noun. So "the" after "all" should be removed to make the sentence grammatically correct.

Thus, the error is in option (c) - all the milk.

Therefore, the corrected form of the sentence is: The poor woman was disheartened when she went to the kitchen and saw that all milk was wasted.

Additional Information:

Uncountable nouns are the nouns that cannot be counted or usually are not counted, for example, light, water, milk, information, furniture, etc. They do not generally have a plural form and can't be preceded by 'a' or 'an'. questions.question:
Identify the segment in the sentence that contains a grammatical error.

When the jury were divided in its opinion, the decision was delayed and this caused widespread chaos among the people.

options.label: C
options.text: the decision was delayed and this caused

questions.solution:
The verb that agrees with the noun 'jury' follows the following conditions:

When sense of unity- singular

When sense of separation - plural

For example:

The jury was told that it was a sensitive case. (Expresses a sense of unity)

The jury were divided in their opinion. (Expresses a sense of separation)

In the question, it is stated that the "jury were divided". Thus, the determiner "its" is incorrect because it is singular. It should be replaced by a plural determiner. Thus, "their" will be the appropriate plural determiner in part (b) of the sentence.

Thus, the error is in option (b) - in its opinion.

Therefore, the corrected form of the sentence is: When the jury were divided in their opinion, the decision was delayed and this caused widespread chaos among the people.

Additional Information:

The subject is used to talk about the person or thing (a noun or pronoun) that does the action. So, the subject of a sentence is the person, place, thing, or idea that is performing the action.

Verbs are words that show action (sing), occurrence (develop), or state of being (exist). Almost every sentence requires a verb.

It should be kept in mind that a verb must agree with the subject, not the word or the phrase that describes the subject.

For example: The number of deaths due to Covid has increased recently. (Here, a singular verb "has" is used because it agrees with "number", which is the subject in this sentence.)

A determiner, also called determinative, is a word, phrase, or affix that occurs together with a noun or noun phrase and serves to express the reference of that noun or noun phrase in the context.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

She asked me why I had not informed her earlier about the change in schedule.

options.label: A
options.text: She said, "Why you did not inform me earlier about the change in schedule?"

options.label: B
options.text: She said, "Why did you not inform me earlier about the change in schedule?"

options.label: C
options.text: She said, "Why had you not informed me earlier about the change in schedule?"

options.label: D
options.text: She said, "Why you had not informed me earlier about the change in schedule?"

questions.correct_text: She said, "Why did you not inform me earlier about the change in schedule?"
questions.solution:
The sentence in the Indirect Speech is in Past Perfect Tense ("had not informed"). Therefore, the sentence in the Direct Speech will be converted into Simple Past Tense.

Past Perfect (Subject + had + V3 + Object) will be converted into Simple Past (Subject + V2 + Object).

For example:

She said that she had lost her keys. (Indirect Speech)

She said, "I lost my keys." (Direct Speech)

The following things in the sentence will change when changed from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:

"had not informed" →"did not inform"

"she" →"I"

"me" →"you"

The interrogative form will be restored (question form with auxiliary "did")

Therefore, the correct answer is:

(b) She said, "Why did you not inform me earlier about the change in schedule?"

Hence, option (b) is correct.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

The reporter said to the winner, "Do you want to say anything to your family back at home?"

options.label: D

questions.correct_text: The reporter asked the winner whether he wanted to say anything to his family back at home.
questions.solution:
In the case of Interrogative sentences like this, "said" in Direct Speech is changed into "enquired (of)", "wanted to know", "asked", etc.

In Indirect speech, the verb is always placed after the subject, unlike in Direct Speech.

If there is a question in the Direct Speech whose answer can come as "Yes" or "No" in the Indirect Speech, we should use the conjunctions "if" or "whether".

For example:

Ravi said to me, "Is she studying?" (Direct Speech)

Ravi asked me if she was studying. (Indirect Speech)

Also, the sentence in the Direct Speech is in the Simple Present tense. So, the tense in the Indirect Speech should be in the Simple Past tense.

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

· The reporting verb 'said to' is changed into 'asked'.

· The verb 'do want' (simple present) is changed into 'wanted' (simple past).

· The pronoun 'you' is changed into 'he'.

· The possessive determiner 'your' is changed into 'his'.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (c): The reporter asked the winner whether he wanted to say anything to his family back at home.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the following passage and answer the questions.

'If it's worth doing, it's worth doing well.' How many times did I hear that growing up? My parents were attempting to teach me (just in case I hadn't absorbed it from their actions) the importance of striving for excellence. They were encouraging what some psychologists call 'constructive perfectionism' or 'healthy perfectionism' - a personality trait that's associated with finding enjoyment and even fulfilment in life from doing things as well as you possibly can. With constructive or 'positive perfectionism', the focus is process-oriented; you learn from mistakes or even failure. It's generally considered a beneficial trait that's linked with being more conscientious and self-disciplined.

Yet perfectionism can have a darker side. The American academic and author Brené Brown defined this kind of perfectionism in her first book, The Gifts of Imperfection (2010), as 'a self-destructive and addictive belief system that fuels this primary thought: if I look perfect, live perfectly, and do everything perfectly, I can avoid or minimise the painful feelings of shame, judgment and blame.' This form of perfectionism, which is fuelled by inner shame that must be quelled, involves trying to constantly meet perceived expectations of what 'perfect' is. This perfectionism isn't fulfilling and it's far from enjoyable. Yet many people feel it's mandatory to look as if all is perfect. They believe that not to do so would imply imperfection.

This is what's known in the wider psychological literature as 'unhealthy perfectionism' or 'destructive perfectionism'. In this case, the purpose has nothing to do with process. It's goal-oriented. It's driven. It's pressured. And I believe it's increasingly contributing to mental health problems.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

For ­­­__ teacher to hit ___ child is not just morally wrong but also illegal.
questions.solution:
The most appropriate option to fill in the blanks is (a). The indefinite article "a" is used to refer to non-specific or unspecified nouns. The construction of the sentence aims to convey the idea that in general, the action of any teacher hitting any child is morally wrong and illegal. The use of the indefinite article ("a") emphasises that the sentence refers to any teacher and any child, not particular or specified individuals. The use of the definite article "the" before 'teacher' suggests a specific or previously mentioned teacher. This usage does not align with the context of the sentence. The article "an" is used before words that start with vowel sounds. However, the word "child" begins with a consonant sound. So, 'an' is not a suitable choice here. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

The complete sentence is: For a teacher to hit a child is not just morally wrong but also illegal.

NOTE:

A noun is a word used as the name of a person, place, or thing. Now consider the following sentences:

1) Mahesh is a clever boy.

2) A herd of cattle was grazing on the pastureland.

3) Honesty is the best policy.

An article is a word that comes before a noun to indicate whether it's specific or general.

Definite and indefinite articles: In the English language, we have one definite article 'the'; it refers to or introduces, a particular, specific noun. 'An' and 'a' are indefinite articles; they refer to, or introduce, an unspecified noun.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate phrasal verb to fill in the blank.

We had to ____ the party because of his health.
questions.solution:
The most appropriate phrasal verb to fill in the blank is 'call off'. 'Call off' means to cancel something that has been planned. In the context of the given sentence, it describes the cancellation of the party due to his health issues. Other phrasal verbs do not fit the context of the sentence. 'Pick up' means to lift something or to improve. 'Call back' means to return a phone call or to bring someone back. 'Call on' means to visit someone or to ask someone to do something. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

The complete sentence is: We had to call off the party because of his health.

Note:

Phrasal verb: A phrase that consists of a verb with a preposition or adverb or both, the meaning of which is different from the meaning of its separate parts. Example: She has always looked down on me. Here, the phrasal verb 'to look down on someone' doesn't mean that you are looking down from a higher place at someone who is below you; it means that you think that you are better than someone.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

They are cleaning the house for the party. They are also preparing the dinner.

options.label: A
options.text: The house is cleaned by them for the party. The dinner was also prepared by them.

options.label: B
options.text: The house has been cleaned by them for the party. The dinner has been also prepared for them.

options.label: C
options.text: The house was cleaned by them for the party. They also prepared the dinner.

options.label: D
options.text: The house is being cleaned by them for the party. The dinner is also being prepared by them.

questions.correct_text: The house is being cleaned by them for the party. The dinner is also being prepared by them.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive Voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

The usage of a "to be" form of verb is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

In Passive Voice, the preposition "by" is used before the object. However, it is optional in some cases.

The Active voice in this question is in Present Continuous. Thus, the Passive voice will also be in Present Continuous.

The format of Active voice is: Subject + am/is/are + V1 + ing + Object.

Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be: Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + am/is/are + being + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).

For example:

Arnab is typing a document. (Active Voice)

A document is being typed by Arnab. (Passive Voice)

The options except (d) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice. Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

questions.correct_text: The experienced teacher will have explained the complicated topic in a lucid manner.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the helping verb and the preposition 'by' is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

The Passive voice in this question is in Future Perfect. Thus, the Active voice will also be in Future Perfect.

In Passive voice, the format is: Subject (Objective case) + will/shall + have been + V3 + by + Object (Subjective case).

Thus, the format of Active voice is: Subject + will/shall + have + V3 + Object.

For example:

The gold will have been bought by her. (Passive Voice)

She will have bought the gold. (Active Voice)

The options except (d) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: (d) The experienced teacher will have explained the complicated topic in a lucid manner.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

Burnout is the highest among GenZs (18-25 years) in India and they are at the highest risk of resigning from work. It is increasingly decreasing with the older age groups. The study, 'Leadership and the War for Talent', based on a survey of over 2,000 Indian knowledge workers, found that a good 58% of the GenZ are burnt out, while the number is 54% for Millennials (26-41 years). It drops further to 49% and then 36% for GenX (42-57 years) and Baby Boomers (58-75 years), respectively. The trend is similar for age groups at risk of quitting as well. It's highest among GenZ (73%) and progressively drops to 66%, 58% and 43%, respectively. This comes as the world of work sees new terms such as the Great Resignation, Quiet Quitting enter the lexicon after the pandemic. A new research, conducted by Honeycomb Strategy, was based on responses from more than 2,000 Indian knowledge workers within organisations of 100+ employees. Retail employees are the most burnt out (59%) and are at the highest risk of quitting (69%). IT and Communications has the lowest burnout rate among knowledge workers at 51%, but they are equally at risk of quitting. The rate of burnout is almost the same across Retail and Government and Defence at 58-59%. More than 60% of employees across these industries are at the risk of quitting. It's a challenge that requires having the right digital infrastructure in place to remain productive and efficient, while also delivering a great employee experience. A digital headquarters brings an entire organisation together to communicate, collaborate and solve problems, and it is also integral to employee engagement.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A: Strict laws are very important for the prevention of corruption.

B: Corruption weakens trust, hampers economic development, erodes democracy, and further worsens pre-existing conditions like poverty, inequality, environmental crisis, and social division.

C: It can be prevented even if not stopped.

D: Guilty individuals should be given tough punishment, and the laws should be efficient and quickly implemented.
questions.solution:
Sentence B introduces the subject 'corruption', so, it should be the 1st sentence. Sentence B talks about the pre-existing condition which cannot be changed suddenly. So, sentence C has the correct statement after sentence B that at least it should be prevented. So, it should be the 2nd sentence and what steps we can take is mentioned in sentence A, making it the 3rd sentence after rearrangement. 'The laws' mentioned in sentence D shows that this sentence is talking in continuation with sentence A. So, 'D' is the last sentence after rearrangement.

The correct sequence is BCAD.

Hence, option (c) is the correct choice.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

P. Instead it has left this important provision open ended.

Q. The union Labour ministry has stayed away from making it part of the wage code bill.

R. India will not have a single mandatory minimum wage floor as talked earlier.

S. The labour ministry's decision comes following criticism that its national floor is less than half of what was suggested by an internal committee.
questions.solution:
R comes first, as it informs us that there will not be single minimum wage floor. Q comes second, as it tells us why this is the case. P comes third, telling us what the labour ministry has done instead of this provision. S comes last, as it tells us what made the ministry take its decision. RQPS is the correct sequence.

Alternate solution:

P and Q can't be the first sentence as they both have the pronoun 'it' and 'it' is used to refer to a thing previously mentioned or easily identified. S also can't be the first sentence as the term 'the labour ministry's decision' needs a reference. Only R is fit to be the first sentence. This eliminates options a), b) and c).

So, option d) is correct.

B. Most species are native to the Northern Hemisphere and their range is temperate climates and extends into the subtropics.

questions.solution:
After thoroughly reading the sentences, we can conclude that sentence D introduces Lilium as a genus of flowering plants, and sentence C follows logically, discussing the cultural and literary importance of lilies. Together, they lay the foundation for the topic. B and A also form a pair as sentence B provides information about the geographical range of lilies, and sentence A clarifies that many plants with "lily" in their names are not true lilies, making a distinction about the genus.

The correct order of sentences is DCBA. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

questions.question:

A. Many Indigenous communities, who have lived in harmony with nature for generations, are being displaced, their homes and livelihoods destroyed as logging companies push deeper into once-pristine forests.

B. Scientists warn that if deforestation continues at its current pace, we could lose entire species before they are even discovered, along with vital natural resources needed for human survival.

C. The rapid deforestation taking place around the world is not only causing irreversible damage to biodiversity but also accelerating the effects of climate change, putting countless ecosystems at risk of collapse.

D. Governments and environmental organizations are struggling to find effective solutions to balance economic development with the urgent need to preserve the planet's remaining forests for future generations.
questions.solution:
• After reading the sentence, it can be noted that C has to be the first sentence because it introduces the theme of discussion which is 'deforestation'.

• It is followed by sentence A, in which the primary effect of deforestation is mentioned.

• Sentence B starts a new point by stating the warning given by scientists against deforestation and what it might lead to.

• So, this has to follow sentence A; and sentence D talks about the struggle that governments and organizations face in taking effective solutions against deforestation and creating a balance between economic development and environmental conservation. So, the final order is CABD.

Hence, the correct answer is option (b).

questions.question:
Under Article 368, consider the following statements:

I. An amendment changing the manner of election of the President requires ratification by not less than half of the States.

II. An amendment altering the Seventh Schedule (e.g., adding a subject to the Concurrent List) requires ratification by not less than half of the States.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
अनुच्छेद 368 के तहत, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. राष्ट्रपति के चुनाव के तरीके को बदलने वाले संशोधन के लिए कम से कम आधे राज्यों द्वारा अनुसमर्थन की आवश्यकता होती है।

II. सातवीं अनुसूची में परिवर्तन करने वाले संशोधन (जैसे, समवर्ती सूची में एक विषय जोड़ना) के लिए कम से कम आधे राज्यों द्वारा अनुसमर्थन की आवश्यकता होती है।

उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा कथन सही है / हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Both statements are correct. Both the election of the President and any change to the distribution of legislative powers in the Seventh Schedule are considered to be part of the federal structure of the Constitution. Therefore, any amendment to these provisions requires the more rigid procedure of ratification by the states in addition to a special majority in Parliament.

Explanation of Statements:

I is Correct. The procedure for the election of the President (Article 54 and 55) is one of the provisions that affects the federal character of the Constitution, as both the Union and the States participate in the election. According to Article 368(2), any amendment to these articles must be passed by a special majority in both Houses of Parliament and must also be ratified by the legislatures of not less than one-half of the states by a simple majority.

II is Correct. The Seventh Schedule contains the Union List, State List, and Concurrent List, which define the distribution of legislative powers between the Union and the States. This is a core element of India's federal system. Any amendment that seeks to alter this distribution (e.g., by moving a subject from one list to another) falls under the purview of Article 368(2) and requires the same procedure of ratification by at least half of the states after being passed by a special majority in Parliament.

questions.question:
Consider the following statement regrading 'oxidation'.

I. Oxidation involves loss of electron and reduction involves gain of electron.

II. There is no oxidation without reduction and there is no reduction without oxidation.
questions.question_hi:
'ऑक्सीकरण' के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए।

I. ऑक्सीकरण में इलेक्ट्रॉन की हानि शामिल है और अपचयन में इलेक्ट्रॉन की प्राप्ति शामिल है।

II. अपचयन के बिना कोई ऑक्सीकरण नहीं होता है और ऑक्सीकरण के बिना कोई अपचयन नहीं होता है।

options.label: C
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Let's analyze each statement:

I. Oxidation involves loss of electron and reduction involves gain of electron. This is a fundamental definition of oxidation and reduction in terms of electron transfer (often remembered by the mnemonic OIL RIG: Oxidation Is Loss, Reduction Is Gain). (Correct)

II. There is no oxidation without reduction and there is no reduction without oxidation. This is also correct. Oxidation and reduction are complementary processes that always occur simultaneously in a redox (reduction-oxidation) reaction. If one substance loses electrons (is oxidized), another substance must gain those electrons (is reduced).

Therefore, Both I and II are correct statements regarding oxidation (and reduction).

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Rig Veda.

I. It contains treatment for various diseases.

II. It is known as the Brahma Veda.

III. It provides the knowledge about economic condition of ancient India.

Which among the above statements is/are INCORRECT?
questions.question_hi:
ऋग्वेद के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. इसमें विभिन्न रोगों का उपचार शामिल है।

II. इसे ब्रह्म वेद के रूप में जाना जाता है।

III. यह प्राचीन भारत की आर्थिक स्थिति के बारे में ज्ञान प्रदान करता है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से कथन गलत है/हैं?

options.label: A
options.text: None of the given statements are correct.
options.text_hi: दिए गए कथनों में से कोई भी सही नहीं है।

questions.solution:
The Vedas are the earliest known literature in India. The Vedas were written in Sanskrit and were handed down orally from one generation to the other. There are four Vedas, namely, the- Rig Veda, Yajur Veda, Sama Veda, and Atharva Veda.

Rigveda

I. It is the earliest of the Vedas. It is a collection of 1028 hymns in Vedic Sanskrit. Many of these are beautiful descriptions of nature.

II. The prayers are largely for seeking worldly prosperity

III. It is believed that these recitations are the natural outpouring of Vedic rishis experiencing a mentally transcendental stage.

IV. Some of the well-known rishis associated with Rigveda are Vasishta, Gautama, Vishwamitra, and Atri, etc.

V. Rig Veda provides us knowledge about social, political and economic condition of ancient India. So, statement III is correct.

Yajur Veda

I. Yajur means sacrifice or worship. This Veda is concerned mostly with rites and mantras of different sacrifices.

II. It gives directions for the performance of the yajnas.

III. Being a treatise on rituals, it is the most popular of the four Vedas.

Sama Veda

I. Sama Veda consists of 16,000 ragas and raginis or musical notes.

II. The Sama Veda prescribes the tunes for the recitation of the hymns of the Rig Veda.

Atharva Veda

I. The Atharva Veda is also known as the Brahma Veda. It contains treatment for around ninety-nine diseases. So, statements I and II are not correct.

II. The source of this Veda is traced to two rishis called Atharva and Angiras.

III. The Atharva Veda is of immense value as it represents the religious ideas at an early period of civilization.

questions.question:
Which one of the following conditions are required for getting recognition as a State Party in India?

I. Party has to win minimum 6% of the seats in the legislative assembly of the State.

II. Party has to win 1 loksabha seat out of every 25 Loksabha seats.

III. Party has to poll 8% of the votes in the state.

Select the answer using the codes given below:
questions.question_hi:
भारत में राज्य पार्टी के रूप में मान्यता प्राप्त करने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी शर्त आवश्यक है?

I. पार्टी को राज्य की विधान सभा में न्यूनतम 6% सीटें जीतनी होंगी।

II. पार्टी को प्रत्येक 25 लोकसभा सीटों में से 1 लोकसभा सीट जीतनी होगी।

III. पार्टी को राज्य में 8% वोट प्राप्त करने होंगे।

नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके उत्तर चुनें:
questions.solution:
A political party shall be treated as a recognised political party in a State, if and only if the political party fulfils any of the following conditions:

Statement I is incorrect: At General Elections or Legislative Assembly elections, the party has won minimum 3% of seats in the legislative assembly of the State (subject to a minimum of 3 seats).

Statement II and III are correct.

At a Lok Sabha General Elections, the party has won 1 Lok sabha seat for every 25 Lok Sabha seat allotted for the State.

At a General Election to Lok Sabha or Legislative Assembly, the party has polled minimum of 6% of votes in a State and in addition it has won 1 Lok Sabha or 2 Legislative Assembly seats.

At a General Election to Lok Sabha or Legislative Assembly, the party has polled 8% of votes in a State.

For National Status:

The party wins 2% of seats in the Lok Sabha (11 seats) from at least 3 different States.

At a General Election to Lok Sabha or Legislative Assembly, the party polls 6% of votes in four States and in addition it wins 4 Lok Sabha seats.

A party gets recognition as State Party in four or more States.

Both national and state parties have to fulfill these conditions for all subsequent Loksabha or State elections. Else, they lose their status.

Source: PIB

questions.question:
To promote equity in agriculture, the policies implemented by India after independence include:

I. Land Reforms

II. Land Ceiling.

III. Contract farming.

IV. Commercialization.

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
questions.question_hi:
कृषि में समानता को बढ़ावा देने के लिए, स्वतंत्रता के बाद भारत द्वारा लागू की गई नीतियों में शामिल हैं:

I. भूमि सुधार

II. भूमि सीमा।

III. अनुबंध खेती।

IV. व्यावसायीकरण।

नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनें।
questions.solution:
Equity in agriculture called for land reforms which primarily refer to change in the ownership of landholdings. Just a year after independence, steps were taken to abolish intermediaries and to make the tillers the owners of land. The idea behind this move was that ownership of land would give incentives to the tillers to invest in making improvements provided sufficient capital was made available to them.

Land ceiling was another policy to promote equity in the agricultural sector. This means fixing the maximum size of land which could be owned by an individual. The purpose of land ceiling was to reduce the concentration of land ownership in a few hands.

Source: Indian Economic Development-Class-XI (NCERT)

questions.question:
Evaluate the following statements about Plant Growth Regulators (PGRs):

I. Auxins, gibberellins, and cytokinins are categorized as plant growth promoters.

II. Abscisic acid (ABA) is known as the "stress hormone" because it helps plants tolerate stress by stimulating the closure of stomata.

III. Ethylene, a gaseous PGR, promotes the ripening of fruits and the abscission (falling) of leaves and flowers.

Which combination of statements is correct?
questions.question_hi:
पादप वृद्धि नियामकों (PGRs) के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों का मूल्यांकन करें:

I. ऑक्सिन, जिबरेलिन और साइटोकाइनिन को पादप वृद्धि प्रवर्तक के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है।

II. एब्सिसिक एसिड (ABA) को "तनाव हार्मोन" के रूप में जाना जाता है क्योंकि यह रंध्रों के बंद होने को उत्तेजित करके पौधों को तनाव सहन करने में मदद करता है।

III. एथिलीन, एक गैसीय PGR, फलों के पकने और पत्तियों और फूलों के विच्छिन्न (गिरने) को बढ़ावा देता है।

कथनों का कौन सा संयोजन सही है?
questions.solution:
Statement I is correct. Auxins, gibberellins, and cytokinins are involved in growth-promoting activities such as cell division, enlargement, and flowering.

Statement II is correct. Abscisic acid (ABA) increases the tolerance of plants to various stresses and stimulates stomatal closure, which is why it is called the stress hormone.

Statement III is correct. Ethylene is highly effective in promoting fruit ripening and also promotes senescence and abscission of plant organs like leaves and flowers.

questions.question:
Regarding RBI's monetary policy instruments, consider the following:

1. An increase in CRR immediately reduces banks' lendable resources and does not earn interest.

2. SLR can be maintained in cash, gold, and specified approved securities, typically earning interest on G-Secs.

Which of the above is true?
questions.question_hi:
आरबीआई के मौद्रिक नीति उपकरणों के संबंध में, निम्नलिखित पर विचार करें:

1. सीआरआर में वृद्धि से बैंकों के उधार देने योग्य संसाधन तुरंत कम हो जाते हैं और ब्याज नहीं मिलता है।

2. एसएलआर को नकदी, सोने और निर्दिष्ट अनुमोदित प्रतिभूतियों में बनाए रखा जा सकता है, आमतौर पर जी-सेक पर ब्याज अर्जित किया जा सकता है।

उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा सत्य है?
questions.solution:
Both statements are correct. They accurately describe the nature and impact of two of the Reserve Bank of India's key statutory reserve requirements: the Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) and the Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR).

Explanation of Statements:

1 is Correct. The Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) is the percentage of a commercial bank's Net Demand and Time Liabilities (NDTL) that it must mandatorily keep as cash reserves with the RBI.

Reduces Lendable Resources: When the RBI increases the CRR, banks have to set aside a larger portion of their deposits, which directly reduces the amount of money they have available to lend to customers. This is a direct tool to contract the money supply.

Does Not Earn Interest: The reserves kept with the RBI under the CRR requirement do not earn any interest for the commercial banks. This makes CRR a powerful but blunt instrument, as it directly impacts bank profitability.

2 is Correct. The Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) is the percentage of NDTL that a commercial bank must maintain in the form of safe and liquid assets before providing credit to customers.

Forms of Assets: Statement correctly lists the eligible forms. SLR can be maintained as cash (in the bank's own vault), gold, or investments in unencumbered, approved securities. These approved securities are predominantly Government Securities (G-Secs) and State Development Loans (SDLs).

Earns Interest: Unlike CRR, the assets held under SLR, particularly government securities, do earn interest for the banks. This makes SLR a less punitive tool than CRR, as it does not directly hit bank profitability in the same way.

Further insights:

Quantitative Tools: Both CRR and SLR are quantitative (or general) tools of monetary policy. By adjusting these ratios, the RBI can directly influence the credit-creating capacity of the banking system, thereby controlling the overall money supply in the economy.

Current Status: Over the years, the RBI has progressively lowered the SLR to align with market-based reforms and to free up more funds for banks to lend to the commercial sector. The CRR is used more actively to manage short-term liquidity conditions in the system.

questions.question: In standard FIBA rules, which of the following is the correct shot clock duration that resets when the ball hits the rim?
questions.question_hi: मानक FIBA नियमों में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही शॉट क्लॉक अवधि है जो गेंद के रिम से टकराने पर रीसेट होती है?
questions.solution:
Under FIBA rules, the shot clock resets to 14 seconds (not the full 24) when the ball contacts the rim on an unsuccessful shot attempt.

The 14-second reset rule was introduced by FIBA to speed up play. In NBA, the shot clock resets to 14 seconds after an offensive rebound off the rim, which mirrors this FIBA provision.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Product or Value-added method in income accounting.

I. It is estimated by measuring the aggregate value of final goods and services produced by all the firms.

II. Factor payments like the wages, interest, profits and rents paid are not included in this method.

Which of the following is/ are correct?
questions.question_hi:
आय लेखांकन में उत्पाद या मूल्य-वर्धित विधि के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. इसका अनुमान सभी फर्मों द्वारा उत्पादित अंतिम वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के कुल मूल्य को मापकर लगाया जाता है।

II. इस विधि में मजदूरी, ब्याज, लाभ और किराए जैसे कारक भुगतान शामिल नहीं हैं।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Product method is the measuring the aggregate value of final goods and services produced by all the firms. It considers only the value added to an item. The value added by a firm is Value of production of the firm minus the value of intermediate goods used. Hence, statement 1 is correct.

The value added by the firm is distributed among its factors of production by means of wages, interests, profits and rents paid and adds up to value added of the firm. Hence, Statement 2 is incorrect.

questions.question:
Consider the statements and choose the correct one(s).

1. Arthropods possess jointed appendages and an exoskeleton composed largely of chitin.

2. Annelids typically have a true coelom and many exhibit a closed circulatory system.

3. Both arthropods and annelids are segmented, but segmentation is more clearly metameric in annelids.
questions.question_hi:
कथनों पर विचार करें और सही कथन चुनें।

1. आर्थ्रोपोड्स में संयुक्त उपांग और एक एक्सोस्केलेटन होता है जो बड़े पैमाने पर काइटिन से बना होता है।

2. एनेलिड्स में आमतौर पर एक वास्तविक सीलोम होता है और कई एक बंद परिसंचरण तंत्र प्रदर्शित करते हैं।

3. आर्थ्रोपोड्स और एनेलिड्स दोनों खंडित होते हैं, लेकिन एनेलिड्स में विभाजन अधिक स्पष्ट रूप से मेटामेरिक होता है।
questions.solution:
All three statements are correct. They accurately describe the key defining characteristics of the phyla Arthropoda and Annelida and the nature of segmentation in both groups.

Explanation of Statements:

1 is Correct. This statement lists the two most distinctive features of the phylum Arthropoda. The name itself means "jointed foot," referring to their jointed appendages (legs, antennae, mouthparts). Their body is covered by a hard, protective outer layer called an exoskeleton, which is primarily composed of chitin, a tough polysaccharide.

2 is Correct. This statement accurately describes key features of the phylum Annelida (segmented worms like earthworms and leeches). They are coelomates, meaning they possess a true coelom (a body cavity completely lined with mesoderm). This allows for more complex organ systems. Many annelids, particularly active ones like earthworms, have a closed circulatory system, where blood is confined within vessels, allowing for more efficient transport of oxygen and nutrients compared to an open system.

3 is Correct. Both phyla exhibit segmentation, the division of the body into a series of repeating units. However, the nature of this segmentation differs.

In annelids, the segmentation is metameric, meaning the segments are largely identical and there is a serial repetition of internal organs (like nephridia and ganglia) in each segment. This is very clear externally and internally.

In arthropods, while the body is fundamentally segmented, there is a strong tendency for segments to fuse into specialized body regions called tagmata (e.g., the head, thorax, and abdomen of an insect). This process, known as tagmosis, makes the segmentation less uniform and repetitive than in annelids. Therefore, the statement that segmentation is more clearly metameric in annelids is correct.

Further insights:

The presence of segmentation in both annelids and arthropods was once thought to indicate a close evolutionary relationship. However, modern genetic and molecular evidence suggests that they belong to different major clades of protostomes (Annelida to Lophotrochozoa, and Arthropoda to Ecdysozoa) and that segmentation likely evolved independently in the two lineages (convergent evolution).

Arthropods have an open circulatory system, where blood (hemolymph) is pumped into a body cavity (hemocoel), which is a key difference from the closed system of many annelids.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Biodiversity Hotspots in India:

a. India has a total of four biodiversity hotspots.

b. The Eastern Himalaya and Western Ghats are included among them.

c. The Indo-Gangetic plains and Thar Desert are also classified as biodiversity hotspots.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में जैव विविधता हॉटस्पॉट के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

a. भारत में कुल चार जैव विविधता हॉटस्पॉट हैं।

b. पूर्वी हिमालय और पश्चिमी घाट उनमें शामिल हैं।

c. सिंधु-गंगा के मैदान और थार रेगिस्तान को भी जैव विविधता हॉटस्पॉट के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है।

ऊपर दिए गए कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements a and b are correct, while statement c is incorrect.

India is home to four global biodiversity hotspots, which include the Eastern Himalaya and the Western Ghats.

The Indo-Gangetic plains and the Thar Desert, while being important ecological regions, do not meet the specific criteria to be classified as biodiversity hotspots.

Explanation of Statements:

Statement a is correct. India is a mega-diverse country and is home to parts of four of the 36 globally recognized biodiversity hotspots. These are:

The Himalayas

The Western Ghats

The Indo-Burma region

Sundaland

Statement b is correct. The Eastern Himalaya and the Western Ghats are two of the most well-known and significant biodiversity hotspots in India, renowned for their high levels of species richness and endemism.

Statement c is incorrect. To be classified as a biodiversity hotspot, a region must meet two strict criteria: it must contain at least 1,500 species of vascular plants as endemics (found nowhere else), and it has to have lost at least 70% of its original habitat. The Indo-Gangetic plains and the Thar Desert do not meet the criterion of exceptionally high plant endemism required for this classification.

Further insights:

The Indo-Burma Hotspot: This region includes most of North-East India (excluding Assam and the Andaman Islands), Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam, Laos, Cambodia, and southern China.

The Sundaland Hotspot: In India, this hotspot is represented by the Nicobar Islands. The region also includes parts of Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Brunei, and the Philippines.

The concept of biodiversity hotspots was first developed by scientist Norman Myers in 1988 and was later adopted and refined by Conservation International. This concept helps prioritize conservation efforts by focusing on regions that are both incredibly rich in life and under severe threat.

questions.question: The 'Nagara', 'Dravida', and 'Vesara' styles are the three principal categories of Indian temple architecture. Which of the following correctly describes the Vesara style?
questions.question_hi: 'नागरा', 'द्रविड़', और 'वेसर' शैलियाँ भारतीय मंदिर वास्तुकला की तीन प्रमुख श्रेणियाँ हैं। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी वेसर शैली का सही वर्णन करती है?

options.label: A
options.text: A purely Dravidian style concentrated exclusively in Tamil Nadu and Kerala
options.text_hi: एक शुद्ध द्रविड़ शैली जो केवल तमिलनाडु और केरल में केंद्रित है

options.label: B
options.text: A hybrid style combining Nagara and Dravida elements, predominantly found in the Deccan region
options.text_hi: एक मिश्रित शैली जो नागर और द्रविड़ तत्वों को मिलाती है, जो मुख्य रूप से दक्कन क्षेत्र में पाई जाती है

options.label: C
options.text: A northern style characterised by a curvilinear shikhara and an absence of gopurams
options.text_hi: एक उत्तरी शैली जो एक वक्राकार शिखर और गोपुरम की अनुपस्थिति से पहचानी जाती है

options.label: D
options.text: A Buddhist-influenced style confined to the rock-cut cave temples of Maharashtra
options.text_hi: महाराष्ट्र के शिला-कट गुफा मंदिरों तक सीमित एक बौद्ध-प्रभावित शैली

questions.correct_text: A hybrid style combining Nagara and Dravida elements, predominantly found in the Deccan region
questions.solution:
Vesara ("hybrid") blends the curvilinear shikhara of Nagara with the horizontal tiers of Dravida. The Chalukyan and Hoysala temples of Karnataka are prime examples.

The Hoysaleswara Temple at Halebidu and the Durga Temple at Aihole are celebrated examples of Vesara architecture. The Chalukyas of Badami are credited with its early development.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the World Development Report (WDR):

1. It is published annually by the World Bank.

2. Each edition focuses on a specific theme related to economic development.

3. The 2025 edition was themed "The Middle Income Trap."

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
विश्व विकास रिपोर्ट (WDR) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. इसे विश्व बैंक द्वारा वार्षिक रूप से प्रकाशित किया जाता है।

2. प्रत्येक संस्करण आर्थिक विकास से संबंधित एक विशिष्ट विषय पर केंद्रित होता है।

3. 2025 का संस्करण "मध्यम आय जाल" थीम पर आधारित था।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
The World Development Report has been published annually by the World Bank since 1978.

Each WDR edition is dedicated to a specific development theme - past themes have included poverty, governance, gender, digital dividends, and conflict.

The WDR 2025 theme was 'Standards for Development' and the WDR 2024 was titled "The Middle Income Trap".

The World Bank's World Development Report 2025: Standards for Development outlines how measurement, compatibility, and quality standards act as the invisible infrastructure of modern economies. These three dimensions drive market integration, technology diffusion, and risk reduction.

The three dimensions of standards World Development Report 2025 identifies three critical functions of standards:

Measurement: Consistency in measurement that is essential for building, testing, and certification

Compatibility: Interoperability and substitutability that power scale and order

Quality: Baselines for performance, safety, and reliability

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the speed of the sound.

I. The speed of sound increases when it moves from solid to gaseous medium.

II. The speed of sound is proportional to the temperature in a medium.

Which among the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
ध्वनि की गति के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. ठोस से गैसीय माध्यम में जाने पर ध्वनि की गति बढ़ जाती है।

II. ध्वनि की गति माध्यम में तापमान के समानुपाती होती है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Sound propagates through a medium at a finite speed. It travels with a speed which is much less than the speed of light. The speed of sound depends on the properties of the medium through which it travels and depends on the temperature of the medium.

Statement I is incorrect: The speed of the sound decreases when it goes from solid to a gaseous state.

Statement II is correct: In any medium, as the temperature is increased, the speed of sound also increases and vice versa.

Source: NCERT- IX

questions.question: Which security feature uses a "Public Key" to encrypt data and a "Private Key" to decrypt it?
questions.question_hi: कौन सा सुरक्षा फीचर डेटा को एन्क्रिप्ट करने के लिए "पब्लिक की" और उसे डिक्रिप्ट करने के लिए "प्राइवेट की" का उपयोग करता है?
questions.solution:
The use of a Public Key for encryption and a Private Key for decryption is known as Asymmetric Encryption.

Explanation of Terms:

· Symmetric Encryption: Uses the same single key for both encryption and decryption.

· Asymmetric Encryption: Also known as Public Key Cryptography. The Public key is shared with everyone to encrypt data, but only the owner of the matching Private key can decrypt it.

· Hashing: A one-way process that turns data into a fixed-length string; it cannot be decrypted.

Further Insights:

· RSA is the most famous algorithm for asymmetric encryption, used widely in securing web browsing (HTTPS).

questions.question: Which worm is also known as the Great Worm?
