questions.solution:
· The Morris worm has sometimes been referred to as the "Great Worm", due to the devastating effect it had on the Internet at that time, both in overall system downtime and in psychological impact on the perception of security and reliability of the Internet.

· The Morris worm was a worm designed by Robert Tappan Morris that was released on November 2nd, 1988.

· A bug in his code infected systems throughout the internet at a faster pace than Morris originally expected, and his worm ended up infecting an estimated 10 percent of the internet.

· The end result was major damage and widespread outages.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about primary memory:

1) Primary memory is directly accessible by the CPU.

2) Primary memory retains data even when power is off.

3) RAM is an example of primary memory.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
प्राथमिक मेमोरी के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) प्राथमिक मेमोरी CPU द्वारा सीधे एक्सेस की जा सकती है।

2) प्राथमिक मेमोरी बिजली बंद होने पर भी डेटा को सुरक्षित रखती है।

3) RAM प्राथमिक मेमोरी का एक उदाहरण है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because RAM (the most common primary memory) is volatile and loses its data when power is lost.

Explanation of Statements:

· 1. is Correct. Primary memory is located close to the CPU on the motherboard, allowing the processor to access it directly and rapidly via the data bus.

· 2. is Incorrect. Most primary memory, specifically RAM, is volatile. It requires a constant electrical charge to maintain the data stored within it. Permanent storage is the role of secondary memory (like SSDs).

· 3. is Correct. RAM (Random Access Memory) is the quintessential example of primary memory used to store data currently being used by active programs.

Further Insights:

· ROM (Read Only Memory) is also a type of primary memory, but unlike RAM, it is non-volatile and holds boot-up instructions.

questions.question: Which feature in MS Word automatically moves text to the next line when it reaches the right margin?
questions.question_hi: एमएस वर्ड में कौन सा फीचर है जो टेक्स्ट के दाहिने मार्जिन तक पहुँचने पर उसे स्वचालित रूप से अगली पंक्ति में ले जाता है?
questions.solution:
The feature that automatically moves text to the next line is Word Wrap.

Explanation of Features:

· Word Wrap: A standard word-processing feature that forces text to the next line when it reaches the right margin, so the user doesn't have to press 'Enter' manually.

· Auto-Text: A feature that stores frequently used text for quick insertion.

· Line Break: A manual break inserted by the user (Shift + Enter).

· Page Break: Ends the current page and starts a new one.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about cache memory:

1) Cache memory reduces average memory access time.

2) Cache memory is larger in size than RAM.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
कैश मेमोरी के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) कैश मेमोरी औसत मेमोरी एक्सेस समय को कम करती है।

2) कैश मेमोरी का आकार रैम से बड़ा होता है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because cache memory is significantly smaller in capacity compared to RAM.

Explanation of Statements:

1) is Correct. Cache is a high-speed memory placed between the CPU and RAM. It stores frequently used data so the CPU doesn't have to wait for the slower RAM, thus reducing average access time.

2) is Incorrect. Due to its high cost and the complexity of its hardware (SRAM), cache is kept very small (usually in Megabytes), whereas RAM is much larger (usually in Gigabytes).

Further Insights:

Cache is categorized into levels: L1 (fastest/smallest), L2, and L3 (slowest/largest cache level).

It operates on the principle of "Locality of Reference."

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about USB ports:

1) USB supports hot plugging of devices.

2) USB devices require system restart to be recognized.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
यूएसबी पोर्ट के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) यूएसबी उपकरणों की हॉट प्लगिंग का समर्थन करता है।

2) यूएसबी उपकरणों को पहचानने के लिए सिस्टम को रीस्टार्ट करना आवश्यक है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because USB devices are designed to be recognized instantly without a system reboot.

Explanation of Statements:

1) is Correct. "Hot plugging" is the ability to connect or disconnect peripheral devices while the computer is running without causing any damage or requiring a restart.

2) is Incorrect. USB is a "Plug and Play" (PnP) interface. The operating system identifies the device and loads the necessary drivers as soon as it is plugged in.

Further Insights:

USB (Universal Serial Bus) has evolved through versions (2.0, 3.0, 4.0), significantly increasing data transfer speeds over time.

A single USB port can theoretically support up to 127 devices using hubs.

questions.solution:
The ribbon tab in MS Excel that contains options for formatting cells, such as changing font styles, cell borders, and background colors, is the "Home" tab. The "Home" tab is one of the primary tabs in the Excel ribbon and includes various formatting options and essential commands for working with cells and data.

 Under the "Home" tab, you'll find options for changing font styles, font size, font color, text alignment, applying cell borders, applying cell shading (background color), and other basic formatting features. Additionally, you can find options to format numbers, apply conditional formatting, and access the Format Painter tool that allows you to copy and apply cell formatting.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:

i. The VLOOKUP function cannot return values from columns to the left of the lookup column.

ii. The XLOOKUP function can replace both VLOOKUP and HLOOKUP.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i. VLOOKUP फ़ंक्शन लुकअप कॉलम के बाईं ओर स्थित कॉलम से मान नहीं लौटा सकता है।

ii. XLOOKUP फ़ंक्शन VLOOKUP और HLOOKUP दोनों का स्थान ले सकता है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement 1 is CORRECT: The VLOOKUP (Vertical Lookup) function has a fundamental limitation: it always searches for a value in the first (leftmost) column of a table array and retrieves data from a column to the right. It cannot "look left." If your unique ID is in Column B and the data you want to retrieve is in Column A, VLOOKUP will fail unless you rearrange your data or use an alternative like INDEX and MATCH.

Statement 2 is CORRECT: XLOOKUP, introduced in newer versions of Excel (Office 365 and Excel 2021+), was designed specifically to overcome the weaknesses of older lookup functions.

Replaces VLOOKUP: It searches vertically and can look both left and right.

Replaces HLOOKUP: It can search horizontally (replacing rows) just as easily as vertically.

Additional Benefits: It defaults to an "Exact Match," so you don't have to remember to type FALSE or 0 at the end of the formula.

OSI stands for Open Systems Interconnection. It enables the provides a standard for different computer systems to be able to communicate with each other.

questions.question: The data link layer is responsible for the node to node delivery of the message. A single packet on a data link is known as?

questions.solution: The data link layer is responsible for the node to node delivery of the message. The main function of this layer is to make sure data transfer is error free from one node to another, over the physical layer. When a packet arrives in a network, it is the responsibility of DLL to transmit it to the Host using its MAC address. The packet received from Network layer is further divided into frames depending on the frame size of NIC(Network Interface Card). DLL also encapsulates Sender and Receiver's MAC address in the header.A single packet on a data link is known as frame.

questions.question: Which protocol converts domain names to IP addresses?

DNS is the service that translates human-readable names into machine-readable IP addresses.

Explanation:

DNS (Domain Name System): Computers communicate using IP addresses (like 192.0.2.1). Since humans cannot remember these easily, DNS acts as a "phonebook" that maps names like google.com to the correct IP.

DHCP: Automatically assigns IP addresses to devices on a local network.

FTP: Used for file transfers.

Further Insights:

When you type a URL, your computer first queries a DNS Resolver to find out where the website is hosted.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding FIND() and FINDB() functions in MS Excel:

Statement 1: FIND() counts each character as one, regardless of whether it is single-byte or double-byte.

Statement 2: FINDB() is mainly used with languages that use double-byte characters such as Japanese or Chinese.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
एमएस एक्सेल में FIND() और FINDB() फ़ंक्शन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन 1: FIND() प्रत्येक वर्ण को एक के रूप में गिनता है, चाहे वह सिंगल-बाइट हो या डबल-बाइट।

कथन 2: FINDB() मुख्य रूप से उन भाषाओं के साथ उपयोग किया जाता है जो डबल-बाइट वर्णों का उपयोग करती हैं, जैसे जापानी या चीनी।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो कथन 1 और न ही कथन 2

questions.solution:
In Microsoft Excel, there is a distinct difference between "Character-based" functions and "Byte-based" functions. These are used depending on the character set of the language you are working with.

Statement 1: FIND() counts each character as one (Correct)

The FIND() function is designed for languages that use Single-Byte Character Sets (SBCS), like English.

It treats every character-whether it is a letter, a number, or a space-as 1 unit.

Even if you use it on a double-byte character (like a Kanji character), FIND() will still count it as 1.

Formula: =FIND(find_text, within_text, [start_num])

Statement 2: FINDB() is used for Double-Byte characters (Correct)

The FINDB() function is specifically intended for use with Double-Byte Character Sets (DBCS). This includes languages like Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), and Korean.

In these languages, each character typically occupies 2 bytes of storage.

FINDB() counts each double-byte character as 2, while it counts single-byte characters (like English letters) as 1.

This is crucial when you are trying to find the exact byte position of a character for data extraction or system compatibility.

questions.question: A student scores 40% out of a maximum of 300 marks in an exam. The following year, the maximum marks are increased by 20%, and the student's score goes up by 24 marks. What is the student's percentage score in the second year?
questions.question_hi: एक छात्र एक परीक्षा में अधिकतम 300 अंकों में से 40% अंक प्राप्त करता है। अगले वर्ष, अधिकतम अंक 20% बढ़ जाते हैं, और छात्र के अंक 24 अंक बढ़ जाते हैं। दूसरे वर्ष में छात्र के प्रतिशत अंक क्या हैं?
questions.solution:
Maximum marks = 300

Score of student = 40% of 300 = 120

Maximum marks of next year = 300 * 120/100 = 360

Score of student in next year = 120 + 24 = 144

Required percentage = 144/360 * 100 = 40%

questions.question: If the breadth of a rectangle is decreased by 4 cm and the length is increased by 5 cm, then its area is reduced by 24 cm2. If the breadth is increased by 2 m, then its area is increased by 32 cm. What is the breadth of the rectangle?
questions.question_hi: यदि एक आयत की चौड़ाई 4 सेमी कम कर दी जाए और लंबाई 5 सेमी बढ़ा दी जाए, तो उसका क्षेत्रफल 24 सेमी कम हो जाता है।2। यदि चौड़ाई 2 मीटर बढ़ा दी जाए, तो उसका क्षेत्रफल 32 सेमी बढ़ जाता है। आयत की चौड़ाई क्या है?
questions.solution:
Let the length and breadth of the triangle be 'X' cm and 'Y' cm respectively.

(X + 5) (Y - 4) = XY - 24

XY + 5Y - 4X - 20 = XY - 24

5Y - 4X + 4 = 0 ... (i)

(Y + 2) * X = XY + 32

XY + 2X = XY + 32

2X = 32

X = 16 .... (ii)

Put the value of (ii) into (i)

5Y - 4 * 16 + 4 = 0

5Y = 60

Y = 12 cm

questions.question: The total surface area of a solid cube is 3.375 m2. It is melted and recast into a solid right circular cylinder with a radius of 0.15 m. What is the height (in m) of the cylinder (correct. to two decimal place)? (take π = 22/7)

6a2 = 3.375

a2 = 0.5625

a = 0.75 m

Volume of cube = Volume of cylinder

0.75 * 0.75 * 0.75 = 22/7 * (0.15)2 * h

questions.question: The length of two parallel sides of a trapezium are (B) m and (5B/3) m. If its height is (B/2) m, then what is the area (in m2) of the trapezium?

Area of trapezium = (1/2) * height * sum of parallel sides

= (1/2) * (B/2) * [B + (5B/3)]

= (B/4) * (8B/3)

= 2B2/3 m2

For x2 + 2x - 3

= x2 + 3x - x - 3

= (x - 1)(x + 3)

And, for x2 - x - 12

= x2 - 4x + 3x - 12

= (x - 4)(x + 3)

Therefore, HCF of the given two expressions = (x + 3)

Total number of outcomes = 6 x 6 x 6 = 216

Set of possible outcomes = (1,1,1), (2,2,2), (3,3,3), (4,4,4), (5,5,5), (6,6,6) = 6

Probability = 6/216 = 1/36

questions.question:
Consider the following set of numbers: {3,8,5,1,9,4,6,2,3,3,9,4,8}

What is the mean of mean, median and mode of the set?
questions.question_hi:
निम्न संख्याओं के समूह पर विचार करे: {3,8,5,1,9,4,6,2,3,3,9,4,8}

समूह के माध्य, माध्यिका और बहुलक का माध्य कितना है?
questions.solution:
Arranging the numbers in ascending order:

{1,2,3,3,3,4,4,5,6,8,8,9,9}

Median = ((13 + 1)/2)th term = 7th term = 4

Since '3' is repeated the most number of times, Mode = 3

Mean = (1+2+3+3+3+4+4+5+6+8+8+9+9)/13 = 5

So, the mean of mean, median and mode = (4 + 3 + 5)/3 = 4

questions.question: If the lateral surface area of the prism is 1584 cm2 and the side of the base of the prism is 24 cm, then find the volume of the prism. The base of a right prism is an equilateral triangle

questions.solution:
Let the height of the prism be h cm

Lateral surface area of the prism = Perimeter of base * height

3 * 24 * h = 1584

h = 22 cm

The volume of the prism = Area of base * height

= √3/4 * a2 * h

= √3/4 * 24 * 24 * 22

= 3168√3 cm3

questions.question: A shopkeeper allows two successive discounts of 20% each on marked price of an article and still makes a profit of 20%. What is the respective ratio of marked price and cost price of the article?
questions.question_hi: एक दुकानदार एक वस्तु के अंकित मूल्य पर 20% की दो क्रमिक छूट देता है और फिर भी 20% का लाभ कमाता है। तो, वस्तु के अंकित मूल्य और क्रय मूल्य का संबंधित अनुपात क्या है?
questions.solution:
Equivalent discount percent for two successive discounts of d1% and d2% = (d1 + d2 - d1 * d2/100)%

Here, equivalent discount percent for two successive discounts of 20% each = (20 + 20 - 20 * 20/100)%

= 36%

Here, SP = (100 - 36)% of MP

MP = (25/16) * SP

And, SP = (100 + 20)% of CP

CP = (5/6) * SP

Therefore, ratio = MP: CP = ((25/16) * SP): ((5/6) * SP) = 15: 8

questions.question: The average of 13 numbers is 57. The average of the first 6 numbers is 55, and the average of the next 4 numbers is 62. If the 11th number is 20 less than the 12th number and is 10 more than the 13th number, then what is the average value of the 12th and 13th numbers?
questions.question_hi: 13 संख्याओं का औसत 57 है। पहली 6 संख्याओं का औसत 55 है और अगली 4 संख्याओं का औसत 62 है। यदि 11वीं संख्या 12वीं संख्या से 20 कम है और 13वीं संख्या से 10 अधिक है, तो 12वीं और 13वीं संख्याओं का औसत मान क्या है?
questions.solution:
Sum of all 13 numbers = 13 x 57 = 741

Sum of first 6 numbers = 6 x 55 = 330

Sum of next 4 numbers = 4 x 62 = 248

Sum of 11th, 12th, and 13th number = 741 - (330 + 248) = 163

Let 11th number be X.

Then,

12th number = X + 20

And

13th number = X - 10

Therefore,

X + X + 20 + X - 10 = 163

3X + 10 = 163

3X = 153

X = 51

Average value of the 12th and 13th numbers = [(51 + 20) + (51 - 10)]/2 = 56

questions.question: Aditi and Aman appear for an interview for two vacancies. The probability of Aditi's selection is 3/7 and that of Aman's selection is 7/9. Find the probability that none of them be selected.
questions.question_hi: अदिति और अमन दो रिक्तियों के लिए साक्षात्कार में शामिल होते हैं। अदिति के चयन की संभावना 3/7 है और अमन के चयन की संभावना 7/9 है। उनमें से किसी के भी चयनित न होने की संभावना ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
The probability of Aditi's not being selected = 1 - 3/7 = 4/7

The probability of Aman's not being selected = 1 - 7/9 = 2/9

Hence, the required probability = 4/7 * 2/9

= 8/63

questions.question: A man, a woman and a child get Rs 1400 in total as daily wages. If a woman is twice as much efficient as a child and a man is twice as much efficient as a woman, then find the difference between earnings of man and child.
questions.question_hi: एक पुरुष, एक महिला और एक बच्चे को कुल मिलाकर 1400 रुपये दैनिक मजदूरी मिलती है। यदि एक महिला, एक बच्चे से दोगुनी कुशल है और एक पुरुष, एक महिला से दोगुना कुशल है, तो पुरुष और बच्चे की कमाई में अंतर ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Earnings are always distributed in ratio of efficiencies.

Hence, Ratio of efficiency of man and woman = 2:1

Ratio of efficiency of woman and child = 2:1

Ratio of efficiency of man, woman and child = 4:2:1

Earnings of man = 1400*4/7 = Rs 800

Earnings of child = 1400*1/7 = Rs 200

Desired difference = 800 - 200 = Rs 600

questions.solution:
Ratio of the diameter of ball X to ball Y = 5: 2

Ratio of radii of ball X to ball Y = 5: 2

Ratio of volumes of ball X to that of ball Y = 53: 23 = 125: 8

questions.question: If NO = 15 and DEN = 12, then how will you code WISH?
questions.question_hi: यदि NO = 15 और DEN = 12 है, तो WISH को कैसे कोडित करेंगे?
questions.solution:
When the letters of alphabetical series are numbered from 1 to 26 from A to Z, we get,

N = 14, O=15, D=4, E=5, W=23, I=9, H=8, S=19

Logic is -

(sum of letters +1)/2

NO = 14+15=29; and, (29+1)/2=15

DEN = 4+5+14=23; (23+1)/2= 12

Hence,

WISH = 23+9+8+19= 59

59+1=60

60/2=30

questions.correct_text: Both Statement (I) and Statement (II) are individually true but Statement (II) is NOT the correct explanation of Statement (I).
questions.solution:
Both the statement share common background i.e., Cleanliness.

The Indian Government's plan to make India free of open defecation in the upcoming years i.e., by year 2030 through the Swachh Survekshan mission. So, statement I is true.

Indore is the top clean city in India because of well-planned waste segregation, conversion, and disposal. Indore became the Cleanest City in India for the sixth time. So, statement II is true.

questions.question: If the 16th of a month with 30 days is Wednesday, then what is the date of second Saturday of the immediate next month?
questions.question_hi: यदि 30 दिन वाले एक महीने की 16 तारीख को बुधवार है, तो ठीक अगले महीने के दूसरे शनिवार की तारीख क्या होगी?
questions.solution:
16th of a month with 30 days is Wednesday

16+7=23 is also a Wednesday

23+7=30 is also a Wednesday

So, 3rd of next month is Saturday.

3+7=10 is also Saturday.

So, the date of second Saturday is 10.

questions.solution:
It is given that,

Only one laptop was bought after G and J was bought immediately before G.

Only two laptops were bought before F.

We get,

F JG

H was bought somewhere before D but not before E.

I was not bought before D.

The final arrangement is,

EHFDJGI

Here, E was bought immediately before H.

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation.

91 * 7 * 21 * 14 * 2 = 6
questions.question_hi:
* चिह्नों को क्रमिक रूप से प्रतिस्थापित कर दिए गए समीकरण को संतुलित करने के लिए गणितीय चिह्नों के सही संयोजन का चयन कीजिए।

91 * 7 * 21 * 14 * 2 = 6
questions.solution:
Option (a):

91 * 7 * 21 * 14 * 2 = 6

After putting the signs:

91 ÷ 7 x 21 + 14 - 2 = 6

13 x 21 + 12 = 6

273 + 12 = 6

285 is not equal to 6.

Option (b):

91 * 7 * 21 * 14 * 2 = 6

After putting the signs:

91 - 7 + 21 ÷ 14 x 2 = 6

84 + 1.5 x 2 = 6

84 + 3 = 6

87 is not equal to 6.

Option (c):

91 * 7 * 21 * 14 * 2 = 6

After putting the signs:

91 ÷ 7 + 21 - 14 x 2 = 6

13 + 21 - 28 = 6

13 - 7 = 6

6 is equal to 6.

Option (d):

91 * 7 * 21 * 14 * 2 = 6

After putting the signs:

91 ÷ 7 - 21 + 14 x 2 = 6

13 - 21 + 28 = 6

13 + 7 = 6

20 is not equal to 6.

So, Option (c) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All Whom are What

Some What are Why

No Why is Where

Conclusions:

I: Some Whom being Where is a possibility

II: All What are Where

III: No What is Where
questions.question_hi:
तीन कथन और उसके बाद तीन निष्कर्ष क्रमांकित I, II और III दिए गए हैं। कथनों को सत्य मानते हुए, भले ही वे सामान्यतः ज्ञात तथ्यों से भिन्न प्रतीत होते हों, यह निर्धारित कीजिए कि कौन-सा/से निष्कर्ष कथनों का तार्किक रूप से अनुसरण करता/करते है/हैं।

कथन:

सभी Whom, What हैं।

कुछ What, Why हैं।

कोई Why, Where नहीं हैं।

निष्कर्ष:

I: कुछ Whom के Where होने की संभावना है।

II: सभी What, Where हैं।

III: कोई What, Where नहीं है।

options.label: B
options.text_hi: II और III दोनों अनुसरण करते हैं

options.label: D
options.text_hi: I और II दोनों अनुसरण करते हैं

questions.solution:
Statements:

All Whom are What

Some What are Why

No Why is Where

Some Whom being Where is a possibility: As there is no direct relation between Whom and Where. There is a possibility of Some Whom being Where. So , conclusion I is true.

All What are Where: As there is no direct relation between What and Where. So, conclusion II is false.

No What is Where: As there is no direct relation between What and Where. SO, conclusion III is false.

Hence, only conclusion I follows.

If '÷' means addition, ' - ' means division, 'x' means subtraction and '+' means multiplication, then what is the value of the following expression?

{[2 x (16 x 21) ÷ 8] - 3} + 10
questions.question_hi:
यदि '÷' का अर्थ जोड़ है, '-' का अर्थ भाग है, 'x' का अर्थ घटाव है और '+' का अर्थ गुणा है, तो निम्नलिखित व्यंजक का मान कितना होगा?

{[2 x (16 x 21) ÷ 8] - 3} + 10
questions.solution:
'÷' means addition, ' - ' means division, 'x' means subtraction and '+' means multiplication.

So, the given expression will be:

{[2 - (16 - 21) + 8] ÷ 3} x 10

= {[2 - (-5) + 8] ÷ 3} x 10

= {[2 + 5 + 8] ÷ 3} x 10

= {[15] ÷ 3} x 10

= 5 x 10

= 50

questions.question:
Choose the option that gives the correct active form of the sentence.

Why had the retaining wall not been reinforced by the contractor before the monsoon inspection?

options.label: A
options.text: Why did the contractor not reinforce the retaining wall before the monsoon inspection?

options.label: B
options.text: Why had the contractor not been reinforcing the retaining wall before the monsoon inspection?

options.label: C
options.text: Why had the contractor not reinforced the retaining wall before the monsoon inspection?

options.label: D
options.text: Why was the contractor not reinforcing the retaining wall before the monsoon inspection?

questions.correct_text: Why had the contractor not reinforced the retaining wall before the monsoon inspection?
questions.solution:
Option (c) is correct. The passive form HAD NOT BEEN REINFORCED is past perfect passive. In active voice, it changes to HAD NOT REINFORCED. Since the agent is clearly given by "the contractor," it must become the subject in the active form.

• Option (a): changes the tense from past perfect to simple past.

• Option (b): changes the structure to past perfect continuous, which is different from the original meaning.

• Option (d): changes the tense to past continuous, so the rule of past perfect passive to past perfect active is not followed.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

The guard said to the visitor, "Have you carried your identity card?"

options.label: A
options.text: The guard asked the visitor whether he had carried his identity card.

options.label: B
options.text: The guard asked the visitor that had he carried his identity card.

options.label: C
options.text: The guard asked the visitor whether had he carried his identity card.

options.label: D
options.text: The guard told the visitor whether he carried his identity card.

questions.correct_text: The guard asked the visitor whether he had carried his identity card.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option a.

Rule of Reported Speech: A yes/no question is reported with "asked" and "if" or "whether". The sentence stops being a question, so normal statement order is used.

Example: She said, "Did you finish the work?" → She asked if I had finished the work.

This is a yes/no question because it can be answered with "yes" or "no".

So "said to" changes to "asked".

We use "whether" here.

"you" refers to the visitor, so it becomes "he".

"Have you carried" changes to "had carried".

That makes Option a correct.

Option b is wrong because that had he carried is not the correct pattern for reported questions.

Option c is wrong because whether had he carried keeps question order. Reported speech needs statement order: whether he had carried.

Option d is wrong because told is not the right reporting verb for a question, and carried should be had carried.

Final correct sentence: The guard asked the visitor whether he had carried his identity card.

questions.question:

questions.solution:
According to the rule, with the following verbs/ adjectives/ phrases- 'used to, prone to, looking forward to, given to, taken to, object to', 'base form of verb+ ing' is used after 'to'.

So, 'making' is the correct word for the given blank.

Hence, option (b) is correct.

questions.question:
Select the right phrasal verb for the blank.

We decided to ____ our old tile-roofed building as it was withering too much.
questions.solution:
Pull over- To slow down and move to the side of the road

Pull up- Come to a halt

Pull down- Demolish a building

Pull in- Move to the side of or off the road

The sentence talks about the decision to do something about an old, roofed building. Among the options, 'pull over', 'pull up' and 'pull in' are contextually irrelevant and so they are negated. 'Pull down' matches the context of the sentence and describes what is decided about the building and is also grammatically correct.

Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

Note:

Phrasal verb: A phrase that consists of a verb with a preposition or adverb or both, the meaning of which is different from the meaning of its separate parts. Example: She has always looked down on me. Here, the phrasal verb 'to look down on someone' doesn't mean that you are looking down from a higher place at someone who is below you; it means that you think that you are better than someone.

questions.question: What is the best meaning of "complement" in the sentence: "Remote healthcare is not expected to replace physical hospitals entirely but rather to complement them, creating a hybrid system that is more efficient and inclusive"?

options.label: B
options.text: To compete with something in order to dominate

options.label: C
options.text: To complete or enhance something by adding what is lacking

options.label: D
options.text: To replace something with a better alternative

questions.correct_text: To complete or enhance something by adding what is lacking
questions.solution:
In this context, "complement" means to add to something in a way that improves it or makes it complete. Remote healthcare isn't replacing hospitals; it's working alongside them to create a better, more complete healthcare system.

This aligns with option (c).

Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.
questions.passage:
Directions : Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

The concept of healthcare has been reshaped significantly with the rise of remote medical services, often called telemedicine. This model allows patients to consult doctors through video calls, chat platforms, or specialized apps without leaving their homes, providing convenience and comfort that traditional hospital visits often cannot match. The COVID-19 pandemic accelerated its acceptance as people sought safe ways to access medical advice, but its relevance continues to grow in a post-pandemic world where flexibility and accessibility are increasingly valued.

Remote healthcare is especially valuable for people in rural or underserved areas, where access to specialists is limited and traveling long distances to hospitals can be difficult. By removing the need for constant physical visits, it reduces travel costs, saves time, and makes routine monitoring easier for individuals with chronic conditions such as diabetes or hypertension. In this way, it ensures continuity of care without putting unnecessary burdens on patients. Additionally, wearable devices that track vital signs such as heart rate, blood pressure, or glucose levels are enhancing the effectiveness of digital consultations by providing doctors with real-time data.

However, challenges remain, including concerns about data privacy, internet connectivity gaps, and the pressing need for clear regulatory frameworks to ensure safety and accountability. Despite these obstacles, the model is proving to be a sustainable approach for expanding medical access. Governments and private firms alike are investing in digital infrastructure to support its growth. Remote healthcare is not expected to replace physical hospitals entirely but rather to complement them, creating a hybrid system that is more efficient and inclusive. In the long run, it may redefine the doctor-patient relationship and make healthcare more personalized and accessible for millions.

questions.question: Which of the following correctly identifies the tense used predominantly in the passage?
questions.solution:
The passage mainly uses the Present Simple tense (e.g., allows, reduces, saves, makes, remains, is), though the opening sentence uses the Present Perfect (has been reshaped). The overall narration is in the Present Simple to describe general facts and ongoing realities.

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

Option b) Past simple - Incorrect; no consistent use of past events.

Option c) Present Perfect - Appears once but not predominant.

Option d) Past Perfect - Not used at all.

questions.question: What type of pronoun is the word "them" in the sentence, "Remote healthcare is not expected to replace physical hospitals entirely but rather to complement them, creating a hybrid system that is more efficient and inclusive"?
questions.solution:
The pronoun "them" is used as the object of the verb "complement." It is receiving the action of the verb. Pronouns that are used as objects (receiving the action) are called objective pronouns.

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

Option (b): A possessive pronoun shows ownership or belonging. (Examples: mine, yours, theirs). The word "them" does not show ownership.

Option (c): A demonstrative pronoun points to a specific noun. (Examples: this, that, these, those). "Them" does not point to the hospitals; it replaces the noun.

Option (d): A subjective pronoun is used as the subject of a sentence, meaning it performs the action. (Examples: I, she, they). The subjective form of "them" is "they."

questions.question: What is the overall tone of the passage on remote healthcare?
questions.solution:
The passage explains what remote healthcare is, discusses its benefits (accessibility, cost-saving), mentions its challenges (privacy, connectivity), and projects its future role. It presents these points in a balanced and factual way.

Option (a): This is incorrect. A pessimistic tone would focus primarily on the failures and challenges, suggesting a negative future. The passage, however, highlights many benefits and calls the model "valuable" and "sustainable."

Option (b): This is correct. The primary purpose of the passage is to inform the reader about the concept of remote healthcare. It provides facts, explains pros and cons, and describes its development in a neutral, objective manner.

Option (c): This is incorrect. An alarmist tone would create a sense of panic or extreme worry. While the passage mentions challenges, it does so calmly and without exaggeration.

Option (d): This is incorrect. A satirical tone uses humor, irony, or ridicule to criticize a topic. The passage treats remote healthcare seriously and respectfully.

Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.

questions.passage:
Directions: Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

In the northern part of Austin there once dwelt an honest family by the name of Smothers. The family consisted of John Smothers, his wife, himself, their little daughter who was five years of age and her parents, making six people towards the population of the city when counted for a special write up but only three by actual count. One night after supper, the little girl was seized with a severe colic and John Smothers hurried down to get some medicine. He never came back. The little girl recovered and in time grew up to womanhood. The mother grieved very much over her husband's disappearance, and it was nearly three months before she married again and moved to San Antonio.

The little girl also married in time, and after a few years had rolled around, she also had a little girl five years of age. She lived in the same house where they dwelt when her father had left and never returned. One night by a remarkable coincidence her little girl was taken with cramp colic on the anniversary of the disappearance of John Smothers, who would now have been her grandfather if he had been alive and had a steady job. "I will go downtown and get some medicine for her", said John Smith for it was none other than he who she had married. "No, no, dear John," cried his wife. "You too might disappear forever and then forget to come back."

So, John Smith did not go, and together they sat by the bedside of little Pansy. After a while, Little Pansy seemed to grow worse and John Smith again attempted to go for medicine, but his wife would not let him. Suddenly the door opened and an old man, stooped and bent, with long white hair, entered the room. "Hello, here is grandpa", said Pansy. She had recognized him before any of the others. The old man drew bottle of medicine from his pocket and gave Pansy a spoonful. She got well immediately.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. The wildlife sanctuary served as a haven for endangered species, offering them a chance to thrive in a protected environment.

B. Conservationists worked tirelessly to restore habitats, monitor animal populations, and prevent illegal poaching.

C. Public awareness campaigns were also launched to educate people about the importance of preserving biodiversity.

D. Over the years, these efforts resulted in significant improvements, with many species being brought back from the brink of extinction.
questions.solution:
Sentence A introduces the wildlife sanctuary, explaining that it serves as a haven for endangered species, offering a protected environment for them to thrive. This sets the stage for the sanctuary's purpose.

Sentence B follows logically, describing the conservationists' efforts to restore habitats, monitor populations, and prevent poaching, which are key actions that support the sanctuary's goals.

Sentence C continues by discussing public awareness campaigns to educate people on the importance of preserving biodiversity. This supports the conservation efforts by encouraging broader public involvement.

Sentence D concludes the passage, reflecting on the positive outcomes of these efforts, with many species being brought back from the brink of extinction, showing the results of the sanctuary's work.

Thus, the correct order is ABCD.

Hence, option (d) is correct.

questions.question:
Given below are five jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives the correct logical sequence.

A. This unique adaptation allows them to thrive in arid environments where water is extremely scarce for long periods.

B. Camels are renowned for their ability to survive extended periods without water, a characteristic vital in desert ecosystems.

C. Contrary to popular belief, their humps store fat, not water, which can be metabolised for energy and water.

D. Moreover, they can tolerate significant dehydration, losing up to 30-40% of their body water without ill effects.

E. When water is available, they can drink enormous quantities very quickly, rehydrating rapidly to replenish lost fluids.
questions.solution:
The correct sequence is BCADE.

Sentence B introduces camels and their well-known characteristic of surviving without water, setting the main topic.

Sentence C corrects a common misconception about "their humps" (camels' humps from B), clarifying they store fat, not water.

Sentence A explains the significance of "This unique adaptation" (implicitly, the combination of fat storage for energy/water and other physiological traits that allow survival without water), linking it to their ability to thrive in arid environments.

Sentence D uses "Moreover" to add another remarkable adaptation: their tolerance for dehydration, building on their survival capabilities.

Sentence E describes their behavior "When water is available," explaining how they rehydrate, which contrasts with their ability to go without water (B) and tolerate dehydration (D).

Thus, the coherent and logical order is BCADE.

Hence, option (d) is the answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The boy cleaned the room. He also fixed the broken chair.

options.label: A
options.text: The room is cleaned by the boy. Even the broken chair is fixed by him.

options.label: B
options.text: The room was cleaned by the boy. He has even fixed the broken chair.

options.label: C
options.text: The room has been cleaned by the boy. He fixes the chair.

options.label: D
options.text: The room was cleaned by the boy. The broken chair was also fixed by him.

questions.correct_text: The room was cleaned by the boy. The broken chair was also fixed by him.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

The usage of a "to be" form of verb ['was'] is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

In Passive Voice, the preposition "by" is used before the object. However, it is optional in some cases.

The Active voice in this question is in Past Indefinite. Thus, the Passive voice will also be in Past Indefinite.

The format of Active voice is: Subject + V2 + Object.

Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be: Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + was/were + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).

For example:

Real Madrid won the Champions League. (Active Voice)

The Champions League was won by Real Madrid. (Passive Voice)

The options except (d) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: "The room was cleaned by the boy. The broken chair was also fixed by him."

Hence, option (d) is correct.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

Riya said to me, "I have finished the project, but I will revise the last section tomorrow."

options.label: A
options.text: Riya told me that she has finished the project but would revise the last section tomorrow.

options.label: B
options.text: Riya said me that she had finished the project but would revise the last section the next day.

options.label: C
options.text: Riya told me that she had finished the project but would revise the last section the next day.

options.label: D
options.text: Riya told me that I had finished the project but would revise the last section the next day.

questions.correct_text: Riya told me that she had finished the project but would revise the last section the next day.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option c.

Rule of Reported Speech: In a statement, "said to" usually changes to "told" when an object is given, and the verb moves one step into the past when the reporting verb is in the past.

Example: He said to me, "I will call you tomorrow." → He told me that he would call me the next day.

Here, "said to me" changes to "told me".

"I" refers to Riya, so it changes to "she".

"have finished" changes to "had finished".

"will revise" changes to "would revise".

"tomorrow" changes to "the next day".

So the full reported speech is correct in Option c.

Option a is wrong because has finished does not fit after a past reporting verb here, and tomorrow should change to the next day.

Option b is wrong because said me is incorrect. We say told me, not "said me".

Option d is wrong because I had finished is incorrect. The speaker was Riya, so it must be she had finished.

Final correct sentence: Riya told me that she had finished the project but would revise the last section the next day.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The manager requested the employees to complete the report before the deadline and submit it to him.

options.label: A
options.text: The manager said, "Please complete the report before the deadline and submit it to me."

options.label: B
options.text: The manager said, "Complete the report before deadline and submit to him."

options.label: C
options.text: The manager said, "You should complete the report and submit it to me."

options.label: D
options.text: The manager said, "Completed the report, can you and submit it to me, please."

questions.correct_text: The manager said, "Please complete the report before the deadline and submit it to me."
questions.solution:
The sentence in the Indirect Speech is in request form ("requested") with an infinitive structure ("to complete.. and submit.."). Therefore, the sentence in the Direct Speech will be in an Imperative Sentence (request form).

Requested + object + to + V1 will be converted into "Please + V1 .." in Direct Speech.

For example:

He requested me to help him. (Indirect Speech)

He said, "Please help me." (Direct Speech)

The following things in the sentence will change when changed from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:

"requested" →"said, 'Please..'"

"the employees" → (understood as "you")

"to complete" →"complete"

"to him" →"to me"

Proper imperative structure is restored.

Therefore, the correct answer is:(a) The manager said, "Please complete the report before the deadline and submit it to me."

Hence, option (a) is correct.

questions.question:

questions.solution: 'Could' is a modal verb and a modal verb is always followed by a verb in the base form; so 'get' should have been used. This negates option C and the given phrase. Option A is incorrect because of the use of the word 'some'. The words some and any are used when the speaker cannot specify or does not need/want to specify a number or an exact amount. The general rule is that any is used for questions and negatives while some is used for positive. In the question statement, the sentence intends to convey the thought that the speaker couldn't sleep at all. 'Any' is correct in this sense. Option B is the correct answer.

This is the place in which my brother and I used to play on childhood.
questions.solution:
The error is in Option (b).

The use of the preposition 'on' is the error. 'On' is used to denote a particular position but in the given sentence the speaker is mentioning about a particular time line. The prepositions that can denote time period are 'since', 'in', 'during', etc. With respect to the given sentence, the preposition that can be correctly placed before 'childhood' is 'during' or 'in'.

Hence, the correct answer is option (b).

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into three segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is error free, mark 'No error' as your answer.

As long as you lack / something, you yearn of / it without ceasing.
questions.solution:
The sentence contains a prepositional error. The verb 'yearn' means 'have an intense feeling of longing for something'. It doesn't take the preposition 'of'. It always takes the preposition 'for'. E.g., "She yearned for a glimpse of her best friend". Therefore, the error is in the part in option (c).

The correct sentence is: As long as you lack something, you yearn for it without ceasing.

Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

questions.passage:
Directions :Read the given passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.

The energy sector, with its intricate challenges and vast potential, stands at the cusp of change, and as we navigate the path forward, the role of diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) becomes not just beneficial but essential. Women's participation tends to be more prominent in new energy domains than the traditional energy sectors. As per the International Energy Agency (IEA), women constitute less than 16% of the workforce in traditional energy sectors, despite comprising 39% of the global workforce.

Gender diversity drives innovation, opens new pathways for technology deployment, brings valuable perspectives to social and economic development and provides a richer pool of talent for key and emerging industries. However, as in many parts of the world, the energy sector in India remains one of the least gender-diverse sectors, mostly male-dominated. Women are breaking the glass ceiling, and the transformation is indeed beginning at the educational level. Female students are often outperforming their male counterparts in the science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) domains. Presently, there is a notable influx of women STEM graduates, outnumbering their male counterparts, with 180 female students pursuing a master's degree in science for every 100 male students. As per the All-India Survey on Higher Education, of the 55.5 lakh students enrolled in the Science Stream in 2021 - 22, female students outnumbered male students (29.5 versus 26 lakh).

While women are progressing in STEM education, they still do not make a sizeable representation in scientific research and engineering domains. However, the energy sector is driving the change and promoting DEI aggressively around the world. As per the same report, the energy and materials segment is at the top in prioritising women in their DEI activities. The flip side of the coin is this is the sector where women are also scarce at all levels of seniority. The nature of women's roles within the energy sector also needs to be examined. Women may most likely be occupying non-STEM or administrative positions, even in ostensibly inclusive segments like renewable energy.

Diverse viewpoints contribute to a richer pool of ideas crucial for innovation and problem-solving. Organisations that champion diversity and inclusion are often at the forefront of innovation. From a business standpoint, policies fostering inclusion and above-average diversity correlate with increased revenues driven by innovation. Consequently, organisations within the energy sector must take the lead in fostering inclusive growth.

questions.question: Which of the following is not cited as an outcome of fostering gender diversity in the workplace?

options.label: B
options.text: Results in a decrease in revenues.

options.label: C
options.text: Opens new avenues to deploy technology.

options.label: D
options.text: Provides a diverse and skilled set of people.

questions.correct_text: Results in a decrease in revenues.
questions.solution:
The second paragraph mentions: "Gender diversity drives innovation, opens new pathways for technology deployment..." This statement from the passage suggests that gender diversity in the workplace contributes to increased innovation (option a), the exploration and implementation of new approaches and technologies (option c) and a richer pool of talented people (option d).

However, option (b) contradicts the claim of the passage [last paragraph]: "From a business standpoint, policies fostering inclusion and above-average diversity correlate with increased revenues driven by innovation." The passage implies that organizations championing diversity and inclusion often correlate with increased revenues driven by innovation.

Hence, option (b) is not listed as an outcome of promoting gender diversity in the workplace.

questions.question: What is the antonym of "scarce" from the passage?
questions.solution:
The word "scarce" means in short supply or insufficient quantity. Let us examine the given options:

(a) Rare: Not occurring very often; uncommon.

(b) Limited: Restricted in size, amount, or extent; confined or restricted within certain boundaries.

(c) Opaque: Not transparent; not allowing light to pass through; difficult to understand or explain.

(d) Abundant: Present in large quantities; plentiful.

Hence, "abundant" is the word that represents the opposite meaning, indicating plentifulness or being present in large quantities. Thus, option (d) is the correct answer.
questions.passage:
Directions :Read the given passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.

The energy sector, with its intricate challenges and vast potential, stands at the cusp of change, and as we navigate the path forward, the role of diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) becomes not just beneficial but essential. Women's participation tends to be more prominent in new energy domains than the traditional energy sectors. As per the International Energy Agency (IEA), women constitute less than 16% of the workforce in traditional energy sectors, despite comprising 39% of the global workforce.

Gender diversity drives innovation, opens new pathways for technology deployment, brings valuable perspectives to social and economic development and provides a richer pool of talent for key and emerging industries. However, as in many parts of the world, the energy sector in India remains one of the least gender-diverse sectors, mostly male-dominated. Women are breaking the glass ceiling, and the transformation is indeed beginning at the educational level. Female students are often outperforming their male counterparts in the science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) domains. Presently, there is a notable influx of women STEM graduates, outnumbering their male counterparts, with 180 female students pursuing a master's degree in science for every 100 male students. As per the All-India Survey on Higher Education, of the 55.5 lakh students enrolled in the Science Stream in 2021 - 22, female students outnumbered male students (29.5 versus 26 lakh).

While women are progressing in STEM education, they still do not make a sizeable representation in scientific research and engineering domains. However, the energy sector is driving the change and promoting DEI aggressively around the world. As per the same report, the energy and materials segment is at the top in prioritising women in their DEI activities. The flip side of the coin is this is the sector where women are also scarce at all levels of seniority. The nature of women's roles within the energy sector also needs to be examined. Women may most likely be occupying non-STEM or administrative positions, even in ostensibly inclusive segments like renewable energy.

Diverse viewpoints contribute to a richer pool of ideas crucial for innovation and problem-solving. Organisations that champion diversity and inclusion are often at the forefront of innovation. From a business standpoint, policies fostering inclusion and above-average diversity correlate with increased revenues driven by innovation. Consequently, organisations within the energy sector must take the lead in fostering inclusive growth.

options.label: B
options.text: Overcoming the Skills Gap in the Science Sector.

options.label: C
options.text: Empowering Women in the Energy Industry.

options.label: D
options.text: Exploring the Role of STEM Education.

questions.solution:

(a) The Rise of Renewable Energy and its Impact on Jobs: While the passage mentions renewable energy, it is not the main focus. The focus is on gender diversity within the sector.

(b) Overcoming the Skills Gap in the Science Sector: The passage acknowledges the need for skilled women in STEM fields, but it doesn't delve into solutions for the skills gap.

(c) Empowering Women in the Energy Industry: This title accurately reflects the main theme of the passage. The passage discusses the challenges and opportunities for women in the energy sector, highlighting efforts to empower women and promote gender diversity and inclusion within the industry.

(d) Exploring the Role of STEM Education: While STEM education is discussed as a factor in increasing women's participation, the passage goes beyond just education to explore challenges and opportunities within the industry itself.

Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

He said that if he had enough money, he would travel abroad the following year.

options.label: A
options.text: He said, "If I have enough money, I will travel abroad next year."

options.label: B
options.text: He said, "If I had enough money, I would travel abroad next year."

options.label: C
options.text: He said, "If I had enough money, I would travel abroad the following year."

options.label: D
options.text: He said, "If I have enough money, I would travel abroad next year."

questions.correct_text: He said, "If I had enough money, I would travel abroad next year."
questions.solution:
The sentence in the Indirect Speech is in a Conditional Sentence (Second Conditional): "if he had enough money" and "would travel". Therefore, the sentence in the Direct Speech will also remain in the Second Conditional form.

Past Tense (had) + would + V1 remains Past Tense + would + V1 in Direct Speech.

For example:

He said that if he were rich, he would buy a car. (Indirect Speech)

He said, "If I were rich, I would buy a car." (Direct Speech)

The following things in the sentence will change when changed from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:

"he" →"I"

"the following year" →"next year"

The conditional structure remains the same ("if I had.. I would..")

Therefore, the correct answer is:

(b) He said, "If I had enough money, I would travel abroad next year".

Hence, option (b) is correct.

questions.question: Which of the following is a homonym of mote?
questions.solution:
Option (c) is correct because MOAT is pronounced like MOTE but has a different meaning. A mote is a tiny particle, especially of dust, while a moat is a deep ditch around a fort or castle. The rule is that such words are identified through matching sound, not similar spelling.

• Option (a) is incorrect because MUTE has a different vowel sound.

• Option (b) is incorrect because MOOT is pronounced differently.

• Option (d) is incorrect because MATE does not match the pronunciation of MOTE.

questions.question: Which of the following article empowers the parliament to admit into the union of India, or establish, new states on such terms and conditions as it thinks fit?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस अनुच्छेद द्वारा संसद को भारत के संघ में प्रवेश करने, या इस तरह के नियमों और शर्तों पर नए राज्यों को स्थापित करने के लिए जैसी भी उचित हो, सक्षम बनाया जाता है?
questions.solution:
- Article 2 states that the parliament may, by law, admit new states into Union of India or establish new states on terms and conditions it deems fit. For e.g. the addition of the State of Sikkim by the 35th (1974) and 36th (1975) constitutional amendments.

- Article 11: Grants Parliament the power to regulate citizenship by law

- Article 13: Declares laws inconsistent with Fundamental Rights as void

- Article 3: Allows Parliament to form new states or alter boundaries, names, or areas of existing states.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct?

A. In March 2024, the Union Cabinet approved PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana.

B. The total outlay of the scheme is Rs.75,021 crore.

C. It is for installing rooftop solar and providing free electricity up to 300 units every month for One Crore households.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

A. मार्च 2024 में, केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल ने प्रधानमंत्री-सूर्य घर: मुफ्त बिजली योजना को मंजूरी दी।

B. योजना का कुल परिव्यय रु.75,021 करोड़ है।

C. यह छत पर (रूफटॉप) सौर ऊर्जा स्थापित करने और एक करोड़ घरों के लिए प्रत्येक महीने 300 यूनिट तक मुफ्त बिजली प्रदान करने हेतु है।
questions.solution:
The Union Cabinet, chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, has approved PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana with a total outlay of Rs.75,021 crore for installing rooftop solar and providing free electricity up to 300 units every month for One Crore households.

The Prime Minister had launched the scheme on 13th February, 2024. The scheme provides a CFA of 60% of system cost for 2 kW systems and 40% of additional system cost for systems between 2 to 3 kW capacity. The CFA will be capped at 3 kW.

At current benchmark prices, this will mean Rs 30,000 subsidy for 1 kW system, Rs 60,000 for 2 kW systems and Rs 78,000 for 3 kW systems or higher. Households will be able to access collateral-free low-interest loan products of around 7% at present for installation of residential RTS systems up to 3 kW. It is estimated that the scheme will create around 17 lakh direct jobs in manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, sales, installation, O&M and other services.

The proposed scheme will result in addition of 30 GW of solar capacity through rooftop solar in the residential sector, generating 1000 BUs of electricity and resulting in reduction of 720 million tonnes of CO2 equivalent emissions over the 25-year lifetime of rooftop systems.

A 3 kW system will be able to generate more than 300 units a month on an average for a household.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the 'Laffer Curve'.

I. It proposes that there is an optimal income tax level to maximise tax revenues of the government.

II. It illustrates the concept of taxable income elasticity.

Which among the above-mentioned statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
'लाफ़र वक्र' के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. यह प्रस्तावित करता है कि सरकार के कर राजस्व को अधिकतम करने के लिए एक इष्टतम आयकर स्तर है।

II. यह कर योग्य आय लोच की अवधारणा को दर्शाता है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
All of the statements are correct:

Laffer curve is a graphical representation of the relationship between tax rates and total tax collections.

It illustrates the concept of taxable income elasticity - i.e., taxable income changes in response to changes in the rate of taxation. The Laffer curve assumes that no tax revenue is raised at the extreme tax rates of 0% and 100% and that there is a rate between 0% and 100% that maximizes government taxation revenue. It claims that low-income tax policies spur non-inflationary growth by encouraging new investment.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct?

i. Warren Hastings abolished the Dual Government in Bengal and worked under the Supreme Council created by the Regulating Act (1773).

ii. Lord Cornwallis introduced the Permanent Settlement (1793) and reorganized the civil service to curb corruption.

iii. Lord Ripon repealed the Vernacular Press Act and introduced the Ilbert Bill.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

i. वॉरेन हेस्टिंग्स ने बंगाल में द्वैध सरकार को समाप्त कर दिया और रेगुलेटिंग एक्ट (1773) द्वारा बनाई गई सुप्रीम काउंसिल के अधीन काम किया।

ii. लॉर्ड कार्नवालिस ने स्थायी बंदोबस्त (1793) की शुरुआत की और भ्रष्टाचार पर अंकुश लगाने के लिए सिविल सेवा का पुनर्गठन किया।

iii. लॉर्ड रिपन ने वर्नाक्युलर प्रेस एक्ट को निरस्त कर दिया और इल्बर्ट बिल पेश किया।
questions.solution:
All three statements are historically correct. Each one accurately pairs a significant Governor-General or Viceroy with some of their most notable administrative, economic, or legislative actions.

Explanation of Statements:

i is Correct. Warren Hastings, the first Governor-General of Bengal (1772-1785), is credited with ending the disastrous Dual Government system in Bengal that had been established by Robert Clive. The Regulating Act of 1773 was a landmark piece of legislation that attempted to bring the East India Company's affairs under the control of the British Parliament. It established the post of Governor-General of Bengal and created a Supreme Council of four members to assist (and often oppose) him, marking the beginning of centralized administration.

ii is Correct. Lord Cornwallis (Governor-General 1786-1793) introduced major reforms. His most famous economic measure was the Permanent Settlement of land revenue in Bengal in 1793, which fixed the land revenue demand in perpetuity on the zamindars. He is also regarded as the "Father of the Civil Service in India" for reorganizing and professionalizing the administration, separating commercial and administrative functions, and introducing measures like higher salaries to curb the widespread corruption among Company officials.

iii is Correct. Lord Ripon (Viceroy 1880-1884) is known as one of the more liberal and popular Viceroys. In 1882, he repealed the controversial Vernacular Press Act of 1878 (enacted by his predecessor, Lord Lytton), which had imposed severe restrictions on the non-English press in India. He also introduced the Ilbert Bill in 1883, which sought to remove racial discrimination by allowing Indian judges to try Europeans. Although the bill was heavily modified due to intense opposition from the European community, it was a significant, albeit failed, step towards legal equality.

Further insights:

These three figures represent different phases of British rule in India: Hastings represents the transition from a trading company to a territorial power, Cornwallis represents the consolidation of British administration, and Ripon represents a period of liberal reform within the established empire.

Lord Ripon is also celebrated for his resolution on local self-government in 1882, which is considered a key milestone in the development of municipal governance in India.

questions.question: Why is the Hydrogen element considered the anomaly of the Periodic table?
questions.question_hi: हाइड्रोजन तत्व को आवर्त सारणी की विसंगति क्यों माना जाता है?

options.label: A
options.text: It is the first element of the periodic table.
options.text_hi: यह आवर्त सारणी का प्रथम तत्व है।

options.label: B
options.text: It shows the property of alkali metals.
options.text_hi: यह क्षार धातुओं के गुणधर्म को दर्शाता है।

options.label: C
options.text: It shows the property of Halogens
options.text_hi: यह हैलोजन के गुण को दर्शाता है।

options.label: D
options.text: It shows the properties of alkali metals and Halogens.
options.text_hi: यह क्षार धातुओं और हैलोजन के गुणों को दर्शाता है।

questions.correct_text: It shows the properties of alkali metals and Halogens.
questions.solution:
• Hydrogen is considered an anomaly in the periodic table because it has properties similar to both alkali metals and halogens

• It can lose one electron, as do alkali metals, and gain one electron, as do halogens.

• While all group 1 metals are present in mono-atomic state Hydrogen as found in diatomic molecules similar to Halogens.

questions.question:
Regarding the 1991 economic reforms in India, consider the following statements:

i. The New Industrial Policy of 1991 opened up several sectors to automatic FDI approval, allowing up to 51% foreign equity in selected high-priority industries.

ii. Current Account Convertibility was introduced immediately in 1991 as part of the stabilization package.

iii. The 1991 reforms reduced the number of industries reserved exclusively for the public sector from 17 to a much smaller list restricted to strategic areas such as defence and atomic energy.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में 1991 के आर्थिक सुधारों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i. 1991 की नई औद्योगिक नीति ने कई क्षेत्रों को स्वतः प्रत्यक्ष विदेशी निवेश (एफडीआई) स्वीकृति के लिए खोल दिया, जिससे चुनिंदा उच्च प्राथमिकता वाले उद्योगों में 51% तक विदेशी इक्विटी की अनुमति मिली।

ii. स्थिरीकरण पैकेज के हिस्से के रूप में चालू खाता परिवर्तनीयता को 1991 में ही लागू किया गया था।

iii. 1991 के सुधारों ने सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के लिए विशेष रूप से आरक्षित उद्योगों की संख्या को 17 से घटाकर रक्षा और परमाणु ऊर्जा जैसे रणनीतिक क्षेत्रों तक सीमित कर दिया।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement i is correct.

The Industrial Policy 1991 introduced automatic FDI approval up to 51% in a set of "high-priority industries", marking a major departure from earlier restrictive policies.

Statement ii is incorrect.

Current Account Convertibility was not introduced in 1991.

It was achieved later, in 1994, when India accepted IMF Article VIII obligations. The 1991 reforms focused on macro-stabilization, devaluation, industrial deregulation, trade liberalisation, and beginning financial sector reforms-but current account convertibility came after stabilization.

Statement iii is correct.

The number of industries reserved for the public sector was significantly reduced-from 17 to 8, and later to only a few strategic ones (defence, atomic energy, railways). This marked a major structural shift toward private participation.

questions.question:
Consider the differences between the cyclones generated in the Bay of Bengal basin and the Arabian Sea basin.

I. Tropical cyclones are more prone to the Bay of Bengal region.

II. The surface temperature of the Bay of Bengal is more than that of the Arabian Sea.

III. Cyclones do not form in the Arabian Sea basin.

Which among the statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
बंगाल की खाड़ी बेसिन और अरब सागर बेसिन में उत्पन्न चक्रवातों के बीच अंतर पर विचार करें।

I. बंगाल की खाड़ी क्षेत्र में उष्णकटिबंधीय चक्रवातों का खतरा अधिक होता है।

II. बंगाल की खाड़ी का सतही तापमान अरब सागर से अधिक है।

III. अरब सागर बेसिन में चक्रवात नहीं बनते हैं।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement III is incorrect:

The Indian subcontinent experiences cyclones from two basins:

· The Bay of Bengal basin and

· The Arabian Sea basin.

Statement I and II are correct:

Of the two, more cyclones are generated in the Bay of Bengal and cyclones here have also been more severe than the one generated over the Arabian Sea.

One of the reasons why tropical cyclones are more prone to the Bay of Bengal is that its surface temperature is more than that of the Arabian Sea.

Tropical cyclones generally need a temperature of around 28 degrees Celsius. The Bay of Bengal is more conducive to this than the Arabian Sea.

questions.solution:
