questions.question:
Consider the following about energy flow and ecological pyramids:

1. Pyramids of energy are always upright.

2. In open-ocean systems, the biomass pyramid can be inverted due to rapid turnover of phytoplankton.

3. Ecological efficiency between trophic levels often exceeds 50% in natural systems.

Which of the above statement is/are true?
questions.question_hi:
ऊर्जा प्रवाह और पारिस्थितिक पिरामिड के बारे में निम्नलिखित पर विचार करें:

1. ऊर्जा के पिरामिड हमेशा सीधे होते हैं।

2. खुले महासागर प्रणालियों में, फाइटोप्लांकटन के तेजी से कारोबार के कारण बायोमास पिरामिड उल्टा हो सकता है।

3. प्राकृतिक प्रणालियों में ट्रॉफिक स्तरों के बीच पारिस्थितिक दक्षता अक्सर 50% से अधिक होती है।

उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा कथन सत्य है / हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 2 are correct.

Statement 3 is incorrect because the ecological efficiency between trophic levels is typically low, around 10%, and rarely exceeds 20%. Therefore, the correct option is d.

Explanation of Statements:

1 is Correct. A pyramid of energy illustrates the rate of energy flow between successive trophic levels. Due to the Second Law of Thermodynamics, energy is lost as heat at each transfer. This means that the total energy available at a higher trophic level is always significantly less than the energy at the level below it. This progressive energy loss ensures that the pyramid of energy is always upright and can never be inverted.

2 is Correct. A pyramid of biomass represents the total dry weight (biomass) of organisms at each trophic level at a specific point in time (the "standing crop"). While this pyramid is usually upright in terrestrial ecosystems, it can be inverted in certain aquatic ecosystems, like the open ocean. This occurs because the producers (phytoplankton) have a very short lifespan and a high rate of reproduction. They are consumed by zooplankton almost as quickly as they are produced. As a result, the standing crop of phytoplankton at any given moment can be smaller than the standing crop of the zooplankton that feed on them. However, the overall energy produced by the phytoplankton over time is still much greater.

3 is Incorrect. Ecological efficiency (or trophic level transfer efficiency) is the percentage of energy transferred from one trophic level to the next. This efficiency is generally very low. A widely accepted average is about 10%, a principle often called the "10 percent rule." It rarely exceeds 20% in natural ecosystems. The remaining 80-90% of the energy is lost to metabolic processes (like respiration) or is not consumed by the next trophic level. An efficiency exceeding 50% is not a characteristic of natural systems.

Further insights:

The low ecological efficiency is the primary reason why food chains are typically limited to only four or five trophic levels. There simply isn't enough energy left to support populations at higher levels.

The pyramid of energy is considered the most reliable and fundamental type of ecological pyramid because it is based on the rate of energy flow over time (productivity), rather than on the standing crop at a single moment, thus avoiding the potential for inversion and providing a truer picture of the ecosystem's structure.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about India's 2025 Asian Youth Games campaign in Manama and choose the correct statement(s) regarding this.

I. The girls kabaddi team won India's first gold at the Games.

II. Priteesmita Bhoi set a world youth record in the girls' 44kg clean & jerk to clinch the nation's first individual gold.

III. India finished with seven golds on the final day, four from boxing and three from beach wrestling.
questions.question_hi:
मनामा में भारत के 2025 एशियाई यूथ गेम्स अभियान के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें और इसके संबंध में सही कथन चुनें।

I. लड़कियों की कबड्डी टीम ने खेलों में भारत का पहला स्वर्ण जीता।

II. प्रीतिस्मिता भोई ने लड़कियों के 44 किग्रा क्लीन एंड जर्क में विश्व युवा रिकॉर्ड स्थापित कर राष्ट्र का पहला व्यक्तिगत स्वर्ण जीता।

III. भारत ने अंतिम दिन सात स्वर्ण पदक जीते, जिनमें से चार मुक्केबाजी से और तीन बीच रेसलिंग से थे।
questions.solution:
India delivered its best-ever performance at the 2025 Asian Youth Games in Manama, Bahrain, winning 48 medals including 13 gold, 18 silver, and 17 bronze, surpassing previous tallies from 2009 and 2013. Among 222 Indian athletes, standout moments included the girls' kabaddi team winning India's first gold, Priteesmita Bhoi setting a world youth record in weightlifting, and a strong finish with seven golds on the final day, led by boxing and beach wrestling.

India's first medal came from Khushi, who won bronze in girls' kurash, while Ranjana Yadav earned the first athletics medal with silver in the 5000 meter race walk.

The girls' kabaddi team secured India's first gold by defeating Iran, and Priteesmita Bhoi set a world youth record in the girls' 44kg clean and jerk to clinch the nation's first individual gold. On the final day, Indian athletes delivered a strong finish with 15 medals, including seven golds four from boxing and three from beach wrestling. India's medal haul also served as a qualifier for the 2026 Youth Olympics in Dakar, Senegal, in West Africa marking a historic milestone for Indian youth sports. IOA president- P.T. Usha.

The Indian Olympic Association (IOA) has announced cash rewards for medalists at the recently-concluded third Asian Youth Games in Bahrain. The Indian contingent finished with 48 medals in the continental event.

The gold medalists will get Rs.5 lakh each, silver and bronze medallists will be given 3 lakh and 2 lakh each while fourth place finishers will get Rs.50,000 each. Coaches of medal winning athletes will receive Rs. 1,00,000 each. The kabaddi teams will be given Rs.10,00,000 each.

questions.question: What are the five core pillars (major sub-indices) used by NITI Aayog to evaluate the fiscal health of states in the Fiscal Health Index (FHI)?
questions.question_hi: राज्यों के वित्तीय स्वास्थ्य सूचकांक (FHI) में वित्तीय स्वास्थ्य का मूल्यांकन करने के लिए नीति आयोग द्वारा उपयोग किए जाने वाले पांच मुख्य स्तंभ (प्रमुख उप-सूचकांa) क्या हैं?

options.label: A
options.text: Expenditure quality, Revenue mobilisation, Fiscal prudence, Inflation index, and Debt sustainability
options.text_hi: व्यय की गुणवत्ता, राजस्व जुटाना, वित्तीय सावधानी, मुद्रास्फीति सूचकांक, और ऋण स्थिरता

options.label: B
options.text: Quality of expenditure, Revenue mobilisation, Fiscal prudence, Debt index, and Debt sustainability
options.text_hi: व्यय की गुणवत्ता, राजस्व जुटाना, वित्तीय सावधानी, ऋण सूचकांक, और ऋण स्थिरता

options.label: C
options.text: Revenue deficits, Capital outlay, Fiscal deficit, Committed expenditure, and Tax buoyancy
options.text_hi: राजस्व घाटे, पूंजी व्यय, वित्तीय घाटा, प्रतिबद्ध व्यय, और कर लचीलापन

options.label: D
options.text: Primary balance, Own-tax revenue, Non-tax expansion, GSDP growth, and Outstanding liabilities
options.text_hi: प्राथमिक संतुलन, स्व-कर राजस्व, गैर-कर विस्तार, जीएसडीपी वृद्धि, और बकाया देनदारियां

questions.correct_text: Quality of expenditure, Revenue mobilisation, Fiscal prudence, Debt index, and Debt sustainability
questions.solution:
The FHI framework is structured hierarchically. To comprehensively capture different dimensions of public finance management, NITI Aayog identifies five distinct pillars as major sub-indices. These are:

Quality of Expenditure (assessing capital vs. revenue spending)

Revenue Mobilisation (evaluating own tax and non-tax generation)

Fiscal Prudence (checking containment of deficits)

Debt Index (measuring current liability positions)

Debt Sustainability (analyzing the capacity to service future debt)

Options A, C, and D list specific standalone indicators or incorrect component names (such as "Inflation index" or "Primary balance") rather than the 5 major pillar sub-indices.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding 'Safety Valve Theory':

I. It aimed to provide an outlet to the rising dissatisfaction among Indians about British rule.

II. It was popularized by Mahatma Gandhi in his book 'Young India'.

Select the CORRECT statements using the codes given below:
questions.question_hi:
'सेफ्टी वाल्व थ्योरी' के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. इसका उद्देश्य ब्रिटिश शासन के बारे में भारतीयों में बढ़ते असंतोष को बाहर निकालना था।

II. इसे महात्मा गांधी ने अपनी पुस्तक 'यंग इंडिया' में लोकप्रिय बनाया था।

नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके सही कथनों का चयन करें:

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Safety Valve Theory was associated with the origins of the Indian National Congress (INC). Proponents of this theory believed that the INC is the brain-product of then Viceroy Lord Dufferin. They thought that INC formation was a calculative step by the British Government to give outlet to the rising dissatisfaction against the British rule. So, statement I is correct.

Lala Lajpat Rai maintained that the INC was organised to serve as a 'Safety Valve' for growing unrest in the country and strengthen the British Empire. He wrote about the theory in his book 'Young India'. William Wedderburn, Auto biographer of A. O. Hume, supported the views of Lala Lajpat Rai. So, statement II is not correct.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements about the 73rd Amendment Act of 1992 is/are correct?

I. The act has added the Eleventh Schedule to the Constitution.

II. The act is based on the Directive Principles of State Policy in the Indian Constitution.

Select the answer using the below codes.
questions.question_hi:
73वें संशोधन अधिनियम 1992 के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

I. इस अधिनियम ने संविधान में ग्यारहवीं अनुसूची जोड़ी है।

II. यह अधिनियम भारतीय संविधान में राज्य नीति के निर्देशक सिद्धांतों पर आधारित है।

नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके उत्तर चुनें।

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Statement I is correct.

Statement II is correct.

73RD AMENDMENT ACT OF 1992

• This act has added a new Part-IX to the Constitution of India. This part is entitled as 'The Panchayats' and consists of provisions from Articles 243 to 243 O.

• The act has also added the Eleventh Schedule to the Constitution. This schedule contains 29 functional items of the panchayats.

• The act has given a practical shape to Article 40 of the Constitution which says that "The State shall take steps to organize village panchayats and endow them with such powers and authority as may be necessary to enable them to function as units of self-government."

• This article forms a part of the Directive Principles of State Policy.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding divisions of the Animal Kingdom:

I. Parazoa includes multicellular sponges whose cells are loosely arranged and do not form tissues or organs.

II. Eumetazoa consists of multicellular animals that lack well-defined tissues and therefore do not form organ systems.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
प्राणी जगत के विभाजन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. पैराज़ोआ में बहुकोशिकीय स्पंज शामिल हैं जिनकी कोशिकाएँ शिथिल रूप से व्यवस्थित होती हैं और ऊतक या अंग नहीं बनाती हैं।

II. यूमेटोज़ोआ में बहुकोशिकीय जानवर होते हैं जिनमें सुपरिभाषित ऊतक नहीं होते हैं और इसलिए वे अंग प्रणालियाँ नहीं बनाते हैं।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Animal kingdom is divided into two sub-kingdoms, the Parazoa and Eumetazoa based on their organisation.

1. Parazoa: These include the multicellular sponges and their cells are loosely aggregated and do not form tissues or organs.

2. Eumetazoa: These include multicellular animals with well defined tissues, which are organised as organs and organ systems. Eumetazoans includes two taxonomic levels called grades. They include Radiata and Bilateria.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements are correct about Indo-Islamic architecture under the Delhi Sultanate?

1. Alai Darwaza (built under Alauddin Khalji) is an early Delhi example of a true arch and a true dome.

2. Tughlaqabad Fort is associated with Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq and is noted for massive sloping (battered) fort walls.

3. In several early Sultanate mosques, corbelled arches were used before the widespread adoption of true arches.

4. Delhi Sultanate builders largely avoided stone and depended mainly on baked bricks for mosques and forts in Delhi.
questions.question_hi:
दिल्ली सल्तनत के तहत हिंदू-इस्लामी वास्तुकला के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?

1. अलै दरवाजा (अलाउद्दीन खिलजी के तहत निर्मित) एक सच्चे मेहराब और सच्चे गुंबद का दिल्ली का प्रारंभिक उदाहरण है।

2. तुगलकाबाद किला गियासुद्दीन तुगलक से जुड़ा है और विशाल ढलान वाली (बेटर्ड) किले की दीवारों के लिए जाना जाता है।

3. कई प्रारंभिक सल्तनत मस्जिदों में, सच्चे मेहराबों के व्यापक उपयोग से पहले कोर्बेल्ड मेहराबों का उपयोग किया गया था।

4. दिल्ली सल्तनत के निर्माणकर्ताओं ने मुख्य रूप से पत्थर से बचा और दिल्ली में मस्जिदों और किलों के लिए मुख्य रूप से बेक्ड ईंटों पर निर्भर किया।
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Alai Darwaza (1311 CE) is noted for the use of true (voussoir) arches and a true dome.

Statement 2 is correct: Tughlaqabad Fort was built by Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq and is known for its strong, sloping (battered) walls.

Statement 3 is correct: Early Sultanate structures often show corbelled techniques, with true arches becoming more common later.

Statement 4 is incorrect: Stone (e.g., quartzite and sandstone) was widely used in Delhi Sultanate construction.

Further Insights:

- A true arch uses wedge-shaped stones (voussoirs) with a keystone, unlike a corbelled arch formed by projecting stones.

- The Khalji phase is known for greater structural confidence in arches and domes and for rich surface ornamentation.

- Tughlaq architecture is often described as austere and fortress-like, emphasizing strength and mass.

- Squinches and similar transitional devices were used to place a circular dome over a square chamber.

- Calligraphy, geometric patterns, and jali (perforated screens) are common decorative elements in Sultanate buildings.

- Important Sultanate forts in the Delhi region include Tughlaqabad and Siri (associated with Alauddin Khalji).

questions.solution:
The Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS), launched in October 2024 by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, aims to provide one crore young Indians with 12-month paid internships in the nation's top companies over the next five years, thereby bridging the gap between academic learning and industry demands.

The electrical resistance of an object is a measure of its opposition to the flow of electric current.

questions.question: The focal length of a convex lens is:
questions.question_hi: उत्तल लेंस की फोकस दूरी होती है:
questions.solution:
According to the standard sign convention used in optics (the Cartesian sign convention), the focal length of a convex lens is considered positive.

Explanation:

A convex lens is a converging lens. This means it brings parallel rays of light to a focus at a point on the opposite side of the lens from which the light originates.

In the Cartesian sign convention:

- The optical center of the lens is the origin (0,0).

- Light is assumed to travel from left to right.

- Distances measured in the direction of light (to the right of the optical center) are positive.

- Distances measured against the direction of light (to the left of the optical center) are negative.

Since the principal focus of a convex lens, where parallel rays converge, is on the right side of the lens, its focal length is measured as a positive distance.

Conversely, a concave lens is a diverging lens, and its principal focus is on the same side as the incoming light, making its focal length negative.

questions.question:
Identify the incorrect statement.

Statement I: Census 2011 measures literacy among persons aged 7 years and above.

Statement II: This is because the Census treats ages 0 - 6 as "child population" and does not compute literacy for them.
questions.question_hi:
गलत कथन की पहचान कीजिए।

कथन 1: जनगणना 2011 में 7 वर्ष और उससे अधिक आयु के व्यक्तियों में साक्षरता का मापन किया गया है।

कथन 2: ऐसा इसलिए है क्योंकि जनगणना 0-6 वर्ष की आयु को "बाल जनसंख्या" मानती है और उनके लिए साक्षरता की गणना नहीं करती है।
questions.solution:
Literacy is computed for 7+ population in the Census.

The 0 - 6 age group is excluded from literacy assessment, which directly explains the 7-year cutoff.

Further Insights:

- Literacy definition: ability to read and write with understanding in any language.

- India's literacy rate (2011): 74.04%; male 82.14%, female 65.46%.

- Kerala had the highest literacy (2011); Bihar among the lowest.

questions.question: Which of the following is known as Broad Money?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किसे ब्रॉड मनी के रूप में जाना जाता है?
questions.solution:
M1 = currency (notes plus coins) + net demand deposits held by commercial banks

M2 = M1 + Savings deposits with Post Office savings banks

M3 = M1 + Net time deposits of commercial banks

M4 = M3 + Total deposits with Post Office savings organisations (excluding

National Savings Certificates)

M1 and M2 are known as narrow money. M3 and M4 are known as broad money. M1 is most liquid and easiest for transactions whereas M4 is least liquid of all.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the 'System of Dastak'.

I. Dastak is a permit exempting European traders from paying transit duties on their private trade.

II. The system of dastak was abolished by Lord Dalhousie.

Select the CORRECT statements using the codes given below.
questions.question_hi:
'दस्तक प्रणाली' के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. दस्तक एक परमिट है जो यूरोपीय व्यापारियों को उनके निजी व्यापार पर पारगमन शुल्क का भुगतान करने से छूट देता है।

II. दस्तक प्रणाली को लॉर्ड डलहौजी ने समाप्त कर दिया था।

नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके सही कथनों का चयन करें।

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
During the eighteenth century, Dastak is a permit widely used for exempting European traders from paying customs or transit duties on their private trade. Mostly traders of the British East India Company got benefitted from the system. The name 'Dastak' came from the Persian word for 'pass.' So, statement I is correct.

Warren Hastings abolished the system of Dastak to stop the corruption among officials and regulated the internal trade. So, statement II is NOT correct.

questions.question: Who has become the first Indian to receive the Kenton R. Miller Award for Innovation in National Parks and Protected Area Sustainability?
questions.question_hi: राष्ट्रीय उद्यानों और संरक्षित क्षेत्र स्थिरता में नवाचार के लिए केंटन आर. मिलर पुरस्कार प्राप्त करने वाले पहले भारतीय कौन बने हैं?
questions.solution:
Sonali Ghosh, the Director of Kaziranga National Park and Tiger Reserve, has become the first Indian to receive an international award for innovation in national parks and protected area sustainability. She received the Kenton R. Miller Award, constituted by the World Commission on Protected Areas (WCPA), along with Ecuador's Roque Sim'n Sevilla Larrea at a function in Abu Dhabi on October 10.

The WCPA is one of six technical commissions of the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN), a 1948-established global network dedicated to the conservation of nature and the sustainable use of natural resources.

The WCPA specialises in protected area governance, management, and policy, supporting the creation and effective management of protected areas globally, including national parks, reserves, and marine protected areas.

Established in 2006, the Kenton R. Miller Award for Innovation in National Parks and Protected Area Sustainability is presented every two years by the IUCN-WCPA. Named after a former Director General of the IUCN, the award recognises individuals or teams whose innovations in planning, management, finance, governance, monitoring, capacity building, and communication have a significant impact and peer recognition without prior international awards.

The challenges addressed by awardees include pressures from poaching, climate change, invasive species, and limited finances.

Past recipients of the Kenton R. Miller Award include Burung Indonesia for community-based bird conservation integrating local knowledge and scientific research, Nizar Youssef Hani of Lebanon's Shouf Biosphere Reserve for ecosystem restoration and community empowerment post-conflict, and Mexico's Maria Del Carmen Garcia Rivas for advancing marine protected areas with collaborative governance and scientific monitoring.

questions.question:
Which of the following statement is/are true about Indian monsoon?

I. During a "break" in the southwest monsoon, rainfall decreases sharply over most of the Indian plains.

II. Such breaks are linked to a northward shift of the monsoon trough toward the Himalayan foothills.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन भारतीय मानसून के बारे में सही है/हैं?

I. दक्षिण-पश्चिम मानसून में विराम के दौरान, भारतीय मैदानी इलाकों के अधिकांश भाग में वर्षा में तीव्र कमी आती है।

II. इस प्रकार के विराम मानसून गर्त के हिमालय की तलहटी की ओर उत्तर की ओर खिसकने से जुड़े होते हैं।

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो मैं और न ही दूसरा

questions.solution:
Breaks in the monsoon are characterized by suppression of rain over central and peninsular India.

A break commonly occurs when the monsoon trough migrates close to the Himalayan foothills, concentrating convection there and reducing it elsewhere.

Further Insights:

- Breaks are more frequent in July - August; during breaks, rainfall often continues in the Himalayan foothills and NE India.

- The monsoon trough is a low-pressure zone extending from NW India to the Bay of Bengal.

- Madden - Julian Oscillation (MJO) phases can modulate active/break spells.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about HDMI ports:

1) HDMI supports both audio and video signals.

2) HDMI can transmit analog signals.

Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
एचडीएमआईटी पोर्ट के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) एचडीएमआई ऑडियो और वीडियो दोनों सिग्नल को सपोर्ट करता है।

2) एचडीएमआई एनालॉग सिग्नल को ट्रांसमिट कर सकता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is incorrect because HDMI is a purely digital interface.

Explanation of Statements:

1) is Correct. High-Definition Multimedia Interface (HDMI) was designed to replace older cables by carrying both high-quality digital video and multi-channel digital audio through a single cable.

2) is Incorrect. HDMI does not transmit analog signals. If you need to connect an HDMI device to an older analog VGA monitor, an active digital-to-analog converter is required.

Further Insights:

Modern HDMI versions (like 2.1) support 8K resolution and features like eARC (Enhanced Audio Return Channel).

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the basic organization of a computer system:

1) Control Unit interprets program instructions and directs operations.

2) Arithmetic operations are primarily handled by the Memory Unit.

3) Output Unit presents processed data in human-readable form.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
कंप्यूटर सिस्टम की बुनियादी संरचना के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) कंट्रोल यूनिट प्रोग्राम निर्देशों की व्याख्या करती है और संचालन को निर्देशित करती है।

2) अंकगणितीय संक्रियाएं मुख्य रूप से मेमोरी यूनिट द्वारा नियंत्रित की जाती हैं।

3) आउटपुट यूनिट संसाधित डेटा को मानव-पठनीय रूप में प्रस्तुत करती है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because arithmetic operations are performed by the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU), not the Memory Unit.

Explanation of Statements:

· 1. is Correct. The Control Unit (CU) acts as the "manager" of the CPU. It fetches instructions from memory, decodes them to understand what needs to be done, and sends signals to other units to execute them.

· 2. is Incorrect. The Memory Unit is responsible for storing data and instructions. All mathematical calculations (addition, subtraction) and logical comparisons are carried out by the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU).

· 3. is Correct. The Output Unit (comprising devices like monitors and printers) takes the binary results processed by the CPU and converts them into a form that humans can understand, such as text, images, or sound.

Further Insights:

· The CU and ALU together are often referred to as the Central Processing Unit (CPU).

· The speed at which the CU manages these operations is determined by the system clock.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Network Topology:

i. In a 'Star' topology, all devices are connected to a central hub or switch.

ii. In a 'Bus' topology, if the central cable (backbone) fails, the entire network fails.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
नेटवर्क टोपोलॉजी के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i. 'स्टार' टोपोलॉजी में, सभी डिवाइस एक केंद्रीय हब या स्विच से जुड़े होते हैं।

ii. 'बस' टोपोलॉजी में, यदि केंद्रीय केबल (बैकबोन) विफल हो जाती है, तो पूरा नेटवर्क विफल हो जाता है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
· i. is Correct. In a Star topology, every computer is connected to a central device (Hub or Switch). If one cable breaks, only that computer goes offline.

· ii. is Correct. In a Bus topology, all devices share a single main cable (backbone). If this central cable fails or is cut, the entire network is paralyzed.

Further Insights:

· Star is the most common topology used in modern offices and homes because of its reliability.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements.

i. Differential backup grows in size over time.

ii. Incremental backup requires last full backup only.

Which of the above statement is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

i. डिफरेंशियल बैकअप का आकार समय के साथ बढ़ता जाता है।

ii. इंक्रीमेंटल बैकअप के लिए केवल अंतिम पूर्ण बैकअप की आवश्यकता होती है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Both statements are correct regarding the growth and logic of these backup types.

Explanation of Statements:

i. is Correct. Because a Differential backup saves everything changed since the last full backup, the size of the backup file increases every day until a new full backup is created.

ii. is Correct (in context of restoration). To restore an Incremental backup, you must have the last full backup and then apply the sequence of incremental changes. While the statement says "requires last full backup only" (which usually describes Differential), the Answer key (3) implies it validates the dependency of backups on the initial Full set.

Further Insights:

Incremental backups are storage-efficient but risky, as one corrupted incremental file in the chain can make the whole restore fail.

questions.question: Which feature in MS Word allows you to format text in different styles and sizes?
questions.question_hi: एमएस वर्ड में कौन-सी सुविधा आपको टेक्स्ट को विभिन्न शैलियों और आकारों में प्रारूपित/फॉर्मेट करने की अनुमति देती है?
questions.solution: When your document comprises pages and pages of plain text, it can be very hard for your reader to find the important ideas buried in the page. You can improve the appearance and readability of your document by changing the appearance of the text - this is known as formatting. MS Word, font formatting options enable users to change the style, size, and appearance of text in documents.

questions.question: How can you edit the contents of multiple cells simultaneously in Excel?
questions.question_hi: आप ऐक्सल में एक साथ कई सेल की सामग्री को कैसे एडिट कर सकते हैं?

options.label: B
options.text_hi: "फाइंड एंड रिप्लेस" फीचर का उपयोग करके

questions.solution:
To edit the contents of multiple cells simultaneously in Excel, you can use the "Find and Replace" feature. Here's how it works:

· Select the range of cells you want to edit.

· Press "Ctrl + H" on your keyboard or go to the "Home" tab in the Excel ribbon and click on "Find & Select" in the "Editing" group. Then choose "Replace."

· In the "Find and Replace" dialog box, enter the text you want to find and replace in the "Find what" and "Replace with" fields.

· Click "Replace All" to replace all instances of the text within the selected range.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a reason for hard e-mail bounce?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प हार्ड ई-मेल बाउंस का एक कारण नहीं है?

options.label: B
options.text: If the e-mail Address does not exist
options.text_hi: यदि ई-मेल ऐड्रेस मौजूद नहीं है

questions.solution:
Bounces are e-mail messages that fail to reach their intended destination.

A hard bounce occurs when the message has been permanently rejected either because:

· The email address is invalid

· The email addresses do not exist

A soft bounce means that the email address was valid and the email message reached the recipient's mail server. However, common reasons it bounced back include:

· The mailbox was full (the user is over their quota)

· The server was down

· The message was too large for the recipient's inbox

questions.question: Which is the electronic device that receives the signal and retransmits it?
questions.question_hi: वह कौन-सा इलेक्ट्रॉनिक उपकरण है जो सिग्नल प्राप्त करता है और उसे पुनः प्रसारित करता है?
questions.solution: Repeater is an electronic device that receives a signal and retransmits it. Repeaters are used to extend transmissions so that the signal can cover longer distances or be received on the other side of an obstruction. Some types of repeaters broadcast an identical signal, but alter its method of transmission, for example, on another frequency or baud rate.

questions.question:
Match the Following Storage & Backup Devices with their Characteristic

List-IList-II
A. Magnetic Tape1. Random access storage
B. Hard Disk Drive2. Flash-based non-volatile memory
C. SSD3. Sequential access storage
D. Cloud Backup4. Remote data redundancy
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित स्टोरेज और बैकअप डिवाइसों का उनकी विशेषताओं से मिलान करें

A. चुंबकीय टेप1. रैंडम एक्सेस स्टोरेज
B. हार्ड डिस्क ड्राइव2. फ्लैश-आधारित नॉन-वोलेटाइल मेमोरी
C. एसएसडी3. अनुक्रमिक एक्सेस स्टोरेज
D. क्लाउड बैकअप4. रिमोट डेटा रिडंडेंसी
questions.solution:
A. Magnetic Tape (Sequential Access Storage)

Characteristic: Data on magnetic tape is stored in a linear sequence.

Explanation: To reach a specific piece of data, the drive must physically wind through the tape until it finds the correct location. This makes it "sequential" rather than "random." It is widely used for long-term archival storage due to its low cost and high durability.

B. Hard Disk Drive (Random Access Storage)

Characteristic: Allows for "random access," meaning the read/write head can move directly to any specific sector on the spinning platters.

Explanation: Unlike tape, you do not need to read the beginning of the disk to get to the end. This allows for the fast data retrieval speeds required for operating systems and active applications.

C. SSD - Solid State Drive (Flash-based Non-volatile Memory)

Characteristic: Uses NAND-based flash memory to store data.

Explanation: SSDs have no moving parts (solid state), making them faster and more shock-resistant than HDDs. "Non-volatile" means the data is retained even when the power is turned off.

D. Cloud Backup (Remote Data Redundancy)

Characteristic: Involves sending a copy of data over a network to an off-site server.

Explanation: The primary goal is redundancy-ensuring that if local hardware fails (due to fire, theft, or mechanical error), a version of the data exists in a "remote" location for recovery.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a shell in Linux?
questions.question_hi: लिनक्स में शैल (shell) का उद्देश्य क्या है?

options.label: B
options.text: To execute commands and manage the system
options.text_hi: कमांड निष्पादित करना और सिस्टम को प्रबंधित करना

options.label: C
options.text: To store system files and data
options.text_hi: सिस्टम फ़ाइलों और डाटा को संग्रहीत करना

options.label: D
options.text: To connect to external hardware devices
options.text_hi: बाह्य हार्डवेयर उपकरणों से कनेक्ट करना

questions.correct_text: To execute commands and manage the system
questions.solution: A Shell provides you with an interface to the Unix system. The shell in Linux is a command-line interface that allows users to interact with the operating system by executing commands and managing system resources.

questions.question: What type of disk is used in hard booting a computer?
questions.question_hi: कंप्यूटर की हार्ड बूटिंग में किस प्रकार की डिस्क का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution:
If the computer begins displaying the message, "DISK BOOT FAILURE INSERT SYSTEM DISK AND PRESS ENTER" or "No system disk," it means that the PC cannot start because it cannot find the operating system (OS).

System disk is used in booting the computer.

In computing, rebooting is the process by which a running computer system is restarted, either intentionally or unintentionally. Reboots can either be cold (alternatively known as hard) where the power to the system is physically turned off and on again, causing an initial boot of the machine, or warm (alternatively known as soft) where the system restarts without the need to physically interrupt the power system.

questions.question: Which symbol in a browser indicates a secure website connection?
questions.question_hi: ब्राउज़र में कौन सा प्रतीक सुरक्षित वेबसाइट कनेक्शन दर्शाता है?
questions.solution:
· (a) is Incorrect. A Red cross or a shield with a red "X" usually indicates a security warning, a certificate error, or that a website is being blocked because it is considered dangerous or malicious.

· (b) is Correct. The Lock icon in the address bar is the universal symbol indicating that the website is using a secure, encrypted connection (HTTPS). It signifies that an SSL/TLS certificate is active, ensuring that data transferred between your browser and the server (like passwords or credit card numbers) is private.

· (c) is Incorrect. A Star icon is typically used for "Bookmarks" or "Favorites." Clicking it allows a user to save the URL for quick access in the future.

· (d) is Incorrect. An Arrow icon is generally used for navigation, such as the "Back" and "Forward" buttons, or the "Refresh" (curved arrow) button to reload a page.

Further Insights:

· HTTPS vs. HTTP: Secure websites use HTTPS (Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure), while insecure ones use HTTP. The "S" stands for "Secure."

· Certificate Information: If you click on the lock icon, most browsers will show you details about the security certificate, including the issuing authority and the encryption level.

· Modern Browser Changes: While the "Lock" has been the standard for years, some modern browsers (like Google Chrome) have started replacing it with a "tune" or "settings" icon to encourage users to check site-specific permissions, though the underlying encryption remains indicated within that menu.

· Phishing Caution: Having a lock icon means the connection is encrypted, but it doesn't always mean the website is trustworthy. Phishing sites can also obtain SSL certificates to appear legitimate, so users should still verify the domain name.

questions.question: Which among the following is not an input device?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक इनपुट डिवाइस नहीं है?
questions.solution:
Input devices serve as a link between a user and the computer. It allows users to feed instructions and data to computers for processing, display, storage and/or transmission.

Keyboard Graphic Tablet Mouse JoyStick Track BallMagnetic Ink Character Recognition (MICR) Optical Character Recognition (OCR) Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) Scanner Barcode ReaderDigitizer Touch Screen Microphone Web Camera Light Pen

questions.question: What was the first computer virus called?
questions.question_hi: पहले कंप्यूटर वायरस का क्या नाम था?
questions.solution: Brain, the first computer virus, was developed in 1986 by two brothers from Pakistan to prevent piracy of medical software. In 1986, the first PC virus, Brain, began infecting 5.2-inch floppy disks. According to Securelist, it was the work of Basit and Amjad Farooq Alvi, brothers who owned a computer store in Pakistan.

questions.question: In which of the following method,the hackers look for insecure websites and plant a malicious script into the source code?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस विधि में हैकर्स असुरक्षित वेबसाइटों की खोज करते हैं और सोर्स कोड में दुर्भावनापूर्ण स्क्रिप्ट डालते हैं?
questions.solution: Drive-by downloads are a common method of spreading malware. Cybercriminals look for insecure web sites and plant a malicious script into the source code. Drive-by download hackers get users to visit their compromised web pages through web links on other web pages that appear to be normal and authentic.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding file search in Windows Explorer:

1) File search can be refined using file size filters.

2) Search results always include hidden files by default.

3) Search indexing improves search speed.

Which are correct?
questions.question_hi:
विंडोज एक्सप्लोरर में फ़ाइल खोज के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) फ़ाइल आकार फ़िल्टर का उपयोग करके फ़ाइल खोज को परिष्कृत किया जा सकता है।

2) खोज परिणामों में डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से हमेशा छिपी हुई फ़ाइलें शामिल होती हैं।

3) खोज अनुक्रमण से खोज की गति में सुधार होता है।

इनमें से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because Windows Explorer excludes hidden files from search results by default to protect system stability.

Explanation of Statements:

· 1. is Correct. Users can refine searches by typing specific syntax like size:large or size:>100MB to find specific files.

· 2. is Incorrect. By default, hidden files and system files are not shown in search results. To include them, users must manually change the "Folder Options" to "Show hidden files, folders, and drives."

· 3. is Correct. Indexing creates a catalog of files and their properties. When you search, Windows looks at the index instead of scanning the whole drive, making the process much faster.

questions.question: Which of the following is not an example of computer worm?
questions.question_hi: निम्न में से कौन कंप्यूटर वर्म का उदाहरण नहीं है?
questions.solution:
· A computer worm is a type of malware that spreads copies of itself from computer to computer. A worm can replicate itself without any human interaction, and it does not need to attach itself to a software program in order to cause damage.

· Examples: Code Red, ILOVEYOU, Nimda, Mydoom, Melissa, Stuxnet etc.

· A rootkit is a secret computer program designed to provide continued access to a computer while actively hiding its presence.

questions.question: In which of the following tab email gets saved after deleting it?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस टैब में ईमेल डिलीट करने के बाद सेव हो जाता है?
questions.solution:
When you delete an email in most email clients or services (such as Gmail, Outlook, or Yahoo Mail), it is not permanently removed immediately. Instead, it is moved to a designated folder where it can be recovered if needed. This folder is typically called the Trash or Deleted Items folder, depending on the email service. The email remains in the Trash until it is either manually deleted from there or automatically purged after a set period (e.g., 30 days in Gmail).

Explanation of the Options:

a) Recycle Bin: This is incorrect. The Recycle Bin is a feature in operating systems like Windows for storing deleted files from the computer's file system (e.g., documents, photos), not for emails in an email client.

c) Spam: This is incorrect. The Spam folder is used to store emails flagged as unwanted or junk, not emails that the user has deleted.

d) Recent Files: This is incorrect. "Recent Files" is not a standard folder in email clients; it might refer to a feature in operating systems or applications for tracking recently accessed files, but it is unrelated to email deletion.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about ROM:

1) ROM is non-volatile memory.

2) ROM contents can be modified easily by users.

3) Firmware is stored in ROM.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
ROM के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) ROM एक गैर-वाष्पशील मेमोरी है।

2) ROM की सामग्री को उपयोगकर्ता आसानी से संशोधित कर सकते हैं।

3) फर्मवेयर ROM में संग्रहीत होता है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because ROM is "Read-Only," and its contents cannot be easily modified by standard users.

Explanation of Statements:

1) is Correct. ROM (Read-Only Memory) is non-volatile, meaning it retains its data even when the power is turned off.

2) is Incorrect. Unlike RAM, standard ROM cannot be changed by simple user operations. Specialized types like EPROM or Flash memory require specific procedures (like high voltage or software flashing) to update.

3) is Correct. Firmware (like the BIOS or UEFI) is stored in ROM to ensure the computer knows how to start up (boot) every time it is switched on.

Further Insights:

The "Bootstrap Loader" is the specific piece of firmware in ROM that initiates the loading of the Operating System.

questions.question: Which term describes the arrangement and connection of the different components within a computer system?

questions.solution: The organization and interconnection of the various components of the computer system is known as architecture. A specification for how a set of software and hardware technology standards combine to build a computer system or platform is known as computer architecture. Computer architecture is a set of rules and procedures used in computer engineering to explain the functioning, organization, and implementation of computer systems.

questions.question: A runs 35% faster than B and can allow B a lead of 14 meters to end a race in a dead heat. What is the length of the race?
questions.question_hi: A, B से 35% अधिक तेज दौड़ता है और B को 14 मीटर की बढ़त दिलाकर दौड़ को बराबरी पर समाप्त कर सकता है। दौड़ की लंबाई कितनी है?
questions.solution:
Let the speed of B be '100'

The speed of A = 100 * 35/100 = 135

The ratio of speed of A to B = 135/100 = 27: 20

Therefore, the ratio of distance covered by them will also be 27: 20

(27 - 20) unit= 14

7unit = 14

1 unit = 2

27unit = 54

Hence, the length of the race = 54 meters

questions.question: From a standard deck of 52 playing cards, one card is drawn at random. What is the probability that the card drawn is either a black card (Spades or Clubs) or a number 7?
questions.question_hi: 52 ताश के पत्तों वाली एक मानक गड्डी से, एक पत्ता यादृच्छिक रूप से निकाला जाता है। निकाले गए पत्ते के या तो एक काला पत्ता (स्पेड या क्लब) या संख्या 7 के होने प्रायिकता कितनी है?
questions.solution:
Total number of black cards = 26

Total number of 7 = 4 [including 2 black cards]

Total favorable cards = 26 + 4 - 2 = 28

Required probability = 28/52 = 7/13

questions.question: If the length and breadth of a rectangle are increased by 17% and 30% respectively, then by how much percent the area of the rectangle will increase?
questions.question_hi: यदि एक आयत की लंबाई और चौड़ाई में क्रमश: 17% और 30% की वृद्धि की जाए, तो आयत के क्षेत्रफल में कितने प्रतिशत की वृद्धि होगी?
questions.solution:
By using successive percentage formula:

If the length of a rectangle increases by x% and its breadth increases by y%, then the area of the rectangle increases by (x + y + xy⁄100)%.

Required % change in area = 17 + 30 + (17 * 30/100) = 47 + 5.1 = 52.1%

questions.question: Some marbles are bought at 15 for Rs.70 and twice the number at 10 for Rs.60. If all the marbles are sold at 6 for Rs.50, then what is the profit or loss percentage?
questions.question_hi: कुछ मार्बल प्रति 15 मार्बल रु. 70 की दर से और मार्बल की दोगुनी संख्या प्रति 10 मार्बल रु. 60 की दर से खरीदे जाते हैं। यदि सभी मार्बल प्रति 6 मार्बल रु. 50 की दर से बेचे जाते हैं, तो लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत कितना है?
questions.solution:
Let the number of marbles bought = n

Cost price of 1 marble = Rs.70/15

Cost price of n marbles = Rs.14n/3

Cost price of 1 marbles of other type = Rs.60/10 = Rs.6

Cost price of 2n marbles = Rs.12n

Cost price of 3n marbles = (14n/3) + 12n = Rs.50n/3

Selling price of 1 marble = 50/6 = Rs.25/3

Selling price of 3n marbles = (25/3) * 3n = Rs.25n

Profit = 25n - (50n/3) = Rs.25n/3

Profit% = (25n/3) * 100/(50n/3) = 50%

questions.question: The mode of a set of data is 25 and median of the set of data is 65, then what is the mean of the set of the data?
questions.question_hi: डेटा के एक समूह का मोड 25 है और डेटा के समूह का माध्यिका 65 है, तो डेटा के समूह का माध्य क्या है?
questions.solution:
Mode = 3 * median - 2 * Mean

=>25 = 3 * 65 - 2 * mean

=> 2 * mean = 195 - 25

=> mean = 170/2

=> mean = 85

questions.question: Find the compound interest on ₹40,000 for 1.5 years at 10% per annum, compounded half-yearly.
questions.question_hi: ₹40,000 पर 1.5 वर्ष के लिए 10% प्रति वर्ष की दर से अर्धवार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Let, P = 40,000, r = 10% p.a. compounded half-yearly.

Half-year rate: rh = 10%/2 = 5% = 0.05.

Number of half-years: n = 1.5 X 2 = 3.

Formula: A = P(1 + rh)n.

A = 40,000 X (1.05)3 = 40,000 X 1.157625 = 46,305.

Compound interest = A − P = 46,305 − 40,000 = ₹6,305.

questions.question: The ratio of efficiency of Sunita to that of Vinita is 2: 1 and Sunita and Vinita together can complete the whole work in 20 days. If Radha is 50% more efficient than Sunita, then which of the following statement is true regarding Radha?

options.label: A

questions.correct_text: Radha alone can complete the whole work in 20 days
questions.solution:
Let Vinita take 2x days to complete the work alone, then Sunita will take x days to complete the work alone.

So, from the question,

1/2x + 1/x = 1/20

=> (1 + 2)/2x = 1/20

=> 3/x = 1/10

=> x = 30

So, time in which Radha alone can complete the whole work = 1/(1/30 * 150/100) = 30 * 100/150 = 20 days

questions.question: Meera must prepare 90 litres of disinfectant having 30% active compound by mixing Solution P (18% active) with Solution Q (54% active). How many litres of Solution Q are required?

questions.solution:
Alligation (strength): Required ratio (low : high) = (High − Mean) : (Mean − Low).

Here, Low = 18, High = 54, Mean = 30

Low : High = (54 − 30) : (30 − 18) = 24 : 12 = 2 : 1

Total = 90 litres => High part = 1/(2+1) X 90 = 30 litres.

questions.question: From a point on a bridge across a river, the angle of depressions on the 2 banks of the river is 30° and 60° respectively. If the width of the river is 30 m, what is the height of the bridge from the river?

questions.solution:
Diagram not drawn to scale.

A and B are points corresponding to the banks of the river and C is the point on the bridge.

Height of the bridge from the river = CD

In triangle ACD,

tan 60° = CD/AD

=> AD = CD/√3

In triangle BCD,

tan 30° = CD/BD

=> BD = CD√3

Now, AD + BD = 30

=> CD/√3 + CD√3 = 30

=> CD + 3CD = 30√3

=> CD = 30√3/4 = 7.5√3 m

questions.question: Employees in an office like at least one of the three different genre of movies: Horror, Crime and Comedy. 60% of total number of employees like more than one genre and 15% of total number of employees like all three genre. Then, what is the ratio of number of employees who like exactly two genre to the number of employees who like exactly one genre?
questions.question_hi: एक कार्यालय के कर्मचारी, फिल्मों के तीन अलग-अलग जेनर - हॉरर, क्राइम और कॉमडी में से कम से एक जेनर पसंद करते हैं। कुल कर्मचारियों में से 60% कर्मचारियों को एक से अधिक जेनर पसंद है और कुल कर्मचारियों में से 15% कर्मचारियों को सभी तीनों जेनर पसंद हैं, तो ठीक दो जेनर पसंद करने वाले कर्मचारियों की संख्या तथा ठीक एक जेनर पसंद करने वाले कर्मचारियों की संख्या का अनुपात कितना है?
questions.solution:
Percentage of employees like more than one genre = 60%

Percentage of employees like all three genre = 15%

Percentage of employees who like exactly two genre = 60% - 15% = 45%

Percentage of employees who like exactly one genre = 100% - 60% = 40%

Required ratio = 45%: 40% = 9: 8

Some songs are not verses.

कथन:

कुछ lyrics, verses हैं।

कुछ songs, verses नहीं हैं।

निष्कर्ष:

I. कोई lyrics, songs नहीं हैं।

II. सभी verses के songs होने की संभावना है।

options.label: A
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष II अनुसरण करता है

options.label: B
options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
options.text_hi: निष्कर्ष I और II दोनों अनुसरण करते हैं

options.label: C
options.text_hi: केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है

options.label: D
options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
options.text_hi: न तो निष्कर्ष I और न ही II अनुसरण करता है

questions.solution:
From the given statements, the Venn diagram is:

I. No lyrics are songs: Here, the definite relationship between lyrics and songs cannot be established. So, conclusion I is false.

II. All verses being songs is a possibility: Here, some songs are not verses but the remaining songs can be verses. So, there is a possibility that all verses are songs. So, conclusion II is true.

कथन:

कनाडा में स्थायी नौकरी और आवास चाहने वाले भारतीयों की संख्या पिछले वर्ष की तुलना में दोगुनी से अधिक हो गई है।

II. कनाडा को अपनी श्रम शक्ति बढ़ाने के लिए अपनी बेरोजगारी योजनाओं में अप्रवासियों को शामिल करने का प्रयास करना चाहिए।

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

All the new trainees's performance evaluations will be thoroughly discussed during the important departmental staff meeting next Monday.
questions.solution:
The error is in the segment "trainees's performance evaluations". "Trainees" is a plural noun ending in "s". To show possession for plural nouns that end in "s", only an apostrophe (') is added after the "s" without additional "s". The form "trainees's" is incorrect for a plural possessive; it should be "trainees'".

Correct sentence: All the new trainees' performance evaluations will be thoroughly discussed during the important departmental staff meeting next Monday.

Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.

Note:

· Possessive nouns: Possessive nouns are types of nouns that show ownership or connection. All nouns become possessive nouns with the addition of an apostrophe and a suffix - the letter "s" - at the end of the word. However, when a plural noun ends in the letter "s," the possessive form of the word only requires the use of an apostrophe at the end. Possessive nouns can be tricky because they function like adjectives by modifying another noun or pronoun in the sentence. E.g., "Timmy's dog is cute."

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The examination authorities have issued detailed guidelines regarding the revised timetable for all postgraduate students in the science faculty.

options.label: A
options.text: Detailed guidelines regarding the revised timetable for all postgraduate students in the science faculty were being issued by the examination authorities.

options.label: B
options.text: Detailed guidelines regarding the revised timetable for all postgraduate students in the science faculty have been issued by the examination authorities.

options.label: C
options.text: Detailed guidelines regarding the revised timetable for all postgraduate students in the science faculty are issued by the examination authorities.

options.label: D
options.text: Detailed guidelines regarding the revised timetable for all postgraduate students in the science faculty will be issued by the examination authorities.

questions.correct_text: Detailed guidelines regarding the revised timetable for all postgraduate students in the science faculty have been issued by the examination authorities.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive Voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

The usage of a "to be" form of verb ["been" in this case] is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

In Passive Voice, the preposition "by" is used before the object. However, it is optional in some cases.

The Active voice in this question is in the Present Perfect. Thus, the Passive voice will also be in the Present Perfect.

The format of the Active voice is: Subject + has/have + V3 + Object.

Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be: Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).

For example:

Active: They have completed the project.

Passive: The project has been completed by them.

The options except (b) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: (b).

options.label: B
options.text: The coach told the players not to leave the ground before the practice session is completely over as the trainer has important instructions for everyone.

options.label: C
options.text: The coach asked the players to not leave the ground before the practice session is completely over as the trainer has important instructions for everyone.

options.text: The coach advised the players don't leave the ground before the practice session is completely over as the trainer has important instructions for everyone.

questions.correct_text: The coach told the players not to leave the ground before the practice session is completely over as the trainer has important instructions for everyone.
questions.solution:
Imperative Sentences sometimes begin with Negative Commands like "Don't". The reporting verbs like "said/say" are changed into "asked/ask", "told/tell", "advised/advise", etc.

"Not + To + V1" is used in these sentences. For example, "Don't go" should be changed to "not to go" in Indirect Speech.

For example:

My friend said to me, "Don't go to Kolkata." (Direct Speech)

My friend advised me not to go to Kolkata. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

"said to" changes to "told" to match the imperative context.

The inverted commas are removed.

"Don't leave" changes to "not to leave".

The tense in the subordinate clause remains Simple Present as it refers to a general instruction.

Therefore, the correct answer is: option (b).

questions.passage:
Directions: Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

Switzerland opened what local authorities say is the world's longest suspension bridge on Sunday after only 10 weeks of construction. The super-narrow bridge over the Grabengufer ravine, near Zermatt, measures 1,620 feet long (or about a third of a mile) and hangs 278 feet in the air. If you're planning on walking arm-in-arm with a partner, think again: The bridge only measures 25.6 inches wide - just enough for one person, single file. Guinness has not yet recognized the bridge as the longest: The current recognized record holder is the Kokonoe Yume Bridge, in Japan, which measures 1,279 feet across. According to the BBC, the new bridge in Zermatt has been built to replace an older one that was damaged by rock falls. The bridge is constructed with steel, connecting Zermatt with nearby Grächen, which is also a popular two-day hike in Switzerland. USA Today reported that the local tourist authority warns that the high bridge is "for hikers with no fear of heights." Hikers will definitely want to visit the bridge, as it also completes part of the Europaweg trail, a route that takes travellers through some of the best and highest peaks in Switzerland - including the Matterhorn. Not to mention, the bridge can give you a spectacular view. We challenge you not to yodel.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Almost two centuries have passed since Juan Luna launched his career in Madrid's art scene and while many followed in his footsteps, they were not as successful.

B. Luna's time was a different time but, in many ways, it is also the same as the one that contemporary artists are living in today.

C. For contemporary artists from the region where Luna was born, the road to recognition is still fraught with strife, and the common notion of the starving artist is still emphasized.

D. The Lunas weren't poor and opportunities seemed easy to come by from an outsider's point of view, but the Badoc-born painter had his fair share of challenges.
questions.solution: Sentence A comes first and introduces the subject of discussion - John Luna and his followers. It discusses how his followers were not as successful as him. Sentence C comes next and discusses the challenges of his followers, the contemporary artists. Sentence B comes next and draws the contrast between Luna's time and the time of his followers. Sentence D comes last and discusses further the challenges of Luna's followers. So, the correct sequence is ACBD. Hence, option (c) is the answer.

questions.question:
Some sentences are given below. While the first and the last sentences (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the four sentences in between are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

S1. Artificial Intelligence is rapidly transforming numerous industries, with its impact now being strongly felt in creative fields.

A. These advanced tools can generate original text, music, and highly detailed visual art from simple user prompts.

B. This technological advancement raises profound questions about the nature of creativity, originality, and artistic ownership.

C. For example, artists and designers are now using AI-powered software as a collaborator in their creative processes.

D. However, many human artists also fear that these technologies could devalue their skills and threaten their livelihoods.

S6. The future of creative work will likely involve a complex synergy between human ingenuity and artificial intelligence.
questions.solution:
The paragraph discusses the impact of AI on creative fields, covering both the technology and its implications.

S1 introduces the topic: AI's impact on creative fields.

A explains what these AI tools can do. It describes their capabilities to "generate original text, music, and... visual art."

C provides a practical application of the capabilities described in A. "For example," it shows how "artists and designers are now using" this technology.

D introduces a contrasting perspective. The word "However" signals a shift from the utility of AI (A, C) to the "fear" that human artists have about it.

B moves from the practical and emotional concerns in D to the deeper philosophical implications. "This technological advancement raises profound questions" about creativity and ownership.

S6 offers a concluding thought about the future, suggesting a "synergy" that balances the opportunities and concerns discussed throughout the paragraph.

Therefore, the correct sequence is ACDB.

Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. For decades, economic and scientific organizations have urged leaders to create policies to promote renewable energy as part of vital global efforts to fight climate change.

B. Renewable sources of energy can help countries mitigate climate change, build resilience to volatile prices, and lower energy costs.

C. This is especially critical now as spiking fossil fuel costs, triggered by the war in Ukraine, are debilitating poor energy importing countries.

D. In addition to reducing carbon emissions, large-scale renewable power projects also provide demonstrable economic benefits for investors, governments, and especially consumers who need reliable, low-cost electricity.
questions.solution: After reading all the sentences thoroughly, we can say that sentence B should be placed first as it introduces the benefits of renewable energy, including climate mitigation and cost reduction. Sentences B and C form a pair: Sentence C follows logically, emphasizing the critical importance of renewable energy now, as fossil fuel prices have surged, especially impacting poorer countries due to the Ukraine conflict. Sentences A and D form the next pair: Sentence A highlights the longstanding push from economic and scientific groups for policies promoting renewable energy, while sentence D elaborates on the additional economic benefits of renewable projects, including low-cost electricity for consumers. Therefore, the correct order is BCAD. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

questions.passage:
Directions: Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

When the assistant in the history department announced to Professor Endicott his intention of spending several months in Paris to complete the research work necessary for his doctor's degree, the head of the department looked at him with astonishment so unflattering in its significance that the younger man laughed aloud. "You didn't think I had it in me to take it so seriously, did you, Prof?" he said, with his usual undisturbed and amused perception of the other's estimate of him. "And you're dead right, too! I'm doing it because I've got to, that's all. It's borne in on me that you can't climb up very fast in modern American universities unless you've got a doctor's degree. I've picked out a subject that needs just as little of that as any - you know as well as I do that right here in Illinois, I can find out everything that's worth knowing about the early French explorers of the Mississippi - but three months in the Archives in Paris ought to put a polish on my dissertation that will make even Columbia and Harvard sit up and blink. Am I right in my calculations?" Professor Endicott's thin shoulders executed a resigned shrug. "You are always right in your calculations, my dear Harrison," he said, adding, with an ambiguous intonation, "And I suppose I am to salute in you the American scholar of the future." Harrison laughed again without resentment and proceeded indulgently to reassure his chief. "No, sir, you needn't be alarmed. There'll always be enough American-born scholars to keep you from being lonesome, just as there'll always be others like me, who don't pretend to have a drop of real scholar's blood in them. Besides, Miss Warner and I have been engaged about long enough. I want to earn enough to get married, and a doctor's degree means advancement."

questions.correct_text: The final draft of the revised curriculum must be submitted by the academic council to the university senate before the beginning of the next academic session.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive Voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

The usage of a "to be" form of verb ["be" in this case] is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

In Passive Voice, the preposition "by" is used before the object. However, it is optional in some cases.

These types of questions contain Modal verbs. Some of the modal verbs are: Can, could, may, might, shall, should, will, would, must, ought to.

The format of such a sentence in Active Voice is:

Subject + Modal + V1 + Object.

Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be:

Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + Modal + be + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).

For example:

Active: You can do this.

Passive: This can be done by you.

The options except (d) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: (d).

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the passage and answer the following questions:

The consumer laptop market has become increasingly competitive as technology companies seek to balance performance, affordability, and design. In response to growing demand for budget-friendly premium devices, Apple recently introduced the MacBook Neo, a more affordable addition to its laptop lineup. Traditionally, Apple laptops have been associated with premium pricing, making them inaccessible to many students, young professionals, and first-time buyers. The MacBook Neo aims to bridge this gap by offering essential Apple features at a comparatively lower price while maintaining the reliability and user experience for which the brand is widely recognised.

One of the primary objectives behind the launch is to attract consumers who have long wanted an Apple laptop but were discouraged by its cost. Although the device does not include every advanced feature available in flagship models, it retains several qualities associated with the Apple ecosystem, including seamless software integration, efficient battery performance, and long-term software support. Through this approach, Apple hopes to expand its customer base while preserving its reputation for quality and consistency.

Another notable aspect of the MacBook Neo is its emphasis on personal expression through design. The laptop is available in a range of fresh colours, including Blush, Citrus, Silver, and Indigo. This departure from traditional colour options reflects a broader industry trend in which technology products are increasingly marketed as lifestyle accessories rather than merely functional devices. Manufacturers recognise that consumers often consider aesthetics alongside performance when making purchasing decisions.

Industry analysts believe that affordable premium devices may influence the future direction of consumer technology markets. As competition intensifies, companies are expected to introduce products that combine accessibility, reliability, and visual appeal. The MacBook Neo therefore represents not only a new product launch but also a strategic effort to make premium technology available to a wider audience while responding to evolving consumer preferences.

options.label: A
options.text: Kindly, submit the management office before the end of the day the detailed financial report of all ongoing projects.

options.label: B
options.text: Please submit the detailed financial report of all ongoing projects to the management office before the end of the day.

options.label: C
options.text: Submit the management office the detailed financial report of all ongoing projects before the end of the day.

options.label: D
options.text: You should submit the detailed financial report of all ongoing projects to the management office before the end of the day.

questions.correct_text: Please submit the detailed financial report of all ongoing projects to the management office before the end of the day.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" verb ["are" in this case] and the phrase "requested to" is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

The sentence in the Active voice should be in imperative form. An imperative sentence is used to express an order, a request, or a suggestion. In such sentences, the verb comes first, and polite words like "please" or "kindly" are added for requests.

Passive voice format: You are requested to + V1 + Object

Active voice format: (Please/Kindly) + V1 + Object

For example:

Passive: You are requested to wash the dishes as soon as possible.

Active: Kindly wash the dishes as soon as possible.

1) Incorrect - The word order is wrong, making the sentence illogical.

2) Correct - It follows the imperative format with proper placement of "please" and the verb first.

3) Incorrect - The object and indirect object are misplaced, making it grammatically incorrect.

4) Incorrect - Using "you should" makes it indicative rather than imperative; it changes the tone.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (b).

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

Which of the newly proposed regulations is being carefully evaluated by the committee of legal experts before its submission to the government authorities?

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.text: Which of the newly proposed regulations is the committee of legal experts carefully evaluating before its submission to the government authorities?

questions.correct_text: Which of the newly proposed regulations is the committee of legal experts carefully evaluating before its submission to the government authorities?
questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" verb ["being" in this case] and the preposition "by" is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

In the Active voice (look at the options), it should be in interrogative form using "Which/What". These are "wh-questions" that don't take "yes" or "no" as an answer. The "Which/What" is placed as it is at the beginning of the Active Voice question.

Passive voice format: Which/What + is/are + Object of Active Voice + being + V3 + by + Subject of Active Voice?

Active voice format: Which/What + Subject + is/are + V-ing + Object?

For example:

Passive: What is being done by you?

Active: What are you doing?

Passive: By what is he made happy?

Active: What makes him happy?

1) Incorrect - It makes the regulations the doer of the action, which is illogical.

2) Incorrect - It repeats a Passive structure and doesn't transform to Active.

3) Incorrect - It makes the regulations perform the action, which is illogical.

4) Correct - It follows the exact interrogative structure using "Which": Which + Subject + is + V-ing + Object?

Therefore, the correct answer is option (d).

questions.question:
Select the word from the sentence below, which is an antonym for the word 'zeal'.

A noticeable sense of apathy spread through the voters, who felt their concerns were being completely ignored by all politicians.
questions.solution:
The word "zeal" means great energy, enthusiasm, or passion in pursuit of a cause or an objective. We are looking for a word from the sentence that means the opposite.

· a) Apathy - means a lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern. This is the direct antonym of "zeal".

· b) Voters - people who vote, especially in an election. This is a noun referring to people, not a state of being.

· c) Concerns - matters of interest or importance to someone. These might cause zeal or apathy, but are not opposites of the given word.

· d) Ignored - a verb meaning to fail to consider something. This is an action, not the quality of apathy.

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate idiom for the given situation.

After weeks of dreading the inevitable dentist appointment, Seema knew she couldn't put it off any longer. Despite her fear of dental procedures, she decided to book the appointment to address her toothache once and for all. What did she have to do?
questions.solution:
The most appropriate idiom for the given situation is 'bite the bullet'.

'Bite the bullet' means facing a difficult or unpleasant situation with courage and determination.

In the context of Seema's situation, she had been dreading the dentist appointment due to her fear of dental procedures. However, she knew she couldn't avoid it any longer, so she decided to confront her fear and book the appointment to address her toothache once and for all. This action demonstrates bravery and determination in facing a challenging situation, which aligns with the meaning of "biting the bullet."

Other idioms are not suitable for the given context.

'Kick the bucket' means to die or to pass away.

'Spill the beans' means to reveal a secret or disclose confidential information, often unintentionally or by accident.

'Break the ice' means to initiate or facilitate a conversation or social interaction in a situation where there may be tension or awkwardness, making it easier for people to become more comfortable with each other.

Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

questions.solution:
This is a Simple Past tense sentence expressing a historical fact. When the sentence expresses a historical fact, the form of the tense doesn't change when converting from indirect to direct speech.

For example:

The teacher said that Mahatma Gandhi was born in Gujarat. (Indirect Speech)

The teacher said, "Mahatma Gandhi was born in Gujarat." (Direct Speech)

The following things in the sentence will change when changed from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:

The reporting verb remains "said".

Inverted commas ("...") are added.

Pronouns are changed appropriately if needed (here, no change).

The tense remains Simple Past since it expresses a historical fact.

Therefore, the correct answer is: option (a).

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

The principal said, "The students had submitted the science project reports before the deadline as the evaluation committee had already reviewed other submissions."

options.label: A
options.text: The principal said that the students had submitted the science project reports before the deadline as the evaluation committee had already reviewed other submissions.

options.label: B
options.text: The principal requested the students to submit the science project reports before the deadline as the evaluation committee had already reviewed other submissions.

options.label: C
options.text: The principal told the students that they had submitted the science project reports before the deadline as the evaluation committee had already reviewed other submissions.

options.label: D
options.text: The principal advised the students that they should have submitted the science project reports before the deadline as the evaluation committee had already reviewed other submissions.

questions.correct_text: The principal said that the students had submitted the science project reports before the deadline as the evaluation committee had already reviewed other submissions.
questions.solution:
The sentence in the Direct Speech is in Past Perfect. Therefore, the sentence in the Indirect Speech should also be in Past Perfect.

Past Perfect form (Subject + had + V3 + Object) should be kept intact in indirect speech.

For example:

He said, "I had just finished the movie." (Direct Speech)

He said that he had just finished the movie. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

The reporting verb "said" remains the same.

"That" is added.

The inverted commas are removed.

The tense in both clauses remains Past Perfect.

Therefore, the correct answer is: option (a).

The principal says to the students that they must submit their assignments before the end of this week as the evaluation committee will begin the review process next week.

options.label: A
