questions.solution:
This is an Imperative Sentence showing obligation. The reporting verb is in the Present Tense ("says"), so there is no change in tense in Direct Speech. Though the tense remains the same, the pronouns are changed appropriately from indirect to direct speech.

For example:

Arnab says that he wants to be the best English teacher in India. (Indirect Speech)

Arnab says, "I want to be the best English teacher in India." (Direct Speech)

Subham will say that Kaustav is always late. (Indirect Speech)

Subham will say, "Kaustav is always late." (Direct Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:

The reporting verb remains "says" as it is in the Present Tense.

Pronouns are changed from "their" to "your" and "they" to "you" where required.

Inverted commas ("...") are added in Direct Speech.

Therefore, the correct answer is: option (a).

questions.question:
Consider the following statements with reference to the Impeachment of the President:

a. Article 60 deals with the procedure for impeachment of the president.

b. The impeachment charges can be initiated by either House of Parliament.

c. These charges should be signed by one-third members of the initiating House.

d. The nominated members of either House of Parliament can participate in the impeachment of the President.

Which of the statements given above are not true?
questions.question_hi:
राष्ट्रपति के महाभियोग के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

a. अनुच्छेद 60 राष्ट्रपति के महाभियोग की प्रक्रिया से संबंधित है।

b. महाभियोग के आरोप संसद के किसी भी सदन द्वारा शुरू किए जा सकते हैं।

c. इन आरोपों पर आरंभ करने वाले सदन के एक-तिहाई सदस्यों के हस्ताक्षर होने चाहिए।

d. संसद के किसी भी सदन के नामित सदस्य राष्ट्रपति के महाभियोग में भाग ले सकते हैं।

ऊपर दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा सत्य नहीं है?
questions.solution:
The President can be removed from office by a process of impeachment for 'violation of the Constitution' as mentioned in the Article 61 of Indian Constitution.

The impeachment charges can be initiated by either House of Parliament.

These charges should be signed by one-fourth members of the House (that framed the charges), and a 14 days' notice should be given to the President.

The nominated members of either House of Parliament can participate in the impeachment of the President though they do not participate in his election.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:

I. English won the battle of Plassey through a secretive alliance.

II. The Battle of Plassey was fought between Mir Jafar and the English.

Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. अंग्रेजों ने गुप्त गठबंधन के माध्यम से प्लासी की लड़ाई जीती।

II. प्लासी की लड़ाई मीर जाफर और अंग्रेजों के बीच लड़ी गई थी।

उपर्युक्त कथन में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II.

questions.solution:
Statement I is correct. The English forged a secret alliance with the traitors of the nawab - Mir Jafar, Rai Durlabh, Jagat Seth (an influential banker of Bengal) and Omichand.

Under the deal, Mir Jafar was to be made the nawab who in turn would reward the Company for its services.

The secret alliance of the Company with the conspirators further strengthened the English position. So the English victory in the Battle of Plassey (June 23, 1757) was decided before the battle was even fought

Statement II is Incorrect. The Battle of Plassey was fought between Siraj-ud-daula (Nawab of Bengal) and the English, the war placed at the disposal of the English vast resources of Bengal.

After Plassey, the English virtually monopolised the trade and commerce of Bengal.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the peninsular drainage system.

I. The peninsular drainage system is older than the Himalayan drainage system.

II. The Rivers of the peninsular drainage system are in mature and old stage.

Which among the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
प्रायद्वीपीय जल निकासी प्रणाली के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. प्रायद्वीपीय जल निकासी प्रणाली हिमालयी जल निकासी प्रणाली से पुरानी है।

II. प्रायद्वीपीय जल निकासी प्रणाली की नदियाँ परिपक्व और पुरानी अवस्था में हैं।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Both the statements are correct.

In geomorphology, drainage systems, also known as river systems, are the patterns formed by the streams, rivers, and lakes in a particular drainage basin. They are governed by the topography of the land, whether a particular region is dominated by hard or soft rocks, and the gradient of the land.

The peninsular drainage systems consist of a large number of large and small rivers.

The peninsular drainage systems are older than the Himalayas. This is evident from the broad, largely graded shallow valleys, and the maturity of the rivers. The rivers in this system are old with graded profile and have almost reached their base levels.

Whereas, the Himalayan rivers are young, active and deepening in the valleys.

Source: NCERT

questions.question:
Which of the following were the features of Industrial Policy of 1977?

I. It allowed Foreign investment through technology transfer.

II. Promotion of Khadi and Village industries.

III. De-reservation of Industries.

Select the answer using the code given below.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी 1977 की औद्योगिक नीति की विशेषताएँ थीं?

I. इसने प्रौद्योगिकी हस्तांतरण के माध्यम से विदेशी निवेश की अनुमति दी।

II. खादी और ग्रामोद्योग को बढ़ावा दिया।

III. उद्योगों का आरक्षण समाप्त किया।

नीचे दिए गए कूट का प्रयोग कर उत्तर चुनिए।
questions.solution:
The Industrial Policy Statement of 1977 had an inclination towards the Gandhian-socialistic views towards the economy.

Some key features:

(i) Foreign investment in the unnecessary areas were prohibited. In practice, there was a complete 'no' to foreign investment. Hence, statement I is incorrect.

(ii) Emphasis on village industries with a redefinition of the small and cottage industries.

(iii) Decentralized industrialization was given attention with the objective of linking the masses to the process of industrialization.

(iv) The District Industries Centres (DICs) were set to promote the expansion of small and cottage industries at a mass scale.

(iv) Democratic decentralization got emphasised and the khadi and village industries were restructured. Hence, statement II is correct.

(v) Serious attention was given on the level of production and the prices of essential commodities of everyday use.

Statement III is incorrect: De- reservation is a feature of the New Industrial Policy, 1991.

Source: Indian Economy by Ramesh Singh

questions.question:
In September 2025, global agricultural leaders, policymakers, scientists and farmers gathered in New Delhi for DialogueNEXT in India. Which of the statements given is/are correct?

I. The 2025 edition continued the 'Take it to the Farmer' theme, building on last year's DialogueNEXT in Mexico.

II. It was held on the occasion of World Agriculture Day.

III. It was Hosted by the World Food Prize Foundation
questions.question_hi:
सितंबर 2025 में, वैश्विक कृषि नेता, नीति निर्माता, वैज्ञानिक और किसान नई दिल्ली में DialogueNEXT इंडिया के लिए एकत्रित हुए। दिए गए कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

I. 2025 संस्करण ने 'किसान तक पहुंचाओ' थीम को जारी रखा, जो पिछले वर्ष मेक्सिको में हुए DialogueNEXT पर आधारित था।

II. यह विश्व कृषि दिवस के अवसर पर आयोजित किया गया था।

III. इसे वर्ल्ड फूड प्राइज फाउंडेशन द्वारा आयोजित किया गया था।
questions.solution: Global agricultural leaders, policymakers, scientists and farmers gathered in New Delhi for DialogueNEXT in India. A two-day high-level event aimed at exploring and accelerating breakthrough innovations to secure the world's food future, is being held from 8-9 September, 2025 at the ICAR Convention Centre, PUSA Campus, New Delhi. Hosted by the World Food Prize Foundation in partnership with CIMMYT, the Borlaug Institute for South Asia (BISA) and the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), this year's DialogueNEXT 'Take it to the Farmer' continues the farmer-focused theme, building on last year's DialogueNEXT in Mexico. Held on the occasion of World Agriculture Day, DialogueNEXT will shine a global spotlight on those who feed the world. The event celebrates India's powerful legacy of agricultural innovation, honors Indian World Food Prize Laureates and showcases the country's leadership in global food systems.

questions.question: The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) has waived all charges for the mandatory biometric updates of children aged ________________, a move that is expected to benefit about six crore minors, in October 2025.
questions.question_hi: भारत की विशिष्ट पहचान प्राधिकरण (UIDAI) ने अक्टूबर 2025 में ________________ आयु के बच्चों के अनिवार्य बायोमेट्रिक अपडेट के लिए सभी शुल्क माफ कर दिए हैं, जो लगभग छह करोड़ नाबालिगों को लाभ पहुंचाने की उम्मीद है।
questions.solution: The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) has waived all charges for the mandatory biometric updates of children aged 7 to 15, a move that is expected to benefit about six crore minors. The waiver is already in effect from October 1, 2025, and will be in force for a period of one year. 'A child under the age of five enrols for Aadhaar by providing the photograph, name, date of birth, gender, address, and birth certificate. Biometric details such as fingerprints and iris are not captured for Aadhaar enrolment below the age of five,' said a Press Information Bureau (PIB) release. Therefore, updating fingerprints, iris, and photo in Aadhaar is mandatory when the child reaches the age of five. 'This is called first Mandatory Biometric Update (MBU). Similarly, a child is required to update biometrics once again upon reaching the age of 15 years, which is referred to as the second MBU,' it said. 'The first and second MBUs, if performed between 5-7 and 15-17 years of age respectively, are thus free of cost. Thereafter, a prescribed fee of '125 per MBU is charged. With this decision, MBU is now effectively free for all children in the age group of 5-17,' said the release.

questions.question:
Read the statements below and select the correct option.

I. Regulating act of 1773 was the first step of British government to control the affairs of East India company in India.

II. The act elevated Governor of Bengal Warren Hastings Governor general.
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दिए गए कथनों को पढ़ें और सही विकल्प का चयन करें।

I. 1773 का विनियमन अधिनियम भारत में ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के मामलों को नियंत्रित करने के लिए ब्रिटिश सरकार का पहला कदम था।

II. इस अधिनियम ने बंगाल के गवर्नर वारेन हेस्टिंग्स को गवर्नर जनरल के पद पर पदोन्नत कर दिया।

options.label: B
options.text: Both I and II are true
options.text_hi: I और II दोनों सत्य हैं

options.label: C
options.text: Both I and II are false
options.text_hi: I और II दोनों असत्य हैं

questions.correct_text: Both I and II are true
questions.solution:
Regulating act of 1773

- It was the first step of British government to control the affairs of East India company in India.

- The act elevated Governor of Bengal Warren Hastings Governor general and subsumed the presidencies of Madras and Bombay under Bengal's control.

- It named four additional members to serve with the Governor general.

questions.question:
Given below are the statements in Assertion (A) and Reason (R), choose the correct option.

Assertion (A): ISRO's SPADEX (Space Docking Experiment) mission marked a major technological milestone for India's future human spaceflight and space station programmes.

Reason (R): The SPADEX mission successfully demonstrated autonomous docking and undocking of two satellites in orbit.
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दिए गए कथन में Assertion (A) और Reason (R) हैं, सही विकल्प चुनें।

Assertion (A): ISRO का SPADEX (स्पेस डॉकिंग एक्सपेरिमेंट) मिशन भारत के भविष्य के मानव अंतरिक्ष उड़ान और अंतरिक्ष स्टेशन कार्यक्रमों के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण तकनीकी मील का पत्थर था।

Reason (R): SPADEX मिशन ने कक्षा में दो उपग्रहों के स्वायत्त डॉकिंग और अनडॉकिंग को सफलतापूर्वक प्रदर्शित किया।

options.label: A
options.text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.text_hi: दोनों कथन (A) और कारण (R) सही हैं, लेकिन कारण (R) कथन (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है।

options.label: B
options.text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options.text_hi: दोनों कथन (A) और कारण (R) सही हैं, और कारण (R) कथन (A) का सही स्पष्टीकरण है।

options.label: C
options.text: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.text_hi: कथन (A) सही है, लेकिन कारण (R) गलत है।

options.label: D
options.text: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
options.text_hi: कथन (A) गलत है, लेकिन कारण (R) सही है।

questions.correct_text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
questions.solution: The SPADEX (Space Docking Experiment) achieved the successful autonomous docking and subsequent undocking of two satellites in orbit in 2025. This capability is essential for future missions involving human spaceflight, orbital servicing, space station assembly, and lunar exploration. Therefore, the Reason correctly explains why the mission was a major technological milestone, making Option 2 the correct answer.

questions.question:
Identify the correct statement(s).

Statement I: Isotopes of an element have different numbers of protons in their nuclei.

Statement II: Isotopes of an element have the same atomic number but different mass numbers.
questions.question_hi:
सही कथन की पहचान कीजिए।

कथन 1: किसी तत्व के समस्थानिकों के नाभिक में प्रोटॉनों की संख्या भिन्न-भिन्न होती है।

कथन 2: किसी तत्व के समस्थानिकों का परमाणु क्रमांक समान होता है, परन्तु द्रव्यमान संख्या भिन्न-भिन्न होती है।

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Isotopes have the same number of protons (same atomic number) but differing numbers of neutrons.

Thus I is false, II is true.

Further Insights:

- Chemical properties are largely identical for isotopes because electron configuration is the same.

- Physical properties (density, diffusion rate) can differ between isotopes.

- Examples: 12C, 13C, 14C; 1H, 2H (D), 3H (T).

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding urbanisation in India (2001-2011):

Statement 1: Urbanisation in India increased by 3.3 percentage points during 2001-2011, which was higher than the increase recorded during 1991-2001.

Statement 2: The average annual urban population growth rate during 2001-2011 was reported as 2.76%.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में शहरीकरण (2001-2011) के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन 1: भारत में शहरीकरण 2001-2011 के दौरान 3.3 प्रतिशत अंकों से बढ़ा, जो 1991-2001 के दौरान दर्ज की गई वृद्धि से अधिक था।

कथन 2: 2001-2011 के दौरान औसत वार्षिक शहरी जनसंख्या वृद्धि दर 2.76% बताई गई।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो a और न ही b

questions.solution:
According to 2011 Census, urban population grew to 377 million showing a growth rate of 2.76 percent per annum during 2001-2011 and the level of urbanisation at the country as a whole increased from 27.7 percent in 2001 to 31.1 percent in 2011- an increase of 3.3 percentage points during 2001-2011 compared to an increase of 2.1 percentage points during 1991-2001.

This clearly reflects the the faster economic growth during 2000s in bringing out speedier urbanisation during 2001-2011.

questions.question:
Which of the following are the major features of the Indus Valley Civilization?

i) Urban Planning

ii) Drainage System

iii) Important structure in the lower town and people live on the citadel.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता की प्रमुख विशेषताएँ हैं?

i) शहरी नियोजन

ii) जल निकासी व्यवस्था

iii) निचले शहर में महत्वपूर्ण संरचना और लोगों का आवास गढ़/किले पर
questions.solution:
Indus Valley Civilization is a Bronze Age Civilization. Existing from somewhere 2500-1750 BC

Important features of IVC

• Urban Planning and advance drainage system and sanitation system.

• Cities are divided into two parts

• Citadel: Where all main buildings are present and all the ritual take place

• Town: Residential area, which was surrounded by brick wall

• Houses are made-up burnt bricks of fixed size

• Important building and places such as

• Great Granary

• Great Bath

• Measuring system same through out the IVC

• They were the first people to produce cotton.

• Matridevi or Shakti is the Mother Goddess.

• Pashupati Mahadeva is known as the lord of Animals.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972:

I. Under the provisions of the Act, Schedule I and Schedule II provide the highest level of legal protection to specified animal species.

II. Schedule VI was specifically incorporated into the Act to provide a legal framework for the protection and regulation of specified plant species.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
वन्यजीव संरक्षण अधिनियम, 1972 के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. अधिनियम के प्रावधानों के तहत, अनुसूची I और अनुसूची II निर्दिष्ट पशु प्रजातियों को सर्वोच्च स्तर की कानूनी सुरक्षा प्रदान करती हैं।

II। अनुसूची VI को विशेष रूप से अधिनियम में शामिल किया गया था ताकि निर्दिष्ट पौधों की प्रजातियों की सुरक्षा और विनियमन के लिए कानूनी ढांचा प्रदान किया जा सके।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Statement I is Correct

Under the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972:

Schedule I and Part II of Schedule II provide the highest level of protection to animals.

Offences related to these species attract the strictest penalties.

Examples include tiger, elephant, rhino, etc.

Statement II is Correct

Schedule VI was added to protect certain plant species.

It prohibits:

Cultivation

Possession

Trade

of specified rare and endangered plants without permission.

Further Insights

• Schedule III & IV provide lesser protection.

• Schedule V includes animals classified as vermin.

• The Act was amended significantly in 2022.

• National Parks and Wildlife Sanctuaries are declared under this Act.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Directive Principles of State Policy in the Constitution of India. Which of the following statements are true?

a) It consists the idea of welfare state

b) Article 39A calls for Equal Justice and Free legal aid

c) Article 45 calls for Uniform Civil code of Citizen

Choose the correct option.
questions.question_hi:
भारत के संविधान में राज्य नीति के निर्देशक सिद्धांतों के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें। निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सत्य है?

a) इसमें कल्याणकारी राज्य का विचार शामिल है।

b) अनुच्छेद 39A समान न्याय और मुफ्त कानूनी सहायता का आह्वान करता है।

c) अनुच्छेद 45 नागरिकों के लिए समान नागरिक संहिता का आह्वान करता है।

सही विकल्प चुनें।
questions.solution:
• DPSP consist the idea of welfare state

• Article 39A calls for Equal Justice and Free Legal aid

• Article 44 calls for Uniform Civil code of Citizen

Further Insight:

• Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSPs) with Articles

○ Promotion of welfare of people - Article 38

○ Securing a uniform civil code - Article 44

○ Adequate livelihood for all - Article 39(a)

○ Equal pay for equal work - Article 39(d)

○ Provision for childhood and youth protection - Article 39(e) & (f)

○ Promotion of education and economic interests of weaker sections - Article 45 & 46

○ Right to adequate nutrition and public health - Article 47

○ Environmental protection and improvement - Article 48A

○ Protection and improvement of forests and wildlife - Article 48A

○ Promotion of international peace and security - Article 51

○ Participation of workers in management of industries - Article 43A

○ Provision of a just and humane condition of work and maternity relief - Article 42

○ Promotion of village panchayats - Article 40

○ Ensuring the right to work, education, and public assistance - Article 41

○ Organizing agriculture and animal husbandry - Article 48

○ Duties of the state to secure a living wage, decent standard of living, and leisure - Article 43

questions.question: The toranas (ornamental gateways) of the Great Stupa at Sanchi were mainly added during which period?
questions.question_hi: सांची के महान स्तूप के तोरण (सजावटी द्वार) मुख्य रूप से किस अवधि के दौरान जोड़े गए थे?
questions.solution:
Ashoka's Mauryan phase is associated with the original stupa core at Sanchi.

The richly carved stone toranas are later additions, generally dated to the Shunga-Satavahana phase.

Further Insights:

- Key parts of a stupa: anda (dome), harmika (railing on top), yasti (central mast), chhatra (umbrellas), vedika (stone railing), torana (gateway).

- Bharhut stupa is noted for its early narrative reliefs on railings and is linked to the Shunga period.

- Amaravati stupa is known for extensive limestone sculptural panels and developed mainly under Satavahana and later patrons.

- In many stupas, decoration becomes more elaborate over time while the basic hemispherical mound form remains.

questions.question: Who among the following won the 2026 Women's Asian Individual Chess Championship held in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, and secured qualification for the 2027 FIDE Women's World Cup?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किसने 2026 में उलानबातर, मंगोलिया में आयोजित महिला एशियाई व्यक्तिगत शतरंज चैंपियनशिप जीती और 2027 FIDE महिला विश्व कप के लिए योग्यता प्राप्त की?
questions.solution: Nineteen-year-old Savitha Shri Baskar has won the 2026 Women's Asian Individual Chess Championship in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. With the win, she also secured qualification for the 2027 FIDE Women's World Cup. The Chennai-based International Master finished with 7.5 points from nine rounds, edging Afruza Khamdamova of Uzbekistan on tie-breaks. Song Yuxin from China took bronze with 6.5 points. The triumph is the biggest achievement of Savitha's career and gives India its 13th Women's Asian Championship title, with the country now winning three of the last four editions.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the economic reforms initiated in India post-1991:

i) The Raja Chelliah Committee recommended the reduction of the Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) and Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) to provide banks with more operational freedom.

ii) The Narasimham Committee outlined a long-term plan to simplify the tax structure and lower personal income tax rates to discourage tax evasion.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
1991 के बाद भारत में शुरू किए गए आर्थिक सुधारों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i) राजा चेल्लियाह समिति ने बैंकों को अधिक परिचालन स्वतंत्रता प्रदान करने के लिए सांविधिक तरलता अनुपात (SLR) और नकद आरक्षित अनुपात (CRR) को कम करने की सिफारिश की।

ii) नरसिम्हम समिति ने कर संरचना को सरल बनाने और कर चोरी को रोकने के लिए व्यक्तिगत आयकर दरों को कम करने की दीर्घकालिक योजना तैयार की।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
Statement (i) is incorrect.

The Raja Chelliah Committee was primarily concerned with tax reforms, especially simplifying the tax system and broadening the tax base. Recommendations on reducing SLR and CRR fall under banking sector reforms, not tax reforms.

Statement (ii) is also incorrect.

The Narasimham Committee focused on banking and financial sector reforms, such as improving bank efficiency, reducing government control over banks, and strengthening prudential norms. It did not deal with simplifying income tax or reducing tax rates.

The Raja Chelliah Committee focused on tax reforms, while the Narasimham Committee concentrated on banking and financial sector reforms in post-1991 India.

Further Insights

Raja Chelliah is known as the father of Indian tax reforms.

Narasimham Committee reports were released in 1991 and 1998.

Reduction of SLR and CRR was part of banking liberalisation.

Tax reform aimed to move from high rates - low compliance to moderate rates - high compliance.

Post-1991 reforms marked India's shift towards a liberalised economy.

questions.question: Which folk percussion instrument is typically a pair of kettle drums played with sticks for ceremonial rhythms?
questions.question_hi: कौन सा लोक पर्कशन वाद्य आमतौर पर डंडों से बजाए जाने वाले तांबे के ड्रम का जोड़ा होता है जो समारोहिक ताल के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.solution:
Nagara (also called nakkara in some regions) is a kettle-drum type instrument, often used as a pair.

It is commonly struck with sticks to produce loud ceremonial and processional beats.

Dhol and dholak are barrel-shaped drums, and mridangam is a Carnatic classical percussion instrument.

Further Insights:

- Dhol is a large double-headed barrel drum; it is often played with sticks and leads dance/procession rhythms (e.g., in Punjabi folk ensembles).

- Dholak is a smaller barrel drum generally played with bare hands and is common in folk and devotional singing.

- Nagara/nakkara traditionally featured in temple and court/announcement contexts due to its high volume and penetrating tone.

- Shehnai bands and wedding/procession ensembles may include nagara or dhol depending on regional practice.

questions.question:
Which of the following is arranged chronologically?

A) Shishunaga- Nanda- Maurya - Haryanka

B) Haryanka - Nanda- Maurya - Shishunaga

C) Shishunaga - Haryanka - Nanda - Maurya

D) Haryanka - Shishunaga - Nanda - Maurya

Select the correct option from the following.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प कालक्रमानुसार व्यवस्थित है?

A) शिशुनाग- नंद- मौर्य - हर्यक

B) हर्यक - नंद- मौर्य - शिशुनाग

C) शिशुनाग - हर्यक - नंद - मौर्य

D) हर्यक - शिशुनाग - नंद - मौर्य

निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
questions.solution:
The correct order is Haryanka-Shishunaga-Nanda-Maurya.

Haryanka Dynasty (c. 544-413 BCE): Founded by Bimbisara in 544 BCE.

Shishunaga Dynasty (c. 413-345 BCE): Established by Shishunaga in 413 BCE.

Nanda Dynasty (c. 345-322 BCE): Established by Mahapadma Nanda.

Maurya Dynasty (c. 322-185 BCE): Established by Chandragupta Maurya in 322 BCE.

questions.question:
Consider the below statements:

1. Turner Syndrome occurs due to the complete or partial absence of one X chromosome in females.

2. Individuals with Turner Syndrome usually have a total of 47 chromosomes in each cell.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दिए गए कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. टर्नर सिंड्रोम महिलाओं में एक एक्स गुणसूत्र की पूर्ण या आंशिक अनुपस्थिति के कारण होता है।

2. टर्नर सिंड्रोम वाले व्यक्तियों में आमतौर पर प्रत्येक कोशिका में कुल 47 गुणसूत्र होते हैं।

उपर्युक्त में से कौन सा कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct, but statement 2 is incorrect. Turner Syndrome is caused by a missing X chromosome, resulting in a total of 45 chromosomes. Therefore, the correct option is a.

Explanation of Statements:

1 is Correct. Turner Syndrome is a chromosomal condition that affects development in females. It occurs when one of the two X chromosomes is partially or completely missing. This condition is also known as monosomy X.

2 is Incorrect. A normal human cell has 46 chromosomes. In Turner Syndrome, the absence of one sex chromosome means individuals have a total of 45 chromosomes per cell (karyotype 45,X0). A count of 47 chromosomes is characteristic of trisomic conditions like Down Syndrome (Trisomy 21) or Klinefelter Syndrome (XXY).

Further Insights:

Common characteristics of Turner Syndrome include short stature and non-functioning ovaries, which leads to infertility. Early diagnosis and hormone therapy can help manage the symptoms.

questions.question: The book The Golden Road: How Ancient India Transformed the World by William Dalrymple primarily explores:
questions.question_hi: विलियम डेलरिम्पल की पुस्तक द गोल्डन रोड: हाउ एंशिएंट इंडिया ट्रांसफॉर्म्ड द वर्ल्ड मुख्य रूप से निम्नलिखित विषयों की खोज करती है:

options.label: A
options.text: The military campaigns of the Delhi Sultanate in South India.
options.text_hi: दक्षिण भारत में दिल्ली सल्तनत के सैन्य अभियान।

options.label: B
options.text: The economic reforms introduced by the British East India Company in India.
options.text_hi: भारत में ब्रिटिश ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी द्वारा लागू आर्थिक सुधार।

options.label: C
options.text: The political history of independent India after 1947.
options.text_hi: 1947 के बाद स्वतंत्र भारत का राजनीतिक इतिहास।

options.label: D
options.text: The spread of India's ideas, culture, religion, science, and trade across Asia and beyond in the ancient world.
options.text_hi: प्राचीन विश्व में भारत के विचारों, संस्कृति, धर्म, विज्ञान, और व्यापार का एशिया और उससे परे फैलाव।

questions.correct_text: The spread of India's ideas, culture, religion, science, and trade across Asia and beyond in the ancient world.
questions.solution: In The Golden Road: How Ancient India Transformed the World, William Dalrymple argues that ancient India was a major centre of cultural, intellectual, religious, and commercial exchange. questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Basic Structure doctrine:

Statement I: The doctrine was propounded in the Kesavananda Bharati case.

Statement II: Parliament cannot amend any provision of the Constitution after this judgment.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
मूल संरचना सिद्धांत के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

कथन I: यह सिद्धांत केशवानंद भारती मामले में प्रतिपादित किया गया था।

कथन II: इस निर्णय के बाद संसद संविधान के किसी भी प्रावधान में संशोधन नहीं कर सकती।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Statement I is Correct: The Basic Structure Doctrine was indeed propounded by the Supreme Court of India in the historic Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973) case. By a slim 7:6 majority, the largest-ever bench (13 judges) ruled that while Parliament has wide powers to amend the Constitution under Article 368, these powers are not absolute.

Statement II is Incorrect: The judgment did not stop Parliament from amending the Constitution. Instead, it placed a limitation on that power. Parliament can still amend any part of the Constitution - including Fundamental Rights - as long as the amendment does not alter, damage, or destroy the "Basic Structure" (core identity) of the Constitution.

Further insights:

The Supreme Court has not provided an exhaustive list of "basic" features. Instead, it decides on a case-by-case basis. Some features identified so far include:

· Supremacy of the Constitution

· Republican and Democratic form of Government

· Secular character of the Constitution

· Separation of powers between the legislature, executive, and judiciary

· Federal character of the Constitution

· Judicial Review

Evolution of the Doctrine:

· Shankari Prasad case (1951) & Sajjan Singh case (1965): The Court initially held that Parliament could amend any part of the Constitution, including Fundamental Rights.

· Golaknath case (1967): The Court reversed its stand, stating Fundamental Rights cannot be amended.

· Kesavananda Bharati case (1973): Created the middle ground - Parliament can amend everything, but must keep the "Basic Structure" intact.

· Minerva Mills case (1980): Further strengthened the doctrine by stating that "Judicial Review" and the "balance between Fundamental Rights and Directive Principles" are part of the basic structure.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Odissi dance:

I. Tribhangi in Odissi refers to a three-bend posture that creates an S-shaped body line.

II. The Gotipua tradition in Odisha traditionally featured young boys dressed as girls, and it contributed to the development of Odissi.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
ओडिसी नृत्य के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. ओडिसी में त्रिभंगी का अर्थ एक तीन-मोड़ वाली मुद्रा है जो एक S-आकार की शरीर रेखा बनाती है।

II. ओडिशा में गोतिपुआ परंपरा में पारंपरिक रूप से लड़कों को लड़कियों के रूप में सजाया जाता था, और इसने ओडिसी के विकास में योगदान दिया।

उपरोक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Statement I is correct because tribhangi literally denotes three deflections of the body, producing the characteristic S-curve in Odissi.

Statement II is correct because Gotipua was performed by young boys in female attire and is recognised as an important precursor/influence for modern Odissi.

Further Insights:

- Chauka is the other basic body geometry in Odissi, typically a square, grounded stance associated with strength and stability.

- The Mahari tradition refers to temple-dancer performers linked with Jagannath temple culture in Odisha and is associated with older ritual contexts of Odissi.

- Odissi is traditionally associated with Odisha; other major classical dances include Bharatanatyam (Tamil Nadu), Kathak (North India), Kathakali and Mohiniyattam (Kerala), Kuchipudi (Andhra Pradesh), Manipuri (Manipur), and Sattriya (Assam).

- In Odissi, abhinaya (expressional aspect) often draws from Vaishnavite themes, especially those connected with Krishna and Jagannath traditions.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:

i. RISC architecture uses a smaller set of simple instructions.

ii. RISC processors generally execute one instruction per clock cycle.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i. RISC आर्किटेक्चर सरल निर्देशों के एक छोटे समूह का उपयोग करता है।

ii. RISC प्रोसेसर सामान्यतः प्रति क्लॉक साइकिल एक निर्देश निष्पादित करते हैं।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो i और न ही ii

questions.solution:
RISC architecture uses a smaller set of simple instructions is Correct.

RISC focuses on a reduced, highly-optimized set of instructions where each command performs a simple task (like adding two registers). This contrasts with CISC (Complex Instruction Set Computer), which uses a large, varied set of complex instructions capable of performing multi-step operations (like memory-to-memory addition) in a single command.

RISC processors generally execute one instruction per clock cycle is Correct.

Because RISC instructions are simple and of uniform length, they are designed to be executed in a single clock cycle. This is largely achieved through a technique called pipelining, which allows different stages of multiple instructions (fetch, decode, execute) to be processed simultaneously, resulting in a throughput of one instruction completed per cycle.

questions.question: A MAC address is also referred to as ____.
questions.question_hi: एक MAC एड्रेस को ____ के नाम से भी जाना जाता है।
questions.solution:
· A Media Access Control address (MAC address) is a hardware identifier that uniquely identifies each device on a network. Primarily, the manufacturer assigns it.

· They are often found on a device's network interface controller (NIC) card.

· A MAC address can also be referred to as a burned-in address, Ethernet hardware address, hardware address, or physical address.

· A MAC address is a 48-bit hexadecimal address.

· It's usually six sets of two digits or characters, separated by colons.

· An example MAC address would be 00:00:5e:00:53:af.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:

I. TCP provides reliable, connection-oriented communication.

II. UDP guarantees packet delivery in correct order.

III. HTTP operates at the application layer of the OSI model.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

I. TCP विश्वसनीय, कनेक्शन-उन्मुख संचार प्रदान करता है।

II. UDP पैकेटों की सही क्रम में डिलीवरी की गारंटी देता है।

III. HTTP OSI मॉडल की अनुप्रयोग परत पर कार्य करता है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
TCP provides reliable, connection-oriented communication is Correct.

TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) is "connection-oriented" because it establishes a dedicated end-to-end connection via a three-way handshake before data is sent. It is "reliable" because it uses sequencing, acknowledgments, and retransmissions to ensure data arrives without errors.

UDP guarantees packet delivery in correct order is Incorrect.

UDP (User Datagram Protocol) is a "connectionless" and "unreliable" protocol. It sends packets (datagrams) without verifying if they reached the destination and does not guarantee that they will arrive in the same order they were sent. It is used when speed is more important than accuracy, such as in VoIP or online gaming.

HTTP operates at the application layer of the OSI model is Correct.

HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) is an Application Layer (Layer 7) protocol. It provides the interface for web browsers and servers to communicate. It relies on the Transport Layer (typically TCP) to move the data across the network.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about spyware:

1) Spyware secretly monitors user activity.

2) Spyware is mainly used to improve system performance.

3) Spyware can collect personal information.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
स्पाइवेयर के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) स्पाइवेयर गुप्त रूप से उपयोगकर्ता की गतिविधि पर नज़र रखता है।

2) स्पाइवेयर का मुख्य रूप से उपयोग सिस्टम के प्रदर्शन को बेहतर बनाने के लिए किया जाता है।

3) स्पाइवेयर व्यक्तिगत जानकारी एकत्र कर सकता है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because spyware is malicious and typically slows down the system by consuming resources.

Explanation of Statements:

· 1. is Correct. The primary goal of spyware is to remain hidden while recording user behavior, such as keystrokes or browsing history.

· 2. is Incorrect. Spyware is never used to improve performance; it often causes crashes, slow internet speeds, and system instability.

· 3. is Correct. It is frequently used to steal credit card numbers, passwords, and other sensitive personal data.

questions.question: Which of the following is an operating system known to give maximum time for each of the critical operations that it performs?

questions.solution:
Real time Operating System is known to give maximum time for each of the critical operations that it performs, like OS calls and interrupt handling. The Real-Time Operating system which guarantees the maximum time for critical operations and complete them on time are referred to as Hard Real-Time Operating Systems.

While the real-time operating systems that can only guarantee a maximum of the time, i.e., the critical task will get priority over other tasks, but no assurity of completing it in a defined time. These systems are referred to as Soft Real-Time Operating Systems.

questions.question: Which of the following is a high speed device used in CPU that is utilised to store data temporarily during processing of the information/data?.
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सीपीयू में प्रयुक्त एक उच्च गति वाला उपकरण है जिसका उपयोग इनफ़ॉर्मेशन/डेटा के प्रोसेसिंग के दौरान डेटा को अस्थायी रूप से स्टोर करने के लिए किया जाता है?
questions.solution:
• Registers is a high speed device used in CPUs that is utilised to store data temporarily during processing.

Further Insight:

• Control Unit (CU)

○ The Control Unit is a component of the CPU that directs the flow of data and instructions within the computer system.

○ It manages and coordinates the execution of instructions by decoding them and controlling other CPU components.

• Key Components of the Control Unit

○ Instruction Buffer Register (IBR)

■ Temporarily holds the part of an instruction fetched from memory.

■ Stores the next instruction for execution, ensuring efficient instruction handling.

○ Current Instruction Register (CIR)

■ Contains the current instruction being executed by the CPU.

■ Decodes the instruction to determine the operation to perform.

○ Memory Address Register (MAR)

■ Holds the memory address of the data or instruction to be accessed.

■ Facilitates communication between the CPU and memory during read/write operations.

○ Program Counter (PC)

■ Tracks the address of the next instruction to be executed.

■ Automatically increments after each instruction, ensuring sequential program execution.

questions.question: Which term refers to sending files from a local system to a remote server?
questions.question_hi: स्थानीय सिस्टम से रिमोट सर्वर पर फ़ाइलें भेजने को किस शब्द से संदर्भित किया जाता है?
questions.solution:
Uploading is the term used for sending data from a local client to a remote server.

Explanation:

Uploading refers to data moving "up" from the user's computer to a central server (e.g., posting a photo to social media). Downloading is the reverse - moving data from a server "down" to the local device.

Further Insights:

Streaming involves consuming data (video/audio) in real-time as it is being transferred, without saving a permanent copy first.

Caching is the temporary storage of data to speed up future access.

Which of the above statements are correct?

I. आभासी स्मृति, RAM के विस्तार के रूप में द्वितीयक संग्रहण का उपयोग करती है।

II. आभासी स्मृति RAM की आवश्यकता को पूरी तरह समाप्त कर देती है।

III. आभासी स्मृति, भौतिक स्मृति की तुलना में बड़े प्रोग्रामों को निष्पादित करने में सहायक होती है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?

options.label: D
options.text: All I, II and III are correct
options.text_hi: I, II और III तीनों सही हैं

questions.solution:
Statements I and III are correct.

Statement II is incorrect because virtual memory is a management technique that complements RAM, not a replacement for it.

Explanation of Statements:

· I. is Correct. Virtual memory creates an illusion for the CPU that it has more RAM than it physically does by using a portion of the hard drive (secondary storage) as a swap space.

· II. is Incorrect. A computer must have physical RAM to function. Virtual memory is much slower than RAM and is only used to handle the overflow of data.

· III. is Correct. It allows a system to run programs that are larger than the physical RAM capacity by loading only the necessary parts of the program into memory at any given time.

Further Insights:

· The process of moving data between RAM and the virtual memory on the disk is called "Paging" or "Swapping."

· Excessive use of virtual memory can lead to "Thrashing," where the system spends more time moving data than executing instructions, causing a significant slowdown.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding files and folders in Windows:

1) A folder can contain files and subfolders.

2) Two files in the same folder can have identical names.

3) File extensions indicate file type.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
विंडोज़ में फ़ाइलों और फ़ोल्डरों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) एक फ़ोल्डर में फ़ाइलें और उपफ़ोल्डर हो सकते हैं।

2) एक ही फ़ोल्डर में दो फ़ाइलों के नाम समान हो सकते हैं।

3) फ़ाइल एक्सटेंशन फ़ाइल प्रकार को इंगित करते हैं।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 1 and 3 are correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because Windows does not allow two files with the exact same name (and extension) to exist in the same folder.

Explanation of Statements:

· 1. is Correct. A folder is a digital container that can hold any number of files as well as other folders (known as subfolders).

· 2. is Incorrect. Every file in a single directory must have a unique identity. If you try to save a file with an existing name, Windows will ask to overwrite it or rename the new file.

· 3. is Correct. File extensions (e.g., .docx, .jpg, .exe) tell the operating system and the user what kind of data the file contains and which program should open it.

Further Insights:

· Folders are used to create a "Directory Tree" or hierarchical structure to organize data efficiently.

questions.question: Which of the following topologies uses token passing as a common access method?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी टोपोलॉजी सामान्य एक्सेस विधि के रूप में टोकन पासिंग का उपयोग करती है?
questions.solution:
Ring topology is like a bus topology, but with connected ends.

o The node that receives the message from the previous computer will retransmit to the next node.

o The data flows in one direction, i.e., it is unidirectional.

o The data flows in a single loop continuously known as an endless loop.

o It has no terminated ends, i.e., each node is connected to another node and has no termination point.

o The data in a ring topology flow in a clockwise direction.

o The most common access method of the ring topology is token passing.

o Token passing: It is a network access method in which a token is passed from one node to another node.

questions.question: Pipe A, Pipe B, and Pipe C alone can fill a tank in 24 hours, 18 hours, and 36 hours respectively and the volume of the tank is 144L. If A, B, and C are open for consecutive days for only 1 hour starting from A and 2L of water is used from the tank every day after the pipe is closed, then find the time (in days) taken to fill the tank.
questions.question_hi: पाइप A, पाइप B और पाइप C अकेले एक टैंक को क्रमशः 24 घंटे, 18 घंटे और 36 घंटे में भर सकते हैं और टैंक का आयतन 144 लीटर है। यदि A से शुरू करते हुए A, B और C को क्रमागत दिनों में केवल 1 घंटे के लिए खोला जाता है और पाइप बंद होने के बाद प्रत्येक दिन टैंक से 2 लीटर पानी का उपयोग किया जाता है, तो टैंक को भरने में लगने वाला समय (दिनों में) ज्ञात करें।
questions.solution:
Efficiency = The total capacity/ Time taken

Efficiency of pipe A = 144/24 = 6

Efficiency of pipe B = 144/18 = 8

Efficiency of pipe C = 144/36 = 4

1st day A fill 6L - 2L + 2nd day B fill 8L - 2L + 3rd day C fill 4L - 2L

3 days = 12L

In 33 days, A, B, and C fill = 12 * 33/3 = 132L

34th day A fill = 132L + 6L - 2L = 136L

35th day B fill = 136L + 8L = 144L

Acid in the vessel = 4 + 3 = 7

questions.question: A sum of Rs.4120 distributed among A, B and C such that A got 25% more than B who got 30% less than C. What is the difference between share of A and C?
questions.question_hi: 4120 रुपये की राशि को A, B और C के बीच इस प्रकार वितरित किया गया कि A को B से 25% अधिक प्राप्त हुआ, तथा B को C से 30% कम प्राप्त हुआ। A और C के हिस्से में क्या अंतर है?
questions.solution:
Let the shares of A, B and C be A, B and C

Here, A + B + C = 4120

A = 125% of B = 5B/4

B = 70% of C

C = 10B/7

Now, (5B/4) + B + (10B/7) = 4120

B = 1120

Now, A = 5 * 1120/4 = 1400

And, C = 10 * 1120/7 = 1600

Therefore, difference between share of A and C = 1600 - 1400 = Rs.200

questions.question:
A regular square pyramid has a base side of 12 cm and a perpendicular height of 9 cm. Consider the following statements:

A. The square of the base side is 144.

B. The numerical value of the volume of the pyramid is three times its base area.

Which of the following is correct?

निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही है?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो A और न ही B

questions.solution:
Base side = 12 cm

Height = 9 cm

Area of square =

Base Area = 12 x 12

= 144 cm2

Volume of pyramid = 1/3 x Base Area x Height

Volume = 1/3 x 144 x 9

= 432 cm3

Statement A:

122 = 144(True)

Statement B:

3 x Base Area = 3 x 144 = 432 cm2

Volume = 432 cm3

432 = 432 (True)

Therefore, both Statement A and Statement B are correct.

Correct Answer: (3) Both A and B

questions.question: If the variance of the data 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 20 is 18.75, then what will be the variance of 6, 10, 14, 18, 22, 40?
questions.solution:
Given data set:

3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 20

New data set:

6, 10, 14, 18, 22, 40

We observe that each value of the new data set is 2 times the corresponding value of the given data set.

Rule:

If every observation of a data set is multiplied by a constant k, then the variance becomes k2 times the original variance.

Here,

k = 2

Given variance = 18.75

New Variance = 22 x 18.75 = 75

questions.question: A marksman has probability 4/9 of hitting a target. He fires 6 shots. What is the probability that he hits exactly 3 times?

Probability of hitting the target on one shot =p=4/9

Probability of missing =q= 1-p =1-4/9 = 5/9

Number of shots =n=6

He hits the target exactly 3 times = k =3

Probability = C(n,k) X pk X qn-k

P(X = 3) = 6C3 · p3 * 3

6C3·(4/9)3 * (5/9)3

questions.question: Points A, B, C and D lie on a circle. If ∠ACB = 42°, then ∠ADB equals:
questions.question_hi: बिंदु A, B, C और D एक वृत्त पर स्थित हैं। यदि ∠ACB = 42° है, तो ∠ADB कितना होगा:
questions.solution:
Points A, B, C and D lie on the same circle. ∠ACB = 42°

Angles subtended by the same chord at the circumference are equal.

Here:

∠ACB subtends chord AB.

∠ADB also subtends chord AB.

Therefore,

∠ACB = ∠ADB

∠ADB = 42°

questions.question: Which of the following numbers cannot be a perfect square?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा संख्या पूर्ण वर्ग नहीं हो सकता?
questions.solution:
A perfect square can only end in 0, 1, 4, 5, 6, or 9.

So, we check the given numbers carefully.

3512 = 123201

Hence, 123201 is a perfect square.

6762 = 456976

Hence, 456976 is also a perfect square.

9992 = 998001

Hence, 998001 is a perfect square.

Now check 789124:

8882 = 788544

8892 = 790321

Since 789124 lies between 8882 and 8892, it is not a perfect square.

Therefore, the correct answer is 789124.

questions.question: The mean and mode of a frequency distribution are in the ratio of 4:5 respectively. If the median of the frequency distribution is 104, then find the mode of the frequency distribution.
questions.question_hi: एक आवृत्ति वितरण के माध्य और बहुलक का अनुपात क्रमशः 4:5 है। यदि आवृत्ति वितरण की माध्यिका 104 है, तो बहुलक ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Let mean and mode of the frequency distribution are 4m and 5m respectively.

Median = 104

Mode = 3 * median - 2 * mean

5m = 3 * 104 - 2 * 4m

13m = 312

m = 24

Hence, mode of the frequency distribution = 5 * 24 = 120

questions.question: Five years ago, Monu and Riya got married. At that time, ratio of their ages was 8:7 respectively. Ratio of their ages after three years will be 10:9 respectively. Monu's daughter Asha is 34 years younger than him. What is the difference between present age of Riya and Asha?
questions.question_hi: पांच साल पहले, मोनू और रिया की शादी हुई थी। उस समय, उनकी उम्र का अनुपात क्रमशः 8:7 था। तीन साल बाद उनकी उम्र का अनुपात क्रमशः 10:9 होगा। मोनू की बेटी आशा उसकी तुलना में 34 साल छोटी है। रिया और आशा की वर्तमान उम्र में क्या अंतर है?
questions.solution:
Present ages of Monu and Riya are (8x + 5) years and (7x + 5) years, respectively.

According to the question,

(8x + 5 + 3)/(7x + 5 + 3) = 10/9

72x + 72 = 70x + 80

2x = 8

x = 4

Present age of Monu = 8x + 5 = 37 years

Present age of Riya = 7x + 5 = 33 years

Present age of Asha = 37 - 34 = 3 years

Difference between the present age of Riya and Asha = 33 - 3 = 30 years

questions.question: In a business, A's capital is 60% of B' capital and B invested for 6 months less than A. If ratio of profit shares of A and B is 4: 5 respectively, then for what time B invested his capital?
questions.question_hi: एक व्यापार में, A की पूंजी B की पूंजी का 60% है और B, A से 6 महीने कम की समयावधि के लिए निवेश करता है। यदि A और B के लाभ के हिस्सों का अनुपात क्रमश: 4:5 है, तो ज्ञात कीजिये कि B ने कितने समय के लिए अपनी पूंजी का निवेश किया?
questions.solution:
Let capital of B = x

So, capital of A = 60% of x = 3x/5

Let time period for A's investment = 't' months

So, time period for B's investment = (t - 6) months

[(3x/5) * t]/[x * (t - 6)] = 4/5

(3t)/(5t - 30) = 4/5

15t = 20t - 120

t = 24

So, time period for B's investment = 24 - 6 = 18 months

questions.question: A solid cylinder of base radius 3 cm and height h cm is melted and recasted into 3 solid sphere such that the radius of each sphere is equal to the height of cylinder. Find the value of h.

questions.solution:
Base radius of cylinder = 3 cm

Height of cylinder = h cm

Radius of each sphere = h cm

Volume of cylinder = 3 * Volume of each sphere

Π * r2 * h = 3 * (4/3) * Π * h3

9 = 4 * h2

h2 = 9/4

h = 3/2

h = 1.5 cm

questions.question: In a certain code language, HORIZONS is written as QJKTQBUP. How will LANGUAGE be written in that code language?
questions.question_hi: एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में, HORIZONS को QJKTQBUP के रूप में लिखा जाता है। उस कोड भाषा में LANGUAGE को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions.solution:
The rule is:

Interchange every pair of adjacent letters.

Then add 2 to each obtained letter.

Pattern:

1st ↔ 2nd

3rd ↔ 4th

5th ↔ 6th

7th ↔ 8th

H O R I Z O N S

After interchanging adjacent pairs

= O H I R O Z S N

Now add 2 to each letter

O + 2 = Q

H + 2 = J

I + 2 = K

R + 2 = T

O + 2 = Q

Z + 2 = B

S + 2 = U

N + 2 = P

So,

HORIZONS = QJKTQBUP

L A N G U A G E

After interchanging adjacent pairs

= A L G N A U E G

Now add 2 to each letter

A + 2 = C

L + 2 = N

G + 2 = I

N + 2 = P

A + 2 = C

U + 2 = W

E + 2 = G

G + 2 = I

So,

LANGUAGE = CNIPCWGI

The statement 'B + C' means B can be greater than C or equal to C.

Hence, option (3) is correct.

questions.question: In a row of 146 participants, Charu is 41st from the left end and Danish is 63rd from the right end. How many participants are standing between Charu and Danish?
questions.question_hi: 146 प्रतिभागियों की एक पंक्ति में, चारु बाएं छोर से 41वें स्थान पर है और डैनिश दाएं छोर से 63वें स्थान पर है। चारु और डैनिश के बीच कितने प्रतिभागी खड़े हैं?
questions.solution:
Formula: Position from left = Total persons − Position from right + 1

Danish's position from the left end = 146 − 63 + 1

= 83 + 1

= 84

Charu's position from the left end = 41

Formula: Persons between two persons = Difference between their positions − 1

Persons between Charu and Danish = 84 − 41 − 1

= 43 − 1

= 42

questions.question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the action that follows.

Statement: A chemical container truck has leaked acid on a highway near a toll plaza, and vehicles are still passing through the affected lane.

Course of Action:

1) Divert traffic away from the affected lane immediately.

2) Send a trained hazardous-material team to neutralise and clear the acid spill.
questions.question_hi:

कथन: एक रासायनिक कंटेनर ट्रक ने टोल प्लाजा के पास एक राजमार्ग पर एसिड लीक कर दिया है, और वाहन अभी भी प्रभावित लेन से गुजर रहे हैं।

कार्रवाई का पाठ्यक्रम:

1) तुरंत प्रभावित लेन से ट्रैफिक को मोड़ें।

2) एसिड फैलाव को निष्प्रभावित करने और साफ करने के लिए प्रशिक्षित खतरनाक पदार्थ टीम भेजें।
questions.solution:
The acid spill can damage vehicles and injure people passing through the affected lane.

Diverting traffic is an immediate safety action.

A trained hazardous-material team is required because acid cannot be handled like ordinary waste.

Hence, both actions follow.

questions.question:
The question given below consists of two statements, one labelled as 'Assertion (A)' and the other labelled as the 'Reason (R)'. You have to examine these two statements carefully and decide if the Assertion (A) and the Reason (R) are individually true and if so, whether the Reason (R) is a correct explanation of the Assertion (A).

Assertion (A): Spring tides happen whenever there is a new moon or a full moon and have nothing to do with the season of spring.

Reason (R): When the sun, moon and Earth are all lined up, the sun's tidal force works with the moon's tidal force.
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दिए गए प्रश्न में दो कथन हैं, एक को 'अभिकथन (A)' और दूसरे को 'कारण (R)' के रूप में लेबल किया गया है। आपको इन दोनों कथनों की सावधानीपूर्वक जाँच करनी है और यह निर्धारित करना है कि अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) व्यक्तिगत रूप से सत्य हैं या नहीं और यदि सत्य हैं, तो कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है या नहीं।

अभिकथन (A): वसंत ज्वार तब आते हैं जब अमावस्या या पूर्णिमा होती है और इसका वसंत के मौसम से कोई संबंध नहीं है।

कारण (R): जब सूर्य, चंद्रमा और पृथ्वी सभी एक पंक्ति में होते हैं, तो सूर्य का ज्वारीय बल चंद्रमा के ज्वारीय बल के साथ काम करता है।

options.label: A
options.text: Both A and R are true and R is NOT the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: A और R दोनों सत्य हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options.label: B
options.text: A is true and R is false.
options.text_hi: A सत्य है और R असत्य है।

options.label: C
options.text: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: A और R दोनों सत्य हैं और R, A की सही व्याख्या है।

options.label: D
options.text: A is false and R is true.
options.text_hi: A असत्य है और R सत्य है।

questions.correct_text: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
questions.solution:
The tide which occurs at that time of full or new moon when the sun and moon both aligned with the earth is known as a spring tide.

When the sun, moon and Earth are all lined up, the sun's tidal force works with the moon's tidal force. The combined pull can cause the highest and lowest tides that are known as spring tides.

So, both (A) are (R) are true and (R) is a correct explanation of (A).

Six persons- A, B, C, D, E and F are of different heights but not in the same order. Who among the following second tallest person?

Statements:

(I) Only three persons are taller than D. B is taller than E but shorter than D.

(II) F is shorter than A. D is immediate shorter than C. F is not the shortest person.

एक प्रश्न दिया गया है, जिसके बाद I और II लेबल वाले दो कथन दिए गए हैं। पहचान करें कि कौन-सा/से कथन प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है/हैं।

छह व्यक्तियों- A, B, C, D, E और F के कद अलग-अलग हैं, लेकिन समान क्रम में नहीं हैं। निम्नलिखित में से दूसरा सबसे लंबा व्यक्ति कौन है?

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The marketing campaign was created by the team. The strategies were explained by the manager.

options.label: A
options.text: The team creates the marketing campaign. The manager explains the strategies.

options.label: B
options.text: The team created the marketing campaign. The manager explained the strategies.

options.label: C
options.text: The team has created the marketing campaign. The manager has explained the strategies.

options.label: D
options.text: The team had created the marketing campaign. The manager had explained the strategies.

questions.correct_text: The team created the marketing campaign. The manager explained the strategies.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" verb (was/were) and the preposition 'by' is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

The Passive voice in this question is in Past Indefinite. Thus, the Active voice will also be in Past Indefinite.

In Passive voice, the format is: Object of the Active voice (Subjective case) + was/were + V3 + by + Subject of the Active voice (Objective case).

Thus, the format of Active voice is: Subject + V2 + Object.

For example:

The Champions League was won by Real Madrid. (Passive Voice)

Real Madrid won the Champions League. (Active Voice)

The options except (b) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: The team created the marketing campaign. The manager explained the strategies.

Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

questions.solution:
The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive Voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

The usage of a "to be" form of verb ["being" in this case] is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

In Passive Voice, the preposition "by" is used before the object. However, it is optional in some cases.

The Active voice in this question is in the Present Continuous. Thus, the Passive voice will also be in Present Continuous.

The format of the Active voice is: Subject + am/is/are + V4 (-ing) + Object.

Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be: Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + am/is/are + being + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).

For example:

Active: She is writing a letter.

Passive: A letter is being written by her.

The options except (b) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: (b).

questions.question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts - P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

1: A bee colony operates as a highly organized and efficient superorganism. P: Other bees are foragers, tasked with flying out to collect nectar and pollen from flowers. Q: Each member has a specific role that contributes to the survival and success of the whole hive. R: Upon returning, these foragers perform a complex 'waggle dance' to communicate the location of food sources to their hive mates. S: For instance, the queen bee is solely responsible for laying eggs, ensuring the continuation of the colony. 6: This remarkable system of division of labor and communication ensures the colony can thrive.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is b) QSPR.

The paragraph describes the social structure of a bee colony.

Opening Statement (1): Introduces the main idea of the colony as an organized system.

Sentence Q: This sentence directly elaborates on the "highly organized" nature mentioned in sentence 1 by stating that each member has a "specific role." This is the topic sentence for the rest of the paragraph.

Sentence S: The phrase "For instance" provides the first specific example of a role, introducing the queen bee and her function. This directly supports the claim made in Q.

Sentence P: This sentence provides another example of a different role, the "foragers," contrasting them with the queen.

Sentence R: This sentence describes a specific action that "these foragers" (mentioned in P) perform. The phrase "Upon returning" creates a clear chronological link to the action of foraging described in P. This establishes a strong P-R connection.

Closing Statement (6): This sentence serves as a perfect summary, referencing the two main themes discussed: the "division of labor" (Q, S, P) and "communication" (R).

Therefore, the most logical sequence is QSPR.

questions.question:
Some sentences are given below. While the first and the last sentences (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the four sentences in between are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

S1. The Global Positioning System (GPS) is a satellite-based navigation system that provides location and time information anywhere on Earth.

A. This network consists of a constellation of about thirty satellites orbiting the Earth at a high altitude.

B. By receiving signals from at least four of these satellites, a GPS receiver can calculate its precise location.

C. This calculation is based on measuring the time it takes for the signal to travel from each satellite to the receiver.

D. Each satellite in the constellation continuously transmits timed signals that contain data about its current position and time.

S6. This remarkable technology has become an integral part of modern life, used in everything from car navigation to smartphone apps.
questions.solution:
The paragraph explains the process of how GPS technology determines a location.

S1 introduces the Global Positioning System (GPS).

A describes the fundamental infrastructure of the system, "a constellation of about thirty satellites."

D explains what the satellites from A do. "Each satellite... continuously transmits timed signals."

B describes the role of the user's device. A "GPS receiver" needs signals "from at least four of these satellites."

C explains the method of calculation mentioned in B. "This calculation is based on measuring the time" the signal takes to travel.

S6 concludes by highlighting the widespread application of the technology just described.

Therefore, the correct sequence is ADBC.

Hence, option (b) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. That first article, a brief one, stated only that during the last day or so the beaches of the metropolis had been closed to bathers by reason of a thick scum of clear grey, jelly-like substance that had been left upon them by the retreating tides.

B. The first intimation the world received of the life masters and of the doom that they were to lose upon it was contained in a news dispatch sent out by the great press syndicates from New York.

C. These glistening deposits, the dispatch added, were considered to be in all probability the result of some sea-migration of a great mass of minute, jelly-like organisms.

D. This clear slime, which exhibited a few signs of rudimentary life and movement, had also been deposited by the tides upon the sea walls and dock piles about the city and had been reported too from a score or more of places along the New Jersey.
questions.solution: Sentence B comes first as it introduces the subject of the discussion 'life-masters' and mentions when and how the world was informed about the life-masters (through a news dispatch). Sentence A comes next as it refers to that news dispatch (by the use of 'that first article'). It mentions the news report that how the beaches were closed for bathers because of a thick scum, jelly-like substance. 'This slime' in sentence D refers to the jelly-like substance mentioned in sentence A, so sentence D follows. Sentence C mentions how these substances could have reached the beaches of the metropolis. So, the correct sequence is BADC. Hence, option (d) is the answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The research committee reviewed the proposals for innovative projects last Monday.

options.label: A
options.text: The proposals for innovative projects are reviewed by the research committee last Monday.

options.label: B
options.text: The proposals for innovative projects have been reviewed by the research committee last Monday.

options.label: C
options.text: The proposals for innovative projects were reviewed by the research committee last Monday.

options.label: D
options.text: The research committee was reviewed by the proposals for innovative projects last Monday.

questions.correct_text: The proposals for innovative projects were reviewed by the research committee last Monday.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive Voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

The usage of a "to be" form of verb ["were" in this case] is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

In Passive Voice, the preposition "by" is used before the object. However, it is optional in some cases.

The Active voice in this question is in Past Indefinite. Thus, the Passive voice will also be in Past Indefinite.

The format of the Active voice is: Subject + V2 + Object.

Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be: Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + was/were + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).

For example:

Active: She wrote a letter.

Passive: A letter was written by her.

The options except (c) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: (c).

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

She said that water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.

options.label: A
options.text: She said, "Water is boiling at 100 degrees Celsius."

options.label: B
options.text: She said, "Water will boil at 100 degrees Celsius."

options.label: C
options.text: She said, "Water boiled at 100 degrees Celsius."

options.label: D
options.text: She said, "Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius."

questions.correct_text: She said, "Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius."
questions.solution:
If there is any Universal Truth or Habitual Truth in the Indirect Speech, there is no change in the tense of Direct Speech.

For example:

He said that the sun revolves around the sun. (Indirect Speech)

He said, "The sun revolves around the sun" (Direct Speech)

However, changes can take place in the Pronouns of the Direct Speech.

'Said that' in the Indirect Speech is changed into 'said' in the Direct Speech.

Therefore, the correct answer is: She said, "Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius."

Hence, (d) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

The principal said to the head boy, "How had the students prepared for the annual science exhibition before the evaluation committee arrived?"

options.label: A
options.text: The principal asked the head boy how the students had prepared for the annual science exhibition before the evaluation committee arrived.

options.label: B
options.text: The principal said to the head boy how the students had prepared for the annual science exhibition before the evaluation committee arrived.

options.label: C
options.text: The principal enquired the head boy how had the students prepared for the annual science exhibition before the evaluation committee arrived.

options.label: D
options.text: The principal asked the head boy what the students had prepared for the annual science exhibition before the evaluation committee arrived.

questions.correct_text: The principal asked the head boy how the students had prepared for the annual science exhibition before the evaluation committee arrived.
questions.solution:
Interrogative Sentences (without yes/no) are used to demonstrate asking for information. In the case of Interrogative sentences like this, "said" in Direct Speech is changed into "enquired (of)", "wanted to know", "asked", etc.

In Indirect speech, the verb is always placed after the subject, unlike in Direct Speech.

For example:

The teacher said to him, "What is your name?" (Direct Speech)

The teacher asked him what his name was. (Indirect Speech)

Also, the sentence in the Direct Speech is in the Past Perfect tense. So, the tense in the Indirect Speech should be in the Past Perfect tense.

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

"said to" changes to "asked" to match the interrogative context.

The word order is changed: the verb comes after the subject.

The question mark is removed.

The tense in the clause remains Past Perfect ("had prepared").

Therefore, the correct answer is: option (a).

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that best expresses the meaning of the idiom/phrasal verb in the given sentence.

He advised his friend to buckle down and focus on studying, emphasizing the importance of hard work and dedication.
questions.solution: The phrasal verb "buckle down" means to start working hard. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The teacher wished the students that they might achieve excellent results in the annual examinations and gain recognition for their hard work.

options.label: A
options.text: The teacher said to the students, "May you achieve excellent results in the annual examinations and gain recognition for your hard work!"

options.label: B
options.text: The teacher said to the students, "You might achieve excellent results in the annual examinations and gain recognition for your hard work."

options.label: C
options.text: The teacher told the students, "May you might achieve excellent results in the annual examinations and gain recognition for your hard work!"

options.label: D
options.text: The teacher said to the students, "Wish you achieve excellent results in the annual examinations and gain recognition for your hard work!"

questions.correct_text: The teacher said to the students, "May you achieve excellent results in the annual examinations and gain recognition for your hard work!"
questions.solution:
These kinds of sentences are called Optative Sentences. Optative Sentences are usually prayers or wishes.

Rules to follow while converting from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:

Reporting verbs like "wish/wished, pray/prayed, bless/blessed" in indirect speech are replaced with "say/said" in direct speech.

The conjunction "that" is removed, and inverted commas are introduced.

Assertive construct, i.e., "Subject + might/may + V1 + Object" in indirect speech, is changed to optative construct, i.e., "May + Subject + V1 + Object + !" in direct speech.

For example:

The father wished his son that God might bless him. (Indirect Speech)

The father said to his son, "May God bless you!" (Direct Speech)

The following things in the sentence will change when changed from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:

The reporting verb "wished" is changed to "said to".

The conjunction "that" is removed.

The Past Subjunctive construct ("they might achieve") is changed to the Optative construct ("May you achieve").

Pronouns are changed appropriately (they → you, their → your).

Inverted commas are added.

Therefore, the correct answer is: option (a).

In the below question, some parts of the sentences have errors and some are correct. Find out which part of a sentence has an error. If a sentence is free from error, choose the "No Error" option.

He present stood at the door immediately beneath me, smoking his pipe, and Joseph stood there too, quietly talking to him.

options.label: B
options.text: smoking his pipe, and Joseph stood there too

options.label: C
options.text: He present stood at the door immediately beneath me

questions.correct_text: He present stood at the door immediately beneath me
questions.solution: The adverb 'presently' should be used instead of the adjective 'present' as it is used to describe the verb 'stood'. Option C is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the following sentence identify the segment which contains a grammatical error.

Of his life with his wife and family, we know nothing except that he had at least one son, name Lewis.

options.label: B
options.text: at least one son, name Lewis

options.label: C
options.text: Of his life with his wife and family,

questions.correct_text: at least one son, name Lewis
questions.solution:
The participial adjective 'named' should be used here instead of the noun 'name', as it is being used to describe the noun 'son'. B is the right answer.

Correct sentence: Of his life with his wife and family, we know nothing except that he had at least one son, named Lewis.
