In the question given below, a part of the sentence is bracketed. Below are given alternatives to the bracketed part which may improve the sentence. Choose the correct alternative. In case no improvement is required, choose 'No Improvement' option.

It was a lovely feeling to carry a gift like that, (ready to be giving to) someone who was miserable!
questions.solution: Option B is the right answer. Option C is eliminated, as the sentence needs improvement. Options A and D are eliminated since the correct syntax would be 'ready +to +be +given'; the other options are grammatically incorrect.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The army commander ordered the soldiers to secure the perimeter, check all the ammunition supplies, and report back immediately before the inspection began.

options.label: A
options.text: The army commander said to the soldiers, "You are to secure the perimeter, check all the ammunition supplies, and report back immediately before the inspection begins."

options.label: B
options.text: The army commander told the soldiers, "To secure the perimeter, check all the ammunition supplies, and report back immediately before the inspection begins."

options.label: C
options.text: The army commander said to the soldiers, "Secure the perimeter, check all the ammunition supplies, and report back immediately before the inspection begins."

options.label: D
options.text: The army commander advised the soldiers, "You must secure the perimeter, check all the ammunition supplies, and report back immediately before the inspection begins."

questions.correct_text: The army commander said to the soldiers, "Secure the perimeter, check all the ammunition supplies, and report back immediately before the inspection begins."
questions.solution:
Imperative Sentences in Direct Speech are used to demonstrate Request, Order, Command, etc. Imperative Sentences in Direct Speech begin with Principal Verbs like Go, Make, Secure, etc.

The reporting verbs like "ordered" in indirect speech are changed into "said to" in direct speech.

"To" used before the Principal Verb in Indirect Speech is removed in Direct Speech.

For example:

John ordered his assistant to bring him a glass of water. (Indirect Speech)

John said to his assistant, "Bring me a glass of water." (Direct Speech)

The following things in the sentence will change when changed from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:

The reporting verb "ordered" is changed to "said to".

"To secure" is changed to "Secure" to start the imperative sentence.

Inverted commas ("...") are added.

Therefore, the correct answer is: option (c).

questions.question: In the sentence, "Earlier, people in many smaller cities often depended on locally available auto-rickshaws or taxi operators, whose fares could vary considerably depending on distance, demand, or individual negotiation," the clause "whose fares could vary considerably depending on distance, demand, or individual negotiation" functions as:

options.label: A
options.text: A noun clause acting as the object of the sentence

options.label: B
options.text: An adverb clause explaining the result of the action

options.label: C
options.text: A relative clause providing information about the operators

options.label: D
options.text: An independent clause expressing a separate complete idea

questions.correct_text: A relative clause providing information about the operators
questions.solution:
Among the given options, a relative clause providing information about the operators is the best fit because the clause "whose fares could vary considerably depending on distance, demand, or individual negotiation" modifies the noun phrase "auto-rickshaws or taxi operators." The relative pronoun "whose" introduces additional information regarding the fares associated with those operators. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

A noun clause functions as a noun within a sentence, which is not the case here. An adverb clause modifies a verb, adjective, or another adverb and generally expresses time, reason, condition, or result. An independent clause can stand alone as a complete sentence, whereas the given clause depends on the main clause for its meaning.

Note: Relative pronouns: A relative pronoun is used to connect a clause or phrase to a noun or pronoun. The clause modifies, or describes, the noun. The most common relative pronouns are who, whom, whose, which, and that. For example, she is the girl who received the award for bravery from our Home Minister.
questions.passage:
Directions : Read the passage and answer the following questions:

The expansion of app-based transportation and delivery services into smaller Indian cities has significantly transformed everyday life and urban mobility. For many years, services such as instant grocery delivery, app-based taxis, and bike rides were largely associated with metropolitan centres like Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Chennai, where dense populations and advanced digital infrastructure supported their growth. However, in recent years, companies offering ride-hailing and quick-commerce services have steadily expanded their operations into emerging urban centres such as Jammu, Dehradun, Jalandhar, Udaipur, and several other tier-two and tier-three cities.

This shift has altered the way residents access transportation and essential goods. Earlier, people in many smaller cities often depended on locally available auto-rickshaws or taxi operators, whose fares could vary considerably depending on distance, demand, or individual negotiation. In some cases, commuters faced inconvenience due to the absence of transparent pricing mechanisms. App-based platforms introduced a more structured system in which fares are calculated through predefined algorithms, allowing users to view estimated costs before confirming a ride.

The impact extends beyond transportation. Quick-commerce platforms now enable customers to receive groceries, medicines, and household necessities within a short period, sometimes in as little as ten to fifteen minutes. As a result, consumers no longer need to travel long distances or depend entirely on traditional neighbourhood stores for urgent purchases. The convenience of digital payments, real-time tracking, and service ratings has further strengthened public confidence in these platforms.

While challenges related to internet access, operational costs, and market sustainability remain, the growing adoption of such services reflects a broader trend of digital integration across India. The spread of app-based mobility and delivery networks demonstrates how technological innovations that were once concentrated in major metropolitan areas are increasingly becoming accessible to residents of smaller cities, contributing to greater convenience, transparency, and consumer choice in daily life.

questions.question: In the sentence, "Quick-commerce platforms now enable customers to receive groceries, medicines, and household necessities within a short period," the verb "enable" is used in:

options.label: A
options.text: Simple Present Tense to describe a general function

options.label: B
options.text: Present Perfect Tense showing a completed action

options.label: C
options.text: Past Continuous Tense describing an ongoing process

options.label: D
options.text: Simple Future Tense expressing a forthcoming activity

questions.correct_text: Simple Present Tense to describe a general function
questions.solution:
Among the given options, Simple Present Tense to describe a general function is the best fit because the verb "enable" expresses a regular and ongoing capability of quick-commerce platforms. The sentence describes a general fact about how such platforms operate rather than an action limited to a specific time. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

The sentence is not in the Present Perfect Tense because it does not contain a form such as "have enabled." It is not in the Past Continuous Tense because there is no structure such as "were enabling." Similarly, it is not in the Simple Future Tense because it does not indicate a future action.

questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" verb ["be" in this case] and the preposition "by" is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

In this question, the Passive voice is in Interrogative with a Modal Auxiliary verb ("can"). Thus, the Active voice will also be in Interrogative with the same modal.

Passive voice format: Modal + Object of the Active voice (Subjective case) + be + V3 + by + Subject of the Active voice (Objective case)?

Active voice format: Modal + Subject + V1 + Object?

For example:

Passive: Can this be done by you?

Active: Can you do this?

a) Incorrect - It makes the curriculum the doer of the action, which is illogical.

b) Incorrect - It replaces "can" with "will," changing the meaning and tense.

c) Correct - It follows the exact interrogative structure with modal "can": Can + Subject + V1 + Object?

d) Incorrect - "Could .. implemented" is grammatically wrong; modal + V1 is required, not V3.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (c).

The adjective 'separate' is used in the sentence to modify the verb 'stored'. Verbs are modified by adverbs. But the word 'separate' is not an adverb. In order to modify the verb 'stored' correctly, we need an adverb. Accordingly, 'separate' needs to be replaced with its adverb form 'separately'. Option (a) correctly substitutes "separate" with "separately" to convey the intended meaning of storing the documents in a way that ensures clarity and prevents confusion. Options (b) and (c) are not correct because these options do not rectify the original error. These options also use the words 'different' [adjective] and 'separate' which are not adverbs. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

The correct sentence is: The documents should be stored separately to avoid confusion.

questions.passage:
Directions : Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

Many thousands of years before Christopher Columbus' ships landed in the Bahamas, a different group of people discovered America: the nomadic ancestors of modern Native Americans who hiked over a "land bridge" from Asia to what is now Alaska more than 12,000 years ago. In fact, by the time European adventurers arrived in the 15th century, scholars estimate that more than 50 million people were already living in the Americas. Of these, some 10 million lived in the area that would become the United States. As time passed, these migrants and their descendants pushed south and east, adapting as they went. In order to keep track of these diverse groups, anthropologists and geographers have divided them into "culture areas," or rough groupings of contiguous peoples who shared similar habitats and characteristics.

Most scholars break North America - excluding present-day Mexico - into 10 separate culture areas: the Arctic, the Subarctic, the Northeast, the Southeast, the Plains, the Southwest, the Great Basin, California, the Northwest Coast, and the Plateau. The Arctic culture area, a cold, flat, treeless region (actually a frozen desert) near the Arctic Circle in present-day Alaska, Canada and Greenland, was home to the Inuit and the Aleut. Both groups spoke, and continue to speak, dialects descended from what scholars call the Eskimo-Aleut language family. Because it is such an inhospitable landscape, the Arctic's population was comparatively small and scattered. Some of its peoples, especially the Inuit in the northern part of the region, were nomads, following seals, polar bears, and other game as they migrated across the tundra. In the southern part of the region, the Aleut were a bit more settled, living in small fishing villages along the shore.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Asteroid belt and Kuiper belt.

I. Asteroid belt falls between planet mars and planet Jupiter, whereas Kuiper belt is found beyond the planet Neptune.

II. Comets originates from both Asteroid belt and Kuiper belt.

Which among the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
क्षुद्रग्रह बेल्ट और कुइपर बेल्ट के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. क्षुद्रग्रह बेल्ट मंगल ग्रह और बृहस्पति ग्रह के बीच में स्थित है, जबकि कुइपर बेल्ट नेपच्यून ग्रह के आगे स्थित है।

II. धूमकेतु क्षुद्रग्रह बेल्ट और कुइपर बेल्ट दोनों से उत्पन्न होते हैं।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Statement I is correct: The asteroid belt is a region of the solar system falling roughly between the planets Mars and Jupiter where the greatest concentration of asteroid orbits can be found.

Whereas Kuiper Belt is a donut-shaped region of icy bodies beyond the orbit of Neptune. There may be millions of these icy objects, collectively referred to as Kuiper Belt objects (KBOs) or trans-Neptunian objects (TNOs), in this distant region of our solar system.

Statement II is Incorrect: The Oort Cloud and the Kuiper Belt are thought to be sources of comets.

The Oort Cloud is a much more distant region of icy, comet-like bodies that surrounds the solar system, including the Kuiper Belt.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct?

Statements:

I. Newton's First Law of Motion is also called the Law of Inertia.

II. Inertia depends on both mass and velocity of an object.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

कथन:

I. न्यूटन के गति के प्रथम नियम को जड़त्व का नियम भी कहा जाता है।

II. जड़त्व किसी वस्तु के द्रव्यमान और वेग दोनों पर निर्भर करता है।

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I और न ही II

questions.solution:
Statement I: "Newton's First Law of Motion is also called the Law of Inertia."

· This statement is correct. Newton's First Law states that an object at rest stays at rest, and an object in motion stays in motion with the same speed and direction unless acted upon by an unbalanced force. This describes the property of inertia, which is why the law is commonly referred to as the Law of Inertia.

Statement II: "Inertia depends on both mass and velocity of an object."

· This statement is incorrect. Inertia depends only on the mass of an object, not its velocity. Inertia is the resistance of any physical object to a change in its state of motion or rest. The more mass an object has, the greater its inertia. Velocity affects momentum (mass X velocity) but not inertia itself.

Therefore, only Statement I is correct.

questions.question: What is India's global rank in the QS World Future Skills Index 2027, which evaluates countries based on future workforce readiness, AI skills, and digital capability development?
questions.question_hi: QS वर्ल्ड फ्यूचर स्किल्स इंडेक्स 2027 में, जो भविष्य की कार्यबल तत्परता, एआई कौशल, और डिजिटल क्षमता विकास के आधार पर देशों का मूल्यांकन करता है, भारत की वैश्विक रैंक क्या है?
questions.solution:
India has secured the 13th position globally in the QS World Future Skills Index 2027, highlighting the country's growing focus on future technologies, skill development and workforce readiness.

The ranking reflects India's progress in preparing students and professionals for the changing demands of the job market, especially in areas like artificial intelligence (AI) and digital skills.

The QS World Future Skills Index measures how well countries are prepared for the future of work. It looks at factors such as skills alignment, academic readiness, economic transformation and the ability of countries to meet the growing demand for new-age skills.

According to the index, India has also performed strongly among lower-middle-income economies, securing the top position in this category. The ranking shows the country's efforts towards building a workforce that can adapt to new technologies and emerging industries.

According to QS, India scored 89.4 overall and achieved a perfect score of 100 in Economic Capacity, the highest in the world. The ranking was driven by sustained economic growth, infrastructure investment and rapid expansion in AI-related sectors.

The concern is quality. The report places India at 73rd on the Human Capital Index, indicating a significant gap between the volume of graduates being produced, and the skills required in fast-growing sectors such as artificial intelligence, digital technologies and green industries.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the carbon cycle.

I. Majority of the carbon is found in oceans.

II. Carbon is one of the major components of the organisms.

III. Decomposers doesn't release the carbon into atmosphere.

Which among the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
कार्बन चक्र के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. अधिकांश कार्बन महासागरों में पाया जाता है।

II. कार्बन जीवों के प्रमुख घटकों में से एक है।

III. अपघटक कार्बन को वायुमंडल में नहीं छोड़ते हैं।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement I is correct: About 71% of the total carbon on the earth is found dissolved in oceans. This oceanic reservoir regulates the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere. Fossil fuel also represent a reservoir of carbon.

Statement II is correct: Carbon constitutes 49% of dry weight of organisms and is one of the major components of the organisms.

Statement III is incorrect: Decomposers contribute substantially to CO2 pool by their processing of waste materials and dead organic matter of land or oceans.

Pygmy Hogg: The smallest member of the pig family, the pygmy hog, is a critically endangered species. questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the plant succession.

I. Hydrarch succession takes place in water or wet areas.

II. Xerarch succession takes place in both dry or wet areas.

III. Both Hydrarch and Xerarch succession leads to mesic conditions.

Which among the above statement is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
पौधे के अनुक्रम के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें।

I. हाइड्रार्क अनुक्रम पानी या गीले क्षेत्रों में होता है।

II. ज़ेरार्क अनुक्रम सूखे या गीले दोनों क्षेत्रों में होता है।

III. हाइड्रार्क और ज़ेरार्क दोनों अनुक्रम मेसिक स्थितियों की ओर ले जाते हैं।

उपर्युक्त कथन में से कौन सा सही है / हैं?
questions.solution:
Based on the nature of the habitat - whether it is water (or very wet areas) or it is on very dry areas - a succession of plants is called hydrarch or xerarch, respectively.

Statement III is correct: Both hydrarch and xerarch successions lead to medium water conditions (mesic) - neither too dry (xeric) nor too wet (hydric).

Statement I is correct: Hydrarch succession takes place in wet areas and the successional series progress from hydric to the mesic conditions.

Statement II is incorrect: Xerarch succession takes place in dry areas and the series progress from xeric to mesic conditions.

questions.question:
What alternatives does a Governor have after a money bill passed by the state legislature is presented to him?

I. He may withhold his assent to the bill, the bill then ends and does not become an act

II. He may return the bill for reconsideration of the state legislature

III. He may reserve the bill for the consideration of the president

Select the correct answer using codes below.
questions.question_hi:
राज्य विधानमंडल द्वारा पारित धन विधेयक राज्यपाल के समक्ष प्रस्तुत किए जाने के बाद उसके पास क्या विकल्प होते हैं?

I. वह विधेयक पर अपनी सहमति नहीं दे सकता, फिर विधेयक समाप्त हो जाता है और अधिनियम नहीं बनता।

II. वह विधेयक को राज्य विधानमंडल के पुनर्विचार के लिए लौटा सकता है।

III. वह विधेयक को राष्ट्रपति के विचार के लिए सुरक्षित रख सकता है।

नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनें।
questions.solution:
Every money bill, after it is passed by the state legislature (unicameral or bicameral), is presented to the governor for his assent. He has three alternatives:

1. He may give his assent to the bill, the bill then becomes an act.

2. He may withhold his assent to the bill, the bill then ends and does not become an act.

3. He may reserve the bill for the consideration of the president.

Thus, the governor cannot return a money bill for the reconsideration of the state legislature. Normally, the governor gives his assent to a money bill as it is introduced in the state legislature with his previous permission.

When the governor reserves a money bill for the consideration of the President, he will not have any further role in the enactment of the bill. If the President gives his assent to the bill, it becomes an Act. This means that the assent of the governor is no longer required.

II. They don't support any vegetative growth.

निम्नलिखित मिट्टी की विशेषताओं पर विचार करें।

I. ये अनुपजाऊ मिट्टी हैं और आम तौर पर जलभराव वाले क्षेत्रों में पाई जाती हैं।

II. ये किसी भी वनस्पति विकास का समर्थन नहीं करती हैं।

II. इस मिट्टी में सुधार के लिए जिप्सम मिलाया जाता है।

उपर्युक्त गद्यांश किस प्रकार की मिट्टी को संदर्भित करता है?
questions.solution:
Saline soils occur generally in swampy and waterlogged areas and also occur in arid and semi-arid areas. They have more salts largely because of the dry climate and/or poor drainage. They lack nitrogen and calcium. These factors make saline soils infertile and necessitates reclamation.

Saline soils are distributed over Western Gujarat, Deltas of Eastern Coast, Excessively irrigated areas of Punjab and Haryana and Sundarbans areas of West Bengal.

Source: India: Physical Environment NCERT

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about elasticity of demand:

1) Perfectly inelastic demand curve is a horizontal line parallel to the quantity axis.

2) Unit elastic demand implies percentage change in quantity demanded equals percentage change in price.

3) Luxury goods generally have a higher income elasticity of demand than necessity goods.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
मांग की लोच के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) पूर्णतः बेलोचदार मांग वक्र, मात्रा अक्ष के समानांतर एक क्षैतिज रेखा है।

2) इकाई लोचदार मांग का तात्पर्य है कि मांग की गई मात्रा में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन, कीमत में प्रतिशत परिवर्तन के बराबर है।

3) विलासिता की वस्तुओं में आम तौर पर आवश्यकता की वस्तुओं की तुलना में मांग की आय लोच अधिक होती है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statements 2 and 3 are correct.

Statement 1 is incorrect because a perfectly inelastic demand curve is a vertical line, not a horizontal one.

Explanation of Statements:

1 is Incorrect. Perfectly inelastic demand (where the price elasticity of demand is zero) means that the quantity demanded does not change at all, regardless of the price. To represent this graphically, the demand curve is a vertical line parallel to the price (Y) axis. A horizontal line parallel to the quantity (X) axis represents perfectly elastic demand, where any price increase above the market price causes quantity demanded to drop to zero.

2 is Correct. Unit elastic demand occurs when the price elasticity of demand is exactly equal to one (-1, ignoring the negative sign). This means that a given percentage change in the price of a good leads to an equal percentage change in the quantity demanded. For example, a 10% increase in price would cause a 10% decrease in quantity demanded.

3 is Correct. Income elasticity of demand measures how the quantity demanded of a good responds to a change in consumer income.

- Luxury goods are items that consumers buy in much larger quantities as their income rises. They have a high positive income elasticity of demand (greater than 1).

- Necessity goods (like basic food items) are items that consumers will buy regardless of their income level. As income rises, the quantity demanded for these goods increases only slightly or not at all. They have a low positive income elasticity of demand (between 0 and 1).

Therefore, the statement is correct.

Further Insights:

Price Elasticity of Demand (PED): Measures the responsiveness of quantity demanded to a change in its price. It helps businesses understand how a price change might affect their total revenue.

Income Elasticity of Demand (YED): Helps classify goods into normal goods (positive YED) and inferior goods (negative YED). Normal goods are further divided into necessities (0 < YED < 1) and luxuries (YED > 1).

Understanding elasticity is crucial for firms in setting pricing strategies and for governments in levying taxes. For instance, governments often tax goods with inelastic demand (like fuel and tobacco) because consumers will continue to buy them even if the price increases, ensuring stable tax revenue.

I. विघटन से लोकसभा का जीवन समाप्त हो जाता है।

II. सदन के समक्ष लंबित सभी मामले विघटन के साथ समाप्त हो जाते हैं।

III. राज्यसभा में लंबित एक विधेयक, जो अभी तक लोकसभा में पेश नहीं किया गया है, समाप्त नहीं होगा।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा सही है / हैं?
questions.solution:
All the statements are correct.

Dissolution ends the very life of the existing Lok Sabha. 'Dissolution of the Lok Sabha' means the end of the life of the Lok Sabha either by an order made by the President under article 85 (2) (b) of the Constitution or on the expiration of the period of five years from the date appointed for its first meeting.

All the matters pending before the House lapse with dissolution. This includes notices, motions and Bills. To pursue these matters, they have to be re-introduced in the next House after elections.

All Bills, except those bills pending in the Rajya Sabha, not yet introduced in the Lok Sabha, will lapse.

A Dissolution would not affect the joint sitting of the two houses summoned by the President before the dissolution of the house.

questions.question:
Which of the following influences the oceanic currents?

I. Insolation

II. Marine organisms

III. Gravity

IV. Coriolis force

Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा समुद्री धाराओं को प्रभावित करता है?

I. सूर्यातप

II. समुद्री जीव

III. गुरुत्वाकर्षण

IV. कोरिओलिस बल

नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनें।
questions.solution:
Ocean currents represent a regular volume of water in a definite path and direction. Forces that influences the oceanic currents are

1. Insolation: Heating by incoming solar radiation (insolation) causes the water to expand. Near the equator the ocean water is about 8 cm higher in level than in the middle latitudes because of expanded water. This causes a very slight gradient and water tends to flow down the slope.

2. Wind: Wind blowing on the surface of the ocean pushes the water to move. Friction between the wind and the water surface affects the movement of the water body in its course.

3. Gravity: Gravity tends to pull the water down the pile and create gradient variation.

4. Coriolis force: The Coriolis force intervenes and causes the water to move to the right in the northern hemisphere and to the left in the southern hemisphere.

Marine organisms don't influence ocean currents.

Source: NCERT

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Pallava art and architecture:

1. The Kailasanatha Temple at Kanchipuram is an early Pallava structural stone temple associated with Narasimhavarman II (Rajasimha).

2. The Pancha Rathas at Mamallapuram (Mahabalipuram) are monolithic rock-cut shrines.

Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
पल्लव कला और वास्तुकला के बारे में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. कांचीपुरम में कैलासनाथ मंदिर एक प्रारंभिक पल्लव संरचनात्मक पत्थर का मंदिर है जो नरसिंहवर्मन द्वितीय (राजसिंह) से संबंधित है।

2. ममल्लपुरम (महाबलीपुरम) में पंच रथ एकल चट्टान से बने शिल्प हैं।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: the Kailasanatha Temple at Kanchipuram is a major early structural (built) temple of the Pallavas and is linked to Narasimhavarman II, also called Rajasimha.

Statement 2 is correct: the Pancha Rathas are carved out of single rock boulders at Mamallapuram, making them monolithic rock-cut shrines.

Further Insights:

- Mamallapuram is a Pallava port-town and a major centre for rock-cut caves (mandapas), monoliths (rathas) and open-air reliefs.

- The Shore Temple at Mamallapuram is a noted Pallava structural temple complex facing the sea.

- "Arjuna's Penance/Descent of the Ganga" at Mamallapuram is a famous large open-air rock relief from the Pallava period.

- Mahendravarman I is especially associated with early Pallava rock-cut cave temples (mandapas).

- Kanchipuram was an important Pallava capital and a key site for Pallava structural temple development in the Dravida tradition.

questions.question: In football, an offside offence cannot be given directly from which restart?
questions.question_hi: फुटबॉल में, ऑफसाइड अपराध सीधे किस पुनःप्रारंभ से नहीं दिया जा सकता?
questions.solution:
Offside is not applicable when a player receives the ball directly from a throw-in.

Offside can apply from open play and from restarts like kick-off or free kicks if the offside conditions are met.

Further Insights:

- A player is in an offside position only in the opponents' half and nearer to the opponents' goal line than both the ball and the second-last opponent.

- Being in an offside position is not an offence by itself; the player must be involved in active play (interfering with play, interfering with an opponent, or gaining an advantage).

- No offside offence can be given directly from a goal kick or a corner kick as well.

- A player is not offside if level with the second-last opponent or level with the ball.

- A player cannot be offside in their own half.

questions.question: The element presents in same group have the same ________.
questions.question_hi: समान समूह में मौजूद तत्व का समान ________ होता है।
questions.solution:
· The elements present in same group have the same number of valence electrons.

· Valence electron is an outer shell electron within an atom and they participate in the formation of a chemical bond.

· Valence electrons are the electrons in the outermost shell, or energy level, of an atom.

· For example, oxygen has six valence electrons, two in the 2s subshell and four in the 2p subshell.

questions.question: Bhangra and Giddha are primarily associated with which theme in Punjab's folk culture?
questions.question_hi: भांगड़ा और गिद्दा मुख्य रूप से पंजाब की लोक संस्कृति में किस विषय से जुड़े हैं?
questions.solution:
Bhangra and Giddha originated as folk dances performed around the harvest season in Punjab.

They are linked to agrarian life and are widely seen as symbols of Punjabi cultural identity.

Further Insights:

- Bhangra is traditionally performed to the beat of the dhol and is commonly linked with the spring harvest festival of Baisakhi.

- Giddha is a traditional Punjabi women's folk dance, often accompanied by claps and boliyan (short lyrical couplets).

- Many Indian folk dances are season/festival-linked: Bihu (Assam) is tied to the harvest cycle, and Garba (Gujarat) is linked to Navratri.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements and choose the correct answer:

a. The iron and steel industry in India is mostly located near raw material sources rather than near markets.

b. The IT industry in India developed primarily due to availability of cheap labour and government incentives.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें और सही उत्तर चुनें:

a. भारत में लोहा और इस्पात उद्योग ज्यादातर बाजारों के बजाय कच्चे माल के स्रोतों के पास स्थित है।

b. भारत में आईटी उद्योग मुख्य रूप से सस्ते श्रम और सरकारी प्रोत्साहन की उपलब्धता के कारण विकसित हुआ।

options.label: C
options.text: Both a and b are correct
options.text_hi: a और b दोनों सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither a nor b are correct
options.text_hi: न तो a और न ही b सही हैं

questions.correct_text: Both a and b are correct
questions.solution:
Both statements a and b are correct. They accurately describe the key locational factors for the iron and steel industry and the IT industry in India, respectively.

a is Correct. The iron and steel industry is a raw-material-oriented industry. The primary raw materials are iron ore, coking coal, limestone, and manganese. These are bulky, heavy, and lose significant weight during the manufacturing process. Therefore, to minimize transportation costs, it is more economically viable to locate the steel plants close to the sources of these raw materials rather than near the final markets. This is why major steel plants in India are concentrated in the Chota Nagpur Plateau region, which is rich in these mineral resources.

b is Correct. The Information Technology (IT) industry is a knowledge-based or footloose industry, meaning it is not tied to raw materials or specific markets. Its development in India was driven by a unique set of factors:

Availability of cheap labour: More accurately, it was the availability of a large pool of skilled, English-speaking, and relatively low-cost software engineers and IT professionals that gave India a significant competitive advantage.

Government incentives: The Government of India played a crucial role by establishing Software Technology Parks (STPs) in the early 1990s. These STPs provided high-speed data communication links, reliable infrastructure, and a range of fiscal incentives, including tax holidays, which were instrumental in attracting investment and fostering the growth of the industry.

questions.question:

1) रजिस्टर कैश मेमोरी से तेज़ होते हैं।

questions.solution:
1) is Correct. Registers are located directly inside the CPU core. They are the fastest memory in the entire computer hierarchy, even faster than L1 Cache.

2) is Correct. Registers are used to hold the specific pieces of data the CPU is currently working on, such as operands for an addition or the intermediate result of a long calculation.

Further Insights:

Common registers include the Accumulator, Instruction Register, and Memory Address Register (MAR).

questions.question: Which of the following is the tertiary memory of a computer?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी कंप्यूटर की तृतीयक मेमोरी है?
questions.solution:
The primary storage of a computer system is its main memory. Temporary memory, often known as cache memory, is the primary store. Primary memory has a relatively limited capacity, and it is always smaller than secondary memory.

Primary storage examples are - Read-only memory (ROM) and RAM (Random Access Memory).

A secondary storage device has more storage capacity and can save data for a longer period. Compact discs (CDs), USB drives, hard discs, and other devices can be external or inside a computer.

The primary goal of tertiary storage is to provide massive storage capacity at a reasonable cost. In Hierarchical Storage Systems, the tertiary storage level (HSS) may employ several storage devices. They are as follows: Magnetic cassette, Disks (optical), Optical tapes are a type of optical tape.

questions.question: Encryption and decryption are the functions of which layer?
questions.question_hi: एन्क्रिप्शन और डिक्रिप्शन किस लेयर के कार्य हैं?
questions.solution: Data encryption and decryption take place in the presentation layer. Presentation Layer is the 6th layer in the Open System Interconnection (OSI) model. This layer is also known as Translation layer, as this layer serves as a data translator for the network. The data which this layer receives from the Application Layer is extracted and manipulated here as per the required format to transmit over the network. The main responsibility of this layer is to provide or define the data format and encryption. The presentation layer is also called as Syntax layer since it is responsible for maintaining the proper syntax of the data which it either receives or transmits to other layer(s) .

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:

1) A plotter is mainly used for high-quality vector graphics.

2) A plotter is faster than a laser printer for bulk printing.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) प्लॉटर का उपयोग मुख्य रूप से उच्च गुणवत्ता वाले वेक्टर ग्राफिक्स के लिए किया जाता है।

2) थोक मुद्रण के लिए प्लॉटर लेजर प्रिंटर से तेज़ होता है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन सा/से सही है/हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because a plotter is generally much slower than a laser printer, as it uses pens to draw continuous lines rather than printing in dots or toner layers.

Explanation of Statements:

· 1. is Correct. Plotters are specialized output devices designed to produce high-quality vector graphics. They are widely used in engineering and architecture for printing blueprints and technical drawings.

· 2. is Incorrect. Laser printers are optimized for bulk printing of text and raster images at high speeds. Plotters are precision-driven and move a pen across paper, making them unsuitable for rapid, high-volume document printing.

Further Insights:

· Plotters can draw on very large sheets of paper while maintaining high resolution, which standard office printers cannot handle.

· Common applications for plotters include CAD (Computer-Aided Design) and CAM (Computer-Aided Manufacturing) outputs.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:

1) OS acts as an interface between user and hardware.

2) OS is responsible for virus removal.

Which are correct?
questions.question_hi:

1) ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम उपयोगकर्ता और हार्डवेयर के बीच एक इंटरफ़ेस के रूप में कार्य करता है।

2) ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम वायरस हटाने के लिए जिम्मेदार है।

इनमें से कौन सा कथन सही है?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because virus removal is the function of specialized utility software called Antivirus.

Explanation of Statements:

· 1. is Correct. The OS provides a Graphical User Interface (GUI) or Command Line Interface (CLI) that allows users to communicate with the complex electronic hardware of the computer.

· 2. is Incorrect. While modern operating systems (like Windows) may include built-in security tools, "virus removal" is technically a function of security software, not a core requirement of the operating system itself.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:

i. NTFS supports file-level security and permissions.

ii. FAT32 supports file sizes larger than 4 GB.

iii. NTFS supports disk encryption using EFS.

Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

i. NTFS फ़ाइल-स्तरीय सुरक्षा और अनुमतियों का समर्थन करता है।

ii. FAT32 4 GB से बड़े फ़ाइल आकारों का समर्थन करता है।

iii. NTFS EFS का उपयोग करके डिस्क एन्क्रिप्शन का समर्थन करता है।

उपरोक्त कथनों में से कौन से सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1: NTFS supports file-level security (Correct)

NTFS (New Technology File System) was designed for modern operating systems (Windows NT and later). It allows administrators to set specific permissions (Read, Write, Execute) for individual files and folders for specific users or groups.

Statement 2: FAT32 supports files larger than 4 GB (Incorrect)

This is a major limitation of the FAT32 (File Allocation Table 32) system. The maximum individual file size it can handle is 4 GB minus 1 byte. If you try to copy a 5 GB movie file to a FAT32-formatted USB drive, the operation will fail even if the drive has 100 GB of free space.

Statement 3: NTFS supports disk encryption using EFS (Correct)

NTFS includes a feature called EFS (Encrypting File System). This allows transparent encryption and decryption of files linked to a specific user account, ensuring that even if someone physically steals the hard drive, they cannot read the files without the correct user credentials.

questions.question: In _______ topology each device is connected to every other device on the network through a dedicated point-to-point link.
questions.question_hi: _______ टोपोलॉजी में प्रत्येक डिवाइस एक समर्पित पॉइंट-टू-पॉइंट लिंक के माध्यम से नेटवर्क पर प्रत्येक दूसरे डिवाइस से जुड़ा होता है।
questions.solution: In mesh topology each device is connected to every other device on the network through a dedicated point-to-point link. Dedicated link means that the link only carries data for the two connected devices only. For example, if there are n devices in the network then each device must relate to (n-1) devices of the network. Number of links in a mesh topology of n devices would be n(n-1)/2.

questions.question: Unix is an example of:
questions.question_hi: यूनिक्स किसका एक उदाहरण है?
questions.solution:
Time sharing operating system:

Each task is given some time to execute so that all the tasks work smoothly. Each user gets the time of CPU as they use a single system. These systems are also known as Multitasking Systems. The task can be from a single user or different users also. The time that each task gets to execute is called quantum. After this time interval is over OS switches over to the next task.

Examples of Time-Sharing OSs are Multics, Unix, etc.

questions.question: Which measure helps prevent phishing attacks?
questions.question_hi: फिशिंग हमलों को रोकने में कौन सा उपाय सहायक होता है?
questions.solution:
· Option a - Incorrect: Sharing OTPs can lead to account compromise; attackers often ask for OTPs during phishing attempts.

· Option b - Incorrect: Clicking unknown or suspicious links is a common way phishing attacks succeed.

· Option c - Correct: Verifying the website URL (checking spelling, HTTPS, domain name) helps identify fake or malicious websites and is a key preventive measure against phishing.

· Option d - Incorrect: Using public Wi-Fi can increase security risks rather than prevent phishing.

questions.question: Unsolicited Commercial Email (UCE) is referred to as_______.
questions.question_hi: अनसॉलिसिटेड कमर्शियल ईमेल (UCE) को _______ कहा जाता है।
questions.solution: The term "spam" refers to unsolicited commercial email (UCE) or unsolicited bulk email (UBE). It is flooding the Internet with many copies of the same message, in an attempt to force the message on people who would not otherwise choose to receive it. It is also referred to as junk email. Unsolicited email mostly contains advertisements for services or products. However most of the spams are from marketers or users who are trying to deceive the users.

questions.question: Where are the instructions for booting process of a computer are housed in?
questions.question_hi: कंप्यूटर की बूटिंग प्रक्रिया के निर्देश कहाँ सग्रहित होते हैं?
questions.solution: From the very beginning, when the power button is pressed to turn the computer on, the power supply unit gives power to the motherboard and its components so that they can play their part in the whole system. The first part of the next step of the boot process is controlled by BIOS and it is stored in the non-volatile memory- ROM.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements:

1) POP3 downloads emails to the local system.

2) IMAP deletes emails from server after download.

Which are correct?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1) POP3 ईमेल को स्थानीय सिस्टम पर डाउनलोड करता है।

2) IMAP डाउनलोड होने के बाद सर्वर से ईमेल हटा देता है।

इनमें से कौन सा कथन सही है?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct.

Statement 2 is incorrect because IMAP is designed to keep emails on the server so they can be synced across multiple devices.

Explanation of Statements:

· 1. is Correct. POP3 (Post Office Protocol) downloads the email to your device and, by default, removes it from the server.

· 2. is Incorrect. IMAP (Internet Message Access Protocol) leaves the email on the server. If you read an email on your phone, it appears as "read" on your laptop because both are viewing the same server-side data.

The shortcut to lock the Windows screen is the Windows logo key + L.

questions.solution:
1) is Correct. The filetype: operator (e.g., filetype:pdf) tells the search engine to only show results that are in that specific format.

questions.question: In a dataset, replacing the value 36 with 54 increases the average by 1.5. How many observations does the set contain?

questions.solution:
Change in total = 54 − 36 = 18

If n is the number of observations, increase in average = 1.5 => increase in total = 1.5n

=> 1.5n = 18

=> n = 18 ÷ 1.5 = 12

Express solution:

n = (new − old) ÷ (rise in average)

n = (54 - 36)/1.5 = 12

questions.question: If the radius of a right circular cylinder open at both the ends, is decreased by 25% and the height of the cylinder is increased by 25%. Then the curved surface area of the cylinder thus formed

= 6.25%

questions.question: In an exam, the minimum passing percentage for class VIII and class IX is 42% and 48% respectively. A student from class VIII scored 136 marks and failed by 32 marks. If the maximum marks for class IX is 125 more than that of class VIII, then find the minimum marks for class IX.

questions.solution:
Let the maximum marks for class VIII be 'X'

X * 42/100 = 136 + 32

X = 400

The maximum marks for class IX = 400 + 125

= 525

Hence, the required minimum marks for class IX = 525 * 48/100

= 252

questions.question: The length and breadth of rectangle A are L cm and B cm respectively. The length and breadth of rectangle Y are (3L/2) cm and 4B cm respectively. Find the area of rectangle Y is how many times of the area of rectangle A.

questions.solution:
Area of rectangle A = L * B sq. cm

Area of rectangle Y = (3L/2) * 4B = 6 * L * B sq. cm

So, Area of rectangle Y is 6 times the area of rectangle A.

questions.question: The numbers 5, 7, 10, 12, 14, 18 and N are arranged in ascending order. If the mean of these numbers is equal to the median, find the value of N.
questions.question_hi: संख्याएँ 5, 7, 10, 12, 14, 18 और N आरोही क्रम में व्यवस्थित हैं। यदि इन संख्याओं का माध्य, माध्यिका के बराबर है, तो N का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
There are 7 numbers given and they are arranged in ascending order.

When the total number of observations is odd, the median is the middle term.

So, the median will be the 4th term.

From the given sequence, the 4th term is 12.

Hence, the median of the numbers is 12.

Now, find the mean.

First add all the known numbers: 5 + 7 + 10 + 12 + 14 + 18 = 66

Including N, the total sum becomes 66 + N.

Mean is equal to total sum divided by total number of observations, that is:

Mean = (66 + N) / 7

According to the question, the mean is equal to the median.

So, (66 + N) / 7 = 12

66 + N = 84

N = 18

Let investment of P and Q is 'x' and '14000 - x' respectively.

Ratio of profit Q and R = (14000 - x) * 12: 10000 * 12 = 3: 5

(14000 - x) * 12: 10000 * 12 = 3: 5

x = 8000

Investment of P = x = ₹8000

questions.solution: Hence, the required time = 12 * 27 = 5 hours 24 minutes

questions.question: A line is the perpendicular bisector of the line segment connecting points X(7, 5) and Y(-6, 4). What is the x-intercept of the line?
questions.question_hi: एक रेखा, बिंदुओं X(7, 5) और Y(-6, 4) को जोड़ने वाले रेखाखंड का लंब समद्विभाजक है। उस रेखा का x-अंतःखंड क्या है?
questions.solution:
Given: X(7, 5) and Y(-6, 4)

Mid-point of XY:

M = (x1 + x2)/2, (y1 + y2)/2

= [7 + (-6)]/2, (5 + 4)/2

= 1/2 , 9/2

Slope of XY = m = (y2 - y1)/(x2 - x1)

= (4 - 5)/(-6 - 7) = 1/13

Slope of perpendicular bisector = -1/m = -1/(1/13) = -13

Equation of line through M(1/2, 9/2) =>

y - 9/2 = -13(x - 1/2)

y - 9/2 = -13x + 13/2

y = -13x + 11

For x-intercept => y = 0

0 = -13x + 11

13x = 11

x = 11/13

In a certain code language,

'P▼Q' means 'Q is the sister of P'.

'P◄Q' means 'P is the father of Q'.

'P▲Q' means 'Q is the daughter of P'

'P►Q' means 'P is the wife of Q and has only two children'.

If A ◄ T ►W ▲ S ▼ K, then which of the following statements is false?

I. A is the grandfather of K.

II. W is the daughter-in-law of A.

III. K is the sister of T.

IV. S is the niece of T.
questions.question_hi:
एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में,

'P▼Q' का अर्थ है कि 'Q, P की बहन है'

'P◄Q' का अर्थ है कि 'P, Q का पिता है'

'P▲Q' का अर्थ है कि 'Q, P की पुत्री है'

'P►Q' का अर्थ है कि 'P, Q की पत्नी है और उसकी केवल दो संतान हैं'

यदि A ◄ T ►W ▲ S ▼ K है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा/से कथन असत्य है/हैं?

I. A, K का दादा/नाना है।

II. W, A की बहू है।

III. K, T की बहन है।

IV. S, T की भतीजी/भांजी है।
questions.solution:
It is given that,

'P▼Q' means 'Q is the sister of P'.

'P◄Q' means 'P is the father of Q'.

'P▲Q' means 'Q is the daughter of P'.

'P►Q' means 'P is the wife of Q and has only two children'.

After decoding A ◄ T ►W ▲ S ▼ K, we get:

A is the father of T.

T is the wife of W and has only two children.

S is the daughter of W.

K is the sister of S.

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'ZENITH' is coded as '328' and 'HARBOR' is coded as '248'. What is the code for 'XYLENE' in the code language?
questions.question_hi: एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में, 'ZENITH' को '328' और 'HARBOR' को '248' लिखा जाता है। इस कूट भाषा में 'XYLENE' का कूट क्या है?
questions.solution:
A (1)B (2)C (3)D (4)E (5)F (6)G (7)H (8)I (9)J (10)K (11)L (12)M (13)
Z (26)Y (25)X (24)W (23)V (22)U (21)T (20)S (19)R (18)Q (17)P (16)O (15)N (14)

'ZENITH' is coded as '328'

Z (26), E (5), N (14), I (9), T (20), H (8)

26 + 5 + 14 + 9 + 20 + 8 = 82

82 X 4 = 328

'HARBOR' is coded as '248'

H (8), A (1), R (18), B (2), O (15), R (18)

8 + 1 + 18 + 2 + 15 + 18 = 62

62 X 4 = 248

For 'XYLENE'-

X (24), Y (25), L (12), E (5), N (14), E (5)

24 + 25 + 12 + 5 + 14 + 5 = 85

85 X 4 = 340

Thus, the answer is option (c).

questions.question:
A question is given, followed by two statements labelled I and II. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient to answer the question.

Question:

Six persons- A, D, I, K, O and R are living in a six-storeyed building but not necessarily in the same order. The bottommost floor is 1 above that 2 and so on. On which floor does R lives?

Statements:

(I) Two floors are between I and K. D lives immediate above R. Only one person lives between O and K. A does not lives on a floor.

(II) K lives immediate below A. O lives above D but below I. Three floors are between K and R. A lives above I.
questions.question_hi:
एक प्रश्न दिया गया है, उसके बाद I और II के रूप में लेबल किये गये दो कथन दिए गए हैं। पहचान कीजिए कि कौन-सा/से कथन प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है/हैं।

प्रश्न:

छह व्यक्ति A, D, I, K, O और R छह मंजिला इमारत में रहते हैं, लेकिन आवश्यक नहीं कि ये समान क्रम में हों। सबसे निचली मंजिल की संख्या 1 है और उसके ऊपर वाली मंजिल की संख्या 2 है और इसी प्रकार आगे भी सभी मंजिल संख्यांकित हैं। R किस मंजिल पर रहता है?

कथन:

(I) I और K के बीच दो मंजिलें हैं। D, R के ठीक ऊपर रहता है। O और K के बीच केवल एक व्यक्ति रहता है। A किसी मंजिल पर नहीं रहता है।

(II) K, A के ठीक नीचे रहता है। O, D के ऊपर लेकिन I के नीचे रहता है। K और R के बीच तीन मंजिलें हैं। A, I के ऊपर रहता है।

options.label: A
options.text: Statement I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
options.text_hi: एक साथ कथन I और II प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं हैं

options.label: B
options.text: Statement I and II together are sufficient to answer the question
options.text_hi: एक साथ कथन I और II प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त हैं

options.label: C
options.text: Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement II is not
options.text_hi: अकेले कथन I प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन II नहीं है

options.label: D
options.text: Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement I is not
options.text_hi: अकेले कथन II प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन I नहीं है

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The government has finally launched several welfare schemes which promise to uplift the economic condition of the rural population significantly.

options.label: A
options.text: Several welfare schemes which promise to uplift the economic condition of the rural population have been finally launched by the government.

options.label: B
options.text: Several welfare schemes which promise to uplift the economic condition of the rural population had been finally launched by the government.

options.label: C
options.text: Several welfare schemes were finally launched by the government which promised to uplift the economic condition of the rural population.

options.label: D
options.text: Several welfare schemes which promise to uplift the economic condition of the rural population were being finally launched by the government.

questions.correct_text: Several welfare schemes which promise to uplift the economic condition of the rural population have been finally launched by the government.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive Voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

The usage of a "to be" form of verb ['been' for the given sentence] is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

In Passive Voice, the preposition "by" is used before the object.

The Active voice in this question is in Present Perfect. Thus, the Passive voice will also be in the Present Perfect.

The format in the Active voice is: Subject + has/have + V3 + Object.

Thus, the format in Passive voice will be: Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + has/have + been + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).

For example:

They have won the match. (Active)

The match has been won by them. (Passive)

Options (b), (c), and (d) use incorrect tenses.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (a): Several welfare schemes which promise to uplift the economic condition of the rural population have been finally launched by the government.

Note: V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).

questions.question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence:

The cricket fan exclaimed with joy that his favourite team had won the championship trophy after a thrilling and nail-biting final match against their rivals.

options.label: A
options.text: The cricket fan said, "My favourite team has won the championship trophy after a thrilling and nail-biting final match against their rivals."

options.label: B
options.text: The cricket fan exclaimed, "Wow! My favourite team had won the championship trophy after a thrilling and nail-biting final match against their rivals."

options.label: C
options.text: The cricket fan said, "Hurray! My favourite team has won the championship trophy after a thrilling and nail-biting final match against their rivals."

options.label: D
options.text: The cricket fan said with joy, "His favourite team has won the championship trophy after a thrilling and nail-biting final match against their rivals."

questions.correct_text: The cricket fan said, "Hurray! My favourite team has won the championship trophy after a thrilling and nail-biting final match against their rivals."
questions.solution:
Exclamatory Sentences are used to express joy, surprise, wonder, etc. The reporting verbs in indirect speech change from "Exclaimed with sorrow", "Exclaimed with joy", etc. to "said" in Direct Speech. In Indirect Speech, if the sentence is in assertive form, then it is changed into Exclamatory form in Direct Speech.

For example:

Barney exclaimed with sorrow that he was ruined. (Indirect Speech)

Barney said, "Good Heavens! I am ruined." (Direct Speech)

The tense of the Indirect Speech is in the Past Perfect. So, the tense in the Direct Speech will be in the Present Perfect. [One of the three cases for Past Perfect: Tense remains same, Past perfect changes to Present Perfect or Past perfect changes to Simple Past]

As per the options, the second case is applicable here.

The following things in the sentence will change when changed from Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:

'Exclaimed with joy that' is changed to 'said, "Hurray!'.

'His' is changed to 'My'.

'Had won' is changed to 'has won'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: The cricket fan said, "Hurray! My favourite team has won the championship trophy after a thrilling and nail-biting final match against their rivals."

Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

Has the suit been delivered by the dry cleaner?

options.label: A
options.text: Has the dry cleaner deliver the suit?

options.label: B
options.text: Has the dry cleaner delivering the suit?

options.label: C
options.text: Has the dry cleaner delivered the suit?

options.label: D
options.text: Have the dry cleaner delivered the suit?

questions.correct_text: Has the dry cleaner delivered the suit?
questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" verb ['been' here] and the preposition "by" is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

In Active voice (look at the options), it should be an interrogative sentence. The answer to this question will be either "yes" or "no".

These types of sentences usually begin with a helping verb like: have, has and had.

In Passive voice, the format is: Have/Has/Had + Object of the Active voice (Subjective case) + been + V3 + by + Subject of the Active voice (Objective case).

Thus, the format of such a sentence in Active voice is: Have/Has/Had + Subject + V3 + Object?

For example:

Has the letter been written by Rohit? (Passive)

Has Rohit written the letter? (Active)

The options except (c) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Hence, the correct answer is option (c).

Note:

A Preposition is a word placed before a noun or a pronoun or a noun equivalent (pronoun, adverb, gerund, infinitive, adverbial clause, or any clause that can be used as the object of the preposition) and shows a relationship in space or time or a logical relationship between two or more people, places, or things in a sentence.

Examples

I. The teacher scolded the child for being late.

II. We're going to a party.

· The words in bold are called prepositions because they normally take position before (pre) a noun/pronoun or a noun equivalent (pronoun, adverb, gerund, infinitive, adverbial clause, or any clause that can be used as the object of the preposition.

· The noun/pronoun which is used with a preposition is called its Object.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Projected growth in rocket launches for space tourism, moon landings, and perhaps travel to Mars has many dreaming of a new era of space exploration.

B. Scientists from NOAA and The Aerospace Corp. modelled the climate response of the stratosphere to increased future emissions of black carbon from rockets burning kerosene fuel.

C. Kerosene-burning rocket engines emit black carbon into the stratosphere, where ozone protects life on Earth from harmful ultraviolet radiation that can cause skin cancer and disrupt ecosystems.

D. But a NOAA study suggests that a significant boost in spaceflight activity may damage the protective ozone layer on the one planet where we live.
questions.solution: After reading all the sentences thoroughly, we can say that sentence B should be placed first as it introduces the scientific study about the climate response of the stratosphere to increased black carbon emissions from rocket launches. Sentences B and A form a pair. Sentence A follows and expands on the relevance of this research by describing the anticipated growth in rocket launches for space exploration, which contextualizes why the study is necessary. Sentences D and C form another pair: Sentence D warns that increased spaceflight activity may harm the protective ozone layer, while Sentence C elaborates on how kerosene-burning rocket engines emit black carbon into the stratosphere and the role of ozone in protecting life on Earth from harmful ultraviolet radiation. Therefore, the correct order is BADC. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Pretend you are in class and your teacher gives you an assignment in which you must identify the number of unique dogs in a puzzle.

B. She gives full dog images to one half of the class, cuts up the rest of the images into smaller pieces and gives them to the other half, including you.

C. You end up assembling two dogs while the other half of the class, with the more complete pictures, easily identifies four dogs, which illustrates one of the shortcomings of a short-read genome vs. a long-read genome.

D. Excited for a challenge, you begin assembling the pieces, only to quickly realize that several fragments seem redundant and look like they belong to the same dog.
questions.solution:
Sentence A serves as an introduction to the scenario, framing the context for the entire passage. It engages the reader by setting up the imaginary task given by the teacher. This is the natural starting point as it presents the challenge that will be discussed in the following sentences.

Sentence B continues the narrative by describing how the assignment is divided among the class. It explains the setup: one-half of the class receives full images, while the other half, including the reader, gets fragmented images. This builds on the context introduced in 'A', clarifying the different tasks assigned to the two groups.

Sentence D follows naturally after 'B' as it describes the reader's experience while working on the assignment. It adds a personal element by focusing on the reader's perspective, detailing the process of assembling the fragmented images. This sentence introduces the difficulty of distinguishing between fragments, leading to the realization that the fragments may belong to the same dog.

Sentence C provides the conclusion to the scenario, revealing the final result: the reader identifies only two dogs, while the other half of the class identifies four. It also connects the metaphor to the concept of short-read genomes vs. long-read genomes, offering the lesson or insight that the puzzle exercise was meant to illustrate. This serves as the concluding point that ties everything together.

So, the correct order is ABDC.

Hence, option (d) is the answer.

questions.question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence:

The spectator said, "What a magnificent goal the striker has scored in the final minute of the match to win the cup for his team!"

options.label: A
options.text: The spectator exclaimed with admiration that the striker had scored a very magnificent goal in the final minute of the match to win the cup for his team.

options.label: B
options.text: The spectator said that the striker had scored a magnificent goal in the final minute of the match to win the cup for his team.

options.label: C
options.text: The spectator exclaimed that what a magnificent goal the striker had scored in the final minute of the match to win the cup for his team.

options.label: D
options.text: The spectator exclaimed with admiration that the striker scored a very magnificent goal in the final minute of the match to win the cup for his team.

questions.correct_text: The spectator exclaimed with admiration that the striker had scored a very magnificent goal in the final minute of the match to win the cup for his team.
questions.solution:
Exclamatory Sentences are used to express joy, surprise, wonder, etc. The reporting verb [`said' in the Direct Speech] is changed into "Exclaimed with sorrow", "Exclaimed with joy", "Exclaimed with admiration", etc. The Exclamatory Sentence is changed into an assertive form, often using words like "very" or "great".

For example:

The minister said, "How foolish of me." (Direct Speech)

The minister confessed with regret that he was very foolish. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

· said and What a... are replaced by exclaimed with admiration.

· The sentence is made assertive: the striker had scored a very magnificent goal...

· has scored (Present Perfect) changes to had scored (Past Perfect).

Therefore, the correct answer is: "The spectator exclaimed with admiration that the striker had scored a very magnificent goal in the final minute of the match to win the cup for his team."

Hence, option (a) is correct.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The cell theory is one of the foundational tenet of biology and explains the relationship between cells and living things.

options.label: D
options.text: The cell theory is one of the foundational

questions.solution:
The error lies in option (a).

The noun always takes a plural form after the adjective, when it is preceded by "one of".

The format is: one of + the + adjective + plural noun.

For example: Newton was one of the smartest men in his era.

Similarly, in this context, 'one + of + the + foundational + tenets (plural noun)' is the correct structure of the phrase. Hence, 'tenets' (plural form) must replace 'tenet' (singular).

Thus, the error is in option (a) tenet of biology and explains.

Therefore, the corrected form of the sentence is: The cell theory is one of the foundational tenets of biology and explains the relationship between cells and living things.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Neither the manager nor the assistant manager were available when the client arrived for the meeting.
questions.solution:
The segment that contains a grammatical error is 'were available when the'. The error is related to subject-verb agreement. The subject of the sentence is "Neither the manager nor the assistant manager." This is a compound subject connected to "neither...nor." When using "neither...nor," the verb should agree with the closer subject in terms of proximity. In this case, "assistant manager" is closer to the verb. "Assistant manager" is a singular subject, so the verb should be singular as well. The correct verb form to use with a singular subject is "was" [singular], not "were" [plural]. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

The correct sentence is: Neither the manager nor the assistant manager was available when the client arrived for the meeting.

NOTE:

Subject-verb agreement means that a subject and its verb must be both singular or plural:

A singular subject takes a singular verb.

A plural subject takes a plural verb.

For example, in the sentence 'John lives in France', the subject John (singular 'he') agrees with the third person singular form of the verb to live - lives.

Break into: "Break into" means to forcibly enter a place, which is unrelated to the context of a car ceasing to function.

questions.passage:
Directions: Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

Long, long ago there lived in the land of the Madras a noble king who ruled his people wisely and well. He had most of the things which make people happy a stout heart, a liberal hand, great wealth and peace within the borders of his realm; but because he had neither son nor daughter his happiness was incomplete. So, the king fasted and prayed and offered unceasing sacrifice to the goddess Savitri, the Bringer of Gifts, beseeching her to send sons and daughters to gladden his royal palace and turn it from a dwelling-place into a home. And because he was brave and good and unselfish the goddess answered his prayers and sent him a daughter. The child grew in strength and grace and beauty, and when she drew near to womanhood the fame of her loveliness went out through all the land. So pure and perfect did she seem, so full of maiden grace and modesty, that not one of all the noble lords about her father's court dared to ask her as his wife. One day she came before her father bearing in her arms fresh flowers, which she laid at his feet; and then modestly folding her hands she stood with bowed head before his throne. "Daughter," he said, "the time is come for you to wed, and seeing that no one comes to ask for you, go forth and search for yourself according to our custom. Choose a prince of noble mind." The princess bowed to the ground before the king, her father, and then left his presence. Mounting a gaily-decorated car, she set out on her errand in the company of some of the king's wisest subjects. They passed through many great forests and came to many woodland towns; and the princess watched earnestly, seeking a noble prince in whose keeping her heart could rest.

So, the king fasted and prayed and offered unceasing sacrifice to the goddess Savitri, the Bringer of Gifts, beseeching her to send sons and daughters to gladden his royal palace and turn it from a dwelling-place into a home. And because he was brave and good and unselfish the goddess answered his prayers and sent him a daughter. The child grew in strength and grace and beauty, and when she drew near to womanhood the fame of her loveliness went out through all the land. So pure and perfect did she seem, so full of maiden grace and modesty, that not one of all the noble lords about her father's court dared to ask her as his wife. One day she came before her father bearing in her arms fresh flowers, which she laid at his feet; and then modestly folding her hands she stood with bowed head before his throne. "Daughter," he said, "the time is come for you to wed, and seeing that no one comes to ask for you, go forth and search for yourself according to our custom. Choose a prince of noble mind." The princess bowed to the ground before the king, her father, and then left his presence. Mounting a gaily-decorated car, she set out on her errand in the company of some of the king's wisest subjects. They passed through many great forests and came to many woodland towns; and the princess watched earnestly, seeking a noble prince in whose keeping her heart could rest.

questions.question: Who accompanied the princess on her quest to find a prince of noble mind?
questions.solution:
The passage mentions that - "Mounting a gaily-decorated car, she set out on her errand in the company of some of the king's wisest subjects."

Hence, option (b) is the answer.

questions.question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence:

The witness said, "At 9 PM last night, the suspect was arguing loudly with another person just outside the main gate of the apartment complex."

options.label: A
options.text: The witness said that at 9 PM the previous night, the suspect had argued loudly with another person just outside the main gate of the apartment complex.

options.label: B
options.text: The witness said that at 9 PM last night, the suspect had been arguing loudly with another person just outside the main gate of the apartment complex.

options.label: C
options.text: The witness said that at 9 PM the previous night, the suspect had been arguing loudly with another person just outside the main gate of the apartment complex.

options.label: D
options.text: The witness said that at 9 PM the previous night, the suspect was arguing loudly with another person just outside the main gate of the apartment complex.

questions.correct_text: The witness said that at 9 PM the previous night, the suspect had been arguing loudly with another person just outside the main gate of the apartment complex.
questions.solution:
The sentence in the Direct Speech is in Past Continuous Tense. Therefore, the sentence in the Indirect Speech should be in Past Perfect Continuous Tense.

Past Continuous (Subject + was/were + V1 + ing + Object) should be converted into Past Perfect Continuous (Subject + had + been + V1 + ing + Object).

For example:

He said, "I was watching television last night." (Direct Speech)

He said that he had been watching television the previous night. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

· last night changes to the previous night.

· was arguing changes to had been arguing.

Therefore, the correct answer is: "The witness said that at 9 PM the previous night, the suspect had been arguing loudly with another person just outside the main gate of the apartment complex."

Hence, option (c) is correct.

Note: V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).

options.label: C
options.text: Hurting yourself by kicking against a wall.

questions.correct_text: Hurt yourself by persisting in a useless protest.
questions.solution:
The phrase 'kick against the pricks' means to hurt yourself by persisting in a useless resistance or protest.

Usage - People in prison learn very quickly not to kick against the pricks.

Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

All other sentences have the word 'portrait' incorrectly spelt.

'Portrait' means 'a painting, drawing, photograph, or engraving of a person, especially one depicting only the face or head and shoulders'.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Assuage
questions.solution:
Assuage means to make an unpleasant feeling less intense or to satisfy an appetite or desire. For example, "The letter was intended to assuage the fears of the residents."

Inflame means to provoke or intensify strong feelings, especially anger, in someone. For example, "His controversial speech was designed to inflame the crowd." This act of intensifying is the direct opposite of soothing or lessening, making inflame the correct antonym.

The other options - Alleviate, Mitigate, and Soothe are all synonyms of "assuage", as they mean to lessen pain or distress.

Hence, option (d) is the answer.

questions.question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

The old, dilapidated bridge that serves as the only link to the remote villages has to be completely rebuilt by the public works department.

options.label: A
options.text: The public works department will have to completely rebuild the old, dilapidated bridge that serves as the only link to the remote villages.

options.label: B
options.text: The public works department is to completely rebuild the old, dilapidated bridge that serves as the only link to the remote villages.

options.label: C
options.text: The public works department had to completely rebuild the old, dilapidated bridge that serves as the only link to the remote villages.

options.label: D
options.text: The public works department has to completely rebuild the old, dilapidated bridge that serves as the only link to the remote villages.

questions.correct_text: The public works department has to completely rebuild the old, dilapidated bridge that serves as the only link to the remote villages.
questions.solution:
The subject of the Passive Voice is changed into the object of the Active Voice. Also, the object of the Passive Voice is changed into the subject of the Active Voice.

The removal of the "to be" verb ['be'] and the preposition "by" is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Passive to Active.

The sentence in Active voice should be in Infinitive form (to + V1 form).

The format in Passive voice is: Object of the Active voice (Subjective case) + have/has/had + to + be + V3 + by + Subject of the Active voice (Objective case).

Thus, the format in the Active voice is: Subject + have/has/had + to + V1 + Object.

For example:

Some books have to be lent by me. (Passive)

I have to lend some books. (Active)

The options except (d) don't follow the correct grammatical format of the Active Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is option (d): The public works department has to completely rebuild the old, dilapidated bridge that serves as the only link to the remote villages.

Note: V1 -> Base form/simple form of verb, V2 -> Past form of verb (-ed form or irregular verb), V3 -> Past participle form of verb (-ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n), V4 -> Continuous form of verb / Present participle form of verb (-ing form), V5 -> Third person singular (V1+ -es or -s).

questions.question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its active voice structure to a passive voice structure:

The thorough investigators had uncovered hidden financial trails leading to offshore accounts before the regulatory audit commenced abruptly.

options.label: A
options.text: Before the regulatory audit commenced abruptly, hidden financial trails leading to offshore accounts had been uncovered by the thorough investigators.

options.label: B
options.text: The thorough investigators had been uncovered hidden financial trails leading to offshore accounts before the regulatory audit commenced abruptly.

options.label: C
options.text: Hidden financial trails leading to offshore accounts were uncovered by the thorough investigators before the regulatory audit commenced abruptly.

options.label: D
options.text: Hidden financial trails leading to offshore accounts had uncovered before the regulatory audit commenced abruptly by the thorough investigators.

questions.correct_text: Before the regulatory audit commenced abruptly, hidden financial trails leading to offshore accounts had been uncovered by the thorough investigators.
questions.solution:
The task involves converting a sentence from active voice to passive voice.

Key Rules for Active to Passive Voice when converting active voice to passive voice: Object becomes subject: The direct object ("hidden financial trails...") becomes the new subject.

Verb tense remains: Past perfect ("had uncovered") becomes "had been uncovered" (passive: had + been + past participle).

Agent optional: The original subject ("the thorough investigators") becomes the agent [object] with "by."

Adverbs/modifiers unchanged: "Leading to offshore accounts," "before the regulatory audit commenced abruptly," remain.

Option a) applies the rules seamlessly with natural rephrasing.

Hence, the correct answer is option (a).

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To cut the sinews of Achilles

options.label: B
options.text: To eliminate someone's key strength or advantage

questions.correct_text: To eliminate someone's key strength or advantage
questions.solution:
This idiom comes from Greek mythology and means to destroy the essential strength or vulnerability of someone or something.

Example: "The whistleblower cut the sinews of Achilles by exposing the company's financial loopholes."
