questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

The father said to his son, "Are you spending wisely?"

options.label: A
options.text: The father asked his son whether was he spending wisely.

options.label: B
options.text: The father asked his son if he was spending wisely.

options.label: C
options.text: The father asked his son if he had been spending wisely.

options.label: D
options.text: The father asked his son whether he spent wisely.

questions.correct_text: The father asked his son if he was spending wisely.
questions.solution:
In the case of Interrogative sentences like this, "said" in Direct Speech is changed into "enquired (of)", "wanted to know", "asked", etc.

In Indirect speech, the verb is always placed after the subject, unlike in Direct Speech.

If there is a question in the Direct Speech whose answer can come as "Yes" or "No" in the Indirect Speech, we should use "If" or "Whether" before the Indirect Speech.

For example:

Ravi said to me, "Is she studying?" (Direct Speech)

Ravi asked me if she was studying. (Indirect Speech)

Also, the sentence in the Direct Speech is in the Present Continuous tense. So, the tense in the Indirect Speech should be in the Past Continuous tense.

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

Direct SpeechIndirect Speech
said toasked
Are youif he was

Therefore, the correct answer is: (b) The father asked his son if he was spending wisely.

questions.question:
Arrange the following events during the Indian National Movement in their correct chronological sequence:

1. Announcement of the August Offer by Viceroy Lord Linlithgow

2. Arrival of the Cripps Mission in India

3. Launch of the Quit India Movement

4. Arrival of the Cabinet Mission in India
questions.question_hi:
भारतीय राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन के दौरान निम्नलिखित घटनाओं को उनकी सही कालानुक्रमिक क्रम में व्यवस्थित करें:

1. वाइसराय लॉर्ड लिनलिथगो द्वारा अगस्त प्रस्ताव की घोषणा

2. भारत में क्रिप्स मिशन का आगमन

3. भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन की शुरुआत

4. भारत में कैबिनेट मिशन का आगमन
questions.solution:
1 (August 1940): The August Offer was announced by Lord Linlithgow, offering a dominion status for India after World War II and the expansion of the Viceroy's Executive Council, which was rejected by both the Congress and the Muslim League.

2 (March 1942): The Cripps Mission, headed by Sir Stafford Cripps, arrived in India to secure full Indian cooperation for the war effort in exchange for post-war constitutional promises, famously described by Mahatma Gandhi as a "post-dated cheque on a crashing bank."

3 (August 1942): Following the failure of the Cripps Mission, the All India Congress Committee met in Bombay and passed the historic Quit India Resolution, initiating a mass civil disobedience movement under Gandhi's call of "Do or Die."

4 (March 1946): The Cabinet Mission (comprising Pethick-Lawrence, Stafford Cripps, and A.V. Alexander) arrived in India to discuss the transfer of power and formulate a plan for a constituent assembly and an interim government.

Further insights:

Individual Satyagraha: Following the rejection of the August Offer, Mahatma Gandhi launched the Individual Satyagraha in October 1940 to affirm the right to free speech against the war, with Acharya Vinoba Bhave chosen as the first satyagrahi and Jawaharlal Nehru as the second.

questions.question: In international competitive swimming, which of the following choices correctly describes the rules concerning the execution of the 'Dolphin Kick'?
questions.question_hi: अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रतिस्पर्धी तैराकी में, निम्नलिखित विकल्पों में से कौन सा 'डॉल्फिन किक' के निष्पादन से संबंधित नियमों का सही वर्णन करता है?

options.label: A
options.text: It is the mandatory, exclusive leg movement utilized throughout the entire duration of the Backstroke event, and using it in any other stroke results in immediate disqualification.
options.text_hi: यह अनिवार्य, विशिष्ट पैर की गति है जो बैकस्ट्रोक इवेंट की पूरी अवधि के दौरान उपयोग की जाती है, और इसे किसी अन्य स्ट्रोक में उपयोग करने पर तुरंत अयोग्यता हो जाती है।

options.label: B
options.text: It features a simultaneous downward and upward whip-like motion of both legs together like a dolphin's tail; it is the standard kick for the Butterfly stroke and is legally permitted for up to 15 metres underwater after starts and turns in Freestyle and Backstroke events.
options.text_hi: इसमें दोनों पैरों की एक साथ नीचे और ऊपर की ओर एक चाबुक जैसी गति होती है जैसे डॉल्फिन की पूंछ; यह बटरफ्लाई स्ट्रोक के लिए मानक किक है और फ्रीस्टाइल और बैकस्ट्रोक इवेंट्स में स्टार्ट और टर्न के बाद 15 मीटर तक पानी के नीचे कानूनी रूप से अनुमति प्राप्त है।

options.label: C
options.text: It is an illegal leg motion characterized by a scissor-like separation of the knees, which is banned across all Olympic swimming styles due to unfair hydrodynamic advantages.
options.text_hi: यह एक अवैध पैर की गति है जिसे घुटनों के कैंची जैसे अलगाव द्वारा दर्शाया जाता है, जो सभी ओलंपिक तैराकी शैलियों में अनुचित हाइड्रोडायनामिक लाभों के कारण प्रतिबंधित है।

options.label: D
options.text: It is a specialized stroke where the swimmer must keep their face entirely above the water line while executing alternating vertical leg kicks for the entire length of the pool.
options.text_hi: यह एक विशेष स्ट्रोक है जहाँ तैराक को पूल की पूरी लंबाई में वैकल्पिक ऊर्ध्वाधर पैर की किक्स करते हुए अपना चेहरा पूरी तरह से पानी की सतह के ऊपर रखना होता है।

questions.correct_text: It features a simultaneous downward and upward whip-like motion of both legs together like a dolphin's tail; it is the standard kick for the Butterfly stroke and is legally permitted for up to 15 metres underwater after starts and turns in Freestyle and Backstroke events.
questions.solution:
Option (b) is correct: The dolphin kick involves both legs moving together in a continuous fluid wave. It is the required kick for the Butterfly stroke. Under World Aquatics (FINAI) regulations, swimmers are also permitted to use it underwater to maximize speed after diving off the blocks or pushing off the walls during Freestyle, Backstroke, and Butterfly races, provided they surface before passing the 15-metre mark.

Further insights:

Breaststroke Exception: The rules for Breaststroke are much stricter; swimmers are allowed only one single dolphin kick downward during the underwater pullout phase after the start and each turn, after which they must transition strictly to the traditional breaststroke breast-kick (frog kick).

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding the provisions of the Anti-Defection Law (Tenth Schedule) is factually incorrect?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन एंटी-डिफेक्शन कानून (दसवां अनुसूची) के प्रावधानों के संबंध में तथ्यात्मक रूप से गलत है?

options.label: A
options.text: An independent member of a House becomes disqualified to remain a member if they formally join any political party after their election.
options.text_hi: एक स्वतंत्र सदस्य जो चुनाव के बाद किसी भी राजनीतिक पार्टी में औपचारिक रूप से शामिल होता है, वह सदस्य बने रहने के लिए अयोग्य हो जाता है।

options.label: B
options.text: A nominated member of a House is disqualified if they join any political party after the expiry of a six-month window from the date they take their seat.
options.text_hi: एक नामित सदस्य अयोग्य हो जाता है यदि वे अपनी सीट ग्रहण करने की तारीख से छह महीने की अवधि समाप्त होने के बाद किसी भी राजनीतिक पार्टी में शामिल होते हैं।

options.label: C
options.text: The final power to decide on questions of disqualification on the ground of defection rests with the President of India, acting in consultation with the Election Commission.
options.text_hi: देशद्रोह के आधार पर अयोग्यता के प्रश्नों पर अंतिम निर्णय लेने का अधिकार भारत के राष्ट्रपति के पास है, जो चुनाव आयोग से परामर्श करके कार्य करते हैं।

options.label: D
options.text: The Supreme Court in the Kihoto Hollohan case (1992) ruled that the decision of the Speaker or Chairman under the Tenth Schedule is subject to judicial review.
options.text_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने किहोतो होल्लोहन मामले (1992) में निर्णय दिया कि दसवें अनुसूची के तहत स्पीकर या अध्यक्ष का निर्णय न्यायिक समीक्षा के अधीन है।

questions.correct_text: The final power to decide on questions of disqualification on the ground of defection rests with the President of India, acting in consultation with the Election Commission.
questions.solution:
Option (c) is incorrect: The power to decide on disqualification under the Tenth Schedule rests entirely with the Presiding Officer of the concerned House (the Speaker of Lok Sabha/Assembly or Chairman of Rajya Sabha/Council), not the President of India. (The President decides on standard disqualifications under Article 103 on the advice of the Election Commission).

Other options are accurate descriptions of the rules governing independent members, nominated members, and the scope of judicial review under the Tenth Schedule.

Further insights:

Split Exception Removed: Originally, the Tenth Schedule allowed an exemption if one-third of a party's lawmakers split. However, the 91st Constitutional Amendment Act (2003) deleted this provision. Now, a merger is only valid if at least two-thirds of the members of the legislature party agree to join another party.

questions.question:
Match List-I (Major Rivers of India) with List-II (Their Respective Tributaries) and select the correct answer using the codes given below:

List-IList-II
A. IndusI. Subansiri, Manas, Dhansiri
B. BrahmaputraII. Shyok, Gilgit, Zanskar
C. GodavariIII. Tungabhadra, Koyna, Bhima
D. KrishnaIV. Penganga, Indravati, Manjira
questions.question_hi:
सूची-I (भारत की प्रमुख नदियाँ) को सूची-II (उनकी संबंधित सहायक नदियाँ) के साथ मिलाएं और नीचे दिए गए कोड का उपयोग करके सही उत्तर चुनें:

A. सिंधुI. सुबनसिरी, मानस, धनसिरी
B. ब्रह्मपुत्रII. श्योक, गिलगित, ज़ांस्कर
C. गोदावरीIII. तुंगभद्रा, कोयना, भीमा
D. कृष्णाIV. पेंगंगा, इंद्रावती, मंजिरा
questions.solution:
A-2 (Indus): The Shyok, Gilgit, and Zanskar are critical high-altitude Himalayan tributaries that feed the main channel of the Indus river system in Ladakh and Jammu & Kashmir before it crosses into Pakistan.

B-1 (Brahmaputra): The Subansiri, Manas, and Dhansiri are major tributaries that join the Brahmaputra within the Assam valley, contributing to its massive water flow and sediment load.

C-4 (Godavari): The Penganga, Indravati, and Manjira are key tributaries of the Godavari river, draining large parts of Maharashtra, Telangana, and Chhattisgarh.

D-3 (Krishna): The Tungabhadra, Koyna, and Bhima are vital right and left-bank tributaries feeding the Krishna river basin across Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh.

Further insights:

Antecedent Rivers: Both the Indus and the Brahmaputra are classic examples of antecedent drainage systems; they existed before the Himalayan uplift and carved deep, vertical gorges through the mountain ranges as they rose.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the invocation of National Emergency under Article 352 of the Constitution of India:

1. A proclamation of National Emergency can be made by the President only on the basis of a written recommendation sent by the entire Union Cabinet, not on the advice of the Prime Minister alone.

2. The proclamation must be approved by both Houses of Parliament within a period of two months from the date of its issue by a simple majority vote.

3. While a National Emergency is in operation, the fundamental rights under Articles 20 and 21 cannot be suspended under any circumstances.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत के संविधान के अनुच्छेद 352 के तहत राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल की घोषणा के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल की घोषणा केवल राष्ट्रपति द्वारा की जा सकती है, जो पूरे केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल की लिखित सिफारिश पर आधारित हो, केवल प्रधानमंत्री की सलाह पर नहीं।

2. इस घोषणा को इसके जारी होने की तारीख से दो महीने के भीतर संसद के दोनों सदनों द्वारा साधारण बहुमत से अनुमोदित किया जाना चाहिए।

3. जब राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल लागू होता है, तो अनुच्छेद 20 और 21 के तहत मौलिक अधिकार किसी भी परिस्थिति में निलंबित नहीं किए जा सकते।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: The 44th Constitutional Amendment Act (1978) introduced this safeguard to prevent any unilateral invocation of emergency powers by a Prime Minister without the formal written consensus of the Cabinet.

Statement 2 is incorrect: The proclamation must be approved by both Houses of Parliament within one month (not two months) from its date of issue, and it requires a special majority (a majority of the total membership of each house and a majority of not less than two-thirds of the members present and voting), not a simple majority.

Statement 3 is correct: The 44th Amendment also explicitly restricted Article 359, declaring that the right to protection in respect of conviction for offenses (Article 20) and the right to life and personal liberty (Article 21) remain enforceable even during an active National Emergency.

Further insights:

Grounds: A National Emergency can be declared on three specific grounds: War, External Aggression, or Armed Rebellion. The term "Armed Rebellion" replaced the vague phrase "Internal Disturbance" via the 44th Amendment to prevent political misuse.

questions.question:
Consider the following four statements regarding the phylum Chordata:

1. All chordates possess a dorsal, solid, and double nerve cord at some stage of their life cycle.

2. In urochordates, the notochord extends from head to tail region and is persistent throughout their life.

3. Vertebrates possess a muscular ventral heart with two, three, or four chambers.

4. All vertebrates are chordates, but all chordates are not vertebrates.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
फाइलम कॉर्डाटा के संबंध में निम्नलिखित चार कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. सभी कॉर्डेट्स के जीवन चक्र के किसी न किसी चरण में एक पृष्ठीय, ठोस, और दोहरी तंत्रिका रस्सी होती है।

2. यूरोकोर्डेट्स में, नोटोकॉर्ड सिर से पूंछ क्षेत्र तक फैला होता है और उनके जीवन भर स्थायी रहता है।

3. कशेरुकों में दो, तीन, या चार कक्षों वाला एक मांसपेशीय उदर हृदय होता है।

4. सभी कशेरुकी कॉर्डेट्स होते हैं, लेकिन सभी कॉर्डेट्स कशेरुकी नहीं होते।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is incorrect: Chordates actually possess a dorsal, hollow, and single nerve cord (not solid and double; solid/double nerve cords are characteristic of non-chordates like annelids and arthropods).

Statement 2 is incorrect: In urochordates (tunicates), the notochord is present only in the larval tail and degenerates in adults. The description given in the statement actually applies to cephalochordates.

Statement 3 is correct: Vertebrates feature a ventral, muscular heart that evolves from two chambers (fishes) to three (amphibians/reptiles) and four chambers (birds/mammals).

Statement 4 is correct: This is a classic biological axiom. Vertebrates are a subphylum of Chordata; they possess a notochord during the embryonic period, which is later replaced by a vertebral column. Other subphyla (Urochordata and Cephalochordata) are chordates but not vertebrates.

questions.question:
Read the following statements regarding banking sector terms and regulatory frameworks in India:

1. Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) is the metric tracking a bank's available capital expressed as a percentage of its risk-weighted credit exposures, designed to absorb a reasonable measure of losses before insolvency.

2. Under the SARFAESI Act of 2002, commercial banks can auction residential or commercial properties of defaulting borrowers to recover loans without the mandatory prior intervention of a civil court.

3. A Non-Performing Asset (NPA) is formally classified if the principal or interest payment on a standard commercial loan remains overdue for a period exceeding 45 days.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत में बैंकिंग क्षेत्र की शर्तों और नियामक ढांचों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़ें:

1. कैपिटल एडेक्वेसी रेशियो (CAR) वह मीट्रिक है जो एक बैंक की उपलब्ध पूंजी को उसके जोखिम-भारित क्रेडिट एक्सपोज़र के प्रतिशत के रूप में दर्शाता है, जिसे दिवालियापन से पहले उचित हानि को सहन करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है।

2. 2002 के SARFAESI अधिनियम के तहत, वाणिज्यिक बैंक डिफ़ॉल्ट करने वाले उधारकर्ताओं की आवासीय या वाणिज्यिक संपत्तियों की नीलामी कर सकते हैं ताकि ऋण वसूल किया जा सके, बिना नागरिक न्यायालय के अनिवार्य पूर्व हस्तक्षेप के।

3. एक गैर-निष्पादित संपत्ति (NPA) को औपचारिक रूप से वर्गीकृत किया जाता है यदि एक मानक वाणिज्यिक ऋण पर मूलधन या ब्याज भुगतान 45 दिनों से अधिक की अवधि के लिए बकाया रहता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: CAR (also known as Capital to Risk-Weighted Assets Ratio - CRAR) ensures that banks maintain a safety cushion of capital to handle asset shocks, as mandated by the international Basel accords and regulated by the RBI.

Statement 2 is correct: The Securitisation and Reconstruction of Financial Assets and Enforcement of Security Interest (SARFAESI) Act empowers financial institutions to seize and auction collateralized assets directly if a borrower defaults, significantly speeding up non-performing asset recovery.

Statement 3 is incorrect: In India, a loan asset is classified as an NPA if the interest or installment of principal remains overdue for a period exceeding 90 days, not 45 days, for standard commercial loans (with specific seasonal rules for agricultural credit).

Further insights:

NPA Categories: NPAs are further classified based on the period for which the asset has remained non-performing: Sub-standard (less than or equal to 12 months), Doubtful (exceeding 12 months), and Loss assets (identified as uncollectible by the bank or auditors).

questions.question: According to the Sustainable Development Goals - National Indicator Framework (NIF), 2026 released by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI), how many national SDG indicators are included to monitor progress across all 17 Sustainable Development Goals?
questions.question_hi: सतत विकास लक्ष्यों - राष्ट्रीय संकेतक ढांचा (NIF), 2026 के अनुसार, जो कि सांख्यिकी और कार्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन मंत्रालय (MoSPI) द्वारा जारी किया गया है, सभी 17 सतत विकास लक्ष्यों में प्रगति की निगरानी के लिए कितने राष्ट्रीय SDG संकेतक शामिल हैं?
questions.solution:
Highlights of the Sustainable Development Goals-National Indicator Framework Progress Report, 2026:

The National Indicator Framework (NIF), 2026 consists of 277 national SDG indicators, covering all 17 Sustainable Development Goals. Some of the major highlights of the progress report reflecting India's continued progress towards achieving the Sustainable Development Goals are:

The proportion of population covered by social protection systems/floors increased from'22.0% in 2016'to'65.3% in 2026.

Plant genetic resources conserved increased from'4,32,564 in 2014'15 to 4,91,864 in 2025'26, animal genetic resources rose from'1,40,364 to 3,61,794, and fish genetic resources more than doubled from'47 to 105, reflecting sustained progress in the conservation of genetic resources for food and agriculture.

Maternal Mortality Ratio declined from'122 per 100,000 live births during 2015-17'to'87 during 2022-24.

The Sex Ratio at Birth (in Per 1,000 male live births) improved from'896 females per 1,000'males in'2015'17 to 918'in'2022'24, reflecting a positive trend towards a more balanced gender ratio at birth.

Installed renewable energy generating capacity in the country increased from'64.04 watts per capita in'2014-15 to 193.36 watts per capita in 2025'26, reflecting a threefold expansion in renewable energy capacity over the period.

The unemployment rate declined from'6.1% in 2017-18'to'3.1% in 2025.

questions.question:
Given below are the Assertion and Reason. Choose the correct option:

Assertion (A): An aggressive expansion of open market operations (OMO) involving the purchase of government securities by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) tends to lower market interest rates.

Reason (R): The purchase of government bonds injects fresh liquidity into the banking system, increasing the loanable funds available with commercial banks.
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दिए गए हैं कथन और कारण। सही विकल्प चुनें:

कथन (A): भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI) द्वारा सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों की खरीद में खुले बाजार संचालन (OMO) का आक्रामक विस्तार बाजार ब्याज दरों को कम करने की प्रवृत्ति रखता है।

कारण (R): सरकारी बांड की खरीद बैंकिंग प्रणाली में नई तरलता डालती है, जिससे वाणिज्यिक बैंकों के पास उपलब्ध ऋण योग्य धन में वृद्धि होती है।

options.label: A
options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R सही हैं, और R, A की सही व्याख्या है।

options.label: B
options.text: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R सही हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options.label: C
options.text: A is true, but R is false.
options.text_hi: A सही है, लेकिन R गलत है।

options.label: D
options.text: A is false, but R is true.
options.text_hi: A गलत है, लेकिन R सही है।

questions.correct_text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
questions.solution:
Assertion (A) is true: When the RBI buys government securities from the open market, it pays commercial banks cash in exchange for bonds. This increases the aggregate money supply in the banking system, pushing interest rates downward due to the ease of liquidity.

Reason (R) is true and perfectly explains the assertion: With more cash reserves (liquidity) on hand and lower demand friction, commercial banks lower their lending rates to encourage businesses and individuals to borrow funds, driving economic credit expansion.

Further insights:

Sterilization: If the economy experiences excessive foreign capital inflows that threaten to cause high inflation, the RBI does the opposite-it sells government bonds via OMO to suck out excess liquidity from the system, a process known as sterilization.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Sattriya classical dance form:

1. It was introduced in the 15th century CE by the great Vaishnavite saint Srimanta Sankardeva as a powerful medium for the propagation of the Bhakti movement in Assam.

2. The dance is performed exclusively inside monastery prayer halls called Sattras by male monks known as Bhokots as part of daily rituals.

3. It is structurally based on Ankiya Naat (one-act plays written in the Brajavali language) and incorporates musical compositions called Borgeets.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
सत्रिया शास्त्रीय नृत्य रूप के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. इसे 15वीं शताब्दी ईस्वी में महान वैष्णव संत श्रीमंत शंकरदेव द्वारा असम में भक्ति आंदोलन के प्रचार के लिए एक शक्तिशाली माध्यम के रूप में प्रस्तुत किया गया था।

2. यह नृत्य विशेष रूप से मठ के प्रार्थना कक्षों में जिसे सत्र कहा जाता है, पुरुष भिक्षुओं द्वारा दैनिक अनुष्ठानों के हिस्से के रूप में किया जाता है जिन्हें भोकट कहा जाता है।

3. यह संरचनात्मक रूप से अंकिया नाट (ब्रजावली भाषा में लिखे गए एक-अंक के नाटa) पर आधारित है और इसमें बोरगीत नामक संगीत रचनाएँ शामिल हैं।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Sattriya was created by the polymath saint Srimanta Sankardeva in Assam to popularize Vaishnavism through performing arts. It was recognized as an official classical dance form by Sangeet Natak Akademi in 2000.

Statement 2 is incorrect: While Sattriya originated and evolved as a ritual dance performed inside monasteries (Sattras) by male celibate monks (Bhokots), it has long transitioned to the modern proscenium stage and is now performed widely by both male and female dancers across the globe.

Statement 3 is correct: The dance narratives are drawn from Ankiya Naat (traditional dance-dramas composed in Brajavali, an artificial literary language blending Assamese and Maithili) and utilize Borgeets, which are devotional songs set to specific classical ragas and talas.

Further insights:

Instruments: The primary musical instruments accompanying a Sattriya performance are the Khol (a two-sided clay drum), Tala (cymbals), and the bamboo flute.

questions.question: The Government of India notified revised wage rates under the Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) [VB-GRAM(G)] Act, 2025, effective nationwide from 1 July 2026. What is the interim base wage rate per day introduced to ensure that no notified wage under the programme falls below this benchmark?
questions.question_hi: भारत सरकार ने विकसित भारत - रोजगार और आजीविका मिशन (ग्रामीण) [VB-GRAM(G)] अधिनियम, 2025 के तहत संशोधित मजदूरी दरों की अधिसूचना जारी की, जो 1 जुलाई 2026 से पूरे देश में प्रभावी होगी। इस कार्यक्रम के तहत कोई भी अधिसूचित मजदूरी इस मानक से नीचे न गिरे, इसके लिए प्रति दिन क्या अंतरिम आधार मजदूरी दर लागू की गई है?
questions.solution:
Rs. 300 Becomes the New National Benchmark for Rural Wages under VB- G RAM G.

The Government of India has notified the revised wage rates payable under the Viksit Bharat ' Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin): VB- G RAM G Act, 2025, with effect from 1 July 2026, coinciding with the nationwide commencement of the Act. The revised notification marks a landmark step towards strengthening rural livelihoods by ensuring higher wages, reducing regional disparities and reinforcing the dignity of labour. A defining feature of the notification is the introduction of a Rs. 300 interim base wage rate, ensuring that no notified wage under the programme is below Rs. 300 per day. Historic Wage Enhancement Across the Country

The revised wage notification provides for an increase in wage rates across all States, Union Territories and wage regions, making it one of the most significant wage revisions under the national rural employment programme.

The key highlights are:

Wage rates increased across all 34 States/UTs and wage regions.

21 States/UTs and administrative units have been brought up to the new Rs. 300 interim base wage rate.

The national average notified wage has increased from Rs. 98.8 per day under MGNREGA to Rs. 327.4 per day under VB'G RAM G, representing an average increase of Rs. 28.6 per day.

The average percentage increase across the country exceeds 10 per cent.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the physiological features and ecological dynamics of the Western Ghats:

1. The Western Ghats form an unbroken continuous mountain wall parallel to the Arabian Sea coast, which can only be crossed through specific low gaps or passes such as Thal Ghat, Bhor Ghat, and Palghat Gap.

2. The height of the Western Ghats increases progressively from South to North, culminating in the highest peak, Kalsubai, in Maharashtra.

3. The northern section of the Western Ghats (up to Goa) is composed primarily of basaltic lava sheets from the Deccan Trap vulcanism, supporting semi-evergreen and moist deciduous forests.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
पश्चिमी घाटों की शारीरिक विशेषताओं और पारिस्थितिकीय गतिशीलता के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. पश्चिमी घाट अरब सागर तट के समानांतर एक अविरल सतत पर्वतीय दीवार बनाते हैं, जिसे केवल थाल घाट, भोर घाट, और पालघाट गैप जैसे विशिष्ट निम्न दरारों या दर्रों के माध्यम से पार किया जा सकता है।

2. पश्चिमी घाट की ऊंचाई दक्षिण से उत्तर की ओर क्रमिक रूप से बढ़ती है, जो महाराष्ट्र में सबसे ऊंचे शिखर, कालसुबाई, पर समाप्त होती है।

3. पश्चिमी घाट का उत्तरी भाग (गोवा तa) मुख्य रूप से डेक्कन ट्रैप ज्वालामुखीयता से बने बेसाल्टिक लावा शीट्स से बना है, जो अर्ध-हमेशा हरे और नम पर्णपाती जंगलों का समर्थन करता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Unlike the discontinuous and heavily dissected Eastern Ghats, the Western Ghats are a continuous structural escarpment. Access between the coast and the interior plateau is limited to major natural passes like Thal Ghat (Mumbai-Nashik), Bhor Ghat (Mumbai-Pune), and Palghat Gap.

Statement 2 is incorrect: The elevation of the Western Ghats increases progressively from North to South, not South to North. The highest peaks are located in the southern section, led by Anamudi (2,695 metres) in Kerala's Anaimalai Hills. Kalsubai is the highest peak of Maharashtra but is significantly lower.

Statement 3 is correct: The northern Western Ghats are made of horizontal basalt layers from the Cretaceous volcanic activity that created the Deccan Trap terrain, contrasting with the ancient metamorphic gneisses found in the southern ranges of Karnataka and Kerala.

Further insights:

UNESCO Designation: The entire Western Ghats region is recognized globally as one of the world's eight "hottest hotspots" of biological diversity and was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2012.

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding the phenomenon of 'Western Disturbances' and its impact on Indian agriculture and weather is factually accurate?
questions.question_hi: 'पश्चिमी विक्षोभ' की घटना और इसके भारतीय कृषि और मौसम पर प्रभाव के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन तथ्यात्मक रूप से सही है?

options.label: A
options.text: They are intense tropical cyclones originating over the Bay of Bengal that travel westward across the central plains of India during the peak summer months.
options.text_hi: वे बंगाल की खाड़ी में उत्पन्न होने वाले तीव्र उष्णकटिबंधीय चक्रवात हैं जो गर्मियों के चरम महीनों के दौरान भारत के मध्य मैदानों के पार पश्चिम की ओर यात्रा करते हैं।

options.label: B
options.text: They are non-tropical extra-tropical storms originating over the Mediterranean Sea that bring sudden winter rain and snowfall to northwestern India, driven eastward by the subtropical westerly jet stream.
options.text_hi: वे भूमध्य सागर में उत्पन्न होने वाले गैर-उष्णकटिबंधीय अतिरिक्त-उष्णकटिबंधीय तूफान हैं जो उप-उष्णकटिबंधीय पश्चिमी जेट स्ट्रीम द्वारा पूर्व की ओर प्रेरित होकर उत्तर-पश्चिमी भारत में अचानक सर्दियों की बारिश और हिमपात लाते हैं।

options.label: C
options.text: They represent localized downbursts of dust storms originating in the Thar Desert that sharply lower evening temperatures across northern plains during the month of May.
options.text_hi: वे थार रेगिस्तान में उत्पन्न होने वाले धूल भरे तूफानों के स्थानीय डाउनबर्स्ट का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं जो मई के महीने में उत्तरी मैदानों में शाम के तापमान को तीव्र रूप से कम कर देते हैं।

options.label: D
options.text: They are reverse wind currents from the Indian Ocean that mark the early arrival of the retreating northeast monsoon along the Konkan coast in October.
options.text_hi: वे भारतीय महासागर से आने वाली विपरीत वायु धाराएं हैं जो अक्टूबर में कोंकण तट के साथ पीछे हटते उत्तर-पूर्वी मानसून के प्रारंभिक आगमन को दर्शाती हैं।

questions.correct_text: They are non-tropical extra-tropical storms originating over the Mediterranean Sea that bring sudden winter rain and snowfall to northwestern India, driven eastward by the subtropical westerly jet stream.
questions.solution:
Option (b) is correct: Western Disturbances are extra-tropical cyclones that form over the Mediterranean Sea or Caspian Sea. They travel to South Asia embedded in the upper-atmosphere Subtropical Westerly Jet Stream. When they strike the Himalayas, they cause winter precipitation-heavy snow in Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand, and moderate rain in Punjab, Haryana, and western Uttar Pradesh.

Options (a), (c), and (d) are incorrect because they mistake the geographical origin, atmospheric classification, and seasonal timing of the phenomenon completely.

Further insights:

Rabi Crops: The winter rain brought by Western Disturbances is of immense economic value to Indian agriculture, as it directly waters the un-irrigated Rabi crops, particularly wheat, across the breadbasket states of Northwest India.

questions.question: Who is the current President of Commonwealth Sport?
questions.question_hi: कॉमनवेल्थ स्पोर्ट के वर्तमान अध्यक्ष कौन हैं?
questions.solution:
Dr. Donald Rukare was officially elected unopposed as President of Commonwealth Sport on November 26, 2025, in Glasgow. He made history as the first African leader to hold this position.

Context:

The Commonwealth Games will return to India after a gap of 20 years, with Ahmedabad hosting the 2030 centenary edition. Commonwealth Sport (CS) made the announcement from Glasgow through a physical-cum-virtual press conference after its General Assembly ratified the Executive Board's October 15 proposal in favour of Ahmedabad ahead of the Nigerian capital city of Abuja. The opportunity would give a boost to India's ambition to bid for the 2036 Olympics. CS president Dr. Donald Rukare said the decision followed a 'robust evaluation process.' The Indian delegation, including Gujarat Sports Minister Harsh Sanghavi and Indian Olympic Association president P.T. Usha, underlined that the Games would be athlete-centric and sustainable.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the physiological functions of plant hormones (Phytohormones):

1. Auxins are primarily responsible for apical dominance, phototropism, and cell elongation at the growing tips of stems and roots.

2. Ethylene is a gaseous plant hormone that accelerates fruit ripening and triggers abscission (shedding) of leaves and flowers.

3. Abscisic Acid (ABA) acts as a powerful growth promoter that stimulates seed germination and induces stomatal opening during high humidity.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
पौधों के हार्मोनों (फाइटोहॉर्मोन्स) के शारीरिक कार्यों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. ऑक्सिन मुख्य रूप से शीर्ष वर्चस्व, प्रकाश की ओर झुकाव (फोटोट्रोपिज्म), और तनों और जड़ों के बढ़ते सिरे पर कोशिका लम्बाईकरण के लिए जिम्मेदार होते हैं।

2. एथिलीन एक गैसीय पौध हार्मोन है जो फल के पकने की प्रक्रिया को तेज करता है और पत्तियों और फूलों के झड़ने (एब्सीशन) को प्रेरित करता है।

3. एब्सिसिक एसिड (एबीए) एक शक्तिशाली वृद्धि प्रवर्तक के रूप में कार्य करता है जो बीज अंकुरण को उत्तेजित करता है और उच्च आर्द्रता के दौरान स्टोमेटा के खुलने को प्रेरित करता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Auxin (such as Indole-3-acetic acid) promotes the elongation of cells in shoots and is responsible for phototropic bending toward light sources. It also suppresses the growth of lateral buds (apical dominance).

Statement 2 is correct: Ethylene gas acts as an aging and ripening hormone in plants, breaking down cell walls to soften fruits and signaling the plant to drop old leaves.

Statement 3 is incorrect: Abscisic Acid (ABA) is a plant growth inhibitor, often called the "stress hormone." It inhibits seed germination (maintaining dormancy until favorable conditions arise) and induces the rapid closing of stomata during water stress to minimize water loss through transpiration, acting opposite to growth promoters like Gibberellins.

Further insights:

Cytokinins: Cytokinins are plant hormones that promote active cell division (cytokinesis) and delay leaf senescence (aging). They are found in high concentrations in areas of rapid growth, such as coconut milk and developing fruits.

questions.question:
Read the following statements regarding the administrative and land revenue reforms of Sher Shah Suri:

Statement I: Sher Shah Suri introduced a land measurement system based on the Sikandari gaz and classified land into three categories based on productivity to determine a uniform tax rate fixed at one-half of the average produce.

Statement II: He introduced the Patta (title deed) and Qabuliyat (deed of agreement) to formalize the legal rights and obligations between the state and the peasantry.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.question_hi:
शेर शाह सूरी के प्रशासनिक और भूमि राजस्व सुधारों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़ें:

कथन I: शेर शाह सूरी ने सिकंदरी गज पर आधारित भूमि मापन प्रणाली शुरू की और उत्पादकता के आधार पर भूमि को तीन श्रेणियों में वर्गीकृत किया ताकि औसत उपज के आधे हिस्से के बराबर एक समान कर दर निर्धारित की जा सके।

कथन II: उन्होंने पट्टा (टाइटल डीड) और क़बूलियत (समझौते का दस्तावेज़) पेश किए ताकि राज्य और कृषक वर्ग के बीच कानूनी अधिकारों और दायित्वों को औपचारिक बनाया जा सके।

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statements I and II are correct
options.text_hi: दोनों कथन I और II सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Neither Statement I nor II is correct
options.text_hi: न तो कथन I सही है और न ही II सही है

questions.solution:
Statement I is incorrect: While Sher Shah Suri did introduce a land measurement system utilizing the Sikandari gaz (32 digits) and a rope-based measurement system (Jarib), his tax rate was typically fixed at one-third (1/3rd) of the average produce, not one-half, except in a few fertile regions like Multan where it was lower.

Statement II is correct: Sher Shah introduced the system of Patta (a document mentioning the area of land, its type, and the revenue the peasant had to pay) and Qabuliyat (the peasant's written agreement accepting the terms of the Patta), which brought high structural clarity and reduced exploitation by middlemen.

Further insights:

Currency Reforms: Sher Shah Suri is credited with introducing the silver coin called the Rupia (weighing 178 grains) and copper coins called Dam, which remained the standard currency models throughout the Mughal period and laid the foundation for the modern Indian Rupee.

Infrastructure: He reconstructed and extended the ancient royal highway, historically known as the Uttarapath, which came to be known as the Grand Trunk Road, connecting Calcutta (now Kolkata) to Peshawar.

questions.question: Which of the following statements accurately explains why high-frequency Ultraviolet (UV) radiation is much more effective at causing the Photoelectric Effect than low-frequency Infrared (IR) radiation?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही ढंग से बताता है कि उच्च-आवृत्ति पराबैंगनी (UV) विकिरण फोटोइलेक्ट्रिक प्रभाव उत्पन्न करने में निम्न-आवृत्ति अवरक्त (IR) विकिरण की तुलना में बहुत अधिक प्रभावी क्यों है?

options.label: A
options.text: UV radiation travels significantly faster through a vacuum than IR radiation, hitting the metal surface with greater kinetic force.
options.text_hi: यूवी विकिरण निर्वात में आईआर विकिरण की तुलना में काफी तेज़ी से यात्रा करता है, धातु की सतह से अधिक गतिज बल के साथ टकराता है।

options.label: B
options.text: According to quantum theory, the energy of a photon is directly proportional to its frequency (E = hν); UV photons possess energy exceeding the metal's threshold work function, whereas IR photons do not.
options.text_hi: क्वांटम सिद्धांत के अनुसार, फोटॉन की ऊर्जा उसकी आवृत्ति के सीधे अनुपाती होती है (E = hν); यूवी फोटॉन में धातु के थ्रेशोल्ड वर्क फंक्शन से अधिक ऊर्जा होती है, जबकि आईआर फोटॉन में नहीं होती।

options.label: C
options.text: IR radiation has a shorter wavelength than UV radiation, causing its energy to reflect completely off the surface electrons without absorption.
options.text_hi: आईआर विकिरण की तरंगदैर्ध्य यूवी विकिरण से छोटी होती है, जिससे इसकी ऊर्जा सतह के इलेक्ट्रॉनों से पूरी तरह परावर्तित हो जाती है बिना अवशोषित हुए।

options.label: D
options.text: UV radiation contains a significantly higher total number of photons per second than IR radiation at equivalent light intensities, increasing the statistical probability of a collision.
options.text_hi: यूवी विकिरण में समान प्रकाश तीव्रता पर आईआर विकिरण की तुलना में प्रति सेकंड काफी अधिक फोटॉनों की कुल संख्या होती है, जिससे टकराव की सांख्यिकीय संभावना बढ़ जाती है।

questions.correct_text: According to quantum theory, the energy of a photon is directly proportional to its frequency (E = hν); UV photons possess energy exceeding the metal's threshold work function, whereas IR photons do not.
questions.solution:
Option (b) is correct: Einstein's photoelectric equation states that the maximum kinetic energy of an emitted electron is KEmax=hν−Φ , where hν is the incoming photon energy and Φ is the work function (the minimum energy required to eject an electron). Because UV radiation has a higher frequency (ν) than IR, its individual photons carry sufficient energy to break the atomic binding forces. IR photons lack this minimum quantum threshold, meaning no electrons are released regardless of light intensity or duration.

Option (a) is incorrect because all electromagnetic waves travel at the exact same speed in a vacuum (c).

Option (c) incorrectly states the wavelength relationship (IR has longer wavelengths than UV).

Option (d) is incorrect because photon energy, not photon count (intensity), determines whether emission occurs.

Further insights:

Threshold Frequency: The minimum frequency required to trigger the photoelectric effect is called the threshold frequency (ν0). If incoming light falls below this specific frequency, it will fail to eject electrons even if left shining on the metal for days.

questions.question:
Given below are the Assertion and Reason. Choose the correct option:

Assertion (A): When an iron nail is immersed in an aqueous solution of Copper Sulfate (CuSO4), the blue color of the solution slowly fades and turns light green.

Reason (R): Iron is chemically more reactive than copper on the reactivity series, resulting in a displacement reaction that yields Iron Sulfate (FeSO4) and precipitates solid copper.
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दिए गए हैं कथन और कारण। सही विकल्प चुनें:

कथन (A): जब एक लोहे की कील को तांबे के सल्फेट (CuSO4) के जलीय घोल में डुबोया जाता है, तो घोल का नीला रंग धीरे-धीरे फीका पड़ जाता है और हल्का हरा हो जाता है।

कारण (R): लोहे की रासायनिक सक्रियता तांबे से अधिक होती है, जिसके कारण विस्थापन प्रतिक्रिया होती है जो लोहे के सल्फेट (FeSO4) का निर्माण करती है और ठोस तांबा उत्पन्न होता है।

options.label: A
options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R सही हैं, और R, A की सही व्याख्या है।

options.label: B
options.text: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R सही हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options.label: C
options.text: A is true, but R is false.
options.text_hi: A सही है, लेकिन R गलत है।

options.label: D
options.text: Both A and R are false.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R गलत हैं।

questions.correct_text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
questions.solution:
Assertion (A) is true. The initial bright blue color of the solution is due to the presence of hydrated Cu2+ ions. As the reaction proceeds, Cu2+ ions are reduced to metallic copper, while iron dissolves as Fe2+ ions, causing the solution to change from blue to light green.

Reason (R) is also true and correctly explains the assertion. The reaction is a classic single-displacement reaction:

Fe + CuSO4 → FeSO4 + Cu

Since iron is more reactive than copper (it is higher in the electrochemical activity series), iron is oxidized by losing electrons, while copper ions gain these electrons and are reduced to metallic copper.

Further Insight: This is also a redox (oxidation-reduction) reaction:

  • Oxidation: Fe → Fe2+ + 2e−

  • Reduction: Cu2+ + 2e− → Cu

Therefore, both the Assertion and the Reason are true, and the Reason correctly explains the Assertion.

questions.question: In Novemember 2025, Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated a 77-foot bronze statue of Lord Rama, recognized as the world's tallest statue of Lord Ram, at the Shree Samsthan Gokarn Partagali Jeevottam Math. In which state is this prominent Dvaita Vaishnava institution located?
questions.question_hi: नवंबर 2025 में, प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने श्री संस्थान गोकर्ण पारतागली जीवोत्तम मठ में भगवान राम की 77 फुट ऊंची कांस्य प्रतिमा का उद्घाटन किया, जिसे भगवान राम की दुनिया की सबसे ऊंची प्रतिमा के रूप में मान्यता प्राप्त है। यह प्रमुख द्वैत वैष्णव संस्था किस राज्य में स्थित है?
questions.solution: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated a towering 77-foot bronze statue of Lord Rama at the Shree Samsthan Gokarn Partagali Jeevottam Math in Goa. The unveiling comes as part of the Math's 550th anniversary celebrations, known as the Sardha Panchashatamanotsava, in which the Prime Minister is participating during his Goa visit. It is one of the oldest and most prominent Dvaita Vaishnava institutions in India. The ceremony marked a milestone moment for the math, which belongs to the Gaud Saraswat Brahmin community and has served as a central Vaishnava spiritual seat for centuries. Alongside the statue, PM Modi inaugurated the Ramayana Theme Park, released a special postal stamp and a commemorative coin. The statue itself, crafted by legendary sculptor Ram V Sutar, known for designing the Statue of Unity, has been presented as the world's tallest statue of Lord Ram. Modi described it as a symbol of unity, devotion and India's cultural continuity.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the structural features and payloads of ISRO's Aditya-L1 solar observatory mission:

1. Aditya-L1 is India's first dedicated space-based solar mission, placed in a halo orbit around the Lagrangian Point 1 (L1) of the Sun-Earth system, approximately 1.5 million kilometers from Earth.

2. The spacecraft carries seven distinct payloads, of which the Visible Emission Line Coronagraph (VELC) is the primary payload designed to study the solar corona and Coronal Mass Ejections (CMEs).

3. Because Lagrangian Point 1 sits directly between the Earth and the Sun, the spacecraft faces periodic eclipses when the Earth blocks its view of the Sun, requiring heavy battery backups.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
ISRO के आदित्य-L1 सौर वेधशाला मिशन की संरचनात्मक विशेषताओं और पेलोड के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. आदित्य-L1 भारत का पहला समर्पित अंतरिक्ष-आधारित सौर मिशन है, जो सूर्य-धरती प्रणाली के लैग्रेंजियन पॉइंट 1 (L1) के चारों ओर एक हेलो कक्षा में स्थित है, जो पृथ्वी से लगभग 1.5 मिलियन किलोमीटर दूर है।

2. अंतरिक्ष यान में सात अलग-अलग पेलोड हैं, जिनमें से विजिबल एमिशन लाइन कोरोनोग्राफ (VELC) मुख्य पेलोड है जिसे सौर कोरोना और कोरोनल मास इजेक्शंस (CMEs) का अध्ययन करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है।

3. क्योंकि लैग्रेंजियन पॉइंट 1 सीधे पृथ्वी और सूर्य के बीच स्थित है, इसलिए जब पृथ्वी सूर्य की दृष्टि को ब्लॉक करती है तो अंतरिक्ष यान को आवधिक ग्रहणों का सामना करना पड़ता है, जिसके लिए भारी बैटरी बैकअप की आवश्यकता होती है।

उपरोक्त दिए गए कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Aditya-L1 was successfully launched in September 2023 and injected into its destination halo orbit around L1 in January 2024 to observe solar phenomena.

Statement 2 is correct: Out of its seven scientific payloads (four remote sensing and three in-situ), the VELC payload designed by the Indian Institute of Astrophysics is the most critical instrument, engineered to image the solar corona very close to the solar disk.

Statement 3 is incorrect: The defining characteristic of positioning a satellite at Lagrangian Point 1 (L1) is that it provides a continuous, unobstructed view of the Sun without any occultation or eclipses. The gravitational balance at L1 allows the satellite to stay fixed relative to the Earth and Sun, ensuring uninterrupted solar monitoring.

Further insights:

Other Payloads: Other key instruments on Aditya-L1 include SUIT (Solar Ultraviolet Imaging Telescope), ASPEX (Aditya Solar wind Particle Experiment), and PAPA (Plasma Analyser Package for Aditya), which collect data on solar winds, magnetic fields, and space weather dynamics.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the ecological process of Cultural Eutrophication in freshwater bodies:

1. It is initiated by the heavy runoff of synthetic fertilizers containing nitrates and phosphates into water bodies, causing an explosive proliferation of phytoplankton known as an algal bloom.

2. The massive drop in Dissolved Oxygen (DO) levels that kills aquatic life occurs primarily because the dense algal mat physically blocks atmospheric oxygen from dissolving into the water surface.

3. The Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD) of the water body increases sharply during a advanced eutrophication phase, serving as an index of high organic pollution.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
ताजे पानी के जलाशयों में सांस्कृतिक पोषण संबंधी पारिस्थितिक प्रक्रिया के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. यह नाइट्रेट और फॉस्फेट युक्त सिंथेटिक उर्वरकों के भारी बहाव द्वारा जलाशयों में शुरू होती है, जिससे फाइटोप्लांकटन का तीव्र प्रसार होता है जिसे शैवाल फूल कहा जाता है।

2. घनिष्ठ शैवाल की चादर वायुमंडलीय ऑक्सीजन को पानी की सतह में घुलने से शारीरिक रूप से अवरुद्ध करने के कारण डूबे हुए ऑक्सीजन (DO) स्तर में भारी गिरावट होती है जो जलीय जीवन को मार देती है।

3. उन्नत पोषण चरण के दौरान जलाशय का जैव रासायनिक ऑक्सीजन मांग (BOD) तीव्र रूप से बढ़ जाता है, जो उच्च जैविक प्रदूषण का सूचक है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is correct: Nitrogen and phosphorus act as limiting nutrients in aquatic ecosystems. When dumped in excess via agricultural runoff or sewage, they over-enrich the water, causing rapid algal multiplication.

Statement 2 is incorrect: While the surface algal mat does cause minor obstruction to light and air, the primary cause of severe oxygen depletion (anoxia) is the biological decomposition process. When the massive volume of algae dies, aerobic bacteria decompose the organic matter, consuming nearly all the dissolved oxygen in the water column.

Statement 3 is correct: BOD measures the amount of oxygen required by aerobic microorganisms to decompose organic matter. A high load of dying algae means decomposers work at maximum capacity, driving up the BOD value.

Further insights:

Hypoxia: Regions of severe oxygen depletion in lakes or oceans resulting from eutrophication are termed "Dead Zones" or hypoxic zones, where normal marine life cannot survive, leading to mass fish kills.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the structural shift in India's developmental planning from the Planning Commission to NITI Aayog:

1. The Planning Commission was a statutory body established by an Act of Parliament, whereas NITI Aayog is a constitutional body created under Article 280.

2. The Planning Commission followed a centralized, 'top-down' approach to plan formulation and possessed the mandate to allocate central funds to states, whereas NITI Aayog operates on a 'bottom-up' model emphasizing cooperative federalism.

3. The Governing Council of NITI Aayog includes the Chief Ministers of all States and the Lieutenant Governors of Union Territories, establishing a shared national development agenda.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.question_hi:
भारत की विकासात्मक योजना में योजना आयोग से नीति आयोग तक संरचनात्मक बदलाव के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें:

1. योजना आयोग संसद के एक अधिनियम द्वारा स्थापित एक सांविधिक निकाय था, जबकि नीति आयोग अनुच्छेद 280 के तहत निर्मित एक संवैधानिक निकाय है।

2. योजना आयोग ने योजना निर्माण के लिए केंद्रीकृत, 'टॉप-डाउन' दृष्टिकोण अपनाया और राज्यों को केंद्रीय निधि आवंटित करने का अधिकार था, जबकि नीति आयोग 'बॉटम-अप' मॉडल पर कार्य करता है जो सहकारी संघवाद पर जोर देता है।

3. नीति आयोग की संचालन परिषद में सभी राज्यों के मुख्यमंत्री और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों के उपराज्यपाल शामिल हैं, जो एक साझा राष्ट्रीय विकास एजेंडा स्थापित करता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?
questions.solution:
Statement 1 is incorrect: Both the Planning Commission (established in 1950) and NITI Aayog (established in 2015) are non-constitutional, non-statutory bodies. They were created via executive resolutions of the Union Cabinet, meaning they are extra-constitutional advisory bodies.

Statement 2 is correct: The Planning Commission designed central plans and allocated funds to ministries and state governments. NITI Aayog serves primarily as a policy think-tank and does not possess the administrative power to allocate public funds, shifting financial allocation power back to the Ministry of Finance.

Statement 3 is correct: To institutionalize cooperative federalism, NITI Aayog's structural core includes a Governing Council comprising all state Chief Ministers and UT heads, ensuring states have a direct voice in designing national strategies.

Further insights:

Full Form: NITI stands for National Institution for Transforming India. It emphasizes competitive and cooperative federalism by publishing regular performance indexes across health, education, and water management to encourage healthy developmental competition among states.

questions.question:
Given below are the Assertion and Reason. Choose the correct option regarding both statements:

Assertion (A): The Shore Temple at Mahabalipuram features structurally standalone stone masonry towers rather than being carved directly out of a single monolithic rock face.

Reason (R): Built under the patronage of Narasimhavarman II (Rajasimha) of the Pallava dynasty, it marked a transition from rock-cut architecture to structural stone temple building.
questions.question_hi:
नीचे दिए गए हैं कथन और कारण। दोनों कथनों के संबंध में सही विकल्प चुनें:

कथन (A): महाबलीपुरम का शोर मंदिर संरचनात्मक रूप से स्वतंत्र पत्थर की मसनरी टावरों की विशेषता रखता है, न कि एकल एकाकार चट्टान की सतह से सीधे तराशा गया हो।

कारण (R): पल्लव वंश के नरसिंहवर्मन द्वितीय (राजसिंह) के संरक्षण में निर्मित, इसने शिला-कट वास्तुकला से संरचनात्मक पत्थर के मंदिर निर्माण की ओर संक्रमण को चिह्नित किया।

options.label: A
options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R सही हैं, और R, A की सही व्याख्या है।

options.label: B
options.text: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
options.text_hi: दोनों A और R सही हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options.label: C
options.text: A is true, but R is false.
options.text_hi: A सही है, लेकिन R गलत है।

options.label: D
options.text: A is false, but R is true.
options.text_hi: A गलत है, लेकिन R सही है।

questions.correct_text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
questions.solution:
· World Press Freedom Day is observed on 3rd May every year globally.

· World Press Freedom Day was proclaimed by the UN General Assembly in December 1993, following the recommendation of UNESCO's General Conference.

· Since then, 3 May, the anniversary of the Declaration of Windhoek is celebrated worldwide as World Press Freedom Day.

· The theme for the year 2022: "Journalism under digital siege".

questions.question:
Which of the following statements about the Kathina festival in Buddhism are correct?

1. Kathina is celebrated at the end of the three-month Vassa (Rains Retreat) observed by monks.

2. During Kathina, lay Buddhists traditionally offer new robes and other requisites to the monastic community (Sangha).

3. The Kathina ceremony may be held at any time of the year according to the convenience of the monastery.
questions.question_hi:
बौद्ध धर्म में कथिन त्योहार के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन से कथन सही हैं?

1. कथिन तीन महीने के वस्स (वर्षा निवास) के अंत में मनाया जाता है जिसे भिक्षु पालन करते हैं।

2. कथिन के दौरान, शिष्यों द्वारा पारंपरिक रूप से नए वस्त्र और अन्य आवश्यक वस्तुएं संघ को दी जाती हैं।

3. कथिन समारोह किसी भी समय मठ की सुविधा के अनुसार आयोजित किया जा सकता है।
questions.solution:
Statement 1: Correct. Kathina marks the conclusion of the three-month Vassa, the annual rains retreat observed by monks.

Statement 2: Correct. The festival is centered on acts of generosity (dāna), with lay devotees offering robes and other necessities to the Sangha as an expression of gratitude.

Statement 3: Incorrect. Kathina is not held at any time of the year. A monastery may conduct the Kathina ceremony only during the prescribed period following the end of Vassa, traditionally within one lunar month after the retreat concludes.

questions.question: Which network infrastructure component operates explicitly at the Physical Layer (Layer 1) of the OSI model to amplify incoming electrical or optical signals to overcome attenuation over long cable distances?
questions.question_hi: कौन सा नेटवर्क इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर घटक OSI मॉडल की भौतिक परत (लेयर 1) पर स्पष्ट रूप से काम करता है ताकि लंबी केबल दूरी पर कमजोर होने वाले विद्युत या ऑप्टिकल सिग्नलों को बढ़ाया जा सके?
questions.solution:
Repeater: Correct. A repeater is a pure hardware device operating at Layer 1. It does not look at addresses; it simply receives weak electrical signals and regenerates them to extend network range.

Router: Incorrect. Routers work at the Network Layer (Layer 3) to route packets across networks using logical IP addressing.

Network Switch: Incorrect. Standard switches operate at the Data Link Layer (Layer 2) to filter and forward frames using MAC addresses.

Gateway: Incorrect. Gateways typically function across the upper layers (Layers 4 through 7) to translate protocols between entirely different network architectures.

Further insights:

A network Hub is essentially a multi-port repeater. It takes signals in on one port, amplifies them, and blindly broadcasts them out to all other connected ports.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding asymmetric encryption and select the correct option:

Statement I: Data encrypted using a recipient's public key can only be decrypted using that same recipient's private key.

Statement II: Digital signatures are created by the sender encrypting a message hash with their own private key to ensure non-repudiation.
questions.question_hi:
असाममित एन्क्रिप्शन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें और सही विकल्प चुनें:

कथन I: प्राप्तकर्ता की सार्वजनिक कुंजी का उपयोग करके एन्क्रिप्ट किया गया डेटा केवल उसी प्राप्तकर्ता की निजी कुंजी का उपयोग करके डिक्रिप्ट किया जा सकता है।

कथन II: डिजिटल हस्ताक्षर प्रेषक द्वारा अपने स्वयं के निजी कुंजी से संदेश हैश को एन्क्रिप्ट करके बनाए जाते हैं ताकि गैर-इनकार सुनिश्चित किया जा सके।

options.label: A
options.text: Statement I is true but Statement II is false
options.text_hi: वक्तव्य I सही है लेकिन वक्तव्य II गलत है

options.label: B
options.text: Statement I is false but Statement II is true
options.text_hi: वक्तव्य I गलत है लेकिन वक्तव्य II सही है

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are true
options.text_hi: दोनों वक्तव्य I और वक्तव्य II सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are false
options.text_hi: दोनों वक्तव्य I और वक्तव्य II गलत हैं

questions.correct_text: Both Statement I and Statement II are true
questions.solution:
Statement I correctly describes public key confidentiality.

Statement II correctly defines how a digital signature provides integrity and authenticity via the sender's private key.

Further insights:

Because asymmetric algorithms (like RSA) are mathematically complex and slower, systems often use asymmetric encryption just to safely exchange a temporary "session key," which then handles the bulk data transfer via faster symmetric encryption.

questions.question: In Windows 11, which of the following keyboard shortcuts will instantly launch the Task Manager utility without needing any intermediate menu clicks?
questions.question_hi: Windows 11 में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कीबोर्ड शॉर्टकट बिना किसी मध्यवर्ती मेनू क्लिक के तुरंत टास्क मैनेजर यूटिलिटी लॉन्च करेगा?
questions.solution:
(a) Ctrl + Alt + Delete: Incorrect. This opens a full-screen secure system options menu where Task Manager is just one of several options.

(b) Ctrl + Shift + Esc: Correct. This shortcut bypasses intermediary choices and opens Task Manager immediately over your active screen.

(c) Windows Key + X: Incorrect. This opens the Quick Link / Power User menu, which provides text links to various advanced system settings.

(d) Alt + F4: Incorrect. This closes the currently active window or app, or opens the shutdown dialog if you are on the desktop.

Further insights:

Inside Task Manager, you can monitor live CPU, memory, disk, and network usage metrics, as well as disable programs that launch automatically during Windows startup.

questions.question: What will be the exact output of the Excel formula =LEN("Computer Awareness")?
questions.question_hi: Excel सूत्र =LEN("Computer Awareness") का सटीक आउटपुट क्या होगा?
questions.solution:
The LEN function counts every character inside the string, including letters, symbols, numbers, and spaces. Counting "Computer" (8) + space (1) + "Awareness" (9) equals 18 characters.

Further insights:

To clean up unexpected calculations caused by invisible trailing spaces in raw datasets, wrap your cell text inside the =TRIM() function before running character or lookup formulas.

questions.question: Which of the following serves as an intermediary to make requests on behalf of clients, hiding the client's internal identity, but is not primarily a rule-based perimeter filter?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा क्लाइंट की आंतरिक पहचान को छुपाते हुए क्लाइंट की ओर से अनुरोध करने के लिए एक मध्यस्थ के रूप में कार्य करता है, लेकिन मुख्य रूप से एक नियम-आधारित परिधीय फ़िल्टर नहीं है?
questions.solution:
(d) Proxy Server: Correct. A proxy serves as an intermediary to make requests on behalf of clients, hiding the client's internal identity, but is not primarily a rule-based perimeter filter.

(a) Domain Name System (DNS): Incorrect. DNS maps human-readable domain names (like www.google.com) to numeric IP addresses.

(b) Network Bridge: Incorrect. A bridge aggregates multiple network segments together into a single unified local area network.

(c) Firewall: Incorrect. Firewalls evaluate data packets against access control lists (ACLs) to block unauthorized intrusion attempts while allowing safe communications.

Further insights:

Modern Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) perform Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), looking beyond simple header filters to identify and block advanced malware payloads within the data stream.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT regarding the properties of Read-Only Memory (ROM)?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन रीड-ओनली मेमोरी (ROM) के गुणों के संबंध में गलत है?

options.label: A
options.text: ROM is non-volatile memory, meaning it retains data even when the computer is powered down.
options.text_hi: ROM एक गैर-वाष्पशील मेमोरी है, जिसका अर्थ है कि यह डेटा को तब भी बनाए रखता है जब कंप्यूटर बंद हो जाता है।

options.label: B
options.text: EEPROM is a type of ROM that can be erased and rewritten electrically within the computer.
options.text_hi: EEPROM ROM का एक प्रकार है जिसे कंप्यूटर के भीतर विद्युत रूप से मिटाया और पुनः लिखा जा सकता है।

options.label: C
options.text: The computer's primary operating system files (like the kernel) are permanently stored inside the main ROM chip for fast booting.
options.text_hi: कंप्यूटर की प्राथमिक ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम फाइलें (जैसे कर्नेल) तेज़ बूटिंग के लिए मुख्य ROM चिप के अंदर स्थायी रूप से संग्रहीत होती हैं।

options.label: D
options.text: PROM is a type of ROM that can be programmed exactly once by the user or manufacturer using a special device.
options.text_hi: PROM ROM का एक प्रकार है जिसे उपयोगकर्ता या निर्माता द्वारा एक विशेष उपकरण का उपयोग करके केवल A बार प्रोग्राम किया जा सकता है।

questions.correct_text: The computer's primary operating system files (like the kernel) are permanently stored inside the main ROM chip for fast booting.
questions.solution:
a) ROM is non-volatile memory...: Correct statement. It does not lose data when electricity cuts out.

b) EEPROM is a type of ROM...: Correct statement. Electrically Erasable Programmable ROM allows firmware updates without removing the chip.

c) The computer's primary operating system files... are permanently stored inside the main ROM chip: Incorrect statement. Operating system kernels are far too large for ROM chips and are instead stored on secondary storage (HDD/SSD) and loaded into RAM at boot. ROM only holds initialization code like BIOS/UEFI.

d) PROM is a type of ROM...: Correct statement. Programmable ROM chips leave the factory blank and can be written to exactly once.

Further insights:

The fundamental bootstrap loader program stored in ROM executes a power-on self-test (POST) to verify hardware integrity before locating and running the main OS from your storage drive.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is CORRECT regarding different printer technologies?

Statement A: Laser printers use static electricity to attract fine toner powder onto paper and bond it using heated rollers.

Statement B: Impact printers like dot-matrix printers use tiny ink nozzles to spray droplets directly onto pages.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन विभिन्न प्रिंटर तकनीकों के संबंध में सही है?

कथन A: लेजर प्रिंटर कागज पर सूक्ष्म टोनर पाउडर को आकर्षित करने के लिए स्थैतिक बिजली का उपयोग करते हैं और इसे गर्म रोलर्स का उपयोग करके जोड़ते हैं।

कथन B: डॉट-मैट्रिक्स जैसे इम्पैक्ट प्रिंटर पृष्ठों पर सीधे बूंदें छिड़कने के लिए छोटे स्याही नोजल का उपयोग करते हैं।

options.label: D
options.text_hi: न तो A और न ही B

questions.solution:
Statement A accurately describes the laser printing process.

Statement B is false because dot-matrix printers use mechanical pins striking an inked ribbon, whereas spraying ink droplets is the mechanic behind inkjet printers.

Further insights:

The heating assembly inside a laser printer that melts and bonds the plastic toner powder permanently onto the paper fibers is called the Fuser unit.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding secondary storage device operations:

Statement X: Solid State Drives (SSDs) read and write data mechanically using a spinning magnetic platter magnetic head configuration.

Statement Y: SSDs offer significantly faster read/write seek speeds and lower latency than traditional Hard Disk Drives (HDDs) because they have no moving parts.
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार करें जो द्वितीयक भंडारण उपकरण संचालन के बारे में हैं:

कथन X: सॉलिड स्टेट ड्राइव्स (SSDs) डेटा को यांत्रिक रूप से पढ़ते और लिखते हैं, जिसमें एक घूमने वाला चुंबकीय प्लेटर और चुंबकीय हेड कॉन्फ़िगरेशन होता है।

कथन Y: SSDs पारंपरिक हार्ड डिस्क ड्राइव्स (HDDs) की तुलना में काफी तेज़ पढ़ने/लिखने की गति और कम विलंबता प्रदान करते हैं क्योंकि इनमें कोई चलने वाले भाग नहीं होते।

options.label: A
options.text: Statement X is correct but Statement Y is incorrect
options.text_hi: वक्तव्य X सही है लेकिन वक्तव्य Y गलत है

options.label: B
options.text: Statement X is incorrect but Statement Y is correct
options.text_hi: वक्तव्य X गलत है लेकिन वक्तव्य Y सही है

options.label: C
options.text: Both Statement X and Statement Y are correct
options.text_hi: दोनों वक्तव्य X और Y सही हैं

options.label: D
options.text: Both Statement X and Statement Y are incorrect
options.text_hi: दोनों वक्तव्य X और Y गलत हैं

questions.correct_text: Statement X is incorrect but Statement Y is correct
questions.solution:
Statement X is incorrect but Statement Y is correct: Correct. Statement X is false because HDDs use mechanical platters and heads, while SSDs rely on solid-state flash memory. Statement Y is true, accurately highlighting the performance benefits of SSDs.

Further insights:

Because SSDs do not have mechanical read heads that need to physically move across disk tracks, their random data access speed remains uniform regardless of where the data blocks are located.

questions.question: Which of the following functions in MS Excel 365 returns the serial number of the current date and time, updating automatically whenever the worksheet is recalculated?
questions.question_hi: MS Excel 365 में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा फ़ंक्शन वर्तमान तिथि और समय का सीरियल नंबर लौटाता है, जो वर्कशीट के पुनः गणना होने पर स्वचालित रूप से अपडेट होता है?
questions.solution:
(a) =TODAY(): Incorrect. This function returns the current date only, with the time component set to midnight (e.g., 12:00 AM).

(b) =NOW(): Correct. The NOW function returns both the current system date and the precise time down to the minute, refreshing dynamically with recalculations.

(c) =DATE(): Incorrect. This function requires explicit arguments to construct a date: =DATE(year, month, day).

(d) =CURRENT(): Incorrect. This is not a standard standalone date/time function in Excel.

Further insights:

You can format the cell containing =NOW() using standard Custom formatting to display only the time component (hh:mm:ss) if the date stamp is not required.

questions.question: What will be the result of the Excel formula =REPLACE("Excel2026", 6, 4, "365")?
questions.question_hi: Excel सूत्र =REPLACE("Excel2026", 6, 4, "365") का परिणाम क्या होगा?
questions.solution:
(a) Excel365: Correct. The REPLACE function syntax is =REPLACE(old_text, start_num, num_chars, new_text). Starting at position 6 (the number "2"), it selects 4 characters ("2026") and replaces them entirely with the string "365".

(b) Exce365: Incorrect. This would occur if the replacement started at index position 5.

(c) Excel20365: Incorrect. This implies an insertion rather than a replacement of the target characters.

(d) #VALUE!: Incorrect.

Further insights:

If you want to swap specific characters everywhere they appear in a string without knowing their exact index position, use the =SUBSTITUTE() function instead.

questions.question: Which of the following terms describes the internal system software component that manages the physical allocation of resources, handles hardware inputs/outputs, and schedules processing tasks directly for the hardware?
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा शब्द आंतरिक सिस्टम सॉफ़्टवेयर घटक का वर्णन करता है जो संसाधनों के भौतिक आवंटन का प्रबंधन करता है, हार्डवेयर इनपुट/आउटपुट को संभालता है, और हार्डवेयर के लिए सीधे प्रसंस्करण कार्यों का समय निर्धारण करता है?
questions.solution:
(a) Application Interface: Incorrect. This layer provides a way for users or software programs to interact with high-level services.

(b) Operating System Kernel: Correct. The kernel is the core component of an Operating System. It has complete control over everything in the system, managing hardware interactions, memory management, and process scheduling.

(c) Device Driver Manager: Incorrect. This sub-system manages the specific translation files needed for peripheral add-ons, but does not control core system scheduling.

(d) Command Line Interpreter: Incorrect. Also known as the shell, this is an interface layer that translates text commands from the user into instructions the operating system can run.

Further insights:

The kernel runs in a privileged area of computer memory known as Kernel Mode (or Supervisor Mode) to shield critical system operations from user-level application bugs.

questions.question: When analyzing IPv4 addresses, which of the following represents a valid Class C IP address structure that could be assigned to a local host machine?
questions.question_hi: IPv4 पतों का विश्लेषण करते समय, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक वैध क्लास C IP पता संरचना का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जिसे एक स्थानीय होस्ट मशीन को सौंपा जा सकता है?
questions.solution:
(a) 10.0.0.5: Incorrect. This falls into the Class A range (1.0.0.0 to 126.255.255.255).

(b) 172.16.254.1: Incorrect. This falls into the Class B range (128.0.0.0 to 191.255.255.255).

(c) 192.168.1.50: Correct. Class C addresses span from 192.0.0.0 to 223.255.255.255.

(d) 224.0.0.1: Incorrect. This falls into Class D (224.0.0.0 to 239.255.255.255), which is reserved exclusively for multicast traffic.

Further insights:

The default subnet mask for a Class C network is 255.255.255.0, which allocates the first 24 bits for the network identity and leaves the remaining 8 bits for identifying individual host devices.

questions.question: A corporate accountant accidentally enters text strings into a column intended strictly for numerical currency formatting. Which MS Excel feature can be implemented beforehand to restrict data entry to numbers only and display a custom error message for text inputs?
questions.question_hi: एक कॉर्पोरेट अकाउंटेंट गलती से एक कॉलम में टेक्स्ट स्ट्रिंग्स दर्ज कर देता है जो केवल संख्यात्मक मुद्रा स्वरूपण के लिए निर्धारित है। कौन सा MS Excel फीचर पहले से लागू किया जा सकता है ताकि डेटा प्रविष्टि केवल संख्याओं तक सीमित रहे और टेक्स्ट इनपुट के लिए एक कस्टम त्रुटि संदेश प्रदर्शित हो?

options.label: C
options.text_hi: पाठ को स्तंभों में विभाजित करें

questions.solution:
(a) Conditional Formatting: Incorrect. This changes the visual appearance (color, font) of cells based on rules, but does not block input errors.

(b) Data Validation: Correct. The Data Validation tool sets hard constraints on what can be typed into a cell (e.g., decimals, integers, date ranges) and can block invalid entries with an alert.

(c) Text to Columns: Incorrect. This utility splits a single column of text into multiple columns based on a delimiter like a comma or space.

(d) Goal Seek: Incorrect. This is a what-if analysis tool used to find the input value needed to achieve a specific target formula result.

Further insights:

Data Validation rules can also be configured to provide a drop-down selection list directly inside the cell to prevent typos completely.
