questions.question:
Consider the following technical scenario and select the correct hardware explanation:

"A computer system experiences severe performance slowdowns when running multiple heavy applications simultaneously, though the storage drive is mostly empty. Upgrading the system's volatile memory capacity fixes the issue."

Which component was the primary bottleneck?
questions.question_hi:
निम्नलिखित तकनीकी परिदृश्य पर विचार करें और सही हार्डवेयर व्याख्या चुनें:

"एक कंप्यूटर सिस्टम जब एक साथ कई भारी अनुप्रयोग चलाता है तो गंभीर प्रदर्शन मंदी का सामना करता है, हालांकि स्टोरेज ड्राइव ज्यादातर खाली है। सिस्टम की अस्थायी मेमोरी क्षमता को बढ़ाने से समस्या ठीक हो जाती है।"

प्राथमिक बाधा कौन सा घटक था?
questions.solution:
(a) Hard Disk Drive space: Incorrect. The scenario notes that storage space is mostly empty, indicating disk space capacity was not the problem.

(b) Random Access Memory (RAM): Correct. When RAM fills up, the OS uses secondary storage as a slow alternative (virtual memory/swapping). Upgrading RAM keeps more application data in high-speed storage, fixing the bottleneck.

(c) Central Processing Unit (CPU) clock speed: Incorrect. While a faster clock speed speeds up computation processing, it does not fix issues caused by memory swapping.

(d) Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) cores: Incorrect. This component handles image processing, rendering, and complex parallel operations, not general multi-tasking data management.

Further insights:

The performance drop that occurs when a system spends more time swapping data between RAM and virtual memory disk storage than executing actual instructions is called Thrashing.

questions.question: Which application layer protocol uses port 22 by default to establish a secure, encrypted command-line shell session for managing remote server hosts?
questions.question_hi: कौन सा एप्लिकेशन लेयर प्रोटोकॉल डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से पोर्ट 22 का उपयोग करता है ताकि रिमोट सर्वर होस्ट्स के प्रबंधन के लिए एक सुरक्षित, एन्क्रिप्टेड कमांड-लाइन शेल सत्र स्थापित किया जा सके?
questions.solution:
(a) Telnet: Incorrect. Telnet establishes remote terminal access connections over port 23, but it sends data in plaintext, making it insecure.

(b) File Transfer Protocol (FTP): Incorrect. FTP uses ports 20 and 21 to transfer files between host architectures.

(c) Secure Shell (SSH): Correct. SSH provides secure encrypted communication channels over port 22 for remote logins and command executions.

(d) Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP): Incorrect. HTTP uses port 80 to transfer web page data without encryption.

Further insights:

To securely transfer files using SSH encryption mechanisms instead of basic FTP protocols, systems use SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol), which also defaults to port 22.

questions.question: In MS Word, if you want to ensure that a specific two-word phrase (e.g., "New Delhi") is never split across two lines when it reaches the end of a right margin, which keyboard shortcut should you insert between the words?
questions.question_hi: MS Word में, यदि आप यह सुनिश्चित करना चाहते हैं कि एक विशिष्ट दो-शब्द वाला वाक्यांश (जैसे, "New Delhi") कभी भी दो लाइनों में विभाजित न हो जब वह दाईं मार्जिन के अंत तक पहुंचता है, तो आपको शब्दों के बीच कौन सा कीबोर्ड शॉर्टकट डालना चाहिए?
questions.solution:
(a) Ctrl + Spacebar: Incorrect. This shortcut clears all manual character formatting from selected text, reverting it to the default style.

(b) Ctrl + Shift + Spacebar: Correct. This inserts a Non-breaking Space. It looks like a normal space but binds the adjacent words together so they stay on the same line.

(c) Shift + Enter: Incorrect. This inserts a soft return or manual line break, pushing text down immediately without creating a new paragraph block.

(d) Alt + Spacebar: Incorrect. This opens the system window management menu (Minimize, Maximize, Close) for the active window application.

Further insights:

Similarly, pressing Ctrl + Shift + Hyphen (-) inserts a non-breaking hyphen, which prevents hyphenated names or words from breaking across lines at word-wrap margins.

questions.question: In a computer processor, which specialized high-speed memory tracking component holds the condition codes or flag bits (such as Zero flag, Carry flag, and Overflow flag) resulting from the most recent ALU operation?
questions.question_hi: कंप्यूटर प्रोसेसर में, कौन सा विशेषीकृत उच्च-गति मेमोरी ट्रैकिंग घटक हाल की ALU ऑपरेशन से उत्पन्न स्थिति कोड या फ्लैग बिट्स (जैसे ज़ीरो फ्लैग, कैरी फ्लैग, और ओवरफ़्लो फ्लैc) को रखता है?
questions.solution:
Program Status Word (PSW): Correct. The PSW (also known as the Flags Register) contains various binary status bits that indicate the mathematical outcomes or errors of the last instruction executed.

Accumulator (AC): Incorrect. The accumulator temporarily holds the actual numeric data inputs or outputs of ALU operations.

Instruction Register (IR): Incorrect. The IR stores the instruction bitpattern currently being decoded.

Memory Buffer Register (MBR): Incorrect. This register caches data traveling directly to or from physical RAM addresses.

Further insights:

Conditional branching instructions (like JZ for Jump if Zero) read these flag states inside the PSW directly to decide whether the execution path should change.

questions.question: In MS Word, which of the following layout commands inserts an explicit breaking marker that forces all text following it to move to the top of the next vertical text column on a multi-column page layout?
questions.question_hi: एमएस वर्ड में, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा लेआउट कमांड एक स्पष्ट ब्रेकिंग मार्कर डालता है जो इसके बाद का सारा टेक्स्ट एक बहु-स्तंभ पृष्ठ लेआउट पर अगले ऊर्ध्वाधर टेक्स्ट स्तंभ के शीर्ष पर ले जाने के लिए मजबूर करता है?
questions.solution:
(a) Page Break: Incorrect. A standard Page Break pushes all subsequent text to the start of the next blank page, ignoring column divisions.

(b) Column Break: Correct. A Column Break ends the current text column early and moves the insertion point to the top of the next column on the same page.

(c) Text Wrapping Break: Incorrect. This is used in web layouts or around images to separate text from wrapped graphics, moving text to the next line down.

(d) Continuous Section Break: Incorrect. This starts a new section layout block on the exact same page, which is used to change column counts mid-page.

Further insights:

The direct keyboard shortcut to quickly insert a standard Page Break without using the Layout tab menus is Ctrl + Enter.

questions.question: In MS PowerPoint, which presentation feature allows you to add special visual motion execution steps to an individual object (like a specific image, shape, or text line) on a slide, rather than controlling the switch between slides?
questions.question_hi: MS PowerPoint में, कौन सा प्रस्तुति फीचर आपको स्लाइड पर एक व्यक्तिगत ऑब्जेक्ट (जैसे एक विशिष्ट छवि, आकृति, या टेक्स्ट लाइन) पर विशेष दृश्य गति निष्पादन चरण जोड़ने की अनुमति देता है, बजाय स्लाइड्स के बीच स्विच को नियंत्रित करने के?
questions.solution:
(a) Slide Transitions: Incorrect. Transitions dictate the full-screen visual effect that plays when moving from one slide to another.

(b) Custom Animations: Correct. Animation effects apply specifically to individual elements within a single slide, categorized into Entrance, Emphasis, Exit, and Motion Path paths.

(c) Slide Themes: Incorrect. This controls the global palette schemes, background configurations, and typography definitions for the entire slide deck.

(d) Rehearse Timings: Incorrect. This utility tracks how long you spend presenting each slide to practice and automate slide delivery tempos.

Further insights:

You can use the Animation Pane side panel to re-order your custom animation sequences, control execution delays, or set objects to trigger automatically with or after previous elements.
